Unleash your fears in a fourth-wall-breaking platformer that will leave you questioning allegiances... and reality itself.

Let the hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack and meticulously designed pixel art engulf you in paranormal encounters, impossible glitches, psychological horror, and the nostalgia of classic side-scrolling games.

Enjoy the guidance of A.I.D.E. and a very kind and morally right "Dev," who'll be there to assist players every step of the way. The companions also help give an eerie charm to the surreal experience of playing this unique game. Players also encounter eccentric characters, scary creatures, and unsettling corruptions along their journey.

Experience terror as you navigate nightmarish yet fair platforming challenges with precision and dread. The old-school hard gameplay is reminiscent of classic games that are hard to put down, preparing the brain for the kind of scares that make most analog horror media effective.

Dive into thrilling meta-horror that defies the boundaries of the creepypasta digital horror genre, blending fear and suspense into a truly surreal experience. In DERE Vengeance, the player is part of the story.

Embrace the perfect blend of nightmare and adventure in this story-rich platformer that promises genuine scares and enjoyable gameplay. You can embark on DERE Vengeance without playing our other games, though not advisable, as this terrifying adventure stands on its own with a unique and intriguing experience.

games.name: Cursed Mansion
games.summary: Cursed Mansion is a horror adventure RPG that focuses on nuances and eerie feelings which happens throughout the adventure.

games.name: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator
games.summary: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator is a 2.5D first-person adventure mystery game where you play as an investigator who solves cases by taking pictures of cryptids, urban legends, & mythological creatures as well as befriending them in an open-world environment

games.name: Livingmare Cold Calls
games.summary: Your only fear is the fear of the unknown.

games.name: Chiyo
games.summary: Chiyo is a first-person hardcore escape room horror game set in Japan's Edo era. As Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator possessing supernatural abilities, you are tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark history and it's ultimate secret.

games.name: River God: Enshrouded Current
games.summary: Embark on a journey with "River God: Enshrouded Current," where an ancient village battles a curse woven into its very fabric. Uncover the secrets of a malevolent priest whose dark rituals connect the village to a realm beyond life.

games.name: Terminal Error
games.summary: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

games.name: Jigoku Train
games.summary:
Waking up to an unfamiliar place, what course of action will you choose?

Play as Ling, your average office worker having her usual shifts and living her usual life, woke up on the train one night, finding that she was not going to head to her usual destinations.

Not only that, you will also play another character! He wakes up with no memories on a train heading towards an unknown location. Grant is your average amnesiac guy.

Where are they heading, and what can they do in order to head back home? Or is there even any way home?

games.name: My Lovely Empress
games.summary: My Lovely Empress is a empire management sim inspired by Asian mythology. As the Emperor of the Crimson Empire, you will build relations with neighboring rulers, balance internal factions, and ensure the prosperity of your people, all before you reap their souls to resurrect your beloved empress.

games.name: Winter Night
games.summary: "Winter Night" presents a story inspired by beliefs in Thailand. Players will experience the atmosphere of an ancient, mysterious mansion.presented through 2D PixelArt.

games.name: The Cope
games.summary: The Cope is a 2D, point-and-click game that presents the fear of the unknown. Your night shift client service job as a janitor will start with you getting entangled in a series of strange stories in The Cope mansion. Work cleaning and serving your client and find the truth of this mansion of fear.

games.name: Devilated
games.summary: Devilated is a timeslowing, monster blasting, boomer shooter with RPG pretensions, buckets of blood and a dose of ultraviolence.

games.name: Taken Soul
games.summary: Taken Soul is a survival horror game developed by SOGA Studio. The protagonist play in third-person perspective, he must navigate through dangerous and tense situations, try to survive till the sun rises, and fight against dark forces to investigate the disappearance of his mother and sister.

games.name: Parasomnia
games.summary: What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

games.name: Town of Illustive
games.summary: A group of students from Falica High School have been dared by their classmate and class president Wade Severstone. Solving the mysteries that spread from generation to generation once and for all.

games.name: Left Behind
games.summary: Left Behind is a hyper-realistic psychological horror game where you take on the role of a real estate agent with a client looking to sell you a property. Instead of a straightforward and quick interaction with the client, you find yourself thrust into a deeply unsettling and frightening situation.

games.name: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare
games.summary: Guilty: Takiko's Nightmare is a single-player story-based game. Play as Takiko to explore several areas inside her unique reality. Players can interact with various objects, solve puzzles, fight enemies, or discover some unreal phenomena.

games.name: Frequency of Fear
games.summary:
"FREQUENCY OF FEAR" is a third-person, episodic psychological horror game that drags you into the disctrict of Halimun, a village that used to be known for it's mysticism, folklore, and secrets. Are you brave enough to find out? Discover what's still there in Halimun District!

Play as Maya, an aspiring urban explorer. Break taboos, film forbidden places, and explore the district of Halimun. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, but be careful. Some curses don’t wait to be believed. Stay hidden, and don’t get caught!

games.name: Vague
games.summary: Vague is a first-person psychological horror inspired by early 2000s classic horror titles. Experience the unsettling atmosphere as you follow Raymond K. Fisher in his search for his missing family.

games.name: Sekala
games.summary: Experience a gripping narrative journey in this survival horror hack-and-slash adventure. Follow Kala, a college student trapped in a trauma related to death, as he tries to survive encounters with morbid creatures.

games.name: Project Unseek
games.summary: Project Unseek is a 2v6 class-based asymmetrical online multiplayer horror game inspired by 80s slasher horror movies, SCP urban legend, and Science Fiction, where you compete against each other to survive the experiment as High Schoolers or Mythical Creatures.

games.name: The Anomalous Hour
games.summary: You are alone in a deserted station. Or are you? Take pictures of strange anomalies around the station and you might find a way out.

games.name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
games.summary: "Thou Shalt Not Kill" is a VHS-style first-person walking simulator horror game. You play as Angel, a girl traveling through the forest who finds a VHS tape lying on the ground. She starts watching it, only to discover that the footage is unsettling and tells a mysterious story. As you watch the entire tape, you realize this is no ordinary VHS footage, and you are shocked by its revelations.

games.name: Spooky Pixel Hero
games.summary: A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge.

games.name: MimiCries
games.summary: Investigate the mysteries of a haunted mansion as you solve various challenging puzzles in this Victorian-inspired, narrative-driven escape room game. With only your wit and a lantern to light the way forward, will the choices you make seal your fate, or open the path to freedom?

games.name: Pryzm
games.summary: A survival adventure mystery with turn-based combat and escape parameters that change with every new 1 to 2-hour run. A visual novel that can be played like a speedrun.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Scary In The Journey
games.summary: Scary In is a Co-op Horror game, set in the post-apocalyptic future due to radiation called Solar, and you have to live in underground station where it connect to all the world station. Travel with friends, many solar entity lurking around, and you have to solve puzzle, Start your journey now!

games.name: Nightmare Side: The Game
games.summary: Indonesian horror game set in Ardan Radio station from Bandung. Don't listen to Nightmare Side alone, or you'll invite the darkness.

games.name: DeMyth
games.summary: DeMyth is a short puzzle game inspired by Helltaker. In it, you Interact with cute demit girls to find your missing aunt in the Astral Realm.

games.name: Jurnal Malam: Bestfriend
games.summary: In this game, players will play the role of Afdal, a person whose fate is the opposite of Rahmad's, so one night Rahmad asks Afdal to help look after the house, but unfortunately, everything is not fine, because of the terror that Afdal is experiencing.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: Onward: Asylum
games.summary: Going onwards as we escape this horrific asylum— an indie 2D horror sidescroller where your task is to get out of the facility without getting captured by the monster itself.

games.name: Disconnect
games.summary: Late-night call with your friend keeps on DISCONNECTING. What'd you do if your friend wasn't who you thought they were?

games.name: La Perlas
games.summary: A survival horror set in the Philippines.

games.name: Deal of the Dead Final Cut
games.summary: Deal of the Dead: Final Cut is a Solitaire-style, survival horror, card game rendered in a unique, hand-drawn, art style. Fight your way through randomly shuffled decks of cards and escape from a zombie-infested city set in a post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Demon Guardian
games.summary:
Four girls and a newbie witch doctor explore their friend's haunted house. Although welcoming at first glance, the house shows its true colors when night falls...

Based on the ghosts and beliefs of Thai folklore, Demon Guardian is a visual novel with multiple endings, told from the perspective of Pim, a girl who attract spirits. She quickly drew the attention of the new transfer student, who seems to have a ton of these spirits under his control...

games.name: Unreal Life
games.summary:
After losing her memories, the girl could only remember one name—"Miss Sakura".
She set out to find Miss Sakura, aided by a talking traffic light, and by the power to read the memories of the things she touched.

"Unreal Life" is the story of her journey.
Compare memories of the past with the present, solve mysteries, and follow the girl and the traffic light in this atmospheric puzzle adventure game.

Follow the memories, follow the path, and what you will find is...

games.name: World for Two
games.summary: A sudden catastrophe has led life on Earth to the verge of extinction. The Professor, the only survivor, spent years performing research in an underground laboratory trying to recreate life. The energy he needs to do this can only be harvested outdoors, where he himself cannot go. He therefore created an android to help him. Plants are the only living things left in this world where human civilization is no more. It is cruel, but beautiful. The Professor and the android embark on a quest to bring animals back to the planet. This is a tale of creating life on a dead planet. World for Two is coming to Nintendo Switch! The animations for all creatures have been redrawn, to help them come alive even better. Once you complete the main story, you will be able to enjoy “Chapter 0”, a new special story that includes new art and music and will tell you more about the Professors’s past. And as an added bonus, once you complete the game, you will unlock the option to change the main story’s soundtrack to a fascinating new version played by a piano quintet (piano, two violins, viola and violoncello)

games.name: GenEi AP: Empty Heart
games.summary:
Travel through the world of Harumakigohan in a quest for music.

”What are you listening to, Mikage?”
Spica is looking for something to listen to, and Mikage, the protagonist, goes on a journey in a mysterious world to search for songs that will please her friend.

What’s behind that last door? What is that heartbeat you can hear?

games.name: Ghostpia Season One
games.summary:
"Ghostpia" is a visual novel with cute visuals that look like a picture book, adorned with glitches and noise, and characterized by nostalgic expressions!

This game is a more expressive and interactive reimagining of the visual novel "Ghostpia" that has been released on the App Store and web platforms.

games.name: Mindhack
games.summary: "Mindhack" is a text adventure game that turns the villain's head into a flower garden.

games.name: Ou
games.summary:
"Between somewhere and someone."
U-chronia is a mysterious world constantly changing like a book whose pages are flipped out of order. You will wear the shoes of OU, the protagonist, to live through this game-shaped experience—without knowing what it really is.

games.name: Recolit
games.summary: Recolit is a pixel art mystery adventure game where you explore a strange town by following the trails of "light". Help out the mysterious residents of the town by using items illuminated by the "light" to progress through the story.

games.name: Piggy One Super Spark
games.summary: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

games.name: Moonless Moon
games.summary: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

games.name: Machina of the Farthest
games.summary: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

games.name: From_.
games.summary:
Mr. Postman sails his small boat through watery Aquaria, delivering letters day in and day out.

One day, he awakes to find something strange and unbelievable following him, just as a dark rumor begins to spread through Aquaria.

As the letters he delivers bring writer and reader together, the truth begins to come into focus.

games.name: Chikaro
games.summary: A boy and an android girl wake up without their memories in a world where deadly robots roam the streets. With the boy's powers, they can leave their bodies to walk through walls or possess enemies. The two follow the trail of the intentions left behind by those who once perished above the ground.

games.name: Kitsune: The Journey of Adashino
games.summary: "Where will their light lead them?" Kitsune is a fox girl who finds herself on Adashino Island and starts travelling with her Frog friend. Neon signs give light and color to the island with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Something is lurking in the shadows, inching ever closer...

events.name: Nintendo Direct [JP]: Partner Showcase + Indie World Showcase - 8.27.2024
events.description: Join us on August 27 at 7am PT for an Indie World Showcase followed by a Nintendo Direct: Partner Showcase! The livestream, featuring both presentations back-to-back, will be roughly 40 minutes in total. Please note, there will be no mention of the Nintendo Switch successor during either of these presentations.

games.name: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo
games.summary: Balatro: Friends of Jimbo enables players to customise their decks with new cosmetic card skins featuring characters from The Witcher 3, Dave the Diver, Vampire Survivors, and Among Us.

games.name: Neva
games.summary:
Neva is an action-adventure game developed by Nomada Studio and published by Devolver Digital.
The gameplay combines side-scrolling platforming with environmental puzzles and combat.
Neva has been praised for its stunning art style, emotional storytelling, and refined gameplay mechanics, building upon the foundation laid by GRIS.

games.name: Moth Kubit
games.summary: This is an RPG about corporate life as an ordinary insect. Our protagonist, Moth Kubit, has just been promoted, and all of a sudden embarks on a weird adventure in a megacorp to redeem (or eradicate) himself, his bug-ddies and the company before the mysterious "Final Process" arrives.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker
games.summary: This Sea of Stars DLC finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator: Shrek Special Pack
games.summary:
Playtime is ogre. Get to work cleaning up five fairy tale maps inspired by DreamWorks Animation’s Shrek. It’ll take more than pixie dust to restore these iconic locales to their former lustre, but thankfully, happily ever after is in your hands!

Like onions, dirt has layers. And boy, this particular brew of filth is potent enough to rival even the Fairy Godmother’s strongest concoctions. A sprinkle of soap, a touch of elbow grease and a large dose of ‘DING’s make for the perfect antidote potion! Wash it all down with a swish of high-pressure water and you’ll have these enchanting locations looking as spotless as the Magic Mirror.

games.name: Morsels
games.summary: Morsels is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

games.name: Date Everything!
games.summary: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

games.name: Peglin
games.summary: Peglin is a Pachinko Roguelike - Fight enemies by collecting special orbs and popping pegs to deal damage. Acquire special relics that radically change the game and ensure no two runs are the same. Aim carefully to survive in this unique turn-based RPG!

games.name: Wobbly Life
games.summary: Wobbly Life is a lively open world physics based sandbox. Play with your friends in Online and local co-op, discover a variety of minigames and objectives to earn cash to spend in the world!

games.name: Pico Park 2
games.summary: PICO PARK is back with all new levels! Play with 2-8 players locally or online in this co-op action-puzzle game!

games.name: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX
games.summary: Shovel Knight: Shovel of Hope DX is an enhanced edition of the pixel-perfect adventure. Jump, battle foes, and dig up treasure as you quest to defeat the Order of No Quarter and The Enchantress. DX adds 20 playable characters, online multiplayer, and new features like rewind and save states.

games.name: Europa
games.summary: On the moon Europa, a lush terraformed paradise in Jupiter’s shadow, an android named Zee sets out in search of answers. Run, glide and fly across the landscape, solve mysteries in the ruins of a fallen utopia, and discover the story of the last human alive.

games.name: Cuisineer
games.summary: Explore the world of Cuisineer as you enter dungeons and defeat monsters to get vital ingredients to cook delicious food to serve at your restaurant in this super cute and tasty rogue-lite dungeon crawler!

games.name: On Your Tail
games.summary: Embark on an intriguing seaside getaway you’ll never forget in On Your Tail, a sleuthy story-driven 3D life sim of relaxation, investigation, and knowing how to play your cards right.

games.name: Metal Slug Tactics
games.summary: METAL SLUG makes an explosive return! Dive into this dynamic tactical RPG with a roguelite thrill and experience the iconic run'n'gun action of the original series, redefined. Grab your weapons, assemble your squad and conquer the battlefield to defeat the infamous Rebel Army.

games.name: The Plucky Squire
games.summary: Storybook characters discover a three-dimensional world outside the pages of their book and must jump between 2D & 3D realms to save their friends in this charming action-adventure.

games.name: Pizza Tower
games.summary: Pizza Tower is a 2D platformer mainly inspired by Wario Land and Earthworm Jim. The game has over-the-top hand-drawn animations and music. You play as Peppino Spaghetti, a manic pizza man with many abilities like charging, super jumping and dashing. Peppino has to go up each floor of the tower by finding keys, saving toppins folks and getting as many points as possible!

games.name: Tetris Forever
games.summary:
Tetris Forever celebrates the original, genre-inspiring puzzle game that escaped from behind the Iron Curtain, onto the world stage, and into our cultural consciousness.

More than 15 playable classic games from the series' history are featured, including many being released for the first time outside Japan. Battle your friends in the multiplayer cult favorite Tetris Battle Gaiden, create massive explosions to clear lines in Super Bombliss, and see where it all began in 1984 with an accurate recreation of the first version of Tetris on the Electronika 60 computer.

games.name: Tetris
games.summary: Tetris is a puzzle video game created by Soviet software engineer Alexey Pajitnov in the mid-1980s. Players arrange falling pieces made of four connected blocks, called tetrominoes, into complete horizontal lines within a rectangular playfield. Completed lines disappear and award points, while the speed of the falling pieces increases over time. The game ends when stacked pieces reach the top of the field. With over 520 million sales across approximately 220 versions and at least 70 platforms, it is the second-best-selling video game series.

games.name: Tetris 99
games.summary:
A blockbuster battle royale!
99 players but only one will remain! Tetris 99 is the iconic puzzle game as you've never seen it before. Can you pick the right strategy to best 98 other players online - all at the same time?!

games.name: Star Overdrive
games.summary: Use your powers to explore a massive world on your Hoverboard at lightning speed, face multitudes of enemies and epic bosses. Journey through four uniquely distinct biomes, each brimming with challenges and secrets to uncover.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3
games.summary: Pilgor’s baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; a totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage together, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends.

games.name: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
games.summary: A remake of the first installment in the main Trails series, serving as the beginning to the Liberl arc and the series as a whole. The game follows protagonists Estelle Bright and her adopted brother Joshua, who journey through the country of Liberl to train to become senior Bracers, members of a non-government multinational organization that acts to keep the peace and protect civilians.

games.name: Star Wars: Hunters - Season 3: Echoes of the Rebellion
games.summary: Season 3 is starting to heat up—or should we say ice up? Highlights include: the arrival of Pilbush, the new Hoth Frontline battlefield, the Season 3 Arena Pass, Emotes, new Limited Time Events, the return of Boulder Bash, and much more!

games.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Legends of the Zone Trilogy
games.summary: A bundle of the first three S.T.A.L.K.E.R. games released on consoles for the first time.

games.name: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition
games.summary: Worms Armageddon: Anniversary Edition is a modern release of the 1999 classic, including cross-generation console online play for up to 6 players.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley
games.summary: Explore a world filled with the magic of Disney as you discover rich stories and build the perfect neighbourhood alongside Disney and Pixar Heroes and Villains in this new life-sim adventure game. Welcome to Disney Dreamlight Valley.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: The Patrick Star Game
games.summary: Patrick fans, your time has come – and Bikini Bottom is your open-world playground! You can skydive with just a parasol (or nothing at all), search for buried treasure in the Dump, or release the rage in Mrs. Puff’s Rage Room. Use almost any item you find, - from the reef blower to a paint can, - to make the world more Patrick. And take on challenges only Patrick would attempt, set by up SpongeBob, Sandy Cheeks, Mr. Krabs, and more. So become the Star of the show, put your silliest ideas into action, and enjoy the physics-based chaos that unfolds all around you!

games.name: Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer
games.summary: Start your fitness journey with Fitness Boxing 3: Your Personal Trainer for Nintendo Switch!

games.name: Capcom Fighting Collection 2
games.summary:
Capcom's newest fighting collection hits the stage!

Choose from fan-favorite games like Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001 and Project Justice to 3D action games like Power Stone and Power Stone 2 in this collection of eight classic fighting games!

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!

Get back in the ring and duke it out in battles that everyone rumored, but no one believed!
Whether it's with a rival new or old, give it your all and strive for victory!

games.name: Marvel vs. Capcom Fighting Collection: Arcade Classics
games.summary: The legendary crossover hits are back! The action-packed lineup consisting of seven unique titles, is full of heavy hitters like X-MEN VS. STREET FIGHTER, and MARVEL vs. CAPCOM 2 New Age of Heroes. The collection also includes the rare beat 'em up game, THE PUNISHER.

games.name: Atelier Yumia: The Alchemist of Memories & the Envisioned Land
games.summary:
In a world where alchemy is deemed "taboo", the alchemist Yumia yearns for the "truth" that lies hidden in the ruined continent.
Now, she takes her first steps on a grand adventure across the continent─

games.name: Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars
games.summary: A hero's destiny is written in the Stars. The legendary Konami JRPGs Suikoden I and Suikoden II have now been remastered in HD!

games.name: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake
games.summary:
The Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake is a modernized turn-based JRPG that follows a hero’s quest to defeat the archfiend Baramos. It features updated HD-2D visuals and an orchestral score while maintaining the original's prequel narrative and non-linear world exploration.
The core mechanics center on a vocation system for party customization, now including the new Monster Wrangler class. Modern updates like adjustable battle speeds and difficulty settings streamline the traditional experience of leveling characters and managing strategic combat.

games.name: Castlevania Dominus Collection
games.summary: Three incredible action adventure games from the Castlevania series have finally returned, for the first time! But wait, there's more! Haunted Castle Revisited, a redesigned version of the very first Castlevania arcade game, makes its debut!

games.name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
games.summary: Rule as one of many legendary leaders from throughout history. Establish your civilization, construct cities and architectural wonders to expand your territory, conquer or cooperate with rival civilizations in pursuit of prosperity, and explore the far reaches of the unknown world. Will you build an empire that stands the test of time?

games.name: Tales of Graces F Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Graces f Remastered is an action RPG with high-speed battles that allow you to switch between fighting styles to match your play style. The remastered title adds more than 80 DLC packs and items release for the original and features stunning visuals, newly localized scenes available in English for the first time, and notable quality of life enhancements such as auto-save.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Help Wanted 2
games.summary:
Find out if you have what it takes to be a Fazbear Entertainment Superstar!

Five Nights at Freddy’s: Help Wanted 2 is the sequel to the terrifying VR experience that brought new life to the iconic horror franchise. As a brand new Fazbear employee you’ll have to prove you have what it takes to excel in all aspects of Pizzeria management and maintenance.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach - Ruin
games.summary:
You can run, but you can’t hide…

Enter the ruins of Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex in the FREE story DLC for Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach!

Gregory is once again trapped in the now abandoned Pizzaplex, and he needs your help! Play as Cassie, Gregory’s best friend, Faz-fanatic, and would-be savior as she braves the dark, dreary, and dilapidated pizzeria. Armed with only a Faz-Wrench, a Roxy-Talky, and this weird bunny mask, you will have to help Cassie find her friend, free him, and safely escape the ruins.

Can you save your friend, yourself, and the Pizzaplex? Find out in the 100% free DLC, Five Nights at Freddy’s: Security Breach – Ruin.

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Tales of the Shire
games.summary: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings Game.

games.name: Just Dance 2025 Edition
games.summary:
Get your friends and family together to let loose on Just Dance! To party, exercise, or create special family moments, Just Dance 2025 Edition has something for everyone, with 40 hot new songs.

Need a fun way to exercise? Start your own routine with the Workout Mode and keep yourself motivated by tracking the calories burnt and the time spent dancing. Use Workout Mode to enjoy a dance workout in solo or with your family and friends!

games.name: Funko Fusion
games.summary: Funko Fusion is a third-person action game that’s all about celebrating fandom. Play with some of your favorite characters from across TV, movies, games, and comics, and explore handcrafted worlds inspired by Jurassic World, Back to the Future, JAWS, The Thing, Chucky, Battlestar Galactica, Hot Fuzz, The Umbrella Academy, Five Nights at Freddy’s, Masters of the Universe, Invincible, and many more!

games.name: EA Sports FC 25
games.summary: EA SPORTS FC 25 gives you more ways to win for the club. Team up with friends in your favourite modes with the new 5v5 Rush, and manage your club to victory as FC IQ delivers more tactical control than ever before.

games.name: LEGO Horizon Adventures
games.summary:
LEGO Horizon Adventures is an action-adventure game developed by Guerrilla Games and Studio Gobo, blending the Horizon series setting with LEGO-style visuals and humour.
Players follow a retelling of Aloy’s story as she travels across a post-apocalyptic world inhabited by machine creatures. Gameplay includes exploration, combat, puzzle-solving, and cooperative play.

games.name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
games.summary: The classic action-RPG and life-simulation gameplay, beloved by Rune Factory fans across the globe, is taken in a bold new direction in Guardians of Azuma. This all-new adventure takes place in the never-before-seen eastern country of Azuma where you will assume the Earth Dancer powers and fight against the spreading Blight to bring hope back to this once-prosperous land.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami
games.summary: Yakuza: Kiwami is an enhanced remake of the original Yakuza game for PlayStation 2, not just an HD port. While the original PS2 release also had English voice-acting for western release, this PS4 remake only retains Japanese voice-acting for authenticity with available subtitles for other countries.

games.name: MySims: Cozy Bundle
games.summary: A bundle containing MySims and MySims Kingdom.

games.name: Balatro
games.summary: Balatro is a deck-building roguelite in which players construct poker hands to earn chips and overcome enemy blinds. The game features mechanics for enhancing a deck of playing cards, purchasing Jokers that modify hand effects, and discovering synergies to progress through increasingly challenging encounters.

games.name: Animal Well
games.summary: What lurks beneath the surface of this deceptively minimalistic adventure? In Animal Well there is more than what you see. Explore a dense interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter creatures both beautiful and unsettling, and try to survive what lurks in the dark.

games.name: Platform 8
games.summary: You are trapped on a train that runs forever. Keep an eye out for anomalies and find a way out.

games.name: The Exit 8
games.summary: You are trapped in an endless underground passageway. Take a good look around and find a way to escape.

games.name: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game
games.summary:
All players approach games in varied ways, making different choices.

No one ever plays in exactly the same way. Indeed, how a person plays can be an indicator of their personality...

And Refind Self is a game where you can learn all about that personality.

games.name: Q2 Humanity
games.summary: he smash hit game “Q REMASTERED”, which became extremely popular amongst users in Japan in early 2023, is now coming back! "Q2 HUMANITY" is finally available as Early Access! In "Q2" the sequel to "Q1" you can play as a character yourself. You can fly, jump, run, draw, grab, throw, and so on.

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

games.name: Animal Tower Battle
games.summary: A fun and easy battle game for all ages, with simple rules and controls, playable online and offline!

games.name: Shiren the Wanderer 6: Toguro Island Exploration Record Plus Pack
Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
games.summary: EUREKA! Miles Edgeworth moves beyond the courtroom and straight to the crime scene in Ace Attorney Investigations Collection with revamped graphics, new language options, bonus features, and more! Featuring two remastered titles - Ace Attorney Investigations: Miles Edgeworth and the Western debut of Ace Attorney Investigations 2: Prosecutor's Gambit - it's a perfect package.

games.name: The Hokkaido Serial Murder Case: The Okhotsk Disappearance - Memories in Ice, Tearful Figurine
games.summary:
The legendary Okhotsk Disappearance... is coming back.

A Nipopo doll sheds a tear—another soul is sheds its mortal coil.
One morning, a man's body is found floating in the Tokyo bay.
He's estimated to be in his forties.
But the incident doesn't stop here. It moves to Hokkaido's cities: Kushiro, Abashiri, Shiretoko, Monbetsu...
A second and third murder link the northern island to Tokyo.

The Okhotsk Disappearance is a graphic adventure game where you play as a police detective.
Your job is to find the truth behind the serial murders with the help of your subordinates.
To do so, you have a command interface with 14 actions, such as "Change Location" and "Ask someone".

games.name: Kamaitachi no Yoru x3
games.summary: ​Kamaitachi no Yoru x3 is a collection commemorating the 30th anniversary of the renowned sound novel series "Kamaitachi no Yoru." This compilation includes the main stories of "Kamaitachi no Yoru," "Kamaitachi no Yoru 2," and the series' third and final installment, "Kamaitachi no Yoru x3." Even newcomers can fully enjoy the series, as the relationships between characters and past incidents are thoroughly explored. ​

games.name: Sword Art Online: Fractured Daydream
games.summary: In this online co-op action game, enter a distorted version of the SWORD ART ONLINE world. Pick your role in the form of favorite SWORD ART ONLINE characters and team up with 20 players for raids to defeat powerful enemies.

games.name: Kill The Crows
games.summary: "Kill The Crows" is a fast-paced top-down arena shooter set in the twisted western era. A gunslinger burning with vengeance steps into the ruins of a forsaken town, ready to face death. Prepare for one-shot, one-kill gunfights using classic revolvers and fanning techniques.

games.name: Tokimeki Memorial: Forever with You - Emotional
The Hundred Line: Last Defense Academy
games.summary: A new adventure from the creators of the Danganronpa and Zero Escape series! 15 students are tasked with defending a school from grotesque monsters for 100 days. Can they make it to the end? And will they survive long enough to uncover the truth?

games.name: Stray Children
games.summary: “The Olders, they come to eat the Children…” All of the adults have become monsters, the rumors say. Nowhere is safe outside these walls. Welcome to Stray Children — a bittersweet, fairy tale RPG, created by many of the same people behind beloved cult-classics like Chulip, Little King’s Story, Rule of Rose, Super Mario RPG, and, of course, Moon: Remix RPG Adventure.

games.name: Doraemon Dorayaki Shop Story
games.summary:
A game where you run a sweets shop with the popular manga character Doraemon. Let's make Doraemon's favorite dorayaki and create a store that will be the talk of the town.

First, make the sweets, set up the shelves, prepare the tables, and get ready to run the shop. In addition, various characters from Fujiko・F・Fujio's works will appear as customers.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
games.summary:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a full remake of the groundbreaking non-linear RPG Romancing SaGa 2, which originally launched in Japan in 1993.

Embark on an adventure featuring both new and classic SaGa franchise features, complete with Japanese and English voiceovers, original and rearranged compositions, and much more! This is an ideal entry point for new players and provides an amped-up experience for longtime fans.

games.name: Romance of the Three Kingdoms 8 Remake
games.summary: Theater of war, infinite drama. A masterpiece of historical simulation, "ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS 8" is revived after 20 years! Enjoy the greatest military drama in the series, with the largest number of officers and scenarios, including an improved "All Officers Play" feature.

games.name: Farmagia
games.summary: Command an army of monsters in this all-new action game featuring character designs by famed manga artist Hiro Mashima. Take a stand to free the people of Felicidad as a Farmagia named Ten when monster farming, adventure, and hectic battles come together in an epic tale of rebellion and friendship.

games.name: Stray
games.summary:
Stray is a third-person cat adventure game set amidst the detailed neon-lit alleys of a decaying cybercity and the murky environments of its seedy underbelly. Roam surroundings high and low, defend against unforeseen threats and solve the mysteries of this unwelcoming place inhabited by nothing but unassuming droids and dangerous creatures.

See the world through the eyes of a stray and interact with the environment in playful ways. Be stealthy, nimble, silly, and sometimes as annoying as possible with the strange inhabitants of this foreign world.

games.name: Beyblade X Xone
games.summary: 'BEYBLADE X XONE is a "Beyblade action" game that faithfully recreates the BEYBLADE X series (distributed by TOMY Company, Ltd.) that is popular among fans of all ages. Battle through intense Beybattles and aim for the top of The X!

games.name: Fairy Tail 2
games.summary: The sequel to the 2020 "FAIRY TAIL" console game has finally arrived! Play as Fairy Tail guild members such as protagonists Natsu or Lucy, and experience first-hand how the dramatic events unfold in the series' climactic Alvarez Empire Arc. Enjoy epic battles against Zeref, the Emperor of the Alvarez Empire, his team of elites, the Spriggan 12, and the Black Dragon Acnologia.

games.name: Nour: Play with Your Food
games.summary: Nour is an experimental food art game designed to make you hungry. Free from the constraints of scores, time limits, and realism, Nour lets you play with your food as if you're a kid again, with no mess to clean up.

games.name: Despelote
games.summary: Despelote is a soccer game about people. Get immersed in the streets and parks of Quito through the eyes and ears of eight year old Julián. Dribble, pass and shoot your soccer ball around town, and see what happens when you kick it someone's way. Feel the city change as Ecuador comes closer than ever to qualifying for the World Cup.

games.name: Time Flies
games.summary: This whimsical game is part open world and part flight simulator – and you play it as a fly! You are provided with a bucket list that you can complete before you die. But the life of a fly is short – and the list is long! Go ahead and learn an instrument, become rich, read a book, go on tour, find yourself, get drunk, make someone laugh or enter the art world! And if you don’t feel like pursuing your life goals, just hang, clean your wings, listen to music or watch television. Make the best of the time you have! Because we are all going to die.

games.name: Thank Goodness You're Here!
games.summary: Thank Goodness You're Here! is an absurd comedy slapformer set in the bizarre Northern English town of Barnsworth. As a traveling salesman, take the time to see the sights and meet the locals, who are very eager to give you a series of increasingly odd jobs…

games.name: Arco
games.summary:
Three tales forged in bloodshed, laced with magic, and united by revenge.

Enter the breathtakingly beautiful world of Arco, a unique tactical action game where your decisions shape the story. Journey through lush forests, sweeping plains, and scorching deserts as you guide four unlikely heroes in their vendetta against the Red Company gang.

Battle warriors of different nations, fend off greedy colonizers, and slay monstrous creatures as you voyage across this enchanted land. Change your fate, one move at a time.

games.name: Big Walk
games.summary: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

games.name: Herdling
games.summary: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

events.name: Monster Taming Direct 09.02.2024
events.description: It's finally time everyone! We've got 39 EXCLUSIVE submissions in this love letter to the Monster Taming Genre!

games.name: Essentures
games.summary: Essentures is inspired by the great games of the 90s and late 80s. You will experience a grand story driven adventure through 4 lore rich kingdoms wherein you can catch and collect mysterious creatures, using them as allies or weapons!

games.name: Cassette Beasts
games.summary: Grab your cassette player - it's time to transform! Collect awesome monster forms to use during turn-based battles in this indie open-world RPG. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts' Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: Weirdlands
games.summary: A charmingly quirky RPG where you catch and fuse spirits you fight, and layer by layer reveal deep, intricate lore. This single-player, turn-based RPG has a deceptively simple exterior, but within lie complexity and depth. It's bright and it's dark, it's witty and it's silly, and it's one of a kind.

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Battle Gem Ponies
games.summary:
A super-powered, shapeshifting pony RPG.

Command a super-powered, shape-shifting pony in this RPG Adventure! In a world where unpredictable legendary beasts pose an existential threat, you'll embark on a journey across the Pinto region to become the best pony tamer in the world and protect your magical companion from those who want to use her as a secret weapon.

Customize your team with hundreds of different moves, stat arrangements, & collectible battle gear to gain the upper hand in this rapid-switchout Rock/Paper/Scissors combat system.

A years-in-the-making love letter to the My Little Pony & Pokémon communities, celebrating one year of progress since the successful Kickstarter campaign!

games.name: Pry into the Void
games.summary: A bleak monster-taming RPG where you pry into the hearts of monsters and people. Exploit enemy weaknesses, converse with their souls and navigate challenging moral dilemmas to recruit abstract monsters as your allies.

games.name: Mirrored Soul
games.summary: A turn-based RPG detective story with focus on monster-collecting, exploration, and humor. Negotiate with enemies to recruit them to your party, and fuse your monsters to create new ones.

games.name: Kubberz
games.summary: Kubberz is an Action RPG where you can take part on epic battles against your friends and other players around the world, as well as collect and train more then 100 different species of Kubberz.

games.name: Grimmlins Tale
games.summary: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

games.name: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman
games.summary: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman is a 3D collectathon platformer fused with a monster-catching RPG! Catch monsters, collect permanent upgrades, and unlock even more of this huge 90's-inspired world.

games.name: Nanomon
games.summary: Nanomon are tiny, virtual pets who hang out in the corner of your screen. Train, explore, discover, and play with your Nanomon so they can evolve into the perfect companion! Only the best, most attentive trainers will help their Nanomon achieve their life goal!

games.name: Wizabeasts
games.summary: Wizabeasts is a monster-taming RPG with tactical battles! Uncover a mystery from the past, take down a dangerous gang, and get your student debt forgiven by defeating club champions!

games.name: MonTamer
games.summary: MonTamer is an immersive game that lets you catch and train a wide variety of different Montams as you explore a vast and exciting world. From completing quests and solving puzzles to facing off against other skilled MonTamers, there's always something new and exciting to do in MonTamer.

games.name: Isle of Swaps
games.summary: Grab your cards, it's time to swap! Battle your school pals in this roguelite deckbuilder where you'll trade for new cards when you win defeat them and rip open booster packs looking for rare cards. Conquer everyone's dungeon decks to become Critter Champion of the Playground!

games.name: Tomomon: Legacy of Light
games.summary: Experience the best of both worlds with our monster taming game - relive the nostalgia of classic role-play games, while enjoying fresh and immersive gameplay. Capture and train unique monsters in stunning environments, and put your skills to the test in challenging 3v3 battles.

games.name: Aethermancer
games.summary: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins. Plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles utilizing the four elements of Aether. Watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

games.name: Chronomon
games.summary: Chronomon is a monster taming JRPG game with retro pixel art graphics. Explore a branching storyline, Capture and train over 50+ Chronomon. Battle other trainers in this one of a kind, multi-platform game.

games.name: Kaardik
games.summary: Join the exciting world of Kaardik, a creature collection game. Embark on exciting adventures with your Kaardiks in the fascinating region of Kodumaa. Capture all the Kaardiks, battle with other trainers, and beat the king.

games.name: Eidolon Awakened
games.summary: Eidolon Awakened is a turn-based creature collector RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world overtaken by creatures known as Eidolons. Take your place among the Summoners, able to capture and control the Eidolon to determine the fate of mankind.

games.name: Oni Hunters
games.summary: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

games.name: Astral Arena
games.summary: Create & Combat mystical creatures known as Astrals in this Monster Tamer Roguelike with unique Real Time Combat!

games.name: Decktamer
games.summary: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

games.name: Infinikin
games.summary: Your attacks permanently run out in this monster battling randomizer! Find your favorites from a new pool of monsters for every playthrough. Battle efficiently to outpace your losses and unlock upgrades. Cultivate a team across multiple runs, and defeat corrupted Infinikin bosses.

games.name: 9th Dawn Remake
games.summary: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in top-down or first-person view, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: Splinterra
games.summary: Explore flying islands. Capture creatures. Use powerful spells. In this VR rpg.

games.name: Photogeist Albums: Case 1
games.summary: The first chapter of the in-production photography monster tamer RPG "Photogeist Albums".

games.name: Coromon: Rogue Planet
games.summary: Choose your starter Coromon, upgrade your gear, then battle your way across the wilderness of Velua in a modern-day Monster Tamer with a Roguelite twist! Tame monsters, battle Crimsonite bosses, and uncover the secrets of the galaxy!

games.name: Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts
games.summary: Battle teams of Abomis in this turn-based roguelike monster-tamer where the matchups change every run! Recruit creatures from several different indie universes to help close the rifts destroying Abomi Nation. Create your own Abomis or download others from Steam Workshop for infinite possibilities

games.name: Dragon Spirits 2
games.summary: In this modern urban-themed RPG, you can collect nearly a hundred different dragon spirits, experiment with skill setups, assemble teams, and devise strategies to build your dragon spirit squad. Adventure through the virtual spaces in Metapolis, and uncover the conspiracy behind it all.

games.name: Risimon
games.summary: Risimon is an adventure & monster-taming game combining an off-the-wall tone with a retro, yet restyled, aesthetic. Experience a hilarious journey across the Issou region. Catch Risimon, train them and fight to prove to yourself that you are NOT a loser!

games.name: Scallion RPG
games.summary:
Scallion RPG is a Monster Taming RPG, where you travel the world collect Scallions and battle by transforming into them. With three party members transforming into Scallions at once for a 3v3 battle, your journey is going to be fun and exciting.

Your main goal is explore all region and collect 5 Artifact from Tower Trails and become the ultimate Scallion Master.

You will come along many NPCs in your journey which can join you in and help you in achieving your goal.

games.name: Unlich
games.summary: Unlich is a pixel art dark fantasy monster-taming RPG with grid battles, focused on exploration and customization.

games.name: Pipkin
games.summary: Explore a magical and spooky world, capture wild Pipkin, and fight alongside them, as you uncover a series of mysterious events happening around New Haven...

games.name: EvoBots
games.summary: EvoBots is a mobile adventure inspired by classic games of the monster-taming genre. As part of the Ground Expedition Team you will collect a wide variety of mechanical creatures and use them in turn-based battles. To become a real EvoBot expert you have to master the puzzle elements of the five different energy types to gain the decisive advantage in combat. Can you unravel the dark mysteries of the world of EvoBots?

games.name: Photogeist Albums: Case 2
games.summary: The second chapter of the in-production photography monster tamer RPG "Photogeist Albums".

games.name: Dokimon
games.summary: "Whoa, watch out!" That was close, didn't you know Dokimon are dangerous!?ーStep into Xelos region, where you'll set off on an adventure to uncover the mystery behind your missing childhood friend.

games.name: Digital Tamers 2
games.summary:
Tamers from all around the world, it's time to digitize once again!!
The long-awaited sequel to the acclaimed casual fighting fan game "Digital Tamers: ReBorn" is finally here!

Raise, battle, and evolve!
Embark on the Digital World and find new friends, adventures, and surprises! With more than 100 challenges, 50 unique quests, and more than 380 different Digimon to collect, the Digital World is yours to explore as you wish!

events.name: SAGE 2024
events.description: A yearly online event for Sonic the Hedgehog fangame developers to chat online and to demonstrate finished and unfinished games they are developing.

games.name: Tailwinds
games.summary:
Welcome to Tailwinds, a Pilotwings-inspired mod for Sonic Robo Blast 2,
featuring a story loosely based on the little-known Chuck Yeager origin story.

games.name: Sonic Advance: International
games.summary:
Sonic Advance (Android) International is a collection of mods for the Sonic Advance's Android port that gives quality of life improvements to the game.

The mod pack went by other names before: it started as Anniversary Mods Pack, then was retitled to MOST Mods, being retitled once more to the current title.

games.name: Sonic 1 Strange Dream World
games.summary: Sonic 1: Strange Dream World is a comprehensive "cosmetic and layout" mod for the 2013 mobile/RSDK decompilation of Sonic the Hedgehog. The hack is defined by its surreal, dream-like premise where Sonic relives his first adventure but finds the world distorted with vibrant, unusual colors and "scarier" Badniks.

games.name: Yo! Noid 4: Episode 3
games.summary:
The Noid is back in the long-awaited final episode of Yo Noid 4.

The Noid, and his Sidekick Pepe the Pepperoni, journey to Pepe's home planet: The Domino's Pizza Planet, to save it from enslavement from an insane Hatsune Miku who is threatening to put pineapple on every pizza.

This game is pulled from a world where Domino's Pizza's mascot "The Noid" became the hit platforming sensation rather than Sonic the Hedgehog. Including having Yo! Noid 4 having it's third episode released!

games.name: Variable Geo vs. Asuka 120%
games.summary:
Variable Geo vs. Asuka 120% is a crossover fighting game with characters from Variable Geo and Asuka 120%. Here everything will be standard as in many fighting games, but with differences. For example, some characters from Asuka 120% received new specials and improved supers that differed from the original. Here you will find a couple of mini-games, several additional modes and the ability to play online multiplayer (Network). Have fun in team mode and tag team mode, compete with each other in local or online, practice in training mode and free match. Whatever you want, there are not many modes, but there are enough of them. It is well suited for both tournaments and online gatherings.
Choose your fighter from your favorite fighting series and go to battle!!

games.name: Ultimate Sonic Fighter Remaster
games.summary: Ultimate Sonic Fighter Remaster is a reformulation of the old Ultimate Sonic Fighter fangame released at Sage in 2017. The game has improved both its hud and its structure. The new Ultimate Sonic Fighter has extra modes and even a Tag battle system that was introduced in its sequel.

games.name: Transylmania Deluxe: SAGE 2024 Edition
games.summary:
Sneak into the Bubble Gum Factory with the new Bubble Gum Run mode!
This is a special version of Transylmania Deluxe made for SAGE 2024!

Your castle has been invaded by pesky villagers! To save yourself (and to get some rest) jump on top of their heads or run into them from behind and turn them into the walking dead!
To get to the next level, open your coffin by snagging all of the villagers, and get in before the sun rises!
Watch out for fire, water, sunlight and spikes!

games.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
games.summary: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

games.name: The Noise's Jam-Packed Radical Mini Mayhem!
games.summary: The Noise, being the annoying gremlin he is, decided to shrink himself down and go for a "jog" in Peppibot Factory.

games.name: The New Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
games.summary:
The New Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog is a fangame based on Sonic Cartoons & Archie Comics.
The Game itself takes place in a special Alternate Universe where elements of all three shows (SatAM, AoStH & Underground) co-exist in some kind of fashion. You have a choice to play through 3 zones in this demo; Peridot Coast (a beach in Mobius best known for it's unusual green sand), Marble Valley (a canyon filled with volcanic geysers) & Robotropolis (an industrial city & Primary headquarters of Bumbling villain Dr. Robotnik & his Super Sonic Search & Smash Squad!

games.name: Tails Adventure Remake
games.summary: Tails Adventure Remake is a fan-made remake of the Game Gear game for modern platforms, adding 16:9 widescreen, high refresh rate support, improved physics, controls, and enemies' behavior.

games.name: Supra Smash Bross Devolution 2.22: You Can (Not) Be Serious
games.summary:
Supra Smash Bross Devolution is a satirical take on the Smash Bros. series, with hilariously terrible graphics yet surprisingly deep gameplay.

A decade-long project, Bross' newest update celebrates its past with a complete remake of its very first iteration included.

To celebrate the 10-year anniversary of the Supra Smash Bross games, a full remake of Supra Smash Bross Mayday is contained within Devolution. It can be accessed via the Vault menu.

games.name: Super Sonic Battle
games.summary: Full fledged Sonic Fighting game - Super Sonic Battle. Developed to celebrate the 20th Anniversary of the GBA title Sonic Battle!

games.name: Beyond Golden Coins: Wario's Conquest + SML2 Reclaimed
games.summary:
Super Mario Land 2 is back!
Relive the golden days in this remake of a classic- spiced up with lots of new features!

games.name: Super Clash Bros.
games.summary: Super Clash Bros is a fan-made crossover game with an adventure mode and battle mode. Both modes support up to 4 players. The characters are generally accurate & faithful recreations: same abilities, controls, health systems, inventories, etc. from their games. The levels in adventure mode are remakes from their games too.

games.name: Stealth The Hedgehog
games.summary: This game is an experimental 3D platformer with weird references and other random stuff.

games.name: Sparkster PC
games.summary: A reimagined version of the Genesis version of Sparkster that aims to create something new and exciting with its existing ideas and assets.

games.name: Sonic: The Secret Tracks
games.summary:
It's time to get Funky!

Sonic and Secret Tracks is a Sonic themed overhaul of the popular Rhythm Game of Friday Night Funkin. A collaborative effort between Sonic fans in order to bring a fun, radical experience by the mania for the mania.

games.name: Sonic X TMNT: Score Party
games.summary: Sonic X TMNT: Score Party is a collection of mini-games featuring classic Sonic and teenage mutant ninja turtles from the animated show from the 80s! In these mini-games you will need to collect a certain number of points. Their total number is rated S or D rank, depending on how many points you have collected. In this demo, you will be able to run at super sonic speed as Sonic and kick some shells as Leonardo! At different levels from the games of both franchises, you will meet Dr. Eggman's badniks and Shredder's foot soldiers (and not only)!

games.name: Sonic Velocity
games.summary: Sonic Velocity is a 3D Boost formula hedgehog game in the vein of Sonic Unleashed and Generations.

games.name: Sonic Unleashed +
games.summary: Sonic Unleashed + (Plus) is a sonic fan game that aims to port Sonic Unleashed to PCs.

games.name: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition
games.summary: Sonic The Fighters Blitz Hyper Edition (STFBHE) is the continuation of Sonic the Fighters Blitz (STFB), a 2D re-imagining of the arcade game Sonic The Fighters created by Restless Dipstick. STFBHE aims to rebalance and expand upon the original STFB.

games.name: Sonic Tameshi
games.summary:
Sonic Tameshi is a Classic Sonic Fan Game created on the Sonic Worlds engine.

The game's story follows Sonic after he finds out about Dr Eggman's new plan to extract all the natural resources from an Mystical island. Face Metal Sonic and save the island, stop Eggman from building the Pleasure Island Theme Park and save the beautiful paradise hidden on the other side of the sea. Sonic will feature the Drop Dash, Insta-Shield, Peel Out and a Wall jump!

games.name: Sonic StrikerZ
games.summary:
Welcome to Sonic StrikerZ!
Using 2D Fighter Maker 2022, experience 1v1s, 2v2s, 3v3s and even 4v4 2D chaotic fights across as of right now in this version 27 Zones with 11 characters, including a story/campaign mode with bosses and online!

How you use your power is up to you...
Do not forget your dreams...

games.name: Sonic Skyfall
games.summary:
From Stick Drift Studios comes Sonic Skyfall, a brand new Sonic fangame being made with the Infinity Engine framework, taking inspiration from Unleashed, Colors, Generations, and Frontiers! The very first demo is now playable, featuring the first 4 levels of the game. Each can be played as either Sonic or Shadow, and both hedgehogs have their own collectibles to find. Explore the Atlas Sky Islands in Nanite Nimbus Zone and enter the Liminal Spaces: pocket dimensions that somehow emits familiar energies.

Both Hedgehogs each have one new ability/quirk added to them to mix things up a little. Sonic still has his Bounce Bracelet as his Air Special, but can now also utilize a new Ground Special Ability called the Cylaunch. As the name implies, it is based on the Cyloop from Sonic Frontiers, except it sees Sonic instantly launching himself high into the air, while also being able to take out closeby enemies on the ground. This ability will drain 10 units of Sonic's Boost/Energy Meter, so use it with caution! Shadow's Chaos Control is his Special Ability, which also costs 10 Energy. Not only does Shadow slow down time, but he also reduces his own gravity by a very noticeable amount. With proper use of this perk, Shadow can reach unthinkable heights while cutting down times! Both characters can also fire a projectile that seeks closeby enemies at the cost of 3 Energy. Shadow will fire a Chaos Spear, and Sonic will launch a Sonic Boom Shockwave.

games.name: Sonic Rush 3D
games.summary: A 3D reimagining of the fan favorite 2D platformer, Sonic Rush!

games.name: Sonic Re;Velocity
games.summary: A 2D Sonic fan game with a heavy focus on high-speed momentum and stupidly fast platforming, with a simple control style, a unique gameplay style and a strange emphasis on going as fast as hedgehogly possible.

games.name: Sonic Magenta
games.summary: Sonic Magenta is a free 2D Sonic the Hedgehog fan game made by Scorbunny Channel.

games.name: Sonic Into Cyberspace
games.summary: Sonic Into Cyberspace is a 2D modern Sonic game that aims to evolve and expand upon the 2D Sonic formula. This game places an emphasis on freedom of movement and flow, maintian high speeds to enter boost mode to go even faster and collect rings to reduce the amount of time to enter boost mode.

games.name: Sonic Gamebook Origins
games.summary:
A brand-new old adventure!
Relive the classic adventure gamebook Sonic vs. Zonik, now in full digital glory!
Everything is recorded by the game! No more pencil and paper - enjoy the adventure without lifting a finger!
Progress saves automatically, so come back and resume your game as you please!
Never get lost again with the included Cheat Sheet, a detailed guide to every section in the game!
Toggle a variety of options to customize your experience and foil Robotnik's diabolical traps!
Features authentic Sega Genesis music to suit the mood of each location!

games.name: Sonic Freedom Frontiers
games.summary: Sonic Freedom Frontiers is a game that intends to feature many levels, three playstyles, and a longer story. It plans on combining light influence from RPGs with and Platformer inspiration, making it a larger scale game. It has cutscenes that tell of a narrative with a science fiction flavor, that I wrote. It also has two different styles of platforming, one with more emphasis on physics and momentum, the other on combat. If it is completed, it is likely to have five different zones, all with five levels in each of them, with most of them being platformer styled levels. It is meant to feature hub worlds with top down gameplay, NPCs you can talk to, and saving.

games.name: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Ring
games.summary: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Rings (SFH: KOTR) is a MUGEN-based 2D Fighting Game, which has been in development since 2017.

games.name: Sonic Endless Adventure
games.summary:
Welcome to Sonic Endless Adventure! This is a fan game in which there level created in real time.
In the game you will visit the Green hill level, again. You have only 3 lives, losing them, will end the level. During the passage you will encounter Red Star Rings. With it you can open music for the level.

games.name: Sonic Emerald Madness
games.summary: Sonic Emerald Madness is a boost styled Sonic game that takes its inspiration from Sonic Rush, Sonic Colors and a bit of Mario 64.

games.name: Sonic Eclipse
games.summary: Sonic Eclipse is a 2D Classic Sonic Fan Game, created by the BrainBox Interactive Team, featured as an entry to this years (2024) Sonic Amateur Games Expo!

games.name: Sonic Dungeons: Prototype
games.summary: This a concept for a first-person action game set in the Archie Sonic universe. A game where the player explores the open world of Mobius, recruits various freedom fighters to their team, and raids enemy fortresses ran by Dr. Eggman.

games.name: Sonic Colors Demastered
games.summary:
Sonic Colors Demastered is a 2D reimagining of Sonic Colors for the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo DS. The game features gameplay inspired by the Sonic Rush series and a fully original level design and soundtrack.

Join Sonic, Tails, and a colorful cast of aliens to put a stop to Eggman’s plans for interstellar domination! Use Sonic’s signature suite of abilities, including the boost, grind, and homing attack, to make your way through exhilarating, high-speed 2D platforming challenges!

games.name: Sonic Battle Rush
games.summary:
Based on the original on the Gameboy Advance, Sonic and the gang are back to duke it out with each other once more! Only this time as a 2D traditional fighter!

Fight as Sonic the Hedgehog and Shadow the Hedgehog in the Sage demo and learn the ins and outs of their expanded moveset!

Old mechanics from the original are making a return here as well!

games.name: Sonic Battle R
games.summary: Gather your friends and see who is truly the fastest in this no hold barred fast track. Featuring many different stages through the Sonic series enhancing the stages with new features for multiplayer. Explore the world and work together to complete missions.

games.name: Sonic Adventure Blast 2
games.summary:
Sonic Adventure Blast 2 allows you to play as Sonic, Tails, and Knuckles in Adventure style gameplay.

Blast through over 80 missions as you explore both classic and brand new levels.

games.name: Sonic 2: Rescue Tails
games.summary: Sonic 2: Rescue Tails is a reimagined version of the 8-bit Sonic 2 for the Master system and Game Gear, in the style of the 16-bit Mega Drive/Genesis Sonic games.

games.name: Sonic & Shadow Black Ice
games.summary:
The story is based on the old fairytale story The Snow Queen.

This will be a story driven game. So there will be no battling. Just moving around, interacting with people and objects while solving simple puzzles.

The game will contain voice acting but only for the main cast. Sonic, Shadow and The Snow Queen.

games.name: Sonic & Blaze
games.summary: Sonic & Blaze is a 2D fangame inspired by the Sonic Rush series and the 3D Boost games.

games.name: Silver The Hedgehog
games.summary: a 2d Silver The Hedgehog game

games.name: Sega Brawlers Megamix
games.summary: Sega Brawlers Megamix is a beat'em up style brawler game featuring many of Sega's classic characters and guests from the Sega Genesis days, with a total of 92 playable characters.

games.name: Project X-treme
games.summary: Project X-Treme is a remake of the cancelled "Sonic X-Treme" made by STI (Sega Technical Institute), which was cancelled in 1996

games.name: Project Reignition
games.summary: Project Reignition is an on-rails platformer developed by KumaPauZ. This unofficial remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings, originally developed by Sonic Team and published by SEGA in 2007 for the Wii, aims to bring the classic game to modern systems. Built using the Godot engine, this free and open-source project features enhanced graphics, refined controls, and a smoother frame rate, offering a fresh experience while staying true to the original.

games.name: Project After: Shadow Theory
games.summary: Side-scroller beat am map

games.name: Project 32X: Sonic Mars
games.summary:
Sonic and his friends found out about the Cyberspace and its inhabitants, and Robotnik is using this world to create his empire, now everyone has to try to save the Cyberspace with the power of the Cyber Emeralds.

Project 32X is a fan game that attempts to revive the original Sonic Mars/Sonic 32X project.

games.name: Pokémon: Burning Lotus
games.summary: The game takes place in a new region called Lotus, a region that is filled with Pokémon from every previous generation, including new species as well. You take control as either a male or female protagonist, and the region has eight gym leaders who are all returning leaders from previous games.

games.name: Pokémon Aragonite
games.summary:
Pokémon Aragonite is a fanmade project based on the real life island of Sicily, in the South of Italy.
Started by FrankieChatot and Darkonius Mavakar;
This project aim to reimagine Sicily into the Pokémon world by creating the Sylia region, where you will be able to explore many areas and cities based off actual places!
Initially this started as a fakemon dex where we had fun interpreting our culture, flora and fauna into Fakemon, but then we decided to use Pokémon Essentials to turn it into a playable game!

games.name: PJ the DJ
games.summary: A Parappa the Rapper fan game starring the character PJ Berri

games.name: Nights: Moonlight Dreams...
games.summary: Nights: Moonlight Dreams... is a fan game of Nights into Dreams, developed by Marco Medina.

games.name: Monster World IV Regenesis
games.summary: Monster World IV Regenesis is a fan-made role-playing game to celebrate the 35th anniversary of Wonder Boy. It features combat that expands on the original Monster World IV formula along with combat directly inspired by the popular ATB (Active Time Battle) system introduced in Final Fantasy IV, but with its own unique gimmicks.

games.name: Metal Crash
games.summary: Here is a fangame with a mix of Crash Bandicoot and Metal Slug style gameplay. For the most part it's run & gun, so just make sure you survive, especially since there are no checkpoints!

games.name: Megaman X: Omega Blaster
games.summary: Megaman X Omega Blaster is an Arcade/Arena style fangame inspired by the classic saga arcades (Megaman: The power Battle & Megaman 2: The power fighters) but focused on the X saga but more dynamic, fun, challenging and with improved graphics.

games.name: Mega Man X8 16-bit
games.summary:
A fan game made by AlyssonDaPaz. Bringing the original PS2 classic, MegaMan X8 back to its 16-bit roots! Play as X and blast through a familiar yet fresh experience!

Mega Man X8 16-bit is a reimagining of the PS2 original with SNES styled graphics. The aim was to demake X8 in a similar feel to the first three Mega Man X games, while trying to actually finish a low-scope fangame. After two and a half years of development, version 1.0 was released in September 7th 2024, making the game fully playable from start to finish with X, but Zero and Axl are not featured in the game in any capacity.

In addition to the 16-bit graphics, the game differs from the original game by offering slightly different level designs at times, armor effects, and boss weapons.

games.name: Mega Man 15: The Robot Apocalypse
games.summary:
This game was made to celebrate Mega Man's franchise and delve deep into its rich history and legacy. This is a turn-based RPG with a lot of difficulty options so even if you don't like turn-based, you can just breeze through its rich new story!

Here you control four heroes who are fated to fight against a evil scientist named Doctor Wily and his evil robots that are destroying the city and breaking Space-Time itself!

Fight iconic enemies, bosses, find many easter eggs, collect mysterious items and uncover new events that connects different timelines.

games.name: Logan The Kid: How It Was Intended 1
Knuckles Quest
games.summary: Knuckles Quest is a continuation of the treasure hunting gameplay style that was present in Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, now with a custom framework and levels. Using a radar, search the area for all the emerald pieces, but be careful: the locations are randomly selected!

games.name: Key Hunters DX
games.summary: Key Hunters DX is an re-imagined version of Sonic & Knuckles: Key Hunters!

games.name: Jack & Bob Remastered
games.summary: Jack&Bob Remastered is supposed to demonstrate an alternative dimension of Sonic The Hedgehog. The game is based off Sonic 1 and 2.

games.name: Isekai Mario
games.summary: Isekai Mario is an unofficial freeware fan game that adds anime characters to the world of Super Mario. You can play as hundreds of different anime characters and collect hundreds of power stars in this 3d platformer.

games.name: Hyper's Quest 2: High Voltage
games.summary: The evolution of the Volt Orbs is here!

games.name: Greenmario In Bobbing My Burger
games.summary: A surrealist platformer based on Super Mario and the Amiga demoscene.

games.name: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect
games.summary: Freedom Planet: Shang Mu Architect is an unofficial stage builder fan game set after the events of the first Freedom Planet, featuring its own campaign mode to showcase the capabilities of the editor.

games.name: EvilBritishGuy's Sonic and The Hedgehogs
games.summary: Sonic and The Hedgehogs reimagines how an Open-World Sonic game should play, Open-World in this context meaning that Sonic is free to go anywhere and do anything that Sonic can and would do. Rather than only rapidly progressing through mostly linear stages to reach a goal miles away from where you start, Sonic makes whatever world he finds himself in his playground.

games.name: Evil Elves II Deluxe
games.summary:
The Evil Elves are back at it again with a brand new remake, just in time for the holiday season!
Evil Elves II Deluxe is a remake of Evil Elves II, a game once available on Zeeks and Funschool.

games.name: Chapter Zero: The Angel Island Saga
games.summary: The world is a chaotic, terrifying place, rife with all manner of monsters, warlords and hostile architecture. Even for the mighty Pachacamac clan, just the act of survival is a day to day struggle, and everybody seems to know that they can't keep it up forever. In pursuit of a safe home, a lone shaman named Ichima happens apon the Special Stage - and with it, a means of realizing their dreams of safety and peace...

games.name: BrazSonic 20XX
