games.summary: BrazSonic 20XX is a reboot of the BrazSonic series set in 20XX's Brazil, where the congressman Dr. Corruptnik, who dreams of being President of the country, seeks the Corruption Emeralds to make it true. However, his ambition implies chaos and destruction to the lands and citizens. Then the hero BrazSonic will come into the scene to stop him!

games.name: Bowser Gets Clever: Insert Subtitle Here
games.summary: This game is half-parody of a Super Mario Bros. game, a reimagining of a really old game made in 2009 by Adrien Dittrick.

games.name: Beavis And Butt-Head In Quest To Score
games.summary: Beavis and Butt-head can't afford tickets to a concert that they want to go to as the tickets are 20bucks and unfortunately they only had 20 cents. With a goal in mind to score and to do things that don't suck Beavis and Butt-Head set off to get $20 to pay for the tickets and to acquire the delicacy known as Nachos as the venue didn't sell it.

games.name: Battle Cross Fever
games.summary: Prepare yourself for this brand-new age of fighting game with never-before-seen mechanics!

games.name: Ashura The Glitch
games.summary: A Sonic the Hedgehog Metroidvania inspired by the Metroid series and Axiom Verge.

games.name: Acceleration of Suguri: Y-Edition
games.summary: Acceleration of Suguri Y-Edition is a fan-made remake of Acceleration of SUGURI. The speed has been cranked up, gameplay and visuals have been polished, along with a more balanced cast and rollback netcode!

games.name: Zorropa y La Torre de las Sombras
games.summary:
Zorropa is a young fox that has to leave his house due to some spiky plants growing all over the island, it is at this moment that your adventure begins.
Use your abilities to make your way into towers that behold the power of the sun, maybe with this power you can save the island, or start an adventure and save the world.

games.name: Zafe's Adventures
games.summary: Zafe's Adventures is a new and simplified 2D platformer game with a simple run and gun elements and gameplay. Inspired by abandonware platformer, Sonic the Hedgehog series and its fangame, Spark the Electric Jester, Jazz Jackrabbit and Freedom Planet and as well with other simple 2D game that was made using GameMaker or Scratch in the past. This has been considered as a small solo indie game project only. The game follows a young and heroic pyrokinetic cartoon humanoid who tries to fight back against evil entities around the hillside wilderness. While he ends up on a long journey through another different world via the mysterious dimension portal.

games.name: Yellow Taxi Goes Vroom
games.summary: Make full use of your advanced move-set to navigate hand-crafted retro worlds without a jump button in this vibrant love letter to the N64 era of collectathons!

games.name: Yaysuu's X-Treme Adventure
games.summary: Yaysuu's X-Treme Adventure is a side-scrolling 2D Platformer inspired by games like Sonic and Undertale. It stars the titular YAYSUU the Stickling, and his older brother Teddy, and the main villain, Fringlebert Theodore.

games.name: XGA
games.summary: This is a Metroidvania aiming to continue Metroid Fusion's focus on horror and the SA-X. Explore a huge, interconnected space station, fighting various monsters, upgrades and boss battles. Avoid XGA as getting caught means certain death....

games.name: Xenogunner Returns: Rule of Chaos
games.summary: A fast-paced boss-focused action platformer!

games.name: Worlde Lande Countrie
games.summary: World Lande Countrie is a 2D platformer game about strange-looking blokes doing strange things.

games.name: Wonder Wand
games.summary: Embark on a spellbinding adventure in a strange land that’s brimming with puzzling dungeons, bouncing slimes & zany encounters in WONDER WAND, a 2D puzzle game about a confused fox with a magical wand.

games.name: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

games.name: Wick3r: Cheese, Keys & Speed
games.summary: Join our petty thieving protagonist Wicker on his Wicked adventure about Cheese, Keys and (naturally) Speed, in this 2000s inspired Momentum 3D Platformer with radical levels and a coolness factor off the charts!

games.name: We Took That Trip
games.summary: A chill narrative experience through procedural and relaxing landscapes. Appreciate the reunion with your best friends, explore the road and it's fantastic things. Turn the radio on, it's time to enjoy this emotional ride.

games.name: We Got Compagnie!
games.summary: Ready your bow, tune your magical violin, and liberate the musical prodigies mangled by a Corrupted Melody by playing your own melody. Prepare yourself, 'cause We Got Compagnie!

games.name: Warrior Spirit
games.summary: A 3D adventure video game for all ages. Use Warrior Spirit's many tools and abilities such as the Four Arms, Bracelets of Good, and Clay for platforming, combat, exploring, and solving puzzles. Travel through various lands and defeat Evil by serving the will and power of Perfect Good.

games.name: Walrus Run
games.summary: Walrus Run is a 2D Action Platformer, compatible with conveniently-shaped bongo controllers. Slide, dash and eat through obstacles to get a high score and take back your fish from the greedy Sargent Seal!

games.name: Void Carrier
games.summary: This game is a difficult puzzle game with many worlds that each have their own gimmicks!

games.name: Vocaless
games.summary: Vocaless is a unique platformer game with rhythm elements, you must perform all of your actions to the beat! Not only that, but everything in the game, from enemies to obstacles, follows the beat of the music.

games.name: Untitled Experimental Platformer by KG
games.summary: A 2D platformer where you'll be able to explore an open world, use different double jump types to tackle different levels, and be able to make your own route through the game.

games.name: Undercroft Warriors
games.summary: Crush the forces of hell and get a high score in this addictive, action-packed, arcade-inspired twin-stick shooter!

games.name: Trinity Heart
games.summary: Bounce, whip, and blast your way through three challenging action stages!!! Enjoy bright scenery and goofy characters!!!

games.name: Triku
games.summary: Meet Triku, a platform-adventure game that's made for fans of Monster World IV and Shantae in which you take control of Triku who must travel across various areas filled with enemies to avoid and dungeons to enter.

games.name: Tricky and the Dream Caster
games.summary:
Tricky O'Possum has been hit with a sleep curse, trapping him in Caster's dream domain!
With the help of his new pal Volt, he's gotta collect the keys to Caster's Castle and beat him up to break the curse.
Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

games.name: Tower of Dreams
games.summary: Climb your way to the top of the tower in this vertical platforming roguelike! Bound off walls, discover fantastical items, and make use of Dream Knight's sword to bounce off of obstacles!

games.name: Toree Saturn
games.summary: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!

games.name: TeknoKinetica
games.summary:
High speeds and faster times are the name of the game! TeknoKinetica is a 2D speed-running oriented platformer built for those who like to retry and optimize! Utilize the power of Parries and Rhythm to blitz through bite-sized stages in speed and style!

You'll need a good dose of speed and quick-wits to make it through with a high rank. Think you got what it takes, accelerator?

games.name: Techpack Collection
games.summary: Techpack Collection is a remake of the 1980s-styled arcade game released in 2020 on Steam, Techpack. In this new version, you will find a whole brand-new menu, redone gameplay, and even more selectable arcade games! If you're a fan of old arcade games and the challenges they bring, this game may give you a kick!

games.name: Team Slay-Bells
games.summary: Team Slay-Bells is about a reindeer named Charlotte and her friends, who are trying to help their home planet Kringlaus.

games.name: Tacti-Cat
games.summary: Tacti-Cat is a fast paced, momentum based, platformer where you play as Ellie the cat and use fish guns to save the world from an evil wizard invasion!

games.name: SyS KillMirror
games.summary: An exploration FPS set on a fake planet called SyS, ruled by the cat named Emperor, will you be able to escape this cursed realm?

games.name: Synthrome
games.summary:
SYNTHROME is designed with speedrunners in mind. It mixes early 2000s 3D platformer charm with modern gameplay & game design.

The game is all about speed, precision, and fluid movement.
Every jump, slide, and burst of speed must be carefully timed, turning each level into a test of skill and strategy.

Explore levels packed with shortcuts, secrets, and rewards. No hand-holding—just pure challenge. Prove your skill.

games.name: Welcome to Sushi Tree
games.summary: A fast paced game inspired by Wario land 4 and pizza tower that puts a lot of focus on story and uniqueness of each level.

games.name: Superguy and Megaboy
games.summary: Superguy and Megaboy is a high-speed, free-roam platformer that is somewhere between 2.5D and 3D. Players can attack only on a 2D axis but otherwise move freely in 3D. Attacks will only hit their targets if they are positioned at roughly the same 3D depth.. meaning if you see a bad guy in the distant background, you won't be able to hit him (or vice versa) unless you move up close!

games.name: Super Nova
games.summary: Welcome to Super Nova! A 2D fast-paced platformer with emphasis on keeping your speed, quick combat, and bosses that will keep you on your toes to beat 'em up!

games.name: Super Infiniboss: The Gauntlet
games.summary: Super Infiniboss: The Gauntlet is an endless boss battle arcade platformer. It's about you, an ever-changing boss, and tons of projectiles. Choose a character, get as many points as you can, and work towards unlocking more characters.

games.name: Super Freaks Side Story: Scruffy Minus - The Rise of the Anti-Freaks
games.summary: A new Classic Super Freaks game, Scruffy Minus is a new platforming adventure (with some freaky surprises!) Run, jump, and activate your different superpowered Suits, to kick butt!

games.name: Super Freaks Presents: Strato Freaks 2
games.summary: Fantasy Zone and NiGHTS thrown back into a super freaky blender!

games.name: Super Freaks Arcade
games.summary: Super Freaks Arcade is a throwback to single-screen arcade games, loosely based on a combination of Mario Bros., and Pac-Man Championship Edition. It aims to reinterpret the gameplay of Super Freaks 1 Ultimate Edition as if it were a 1983 arcade game. While it was originally made in two weeks for the Freakjam 1 pack, Super Freaks Arcade is receiving content updates and overhauls over time that will continue to expand it.

games.name: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition 3.0
games.summary: An update for Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition 3.0 that triples the content of the game, adding The Uncle Swordsman Story, with faster-paced gameplay, and a set of new bosses to go with it!

games.name: Sunrise Doll
games.summary: Sunrise Doll is a single-screen 2D game in which you control the swordsman known as Pawn. The goal of the game is to clear all levels in a sequence. To clear a level, Pawn must defeat all enemies in the level. To defeat an enemy, Pawn must use her sword to reflect projectiles back at it, and then collect its soul. There are various enemies that have different behaviors.

games.name: Stardust the Unicorn
games.summary: A small platformer inspired by old-school speed games. Help Stardust rescue his friends from the Kelpie Kingdom using his speed, horn, and magic dusts that grant him different abilities. Jump around, run, and use your abilities to advance through the levels. Watch out for obstacles and use different dusts to help you progress. Different dusts grant you different powers, which you can use to your advantage. Try them all and use your favorite one.

games.name: Starbot: Asvertichaos
games.summary: Starbot: Asvertichaos is a fast-paced 2D platformer focused on fluid movement. Explore the continent of Asvertica and uncover its secrets as you explore every crack and crevice while meeting a wacky set of characters to find your friend!

games.name: SplatShop-2D Thunderstorm
games.summary: SplatShop-2D, a young game developer, finds Castlestorm, a highly-ambitious yet unreleased old game. However, the game was slowly being corrupted by assets from other games, so 2D solves it the only way he can... Mass Destruction!!

games.name: Speel
games.summary: Speel is an experimental typing game that plays a little more like a puzzler. Your job is to type words incorrectly on purpose.

games.name: Speedy the Rollerskater: SMS Edition
games.summary: Speedy the Rollerskater SMS Edition is a demake of Speedy the Rollerskater using the Open Surge Engine. Besides fixing some issues of the original version, Speedy SMS Edition offers a 'What If' scenario...

games.name: Spacewing War 2
games.summary: The galaxy-wide known cult Shine Tomorrow has taken over the Power Generators in the Center of the Galaxy, and you must stop them! In Spacewing War 2, jump into battle with many new unlockable weapon types and face enemies and obstacles from every corner of the Milkdromeda Galaxy.

games.name: SomnaBuster
games.summary:
If the dream is real to you, it is worth fighting for!

Accounting student Macy is down on her luck and out of her mind, but her life of hum-drum is abruptly interrupted by a visit from a mysterious firefly. After stumbling down a seemingly endless hole, she wakes up in a strange new world. With an explosive broom in tow, Macy sets out discover the mysteries of Esperanto and find her way home.

games.name: Sollire
games.summary: Sollire is a Gradius-style Shoot Them Up combined with bits and pieces inspired by Sonic, Megaman and Zelda.

games.name: Smitty 2
games.summary: Smitty 2 brings back the adorable platforming adventure into a brand new level! Walk, hop and sprint through the interconnected areas around Dripsdale and search for Dropple Capsules and Energy Pellets scattered throughout.

games.name: Scouter
games.summary: Welcome to Scouter! A fast-paced action platformer oozing to the brim with 90's anime goodness! This is a really fast-paced action game where your goal is to get to the end and fight as many enemies (and be as stylish) as you possibly can!

games.name: Sakura X Clash: Last Millennial Spring
games.summary:
Sakura X Clash: Last Millenial Spring is an IKEMEN-based fighting game, that pays homage to arcade classics such as The King of Fighters and Street Fighter.
sXc also uses NGPC-styled graphics and aesthetic, aiming for a simple yet deep gameplay experience, making the game easy to pickup and play for begginers, but with a lot of depth for those who want to master it.
Featuring a (quite literally) colorful and constantly expanding cast of characters, each with its on gameplay style and unique quirks.

games.name: Runaway Star
games.summary: Runaway Star is a classic turn-based RPG inspired by games like Pokemon Mystery Dungeon and Final Fantasy. Explore the world of Raffelsia where falling stars with dangerous monsters inside have begun to plague the region. Join a team of adventurers called the Diurners and work together with new friends to uncover the source of the phenomenon and bring a stop to it.

games.name: Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut
games.summary: Rolling Ball Game returns with Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut! Traverse through obstacles and avoid the capsule-bots trying to knock you off the stage. Featuring all new and remastered levels, alongside extra content.

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Reindeer Story
games.summary: Reindeer Story is a 2D Adventure RPG! Run, Jump and Battle through 6 chapters of this Wintery Epic! Fight foes in turn based battles with a real-time element, dodge enemies attacks in the Battle Zone and retaliate with Z-Skills!

games.name: Rebellion Stryker
games.summary: Gun your way through this cyberpunk Run-n-Gun with never-before-seen hand-drawn graphics! Pick between two characters and even play co-op in this arcade title!

games.name: What's left of Rave Rough
games.summary: Rave Rough is a comedic and chaotic puzzle platformer about chucking your exposable vinyl collection to bounce your way throughout many platforming challenges! All the while butting heads with wacky friends and foes! Levels are very open ended and the moveset compliments this, with you having a lot of freedom to tackle challenges in all sorts of different ways.

games.name: Quantum Cortex
games.summary: Quantum Cortex is a fast-paced, physics-based metroidvania. Tear through a dark, atmospheric environment at lightning speeds and battle terrifying creatures. Discover the eldritch mystery behind civilization’s fall, and rise up against the transhumanist dystopia that took its place.

games.name: Punch Monkey
games.summary: You're a broke loner who lives in a crappy apartment. Crime, drugs and alcohol run rampant in your neighborhood. You dream of a better life but it's out of reach. That is, until you see an ad on TV for a big fight with a cash prize! You set out to claim the prize, but you have to make your way through hordes of unsavory crackheads and worthless bums. Are you up to the challenge?

games.name: Prototype N
games.summary:
Destructive robots are running rampant on Turquoise Island! Nadine, a prototype robot of unknown origin, fights to save her home and friends while searching for her creator.

Prototype N is a side scrolling shooting platformer. The player must help Nadine get through many stages of tricky obstacles such as dangerous robotic foes, hazardous traps and more!

games.name: Project Rodeo
games.summary: Project Rodeo is a proof of concept for a 3D platforming adventure game starring Rodeo, a bat living in an old western/steampunk fantasy-styled world who sets out on a grand adventure throughout the known islands. Inspirations for the game include the Mega Man Legends series, Grandia, Tail Concerto and The Legend of Zelda series.

games.name: Project Cradle
games.summary: Save the world in the blink of an eye! Project Cradle is a fast-paced action platformer. Pilot the nimble HollowBody drone, a robo-rabbit capable of all sorts of acrobatics! Roll, burst, grind and glide through a maze of mysterious underground facilities as you maintain the arcane machinery within.

games.name: Princess Pomu and the 5 Moons
games.summary: Paint without T is PAIN! Princess Pomu just lost her Kingdom and her family was captured, and now she's possessed by an evil spirit! Master the simple but satisfying combo system, get more abilities, pick up weapons, and explore the surreal world of Illeh in this cute metroidvania with a violent twist.

games.name: Potatostrike
games.summary: A space shmup featuring the ultimate potato-based space fighter.

games.name: Pomeraider
games.summary: Pomeraider's an arcade game heavily inspired by the classic Mario Bros!

games.name: Pillow Legends and The Last Nugget
games.summary: A platformer in which you can spend time alone or with friends.

games.name: Penn Guiny
games.summary: After being sucked into a sack full of dreams Penn Guiny lands into an area of the dream realm called "Sunny Shores". With the help of an unnamed cloud lady Penn Guiny learns how to traverse the dream realm.

games.name: Painter Blazer
games.summary: Painter Blazer is a mix between action, arcade, and light puzzle games. You are playing as Blazer, a bunny who likes to paint. He finds a new job as a painter but the company is no good trying to replace workers with robots. Your job is to paint and blow up the robots and to find who is behind all of this.

games.name: Nova's Adventure
games.summary: After crashlanding on an unknown planet, Nova the Star sets out on an adventure to collect all the parts from his broken ship that was hit by an asteroid while on his way home.

games.name: Nina & Yuri
games.summary: You play Nina, a girl who will need to cross several theater scenes to save her soulmate Yuri.

games.name: Mr. Triangle The Pizza Delivery Guy Mania Simulator 2k17 Turbo HD Remix GOTY 2024 Edition: Coked Up + 1.5 Collection DX Directors Cut & Knuckles
games.summary:
The first game in the Mr. Triangle Mania series (a sequel to some games I made as a child, of which the 6th entry was never finished), ported to the second's engine.
Including the extra story Mr. Triangle Mania 1.5, originally an SRB2 mod, now with its original intended ending.

games.name: Mr. Shootem Breaks Out!
games.summary: Mr. Shootem Breaks Out! is an arcade-inspired puzzle-platform-shooter about destroying levels and levels of bricks by using a ball and pure firepower! Brought to you by a group of friends across almost a decade, it's a game unlike anything you've played before!

games.name: Moomi & Spike
games.summary: Experience high-speed thrills and an engaging story in Moomi & Spike, a 3D platformer where agile gameplay and a captivating narrative collide in a vibrant adventure!

games.name: Monochrome Heights
games.summary: Monochrome Heights is a fast paced, challenging 2D platformer inspired by games like Super Mario Bros. and Megaman. It features crisp pixel art, a unique color swapping mechanic, and lots of robots.

games.name: Men of Conviction
games.summary: Men of Conviction is an original action platformer following the story of Izik Dang, a soldier of the underground rebel group Men of Conviction. Slash your way through four unique stages with a variety of different enemies. Use Chips to harness the power of the elements to assist you in your fight. Can you find the strength to stand against the trials that await you?

games.name: Mekanikko
games.summary: Mekanikko is an RPG that takes place in the world of modern steampunk. Explore the world of automatons, as weird things are always about to happen. Meet wacky characters with each of their own story tell. Solve cases with your sugar-freak partner, and find out the truth of this mechanical city.

games.name: Meander Land
games.summary: Meander Land is a remake of Anjelo's Province with new original characters, a new story, and a ton of quality-of-life improvements.

games.name: Mana Expel
games.summary: Mana Expel is a fast-paced action platformer with stealth elements where in the near future magic has just been discovered, and those who master its power are feared like gods. Infiltrate their reign, be fast and unseen, exploit their own territory, and expel these so-called gods from their throne.

games.name: Man Human Person Thingy's Quest To Get Back The Gun
games.summary:
Criminal stickman gets sent to prison without his trusty weapon, oh what will he do now?!?!??

Man Human Person Thingy's Quest To Get Back The Gun is a silly beat-em-up game that doesn't take itself seriously at all, inspired by flash games of the past!!

games.name: Macis
games.summary: Macis is a platform game focused on exploration. In this game, you control a young Chia in a search for her parents, who mysteriously disappeared when she was a child. Your main suspect? The one responsible for security in the city where she lives. Finding her parents seems like an impossible challenge, but alongside her team of bounty hunters, she is confident that she can finally find out what happened.

games.name: Lyrestruck
games.summary: This game follows Irina, who's been wandering through an endless forest, in search of an exit. Will she discover the roots of this curse and break out?

games.name: Lylia's Deadline: Clearance
games.summary: A sequel to the original Lylia's Deadline which features high-speed 2.5D gameplay, low-poly 3D graphics, Rocking music, and more heat-based combat mechanics.

games.name: Lusa the Cathead
games.summary: Lusa the Cathead is an action platformer game where you get to play as a cute cat-head-looking creature named Lusa! Jump your way through the stages, collect orbs and break capsules while avoiding obstacles... and from now on, gathering polymers and megamers to gain score! This game is very customizable, with possibility for not only custom stages, but custom characters with unique mechanics, powered by Lua scripting, free for any modifications!

games.name: Lloyd the Monkey 3: Judgement Day
games.summary: Two years have passed since Lloyd and Lura defeated Kronos and his Dark Gorillas, seemingly once and for all, and the duo have gone their seperate ways. However, the villain Scholz is ripping his way through countless lives in order to complete a decade-spanning plan to conquer the universe once and for all. The final battle is about to begin, and the blood shed at the end of it all will sow the seeds of a new beginning.

games.name: Little Sound Boxing Champion
games.summary:
Coil, a young lightweight boxer challenges the status quo!
In a world where robots have taken over the boxing scene, Coil must box to the beat in order to take the title of Champion back for humanity in this fun little Rhythm Heaven inspired boxing game!

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.summary: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: Knight Legacy
games.summary: A new journey across the Kingdom Of Kavasia awaits you in Knight Legacy! Become a true knight, fight against evil foes and help people with many side quests.

games.name: Knight George
games.summary: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

games.name: Kane TV: The Game
games.summary: Kane TV: The Game is a tribute game based on the Kane TV channel! Join Kane in his adventure in this cybernetic world, passing through many levels with many references to his YouTube videos!

games.name: JettFuel
games.summary: In JettFuel, you play as Jett: a robot used by a factory until its sudden closure. You managed to escape the factory before it was destroyed, but the whereabouts of your brother and fellow coworker Brody, are unknown. In order to reunite with Brody, Jett must collect the Power Gems, which are scattered across many different areas, with some being held by bosses. The gems give the user the power to make one wish. There are also 3 hidden Caged Whisps, creatures made of pure light. in the game to try to find!

games.name: Infinity Girl
games.summary: Infinity Girl is a high-speed rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm.

games.name: Illurama: Masters of Illusions
games.summary:
Illurama: Masters of Illusions it's a bullet hell shmup in the form of a platformer! Inspired by such games like Touhou Project, Dodonpachi, Megaman and more.
Enemies and bosses will shoot projectiles, but beware because they will shoot a TON OF BULLETS.

games.name: Hotel Hysteria!
games.summary: The evil Dr. Von Gordo has kidnapped Madame Moon! you, Vince Vinchi and your...sidekick Kaizo have to find clues to her location by searching through Dr. Von Gordo's Kooky Hotels!

games.name: Hot Job 94'
games.summary: Hot Job 94 is a 3D action platformer inspired by the early 2000's GameCube games such as Sonic Adventure and Super Mario Sunshine. Control 5 different characters with unique attributes like speed, flight, shooting, and combat.

games.name: Horn of Balance
games.summary: Come explore this world of secrets and adventure. Featuring solid 2D Zelda-like gameplay, vast non-linear dungeons and a wholesome story about a young golem protagonist called Linden.

games.name: Honey Bunny
games.summary: Honey Bunny is a bartender at Lucky Rabbit's Foot Casino, the cutest casino in all of Starlight City! She's busy at work when the no-good gang, The Cool Cats, steals away the casino and the entire city's supply of cocktail cherries. Chase them down as Honey Bunny using your ears to headbutt enemies, grab items, and platform around the city as you recover as many cherries as possible!

games.name: Home World Run
games.summary: Two baseball playing sisters have been kidnapped by aliens, now they have to use their athletic skills to avoid hazards, solve puzzles, and most importantly bash some slimy creatures to bits in this hand drawn platformer beat-em-up!

games.name: Hexachampions
games.summary: Hexachampions is a TCG-tabletop RPG hybrid: every Champion has its unique die and abilities. Your strategy is key, but it will be up to the roll of the dice to dictate what your tools will be. So you always know what to blame in case you lose.

games.name: Goldio
games.summary: Goldio is about 6 random people who got sent to a different dimension by the villain, Gamebear. The friends have to escape and stop Gamebear from luring more people into his universe, they do this by going through all the different stages of the game to explode Bresh Mountain!!

games.name: GingerSnap
games.summary: Collect and combine ingredients for a wide combination of moves. Inspired by old N64 era favorites, like Kirby 64 and MegaMan!

games.name: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
games.summary: Take out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens their homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

games.name: Garbage Girl Louise
games.summary: Garbage Girl Louise is an indie platformer about breaking down boxes, cleaning up streets, and taking names! Of course, this is done through bouncing on evil moles, magic trash cans, and cardboard boxes, all while tossing anything you can get your grubby trash girl hands on! Save trapped raccoons, meet weirdos around the city, and even race against your ex-girlfriend! Dingy streets! Bubble wrap! Magical eggs! Lesbians! Yeah, we have everything!

games.name: Galacard
games.summary: Play with cards, with your Game Boy... with aliens!

games.name: Fuu3: Minus3’s Lab
games.summary: Fuu3: Minus3’s Lab is a point-and-click game being created on the Clickteam Fusion 2.5 engine. Discover what you thought you knew about the titular Minus3, Fuu3’s sworn rival! Meet some extravagant characters, take systems down, and piece together who you were meant to be in this 2000s Newgrounds-inspired take on origin stories!

games.name: Fuu3's Fuun Journey
games.summary: Fuu3's Fuun Journey is a 2D platformer that stars the titular Fuu3 on an adventure he’s clearly not ready for, but he’s gonna do it. Someone has to! Joined with his friends Fuu6 and Fuu9, he must make his way through weird and unknown locations in order to stop the nefarious Minus3 and his dastardly team from finding and controlling the remaining paloomanium, an element thought to grant the user powers beyond reality. Will you have the upper hand? Or will you fail and suffer under the might of Minus3? Only one way to find out: BE THERE OR BE SQUARE!

games.name: Frostbite Friends
games.summary: Frostbite Friends is an 80's arcade-style top-down shooter inspired by both niche and classic retro games, starring two snowkids, Mike and Milly, as they venture to rescue the mysterious Dream Stars from the hands of the devious King Guzbum and his assembly of goons!

games.name: Free Skies
games.summary: Free Skies is a mix of arcade skating and speedy platforming inspired by Jet Set Radio, Tony Hawk, and Sonic.

games.name: Frebbventure Alliance
games.summary: That's right, the cat came back, and this time, with more. More what? More friends, more enemies, more action, more levels, more bosses, more story. More everything! Frebbventure Alliance takes the formula for a game that prided itself on being jam-packed no-frills action platforming madness, and does it even harder!

games.name: Foxblade Fable
games.summary: A young boy is forced to embark on a quest to master the powers of the Divines,

games.name: Food Fight
games.summary: You'll have a blast, folks! Come run, jump and fight Jalapenos in Food Fight! This demo is to feature 2 levels and a boss! It also serves as an introduction of what's to come! Our Protagonist, Starla McCormick has found herself at the "Snock Advanced Gay Expo" and out of pure boredom, goes through the eerie catacombs of Gravestone Grease and the cold streets of Freezy Freeze Fields! Are you up for it?

games.name: Firedog: Swooce & Rescue
games.summary: Firedog: Swooce & Rescue is a momentum-based platformer where you play as a firefighting dog with a powerful firehose. Balance the uncontrollable force of a handheld firehose with the athletic moves of a high-energy Pomeranian as you fight enemies, put out fires, and rescue the good citizens of Dog City. And yes, you can pet the dogs.

games.name: Fighting of School
games.summary: Fighting of School is a fighting game, inspired by anime and games from very famous fighting game franchises, it mixes 8-bit elements with 16-bit sounds.

games.name: Dungeon Gals
games.summary: A small polycule-turned-crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges!

games.name: DreamShock
games.summary: Blast through nightmares, come dreams or reality!

games.name: Dream Enkoure
games.summary: A not so simple platformer where you go from left to right.

games.name: Distancy
games.summary: Distancy is a tightly made with passion, tough as nails, Game Boy Color-inspired 2D platformer with various other inspirations! Originally, the game started out small but blossomed into a full team for its creation. Feel the world come to life before your very eyes!

games.name: Danger Cliff 2
games.summary: Danger Cliff 2 is a very open-ended 2D Platformer inspired by Super Mario 63. Run, jump, and drill through huge, interconnected levels with wild themes, unique mechanics, and branching paths. Between being able to hunt down whatever collectibles you want, taking advantage of deep movement mechanics, and three playable characters to choose from, you decide how you tackle this adventure!

games.name: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend
games.summary: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend is a story-driven indie RPG where you play as Michael, a nerdy kangaroo inventor from the Tech District. They have a lifelong goal of making monsters less of a threat to society. And their research takes them to the abandoned offices of the Mall District to test a theory regarding how monsters relate to the memories of the deceased. Things go well, but then they get caught up in a corporate nightmare. Slowly breaking them down and leaving them desperately searching for a way to escape.

games.name: ChromaZone
games.summary: ChromaZone is a game about a man just taking a casual walk around his home island Prismara Isle although suddenly an unfamiliar Robot native to the island appeared before him with his flying saucer-type machine he flew with. he morphed his body into a ball-like shape as he would fly away turning his friends into more or less puppets.

games.name: Celestial Soul
games.summary:
Celestial Soul is a 2D game about anthropomorphic fox who's found himself in the middle of somewhere??

He's on a quest in the Void to retrieve the lost shards of his SOUL, which was shattered by his clumsy new friend.

games.name: Caravan SandWitch
games.summary: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

games.name: Cappi: Starbound Saga
games.summary:
Go forth, it is you who will save the universes... from annihilation.

Cappi: Starbound Saga is a 2D platformer with gameplay styles inspired by the Kirby and Sonic series. With Cappi, use powerful abilities and maintain speed to be able to save the galaxy in record time.

games.name: Canvas Intruder
games.summary: Canvas Intruder is a game about an artist named Pix who got sucked into the canvas world unfortunately thanks to her apprentice's black magic. goofy. But now its up to Pix to navigate through these canvas levels!

games.name: Candy Rangers
games.summary: Go on a single player, On-Rails Shooter Adventure in Candy Rangers and match 4 colors with 4 rangers! Each ranger can take down enemies that match their color, and it's up to you to use each one accordingly! Can you match them all?

games.name: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
games.summary:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

games.name: Bun 'N' Gun
games.summary: Bun 'N' Gun is a fast action-based run-and-gun game where you command different weapon elements and jump through several action-packed stages full of enemies, traps, and powerups.

games.name: Bulletombe
games.summary:
In ancient Greece, in the land of Helenia, a young woman who lived in the mountains closest to Olympus was in charge of looking after a mysterious vase inside the temple. One day the vase was making strange sounds and when Pandora went to check on it, the vase burst open and released all the evils that lay within, and along with them, a cherub named Lucy appeared to inform Pandora that this event would cause untold disasters on earth and that it was necessary to recapture them.
Pandora, with great courage and the power of hope that still resides in the vase, decides to travel through Helenia in search of the evils; luckily they are not too far away and the disasters they bring behind them are clearly visible.

games.name: BuKnight: The Order of the Golden Crest
games.summary: BuKnight is a fun and speedy action-platformer mixing the late '90s era mascot fever with the mid-2000s indie game craze. Use your up-and-downsmash attacks, as well as the special swirling move to hurl pain at your enemies or to change your momentum and dodge their attacks as you zoom past or towards them.

games.name: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion
games.summary: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion is a platformer game made in GB Studio that tells the story of a paintbrush named Bristle, whose planet is invaded by an army of artificially generated monsters. It's up to Bristle to rescue his friends and save any neighboring planets affected by this catastrophe.

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Blobun
games.summary: You are a blob bunny. Your goal? Touch every tile!

games.name: Black Cat Blitz
games.summary: Welcome to Black Cat Blitz! A game of magic, wonder, and gambling your life away. Play as Nemo (or Mimi if you're a gamer girl rawr) as you try to make the best hand possible by collecting cards, climbing stairs, grabbing chips, and avoiding obstacles. Try playing with a friend in co-op mode! or dont... and be lonely

games.name: Biophage
games.summary:
You are a single-celled organism.

Climb walls and ceilings, and find new ways to build up and maintain speed!

Punt your enemies into the air and finish them off with a grab and slam!

Explore the strange ecosystems laid out in your path, and feel the essence of nature!

games.name: Balloon to the Moon 2
games.summary: Balloon to the Moon 2 is a Semi-Open World Retro Style Platformer inspired by Jet Set Willy. After the First Game, Peter made it to the Moon but is then greeted by the moon's Inhabitants. Which are humans with rabbit ears. The Moon Rabbit Princess offers you to live with them if you can complete a trail to grab all the moon treasures scattered throughout the moon. You will have to navigate several areas to grab all the treasures.

games.name: Aureole: Wings of Hope
games.summary: At sonic speeds, Aureole: Wings of Hope takes platforming to the literal skies! Join Ramila and Ryleth on their crusade to reclaim their home from demonic forces in this unique physics-based side-scrolling game.

games.name: Aurascope
games.summary: Aurascope is a 2D action-adventure collectathon platformer with light puzzle and RPG elements. Join our friends Trace and Aurora to uncover the secrets surrounding the Aurascope, a mysterious drive from beyond the stars!

games.name: Astropods: Starside Glaze
games.summary:
Astropods: Starside Glaze is a 2D Fighting Platformer with endless mobility and combat potential! Starring as Hemi and Acro, swap between them at any time to utilize their unique attacks and physics within various environments.

Astropods combines platform fighter combat with platformer styled levels, alongside nonlinear progression and perk customization, to create a dynamic combat-platforming experience unlike anything else!

games.name: Art Strikers
games.summary: Draw your path to victory in Art Strikers! A unique art themed bullet hell shoot-em-up that looks and plays like a beautiful work of art.

games.name: Angels & Demons
games.summary:
Platformer, RPG, Rhythm Game?!
Angels & Demons is a multi-genre mashup!

The Spiritual Barrier has been broken! It's up to you, and your guardian angel Yui, to fix it! Travel the world and fight off demons from The Seven Deadly Sins in a quest to find The Seven Runes of Virtue! Can you fix The Barrier and restore order to The Living Realm?

games.name: Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster - Lights Out
games.summary: Get ready to dive back into the fast-paced world of Adventure Kitty: Drill Buster! This thrilling drilling game takes you on an exciting journey through unique biomes where danger lurks at every turn. In this chapter, Carton and Felicity have retrieved the Earth element, but their adventure is far from over. Now, they must brave the treacherous Lab Biome, a high-tech environment filled with perilous machines and cunning enemies determined to stop them from reaching their goal.

games.name: Acroflow
games.summary: Dive through dimensions with style in this 3D expressive platformer! Join Acro and Flora on their cosmic quest to reunite and return home. Use their acrobatic abilities to jump, dive and spin through bite-sized arcade platforming challenges set across multiple dream-like realms!

games.name: A2C: Ayry Seems to be Playtesting a 2D Runner Shooter from Cci
games.summary: A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other(and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)!

games.name: 02Rhythm
games.summary: 02Rhythm is a rhythm game developed for mobile phones. Inspired by popular rhythm games such as Hatsune Miku: Project Diva and the Persona: Dancing All Night series, it is played by tapping on the screen in the rhythm of the music.

events.name: Hello! Indie!: TGS 2024
events.description: Indie games from around the world gather at TGS 2024!

games.name: BlockWorld Ai
games.summary: RPG puzzle game in which players train a mysterious AI, Hoshihabito-kun, who learns how to move puzzles and the results, and fight powerful bosses together with players

games.name: Cassette Boy
games.summary: All you see is all there is - Cassette Boy: an RPG where what exists depends on you.

games.name: Rap Uncle
games.summary: This game features an old man who misunderstands rap and puns, so you'll have to poke fun at him. Swipe according to the icons displayed on the screen to make a tsukkomi. If you make quick hits, you will get a lot of chicks (scores).

games.name: Isles of Sea and Sky
games.summary: A fantastical, oceanic, and open world puzzle adventure game. Solve novel block-pushing puzzles while unearthing a mystifying narrative, awakening delightful new friends, gathering collectables, and unleashing extraordinary powers beyond your wildest imagination.

games.name: Death the Guitar
games.summary: "Death the Guitar" is a pop and violent 2D Platformer action game. The player is a killer electric guitar whose owner was murdered, and the goal is to take revenge on the humans by manipulating "sound" and "electricity".

games.name: Commentator
games.summary: "Commentator" is a novel game where you become a commentator for a popular news program. By selecting the news to comment on and your critique stance, you will experience a manipulation of public opinion and a changing a world.

games.name: Planet Strike
games.summary: Experience the ultimate cosmic billiards. Solar winds that accelerate planets with intrusion. Asteroids decelerating on impact. Lead the planets of the solar system to the black hole by utilizing various devices placed in the field.

games.name: ElePass: Only Elephants Can Unlock the Passcode
games.summary: This is an action puzzle game for 1 to 2 players that can be played on a single smartphone. You play as the main character, an elephant who has picked up a smartphone, using a finger shaped like an elephant's trunk. There are also special elephant rings to set the mood.

games.name: Detective Nekko
games.summary: Mystery adventure where no one dies. Use your “ability to see too much” to uncover an inconvenient truth.

games.name: Anlife: Motion-Learning Life Evolution
games.summary: Intervene in the evolution of virtual lifeforms that learn to move in a world powered by a physics engine. This world already features built-in mechanisms like heredity and natural selection. The player acts as a creator, manipulating these natural processes to help lifeforms learn and evolve.

games.name: Red Rocket Defencism
games.summary: You, a military officer from our great autocratic motherland, must protect our precious rockets from the evil capitalist enemy in this revolutionary base building strategy game. Bribe! Surveil! Purge! Imbibe! The end justifies the means when you have to protect our invaluable rockets!

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Rely on nothing but your own wits. A first-person cryptographic adventure game that play with paper and pen. As you wander through the maze of memories, can you find the key to saving the future?

games.name: Stellagate
games.summary: Stellagate is a puzzle action with gates that can connect different locations. The connected areas are seamlessly connected to each other, and you are free to throw blocks or lasers through them.

games.name: Inverted Angel
games.summary: A girl visited your home, who you don't know but she identified herself as your girlfriend. She seems a little bit Menhera, but she knows too much to be just a stalker. This is a Kawaii Future Mystery, the AI judges your guesses for branching story. Please Try to find out true identity of her.

games.name: On the Keyboard
games.summary:
This is a keyboard action game where you control a virtual keyboard to carry a Sphere.

The controls are simple: just follow your intuition and press the keys. The virtual keys that correspond to the ones you press will move, and the Sphere will move in response to the force from the keys. Your goal is to carry the Sphere to the finish line without letting it fall off the keyboard.

However, you can't move the Sphere directly, so it often won't behave as you'd like. To manage this irregular Sphere behavior, you’ll need to quickly identify and press the right key from the 40 available. This makes the game more action-packed than it may initially seem.
Moreover, even though it's challenging enough to move the Sphere as intended, the path to the goal is filled with various obstacles that block your way. Overcoming these obstacles requires flexible thinking and skillful manipulation of the keyboard.

Additionally, this game also functions as a typing game, as understanding the spatial arrangement of the keys is crucial. It can improve typing accuracy for both beginners and experienced typists. Why not sharpen your typing skills while having fun with an action-packed game?

And be careful not to break your keyboard!

games.name: Saeko: Giantess Dating Sim
games.summary: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you. Experience the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story with avant-garde art.

games.name: Marron's Day
games.summary: Marron's Day is a silly adventure game where you're a bunny! You love your friends but love carrots even more. Explore the town, run errands for your animal friends, and don't let anyone catch you swiping the carrots from the garden (again)!

games.name: Time For Bed
games.summary: It’s all over if mom catches you playing video games past bedtime. Pretend to sleep through this nightmare, avoid mother’s surveillance, and complete the game at hand.

games.name: Last Standing
games.summary: This is an action game in which players compete to defeat the number of enemies that appear from the left and right sides of the screen. The most distinctive feature of the game is the control method, which is innovative and original, like banging on a keyboard.

games.name: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle
games.summary: In a randomly changing labyrinth castle, Rustil aims for the top floor. An exhilarating roguelike action game in which players aim to reach the top floor while efficiently strengthening the main character by acquiring abilities from the souls of heroes.

games.name: HoooPizza
games.summary: An experiential game where you control a hula hoop instead of a regular game controller to make pizza. Spin the hulahoop to make the largest pizza ever!

games.name: Fallen: Fatal Force
games.summary: Description:This game is a psychic action game. Escape from the maze-like research facility by manipulating telekinesis, levitation, and teleportation.

games.name: Nightmare Operator
games.summary: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

games.name: Pricolage: Idolized
games.summary:
Who are you...?
Pricolage: Idolized is an SNS-based interactive Visual Novel.

games.name: Fowl Damage
games.summary: Fowl Damage is an atmospheric puzzle platformer where your default jump provides enough fall damage to destroy you! Carefully manage your jumps and falls as you adventure through this chilling, beautiful, and occasionally cute world.

games.name: While Waiting
games.summary: A transformative adventure exploring the art of waiting. Clear the game by doing nothing, but discover the power of acceptance and patience in 100+ situations from birth to death. Learn to embrace life as you wait.

games.name: Esophaguys
games.summary: Esophaguys is a silly local multiplayer party game where you play as old folks with elongating necks. Stretch your necks together to find your lost kin and compete against each other for long-necked glory!

games.name: We Harvest Shadows
games.summary: A first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

games.name: Coke Bugs
games.summary: A hallucinatory bender of a late night road trip sketched in nervous lines of arcade action and exploration.

games.name: Dome-King Cabbage
games.summary: Dome-King Cabbage is a visual novel about a cloud-person named Mush nervously making their way to a job interview. Mush has to grapple with their ability to perceive the world through the lens of a monster-collecting RPG. This is the first chapter in an episodic interactive-fiction series. Originally created for TyranoBuilder's Spring Game Jam, Dome-King Cabbage won the competition's gold prize, awarding it $500 and first-place among 50 entrants. The entire work is a mostly solo effort by Joe Buchholz.

games.name: Yolk Heroes: A Long Tamago
games.summary: Yolk Heroes is the virtual pet game you've always wanted! RPG Mechanics, minigames, quests...who doesn't love quests? Your elf will explore, grow stronger, and embark on an adventure to deliver the world from evil! OR! You can just relax and enjoy your little friend.

games.name: Gurei
games.summary: An action platformer where you face challenging enemies inspired by Japanese mythology and acquire their powers. Choose your fights in any order, knowing that each opponent gets stronger as the game progresses!

games.name: Ironhive
games.summary: Ironhive is a deckbuilding strategy game about surviving in a dying world. Build your colony, ensure the survival of your people, create a legacy that will be passed on to the next generations. As the Ironlord, you are their only remaining hope.

games.name: Honey Pot
games.summary: Dive into the immersive world of 'Honey Pot,' a cooperative action-strategy VR game where you and your friends become bees defending the hive from bears on the hunt. Fly, gather honey, construct turrets, deploy stingers, and use bow and arrow attacks in a frantic battle to protect Queen Bee Melli's domain. Team up, strategize, and save the hive in this thrilling VR experience!

games.name: Saborus
games.summary: Saborus, a gripping horror adventure! Guide the brave chicken, through a deadly slaughterhouse. Solve chilling puzzles and face relentless pursuit. Can you survive?

games.name: Mecha Macho
games.summary: Mecha Macho is an action/platform video game, in which you play as Luchin, a 3-year-old baby that is the reincarnation of the legendary wrestling champion "El Super Macho". You will travel through the universe in your robot suit to avenge his death, and recover his champion belt using wrestling techniques and powers, that you start to remember as you make your way through the game

games.name: Rose and Locket
games.summary: Rose, a retired outlaw, wanders through the spirit realm of the Underwest. Take up the once-forgotten skills of the gunslinger, and journey along the breathtaking, cinematic hand-painted landscapes on a quest to rescue your daughter’s spirit.

games.name: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero
games.summary: Primordials Legends: Hollow Hero tells the tale of Brunt, an anthropomorphic Combat Wombat on her first adventure in the fantasy world, Eridal. Embark on this epic 3rd person action-filled adventure, uncover how this world came to be, and meet new legends that will help shape the future of Eridal!

games.name: Copycat
games.summary: Copycat is a narrative-driven game that explores loneliness and belonging. It follows the story of Dawn, a hell-no-to-home-brand, pampered indoor cat living her best nine lives - until she becomes the target of an elaborate plan when a jealous stray look-alike steals her place in the home.

games.name: Final Knight
games.summary: Retro console-style beat 'em up action RPG, Giant weapons, massive monsters, Lightning Ring, 9 fantasy classes, and Sword of Legend.

games.name: Pia
games.summary: "You have stepped on a landmine. How will you handle it?" This game challenges you to disarm a landmine using a multi-key input system, simulating the tough situation. By aligning the character's situation with the player's actions, it offers a unique experience. Using a pedal controller enhances the realism. Can you successfully disarm the landmine and survive?

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Nqc: Non Qualia Character
games.summary: RPG where human who became NPC find himself.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: No Case Should Remain Unsolved
games.summary: Twelve years after Senior Inspector Jeon Gyeong's retirement, she is visited by a young police officer: a woman who pleads with her to reexamine Seowon's case. But with each uncovered memory, only one thing becomes clear: everyone in Seowon's vicinity was lying.

games.name: Dream in the Shell
games.summary:
When a black sphere appears on Earth, countless people become trapped in endless dreams. The protagonist's wife is among them, compelling him to venture into the dangerous sphere to save her.

'Dream in the Shell' is a story adventure game that explores surreal worlds where dreams, memories, and the subconscious blend. Explore mysterious spaces through unique interactions and uncover the truth.

games.name: Bionic Bay
games.summary: An ordinary man in an extraordinary world. Bionic Bay is a new kind of a 2D platformer. It introduces a unique Swap mechanic, allowing players to interact with the physics-based world in new ways. The immersive gameplay is completed by spectacular environments and creative level design.

games.name: Cyber Parkour
games.summary: Cyber Parkour is a PVP mobile racing game with fast-paced gameplay. Race as a Cyber Runner on side-scrolling tracks, dodge obstacles, and use cyber abilities to win! Collect various runner skins and accessories along the way. Break free from the System and race through neon buildings to become the champion in Cyber Parkour.

games.name: Minds Beneath Us
games.summary: Minds Beneath Us is a story-rich Sci-Fi thriller adventure game set in a futuristic Asian city. In a society that has become fully automated with AI, you will be trapped into a body that doesn't belong to yourself, making choices for him and face the coming fate together.

games.name: Evotinction
games.summary: Evotinction is a third-person stealth game featuring unique hacking mechanics. The developers share an enormous passion for the stealth genre and wish to provide a complex and dynamic stealth experience for players. A variety of hacking skills, environment devices and gadgets provide rich emergent gameplay.

games.name: Mecha Force
games.summary: Mecha Force is an immersive and exciting VR experience that blends the thrill of mecha action with the unpredictability of a roguelike game. Players are transported to a world in turmoil, where they must defend against both internal and external threats as they take control of their very own mecha. This is no ordinary machine, however; the player is able to customize and personalize their mecha, choosing from a diverse range of artillery and melee weapons to create their own formidable war machine.

games.name: Arisen Force: Vonimir
games.summary: "Arisen Force: Vonimir" is an A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixels, it combines the engaging RPG adventure storyline with the 2.5D combat experience.We create a magnificent Middle-Earth world, for players exploration and adventure, recruit teammates, collect and develop business, challenge enemies, reveal the secrets of the world, guide the future, forge your own legends .

games.name: Dashy Crashy 100
games.summary: Start your engines and outrun 99 racers in a thrilling knockout race. 100 start. Only 1 survives. Lightning-fast reaction-racing with a 100-racer twist. Party up with friends, master simple tap controls and test your reflexes on choas-filled highways as you try to boost and bash your way to 1st place. Let's DASHY CRASHY!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Kriegsfront Tactics
games.summary: Kriegsfront Tactics is a procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia where you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Build your mecha squad, complete missions, and survive the front another day.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: Airship: Kingdoms Adrift
games.summary: Customize and manage your fleet of airships, plan trade routes, establish industries, explore the vast sky of Europa in the time of turmoil and national conflicts. Airship: Kingdoms Adrift is strategy-simulation game with rich lore and captivating story to explore. Also featuring online PvP mode.

games.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
games.summary: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a Wuxia hack n' slash game. Play as the great fighter, Zhāng Yì Xiàn, who seeks revenge for the death of his family at the hands of China's powerful Gāo Tiān Qí. Dive into a tale of revenge, redemption, martial arts, and intense swordplay.

games.name: Aldian of Ancients
games.summary: Aldian of Ancients is a dinosaur multiplayer simulation/survival game aims to recreate the world of yore filled with creatures that defy comprehension.

games.name: Lost Twins 2
games.summary: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

games.name: Milord
games.summary: Milord is a Kingdom Management RPG game with city building mechanics. You'll be left with hard choices for your fiefdom. Will you be able to rise to the occasion or lose your kingdom and life in the process.

games.name: Metavoidal
games.summary: Play as a drummer seeking revenge on a Metal Band of Eldritch Monsters in this wacky roguelite brawler. Fight through hordes of enemies with only your drumsticks & drumming techniques as your weapons. Tap into the power of their music by finding corrupted music discs to increase your strength to defeat each of the band members. Are you good enough to escape the corrupted hellscape, once and for all?

games.name: Neon Blood
games.summary: The dual Viridis, separated between the luxurious Bright City and the dangerous Blind City, where inequality reigns until you, Axel McCoin, an idealistic detective, start a revolution to change the world in this cyberpunk RPG adventure.

games.name: Haneda Girl
games.summary: Haneda Girl is an action-platformer game with brutal and frantic action. Clean stages swapping between two playable characters. Bullets or Slashes, your choice, but be creative. A wide variety of ways to solve each encounter are at your disposal. Dance the waltz of destruction, end the threat.

games.name: The Crazy Hyper-Dungeon Chronicles
games.summary: The Hyper‑Dungeon awaits! Explore an evershifting labyrinth where classic dungeon‑crawling meets exhilarating action. Challenge yourself in turn-based combat with a real‑time, arcade‑inspired twist and befriend an eccentric cast of dungeon dwellers on the quest for the legendary Sacred Groowl!

games.name: Cinema
games.summary: Cinema is an immersive investigative thriller game where player wields control over time and the intricate interplay of cause and effect within the storyline inspired by silent films.

games.name: Loco Limbo
games.summary: Hello, I'm Loco Limbo, waking up on an island after some crazy military experiments. Now, I can detach my own limbs and control 'em like puppets.Can I make it off this crazy island in one piece?

games.name: Ominous Recall
games.summary: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

games.name: Chess Twist
games.summary: A game of chess set on a procedurally generated board, where tiles can have 3 or 5 diagonals and straight lines bend around your opponent's defenses. Same rules, different battlefield. Opportunities for new strategies are hidden in plain sight. Will you see them before your opponent does?

games.name: Rhythmscapes
games.summary:
Guided by an inner-rhythm spirit, take part in rhythm practices set within immersive visual environments. Enhance your focus and coordination while discovering the essence of your rhythm. Engage in drumming sessions driven by the science of human emotions - all of this is achieved with just your bare hands, and no controllers are needed.

Rhythmscapes makes a groundbreaking leap, synthesizing mindfulness and rhythm-based game mechanics into a single therapeutic experience within immersive VR.

games.name: Pieced Together
games.summary: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

games.name: Videoverse
games.summary: Take a trip back to the days of the early internet and fan forums, when the video game console "Kinmoku Shark" and its online social network "Videoverse" were still popular...

games.name: Tampopo
games.summary: Tampopo is a heartfelt RPG adventure with unique physics-based combat. It is set in a strange world with strange characters. It is a lighthearted game that will make you laugh but it has a hidden darkness to itself which will gently unfold until it wraps all the way around you.

games.name: Suzerain: Kingdom of Rizia
games.summary: Experience the rulership of a new country in the Suzerain Universe with The Kingdom of Rizia DLC – the first expansion of the critically-acclaimed political role-playing game. As King Romus Toras explore the unique geopolitical and internal conflicts of the Kingdom of Rizia.

games.name: Miniatures
games.summary: Miniatures is a collection of strange tales where childhood imagination and reality merge with darker undercurrents of mystery and magic. Explore a vast seascape, build odd furniture, feed a lizard and play with sand castles.

games.name: First Dwarf
games.summary: If there’s one thing dwarves are better at than grooming their beards, it's engineering. Jump into your mech, build a base and explore the crumbled fantasy world in this immersive action RPG.

games.name: Hollow Home
games.summary: Hollow Home is an isometric narrative RPG about the russian invasion of Ukraine, told from the perspective of a teenager trapped inside an occupied city. Learn survival skills, build relationships and face tough choices as each passing day brings new tragedies and destruction to your childhood home.

games.name: Freaked Fleapit
games.summary: Hell never looked this good! Save your soul in a wild cocktail of rhythm-based dungeon crawling and date sims, and dance your way through 9 circles of Hell to heart-pumping music. Which lady of the Fleapit will be the one to join you on your trip out of Purgatory?

games.name: Mineral Madness
games.summary: Mineral Madness is a fast-paced battle arena where you go head-to-head against rival moles as you race to collect the most minerals. Create mayhem as you blast your way through the fully destructible underground to become the number one mole miner!

events.name: IndieMania
events.description: Join us as we celebrate the best of indie gaming with exclusive showcases, developer interviews, and exciting giveaways! IndieMania is your ultimate destination for discovering hidden gems and supporting talented indie developers.

games.name: Sunset Hills
games.summary: The player takes on the role of Nico, who travels by train to each city to visit his former comrades, encountering a variety of people and events on the journey, and gradually learning about different life through solving assorted puzzles along the way. As they reunite, they recall their past experiences in the war, unravelling the war and Nico’s past, and gradually revealing the true purpose of Nico’s journey.

games.name: A Webbing Journey
games.summary: A Webbing Journey is a physics-based sandbox game where you play as a cute little spider. Explore a giant house, create crazy web structures, and complete oversized chores in creative and fun ways.

games.name: Immortal: And the Death that Follows
games.summary: Develop your own unique fighting style, form your own gang and fight your inner demon while trying to escape an interdimensional prison for demigods. Immortal is a rogue-like side-scrolling beat-em-up inspired by fighting games and 90s anime.

games.name: Caravan SandWitch
games.summary: Embark on a journey across vast landscapes in Caravan SandWitch, a captivating narrative-driven exploration adventure game.

games.name: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band
games.summary:
The band is in town, and it’s time for some fun!
Join Miss Rosen, a clockwork majorette escaped from her music box, as she travels the world solving mind-bending puzzles that’ll test your luggage-packing skills to the max!

games.name: Vampires Fable
games.summary: Vampires Fable is a coop, adventure, story-driven game for two players, combining the best of escape room games, puzzle games and arcade games. None of the players will be able to solve the puzzle alone. Whether you manage to find your way back to each other depends only on your communication.

games.name: Super Bawk Bawk Chicken
games.summary: Super Bawk Bawk Chicken is an infinite runner where you play as a charming chicken with super powers.

games.name: Escape The Charon
games.summary: Escape the Charon is a sci-fi adventure meant to be played in one sitting. An ancient alien artifact has been brought to the space station Charon - soon after, the Charon goes dark. James West must search for clues and solve the mystery to discover what went wrong.

games.name: The Dark Side of Ceclon
games.summary: Jensen, the sole survivor of the Nexentia shuttle crash on the planet CECLON. Alone, light years away from all human life! You will have to face the Nocturnes, primitive creatures in order to bring back the Veka energy, humanity's only hope.

games.name: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game
games.summary:
Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a cute, funny, and heartwarming hand animated JRPG from Studio Kumiho.

After a devastating loss, Jae would do anything to fix the past. Blast off with your newfound friends on a journey to the gates of Yimmelia, a fabled land on the moon that’s rumored to grant any wish.

You take turns fighting, landing timed inputs, and using the benefits from those attacks to do awesome team attacks. Your behavior in the world affects the difficulty of combat, and the rewards. The story focuses on laughs while also having real moments about loss, loneliness, and friendship.

games.name: Zlime: Return Of Demon Lord
games.summary: Enter the world of Zlime, an action Roguelike game where you'll embark on a thrilling adventure in a demonic realm. Experience an unique transformation system, devour your foes, enhance your powers, and battle your way to victory! Prepare for an exhilarating and challenging gameplay experience!

games.name: Panzer Paladin
games.summary: Hop in the Paladin power armor, seize melee weapons from the demonic invaders and give them a taste of their own medicine!

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
games.summary: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge is a side-scrolling beat 'em up developed by Tribute Games and published by DotEmu. Inspired by the 1987 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles animated series, the game pays homage to classic TMNT titles like Turtles in Time, featuring retro-inspired pixel art and dynamic combat. Players control Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, Raphael, or other allies, each with unique abilities, as they battle through various levels to thwart Shredder and Krang's plans to conquer New York City. The game supports solo play or co-op for up to six players, blending nostalgic design with modern gameplay mechanics.

games.name: Ninja Senki
games.summary: Ninja Senki is a 2D action platform video game created by Canadian indie developer Jonathan Lavigne. It was inspired by classic NES games such as Ninja JaJaMaru-kun and Mega Man. The 8-bit style game has the same resolution as Game Boy console games (160 x 144 pixels).

games.name: Wizorb
games.summary: The once peaceful Kingdom of Gorudo is threatened by an evil presence. The only hope for salvation is Cyrus!

games.name: Mercenary Kings
games.summary:
In this frantic 2D action game, you are part of the Mercenary Kings, the most skilled team of warriors-for-hire on Earth, but when your comrades have fallen and the fearsome forces of CLAW have seized an island-wide top secret Laboratory Base, you must do what it takes to stop them.

But you're not going in unprepared! Your back-up is made of a crew of rogue geniuses and experts of their field! Able to craft & customize guns'n'blades or upgrading body armor, you've never been this ready to join the fight.

Whether its solo or with friends, move out, cut down CLAW and save the world!

games.name: Flinthook
games.summary: Flinthook is a fast action-platformer with “roguelike” elements. Become space’s greatest pirate with your hookshot, pistol and slowmo powers!

games.name: RetroRealms Arcade
games.summary: The RetroRealms Arcade connects select RetroRealms games with other titles in the series that you own (games and DLC sold separately) to unlock new access and abilities and create the ultimate mash-up of horror legends!

games.name: Ethra
games.summary: EthrA is an RPG/Adventure and open world game that revolves around the misadventures of two characters: Bob and Veil. Both will explore the land of EthrA and uncover a thousand year lie the world already forgot about.

games.name: Steel Assault
games.summary: Punch, whip, and zipline your way through a post-apocalyptic America in this retro-style action platformer! Play as Taro Takahashi, a resistance soldier on a revenge mission against the dictator who lords over the ashes.

games.name: Covert Crew
games.summary: A Superpowered SRPG! Covert Crew is a 2D strategic roleplaying game inspired by the classics of old with a modern twist.

games.name: Gambit Shifter
games.summary: A relaxing puzzle game inspired by chess. Master the board, change your form and create your path to dethrone the opponent King!

games.name: The Storyteller
games.summary: The Storyteller is an online game that takes traditional TTRPG elements into a digital environment. You can build your own world, play online with your friends, engage in role-playing, and guide them through your story.

games.name: River City Girls 2
games.summary: Picking up shortly after the original, River City Girls 2 once again put you in control of Misako and Kyoko - as well as Kunio, Riki, and a few new characters - as they set out on an all-new beat-'em-up adventure across the mean streets of River City. New moves, new enemies, new recruits, new environments, and the return of an old foe await, along with the same over-the-top sense of humor and adrenaline-pumping combat of its predecessor. The game will also feature two-player co-op action both locally and online.

games.name: Tilting Tiles
games.summary: Tilting Tiles is a minimalist puzzle experience. It is a unique movement based puzzle game. Guide the tile through each level’s environment while collecting every item before your moves run out.

games.name: Yars Rising
games.summary:
In WayForward's experienced hands, the Yars franchise becomes an expansive mystery solved through 2D platforming action. Take control of the young hacker Emi Kimura, who is hired by a mysterious patron to infiltrate the shadowy QoTech corporation. Run, jump, sneak, and hack your way through challenges as you slowly unravel a complex secret shrouded in intrigue.

Emi grows in power throughout her adventure, allowing her to retrace her steps and reach previously inaccessible and secret areas. Her evolving hacking skills are critical to solving stimulating minigames that reference the innovative gameplay from the Atari 2600 title Yars' Revenge.

games.name: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
games.summary: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets is an indie Action RPG made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming. A spiritual successor to Save me Mr Tako, play in a world where Octopuses were erased from history.

games.name: A look into...
games.summary: In a peaceful yet broken-down world, you discover a myriad of wildlife and peoples. Collect materials, learn recipes, restore your surroundings, and cultivate foods, all while helping those you encounter. Perhaps you can uncover what’s happening in this strange land—and your role in it all.

games.name: Don't Fraud My Heart!
games.summary: Don't Fraud my Heart is a visual novel made entirely in Microsoft Powerpoint. It is a romantic, financially literate adventure that brings you into the exciting world of tax auditing.

games.name: Clock Tower: Rewind
games.summary:
The Super Famicom classic, Clock Tower, is getting remastered for modern consoles.

This remaster is a collaboration effort between Capcom, Sunsoft, WayForward, and Limited Run. This remaster also marks the first time the original Clock Tower game will see an official release outside of Japan, which up until this point only had fan translations. The remastered version will utilize the Carbon Engine.

Clock Tower is a survival horror point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Human Entertainment for the Super Famicom in 1995. It is the first installment of the long-running Clock Tower series.

The story follows Jennifer Simpson as she learns the secrets of the Barrows Mansion and attempts to escape the game's antagonist, Scissorman.
