games.summary: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, Loretta, a girl who has parasitized by an alien beast, tries to break through the fog and uncover the truth about her fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest place?

games.name: I Witness
games.summary: I Witness is a 2-player online co-op psychological horror game that follows a sibling whose curiosity leads them to investigate a neighbor suspected of being a serial killer who, unbeknownst to them, hides a disturbing desire.

games.name: Pamali: The Vengeful Mother
games.summary: Pamali: The Vengeful Mother is a 1-4 players online co-op survival horror. Use each character’s unique strengths, strategize with your teammates, do everything you can to save the missing children and escape the abandoned orphanage. Bring your friends!

games.name: My Father Lied
games.summary: My Father Lied is a first person point and click mystery game that tells the story of Huda, who finds herself following an unfathomable secret regarding her father’s 20 years disappearance.

games.name: Nif Nif
games.summary: Get ready for a gooey good time in this roguelike deckbuilding adventure with Nif Nif, the piglet who's saving the forest one sparkly animal at a time!

games.name: Mars Attracts
games.summary: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Fufufu
games.summary: Have you ever raced with sheeps, poked noses, or battled against pirate cats? Welcome to FUFUFU, an adorable roguelite adventure for all ages, full of wacky situations. Get ready for some Fu-lish action!

games.name: Egging On
games.summary: Face the challenge of being a real, fragile egg. Climb out of the hen house and survive in a shop, a kitchen, and other dangerous areas. Roll, jump, and use the environment to reach new heights. Don't break your eggshell, and do your best not to fall. With determination, you may reach freedom!

games.name: Asura
games.summary: MMORPG 2D pixel game by a Thai development team that has been in service for over 15 years and is still developing continuously.

games.name: Premeow League
games.summary:
The Universe Need US! Let's Spoil Cat and Free the Universe.
We are the last stand to free the universe from Tyranny Cat Alien- Empurrer from Premeow76 Galaxy.
Spoil the cats and build your own Purrfect football team to compete in Premeow League and Win against Empurrer.

games.name: Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl
games.summary: A silly multiplayer party game, Holiday Party: Mascot Brawl brings festive cheer with battles and mini-games matched with absurd weapons. Compete against friends and roast them with a flamethrower and slap them with a GIANT FISH. Jump into this hilarious holiday-themed brawling mayhem today!

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Zabb World: Secret Stories
games.summary: Welcome to "Zabb World", a virtual world where you can own it, make new friends, and chat. You can also do lots of fun activities together with your hottest character.

games.name: Pakapow Party
games.summary: Pakapow Party is an online board game for 1–4 players, where you’ll go on an adventure to protect villages from invading monsters and explore strange, unpredictable stories. You could end up becoming an ultrarich tycoon but beware, your teammates might just turn you into a poor wanderer

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: LightSup!
games.summary: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

games.name: Phantom Stars
games.summary: A Visual Novel of an investigating-dating idols: “When a new police officer has to go undercover as an 'idol group leader' to solve a case.”

games.name: Great Toy Showdown
games.summary: Welcome to the Great Toy Showdown!! A casual shooter 8-player battle royale game where a variety of animal toy friends battle to be the only one left standing and win the love of their lives. Take on outcast and fallen toys and other animal toys to become the only surviving toy!

games.name: Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake
games.summary:
The Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake is a modernized turn-based JRPG that follows a hero’s quest to defeat the archfiend Baramos. It features updated HD-2D visuals and an orchestral score while maintaining the original's prequel narrative and non-linear world exploration.
The core mechanics center on a vocation system for party customization, now including the new Monster Wrangler class. Modern updates like adjustable battle speeds and difficulty settings streamline the traditional experience of leveling characters and managing strategic combat.

games.name: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake
games.summary: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
games.summary:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a full remake of the groundbreaking non-linear RPG Romancing SaGa 2, which originally launched in Japan in 1993.

Embark on an adventure featuring both new and classic SaGa franchise features, complete with Japanese and English voiceovers, original and rearranged compositions, and much more! This is an ideal entry point for new players and provides an amped-up experience for longtime fans.

games.name: Fantasian Neo Dimension
games.summary:
The father of Final Fantasy, Hironobu Sakaguchi, and renowned composer Nobuo Uematsu return to deliver an original RPG story. Experience an enhanced version of FANTASIAN, initially released for Apple Arcade in 2021, with brand-new features, including English and Japanese voiceovers and an additional difficulty option.

In FANTASIAN Neo Dimension, assume the role of Leo as he journeys to recover his memories and solve the mystery of a strange mechanical infection destroying his world.

Experience an original and modern take on the beloved turn-based battle system, with a wealth of unique mechanics and strategic combat that shake up the classic RPG formula, and explore a multi-dimensional universe come to life, set against the backdrop of over 150 charming hand-crafted dioramas.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: First Dwarf
games.summary: If there’s one thing dwarves are better at than grooming their beards, it's engineering. Jump into your mech, build a base and explore the crumbled fantasy world in this immersive action RPG.

games.name: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight
games.summary: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight is a heartwarming cosy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant.

events.name: Xbox Partner Preview October 2024
events.description:
Xbox Partner Preview is back with ~25 minutes of new gameplay trailers, exciting announcements and exclusive world premieres.
 
Look out for updates from exciting upcoming games like Epic and Remedy's mysterious survival horror Alan Wake 2: The Lake House Expansion, the delightfully zany action-adventure Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii from Sega and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, souls-like action RPG WUCHANG: Fallen Feathers from Leenzee and 505 Games, and more!

games.name: Animal Well
games.summary: What lurks beneath the surface of this deceptively minimalistic adventure? In Animal Well there is more than what you see. Explore a dense interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter creatures both beautiful and unsettling, and try to survive what lurks in the dark.

games.name: Alan Wake II: The Lake House
games.summary: Alan Wake II: The Lake House is a DLC expansion for Alan Wake II. It introduces new story content set in an isolated lake house near Bright Falls, where players uncover additional clues about the supernatural forces affecting Alan Wake. The expansion retains the base game’s focus on psychological horror and narrative-driven exploration.

games.name: Blindfire
games.summary: Blindfire is the first FPS game set in complete darkness. Rely on your insincts to eliminate your opponents. It's either hunt or be hunted... Ready to light 'em up?

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.summary: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

games.name: Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii
games.summary:
A new legend begins as you step into the steel toe boots of Goro Majima, a man who has lost his memory and reinvents himself as a pirate on the open sea.

Embark on an over-the-top, modern-day pirate adventure with an ex-yakuza, now pirate captain and his crew as they engage in exhilarating combat on land and sea in the hunt for lost memories and a legendary treasure.

games.name: Wheel World
games.summary: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire
games.summary: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

games.name: Subnautica 2
games.summary: Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure set on an all-new alien world, developed by Unknown Worlds. Play alone or with friends in 4-player co-op. Adapt to survive by building custom bases and crafting tools. Explore the unknown to uncover the mysteries hidden within the depths.

games.name: Edens Zero
games.summary: This is a 3D action role-playing game based on the space fantasy comic/anime Edens Zero by Hiro Mashima, creator of Fairy Tail and Rave Master. The player controls a diverse cast of characters as they embark on an epic adventure across different planets while battling powerful enemies!

games.name: Eternal Strands
games.summary: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: The Legend of Baboo
games.summary: Young Sepehr and his loveable dog, Baboo, set off on a harrowing quest to save their family from the mystical forces of an ancient evil. Embark on an action-adventure, story-driven journey and explore a vast, magical world caught in a battle between light and dark.

games.name: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
games.summary: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers is a soulslike action RPG set in the land of Shu during the dark and tumultuous late Ming Dynasty, plagued by warring factions and a mysterious illness that spawns monstrous creatures.

games.name: FBC: Firebreak
games.summary: FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order.

events.name: The Indie Horror Showcase 2024
events.description: This year’s broadcast will feature over 60 brand-new bone-chilling trailers, including announcements, premieres, demo releases, new info, and… surprises to keep you on your toes.

games.name: Bye Sweet Carole
games.summary: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

games.name: Karma: The Dark World
games.summary: This is a first-person story-driven psychological horror game. Delve into this dark and strange world with an investigation officer from Roam to find traces of lost memories and fulfill your destiny.

games.name: Omut
games.summary: A punishing fever dream combining abject terror, dark comedy, and many, many deaths.

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary: Hunt creatures of the night in this Action RPG set in the suburbs of Arizona in the iconic 1980's. Choose a class, and take to the streets to save your small town from Baphomet and his demon generals.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Murky Divers
games.summary: Co-op diving horror. Eliminate all traces of your employer's failed experiments from their abandoned underwater labs. Navigate your submarine, dive down with your crew, remove all corpses, but watch out for the abyssal terrors lurking.

games.name: The Thing: Remastered
games.summary: Set after the events of the 1982 John Carpenter movie, The Thing: Remastered is a squad based 3rd person shooter, where each member of your team is equipped with a range of weapons and items to help you in your quest to destroy The Thing.

games.name: Sorry We're Closed
games.summary: Sorry We're Closed is a nostalgic single player survival horror game with rich lore and character interactions that allow multiple endings. Following the end days of Michelle, explore unsettling locations using the environment to hide and survive. Use your demon gun to defend in first person.

games.name: Paperhead Ep. 0
games.summary: In this cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... You wake up in a prison cell. A strange voice calls to you from the depths of dark corridors covered in runic symbols and blood. Reload your trusty shotgun and find out... WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

games.name: Slay the Princess: The Pristine Cut
games.summary:
Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art.

The Pristine Cut is the definitive version of the game. It features expanded content including 3 new chapters, never-before-seen Princesses, expansions to familiar routes, a new ending, over 1,200 new hand-penciled frames, over 2,500 new lines of dialogue, and over 35% more content overall.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Dark Hours
games.summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

games.name: Centum
games.summary: An unreliable narrative-driven adventure game. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal?

games.name: Among Ashes
games.summary: Among Ashes is a terrifying first-person survival horror game. Your friend has sent you a link to a game that someone posted online, but as you play you quickly realize that something is terribly wrong. Whatever you do… KEEP PLAYING

games.name: Cabernet
games.summary: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.

games.name: Oneway.exe
games.summary:
oneway.exe is a first-person, single player horror game, with a heavy focus on story and internet culture. Explore, survive and solve puzzles to find out what happened to UNTITLED.EXE, its developers, and understand why you're in the middle of it.

Face the internet horrors that haunt your past. The one's you've never heard of. They don't exist.

games.name: Tom the Postgirl
games.summary: Take a ride with Tom through her village and discover a great deal—perhaps too much—about the locals. Her approach, although controversial, is highly effective: intense and obsessive stalking.

games.name: Clock Tower: Rewind
games.summary:
The Super Famicom classic, Clock Tower, is getting remastered for modern consoles.

This remaster is a collaboration effort between Capcom, Sunsoft, WayForward, and Limited Run. This remaster also marks the first time the original Clock Tower game will see an official release outside of Japan, which up until this point only had fan translations. The remastered version will utilize the Carbon Engine.

Clock Tower is a survival horror point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Human Entertainment for the Super Famicom in 1995. It is the first installment of the long-running Clock Tower series.

The story follows Jennifer Simpson as she learns the secrets of the Barrows Mansion and attempts to escape the game's antagonist, Scissorman.

Clock Tower originally released in 1995 and is not to be confused with the PlayStation 1 game Clock Tower released in 1996. The franchise only spawned four games, with the most recent release, Clock Tower 3, launching on the PlayStation 2.

games.name: RetroRealms: Halloween
games.summary: Step into the RetroRealms, a 16-bit Pixel Art world, and take control of classic horror icon Michael Myers! Fight your way across multiple levels of platformer action filled with sights and sounds inspired by the original Halloween film. Slice your way through Haddonfield, face-off in epic Boss battles against familiar faces from the movie, and overcome blood-soaked challenges in this intense retro throwback to classic arcade action!

games.name: RetroRealms: Ash vs. Evil Dead
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Ash Williams from the Starz television series Ash vs Evil Dead in a horrifying new Pixel Art platformer! Wielding both his trusty chainsaw and 12-guage shotgun, play as Ash and battle Deadite hordes across multiple levels of 16-bit gameplay filled with enemies from the Ash vs Evil Dead series. Journey into the Dark Realm to overcome additional challenges and save humanity from the Necronomicon in this groovy throwback to classic arcade action.

games.name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
games.summary: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

games.name: Dreamed Away
games.summary: Dreamed Away is an emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements. Play as Théo, a boy lost in a dark, mysterious world. Explore a unique reality, duel against darkness in a unique, fast paced combat system and mind your choices.

games.name: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
games.summary:
Enter the haunting world of Nightmare House. This is the definitive edition of the highly acclaimed horror classic "Nightmare House 2".
Initially released in 2010 as a Source mod for Half-Life 2, the Nightmare House series captivated players with its intense atmosphere and gripping gameplay.

Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.

games.name: Nightmare House: Reimagined
games.summary: No sleeping beyond this point. Escape a waking nightmare in this classic survival horror experience. She's waiting for you.

games.name: Blood Typers
games.summary: TYPE TO KILL in this survival horror adventure. Alone or with friends, explore a sprawling cursed film studio as its horror movies bleed into reality. Choose from a roster of characters then plan your escape from this bloody homage to old school horror. But remember... death is just a typo away.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Haunted Lands
games.summary: An homage to classic DOS games such as Dangerous Dave and Doom. Blast your way through the hordes of ghouls and demons, leaving nothing behind but their rotting corpses.

games.name: Escape from Mutation Station
games.summary: A short, unconventional escape room experience. You are the candidate. You must find a way out of this room. Things are not as they seem.

games.name: Security: The Horrible Nights
games.summary: Every time you die, a new story begins. You are the nighttime security guard at a hospital. Your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale will unfold. If you can survive enough nights, you will learn the truth behind all the horror.

games.name: My Last Friday
games.summary: My Last Friday is a first-person horror-adventure game with a disturbing atmosphere, clever puzzles, body horror, and tense combat. Explore a twisted world, confront terrifying enemies, and endure the nightmarish challenges ahead.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: The Victor Initiative
games.summary: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.summary: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

games.name: Paragnosia
games.summary: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?

games.name: 20 Minutes Till Dawn
games.summary: Shoot down an ever growing horde of Lovecraftian monsters to survive the night. Choose from a variety of upgrades to create unique and game-breaking builds. Unlock a diverse cast of characters and weapons with unique powers.

games.name: Massacre at the Mirage
games.summary: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.

games.name: We Harvest Shadows
games.summary: A first-person farming horror allegory. Become a recluse, build up your farm, and survive the lonely nights.

games.name: Monster DNA
games.summary:
At the international space center of research, something we never ask is why. Our clients are from all corners of the new world's universe and we're sworn to secrecy. We deliver our exclusive hybrids monsters as demanded, and of course, we make sure our hybrids have the best possible work contracts. Our source DNA is sourced from the most notorious galactic inmates seeking participation in our programs, often aiming to secure prison perks or time reductions as they negotiated with their administration.

Your job? Create the monsters we seek, and do a quality control on them, whether it's painful or not.

Each playthrough is unique. You can experience it multiple times.

games.name: Love Eternal
games.summary: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more.

games.name: Home Safety Hotline
games.summary: Home Safety Hotline is an analog horror inspired telephone operator simulator where you answer incoming callers' questions about what's inside their home. Read through a vast catalog of common pests and household hazards, and do your best to become an expert in home safety. You will be held responsible for what happens.

games.name: Empty Shell
games.summary: Empty Shell will throw you in a dark industrial environment, a secret facility on a japanese island. Each volunteer has signed a contract for a "recovery operation" without being privy to too many details. A tense roguelite survival horror with a top down perspective.

games.name: Satanic
games.summary: Satanic is a first-person survival horror game about escaping a satanic cult. Hunted by a relentless demon that responds to your actions, you must avoid detection, scavenge for resources, and navigate your way through an ex-soviet missile silo deep below the surface.

games.name: Scarred
games.summary: Scarred is a first-person atmospheric horror puzzle game where you must uncover the truth about one of your schoolmates before it’s too late. Traverse a world of nightmares inspired by nostalgic Singaporean architecture as you fight to survive.

games.name: Out of Hands
games.summary: Out of Hands is a card-based thriller that blends card battles, video collage and psychological horror. With nightmarish roguelike elements and live-action visuals made out of the real hands of the developer, the game provides an intriguing and spine-chilling experience that leads you to combat the mental struggles and retrieve the lost memory.

games.name: The Mortuary Assistant
games.summary: Having completed your degree in mortuary sciences, you have taken on an apprenticeship at River Fields Mortuary. Over the past several months you have logged many hours aiding the Mortician in daily tasks along with learning the ins and outs of the embalming process as well as how to properly handle and care for the deceased.

games.name: White Knuckle
games.summary: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Clickolding
games.summary: The man in the corner of your hotel room wants you to click something. He wants to watch you click it.

games.name: Life Eater
games.summary: If you don't sacrifice your neighbors, the world ends. Life Eater is an horror fantasy kidnapping simulator where you must become intimately familiar with your targets' lives one intrusive action at a time... and hope that the dark god you serve is even real.

games.name: Vampires: Bloodlord Rising
games.summary: You are a vampire. Build a castle, manage your clan and expand your hold over Sangavia. Develop your character, experience a dramatic story in an open world and rule the land either alone or with your friends in co-op mode.

games.name: System Purge: Hollow Point
games.summary: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a massive expansion which adds a surreal new campaign, challenging new gamemodes, and more.

games.name: Devilated
games.summary: Devilated is a timeslowing, monster blasting, boomer shooter with RPG pretensions, buckets of blood and a dose of ultraviolence.

games.name: The Haunting of Joni Evers
games.summary: The Haunting of Joni Evers is a psychologically thrilling first-person strollplayer set in the small town of Harvest, Oklahoma. Confront, examine, and reexamine Joni’s memories in this emotional story of estranged family underscored by a malevolent, interdimensional haunting.

games.name: Gori: Cuddly Carnage
games.summary:
Are you ready for a third-person, hoverboarding hack & Slash with lots of blood, toys, glitter and adorable cuteness? Then Gori Cuddly Carnage is perfect for you!

Master explosive weaponry and devastating combos in an epic battle to prevent the Adorable Army from conquering the galaxy, and rescue Professor Y, their missing creator and only human who showed Gori and his friends love. Push your combat and platforming skills to the limits as you fight your way through twisted landscapes filled with environmental hazards, razor-sharp adult humour and a bone-crunching, pulse-pounding soundtrack.

These reluctant heroes must track down and obliterate the generals of the Adorable Army, and with the help of a wild cast of unlikely allies - discover the truth about Cool-Toyz Inc. and unravel the secrets of this thrilling, action-packed hack ‘n’ slash adventure. Get ready to unleash the cuddly carnage!

games.name: Projekt Z: Beyond Order
games.summary: Projekt Z: Beyond Order is an atmospheric First-Person Zombie Co-Op-Shooter set in WW2. In this game, you get to play different characters, who have very different abilities, to find out more about the secrets of the german island you all crashed on.

games.name: Deathbound: Accepted by Death
games.summary: Enter the mysterious liminal space between Life and Death a floating rock in the void. In this epic DLC you must release the great essences of the 5 bosses representing five stages of grief – Denial, Anger, Bargaining, Depression and Acceptance – before unlocking Path to Death for the final showdown with Grief – The Purifier – the mightiest of them all.

games.name: Beneath
games.summary: Plunge into a treacherous and enigmatic underwater world and brace yourself to confront the heart-stopping horrors that await as you fight against all odds.

games.name: Blind Exposure
games.summary: Navigate through claustrophobic, completely dark world illuminated only by scans you manage to create; listen carefully to sounds coming from the darkness, and don’t let dread and paranoia get to you.

games.name: Cold and Afraid
games.summary:
In the tranquil confines of a college town, an idyllic peace is shattered by the brutal murder of a student. Shocked and alarmed, the local authorities soon uncover a chilling truth:

​this ghastly act is merely the tip of the iceberg.

As a grim pattern emerges with each successive discovery of mutilated bodies, it becomes evident that a cunning serial killer is haunting the town, leaving a trail of terror in their wake.

games.name: Coven
games.summary: Coven is a retro fps/slasher set in the 1600's in which you play as a young woman who is wrongly accused of witchcraft and burned at the stake. She's resurrected by an unknown force and seeks revenge.

games.name: 10 Dead Doves
games.summary: 10 Dead Doves is a single-player, fixed-perspective narrative horror set in the heart of Appalachia. Avoid strange noises, collect lifelines, and creep through a forest that seems to hate you. Will you discover why the birds drop dead -- or leave behind nothing but footprints?

games.name: Dark and Deep
games.summary: A conspiracy podcast drags you into a world of mystery and terror. Reveal secrets and horrors with mystical frames given to you by a strange observer. Dark and Deep is a first-person cosmic horror game with a focus on puzzles and exploration.

games.name: Bober Bros: The Hole
games.summary: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a paranoid recluse whose life takes a dark turn when a mysterious hole appears in his apartment. Through this ominous hole, anyone—or anything—could be watching him...

games.name: Zero-Sum Heart
games.summary: "I" make a deal with the witch to give up my heart, in exchange for love— from everyone. Is it worth it if losing my heart means gaining *his*?———————————————————————In this short visual novel, make choices and answer the question: is love a zero-sum game?

games.name: The Hungry Fly
games.summary: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.

games.name: Dead Letter Dept.
games.summary: Dead Letter Dept. is a short horror game mystery experience, where you use your computer keyboard to type in various prompts, and attempt to decipher damaged images as oddities begin to appear.

games.name: Mircea
games.summary: Mircea is a short spooky adventure game. Explore a subway infested by mysterious, bug-like beings. Investigate and understand the monsters to capture them... before they capture you.

games.name: Sniper Killer
games.summary: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’. Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.

games.name: Go Home Annie: An SCP Game
games.summary: A twisted first person horror adventure. As an employee of the SCP Replication Division you are tasked with testing artificially developed paranormal events. Solve puzzles, converse with anomalous entities and explore multiple paths to untangle the secrets behind the Replication Division.

games.name: Vile: Exhumed
games.summary: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

games.name: DarkwebStreamer
games.summary: You? An occult streamer on an alternate 90s internet. Your goal? Become #1. The problem? The supernatural is REAL. Manage your stream, do weird rituals, make weird friends and experience a different story every time in this procedurally-generated psycho-horror RPG streaming sim.

games.name: Please Insert Disc
games.summary: Please Insert Disc is a puzzle horror game about navigating the underbelly of a 2000's era gaming console in an attempt to restore its functionality. From the creators of Home Safety Hotline.

events.name: Ghouls 4 Games 2024
events.description: It's that time of the year when trick or treating is near! Let's have a howl of a time celebrating developers and their ghoulish games! With this wicked lineup, Ghouls 4 Games is giving the Monster Mash a run for its money! Stay tuned and keep a watchful eye on your calendar.

games.name: Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game
games.summary:
Cricket: Jae's Really Peculiar Game is a cute, funny, and heartwarming hand animated JRPG from Studio Kumiho.

After a devastating loss, Jae would do anything to fix the past. Blast off with your newfound friends on a journey to the gates of Yimmelia, a fabled land on the moon that’s rumored to grant any wish.

You take turns fighting, landing timed inputs, and using the benefits from those attacks to do awesome team attacks. Your behavior in the world affects the difficulty of combat, and the rewards. The story focuses on laughs while also having real moments about loss, loneliness, and friendship.

games.name: 1000 Deaths
games.summary: 1000 Deaths is a 3D adventure platformer about interpersonal conflicts and the effects of the media. Play fast-paced episodes and discover wildly different endings with each play through. Switch perspectives from a pool of eclectic characters, making decisions that you'll take with you to the grave.

games.name: Lord Ambermaze
games.summary: This world and all life in it have stopped. Only your steps can force the flow of time to move. In this adventure, time is your best ally and your enemy. You need to restore the flow of time - and for that purpose, you'll have to delve into the depths of the underworld and challenge the evil Lord.

games.name: Cat Detective Albert Wilde
games.summary: Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a comedy game, a genre-bending noirish sci-fi mystery set in a fictional version of New York in the 1930's featuring atmospheric black & white vintage visuals, and loveable anthropomorphic characters. Players must muddle their way through a murder mystery that's messier than a fresh hairball, with a captivating voice-over and at least one joke about cat nipples (they have six!).

games.name: Birth
games.summary: Birth is a pleasantly creepy point-and-click puzzle game about living alone in a large city and constructing a creature to keep you company out of spare bones and organs you find lying around. Explore libraries, post offices, museums, cafes, and apartments that don't belong to you, solving observational puzzles hidden in personal belongings and scenery.

games.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
games.summary: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cute building strategy game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

games.name: Almost My Floor: Duality
games.summary: Almost My Floor: Duality - a noir detective horror-adventure game about the internal struggle with depression and the impending darkness in a provincial town. The gameplay is based on decision-making mechanics and a branching storyline.

games.name: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
games.summary: A point n' click sequel to Perfect Tides about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood.

games.name: The Songbird Guild
games.summary: The Songbird Guild is a Yuri RPG/Visual Novel hybrid about magical girls falling in love. Investigate the secrets of a corrupt fantasy world and fight creepy (yet somehow adorable?) monsters in turn-based battles, all to pay the bills in this world where being a magical girl is a regular 9-5 job.

games.name: Hyde's Haunt & Seek
games.summary: Spook or be spooked in this team-based party game. Set in a haunted manor, the mortal Seekers search for a Prized Possession, playing against a team of pranking poltergeists dead set on keeping it to themselves.

games.name: The Spirit Lift
games.summary: The Spirit Lift is a deck-building rogue-like horror adventure in a haunted hotel. Ascend 13 floors in a ghostly elevator. Use equipment cards to battle monsters. Make it to the villain at the top… or die trying!

games.name: Retro Gadgets
games.summary: Retro Gadgets is a gadget creation station where you invent, build, solder, code and customise your own electrifying gadgets then share them with the world.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Broken Soul
games.summary: Broken soul is a personal hell of a lost person, which makes Alex meet his own demons. Should he lose to his fears or he must struggle and fight off the things his own mind hides?

games.name: Magic Inn
games.summary: Reclaim glory in Magic Inn, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.

games.name: This Magical Girl is a B*tch
games.summary:
Join Tabitha Bones in act 1 of a lighthearted romp through the world's most dysfunctional school!

It's Halloween Spirit Week, and even grumpy Tabbie is ready for some fun. But when her nemesis, Eden (the worst kind of 8th grade boy), steals her thunder, everything goes horribly wrong.

Luckily for her, a magical pixie gives her the power to grab fate and whack the sh*t out of anyone in her way!

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: God For A Day
games.summary: In this 2D, narrative-based simulation game, you play as the Son of God. Your mission: Decide, bless or condemn city residents. Uncover the person's story through their items and secrets before making decisions. Your choices alter the city's destiny, and impact your revelation on Judgment Day.

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

games.name: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
games.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

games.name: The Haunting of Joni Evers
games.summary: The Haunting of Joni Evers is a psychologically thrilling first-person strollplayer set in the small town of Harvest, Oklahoma. Confront, examine, and reexamine Joni’s memories in this emotional story of estranged family underscored by a malevolent, interdimensional haunting.

games.name: Reviver
games.summary: A narrative puzzle game with themes of love, fate and time. Follow the life stories of the two main characters and influence their destinies through interactions and choices. The game combines hand-drawn style and an immersive interactive experience to explore a profound journey of love and choice.

games.name: Crackernuts
games.summary: Crackernuts is a narrative game about a goat-headed girl and her sister, a no-bodied head. They are on quest to find themselves and rescue their village from a curse of darkness.

games.name: So, This Vampire Walks Into a Bar
games.summary: Join our broke protagonist Jackie, who, after a workplace accident, will never look the same again. Jackie desperately tries to make ends meet by working in an unusual bar, despite having no experience at all!

games.name: Pieced Together
games.summary: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

games.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
games.summary: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game focused on restoring dirty items to their pristine state. Use a variety of tools to return objects to their original appearance. As you clean each item belonging to the protagonist, reflect on the significance and stories behind them.

games.name: Munch
games.summary: Kill. Eat. Evolve. Unleash your inner monster and incite Chaos in this reverse-horror fantasy action roguelite. Devour the Followers of Order to absorb their elements and mutate a new twisted body forged from Flesh, Nekro, and Ore. Crush their god Ördo to bring back the Gods of Heavy Metal!

games.name: All Systems Dance
games.summary: Automation is not the answer; DANCE is the key to disruption! Help liberate citizens of a consumption-obsessed, corporate dystopia in All Systems Dance: an expressive dance battle adventure. Connect moves, express yourself, feel the music. Join The Movement. The revolution will not be choreographed.

games.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
games.summary:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Tape 101
games.summary: A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real

games.name: Forest Heroes
games.summary: Forest Heroes combines defense gameplay with roguelike deck-building. Enjoy intense battles and diverse strategies with simple controls!

games.name: Zero-Sum Heart
games.summary: "I" make a deal with the witch to give up my heart, in exchange for love— from everyone. Is it worth it if losing my heart means gaining *his*?———————————————————————In this short visual novel, make choices and answer the question: is love a zero-sum game?

games.name: The Legend of Khiimori
games.summary: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

games.name: Water Delivery
games.summary: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?

games.name: Korter 1996
games.summary: You find a secret passage at your new flat leading to other people’s homes. Unpack your stuff, collect items and solve the mysteries of each of the apartments to unlock the story of the apartment block. You might not feel so lonely, after all.

games.name: Angst: A Tale of Survival
games.summary: ANGST is a solo & co-op wilderness survival game set in a freezing, gritty, stylized Low-Poly limbo-like world. Craft tools and weapons, hunt, fish, and fight to stay alive. Upgrade skills to venture deeper into the wild, but be warned: what lurks there can thwart your plans. Survive the ANGST!

games.name: Placid Plastic Deck: A Quiet Quest
games.summary: A wholesome game where you can’t die. A relaxing and witty adventure featuring colorful pixel-art locations, peculiar characters, quirky dialogues, elements of deck-building card battles, and a lot of ducks. A tale of friendship and revenge!

events.name: NOVELASIA: Southeast Asia Visual Novel Showcase 2024
events.description: Open the curtains and get ready for the thrilling journey of NOVELASIA showcase where players and fans will get a look at upcoming release or recently released narrative-focused video games from Southeast Asia creators.

games.name: Momotarou
games.summary: Trapped in a winterscape, Momotarou converses with a demon and learns more about himself.

games.name: Office Crush Dating Simulator
games.summary: A dating simulator where you romance your handsome co-workers and nothing goes wrong.

games.name: Rekindle
games.summary:
Single, alone, and just plain miserable is not how most people would feel on their birthday, but it’s the sad reality for you. Refusing to have the day be a complete waste, you decide it's worth at least getting a cake for yourself.

Why is it that once you have the cake in hand, fate makes you walk past three incredibly important figures from your past?

What could this even mean for you?

games.name: Project Missionary: The Reckoning of Hizzokahpolis
games.summary: A kinetic visual novel about a CEO's search for justice and an unexpected happening.

games.name: Coffee Talk
games.summary: Coffee Talk is a coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator about listening to fantasy-inspired modern peoples’ problems, and helping them by serving up a warm drink or two.

games.name: Long Since The Eschaton
games.summary:
It’s been five years since the apocalypse started, the zombies are slowly decomposing, even new zombies don’t last due to the lack of food source. The last two humans on earth find themselves stumbling upon each other. While one struggles to keep herself alive, the other just wants to end it all.

Long Since the Eschaton follows Kirana, a medic who switched between one survivor group to another until she’s all that’s left. She met Gabe, a self-sustaining survivor who stayed at the same town since the beginning of the plague. Slowly but surely, the two bond and perhaps help each other cope.

games.name: Talents
games.summary: Write your way to success with your talented yet rowdy co-founders in this game development-themed romance visual novel! Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Perfect Gold: The Alchemy of Happiness
games.summary: Perfect Gold: The Alchemy of Happiness is a short, coming-of-age yuri visual novel about two former friends who escape detention in order to celebrate the Sunflower Festival. Set in the magical city of Castlecoast, readers get to know Audrey Clary, an alchemy student and heiress who secretly dreams of a different life, and Marion LaRue, a rebellious elemental magic student in search of someone she once loved.

games.name: The Letter
games.summary: When seven people fall prey to a vicious curse, they will discover that horror rests not from the shadows lurking about, but within themselves. To what ends will one go in order to survive?

games.name: Threads of You: Beyond the Bay
games.summary: 1 broken down car, 2 weeks in a hidden seaside town, and 7 men waiting to sweep you off your feet. Will you follow the threads of destiny in Brine Bay?

games.name: Sacabambaspis' Friendly Adventure
games.summary: A short and friendly adventure as a Sacabambaspis!

games.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
games.summary: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

games.name: An Angel's Final Desire
games.summary:
Play as Emil, who had a fight with his best friend Quinn and they are now missing and he has to find them before it's too late

Can you save Quinn, in the end?

Can you save the child?

games.name: Tale of Ren: Searching for Heart Droplets
games.summary: Me...Mizu Ren Nanami… As a REN people, it's time to go on a mission to conquer the hearts of people in other realms. Then, the Rostania is the town where I was chosen to come here. to the pursuit of secrets that were never known before.

games.name: Mythical Love
games.summary:
Welcome to Mythic High, the highschool of mythical creatures where we can have great moments together with species and sex equality.
You can choose to be one of them and build your relationship to learn more about different kinds of love. So young and colourful. BUT sometimes, when something goes overboard, everything could collapse apart, including love. So choose wisely.

games.name: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator
games.summary: Project Anomaly: Urban Supernatural Investigator is a 2.5D first-person adventure mystery game where you play as an investigator who solves cases by taking pictures of cryptids, urban legends, & mythological creatures as well as befriending them in an open-world environment

games.name: Coffee Talk: Episode 2 - Hibiscus & Butterfly
games.summary: Dust off your coffee machine and prepare your warmest smile to meet your customers again in the second episode of the much loved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator; Coffee Talk Episode 2: Hibiscus & Butterfly.

games.name: Phantom Stars
games.summary: A Visual Novel of an investigating-dating idols: “When a new police officer has to go undercover as an 'idol group leader' to solve a case.”

games.name: Blackjack and Pomodoro Mystery
games.summary:
"Human, go to work."

In the library, you are stuck with Blackjack, an unknown living creature that looks like a cat. Unexpectedly, lots of tomatoes appear in the library. It's also up to you and BJ to solve the mystery and identify the person who left the tomatoes lying around.

This is Pomodoro timer which has 25 minutes working-5 minutes resting and 60 minutes working-10 minute resting plans for player to select and work along with the moving black cat playing around the room.

games.name: Helen
games.summary: You are Helen, a violinist content creator and office worker lost in monotonous life routines until you find a mysterious origami letter that embarks on a soul-searching journey of self-discovery. Respond to the letters, fold into origami, explore the town and find gratitude in small things in life.

games.name: Shepherd’s Plan
games.summary: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Call Me Master
games.summary:
Slip into the future and turn into a slave to love?

"Call Me Master" is an otome dating game that will transport you to the future, where you will meet an enigmatic, attractive man!

games.name: Trilogi Keluarga Bahagia Side Story: Sulastri Si Tukang Jamu
games.summary:
Sulastri hasn't paid the tuition fee yet.
However, he did not have enough money to pay, considering that his mother could not sell herbs because of illness.
Because of Mrs. Jamilah's kindness, Sulastri was given an additional 6 months deadline.
Will Sulastri be able to pay off her tuition fees after selling herbs to replace her mother for 6 months?

games.name: A Space for the Unbound
games.summary: A coming-of-age adventure where you follow two high school sweethearts on a journey of self-discovery at the end of their high school years while facing the end of the world. Explore 90s Indonesian town, uncover its secrets, use supernatural powers to dive into people's hearts, and pet cats.

games.name: Koibito no Nazo: Lover's Enigma
games.summary: In Lover's Enigma, you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Who Murdered My Empress?
games.summary: “Who Murdered My Empress?” is a visually stunning romance visual novel set in a fantastical realm inspired by 19th century Vietnam. Assume the role of an Empress with a lavish harem of captivating men as you navigate intrigue, love, and mystery.

games.name: Milcham: From the Ashes of Hearts
games.summary: A girl of low social class goes undercover to infiltrate a prestigious high school, tasked with a perilous mission.

games.name: Of Frost and Flowers
games.summary: An otome-fantasy visual novel. Play as Alto, a fearless knight, and enter a world of magic and myths with secrets waiting for you to unveil.

games.name: Meteor Shower
games.summary: Fall in love before the snow falls.

games.name: Larut
games.summary: A visual novel that retells the story of Nyai Roro Kidul.

games.name: Saint Maker
games.summary: While attending a religious recollection, Holly Beltran experiences strange hauntings throughout the convent. At night, broken faced statues and whispered prayers haunt Holly’s dreams — before the recollection is over, Holly may have to face more than her own demons to come out alive.

games.name: Into the Depth of the Sky
games.summary: Into the Depth of the Sky is a heartwarming fantasy/mystery/slice-of-life otome game with a dash of action.

games.name: Midheaven: Winds of Ambition
games.summary:
Midheaven: Winds of Ambition follows the tale of a young Mahyine (an original species of the Midheaven saga, with naga-like features) noble in court who determines to follow their ambitions, along with the presence of one of the four Regals.

Winds of Ambition is a stats-raising visual novel, where every choice can result in the most fatal outcome. The objective of the game is keeping the protagonist alive for 12 seasons, and marry one of the four Regals.

games.name: Pryzm
games.summary: A survival adventure mystery with turn-based combat and escape parameters that change with every new 1 to 2-hour run. A visual novel that can be played like a speedrun.

games.name: The Butterfly Dreams
games.summary: A visual novel exploring reality, imagination, and the gap between them that we believe to be there.

games.name: UnHumanize
games.summary: Can technology help humans achieve their dreams, or is fighting fate a big gamble for humanity?

games.name: Trilogi Keluarga Bahagia Side Story: Yuni dan Puzzle Ajaib
games.summary:
Yuni has been separated from her mother and older sister since she was 7 years old.
One day, she finds a magical puzzle piece that can grant her wish.
But to make this happen, Yuni must take all the pieces from those around her; Rio is a delinquent, Haryanto is smart, and Benjamin is kind.
Can Yuni put all the pieces together and make her dream come true?

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Gakutensoku
games.summary: In the year of new 1940, the earth's population was replaced by androids created by man after the devastating effect of the nuclear war. androids made their own robot utopia, but under the glimmer of the cities, hides a dark secret Seigi Kazuichi was another police officer android doing his duty, capturing evildoers who dares destabilize the peace of the utopia, but one event would change his life forever and entangle him in a series of bizarre murder cases.

games.name: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers!
games.summary: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers! is a Visual Novel created for Blossom VN Jam 2024 and Fuck Capitalism Jam 2024 as it's about a trip full of fun spring activities and complaining about your job.

games.name: The Sun Shines Over Us
games.summary: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

games.name: Edda Café
games.summary: Edda Café is a visual novel made by Mushroomallow. It's a cute and heartwarming, yet unusual Valentine-theme love story for Valentine VN Jam 2021 event.

games.name: Problem Solver Club
games.summary: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

games.name: Wanagiri
games.summary: Wanagiri is a short visual novel where you play as Kamila, who accidentally isekai'ed to an uncompleted book that your friend wrote. How will you end the story, and will you be back there again someday?

games.name: Celestia: Chain of Fate
games.summary: A romance-fantasy visual novel that delivers a captivating player driven narrative. Enrol at Celestia Academy and uncover your heritage. Delve into a fantastical realm and unearth your magical potential as a hybrid. Forge new friendships and build affections based on your love interests.

games.name: Coat of Many Feathers
games.summary:
To settle a decades-long war for territorial sovereignty, Lord Trieu Da of the Qin and King An Duong Vuong of Au Lac agreed to a political marriage between their firstborn children. In anticipation for the wedding, Lord Trieu Da sent his son, Trong Thuy, to remain at Au Lac's Royal Citadel as a show of the Qin's goodwill.

On the other end, Princess My Chau is ecstatic at getting an opportunity to meet someone from beyond the citadel walls. Will you be able to aid her attempts to befriend the kindly yet distant Trong Thuy? Or will you let their relationship fall apart before it could even begin?

games.name: Test Subject
games.summary: Test Subject is a short visual novel created for O2A2 Game Jam 2024 with strict asset limitations, where you become a necromancer's test subject?

games.name: Where the Two Flowers Meet
games.summary: An indie psychological horror visual novel about the meaning of everything that has been lost, along with the memories of our time together.

games.name: Inside Out at The Top of the World
games.summary: A visual novel about awkward conversations and being stuck next to your boss on a gigantic rollercoaster

games.name: Where is Mrs Peregrine?
games.summary: A precious family member is missing! She's old, and the weather is pretty cold... Let's search for her!

games.name: Alisa: Developer's Cut
games.summary: Can you survive the Dollhouse? Alisa is a Horror-themed Action Adventure game, and a genuine throwback to the golden age of 90's 3D games.

games.name: Sunset Land
games.summary: Our story takes place on Venture, a planet that has recently been colonized by several corporations to harvest its valuable resources. You play as a psychic named Marco, who is tasked with stealing 3 stellar crystals (artifacts which contain tremendous amounts of energy) for an intergalactic mob boss.

games.name: Camp Sunshine
games.summary: Camp Sunshine is a 16-bit blood-soaked Horror RPG that pits you as Jez, who is dropped off at Summer Camp. He awakes in the middle of the night to discover blood everywhere, a rampaging killer on the loose dressed in a mascot costume and himself involved in a deadly game of cat and mouse! It's up to you to piece together the puzzle, and relive the past of the Summer Camp Slasher in order to put a stop to this night of terror.

games.name: Kristala
games.summary:
Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring Sekiro-inspired combat, acrobatic parkour, and exploration to uncover a detailed story. Embark on a journey to join ranks with Ailur’s most elite warriors as you battle to master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six and uncover the source of a dark curse.

Play as a catlike warrior from one of six clans, each with its own unique magic specialty. Choose your own style of combat: avoid damage by blocking, dashing/rolling, and deflecting attacks; combo light and heavy attacks; utilize multiple weapon abilities; and cast numerous spells.

Your catlike character will be fully customizable via various Talent Trees, including an innovative Feline Skill tree that allows you to unlock and level a multitude of feline-related skills.

games.name: Godshard Chronicles
games.summary: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the world of the Godshard novels with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles, explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

games.name: Atomic Owl
games.summary: Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelite that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups, and a demonic blade. Journey through eight roguelite zones, save your friends, and take up arms against Omega Wing!

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: Arcade Tycoon
games.summary: Build and Manage your own arcade. Pick the best cabinets, creating your own machines, hire and fire staff, plan and manage your venues and try not to blow everything up!

games.name: Turbo Kid
games.summary: Turbo Kid is a BMX-powered pixel-art Metroidvania gore-fest based on the film of the same name.

events.name: Black Voices in Gaming 10.29.24
events.description: In celebration of Black History Month in the UK, this Black Voices in Gaming will feature some amazing talent from the gaming scene including Daniel Akinola, Abubakar Salim, and C. Bedford.

games.name: Sorry We're Closed
games.summary: Sorry We're Closed is a nostalgic single player survival horror game with rich lore and character interactions that allow multiple endings. Following the end days of Michelle, explore unsettling locations using the environment to hide and survive. Use your demon gun to defend in first person.

games.name: Tales of Kenzera: Zau
games.summary: Tales of Kenzera: Zau is a 2.5D metroidvania developed by Surgent Studios and published under the EA Originals label. The game follows Zau, a young shaman who bargains with Kalunga, the God of Death, to revive his father. Players explore the mythological lands of Kenzera, using Zau's athletic abilities—such as double jumping, wall jumping, and air dashing—to traverse the environment. Equipped with the sun mask for melee attacks and the moon mask for ranged combat, Zau can upgrade both weapons along distinct paths. As players gain new skills, they unlock previously inaccessible areas, progressing through a world filled with ancestral spirits and powerful monsters.

games.name: Nixie
games.summary: A 2D action game following the reclusive Fiona Soul, and her adventures fighting spirits and racing across London.

events.name: Playdate Update: Fall 2024
events.description: Join us Thursday, October 31st to meet some awesome Playdate developers and hear about their games, see what's fresh in Catalog, and hear some exciting news. It's gonna be a good one!

games.name: Angel Pop
games.summary: Play as a young girl in a surreal dreamworld in Angel Pop; a mixed-media multidirectional bullet hell shooter with lovingly-crafted bullet patterns and setpieces designed specifically around the Playdate screen.

games.name: Propeller Rat
games.summary: Pilot a propeller-strapped rat through increasingly challenging, hazard-filled worlds with

games.name: Voidblazers
games.summary: Voidblazers is a story-driven shoot 'em up game for Playdate. Join the crew of Icarus as they travel across the galaxy, battle various fleets, and encounter new friends and enemies on their daring mission.

games.name: Under the Castle
games.summary: Under the Castle is a classic rogue game where you'll explore infinite dungeons vanquishing enemies, gathering Orbs of Light and rescuing enslaved villagers. Use your weapons, potions, magic scrolls and even you own hat to navigate the treacherous depths and find your way to the Evil Lord!

games.name: Root Bear
games.summary: You are the Root Bear serving bears their root beer. They're extremely picky on their pour, but they pay well. Go on, Root Bear. Achieve the Perfect Pour.

games.name: Owlet's Embrace
games.summary:
An owlet afraid of flight sets off to explore a vibrant mysterious world and rediscover itself. On this heartwarming adventure, you'll confront the owlet's deepest fears as only the greatest challenges can lead to the most profound growth.

Owlet's Embrace is an action exploration platformer, blending fast paced grappling hook manouvers with combat and emotional discovery.

games.name: Comet
games.summary: A light-hearted puzzle adventure where you play as the exuberant Stella who confronts her fear of the dark to search for her brother.

games.name: Office Chair Curling
games.summary: in this game you throw office chairs at a target

games.name: Bwirds
games.summary:
A whimsical word game!

Writers are lost for words and need your help spelling new ones. The chef needs spicy words for his cook book. The artist needs colorful language and the naturalist needs wild animal words. Use your grabber contraption to nab bwirds out of the sky to form words and reap the rewards as long as you keep your writers happy.

games.name: RowBot Rally
games.summary: Team up with a mechanical pal and row for the gold in the annual Fish Bowl!

games.name: Devils on the Moon Pinball
games.summary: Themed on the astrologically Occult, Devils on the Moon is a Single board VG-Pinball Heavily inspired by all the great Pinball games of the past and some modern ones as well.

games.name: Echo: The Oracle's Scroll
games.summary: Explore a fading world and best its many challenges. As an adventurous child, you'll embark on a quest to deliver a scroll from Bottomrock up to The Archives. Journey through magma lakes and overgrown caverns as you venture through The Kingdoms Three!

games.name: Zero Zero: Perfect Stop
games.summary: Zero Zero: Perfect Stop is a train driving game for Playdate where you use the crank to control the train's throttle and brakes. Stop in the right place, at the right time. Maintain your timetable as you glide through scenic Yamanashi.

games.name: Touch Egg
games.summary:
Will you survive the full time? Or will you become All Thumbs?

Finally, the revolutionary and culturally important egg experience comes to Playdate. 60 seconds on the clock, turn that crank and touch that egg! Watch your fingers and don’t let Him see you, his vision is based on movement!

games.name: Super Conductor
games.summary: Redirect the train to collect 100 coins across 30+ levels, which range from straightforward tracks to spaghetti-like tangles

games.name: Summit
games.summary:
Summit is an exhilarating mountain climbing game that requires precision platforming. Players embark on an epic journey to conquer the mountain by overcoming puzzle platforming obstacles and mastering climbing techniques.

With over 70 puzzle rooms to navigate, Summit offers precision platforming at its best. Equipped with 2 pickaxes, scale the mountain to reach the top. Avoid physics based environmental hazards as you uncover the story behind our protagonist’s unwavering tenacity to reach the top.

Will you reach the summit?

games.name: Bender 2: Bend Harder
games.summary:
Step into the circuits of a robot with an unusual job: bending bars to precise angles.

Your hydraulic hands are itching to twist metal as you stand at the first workstation. A single button controls the bending, and thicker bars bend slower than thinner bars. Let go of the controls when the bar reaches the target angle. Success/retry/fail?

events.name: The Horror Game Awards Showcase - Halloween 2024
events.description: The latest of our regular series of horror games showcases, highlighting recently released and upcoming horror titles.

games.name: Faith: The Unholy Trinity
games.summary: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, insane cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Scare" of the 1980s.

games.name: Silkbulb Test
games.summary: Take the test!

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Vile: Exhumed
games.summary: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

games.name: Bye Sweet Carole
games.summary: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: DarkwebStreamer
games.summary: You? An occult streamer on an alternate 90s internet. Your goal? Become #1. The problem? The supernatural is REAL. Manage your stream, do weird rituals, make weird friends and experience a different story every time in this procedurally-generated psycho-horror RPG streaming sim.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.summary: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

games.name: Terminal Error
games.summary: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

games.name: Finding Frankie
games.summary: Finding Frankie invites you to participate in Frankie's terrifyingly twisted parkour game show. Stealthily navigate around horrifying characters, tackle obstacle courses, and swing and wall-jump through challenging parkour courses! This is a game show you wouldn't want to miss!

games.name: Narrow Woods Hotel
games.summary: A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre! In this "found-footage" horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel. Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out.

games.name: Backward Poiesis
games.summary: A short walking simulator with a horror feel that recreates actual found footage, which can be related to Liminal Space and Backrooms.

games.name: Massacre at the Mirage
games.summary: For less than the price of a movie ticket, experience your very own horror-fueled slasher flick in Massacre at the Mirage. Step into The Mirage cinema and face a chilling nightmare, where staff and patrons must survive a masked killer's rampage.

games.name: Targeosity Horror
games.summary: Explore an abandoned house with a monster. Play pixel mini games to escape from a maniac trap. Solve puzzles in terrible darkness until the monster hears. Overcome panic attacks using a demonic device.

games.name: No More Room in Hell 2
games.summary: No More Room in Hell 2 is a terrifying 8 player co-op action horror experience. Find your friends in the dark and survive - in a dynamic, endlessly replayable zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Captured
games.summary: Trapped in what appears to be an endless hallway in your home, rooms begin to feel unfamiliar. Spot the differences, capture the anomalies, and stay away from any sinister entities.

games.name: I'm on Observation Duty 7
games.summary: The seventh installment of this beloved franchise presents you with six new levels, unique anomalies and insane intruders. As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies. Report any changes in the monitored rooms by clicking on the anomaly and selecting the type OR by choosing the right location and type of the anomaly from a menu to fix it. Anomalies appear at random so you never knows what is going to happen next. Too many active and unreported anomalies means death. Goal is to survive the entire night (from 00:00 to 06:00 in game time). You will need sharp eyes and good memory. The game contains psychological horror that mainly comes from making you paranoid about what has changed.

games.name: Trailcam
