games.summary: In Trailcam, you are a wildlife investigator called to the Appalachian Mountains to solve mysterious missing person cases. Using trail cameras from your watchtower, you'll uncover a sinister truth, navigating a non-linear plot full of twists. Can you solve the mystery?

games.name: Don't Be Afraid 2
games.summary: Descend deep into the nightmare that seamlessly blends with reality in this uncanny horror escape room game. Can you find your way out of the horrid mansion or will you succumb to your fears? Can you face and overcome your past, or will it break you?

games.name: Crow Country
games.summary: The year is 1990. Edward Crow has disappeared. The owner of 'Crow Country', he has not been seen since he unexpectedly shut down his park two years ago. The silence is broken when a mysterious young woman named Mara Forest ventures into the heart of the abandoned theme park in order to find him.

games.name: The Patient
games.summary: Dr. Ellen Reed returns to work as a therapist only to discover an inpatient has been mistakenly dosed with a deadly mutative drug. With hospital records erased due to a power outage, she must work overnight to identify and discreetly euthanize the affected patient before it's too late.

games.name: Place of Decay
games.summary: Explore a corrupted game project in this horror-puzzle adventure. Uncover the mystery behind its collapse and the developer's abandonment. Use the Code Cannon to break through the digital barriers and navigate the chaotic realm to uncover the truth behind its downfall.

games.name: Reaper
games.summary:
Reaper is a medieval-themed first-person shooter, drawing inspiration from such classic titles as Doom, Quake and Hitman.
Play as Death Incarnate, and follow the guidance of a mysterious spirit, tasking you with collecting the souls of a series of targets, and condemning them to the Hell below.

games.name: Backrooms: Partygoers
games.summary: Backrooms: Partygoers is a backrooms horror game based on Level 0 where you play as a researcher tasked to find anomalies inside the backrooms. You are equip with devices that can beep whenever an anomaly is near, where the partygoers roam and can hear you.

games.name: Late Homework
games.summary: Retrieve your forgotten class assignments from school while avoiding the creature known to haunt it at night.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: Shadows of the Damned: Hella Remastered
games.summary: Shadows of the Damned, an action-adventure road trip through hell, has been remastered at last! Get ready for a story about rock, love, and just a little bit of demon slaying.

games.name: Clock Tower: Rewind
games.summary:
The Super Famicom classic, Clock Tower, is getting remastered for modern consoles.

This remaster is a collaboration effort between Capcom, Sunsoft, WayForward, and Limited Run. This remaster also marks the first time the original Clock Tower game will see an official release outside of Japan, which up until this point only had fan translations. The remastered version will utilize the Carbon Engine.

Clock Tower is a survival horror point-and-click adventure game developed and published by Human Entertainment for the Super Famicom in 1995. It is the first installment of the long-running Clock Tower series.

The story follows Jennifer Simpson as she learns the secrets of the Barrows Mansion and attempts to escape the game's antagonist, Scissorman.

Clock Tower originally released in 1995 and is not to be confused with the PlayStation 1 game Clock Tower released in 1996. The franchise only spawned four games, with the most recent release, Clock Tower 3, launching on the PlayStation 2.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.summary: Buckshot Roulette is an indie tabletop horror game that reimagines Russian roulette using a pump-action shotgun instead of a revolver. The player faces off against a computer-controlled opponent called "The Dealer" across three rounds, with consumable items introduced in later rounds that add strategic depth. The game features a single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

games.name: Lurks Within Walls
games.summary:
Lurks Within Walls is a tense survival horror game combining modern dungeon RPGs' exploration elements with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore a series of cursed environments filled with terrifying creatures illustrated by the renowned artist Trevor Henderson.

A building under quarantine. Residents isolated. Those who failed to isolate themselves now stagger through the corridors, contaminated. But it's not just the infected residents—the darkness conceals other anomalies. It feels as if the building itself is alive.

games.name: Beneath
games.summary: Plunge into a treacherous and enigmatic underwater world and brace yourself to confront the heart-stopping horrors that await as you fight against all odds.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: Please Insert Disc
games.summary: Please Insert Disc is a puzzle horror game about navigating the underbelly of a 2000's era gaming console in an attempt to restore its functionality. From the creators of Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Corporeal
games.summary: A paranormal mystery where you piece together a haunted family photo album. As the sole survivor of unexplained events in the 1990s, search for answers in an archive of photos rescued from the ruins of your childhood home, manipulate the past, encounter specters & map your cursed family history.

games.name: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead
games.summary: A Quiet Place: The Road Ahead is a single-player horror adventure game inspired by the critically acclaimed blockbuster movie franchise that highlights a unique survivor story after an invasion of deadly creatures. In this exclusive spin-off, experience the journey of a young woman who must endure a treacherous apocalypse in the midst of interpersonal family conflicts, all while coming to terms with her own inner fears.

games.name: Confronted
games.summary: Outsmart what hunts you. Build your hideouts. Plan each escape. As Dorinela, a survivor returning to face her abuser’s curse, use your wits to stay alive within this cursed gothic castle.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary: Hunt creatures of the night in this Action RPG set in the suburbs of Arizona in the iconic 1980's. Choose a class, and take to the streets to save your small town from Baphomet and his demon generals.

games.name: Darkenstein 3D
games.summary: A retro shooter inspired by the older Wolfenstein and Doom games. A tribute of sorts, if you like, where I aspire emulate the games I love the most and that requires a certain amount of skill to complete, while adding a few personal and more current-day touches.

games.name: Omut
games.summary: A punishing fever dream combining abject terror, dark comedy, and many, many deaths.

games.name: Hollow Doll
games.summary: Hollow Doll is a first-person survival horror game set in a post-humanity earth inhabited by remnant "doll" life. Follow the elusive netdiver, Cel, as she chases after the whispers of a dead network known as the Red_Sea. Explore dystopian megastructure locales and exorcise the corrupted ghosts of drowned netdivers bleeding from the Red_Sea.

games.name: Sniper Killer
games.summary: Eliminate your victims as a serial killer dubbed ‘The Sniper Killer’. Terrorize the city with your keen eye and thirst for blood while staying one step ahead of a detective hell bent on bringing you to justice.

games.name: Terrordrome: Reign of the Legends
games.summary:
Terrordrome - Reign Of The Legends, the first horror fighting game with classic monsters, urban legends and mythological creatures.
Horror icons and urban legends clash in a battle to the death in this original fighting game from the TerrorTeam. Reign Of The Legends explores legends, folklore, myths and the paranormal both in its characters and stages, while incorporating conspiracy theories as the base material for its storyline. Legends and icons are re-imagined in a story set in the 20th century, continuing the legacy of many of the world's favorite monsters and cryptids.

games.name: Killing Time: Resurrected
games.summary: Journey into a mansion on the Island of Matinicus where you'll arrive to find the mansion full of hellacious demonic creatures. Solve deadly puzzles, uncover the secrets behind a famous mystery and discover an ancient artifact from the Pharaoh Ramses, if you can live long enough to find it.

games.name: Among Ashes
games.summary: Among Ashes is a terrifying first-person survival horror game. Your friend has sent you a link to a game that someone posted online, but as you play you quickly realize that something is terribly wrong. Whatever you do… KEEP PLAYING

games.name: Regeneration
games.summary: Regeneration is a third-person survival horror game where you explore an abandoned post-Soviet complex as a scientist. Isolated from the outside world, you face anomalous creatures born from past experiments. Survive, uncover dark secrets, and stop the nightmare before it consumes everything.

games.name: Below, Rusted Gods
games.summary: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

games.name: Same Room Same Day
games.summary: Step into the mind of Rosaline in this psychological horror FPS. Face terrifying manifestations of her fears, battle through intense combat, and help her find inner peace. Solve puzzles along the way to unlock deeper layers of her psyche and bring her closer to healing

games.name: My Last Friday
games.summary: My Last Friday is a first-person horror-adventure game with a disturbing atmosphere, clever puzzles, body horror, and tense combat. Explore a twisted world, confront terrifying enemies, and endure the nightmarish challenges ahead.

games.name: Tower of Tears
games.summary: A 3D Survival-Horror Metroidvania in a vast, interconnected tower ruled by cryptic systems, strange residents and esoteric mysteries...

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: RetroRealms: Ash vs. Evil Dead
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Ash Williams from the Starz television series Ash vs Evil Dead in a horrifying new Pixel Art platformer! Wielding both his trusty chainsaw and 12-guage shotgun, play as Ash and battle Deadite hordes across multiple levels of 16-bit gameplay filled with enemies from the Ash vs Evil Dead series. Journey into the Dark Realm to overcome additional challenges and save humanity from the Necronomicon in this groovy throwback to classic arcade action.

games.name: Parisyte
games.summary: Run, warp, and fight (but mostly run) your way through the Paris catacombs with up to 4 players to loot the most valuable treasures left behind. But beware - there's a reason the catacombs have been closed to the public for many years.

games.name: Nabi
games.summary: Can you escape this abyss, a place of despair and evil? Pride, lust, greed, jealousy, indolence, gluttony, anger Defy their temptations!

games.name: Dead Island 2: Neighborhood Watch
games.summary: Patch 6 will introduce all Dead Island 2 players to the Neighborhood Watch game mode, a new cooperative horde mode, in which players will have to work together against swarms of zombies, including a new way to strategize against the undead.

games.name: Dead Island 2: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
The Ultimate Edition contains the Dead Island 2 base game, plunging you into the heart of Hell-A, with intense zombie-slaying action, along with both epic story expansions: Haus and SoLA.

Unleash a new level of carnage with special weapons and stylish gear. Included in the Ultimate Edition you’ll find: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II pack, Memories of Banoi Pack, Golden Weapons Pack, Pulp Weapons Pack, Red’s Demise Pack, and each Slayer’s Premium Skin Pack.

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer 2
games.summary: In Amanda the Adventurer 2, the story continues as Riley encounters a mysterious masked figure after destroying the TV in the attic. Travel to the Kensdale Public Library and dig deeper into the mystery of Amanda the Adventurer.

games.name: The Axis Unseen
games.summary: The Axis Unseen is a heavy metal horror game created by one of the developers of Skyrim, Starfield and Fallout. Hunt nightmarish monsters from ancient folklore in a mysterious open world, collecting their enhanced sense powers and discovering elemental arrows.

games.name: Alan Wake II: The Lake House
games.summary: Alan Wake II: The Lake House is a DLC expansion for Alan Wake II. It introduces new story content set in an isolated lake house near Bright Falls, where players uncover additional clues about the supernatural forces affecting Alan Wake. The expansion retains the base game’s focus on psychological horror and narrative-driven exploration.

games.name: The Scourge
games.summary: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

games.name: Ban: The Prologue of Gucha Gucha
games.summary: 【A richly coloured horror and mystery tale】"BAN: The Prologue of GUCHA GUCHA” is a third-person horror adventure game. Experience the messy horror from the perspective of the protagonist, who is caught up in the whirlwind of events in a certain town in Japan, Utagacho.

games.name: The Hungry Fly
games.summary: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.

games.name: While We Wait Here
games.summary:
Share thoughts and hot food with your last ever clients, as you wait for the world to end.

Tackling themes of time, the armageddon and the intricacies of human psychology, While We Wait Here promises to be as deep as it does captivating, as players must juggle between the mundanity of flipping burger patties and pouring soda to the frighteningly serious threat that lies outside the diner’s doors.

games.name: Endoparasitic 2
games.summary: Three limbs ripped off, infected with a deadly parasite, you must survive. Drag yourself through the hallways of an infested arcship, fight off twisted eldritch creatures, craft vaccines and ammunition, and escape to civilization.

games.name: Daemonologie
games.summary: A remake of the short folk horror story about the Scottish witch trials in Unreal Engine 5. You play the role of a witchfinder. Speak to the locals and sort their truths from their lies. On the last morning a witch must hang, best you know who by then.

games.name: Terror In The Corn
games.summary: In an endless cornfield where the sun never rises, you must break the curse or risk being trapped forever.

games.name: Crowded. Followed.
games.summary: You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else. A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.

games.name: Moving Houses
games.summary: A silly little physics-based game about moving on... or is it? Be neat, be careful, or be a chaos goblin. The choice is yours. But be warned, not all is as it seems in this quiet little house.

games.name: Cryptmaster
games.summary: Say anything in this bizarre dungeon adventure where words control everything. Fill in the blanks with text or voice to uncover lost abilities, solve strange quests, and play unexpected mini-games. Use your words to conquer the crypt and unleash a whole new kind of "spell casting!"

games.name: Until Dawn
games.summary:
A remake of Until Dawn, an interactive drama survival horror video game originally released in 2015.

The remake features overhauled visuals, new camera controls, prologue rework, new collectables, new areas and interactions, and a new "Stay Calm" mechanic.

games.name: The Damn Psychiatric
games.summary: The "San Lucas" psychiatric hospital, which was built in 1985 to help people with mental illnesses, became the scene of crimes and suspicious experiments in the year 2035. Patients mysteriously disappeared and some were found found dead in a strange way.

games.name: Forgive Me Father 2
games.summary: Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares to restore your sanity. Blast your way through hordes of possessed enemies, unlock an arsenal of deadly weapons and get ready to face even more Lovecraftian madness in this action-packed FPS sequel.

games.name: Slay the Princess: The Pristine Cut
games.summary:
Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art.

The Pristine Cut is the definitive version of the game. It features expanded content including 3 new chapters, never-before-seen Princesses, expansions to familiar routes, a new ending, over 1,200 new hand-penciled frames, over 2,500 new lines of dialogue, and over 35% more content overall.

games.name: Kinki Spiritual Affairs Bureau
games.summary: Time to fight back against the spirits! Play as an exorcist with firearms and purge unlawful spirits to solve the mystery of the Saiga village invasion in Nara!

games.name: Grunn
games.summary: A gardener gets hired to do some maintenance work over the weekend. The tall grass needs to be cut, the wild hedges trimmed, and the dead flowers could use some water. A simple task, but strangely some tools are missing…The owner of the garden isn't around, and their house is off-limits. Perhaps new tools can be found in the mysterious town, or maybe some of the reserved townsfolk have seen them?

games.name: Dark Hours
games.summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

games.name: Coven
games.summary: Coven is a retro fps/slasher set in the 1600's in which you play as a young woman who is wrongly accused of witchcraft and burned at the stake. She's resurrected by an unknown force and seeks revenge.

games.name: Puppet House
games.summary: A disturbing horror game set in the abandoned house of a deceased ventriloquist. Take on the role of Rick and unravel the mystery of the mansion, be careful because you won't be alone. Do you dare to cross the threshold to discover the truth?

games.name: Don't Mess with Gamers
games.summary: A new survival horror game

games.name: Lost Diskettes Vol. 1
games.summary: This is a collection of short and experimental horror experiences, focused on surreal and bizarre plots.

games.name: Don't Look Back!
games.summary:
You've taken what seems like an easy task: find missing keys to unlock doors that will lead you to secrets of the abandoned house. What you don't know is the danger that lurks in the house.

Find all 6 keys to unlock the hidden door, find secret notes that will provide you with mysterious story and reveal all the secrets that the house holds! Listen to Crooked Man sounds, be aware of your surroundings, but DO NOT LOOK AT HIM!

games.name: Bane Murrain
games.summary: Dayne Muren, a nervous wreck of an engineer working on the K.R.E.V research station, is thrown into the midst of a biohazard bloodbath when a meteorite collision turns his crewmembers into mutated creatures.

games.name: Otherplane
games.summary: Otherplane is a 1-4 player ghost horror escape room game

games.name: The Kharzov Effect
games.summary: Welcome to The Kharzov Effect, an immersive first-person puzzle horror game. Explore Dr. Kharzov’s eerie estate as you unravel the mystery behind a series of abductions. Face terrifying creatures, solve intricate puzzles, and uncover the truth of Kharzov's dark history!

games.name: Retro Horror Story
games.summary: Embark on a heart-pounding journey through a cursed maze in this thrilling survival horror game. Evade a terrifying monster and solve intricate puzzles to uncover dark secrets. Can you escape the nightmare?

games.name: The Killing Antidote
games.summary: In the future, pharmaceutical company, X-Gene created a dangerous, monster making virus. Jodi, a fearless investigative journalist, is going to get to the bottom of this and doesn't care who's at the top!

games.name: Ghostbane
games.summary: GHOSTBANE is a game where you act as Paranormal Hunters. Your mission is to identify and neutralize various types of ghosts appearing in different locations. You can try your luck alone, but it's better to work in teams of 2-4 people. Solve this paranormal world using your equipment. Identify the types and beliefs of ghosts. By doing so, you can perform a ritual and trap them. Remember, teamwork and utilizing the strengths of each team member will shape your success. Are you ready, hunters?

games.name: Silent Hill 2
games.summary: Silent Hill 2 Remake is a ground-up reimagining of the 2001 psychological horror game. It follows James Sunderland as he searches for his deceased wife in the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill. The remake features entirely rebuilt visuals in Unreal Engine 5, over-the-shoulder gameplay, reworked combat, and new voice acting.

games.name: Psychopomp Gold
games.summary: Psychopomp is BACK. The catacombs stretch down farther than ever before. Your entire life has been a lie. Delve into the depths, and discover the horrors that lie below. More realms, more modes, more secrets. An ancient voice calls to you from the center of the earth. Will you answer it?

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Retchid
games.summary: The TEC Mining facility on Titan has been over run by beings from another universe. Grab your shotgun and stop this madness.

games.name: Alice's Lullaby
games.summary: Embark on a surreal, psychedelic adventure to travel back and forth through time and rescue young Alice, helping her escape the uncanny, macabre and treacherous world of Styx. Unravel the metaphysical mystery of the grandchild cult and find out why they call you the monster!

games.name: The Fear Business
games.summary: The fear of the scared ones keep them alive, VHS supernatural survival horror.

games.name: Bober Bros: The Hole
games.summary: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a paranoid recluse whose life takes a dark turn when a mysterious hole appears in his apartment. Through this ominous hole, anyone—or anything—could be watching him...

games.name: Carnival Massacre
games.summary: Drawing heavily from classic survival horror tropes, Carnival Massacre takes players on a haunting quest in a cursed theme park. Explore your surroundings, manage your messy inventory, solve puzzles and kill the four ringleaders of the park.

games.name: Their Navy Is Their Doom
games.summary: Command an advanced submarine in a heart-pounding horror experience as you hunt the last remnants of a defeated enemy beneath the Mariana Trench. Navigate, survive, and uncover terrifying oceanic secrets in this immersive underwater warfare game.

games.name: Ghost Frequency
games.summary: In Ghost Frequency, you are a ghost hunter from PIT - Paranormal Investigation Team. Your mission is to locate a sinister spirit using the EMF Ghost Detector to track paranormal activity, the IR Thermal Camera to reveal hidden entities, and the EVP Digital Recorder to capture eerie voices.

games.name: Bad Parenting 1: Mr. Red Face
games.summary: Mr. Red Face, a fictional character created by adults to teach their children, suddenly becomes real..

games.name: Pinnacle Point
games.summary: You must uncover the truth that lured your brother into a corporation’s twisted promise of eternal life. On an island steeped in shadows and secrets, you’ll fight to survive, solve haunting mysteries, and confront a past better left forgotten. A dark, 1990s-inspired modern survival horror awaits.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

games.name: These Darker Tides
games.summary: Welcome [EMPLOYEE] to your new job protecting Deep Sea Cables from creatures of the deep. We're not liable for loss of limbs, sanity, or life while on the job. Don't forget to keep your desk clean and your eyes on those cameras!

games.name: Amanda the Adventurer
games.summary: Digging through your attic you found a box set of an old children's TV show, Amanda the Adventurer, starring a brave girl named Amanda and a cowardly sheep named Wooly. You don't recall any specific episodes or characters in the show. Or what happens in the show exactly. Or much about it at all come to think about it, but it still feels strangely familiar. Curiosity takes hold and you decide to watch the tapes and let horror nostalgia take you back to a simpler age.

games.name: The Fox Hare Disaster: Chapter One
games.summary: Prepare to explore an abandoned mall from the 90’s in this first-person, psychological horror! Tackle puzzles and come face to face with the haunting creatures that lurk inside. Will you be able to make it out alive, or will you suffer the same fate as those who came before you…?

games.name: AquaDark
games.summary: AquaDark is a first-person horror game with management elements set in the ‘80s. As an aquapark owner, players have to serve customers, sell wares, record everything, and solve the mystery behind strange events in the aquapark.

events.name: QUByte Connect 2024
events.description:
QUByte Connect 2024 is here! Presented by Coelho no Japão, QUByte demonstrates its renewed commitment to the gaming public and the Brazilian developer community. This event is the stage to showcase an impressive range of games that reflect the diversity and passion we have for the industry.

Get ready for big news, including updates to MARS 2120 and Top Racer Collection. Our commitment to Brazilian development remains strong, bringing releases such as Hands of Timber, Saborus, Beyond the Evil and more! We're also bringing you games that are already available, such as the horrifying platformer Hannah!

In addition, we present a new surprise partnership to relaunch nostalgic games on current platforms. Stay tuned to discover more incredible titles and unmissable promotions, with a celebration that promises to delight gamers of all ages.

games.name: Raccoo Venture
games.summary: Raccoo Venture is a 3D platform adventure and collect-a-thon that brings a playful atmosphere inspired by the golden classics from 90s. Raccoo is the last heir of the Guardian Power, who for many years protected the Sacred Relics. Now he must protect the world from the dangerous Tattooed Tatus which are going to steal the mythical jewel and bring chaos to the land. Raccoo must defeat enemies, solve secrets and puzzles while exploring the World of Verta, discovering magic items and new costumes that will help him in this journey in a search for the stolen Relic Pieces.

games.name: Lunar Axe
games.summary: After a big earthquake in the city center, ruins of an old building collapse and you end up trapped inside an abandoned house. Find a way out and unravel the mystery of inexplicable tremors, revealing ancient secrets and a mystical artifact, before the city is destroyed.

games.name: Hannah
games.summary:
Hannah is a puzzle platformer horror survival game. You play as Hannah, a teenager born in the 80s, who tries to understand her personality by taking an internal journey to her childhood and discovering what went wrong.

You will immerse yourself in the depths of this dreamlike reality in which Hannah will have to be cunning, to solve puzzles; use the elements at your disposal to create devices and vehicles and avoid dying on the way.

games.name: Mars 2120
games.summary: MARS 2120 is a metroidvania with engaging melee combat inspired by classics like Super Metroid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, or Guacamelee! With the use of special abilities tied to elements like ice, fire, and electricity help Sgt. Anna “Thirteen” Charlotte navigate the colony and battle her way through the secrets of Mars

games.name: Glover
games.summary: The cult classic from the '90s returns! Glover is a charming 3D platformer where you control a magical glove on a quest to restore balance to the kingdom. Roll, jump, and manipulate your magic ball to solve puzzles, overcome challenges, and defeat the evil glove threatening the world!

games.name: Frogue
games.summary: Embark in a journey to rescue your dog in Frogue. A bullet-hell time manipulation roguelike platformer.

games.name: Road Defense: Outsiders
games.summary: Protect vehicles on the road and survive! Road Defense: Outsiders is a game that combines elements of the 'roguelike' and 'tower defense' genres. Upgrade the towers and your own skills to be able to annihilate all the life around you!

games.name: Runa & the Chaikurú Legacy
games.summary: Help the brave adventurer Runa uncover the mysteries buried deep in the Ruins of the ancient Chaikurú civilization, in a classic and epic 3D action-adventure game. Explore a fantasy world inspired by South-American locations, nature and cultures.

games.name: Clawed Cult
games.summary: Clawed Cult is a roguelite bullet heaven with cute cultist animals invoking their elder god, Catchulhu. Guide them through challenging battles with powerful abilities and strategy to emerge victorious. With intense action and stunning art, it's a must-play for fans of games who love a challenge!

games.name: Momo and the Mine
games.summary: Help this charismatic mole collect matchsticks in an abandoned mine in this challenging platform game!

games.name: Top Racer Collection
games.summary: The Top Racer Collection showcases the renowned 16-bit racing game franchise, featuring beloved titles such as Top Racer, Top Racer 2, and Top Racer 3000, along with exciting new and exclusive content.

games.name: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare
games.summary: Deep Deep Deep Nightmare is a 2D Top Down Shooter. Survive by facing monsters in the nightmare of a little boy who didn’t heed his mother’s warnings that eating too much before bed can cause nightmares.

games.name: Saborus
games.summary: Saborus, a gripping horror adventure! Guide the brave chicken, through a deadly slaughterhouse. Solve chilling puzzles and face relentless pursuit. Can you survive?

games.name: Hands of Timber
games.summary: Hands of Timber portrays the journey of a little wooden doll that wakes up inside the mind of its creator. To find her father, she must wander through his memories... the good, the bad, and the incomplete ones...

games.name: Simulacro
games.summary: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

games.name: Shroomtopia
games.summary: Shroomtopia is a relaxing and atmospheric puzzle about manipulating soils and blending colors. Use your logical reasoning to solve challenges and help bring nature back to life.

games.name: Rage of the Dragons NEO
games.summary: Engage in intense tag team battles in Rage of the Dragons NEO! Play the cult-classic among the fans of Fighting Games with brand-exclusive content!

games.name: Extinction Rifts
games.summary: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

games.name: Plungeez
games.summary: Take a dive in the world of Plungeez, a puzzle platformer where Bonnie, a fierce woman who, after falling in the underground, must explore the sewers of Salvador in search of a way out. Light torches, boilers, and use plungers to climb and solve puzzles!

games.name: MetroLand
games.summary: MetroLand is a new endless runner that takes what you know and love about the classic endless runner and turns it up to 11!

games.name: Accolade Sports Collection
games.summary:
Accolade Sports Collection is a retro collection featuring some of the most iconic sports games from the early 90s. This collection includes titles like Summer Challenge, Winter Challenge, Hardball 1&2 and Hoops Shut Up and Jam!.

This collection offers a complete retro gaming experience, where players can easily select from the different titles available, with features like save states, filters options, manuals and more!

games.name: Dawn of Fear
games.summary: Experience an intense survival horror journey as an investigative agent in a dark and cursed village. The quest for a leader has never been so hindered.

games.name: Blades & Battles
games.summary: Blades & Battles is a fantasy Beat'Em Up game that takes players to the heart of the legendary world of King Arthur in his barbarian youth. A modern version of classic titles such as Golden Axe.

events.name: Chao Direct 2024
events.description: Join us for over 10 minutes of fan game trailers and announcements at the Chao Games Showcase!

games.name: Sonic Rush 3D
games.summary: A 3D reimagining of the fan favorite 2D platformer, Sonic Rush!

games.name: Bub's Big Blowout!
games.summary:
Bub and his friends seem to have found themselves lost in a strange new world! Everything is so familiar, yet so different! Will you be able to help Bub and his friends find their way home?

Welcome to "Bub's Big Blowout!", A 3D reimagining of the Bubble Bobble arcade game! Here you can jump, blow bubbles, and burst baddies as bub or one of his 3 friends! Collect fruit, Extend Bubbles, and other collectibles for the best possible score!

games.name: Sonic Colors Demastered
games.summary:
Sonic Colors Demastered is a 2D reimagining of Sonic Colors for the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo DS. The game features gameplay inspired by the Sonic Rush series and a fully original level design and soundtrack.

Join Sonic, Tails, and a colorful cast of aliens to put a stop to Eggman’s plans for interstellar domination! Use Sonic’s signature suite of abilities, including the boost, grind, and homing attack, to make your way through exhilarating, high-speed 2D platforming challenges!

games.name: Sonic Legends
games.summary: Sonic Legends is a non-profit fan project and re-imagining of classic, notable levels throughout the long-lasting history of Sonic fan games!

games.name: Pokémon Aragonite
games.summary:
Pokémon Aragonite is a fanmade project based on the real life island of Sicily, in the South of Italy.
Started by FrankieChatot and Darkonius Mavakar;
This project aim to reimagine Sicily into the Pokémon world by creating the Sylia region, where you will be able to explore many areas and cities based off actual places!
Initially this started as a fakemon dex where we had fun interpreting our culture, flora and fauna into Fakemon, but then we decided to use Pokémon Essentials to turn it into a playable game!

games.name: Sonic Eclipse
games.summary: Sonic Eclipse is a 2D Classic Sonic Fan Game, created by the BrainBox Interactive Team, featured as an entry to this years (2024) Sonic Amateur Games Expo!

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog 2: Gear Shift
games.summary: Save Tails from the clutches of Dr. Robotnik in this complete re-imagining of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the Master System and Game Gear!

games.name: Hotel Mario ReBooked
games.summary: A fan-made port of Hotel Mario for PC.

games.name: Mean Bean Tsuu
games.summary: Mean Bean Tsuu is a hack which aims to be a sequel to the original game, featuring new mechanics from Puyo Puyo Tsuu, as well as a story more in line with that of Japanese Classic Sonic canon.

games.name: Tails' Picross
games.summary: Tails' Picross is a fangame inspired by the Picross game series and other Mega Drive puzzle games. In this game, you will need to clear puzzles using the clues on each row and each collumn of the grid.

events.name: Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct: Celebrations, Reflections, and a Look Ahead
events.description: Welcome to the epic celebration of 30 years of Warcraft! Join us on a heartfelt journey through three decades of adventure, camaraderie, and unforgettable moments in Azeroth and beyond. In this special 45-minute video, we're bringing together the creative minds behind World of Warcraft, Warcraft RTS, Hearthstone, and Warcraft Rumble.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Midnight
games.summary:
The second of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

Introducing Housing!
Before you put down roots in your own cozy corner of Azeroth later this year, jump into our virtual tour for an early glimpse at the customization options that await you.

Explore New and Reimagined Zones
The battle between the Light and the Void spans across four zones as you discover new allies and confront ancient enemies.
- Silvermoon City
- Eversong
- Zul'Aman
- Harandar
- Voidstorm

New Features and Improvements
As the Void invasion descends upon Quel'Thalas, an array of new features add more depth and improvements to our evolving world.
- Prey
- Devourer Demon Hunter
- Haranir
- Dungeons and Raids
- New and Returning Player Experience
- Transmog Updates

games.name: World of Warcraft: The War Within - Undermine(d)
games.summary: Undermine(d), takes players to an underground city built by the creativity of the goblins.

games.name: World of Warcraft: The War Within
games.summary:
Journey through never-before-seen subterranean worlds filled with hidden wonders and lurking perils, down to the dark depths of the nerubian empire, where the malicious Harbinger of the Void is gathering arachnid forces to bring Azeroth to its knees.

Deep beneath the surface lies treasure vaults waiting to be discovered with Delves. Explore these world instances solo or with up to four friends, along with an NPC companion, to defeat bosses and gain epic end-game loot.

Expand the potential of your alternate characters with account-wide progression across your family of characters on your Battle.net account with Warbands. Share your Warband Bank access, War Within Renown, achievements, collections, and more.

Rise to new heights of power with new Hero Talent trees. Each class specialization has access to two choices of self-contained Hero Talent trees inspired by iconic Warcraft universe archetypes.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria Classic
games.summary:
World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria Classic (sometimes shortened to MoP Classic) is a Classic server option that launched in July 2025 which allows playing content and game mechanics of the 2012 Mists of Pandaria expansion. It will be available during the latter half of the modern The War Within period and the beginning of Midnight.

Like prior Classic releases, MoP Classic is similar to its original version, but includes some changes, including significant changes to endgame instance difficulty progression. A Mythic+-like dungeon mode was added, continuing the trend started in Wrath of the Lich King Classic, while Raid Finder mode has been omitted, with its loot shifted to the upgraded dungeons. Minor changes include alts having easier access to flying mount skills and tweaks to Arena healing.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Cataclysm Classic
games.summary: The World-changing Cataclysm arrives in World of Warcraft Classic, with changes made from the original release based on fan feedback.

games.name: Warcraft Rumble
games.summary: Warcraft Rumble is a mobile action strategy game where collectible Warcraft Minis come to life to clash in epic melee battles. Whether you choose to play in the massive single player campaign or compete head-to-head in epic PvP battles, prepare to experience the true meaning of joyful chaos!

games.name: Hearthstone: Across the Timeways
games.summary:
Across the Timeways is Hearthstone's 31st expansion, featuring 145 new collectible cards released on November 4, 2025. In this expansion, players travel with Chromie through alternate realities to recruit Legendary Warcraft heroes.

Across the Timeways introduces two new keywords: Rewind and Fabled. Cards with Rewind can be replayed an additional time for a potentially different outcome. Legendary Fabled cards include 2 additional cards with them in players' decks during deckbuilding.

games.name: Hearthstone: The Lost City of Un'Goro
games.summary: The Lost City of Un'Goro is Hearthstone's 30th expansion, set to release as the second expansion of 2025. This expansion is stylized as the first-ever sequel expansion, following the events of Journey to Un'Goro. Players join Elise on a hunt for a mythical, lost Tortollan city.

games.name: Hearthstone: Into the Emerald Dream
games.summary: Into the Emerald Dream is Hearthstone's 29th expansion, set to release as the first expansion of 2025. This expansion explores the Emerald Dream, as the battle between the Old Gods and the Druids of the Emerald Dream decides the fate of the World Tree.

games.name: Hearthstone: The Great Dark Beyond
games.summary: Long ago, the distant planet Argus was attacked by the demonic Burning Legion. While most of Argus gave in to unholy promises of power, some brave souls escaped to the stars. These “exiled ones” now call themselves Draenei, and they need you to help them find a new home. Pilot your own Starship and explore the vastness between worlds in The Great Dark Beyond!

games.name: Hearthstone
games.summary: Hearthstone is a free-to-play digital collectible card game set in the Warcraft universe. Originally subtitled Heroes of Warcraft, the game features turn-based one-on-one matches where players build 30-card decks and select heroes from eleven classes, each with unique abilities. Players spend mana crystals each turn to summon minions, cast spells, and use weapons with the goal of reducing their opponent's health to zero. The game includes multiple modes such as ranked competitive play, Arena drafting, Battlegrounds (an auto battler for eight players), and rotating Tavern Brawl challenges. New card sets are released as expansions every four months, with a Standard format that rotates older cards out of competitive play.

games.name: Warcraft Remastered Battle Chest
games.summary: Celebrate 30 years of Warcraft history and travel back to the beginning with remastered versions of Warcraft I and II and a newly updated Warcraft III Reforged.

games.name: Warcraft I: Remastered
games.summary:
Journey back to the beginning of a 30-year legacy with the first Warcraft story created in 1994, now remastered with vivid, all-new visuals and modernized controls!

Experience the inciting war between Orcs and Humans that shook Azeroth to its core. Defend the realm as the noble Alliance, or seek to conquer it as the bloodthirsty Horde across thrilling faction campaigns or custom skirmish games. Whichever side you take, there has never been a better time to charge into the legendary battles of Azeroth’s greatest heroes in the Warcraft universe

games.name: Warcraft II: Remastered
games.summary:
Captain your own fleet in the second Warcraft title created in 1995, now remastered with vivid, all-new visuals and modernized controls!

War between orc and humans rages on across the seas, and the fate of the world hangs in the balance as the great tacticians of the Horde and the Alliance clash. Only one thing is certain: winning this war will demand unprecedented cunning, courage, and nerves of steel.

games.name: Warcraft III: Reforged - Version 2.0
games.summary: In celebration of the 30th anniversary of the release of Warcraft: Orcs & Humans, Warcraft III: Reforged has been updated to version 2.0, which includes many fixes, improvements, and nods to Warcraft’s history.

events.name: arcINDIE CURRENT 2024
events.description: Join us for over 35 minutes of exciting independent game trailers and announcements for the arcINDIE expo!

games.name: Wink and the Broken Robot
games.summary:
Explore the weird and cute post-apocalyptic world of The Outskirts while collecting coins and mysterious ancient treasures like floppy disks and cassette tapes

Wink is taking inspiration from Gameboy classics like Super Mario Land 2 and Link's Awakening, but doing its own little thing.

games.name: Electro-Dynamic Mayhem
games.summary: Join the not-so-goody two-shoes robot 'EDM' in a Wario Land 4-inspired speedy‎ platformer where your goal is to cause as much destruction to public property as you can while doing field research.‎

games.name: Lyrestruck
games.summary: This game follows Irina, who's been wandering through an endless forest, in search of an exit. Will she discover the roots of this curse and break out?

games.name: Moomi & Spike
games.summary: Experience high-speed thrills and an engaging story in Moomi & Spike, a 3D platformer where agile gameplay and a captivating narrative collide in a vibrant adventure!

games.name: Tricky and the Dream Caster
games.summary:
Tricky O'Possum has been hit with a sleep curse, trapping him in Caster's dream domain!
With the help of his new pal Volt, he's gotta collect the keys to Caster's Castle and beat him up to break the curse.
Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

games.name: Wildaria
games.summary: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

games.name: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

games.name: Princess Pomu and the 5 Moons
games.summary: Paint without T is PAIN! Princess Pomu just lost her Kingdom and her family was captured, and now she's possessed by an evil spirit! Master the simple but satisfying combo system, get more abilities, pick up weapons, and explore the surreal world of Illeh in this cute metroidvania with a violent twist.

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Triku
games.summary: Meet Triku, a platform-adventure game that's made for fans of Monster World IV and Shantae in which you take control of Triku who must travel across various areas filled with enemies to avoid and dungeons to enter.

games.name: SomnaBuster
games.summary:
If the dream is real to you, it is worth fighting for!

Accounting student Macy is down on her luck and out of her mind, but her life of hum-drum is abruptly interrupted by a visit from a mysterious firefly. After stumbling down a seemingly endless hole, she wakes up in a strange new world. With an explosive broom in tow, Macy sets out discover the mysteries of Esperanto and find her way home.

games.name: Potatostrike
games.summary: A space shmup featuring the ultimate potato-based space fighter.

games.name: Knight George
games.summary: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

games.name: Dagada's Story
games.summary:
Dive into the depths of a snowy world in this adventure game. Explore a mountain where a tribe of strange creatures, the Daoudaounes, lives among ancient ruins, while seeking answers to the mysteries that surround you.

Dagada's Story is a Puzzle-platformer game inspired by Super Nintendo-era games. This adventure emphasizes the balance between exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, with responsive controls and beautiful storytelling.

Particular attention has been given to the creation of the universe and each of its graphical, sound, and game design elements. The animation aims to be smooth and lively, reminiscent of pixel art from such game as Yoshi's island or the Super Mario bros series ...

games.name: Roskur's Run
games.summary: Roskur's Run is an evolution of classic 90's "Hedgehog" physics-based platforming with a deeper move set, upgrades, and a non-linear world to explore. The loop: Explore > Collect > Upgrade > SPEED RUN > Unlock > Explore

games.name: RetroBlazer
games.summary: Take on the mantle of the Pyramid Guard, go up against the cybernetic Ark Legion, and rid the kingdom of a spectral blight. Combining the charm of Saturday Morning Cartoons and the bombastic action of late 90s shooters, RetroBlazer recaptures a golden era of frantic, fast-paced, first-person action.

games.name: Foxblade Fable
games.summary: A young boy is forced to embark on a quest to master the powers of the Divines,

games.name: Apricity
games.summary: Fight, farm and bake your way through ancient canals and the crumbling castles of APRICITY. Gather strength by fishing waterways, harvesting ingredients and slaying ancient beasts. Rekindle the lost light and push back the hungering darkness.

games.name: You Know The Drill
games.summary: An action-puzzle game about a wannabe spelunker digging deep inside dangerous grounds.

games.name: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend
games.summary: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend is a story-driven indie RPG where you play as Michael, a nerdy kangaroo inventor from the Tech District. They have a lifelong goal of making monsters less of a threat to society. And their research takes them to the abandoned offices of the Mall District to test a theory regarding how monsters relate to the memories of the deceased. Things go well, but then they get caught up in a corporate nightmare. Slowly breaking them down and leaving them desperately searching for a way to escape.

games.name: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition
games.summary:
Super Freaks 1 Ultimate Edition is a 2D platformer featuring single player and up to four player drop-in/drop-out cooperative gameplay.
Go to the right, jump on enemy heads, reach the exit, all of that standard stuff. When you select a level, you can choose between any of the Super Freaks before playing, as well as a whole host of other unlockable characters. There are over 20 characters total!

games.name: Super Freaks Presents: Strato Freaks 2
games.summary: Fantasy Zone and NiGHTS thrown back into a super freaky blender!

games.name: Super Freaks Arcade
games.summary: Super Freaks Arcade is a throwback to single-screen arcade games, loosely based on a combination of Mario Bros., and Pac-Man Championship Edition. It aims to reinterpret the gameplay of Super Freaks 1 Ultimate Edition as if it were a 1983 arcade game. While it was originally made in two weeks for the Freakjam 1 pack, Super Freaks Arcade is receiving content updates and overhauls over time that will continue to expand it.

games.name: Super Freaks Side Story: Scruffy Minus - The Rise of the Anti-Freaks
games.summary: A new Classic Super Freaks game, Scruffy Minus is a new platforming adventure (with some freaky surprises!) Run, jump, and activate your different superpowered Suits, to kick butt!

games.name: What's left of Rave Rough
games.summary: Rave Rough is a comedic and chaotic puzzle platformer about chucking your exposable vinyl collection to bounce your way throughout many platforming challenges! All the while butting heads with wacky friends and foes! Levels are very open ended and the moveset compliments this, with you having a lot of freedom to tackle challenges in all sorts of different ways.

games.name: Fractured Alliance
games.summary: Classic real time strategy! Command varied forces, gather resources, build your base, adapt tactics, and dominate vast landscapes. Script your legacy in rich campaigns and dynamic multiplayer battles. Shape the destiny of the world!

games.name: Stellar Warfare
games.summary: A real-time space stategy game with ship customization. Design your own ships, compose your fleet and use it to face off against other players. You will create your own in-game base with powerplants, refineries and base defences to ensure a healthy economy.

games.name: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion
games.summary: Bristle and the Artificial Invasion is a platformer game made in GB Studio that tells the story of a paintbrush named Bristle, whose planet is invaded by an army of artificially generated monsters. It's up to Bristle to rescue his friends and save any neighboring planets affected by this catastrophe.

games.name: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest
games.summary: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest is a 2D platforming game that takes inspiration from classic platformers such as Sonic, and fighting games like Mortal Kombat. The game aims to be a combination of classic 2D platforming with 1v1 fighting whilst also exploring the large forest of Veredilia across various locales with a wide range of characters, technical movesets, and flashy combos. You can take control of one of 3 characters, each with their own special moves, combos, and super moves. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and kick, punch, and slash your way to victory, before it's too late. Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Bun 'N' Gun
games.summary: Bun 'N' Gun is a fast action-based run-and-gun game where you command different weapon elements and jump through several action-packed stages full of enemies, traps, and powerups.

events.name: The MIX Fall Showcase 2024
events.description: From horror to cozy, action to strategy, and everything in between – The MIX kicks off the fall festivities with more games than ever for your wishlist. Dive into the newest digital gems this Thursday, November 21 at 9am PT to find out what you’ll be playing in the future.

games.name: Nubs! Arena
games.summary: Slap yourself into the absurdity of Nubs, where 5-player battles are as chaotic as they are quick! Risk it all for the mighty Konzumos' delight in this arena brawler and smash the others to nublivion in your quest for glory! Simple rules? Check. Roguelite progression? Sure. Predictability? No way!

games.name: SpreadCheat
games.summary: SpreadCheat is a puzzle game that fuses intricate spreadsheet challenges with a comedic, 90s financial vibe in a retro Windows 3.11 setting. The Player takes on the role of the new office prodigy, solving absurd tasks and manipulating spreadsheet cells to hit specific targets using clever formulas.

games.name: Hobnobbers
games.summary: Pillage the mall with your friends, fight murderous Pixys, and worship a divorcée Lady Goddess.

games.name: Traveler's Refrain
games.summary: Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler, and help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Bandit Trap
games.summary: Defend your home against a bandit invasion using inventive boobytraps as a Trapper, or join a team of three Bandits and try to get away with the loot! Introducing BANDIT TRAP—a fresh 3vs1, chaotically fun, physics-driven online multiplayer game for the whole family.

games.name: Big Helmet Heroes
games.summary: Throw yourself into an epic 3D beat'em up adventure with adorable knights, full of surprising worlds and situations. Grab your buddy and play in 2 player co-op to save the princess, but this is only the beginning!

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Frontier Paladin
games.summary: Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with weighty, stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves in tactical action-tower defense battles. Can you rebuild a shattered Order?

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Ovis Loop
games.summary: OVIS LOOP is an Action Roguelite with Fluid Pixel animation and Skill-Deck Building. Step into and be a sheep armed with a sci-fi greatsword, carving a path through wolves. Modify your skills within the desolate worlds of a sci-fi apocalypse to create a unique combat style that is all your own.

games.name: Ultra Mega Cats
games.summary: Ultra Mega Cats is a high-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. As a player, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs, escaping their corporate prison.

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.name: Lovish
games.summary: Lovish is an outrageous 8-bit action-adventure game! Quest with Sir Solomon through a series of bite-sized rooms, as he attempts to free Princess Tsuna, the woman he loves, from the Devil Lord's clutches!

games.name: DuneCrawl
games.summary: DuneCrawl is an online coop action-adventure game where players take on the roles of desert faring privateers. Together, players explore the dust seas by piloting their Dune Crawler, a gigantic walking crustacean festooned with cannons and treasure maps.

games.name: Dreamcore
games.summary: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

games.name: Double Whammy
games.summary: Work at a guitar shop by day! Fight monsters by night! Make custom guitars!

games.name: Blightstone
games.summary: Blightstone is a challenging, dark fantasy turn-based roguelike that brings unique twists to combat through freedom of character placement, interactive environments and hardcore resource management. Dying, learning, and meta-progression will be key in your mission to destroy the Blightstone itself

games.name: Maliki: Poison Of The Past
games.summary: Join Maliki and her wacky family in their epic battle against Poison, a fearsome plant creature that has colonized space-time. Go along on a fantastic odyssey through the ages that provides a unique mix of exploration, temporal riddles and turn-based fights full of surprises.

games.name: Bit Esc
games.summary: Break free from the system in Bit Esc, an action/adventure platformer where Bit sets out to escape from the tyrannic OS. Explore the digital world, overcome frantic challenges, meet new friends and make tough decisions that’ll determine the fate of Bit and the world around them.

games.name: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
games.summary: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: Windswept
games.summary: Our feather-shelled heroes were swept away by a storm, and they need your help! In this '90s-inspired platforming adventure, take on over forty handcrafted stages to discover the secrets of their world, the moon and beyond!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Completely Stretchy
games.summary: Stretch, swing and stick your way through the Grombi Isles! Use your stretchy arm and sticky fingers to explore vibrant regions, meet eccentric characters, and embark on quirky adventures. Oh, and you’re blue?

games.name: Battle Suit Aces
games.summary: Lead a plucky crew against a star-consuming threat in this charming character-driven, card battling RPG. Brought to you by the creators of the award-winning Battle Chef Brigade, recruit ace pilots, upgrade their mecha Battle Suits, grow meaningful friendships and captain your personalized adventure.

games.name: Surfpunk
games.summary: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

games.name: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
games.summary: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and everything will be perfectly fine.

games.name: Lurks Within Walls
games.summary:
Lurks Within Walls is a tense survival horror game combining modern dungeon RPGs' exploration elements with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore a series of cursed environments filled with terrifying creatures illustrated by the renowned artist Trevor Henderson.

A building under quarantine. Residents isolated. Those who failed to isolate themselves now stagger through the corridors, contaminated. But it's not just the infected residents—the darkness conceals other anomalies. It feels as if the building itself is alive.

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
games.summary: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a musical adventure game in which Snufkin needs to restore the harmony of Moominvalley, after a series of grotesque parks has appeared and ruined the valley's natural balance. The game is an ambient and wholesome experience for both kids and adults, and combines open world-mechanics with puzzles, stealth and melodic elements.

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler's Courtship
games.summary: In this heartfelt novella-like story of romance, newfound friend Fuddler needs a helping hand to express his feelings.

games.name: EbiTapes
games.summary: Go on an adventure to meet fun new friends, help them out, and create delicious beats along the way! Record the sounds of the world and make your own cool music.

games.name: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game
games.summary: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a bloody retro fighting beat em up with frenetic action and a lot of fun and references to the Terrifier franchise.

games.name: Doors of Insanity: ReOpened
games.summary: Gear up, sling cards, and power through the endless doors of Purgatory in this demo for Doors of Insanity: ReOpened!

games.name: Stuntboost
games.summary: Race against time on tracks of cardboard and toys to break records, climb leaderboards and become the fastest skater your online-neighborhood has ever seen!

games.name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.summary: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

games.name: Soulmask
games.summary: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

games.name: Voron: Raven's Story
games.summary: In this story-driven adventure, you are the raven from the pages of Norse legends. Fly, explore an open world, uncover its secrets, solve puzzles, save souls, and help your family. Caw!

games.name: Paper Animal Adventure
games.summary: Paper Animal Adventure is a cute roguelike game where you can explore a colorful world, fight scary enemies, and relax with your friends at the campfire! Will you be the one to seal the timelines and find the missing king?

games.name: The Time I Have Left
games.summary: The Time I Have Left is a time-driven escape adventure with RPG elements set in a complex underground facility. A mysterious phenomenon known only as ‘The Miasma’ has marked Aline for certain death.

games.name: Antonblast
games.summary: Antonblast is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

games.name: Grimoire Groves
games.summary: Restore the magical forest as you grow cute plant creatures with your witch magic in this cozy rogue-lite dungeon crawler. Unlock all spells, discover new plant types, befriend magical creatures, and unravel the mystery of the rainbow socks.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Bionic Bay
games.summary: An ordinary man in an extraordinary world. Bionic Bay is a new kind of a 2D platformer. It introduces a unique Swap mechanic, allowing players to interact with the physics-based world in new ways. The immersive gameplay is completed by spectacular environments and creative level design.

games.name: Sacre Bleu
games.summary: You are a Musketeer imprisoned on false charges. Steam-blast your way out and find the evil-doers who framed you. Uncover a plot to take over France!

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.summary: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

games.name: Spray Paint Simulator
games.summary: Sit back, relax and express your creative side in the colorful world of Spray Paint Simulator. Enter the town of Spatterville, meet the locals while you restore, repair, mask and spray paint everything from a kitchen to local landmarks. Buy new equipment, unlock Free Spray and transform the town.

games.name: Cuisineer
games.summary: Explore the world of Cuisineer as you enter dungeons and defeat monsters to get vital ingredients to cook delicious food to serve at your restaurant in this super cute and tasty rogue-lite dungeon crawler!

games.name: Mars Attracts
games.summary: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

games.name: Roman Triumph
games.summary: At the northern fringes of the empire, a new Roman city is born! Manage and grow your city, please the gods, and survive against barbarians and mythological threats to achieve Roman Triumph!

games.name: Neon Inferno
games.summary: NYC 2055: a city beyond salvation. Blast your way through this dense cyberpunk jungle in NEON INFERNO, an explosive fusion of 2D run-and-gun and gallery-shooter, and help the Family dominate its streets!

games.name: Automate It
games.summary: Automate It is a factory building game that requires clever solutions to its size, power, and time constraints. Solve challenges, build and share your own levels, or open things up in sandbox mode. If you want to build it - Automate It.

games.name: Metal Suits: Counter-Attack
games.summary: They should never have ticked him off. Begin a hot-blooded revenge as the protagonist Kevin, who has lost everything and was reborn as a cyborg!

games.name: Cash Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Start your money laundering business in this chill simulator! Use various not-so-powerful tools to restore dirty money bills and some unusual items to their full, crisp potential! Spend your hard-earned crypto to upgrade and cozy up your lab! The cash is in your hands!

games.name: Mightreya
games.summary: Join schoolgirl superhero Reya and her manager Nio as they embark on their journey as Hero Content Creators, fighting monstrous beings that emerge daily from a dimension beyond. Anime-inspired, heart-pounding hero action is waiting for you!

games.name: Everdeep Aurora
games.summary: An ongoing apocalyptic meteor shower has forced the world’s population to settle underground. As Shell, a feline child who awakens to find her mother missing, drill downward from the surface layer through a tile-based underground and discover the Everdeep.

games.name: Overthrown
games.summary: Lift and throw anything as you build and manage your kingdom in this chaotic city builder for 1-6 players. Harness the power of your soul-stealing crown to defend your citizens from bandits and mutants, farm the land, and gather resources. Keep citizens happy or see them desert you!

games.name: Kathy Rain 2: Soothsayer
games.summary: In this point-and-click urban thriller, down-and-out private eye Kathy Rain will embark on her most dangerous case yet — the pursuit of the notorious serial killer known as the Soothsayer. Find clues, gather evidence, connect the dots, and confront the murderer before the hunter becomes the hunted…

games.name: Smash It Wild
games.summary: Smash It Wild is a tactical turn-based game combining volleyball and dodgeball in a fantasy universe. Upgrade your players and defeat your opponents in an intense roguelike competition!

games.name: Ila: A Frosty Glide
games.summary:
Set foot on a magical island and immerse yourself in a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training with her trusty skatebroom. Explore, find secret places, collectables, and improve your magic and flying abilities as you make your way to the summit.

Explore a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training. Start your journey fueled by determination and your trusty skatebroom. Find secret places, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

Who needs a broom when you have a skatebroom? Soar through snowy mountains and enchanted forests, feel the wind as you cross stunning landscapes. Master and upgrade the magic of your to soar higher and farther.

Explore ILA’s small open world at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks, uncover treasures, and unlock secrets flying on your skatebroom. Each discovery rewards you with valuable items and deeper lore, enriching your magical journey.

Collect special items and coins to personalize ILA’s outfit with stylish hats, capes, and skatebrooms to reflect your unique style. As you progress, access new skatebroom upgrades to improve ILA’s flying powers.

Feel the magic and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack composed by Joaquim Scandurra (Sku), which builds up and grows with you as you approach the summit.

games.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
games.summary: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic power of SWAP, using it to Copy & Paste textures within the game world. Turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines as you ride hay bales, explore, fight, and solve puzzles throughout Riverside. Unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game that literally lets you change the world!

games.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
games.summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

games.name: Rendering Ranger: R2 - Rewind
games.summary: You are the Rendering Ranger, a special forces soldier who defending Earth from a devastating alien invasion through nine levels of action platforming as well as blisteringly fast horizontal shooter stages. Originally developed for Super Famicom by Manfred Trenz, creator of the Turrican series.

games.name: Tempo Punk
games.summary: Can you survive in an addicting fusion of rhythm-driven FPS action and captivating dystopian action-packed storytelling? Fight for your life through cutting-edge graphics while the pulsating beats of electronic music get your brain synapses firing at highspeed.

events.name: 2024 Queer Indies Showcase
events.description: The Queer Indies Showcase is a 5-hour live stream featuring 8 games from the Steam sale with fun segments led by streamers and game devs discussing aspects of the game and engaging with the chat.

games.name: Ritual of Raven
games.summary: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

games.name: This Bed We Made
games.summary: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links the clients together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

games.name: Rogue Labyrinth
games.summary: Fight through the ranks in a monster-filled labyrinth created by an egocentric billionaire colonist. Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, fans, and monsters to improve your abilities. The crowd wants a show, so hype them up in this rogue-lite narrative adventure!

games.name: Sibel's Journey
games.summary:
Approaching the subject of sexuality and gender in early adolescence can be scary, overwhelming, and often shameful. As a countermeasure, Sibel’s Journey taps into the potential of mobile games as a proven method for self-learning. The players interactively explore the content without having to ask an adult. As players’ engagement with the game increases, their motivation and ability to remember the learning material improves.

The game follows 13-year-old Sibel, who meets interesting people during an exciting weekend in Berlin. She gets to know their different ways of living and loving, then finally discovers the secret of her best friend Sarah.

Adopting an intersectional approach, Sibel’s Journey provides young people with sound knowledge and a positive attitude about topics such as anatomy, body image, communication, contraception, gender identity and healthy relationships.

games.name: Kiss/Off
games.summary: Kiss/OFF is an action-packed visual novel game about a bizarre intergalactic dating show. Pick your partner and compete in front of a live studio audience to have the Best Kiss by the end of three dates. The cost of failure? DEATH. Ready, set, smooch!

games.name: Quantum Witch
