games.summary: Dungeons and Dining Tables is a Cosy-RPG where you delve dungeons to collect rare furniture to decorate your house! The comfier your house. The better your stats!

games.name: Snow Cone
games.summary:
Snow Cone is a penguin-themed puzzle game where you arrange snowballs into elegant Snow Cones to match customers' orders in dozens of challenging puzzles. Meet interesting characters and expose the truth behind the city's shady penguin underbelly.

Features handcrafted puzzles, pixel-art graphics, and a jazz-inspired soundtrack.

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Burger Bois
games.summary: A food truck simulator about flavor, not labor. As chief burger designer, craft perfect sandwiches and turn your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces - or disasterpieces! No recipe, no 'one-right-answer': just let your tastebuds take you to the top.

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: Which Way Up: Galaxy Games
games.summary:
Which Way Up: Galaxy Games is a family friendly party game that gives unique freedom of movement by allowing you to run on walls and ceilings, orbit around planets, or fall across entire levels by manoeuvring through gravity fields.

Before The Universe existed, the Space Sprites banded together one-by-one to see a dream come to fruition: the dream of life itself. As The Universe began to take shape, so too did space. But space is unpredictable, and creating life is tiresome work. So, the Sprites took it upon themselves to create a pastime. The Galaxy Games.

Each event features its own unique bite-sized challenge where up to 4 players can compete. Eject your friends into space as you race across gravity fields, score a goal with an entire moon, leap across planets to escape a black hole, and capture and hold zodiacal constellations.

games.name: Untethered
games.summary: Stranded in deep space, you must survive against all odds. Scavenge from wreckage, process resources, and build your own space station - a refuge in the most hostile of environments.

games.name: Nullstar: Solus
games.summary: Be. Faster. You are a corporate scavenger drone, sent to rip through the decaying corpse of a dying world to salvage its nullstar. Master flight, thrusters, and face ancient guardians and hazards in 80 precision platformer levels set in the ruins of a civilization where all is not as it might seem.

games.name: Foodomina
games.summary: Play as two personified food girls- Takoyaki & Tempura- in their cosmic battle against mold people! Explore a food-themed galaxy, rich in flavour, make friends, & engage in absurd pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from infection! But mold people used to be food people- Maybe there's another way?

games.name: Adaptory
games.summary: Deep in uncharted space, your expedition took a challenging turn when your ship crash-landed. Master complex simulations to keep your outspoken explorers alive, face unpredictable challenges, and figure out a way back home.

games.name: Vagrient
games.summary: Play as an Armlys alien named Vagrient in this evolving sci-fi action/adventure game, featuring RPG elements. It's full of exploration, combat, character progression, puzzle solving and obstacle clearing!

games.name: Beyond These Stars
games.summary: Journey on the back of the space whale Kewa, building a city for your people as you travel across the galaxy seeking purpose and answers, and developing deep relationships with the universe around you.

games.name: Don't Stop, Girlypop!
games.summary: Spread the love! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option.

games.name: Key Fairy
games.summary: A hand-drawn, pacifist, folkloric, bullet-hell. Grapple and dance around monsters to collect their shattered stars, weave your way through twisting paths, encounter strange folk, uncover ancient magic, and evade forgotten gods in this frenetic 2D action-adventure.

games.name: Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic
games.summary: A first-person, turn-based journey into the occult. Who will stand with Aleister at the end of days?

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: ShelfLife: Art School Detective
games.summary: ShelfLife: Art School Detective is a Mystery Adventure featuring a cast of loveable weirdos! Befriend and investigate 7 potential suspects. Use psychic powers to astral project into their artwork and learn their secrets. Unmask the mysterious ART KILLER that’s terrorising your campus!

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

games.name: Rita
games.summary: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Memory's Reach
games.summary: Memory’s Reach is a first person puzzle-adventure metroidvania. Explore labyrinthian megastructures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and wield fantastic alien technology in a quest to reveal the legacy of a doomed civilization.

games.name: Match & Mastery
games.summary: Match & Mastery is a Turn-Based Tactics game with a Match-3 twist. Master your Magic, unleash powerful spells, and face challenging foes to free the land from a deadly magical blight.

games.name: Lighthaze World
games.summary: Discover a charming adventure in Lighthaze World, a cozy puzzle game for adventure lovers. Collect treasure, solve nonlinear puzzles and follow the anxious hero's heartfelt journey to save their loyal dog. Your decisions shape this delightful puzzle experience.

games.name: Power Sink
games.summary: Power Sink is a Puzzle-Platformer, set in the depths of an underwater hydrothermal power plant. Explore and repair the station before it falls to pieces from the pressure of the sea and the heat from below.

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: Courier Tale
games.summary: You've joined the gig economy as a courier for T.A.L.E. Couriers! Explore, meet and chat with a cast of characters, complete deliveries for the company while doing jobs on the side in this pixel art adventure where this job is not everything you expected it to be...

games.name: Cape Hideous
games.summary: Amongst the motliest of all crews, an enigmatic woman prepares the ship to enter an intense thunderstorm that rages in the middle of the ocean. What otherworldly mysteries lie within?

games.name: Fayrehaven
games.summary: Fayrehaven is a relaxing single-player trading and travelling game. Trade goods and cargo for upgrades. Explore Fayrehaven lake to find great deals for profit.

games.name: Dryft City Kyngs
games.summary: Work, race, explore, chill, repeat. Become the ultimate Dryft Racer in a colourful 2D punk-cartoon world based on a very near-future Melbourne!

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

games.name: Scourge of the Reptiles
games.summary: Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric fantasy world. When a meteor strikes the Earth, humans, elves and dinosaurs alike are gifted with magical abilities—abilities that result in war, devastation and forces that stretch far beyond the hero’s quiet home village.

games.name: Take the Wheels!
games.summary: Take The Wheels! is a sci-fi kart racer with a twist. The control scheme is all wrong! Using asymmetric thrust (like for a tank or plane) and a variety of normal (and odd) powerups, power your way to victory in this "interesting" take on kart racing.

games.name: Winnie's Hole
games.summary:
Join Winnie on a new adventure, from within!
Play as a virus in his body and mind. Capture cells to mutate and build a deck of actions to unleash in combo-driven combat.

A genre-blending roguelite with a dark yet charming story. Embrace discomfort - Sometimes we can't help being seen as a monster...

games.name: Soul Devourer
games.summary: Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a classic 2D horror style. You'll explore the vast, cursed Sakuradoki High School, master unique abilities, fight twisted monsters and uncover the long-buried secrets concealed under the school.

games.name: Cyber Paradise
games.summary: Revive Mini the Dog digitally through 2D roguelite actions; craft her cyber paradise with beloved moments, like sniffing dog butts XD. Uncover a deeper dystopian narrative and strengthen friendships in cafe chats—a frenetic yet cozy journey.

games.name: Wren's Resurgence
games.summary: Wren’s Resurgence is a 2D action platformer where Wren must fight her way through the Yokai-infested lands in order to rescue her sister Swan. With the evil force’s tyrannical grasp on the island, it’s up to Wren to brandish her katana and bring peace back to the land.

games.name: Aussie Bogan Hero
games.summary: G’day mates! In this crackin’ 2D metroidvania, Aussie Bogan Hero sees Davo, a mullet-wearing, beer-loving legend, battle corporate goons and freaky creatures to reopen his pub and save Dusty Springs. 'Cause sometimes, it takes a legend in a singlet to save the day.

games.name: Ascending Inferno
games.summary:
Ascending Inferno is your ultimate goal in this gorgeous, challenging-but-fair 2.5D precision platformer with a ball.

Playing as Dani, it’s not enough to run, jump and platform your way out of Hell - you’ll need to dribble, kick and header her dead brother Vincent’s ball-shaped soul along with you!

Just be sure you don’t fumble the ball - the depths of Hell is a long way to fall…

games.name: Servonauts
games.summary: Servonauts is an absurd couch co-op fuel-attendant game for up to 4 players. Connect pipes, mix fuels and overcome deadly hazards to meet all the customers demands, or die hilariously while trying.

games.name: Bullcrap!
games.summary: Meet Bucky the bull and his no good, untrustworthy farmyard friends! A turn-based bluff card game inspired by the classic game Bullsh*t! Race against your friends to offload your cards. Use wild cards to play dirty and change the rules!

games.name: Splatterbot
games.summary: The cleaning robots have gone rogue! Up to 4-players compete in local-multiplayer to make the most mess! Utilize your environment and power-ups to overwhelm your opponents with untidiness. It's about to get messy..

games.name: Trivia Deal
games.summary: Trivia Deal is the world’s first trivia roguelike. Answer fast. Play smart. Use lifelines, swap cards, and relics to survive the Rainbow Reaper. Each run is unforgiving, one wrong answer can end it all. High-stakes strategy with random questions, categories, and rewards that keep every run fresh.

games.name: Dolven
games.summary:
Dolven is a fantasy turn-based strategy RPG with a deep card-based battle system. Following the events of The Necromancer’s scourge upon the northern townsfolk, guide a band of mercenaries through the Decaying Isles in order to rid the land of evil. Use the Pillars to create a variety of combos to earn mana and gain advantage over the recent evil plaguing the land of Dolven.

Card battles include hand-to-hand combat, where the cards provide characters with additional skills. The Pillars allow you to create various hand combinations that range from matching cards and suits, playing a pivotal role in your quest to accumulate more Mana, Gear, Cards, Skills and even exerting influence over the game's environment. Strategic planning is of utmost importance.

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Pie in the Sky
games.summary: Pluck them. Pluck them all. You are an Australian Magpie on a mission. That mission: Spread havoc, cause mayhem, and grab the occasional unattended piece of food. Menace, rob, and terrify humans, enjoying old-school action arcade gameplay rendered in glorious retro PS2 graphics.

games.name: Anticitizen: Red
games.summary: Use bullet time, a variety of movement mechanics and an improvised arsenal to outwit and outgun biker gangs and corporate police in an American-occupied cyberpunk Australia. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, delve into the lore of the new American empire, and stay for the larrikin charm.

events.name: Indie Live Expo 2024.12.7
events.description: A live digital showcase for the hottest indie game news. It is broadcasted in 3 languages Japanese/Chinese/English, and has been viewed by over 98 million people with more than 2,600 games introduced.

games.name: Ascension
games.summary: In this cultivation 4X strategy game, your sect has been in peril, and so they open a portal—sending you, a young disciple and their last hope, inside. Stand tall as the new sect leader and guide disciples to rebuild what was lost. Sharpen your focus, master alchemy, and ascend to immortality.

games.name: Battle Shapers
games.summary: Battle Shapers is a blazing-fast, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords to bring New Elysium back to the utopia it once was.

games.name: Polylylyrhythm
games.summary: Rhythm game to push polyrhythms. Can you play multiple rhythms like 2 beats, 3 beats and 5 beats?

games.name: Randomax
games.summary: Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory! A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test.

games.name: Dreamed Away
games.summary: Dreamed Away is an emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements. Play as Théo, a boy lost in a dark, mysterious world. Explore a unique reality, duel against darkness in a unique, fast paced combat system and mind your choices.

games.name: Decollate Decoration
games.summary: This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost. The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him" causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.

games.name: Idle Colony
games.summary: A condensed incremental experience, where you build a colony to collect and merge bigger and bigger fruits. Combine game-changing technologies and special upgrades to find the best synergies and take your cash flow to another dimension.

games.name: Sausage Legend: Arena
games.summary: Sausage Legend is a 3D physics-based fighting game where players clash their sausages in battle. You take on the role of a medieval slave, forced to fight in the "Sausage Duel," a pastime of the nobility. To gain your freedom, you must emerge victorious in this mad contest.

games.name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising
games.summary:
Dare to rumble with the best like never before with all-new characters, mechanics, and modes in the sequel to the revolutionary fighting game praised by both newcomers and fighting game veterans alike.

Experience even smoother and more responsive online play with rollback netcode and engage in battle cross-platform against players on PlayStation 5, PlayStation 4, and Steam!

games.name: Sofia in Exchange for Lies
games.summary: Peek into the sins and memories of five personalities through surveillance cameras. This is an immersive, mystery adventure game that unravels the thoughts of the dark past that lie dormant inside Sofia, a suspect in the murder of a presidential candidate, and uncovers the truth behind the crime.

games.name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
games.summary: Asuha, a self-proclaimed gambling prodigy, challenges the Witch ruling the gambling district. Poised to win, she is defeated by a mysterious power. An adventure of gambling, exposing frauds and earning fortunes through poker.

games.name: Weirdo
games.summary: Weirdo is a Japanese manga-style visual novel set in DYL High School. It follows Wang Zhe, an ordinary and frail boy, who tries to win the hearts of girls and complete his experiments. He gets entangled in bizarre events, plunging into darkness. Each choice you make determines his fate.

games.name: Astromeda
games.summary: Astromeda is an adventure RPG, featuring unique fast-paced and turn-based battles in a mysterious, charming world. You are a human who returns to an Earth inhabited by intelligent Bacteria. Explore a rich world, befriend or fight quirky characters, and uncover the mysteries of the Bacteria race. The game is inspired by Undertale, H

games.name: Oblin Party
games.summary: A wacky physics-based, couch/online party brawler where the hands do the talking. Utilize your elastic arms to wield powerful items, or swing, slingshot, grab, and punch to catapult your opponents off the map. Perfect for quick, hilarious multiplayer sessions with friends!

games.name: Captain Bones
games.summary: Captain Bones is an open world game about an ordinary crew member becoming a great pirate captain. To achieve this, he must first survive with what he has collected from the environment. Then, he must find himself a ship and a crew.

games.name: Dead Weight
games.summary: Challenge the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on the adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search for loot. Choose a class or create your own and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

games.name: Do No Harm
games.summary: A Doctor Simulator with a Lovecraftian twist. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

games.name: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain
games.summary: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain is a four-player co-op survival horror game centered on the supernatural "Yokai" from Japanese folklore. Trapped in a cursed domain, you and your companions must work together to endure the curse, hide from the terrifying Yokai, and find a way to escape.

games.name: Mini Golf Simulator
games.summary: A new style of mini golf game where you swing with the Joy-Con hanging down!

games.name: Rift of the NecroDancer
games.summary: The NecroDancer's back in a brand new rhythm game spinoff! Help Cadence navigate the modern world while repairing the rifts that have torn her life apart. Do rhythmic battle via rift mode, minigames, and boss battles! All to the beat of a brand new soundtrack from Danny Baranowsky & friends.

games.name: Besiege
games.summary: Besiege is a physics building game about constructing mechanical machines to annihilate armies, obliterate castles and overcome challenging obstacles. Conquer the campaign or skirmish with friends in Multiplayer!

games.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
games.summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

games.name: Aether Singularity
games.summary: Take on the role of a special agent and fight against digital demons from the Aethernet with your Daemon partner. Something's gone wrong in a prominent research facility, and you and your squad have been deployed to uncover the source of the demonic threat that's been unleashed. Destroy all demons!

games.name: Neon Village
games.summary: This game is a fusion of a "roguelike deck-builder" and "match-3 puzzle". Collect unique residents to create explosive synergies and develop a village glittering with neon!

games.name: The Magic Garden
games.summary: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various characters.By farming, collecting items, and using items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

games.name: Pup Champs
games.summary: A tactical puzzle game about leading a football team of cute dogs! Solve puzzles, score goals and become the champions!

games.name: Dalafri
games.summary: This title is a physics-based 3D sword fighting game. Players take on the role of a slightly flexible warrior and aim to become a champion in the arena.

games.name: Spy Drops
games.summary: Inspired by stealth action from the 90’s, undertake a series of covert ops to save the world from a global terrorist threat. Experience PS generation, 3D stealth action updated with modern effects, randomly generated levels, modern equipment, and head-to-head local multiplayer.

games.name: Re:Choice
games.summary:
"I told you, with you, we can start over!"
Choices that weren't available in the first playthrough become unlocked in the second. A time-loop adventure RPG where the story branches from the very beginning, depending on your decisions.

games.name: Rose & Camellia Collection
games.summary: The graceful, beautiful, and elegant slap battle of the historied Tsubakikoji ladies has emerged. Your swipe becomes the face slap to your foes!

games.name: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double
games.summary: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double is an immersive adventure game where you investigate urband legends in a modern city.

games.name: From Madness with Love
games.summary: This is a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with! For some reason, you just can't communicate with the guy you like... An unusual yet extraordinary experience with a cute pixel art style, fully voiced in Japanese.

games.name: Pocket Legend
games.summary: In Pocket Legend, a roguelike deck-builder, you control a hero transported to a world of legendary weapons. Strategically arrange items in your inventory to defeat enemies with unique attack patterns. Customize your setup, unlock powerful cards, and uncover the fate of the dark forces.

games.name: Kokoro Clover Sun: Prehistoric Invaders!
games.summary: The second installment in the 2000s era styled anime-themed Kokoro Clover series! A visual novel paired with boss battles! Our heroes' next adventure is in...dinosaur times?! This time the bad guys are trying to destroy the future! The only way to fight back is with dino-transformations!

games.name: Red Rocket Defencism
games.summary: You, a military officer from our great autocratic motherland, must protect our precious rockets from the evil capitalist enemy in this revolutionary base building strategy game. Bribe! Surveil! Purge! Imbibe! The end justifies the means when you have to protect our invaluable rockets!

games.name: Sultan's Game
games.summary: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

games.name: Mecha Force
games.summary: Mecha Force is an immersive and exciting VR experience that blends the thrill of mecha action with the unpredictability of a roguelike game. Players are transported to a world in turmoil, where they must defend against both internal and external threats as they take control of their very own mecha. This is no ordinary machine, however; the player is able to customize and personalize their mecha, choosing from a diverse range of artillery and melee weapons to create their own formidable war machine.

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: Sea Fantasy
games.summary: Save the world by fishing! This is a brand new action RPG game where you stand on an adventure to fish the SeaAZ, the marine life of this world, in a vast pixel world. This is not a peaceful fishing game. The destruction of the world is imminent....

games.name: Deserter
games.summary: In this stealth RPG, you play as a deserter who is forced to become a thief in a grim, war-torn town. You'll have access to a rich arsenal of tools and devices: from lock picks and crowbars to grappling hooks and dynamite. Additionally, take advantage of your surroundings: find or create alternate routes, stick to the shadows, stay quiet, or use loud noises to cause distraction.

games.name: Coneru: Dimension Girl
games.summary: Embark on a 2D action date with the dimension-girl, Coneru! This time, your date plan is to fend off the mysterious alien group "Hateful Fruit Company" invading Shinjuku City!

games.name: Rivals Hover League
games.summary: 'Rivals Hover League' is a vehicular combat PvP game where players battle in arenas across the galaxy using hover vehicles with various abilities. Join your teammates and show off your skills - hover, boost, shoot your way to become the MVP!

games.name: Shinonome Abyss: The Maiden Exorcist
games.summary: The main character is a shrine maiden named "Yono," who has to survive in a haunted houses where Mononoke (yokai and vengeful spirits) lurk, using a limited number of items and traps in this strategy roguelike horror action game!

games.name: The Headliners
games.summary: Co-op horror game where you play in teams of 1 to 4 reckless journalists, ready to explore a city overrun by deadly creatures to snap spectacular footage. Your only goal: make the headlines without becoming one.

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

games.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
games.summary: 'Marisa of Liartop Mountain' is an adventure-roleplaying game, where you, the player, will play as Reimu and explore a mountain of books filled with mysteries and lies in search of the whereabouts of the missing Marisa.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist. The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

games.name: Pull Stay
games.summary: Pull Stay is a wacky Beat 'em up game with Tower Defense mechanics. Use your fists or set crazy traps to repel enemies from rushing into your house! Defend your buddy Susumu, who goes out of his house only once in every two months for his haircut!

games.name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
games.summary: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.

games.name: Kemono Teatime
games.summary: Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. Come now and live out your bestest and cutest life—down to the last drop.

games.name: The World Well: Blood of Caro
games.summary: 814 R.E; the war is approaching. In Redimus, the chaotic world where magic, technology, slaves and vampires coexist, a young girl happens upon a magic gun that sets her on a journey of revenge. There is a burning manor behind her, and the road ahead disappears in the jungles of the night...

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Crafty Racer
games.summary: Stunt, push, and rush to the end! Win models and change anything as you want! Your tracks, vehicles, characters, checkpoints, opponents, ... anything!

games.name: The Guilty Hearts
games.summary: Seoyeon Yu, a former police officer, works as a private investigator for a rich family. However, during her investigation, she discovers evidence linking them to her husband's death. Using her ability to see people's guilt, she begins an investigation to solve the mystery.

games.name: Illusion Box
games.summary: "Illusion Box" is the first virtual reality entertainment project of the 21st century. However, malicious rumors and computer virus infections forced the company to shut down the project. Now, the long-abandoned "Illusion Box" devices are being reactivated...

games.name: Shizuku: Japanese myth
games.summary: "Shizuku : Japanese myth" is a 2D action game set in Japan. The fox girl can transform into various forms, and can take over not only the form of the target but also its abilities. There is no single answer, and the game can be played according to your style of play.

games.name: And Roger
games.summary: It was a morning like all others, until she realized her dad wasn't home. In his place, a stranger who speaks nonsense and insists she "takes her medicine". Who is he? Where is dad?

games.name: Rusty Road Racing
games.summary: A fun rally simulator focusing on car physics modeling, tire skidding, and suspension functionality! Full camera customization, recording, and sharing features! Incredible turns and jumps await drivers who are crazy enough!

games.name: Out of Hands
games.summary: Out of Hands is a card-based thriller that blends card battles, video collage and psychological horror. With nightmarish roguelike elements and live-action visuals made out of the real hands of the developer, the game provides an intriguing and spine-chilling experience that leads you to combat the mental struggles and retrieve the lost memory.

games.name: Detective Instinct: Farewell, My Beloved
games.summary: A woman vanishes without a trace on a cross-country train. The catch? Nobody on board remembers her ever existing in the first place - nobody, except for you. Uncover the story in this detective ADV/visual novel!

games.name: Pararecords
games.summary: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

games.name: Bokura
games.summary: Bokura is a puzzle adventure game for 2 players only. Each player will be two boys who have run away from home, and will work together to overcome the wall and aim for "somewhere far".

games.name: Luck be a Landlord
games.summary: Luck be a Landlord is a roguelike deckbuilder about using a slot machine to earn rent money and defeat capitalism. This game does not contain any real-world currency gambling or microtransactions.

games.name: Sigilfarer
games.summary: Sigilfarer is a roguelite adventure where every decision rests on the roll of your dice. Master a dice-building system while navigating a sprawling, procedurally generated world. Strategize your route, manage resources and push your luck to the limit!

games.name: Bladesong
games.summary: Crafting/management game Bladesong is set on taking swordmaking mechanics to a new level, featuring unparalleled customization of the sword's every detail and deep analysis of the sword's physical properties. Take the role of a swordsmith in the city of Eren Keep, one of mankind’s last standing cities after the gods have banished themselves in an act of desperation. Run your forge, fulfill customer commissions and perfect your craft and tools. Find your way in a city governed by an idolized ruler with an iron grip and build a loyal team of those you deem trustworthy.

games.name: Relic Guardian
games.summary: "Relic Guardian" is a fantasy-style strategy tower defense game. As the builder on the battlefield, summon a variety of defense towers and spells with reliable hero companions to complete this epic and guarding adventure!

games.name: 1001 Nights
games.summary: This is an AI-native game. Start a journey in the ancient Persian Empire as Shahrzad. Use magic to turn language into reality, collect unique weapons from the tales, and get revenge on the evil King! The fate of the world is yours to rewrite!

games.name: Yellow Trouble
games.summary: 8-way water gun blasting horizontal 2D arcade co-op shoot ‘em up, with ducks?!

games.name: Detective Dotson
games.summary: Chase down criminals, spy on bad guys and solve cases! Change into a disguise or recruit a team member - your choices matter! Enjoy multi-genre gameplay and watch thrilling episodes. Games and stories from the endlessly intriguing modern day India!

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Tales of Seikyu
games.summary: "Tales of Seikyu" is a fantasy farming sim game set in a lost fae land called Seikyu, inhabited by legendary creatures. However, the town is frequently threatened by the old gods' forces. As a new arrival, can you successfully manage the old inn entrusted to you by God Inari?

games.name: Idle Waters
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of the screen while you do other things. CATCH, COLLECT and DISPLAY fishes!

games.name: Every Day We Fight
games.summary: Caught in a time loop, your band of resistance fighters is humanity’s last hope. Real-time exploration meets turn-based tactics and roguelite strategy as you learn new abilities, seek out new weapons, and develop new techniques to overcome the mysterious alien threat.

games.name: Kill the Witch
games.summary: In an age when humanity gave up on happiness—just to escape unhappiness—and became nothing but bugs. This is the tale of a witch who grips her baseball bat tight... and smashes everything in her path.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Bang Bang Barrage
games.summary: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky top-down roguelike shooter! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!

games.name: Escape from Ever After
games.summary: When a greedy megacorp with the power to enter storybooks takes over Flynt Buckler’s fairytale world, he must get a job to sabotage them from within! Climb the corporate ladder, fight in stylish, snappy combat, and dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!

games.name: Vivid World
games.summary: A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, Vivid World is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Netherworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

games.name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

games.name: Cheese Moon
games.summary: Cheese Moon is an adventure game where cute rabbits explore the moon. Dig out the huge secret hidden on the back of the moon by fighting off aggressive cheeses, and machines with the words 'RTMK' written on them. Summon the rabbit clone to clear the stage. There are 5 worlds, 100 stages waiting.

games.name: Projected Dreams
games.summary: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

games.name: Virtual Cottage 2
games.summary: Virtual Cottage 2 motivates and supports you in tackling your daily tasks. Use its built-in productivity tool to accomplish your goals faster. Create your ultimate cozy space with a wide range of different furniture.

games.name: Needy Streamer Overload: Typing of The Net
games.summary: "Needy Streamer Overload: Typing of The Net" is a typing game in which you enter internet lingo in a call-and-response format with a girl (OMGkawaiiAngel) who has a strong need for approval.

games.name: Kimekyawa: Genkai Beat-chan
games.summary: Flatten cute monsters in a fun way!

games.name: Undergrounded
games.summary: “Undergrounded” is a puzzle adventure where you explore a dungeon formed by the accumulation of American history. Become Scott, who wandered underground in search of his lost engagement ring after failing to propose to his girlfriend, and plumb the depths of the past itself with your buddy Canary!

games.name: BatteryNote
games.summary: This is an adventure game. You, a mechanic, have picked up three robots from a scrapyard. You can select one of them and charge and converse with them within a time limit. How you treat them will change their reactions, and the ending of the game will change little by little along with their fate.

games.name: Steampunk Shinobi
games.summary: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

games.name: Pastel Parade
games.summary: Pastel☆Parade is an exhilarating rhythm game with easy controls! Get into the rhythm with cute and pop music!

games.name: Soulers
games.summary: Soulers is a Team-Building Twin-Stick Shooter. Assemble a team with time-slowing Protagonist and Colleagues with different abilities, and save the world from invasion of 'Glitch'.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
games.summary: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: The Irony
games.summary: You are a nameless mercenary, dispatched to the research facility 'UNDERDOG CORP.' Survive the horrors of this dangerous facility, twisted by human experimentation, and uncover the hidden secrets within before they consume you.

games.name: Ghostpia Season One
games.summary:
"Ghostpia" is a visual novel with cute visuals that look like a picture book, adorned with glitches and noise, and characterized by nostalgic expressions!

This game is a more expressive and interactive reimagining of the visual novel "Ghostpia" that has been released on the App Store and web platforms.

games.name: Needy Streamer Overload
games.summary: NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD is a “multi-ending ADV” depicting daily life with “OMGkawaiiAngel-chan”, a young girl with a rather extreme need for approval attempting to become the #1 “Internet Angel” (streamer).

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: The Mystery Mist
games.summary: In this world, deadly toxic mist is everywhere. The protagonist, Yaqing, becomes an apprentice to a physician skilled in using insects to save his sister, who has been poisoned by the mist. As the story progresses, he finds himself entangled in a tense racial conflict…

games.name: Outpost: Infinity Siege
games.summary: Command Mobile Outpost and take Protoslag Gun to venture deep into the Signet surveillance off-limit area where dangers lurk in the dark. Collect unique Weapon Units. Amp up the firepower of the Outpost that fights with you. This game is about TD, FPS, and RTS all at the same time.

games.name: Vivid Knight
games.summary: Vivid Knight is a roguelike adventure game in which you save your friends from being turned into jewels and combine their abilities to form the ultimate party! Explore an ever-changing dungeon and harness the jewels you collect to defeat the Black Witch!

games.name: Bloodless
games.summary: Stylish retro, action-adventure game featuring fast-paced combat centered around ronin Tomoe's signature dash-counter mechanic, fighting with nothing but her bare fists to disarm her former allies, the samurai army of Shogun Akechi.

games.name: Railbound
games.summary: A relaxing puzzle game about fixing train connections from the makers of Golf Peaks and inbento!

games.name: Angel at Dusk
games.summary: Profusely Genuine! Explosively Orthodox! Shoot, dodge, and destroy! A die-hard style, faithful return to the origin of top down shooters!

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary:
A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out.

Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

games.name: The Hungry Lamb: Traveling in the Late Ming Dynasty
games.summary: A travel text adventure game with Chinese traditional style. Player will escort four girls to Luoyang in order to discover the truth and make decisions along the way. This game involves themes of “Revenge, Cannibalism, etc.” the darker sides of life, but still expect to convey a positive emotion.

games.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost
games.summary: A rhythm game in which players can play popular arrangements of Touhou Project songs. A rebuild of "Touhou Danmaku Kagura" as a stand-alone version with a completely new storyline.

games.name: Alone A Long
games.summary: In a world where you are alone, you repeat your daily routine in a nonchalant and somewhat joyful manner. A simulation game to maintain civilization where the objective is to maintain civilization until the day when you can no longer move.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

games.name: Stars in the Trash
games.summary: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles. Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat decides to run away and seek adventure. Explore, make friends, fight, and escape from the kennelman.

games.name: Symphonia
games.summary: Awaken an expansive musical realm in this non-violent and poetic platformer. In Symphonia, you'll use the power of your violin coupled with your platforming skills to gather an orchestra to bring the musical machinery of the world back to life.

games.name: Mullet Madjack
games.summary: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… of your enemies!

games.name: Sunstone War
games.summary: Harness Aztec bracelets, defend your village! Unique tower defense with epic freedom & diverse enemies. Unleash the Sunstone power now!

games.name: Five Years Old Memories
games.summary: This is an interactive omnibus animation based on interviews with my friends about their memories around the age of five, based on their personal sensory memories and episodes.

games.name: Bit Esc
games.summary: Break free from the system in Bit Esc, an action/adventure platformer where Bit sets out to escape from the tyrannic OS. Explore the digital world, overcome frantic challenges, meet new friends and make tough decisions that’ll determine the fate of Bit and the world around them.

games.name: Sengoku Dynasty
games.summary: Sengoku Dynasty is the ultimate feudal Japan experience: build villages, grow your community, and shape the open world through combat or economy. The choice is yours alone - or that of up to 4 players in multiplayer co-op!

games.name: I Think
games.summary: One day, the programmer came up with an idea. If he could get AI to learn his diary, he could create himself in the electronic world.

games.name: Slime Nomi
games.summary: Slime Nomi is a platformer with creative ideas. Help Nomi collect potion ingredients and concoct witch Millie's extraordinary potion.

games.name: Dear Flower
games.summary: Dear Flower is a point and click adventure game. You can experience the story with hand-drawn animation and cutscenes.

games.name: Blade Chimera
games.summary: In this exploration-heavy 2D action game, use your demon sword to interfere with the past, create platforms, and shield yourself from danger to explore a dystopian cyberpunk world depicted in gorgeously animated pixel art.

games.name: Prolegomena to a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
games.summary: This is a fully voiced multi-ending adventure game that progresses by repeating a limited 3-minute dialogue time. Interactions primarily occur through an interface called "choices".

games.name: Multi Turret Academy
games.summary: Multi Turret Academy is a top-down tank shooter game where you serve as the commander of various WWII tanks to participate in tank battles.

games.name: Living Room
games.summary: "Living Room" is a mixed reality eco-sim for the Meta Quest 3, in which you can nurture a charming, interactive ecosystem. Enjoy the simple pleasures of tending to plants, caring for adorably derpy animals, and watching your environment flourish. This cozy experience is perfect for relaxing, and unwinding, while also offering a somewhat chaotic and delightful escape into nature's beauty right inside your living room.

games.name: Bober Bros: The Hole
games.summary: [Bober Bros] The Hole is a first-person horror game that puts you in the shoes of a paranoid recluse whose life takes a dark turn when a mysterious hole appears in his apartment. Through this ominous hole, anyone—or anything—could be watching him...

games.name: Shinehill
games.summary: Yet again they dumped the toughest job on you. Now you are on a Shinehill Island, where you suddenly replaced one of the new residents. Explore the world, meet charming townspeople, do farming, fishing, cooking and try not to reveal yourself.

games.name: The Worries of Santa Clauses
games.summary: They are somehow arrested when the police find them.

games.name: Kamitsubaki City Regenerate
games.summary: Answer the summons to the parallel world of "Kamitsubaki City" and meet a cast of colorful characters as you set out on a quest to save this city from the brink of destruction in this dark-fantasy sci-fi visual novel!

games.name: Kamitsubaki City Ensemble
games.summary: Kamitsubaki City Ensemble is a rhythm game in the world of destruction.

games.name: Girls Made Pudding
games.summary:
"When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear."

In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from. Follow them on the road as they find out the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Moonless Moon
games.summary: When night falls, she wanders into another world... Moonless Moon is a text-based adventure game following a girl as she travels through a variety of different worlds.

games.name: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad
games.summary: Live the life of a rookie paramedic through frantic minigame action and a wild, funny story. Juggle waves of patients with a battle-like triage system; master dozens of treatment minigames; and win the city's recognition from the rival fire department!

games.name: Slime Puzzle Story
games.summary: "Slime Puzzle Story" is a puzzle game in which you roll a slime. Move various items in addition to the slime to advance the story of humorous adventures in a mysterious village!

games.name: System Purge: Hollow Point
games.summary: Faced with a horrifying tragedy, you must delve into a flowering realm of memories and nightmares to save your dead lover. SYSTEM PURGE - Hollow Point is a massive expansion which adds a surreal new campaign, challenging new gamemodes, and more.

games.name: Yunyun Syndrome!?: Rhythm Psychosis
games.summary: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this world with your degen otaku-posting.

games.name: Bokura: Planet
games.summary: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

games.name: Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Party Dash
games.summary: Give heed! Our academy's time-honored Spring Fan Fest will play to a very special event! Behold, the Slapdash Grand Prix! Teams will compete in four exhilarating events! Aim for ultimate glory in Hurtling Hurdles, Blazing Baskets, Dodgeball Demolitions, and Gourmet Gauntlet!

games.name: IF: Imaginary Friends
games.summary: The main character, a young boy named Croqui, is reunited with the imaginary friends he created in his infancy due to a mental regression caused by the birth of his younger sister. Fearing that he will be forgotten again, the friends try to trap him in their imaginary world by playing games with him! You are Croqui and you will win the game with your friends. An adventure game with an atmosphere like a picture book or a painting, featuring unique imaginary friends.

games.name: Arc Seed
games.summary: Face the interstellar Archangels in a turn-based tactical game with deckbuilding elements and destructible environment, where you pilot powerful mechs to save the Earth from destruction.

games.name: Everholm
games.summary: Lilly was spirited away to a mysterious island. As her memories fade, everyone seems to know about her quest for her missing sister. It's time to establish a homestead, meet the islanders, learn their secrets and solve the mystery of Everholm in this open-ended minimalist RPG!

games.name: 30 Birds
games.summary:
Experience a seamless blend of 2D and 3D in this mesmerizing narrative adventure, with hand-drawn visuals inspired by Persian miniatures. Wander through the gorgeous neighborhoods of Lantern City while enjoying a ska - dub - reggae inspired soundtrack and help Zig gather thirty charismatic and chatty birds to save Simurgh! But beware, you might come across puzzling challenges on your way…

Discover a gorgeous universe laid out on the surface of rotating lanterns. Wander through a beautiful city inspired by Middle Eastern legends, meeting the local goofs, quirky djinns, and regular weirdos along the way. Solve puzzles and interesting challenges to help Zig rescue Simurgh!

games.name: Lamentations
games.summary: You and your teammates are part of an elite undercover unit tasked with finding out information on a mysterious complex known as "the backrooms". Explore various locations, solve puzzles, check your six, and escape with your life!

games.name: All You Need is Help
games.summary:
Dive into a quirky multiplayer co-op puzzle game where adorable, fluffy cube-shaped creatures collaborate to reach their goals. These creatures, each oddly shaped, jostle against each other to help solve puzzles together. When in trouble, shout "HELP!" and friends will surely come to your aid. With everyone's strength, turn friendships into friend-shapes!

The game's intuitive, straightforward controls mean that anyone can jump right in. You'll control creatures that are shaped differently as you progress through each level, to clear challenges. Although these creatures can move around freely, they cannot rotate, necessitating the need for teamwork to solve the puzzles. Join forces to overcome obstacles and reach your goals together!

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: The Devil Within: Satgat
games.summary: The Devil Within: Satgat is a 2.5D stylish action adventure that follows the journey of an Eastern warrior infected with demonic blood. Dig into the secrets of a ruined world while taking down enemies in stylish action sequences.

games.name: Electrogical
games.summary: "Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic" is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging "piece placement," "number manipulation," and "score selection" to aim for a high score in each stage.

games.name: Jelly Troops
games.summary: An online action RTS where the tide can turn in a flash! Fight exciting battles where you recruit golems to battle your opponent’s slimes, cleverly redirect their slimes with walls, or sneakily steal their flag to make a dramatic comeback.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.summary: Buckshot Roulette is an indie tabletop horror game that reimagines Russian roulette using a pump-action shotgun instead of a revolver. The player faces off against a computer-controlled opponent called "The Dealer" across three rounds, with consumable items introduced in later rounds that add strategic depth. The game features a single-player campaign and a multiplayer mode for up to four players.

games.name: The Fox's Way Home
games.summary: Before you know it, you find yourself in the realm between the hidden world and the real world. Rely on the guidance of the Fox shrine Maiden who lives there, and escape from the otherworld!

games.name: Novice Dungeon Master
games.summary: [Novice Dungeon Master] is a dungeon management simulation set in a fantasy world of dungeons and adventures. Turn your beginner dungeon into the ultimate dungeon of your dreams. Greet adventurers who come to visit your dungeon, grow herbs, summon monsters, and more!

games.name: Vampire Hunters
games.summary: Create absurd builds by stacking up weapons and raining down crazy firepower on vampires and demons in this rogue-lite retro FPS. Can you be known as the most outrageous Vampire Hunter in all of Transylvania?

games.name: The Strongest Tofu
games.summary: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.

games.name: Zompizza
games.summary: Manage a pizzeria in the zombie apocalypse world and deliver delicious pizzas to survivors!

games.name: Brave and Desire
games.summary: Brave and Desire is a party battle roguelite RPG with a structure and events that change every time you start! Advance through the dungeon using a route selection system and aim to step through the innermost part of the dungeon!

games.name: Gregory Horror Show Soul of Roses
games.summary: Soul of Roses is a 2D rogue light action game. Absorb the abilities of your enemies, fight, die, revive, and repeat to advance the story.

games.name: KKCKC
games.summary: Become a Keyboard Key Character and become a Keyboard warrior who fights with 53 Keyboard Keys! 'KKCKC' is an action roguelike game that uses only the Keyboard to kill enemies! Survive your stronger enemies and pay back your colleagues' grudges!

games.name: Boyhood's End
games.summary: Boyhood's End is an adventure game following Giovanni, the boy with the lowest human score in the universe, and Campanella, the delinquent genius, and their journey on the galactic railroad regarding the "human" and "inhuman".

events.name: Black Voices in Games 2024 Winter Edition
events.description: For Game Awards week, Black Voices in Gaming will feature some amazing developer spotlights and new interviews!

games.name: Shiny Gauntlet
games.summary: Chase the Cultist. Reclaim the Shard!

games.name: She Dreams Elsewhere
games.summary: She Dreams Elsewhere is a surreal adventure RPG about dreams and the extent to which they mirror reality. You play as Thalia, an anxiety-ridden, comatose woman on a journey to defeat the nightmares preventing her from awakening, while also finding out how exactly this mess happened in the first place.

games.name: Grimm & Tonic
games.summary: Maintaining a healthy Work-Life balance is pretty tricky on a good day but it’s damn near impossible when your boss threatens foreclosure on your mortal existence. As the new bartender at DEAD-END, you’ll make new friends, mix weird drinks, all while navigating Life, Death and everything in between.

games.name: Super Space Club
games.summary: In Super Space Club, journey alongside a group of anthropomorphic heroes as they set out to be the top-ranked defenders of the galaxy. You'll take on various missions, partake in several space dogfights, and jam out to lo-fi beats in this chill, arcade-style shooter.

games.name: Advent Neon
games.summary: Hyperactive 2D action platformer with wicked fast attacks, omnidirectional dashing, and time-freezing! Play well enough to transform and unleash 100% power!

games.name: 5 Force Fighters
games.summary: 5 Force Fighters is a 2D fighting game with a cast of unstoppable characters, and a combat system that boasts universal offensive and defensive options. Unravel the story of 5 teens blessed with elemental powers, but cursed with scarred pasts that have led them to a common, but destructive, goal.

games.name: On the Peril of Parrots
games.summary: Explore the line between machine and personhood, in this Puzzle Narrative experience. Take on the role of an AI, created by the world renowned, Dr. G. Step through a battery of cognition tests and prove your intelligence, sentience and ultimately your humanity.

games.name: RollerGirl
games.summary: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

games.name: Sunken Stones
games.summary: A turn based Puzzle-Strategy game about pirates and cursed treasure. Choose a captain, gather your crew and defeat monsters by strategically placing units on a 5x5 grid.

games.name: Ourlands
games.summary: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

games.name: Daycare Dungeon
games.summary: Dungeon Crawler is an upcoming roguelite, hack n' slash, platformer puzzle game. Makhoba discusses how Dungeon Crawler's imagination mechanic works, the inspiration behind the game's creation, and more.

events.name: Slitherine Next 2024
events.description: The event will showcase key reveals, trailers, and announcements for some of our most popular franchises, including a look at the future of Starship Troopers: Terran Command, Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector, Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance, and Broken Arrow. In addition to these exciting updates, we’ll have a major surprise announcement that will be revealed live during the event.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
games.summary: In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war. Experience every bone-rattling explosion and soul-crushing charge in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector, the definitve battle-scale game of turn-based strategy and fast-paced combat that takes you to the battlefields of the 41st Millenium.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector - Astra Militarum
games.summary:
For the Emperor!

Astra Militarum, the backbone of the Imperium’s might, are ready to fight in Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector. Sixteen new units are available to defend and fight for the Emperor.

games.name: RuneQuest: Warlords
games.summary: RuneQuest: Warlords is a battle-scale turn-based strategy game set in the Runequest universe. Immerse yourself in the rich lore of Glorantha. Become a warlord, master the use of runes and defend your tribe against the incursions of Chaos. Field an army drawing from heroes and creatures.

games.name: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: We are Legion
games.summary:
We Are Legion is the first DLC for Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance, a gritty real-time strategy game set in the intense universe of Terminator: Dark Fate.

It plunges players back into the heart of the conflict as they take command of Legion, the relentless machine army fighting to dominate a shattered world. This DLC expands on the story, focusing on Legion’s mission to eradicate human resistance and assert dominance over a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Ultima Founding
games.summary: The Primaris are ready to step in the battle for the God Emperor and the Holy Throne. Eight new units and unique gameplay mechanics will give you more options for the fight for Gladius Prime.

games.name: Starship Troopers: Terran Command
games.summary: Starship Troopers: Terran Command is a thrilling real-time strategy game set in the Starship Troopers movies universe. Take command of the Mobile Infantry and do your part in the war against the Arachnid threat. Ensure that human civilization, not insect, dominates the galaxy now and always!

games.name: Broken Arrow
games.summary: Broken Arrow is a large-scale real-time modern warfare tactics game. The base game features both the American and Russian factions, more than 100 units and multiple deck specialisations per nation. Broken Arrow brings the genre to a whole new level by combining the complexity of a joint-forces wargame with the typical real-time tactics action-packed gameplay.

events.name: Wholesome Snack: The Game Awards Edition 2024
events.description: Our last showcase of the year, Wholesome Snack: ‪@thegameawards‬ Edition will premiere live on December 10th at 12pm PT / 3pm ET! Get ready for over 20 games, almost half of which are WORLD PREMIERE announcements you'll see here for the very first time.

games.name: Sky: Children of the Light
games.summary:
"Embark on an unforgettable social adventure and an ever-expanding world.

Sky: Children of the Light is a heartwarming and beautifully animated social adventure experience designed to be played together by you and your loved ones.

Set in a wonderland above the clouds, Sky invites you and your friends to fly up to explore the buried mysteries together and rebuild a fallen kingdom for its ancient inhabitants. Using your courage and compassion, players must connect as a community to share and build on their flame to spread light back into the world."

games.name: Despelote
games.summary: Despelote is a soccer game about people. Get immersed in the streets and parks of Quito through the eyes and ears of eight year old Julián. Dribble, pass and shoot your soccer ball around town, and see what happens when you kick it someone's way. Feel the city change as Ecuador comes closer than ever to qualifying for the World Cup.

games.name: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To
games.summary: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To is an action-puzzle game set in a lush, narrative-driven world of witchy demons. Cast spells, be queer, & crash the biggest concert of the year!

games.name: Naiad
games.summary: A relaxing and colorful exploration adventure about flowing by a river. Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful exploration adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. A very personal and unique game created with love by a solo dev.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Tales of Seikyu
games.summary: "Tales of Seikyu" is a fantasy farming sim game set in a lost fae land called Seikyu, inhabited by legendary creatures. However, the town is frequently threatened by the old gods' forces. As a new arrival, can you successfully manage the old inn entrusted to you by God Inari?

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Rusty's Retirement
games.summary: Rusty's Retirement is an idle-farming simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your farm.

games.name: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
games.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

games.name: Pine: A Story of Loss
games.summary: Alone in the forest glade he shared with his wife, a woodworker struggles to accept her passing. Help him hold on to cherished memories of their life together as he struggles to care for himself and his now empty home. Pine is a single-serving game focused on telling a beautiful, emotional tale.

games.name: Aikyam
games.summary: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.summary: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

games.name: Star Birds
games.summary: Star Birds is a cheerful asteroid base-building and resource management game. Discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks and guide your colony of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons!

games.name: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley - Fuddler's Courtship
games.summary: In this heartfelt novella-like story of romance, newfound friend Fuddler needs a helping hand to express his feelings.

games.name: River Towns
games.summary: Solve puzzles by placing buildings and creating vibrant cities in River Towns. Each district has its own style and shapes, making every level a new challenge. Help to restore and rebuild our River Towns.

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: Piece by Piece
games.summary: It's time to open shop! Inherit your family's repair shop, and roll up your sleeves. Fix up the prized possessions of the forest folk, paint yourself a masterpiece to sell and make your family shop all your own with decorations, furniture and cookies!

games.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.summary: When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

games.name: Little Rocket Lab
games.summary: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

games.name: Locomoto
games.summary: Locomoto is a cozy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

games.name: A Waddleful Life
games.summary: A sweet little game where you play as a duck and raise ducklings.

games.name: Pinbleton Park
games.summary: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

games.name: Wylde Society
games.summary: Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

events.name: Flow Games Awards 2024
events.description: The third edition of our gaming awards, FLOW GAMES AWARDS 2024, to celebrate the greatest games, great moments, and all the best that happened in 2024. Who will win the GOTY? Are there any surprises? Our community has also chosen its favorite moments in this vote!

games.name: No Heroes Here 2
games.summary: A group of non-adventurers is the last hope in defending the castle in this co-op roguelite chaotic game. Organize your castle, purchase new items each day, work as a team to craft ammo, and shoot at enemies to protect your kingdom. Just because you’re no hero doesn’t mean you can’t save the day!

games.name: Saborus
games.summary: Saborus, a gripping horror adventure! Guide the brave chicken, through a deadly slaughterhouse. Solve chilling puzzles and face relentless pursuit. Can you survive?

games.name: Holy Shot
games.summary: Holy Shot is a fast-paced, physics-based top-down shooter. Face nasty hordes of monsters in a chaotic environmental destruction, combining powerful weapons and strategic abilities to survive intense battles against challenging bosses.

games.name: Mark of the Deep
games.summary: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey as the fierce Marcus "Rookie" Ramsey and explore the mysteries of a cursed island to find your missing pirate crew.

games.name: Kaardik
games.summary: Join the exciting world of Kaardik, a creature collection game. Embark on exciting adventures with your Kaardiks in the fascinating region of Kodumaa. Capture all the Kaardiks, battle with other trainers, and beat the king.

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Bagdex
games.summary: The journey begins! Collect over 160 creatures inspired by Brazilian culture, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

games.name: Rabbit's Fall
games.summary: It will be a journey from scratch where you'll need to tend to your farm with a lot of hard work while striving on a mission to reestablish the city's guild for gaining recognition and respect.

games.name: Extinction Rifts
games.summary: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

games.name: Asleep: Act 2
games.summary: Upon mysteriously waking up on the outskirts of a small village, Ana Lúcia continues her journey in search of answers in a supposedly peaceful new environment but soon experiences suspicious events forcing her to face even more intense and disturbing dangers. The nightmare continues.

events.name: Latin American Games Showcase: The Game Awards Edition
events.description: Get ready for over an hour long show highlighting 50+ of the best games developed in Latin America!

games.name: Gaucho and the Grassland
games.summary: Gaucho and the Grassland is an Animal Farm Sim game where you need to gather resources, explore the land, breed animals and much more, to overcome the challenging life on the grasslands. The world of Gaucho is a mystical wildland, inspired by South Brazil's culture and its local tales.

games.name: Idle Waters
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of the screen while you do other things. CATCH, COLLECT and DISPLAY fishes!

games.name: Cold VR
games.summary: COLD VR It's the non-stop VR experience. With its twisting mechanics, this game will turn you into an unstoppable machine as you adapt and overcome challenges in each level, you are in control of time. Every time you stop, time flows; you move, it slows down. So, keep on moving!

games.name: Travel On, Pigeon!
games.summary: This is a puzzle-rhythm game about a tourist pigeon having a good time, with engaging challenges you can take at your own pace. Stroll through cute and nostalgic places and get with the flow in this chill and charming experience.

games.name: Storyteller
games.summary: With Storyteller you are the one writing the stories! Start with a title, characters and settings and create your own twist on stories familiar and new.

games.name: Spaceman Memories
games.summary: Spaceman Memories is a retro JRPG that takes place in a distant future but draws inspiration from ancient Japanese folktales. A story full of wonder and nostalgia as you take on the role of Ichiro 94, an astronaut who wakes up from hypersleep to go on a journey to find the remnants of his past.

games.name: Kentum
games.summary: Stranded in the year 10,000, Kent—an average Joe turned clone—must survive, explore, and rebuild civilization with the help of a snarky AI. Craft, farm, and automate in this 2D craftervania adventure as you uncover Earth’s secrets and kickstart humanity, one machine at a time.

games.name: Sopa: Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.summary: Emotional narrative adventure about the things we pass along. Inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and The Little Prince.

games.name: Prisma
games.summary: This is the story of Alma, a girl that receives strange powers from an old Camera containing a magical Prism Shard, and is transported to another world alongside other Almas from different universes. Each Alma will have their own Prism Shard, and a unique vision of the world, some will be friends, other enemies and some NPCs.Bring together a party of Almas, open new quests and combos by bonding with them, and unlock different routes to prevent the reality to break.

games.name: Wander Stars
