games.summary: A Webbing Journey is a physics-based sandbox game where you play as a cute little spider. Explore a giant house, create crazy web structures, and complete oversized chores in creative and fun ways.

games.name: The Land Beneath Us
games.summary: The Land Beneath Us is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Defeat the Seven Lords and rescue The Creator and her vital Soul-Tech.

games.name: Bambas!
games.summary: Relive your childhood and turn every crosswalk, curb, and puddle into an epic adventure with this innovative urban walking simulator.

games.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Cozy Kitchen
games.summary: Step into a fresh new corner of Spirit City's room with the Cozy Kitchen DLC! This feast of a DLC expands your Spirit City experience with a brand-new kitchen area. New items, spirits and activities await!

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Catto's Post Office
games.summary: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting new and old friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents.

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Été
games.summary: Fill a blank canvas with ink and photograph alongside Marianne, an ambitious young filmmaker, and Théo, a charming musician. Explore a maze of intimate moments by using memory itself to navigate an immersive, open world.

games.name: Memory Lost
games.summary: MemoryLost is an action shooter, the battles in which are built around the mechanics of mind capturing and moving into the enemy's body. First-aid kits were not delivered, there is only one clip in the weapon - change the bodies to survive!

games.name: The Night is Grey
games.summary: A cinematic thriller told through the classic perspective of point & click adventure games. The Night is Grey is about modern storytelling fused together with hand-drawn animated characters, fully animated backgrounds and an original studio recorded music score.

games.name: Homecall
games.summary: Horror-ambiance in low-poly. Open-ended exploration, investigation, hidden items, interesting puzzles and intriguing dark storyline.

games.name: Two Falls: Nishu Takuashina
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the harsh wilderness of 17th century Canada through the eyes of Maikan, a young Innu, and Jeanne, a French woman who crossed the Atlantic to start a new life. Decide how the characters will survive, and watch the impact of your choices unfold in this coming-of-age story!

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

games.name: Eat the Rich
games.summary: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
games.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

games.name: Sang: The Desert Blade
games.summary: Sang: The Desert Blade is a Souls-like Action RPG, inspired by Dark Souls and The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past, where you explore, fight, overcome challenges and defeat terrifying bosses in the unforgiving world of Zemsluna. Follow the story of Sang as she looks for her long lost kin.

games.name: Max Mustard
games.summary: Max Mustard is a made-for-VR platformer with 40 unique levels, 4 ridiculous bosses and 8 powerful upgrades. No boring bits! It’s the perfect combination of first-person power-ups and classic third-person platforming. This is a VR platformer you’ll find impossible to put down.

games.name: Battle Shapers
games.summary: Battle Shapers is a blazing-fast, sci-fi FPS roguelite in which you shoot and smash your way through swarms of corrupt robots. Wield powerful weapons, abilities and game-changing new powers stolen from ruthless Overlords to bring New Elysium back to the utopia it once was.

games.name: Le Fol
games.summary: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

games.name: Spiral
games.summary: Spiral is a third-person narratively driven exploration game sharing a poetic vision of cognitive degeneration seen from the inside. It tells the story of Bernard, a man who wishes goodbye one last time to the memories that built him from his early childhood to who he is today.

games.name: Voron: Raven's Story
games.summary: In this story-driven adventure, you are the raven from the pages of Norse legends. Fly, explore an open world, uncover its secrets, solve puzzles, save souls, and help your family. Caw!

games.name: Bapbap
games.summary: Join BAPBAP, the Roguelike Party game where no two matches are ever the same. Round up your homies, pick a character, and build a giga-unfair build that'll make them hate you - then do it all over again!

games.name: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi
games.summary: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi is a fantasy adventure game where a sword–wielding Guardian and an arcane Monk must learn to work together to defeat the Void corrupting their home. Explore ruined temples, solve environmental puzzles, rescue spirits, and defeat giant Void monsters!

games.name: Paper Perjury
games.summary:
Investigating a simple robbery reveals a tapestry of mysteries!

Solve a series of cases as newly hired police clerk Justina Smith and find out the truth behind a string of suspicious crimes. Work with the energetic detective Ernest Hunt and dig for clues in the paper trail to discover the secrets that paperwork can hide.

games.name: Reviver
games.summary: A narrative puzzle game with themes of love, fate and time. Follow the life stories of the two main characters and influence their destinies through interactions and choices. The game combines hand-drawn style and an immersive interactive experience to explore a profound journey of love and choice.

games.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
games.summary: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cute building strategy game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

games.name: Island of Winds
games.summary:
Island of Winds takes you to 17th century Iceland, plunging them into a magical world teeming with trolls, giant spiders, and mythical creatures. Experience all of this through the eyes of the magic-wielding Brynhild, a member of the Balance Keepers who draws her magical power from the natural world.

Brynhild's journey has her on a quest to find her mentor, Hrymja, that will take her through nine incredible landscapes that draw on Iceland's stunning natural beauty. These locations range from the fiery Lava of Skjól to the treacherous Jökla lagoon and gleaming Obsidian Shore. Brynhild will face legendary creatures on her journey, such as the powerful and majestic Bear King, Hafgúfa - Guardian of the Sea and the majestic elven lady Vör of the Oasis.

games.name: As We Descend
games.summary: The roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Recruit, upgrade, and deploy your forces in tactical battles against corrupt creatures. Make hard decisions in humanity’s final city to bolster your odds. Will you break the cycle of endless descent?

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: Stars in the Trash
games.summary: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles. Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat decides to run away and seek adventure. Explore, make friends, fight, and escape from the kennelman.

games.name: Temtem: Swarm
games.summary:
Dive in solo or team up with other players online to face relentless Swarms! Level up fast, and unleash ridiculous synergies in a vibrant world full of familiar creatures and flashy upgrades. Temtem: Swarm blends the chaotic fun of survivor-likes with Temtem’s signature strategy.

Each hand-crafted stage throws tougher challenges your way. Test your timing and teamwork against mini-bosses, massive Tems like Tyranak and Galios, and their screen-filling attacks! Use matchmaking or bring friends and coordinate Gears, Traits, and Ultimates to wipe the map clean. Or don't coordinate at all and just vibe through the chaos, we won’t judge.

Defeat enemies to level up, unlock wild new abilities, and evolve your Tems mid-run to turn the tide. Even if you go down, Ghost Mode lets you support the squad until they can revive you. Collect and master unique Tems, their Luma and Umbra variants, and pack every run with fresh combos, evolving strategies, and just the right amount of bullet heaven mayhem!

games.name: Glasshouse
games.summary: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

games.name: Ambroise Niflette & the Gleaned Bell
games.summary: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

games.name: Berserk Boy
games.summary: Berserk Boy is a vibrant, retro 2D action platformer that lets you… GO BERSERK! Change into different forms and use the power of Lightning, Fire, Earth, Air, and Ice as you race through stylish stages in a heroic battle to save the planet from the evil Dr. Genos!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
games.summary: Study, relax, or get productive in the cozy world of Spirit City. Set the mood with lofi beats and soundscapes, customize your character and spirit pet, and use the productivity tools to help you stay on task. All while discovering cute hidden spirits and adding them to your spirit collection.

games.name: Rune Fencer Illyia
games.summary: Rune Fencer Illyia is an intense, atmospheric action-platformer with a heavy focus on exploration and combat. Traverse an enormous and dangerous world, meet strange allies, and outfight your numerous foes with fast-paced swordplay and stolen runic magic.

games.name: Die in the Dungeon
games.summary: Fight your way through a mysterious dungeon in this deck-building, turn-based roguelike where you don't use cards, but dice! Deal with enemies by combining powerful dice on your board, boost their effects with magical relics, and risk it all hoping for a good roll on unexpected encounters.

games.name: Threshold
games.summary: Threshold is a short, dark and atmospheric First Person Exploration game picturing disturbing facts about an untold brutal story. Pick your country, start your shift and try to save the world with the help of your precious bucket, some Air Cans and a bunch of planks.

games.name: Mythwrecked: Ambrosia Island
games.summary: You’re shipwrecked on a lost mythical island. As backpacker Alex, you must befriend the forgotten gods of Greek mythology and restore their memories. Explore the dynamic island and its story sandbox to build new friendships, solve the mystery and save the gods.

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
games.summary: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

games.name: Solarpunk
games.summary:
Solarpunk is a survival game in a technically advanced world of floating islands. Alone or together with your friends, you can construct buildings, grow food, craft gadgets and explore distant islands with your own airship.

Use sunlight, wind and water to create an energy system and automate your processes like gathering ressoureces, watering your plants or catching fish.

games.name: Kaiserpunk
games.summary: Build and conquer in Kaiserpunk, the ultimate city builder and grand strategy combo set in an alternative 20th century world. Engage in epic battles on land, sea, and air, or use your economic power to emerge as the ultimate victor.

games.name: Airframe Ultra
games.summary:
Welcome to the violent underground world of Ultra Circuit racing.

From the cracked asphalt of San Juaro and the Ysidro edgelands to the hulking megacities of the Texicali Zego zone, Airframe riders from all across the Southlands compete for fame, fortune, and a chance at glory… three feet above or six feet below.

games.name: Button Man
games.summary: Button Man is a side-scrolling adventure game set in a fictional Nova Scotia during prohibition. After years of being the henchmen to the local bootlegging kingpin your job now is to find who killed him and protect the town from what’s coming to it. Explore Kingsport and learn the truth!

games.name: Garden Trills
games.summary:
Explore floating gardens as Tomi, a tiny sparrow. Grow magical plants, meet other birds and get your wings dirty together to cultivate beautiful places for you to peacefully fly around and discover all their secrets.

Garden Trills is a cozy adventure game about exploring whimsical gardens and befriending a charming cast of tiny birds.

games.name: Mirage Noir
games.summary: Play as a detective, solve cases, and try to catch an elusive serial killer in this mystery visual novel focused on found family

games.name: Reality Drift
games.summary: Reality Drift is a roguelike racing game where your choices matter. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades for your car and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

games.name: The Holy Gosh Darn
games.summary: The Holy Gosh Darn is a narrative adventure with a time-travelling twist. Time travel to jump between the past and present across Heaven, Hell, Earth and Helheim. Uncover information in one timeline to alter things in another in a bid to stop your universe from going bang. Again.

games.name: Towerful Defense
games.summary: A roguelike tower defense where you control a single tower to fight against hordes of aliens coming from all directions. Pick your tower, equip up to 4 skills, and choose from a variety of traits and unique effect items to craft powerful builds that lead you to victory.

games.name: Psychroma
games.summary: Psychroma is a narrative-driven side-scroller where you play as a digital medium. Confront the past by piecing together the broken memories of a cybernetic house, and exorcise the ghosts in the machine.

games.name: Don't Stop, Girlypop!
games.summary: Spread the love! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option.

games.name: Stuntboost
games.summary: Race against time on tracks of cardboard and toys to break records, climb leaderboards and become the fastest skater your online-neighborhood has ever seen!

games.name: Promise Mascot Agency
games.summary: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

games.name: Legends of the Round Table
games.summary: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

games.name: Weldiver
games.summary:
Each mission in Weldiver is a journey into the ocean’s depths, where players undertake the challenging work of maintaining offshore structures, performing emergency repairs, and replacing seabed infrastructure like optical cables, pipelines, and power lines.

Forty times more likely to die than the average worker... and every time I go down, the pressure waits. Trying to make me implode, drown, freeze... or worse.

games.name: Nubs! Arena
games.summary: Slap yourself into the absurdity of Nubs, where 5-player battles are as chaotic as they are quick! Risk it all for the mighty Konzumos' delight in this arena brawler and smash the others to nublivion in your quest for glory! Simple rules? Check. Roguelite progression? Sure. Predictability? No way!

games.name: Collector's Cove
games.summary: All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector!

games.name: Bullets & Brains
games.summary: Bullets and Brains is an adrenaline-pumping arcade top-down 3D shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by brain-hungry hordes of zombies. Prepare yourself for an intense battle against the never-ending onslaught of the undead.

games.name: Super Animal Royale
games.summary: Select your favorite adorably murderous fox, panda, or sloth and parachute into a furocious 64-player battle arena. Explore a top-down 2D world, full of exotic biomes, psychotic animals, hamster balls, emus and much more. Wield pistols, snipers, miniguns, explosives, and silly dances on your way to the top of the food chain.

games.name: Magenta Horizon: Neverending Harvest
games.summary: Magenta Horizon is a fast-paced 2D action platformer game that is heavily inspired by the Spectacle Fighter genre. Playing as a Reaper of the twisted purgatorial afterlife, push your skills to the limit to destroy the hordes of demons and epic bosses to reach your destination.

games.name: Devilated
games.summary: Devilated is a timeslowing, monster blasting, boomer shooter with RPG pretensions, buckets of blood and a dose of ultraviolence.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Golf by the Way
games.summary: A fast-paced real-time mini-golf party game with no stroke count! Play as an actual golfer in real-time and go smack your friends’ golf ball or even your friends themselves.

games.name: Strand
games.summary: Step into the desolate void of a high-tech space station in STRAND. Face mind-bending puzzles to escape an infinite time loop while uncovering the fate of your crew. Every detail matters as you unravel the mystery and question humanity’s role in the vast, unforgiving universe.

games.name: Starless Abyss
games.summary: Earth has fallen. Science and the Occult have united forces to brace for the arrival of the Eldritch. But will the efforts against this strange, alien race be enough? Play as one of many Proximae used to help defend humanity in this turn-based, roguelike, intergalactic deck builder.

games.name: Leila
games.summary: Enter the world of an everyday woman as you explore her past in this point & click narrative game. Hand-drawn animations bring her memories to life, and thought-provoking puzzles lay bare the reasons behind her choices. Immerse yourself in a story unfolds as you decipher its intricate pieces.

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: Relic Hunters Legend
games.summary: Fast. Fluid. Fun. An online cooperative Shooter/Looter/RPG. Gather up to 4 friends, gear up, and save the Galaxy from a terrible villain who has stolen the past!

games.name: Katanaut
games.summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

games.name: Fruitbus
games.summary: Fruitbus is a cute culinary adventure, set in an open world where taste is everything. Upgrade your trusty truck and visit a whole world of new destinations together.

games.name: Wild Tactics
games.summary: The Wildest character-driven tactical strategy game you've ever seen! Build your team and maintain their relationships in the war against organized crime. Uncover the conspiracy in the animal-populated city of Clawville, and find the mastermind behind its downfall!

games.name: Awaken: Astral Blade
games.summary: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, Loretta, a girl who has parasitized by an alien beast, tries to break through the fog and uncover the truth about her fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest place?

games.name: Crab God
games.summary: Crab God is an atmospheric underwater god game where you must restore the environment to sustain your children. Build beautiful coral reefs, grow your crabby religion, and explore a hostile yet beautiful ocean world. Can you protect your children and raise the next generation of ocean guardians?

games.name: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon
games.summary: Ultimate Sheep Raccoon is a bike-racing party game where you and your friends build the course together. Add obstacles and dangerous traps, take the lead with power-ups, and race to the finish!

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

events.name: The Horror Game Awards 2024
events.description: Join ‪@HorrorGameCentral_‬, ‪@AKblackandredYT‬ and ‪@ash.millman‬ for the 2024 Horror Game Awards. Celebrating the best in horror gaming from this year and looking forward to the next.

games.name: Juice
games.summary: Enjoy the binge of a ravenous Monster vs the last stand of a lone survivor in this dual narrative fps about the end of the world!

games.name: Ground Zero
games.summary: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

games.name: Beneath
games.summary: Plunge into a treacherous and enigmatic underwater world and brace yourself to confront the heart-stopping horrors that await as you fight against all odds.

games.name: Animal Use Protocol
games.summary: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

games.name: Vile: Exhumed
games.summary: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

games.name: Nightmare Operator
games.summary: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

games.name: Who Are You!?
games.summary: Who Are You!? is a sci-fi psychological horror experience based on real UFO research. The story centers on Ray Roswell and his internal fight to understand the disappearance of his wife, which may involve an alien abduction.

games.name: Asylum
games.summary: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

games.name: Soul Devourer
games.summary: Soul Devourer is a metroidvania action-platformer with a classic 2D horror style. You'll explore the vast, cursed Sakuradoki High School, master unique abilities, fight twisted monsters and uncover the long-buried secrets concealed under the school.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: Dead of Darkness
games.summary: Dead of Darkness is a 2D survival-horror action-adventure. Investigate a missing persons case on Velvet Island and unravel its disturbing secret. You’ll have to face grotesque creatures, hurdle deadly traps, solve puzzles, and most importantly, survive.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: Deprision is a psychological horror game that delivers an immersive and terrifying AAA experience. Survive human madness, amnesia's power, and navigate parallel worlds via a deadly virus. Solve your world's problem, survive, prevent more deaths, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Demon King
games.summary: Venture through the Labyrinth Of The Demon King, solving puzzles and fighting fearsome monsters in an epic quest to track down the demon who betrayed your lord and end it’s life.

games.name: Feed The Pit
games.summary: JOIN THE SOCIETY. Avoid unpredictable horrors that will pursue you relentlessly. Perform rituals in a haunted forest to find dead bodies. Feed these bodies to THE PIT, lest you be fed to it yourself.

games.name: Bad Cheese
games.summary: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

games.name: The Temple of Children
games.summary: The Temple of Children is a story-driven horror adventure about a simple little girl from a Russian province. Against her will she became part of horrible events, watching her reality turn into hell. To survive she needs to unravel the secret that children are hiding.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven roguelike with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Dark Atlas: Infernum
games.summary: If Hell is a state of the soul, this story is the descent to the inner abyss. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story , where the end of the world is combined with psychological terror in a survival horror experience with a strong narrative component.

games.name: Monster DNA
games.summary:
At the international space center of research, something we never ask is why. Our clients are from all corners of the new world's universe and we're sworn to secrecy. We deliver our exclusive hybrids monsters as demanded, and of course, we make sure our hybrids have the best possible work contracts. Our source DNA is sourced from the most notorious galactic inmates seeking participation in our programs, often aiming to secure prison perks or time reductions as they negotiated with their administration.

Your job? Create the monsters we seek, and do a quality control on them, whether it's painful or not.

Each playthrough is unique. You can experience it multiple times.

games.name: Deadcam
games.summary: DEADCAM is a 80's and 90's inspired psychological survival horror game based around found footage presented as "recordings". These recordings serve as a collection of short, self-contained experiences, each set in their own location featuring unique entities, monsters and creatures.

games.name: Stygian: Outer Gods
games.summary: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and the decision counts now, are you up to the task?

games.name: Cold Abyss
games.summary: COLD ABYSS is a relaxing and atmospheric exploration game where you repair internet cables on the bottom of the ocean.There are no enemies or other forms of danger down there. Just you.

games.name: Heavy As Stone
games.summary: Investigate a series of deaths on behalf of the Atsmith Life Insurance Co., uncovering the relationship between these cases and the cause of your mysterious illness. Adapt to your disease and survive Terminal's seedy underbelly as you face the consequences of your search for answers.

games.name: The Lacerator
games.summary: A mix of classic survival horror and trash movies, play as an 80's porn actor and beware of every corner because you can get Lacerator and lose a limb in real time... But you can still adapt and survive.

games.name: Habilis
games.summary: Follow Nathan Walters as he quickly descends into insanity. Discover the ancient secrets held within a futuristic abandoned factory. A bodycam, Lovecraft-style horror experience not for the weak of heart. Hide, and survive if you can.

games.name: Alisa: The Parting
games.summary: Alisa: The Parting is an unforgettable action packed adventure, that looks and plays exactly like a late 90's and early 2000's 32bit game. With crispy pixely polygons and pre-rendered backgrounds and cinematics, Alisa: The Parting is enjoyable in both solo and co-op play.

games.name: Below, Rusted Gods
games.summary: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

games.name: Becrowned
games.summary: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Projekt Z: Beyond Order
games.summary: Projekt Z: Beyond Order is an atmospheric First-Person Zombie Co-Op-Shooter set in WW2. In this game, you get to play different characters, who have very different abilities, to find out more about the secrets of the german island you all crashed on.

games.name: Birchwood
games.summary:
Birchwood is a narrative driven psychological horror game which delves into the dark-side of 1980’s Britain.
After an ecological and personal tragedy befell your household a decade earlier, you must now return home and uncover the morbid secrets which lay at the heart of the once idyllic farmhouse, while confronting the evil which destroyed your family.
Armed with nothing but a VHS camcorder, it’s up to you to solve the mystery of what really happened on that fateful night ten years ago.

games.name: Heartworm
games.summary: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Scarlet Lake
games.summary: Delve into a retro survival horror where everything is not what it seems. You control Ben Murphy, a detective sent to investigate the strange on-goings in a small town, only to be caught in a nightmare surrounded by terrifying creatures. What dark mysteries will you uncover in Scarlet Lake?

games.name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
games.summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Bye Sweet Carole
games.summary: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

games.name: Survive: Frost Bite
games.summary: Trapped in an isolated Antarctic research base, you’re hunted by bloodthirsty werewolves after a brutal attack. With every passing second, survival becomes a desperate struggle—will you outsmart the creatures stalking you, or will the relentless terror tear you apart before help arrives?

games.name: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror
games.summary:
Enter the broken mind of Eliza de Moor, a once-celebrated singer, now trapped in the labyrinth of her own forgotten memories. The only hope for recovering her memories lies with Doctor Stern and his experimental medicine. As Eliza, you'll navigate the reality and the world behind the broken mirror, guided by the effects of the drug.

Will you be able to piece together the mystery of your past, or will you get lost in this dark and twisted reality?

games.name: The 9th Charnel
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game, The 9th Charnel is filled with a rich and frightening atmosphere. While exploring the many mysteries of this world, you must survive- whether you do it through stealth or by using weapons.

games.name: Captain Midnight
games.summary: The tide always wins

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

games.name: Mama's Sleeping Angels
games.summary: Kiss and decapitate your friends in a Co-Op horror game about collecting cursed objects to feed to a deity called Mama, lest she hunger for you. Work together, and betray each other... Anything to keep Mama happy.

games.name: Mimic
games.summary: A multiplayer survival horror game where players must choose their allies carefully to survive imminent danger. In this social-deduction game players won't know who to trust with their lives.

games.name: Oxide Room 208
games.summary: Eight people trapped in an old laboratory will try to survive their last moments of life in this frenetic body-horror full of action, blood and guts. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment where flesh and madness merge.

games.name: BrokenLore: Follow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Follow is a captivating psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering metaphorical surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

games.name: Shiver
games.summary: A survival horror game where reality itself seems to unravel as you navigate the frozen hellscape to find your missing sister – defending yourself from horrors beyond our understanding, and nature itself. Solve puzzles, combat ice-covered nightmares, and most importantly, survive.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
games.summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

events.name: NSMBW Hacking Depot Holiday Direct
events.description: This is a presentation of trailers and previews for mods of New Super Mario Bros. Wii and U which premiered on Christmas Day 2024 and was organised by Miguel and TMolter and presented by NinTyler.

games.name: Super Mario and the Cosmic Catalyst

events.name: Os Melhores Jogos Brasileiros de 2024 - Premiação Sem Prêmios do Controles Voadores

games.name: Hyper Space
games.summary: Hyper Space is a “Dodge ’Em Up” Arcade game. Collect stars while avoiding space hazards to reach the highest score, unlock new skins, compete with your friends and travel through space to the most distant galaxies.

games.name: Keys and Kastles
games.summary: Welcome to Keys and Kastles, a simple but very challenging platform game! Go through different stages and try to look for hidden treasures! Be careful as there are traps around every corner! Good luck!

games.name: Reality Rash
games.summary: Reality Rash is a 3D beat 'em up inspired by classics such as Jackie Chan Stuntmaster, Streets of Rage, and TMNT... Action takes place in 4 different worlds each one with unique enemies! Play solo or in 2 player co-op, It’s a nostalgic and modern beat 'em up!

games.name: Mullet Madjack
games.summary: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… of your enemies!

games.name: Archaeogem
games.summary: Hats up and whips out; the jungle's mysteries await! Explore lush biomes, use your trusty whip to extract wild flowers' mystic powers, and collect rare gems in this dynamic precision-platformer. Unearth archaeological marvels and become a legend - if you make it out alive!

games.name: The Rise
games.summary: Help Sam and Elicy on their challenging journey through the abyss. An epic 2D precision platform game where exploring the unknown, overcoming obstacles, and discovering secrets are crucial to reaching the top of the abyss. Adventure awaits you!

games.name: Super Laura Up
games.summary: Super Laura Up is a platformer Inspired by retro platformers and precision platformers, this game will take you on a journey through a variety of challenging levels, where you must use your precision and timing to overcome obstacles and reach the end.

games.name: Just King
games.summary: Just King is an action auto-battler with roguelike elements. Assemble your party to venture into different lands fighting fearsome kings and their deadly armies. Use your loot to hire and upgrade mighty heroes... or the bard.

games.name: Ultimate Jello Party
games.summary: Ultimate Jello Party is a multiplayer party game that combines elements of card, board and minigame battles. Challenge up to 3 friends and mess up the game with your strategies! Earn coins, plan your moves, collect and accumulate jellies to become the big winner.

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: HomeNaut
games.summary: HomeNaut is a puzzle platformer in which you spin the direction of gravity.

games.name: Schrodinger's Cat Experiment
games.summary: Schrodinger's Cat Experiment is a Brazilian indie game in pixel art that combines brain-teasing puzzles with enchanting aesthetics and feline charm. Dead or alive? The cat's fate is in your hands.

games.name: Turi: Kaapora
games.summary: Turi: Kaapora is an isometric hack 'n' slash where you will control the guardian Caipora, with insistent and brutal enemies, discover the forest and its secrets, get all the help you can, and destroy enemy buildings so they can see who is in charge here.

games.name: Mimic Dungeon
games.summary: Help the Wizard escape the dungeon by killing enemies with the staff that makes everyone copy his moves.

games.name: Marlow in Apocalyptic Acid World
games.summary:
Marlow in Apocalyptic Acid World is a platform game for ZX Spectrum 128k, inspired by "The Great Giana Sisters." What? Did you think the inspiration came from a certain mustache plumber? No way…

Navigate this vast apocalyptic world by jumping, stomping on enemies, collecting crystals, and breaking blocks with your head across 4 worlds, totaling 16 levels and 5 Boss battles.

games.name: Jataí: The Bee
games.summary: The Jataí is a native bee of the Atlantic Forest. It must fulfill its duty to pollinate flowers and collect pollen and nectar to feed the hive. During the mission, some enemies will appear: spiders hanging from their webs, lemon bees raiding the hive, and a large spider, the Queen, who must be stopped.

games.name: Temples vs. Buildings
games.summary: Temples vs Buildings is a roguelike with shoot'em up elements. The player will control flying temples of many cultures and fight against a vast array of flying buildings.

games.name: Conqueror Of The Galaxy
games.summary:
Conqueror Of The Galaxy is a 2D bullet hell space shooter that puts you in command of powerful spaceships as you conquer galaxies.

With vibrant graphics and intense gameplay, you’ll face waves of enemies, dodge deadly projectiles, and use strategic skills to overcome epic challenges.
With each battle, you’ll be able to upgrade your ship, unlock new features, and conquer galaxies, establishing yourself as the greatest Conqueror in the Universe. Step onto the battlefield and show off your skills!

games.name: Mayday: The Survival Island
games.summary: After a mysterious crash, you awaken alone on a strange island. Survive by hunting, farming, and crafting, then explore a vast archipelago filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and magical totems. Build your base, uncover the truth, and escape—if you can.

games.name: Spell Crisis
games.summary: Shoot your spells as a little witch in this Mega Man-like action platformer with more exploration elements. Unleash new magic powers, discover new paths, and find rare and hidden items according to your decisions in the game.

games.name: Fourspell Survivors Online
games.summary: Join friends online to survive endless hordes of monsters in this online coop "survivors" game! Evolve your spells, defeat bosses and develop the best character builds and party formations. Cooperation is key to survive in this action roguelike with unique characters.

games.name: Astercys
games.summary: Step into an alternate realm where you traverse through different dimensions, survive spinning battles, and indulge in plenty of pineapple!

games.name: RhythMania
games.summary: An upcoming vibrant rhythm anthology filled with over a dozen dynamic mini-games with minimalistic inputs across musical genres and visual styles!

games.name: Oni's Tale
games.summary: Oni’s Tale is a vibrant 2D anime-style platformer and typing adventure inspired by an ancient Japanese story. Join Oni siblings Gomu and Momo on a journey through a fantastical world filled with puzzles, challenges, and wonder. Test your skills and uncover a magical tale of friendship and discovery!

games.name: Debtors' Club
games.summary: Be the tax collector of a shady city hall in this narrative-driven resource management game. Talk to debtors, manage a team, make difficult choices, and challenge the city's moral decay. It's their money, but it's your job.

games.name: The Cabbage Effect
games.summary: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter on procedurally generated stages that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

games.name: Sovereign's Enigma
games.summary: Sovereign's Enigma is a 2D platformer with survival elements, in a densely interconnected cave, where the player needs to uncover the story of an ancient civilization to solve a mystery from the past. This game is a slow and immersive experience, with a strong focus on storytelling, atmosphere, and characters.

games.name: Century of Anticipation
games.summary: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl, your only company is yourself. In this short adventure, your challenge might be the toughest of all: make time pass again!

games.name: Bloodless
games.summary: Stylish retro, action-adventure game featuring fast-paced combat centered around ronin Tomoe's signature dash-counter mechanic, fighting with nothing but her bare fists to disarm her former allies, the samurai army of Shogun Akechi.

games.name: Momodora: Moonlit Farewell
games.summary: Join Momo, High Priestess of the village of Koho, as she embarks on a divine mission to save her people from imminent destruction at the hands of the demon hordes summoned by a malevolent bellringer.

games.name: Bloodsaint
games.summary: BLOODSAINT is not a remaster of a 94's retro-hardcore minigame about a cleric performing a ritual for a ruthless syntetic deity, but pretty close.

games.name: Ghostein
games.summary: Guide a boy, hide him and escape from the Nazi camp using posters! Ghostein is a short stealth game. You control the ghost of the father, who died in the gas chamber, who returns to save his son from the same fate. With the posters you give the command that the boy needs to do.

games.name: Coralina: A Memory Tale
games.summary: A oneiric plot about two girls unraveling the mysteries of Limbo, a land of alchemists, and its other layers: Hell and Purgatory. The second chapter of "Coralina", an indie and retro game, with a charming and original look.

games.name: Verum
games.summary: Verum: a thought-provoking game exploring ethical issues surrounding tech corporations and personal data usage. Embark on a journey through multiple side stories, gain diverse perspectives, and unlock multiple endings to uncover the full story. Simple yet immersive gameplay with captivating graphics

games.name: Someone to Hold Me
games.summary: A very short, simple visual novel made in a week, starring an asexual girl and her internal and social tribulations. Featuring one ending, an unlockable epilogue, and a few post-game secrets.

games.name: Hydrangea
games.summary: Hydrangea is a romance and psychological horror visual novel inspired by the Hanahaki disease trope. You play as someone whose sweetheart, customizable to your preferences, falls ill with a mysterious condition just as you reconsider ending the relationship. Drawn closer by their plight, you find yourself navigating a love that deepens into obsession, where affection takes a dark turn and the petals of devotion threaten to suffocate.

games.name: Project Chameleon
games.summary: Project Chameleon is a stealth game where you must shape-shift into objects to go unnoticed by your enemies. Play as Siren, an elite spy executing missions around the globe. Manipulate your surroundings, set traps, and use powerful gadgets in each mission.

games.name: Ekorella Vol 1
games.summary: A turn-based RPG set in a fantastic society of plants and animals. Fight against monsters and visit exotic places that have their unique culture and history. Beware of what lurks in the darkness...

games.name: Mooh
games.summary: An adventure in space through a cow that was abducted and is trying to return home. Explore the planets, solve puzzles, save the mimosas and collect parts to improve the ship that will take Mooh back home.

games.name: Plungeez
games.summary: Take a dive in the world of Plungeez, a puzzle platformer where Bonnie, a fierce woman who, after falling in the underground, must explore the sewers of Salvador in search of a way out. Light torches, boilers, and use plungers to climb and solve puzzles!

games.name: Devil's Drizzle
games.summary: An enchanting 2D pixel art platformer with an engaging story, starring a brave kid, their trusty umbrella, and Sumerian demons. It features a diverse range of mechanics and level designs, including action, adventure, horror, puzzle, and drama.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: One Last Story
games.summary: Do a writer's last words mean anything to the living? A story about death and the (idealization or fear of a possible) future.

games.name: Death by Hype
games.summary:
Death by HYPE is a melee Boomer-Shooter focused on fast-paced combat. The game takes place in the middle of the HYPE virus pandemic, and you (as an essential worker) must attend your shift at the beloved restaurant chain KAFC (Karlos Frango Cozinha), to sustain the needs of never-ending HYPEhead shoppers. In an unfortunate-- but predictable turn of events, your coworker bites your hand, and with the imminent infection ready to take its toll, you decide to go out by fullfilling your lifelong dream: taking out your pent up frustration on all your HYPE-ified customers.

Punch, slice, and stab through the maze corridors of the mall. Enter the stores and find out what happened with the other employees and survive as long as you can in this arcade boomer-puncher experience.

games.name: Tales Beyond the Tomb: Pineville Night Stalker
games.summary: After her mother's unexpected death, Megan receives a call about a mysterious inheritance awaiting her in the town of Pineville. With her work friend, Lenny, she embarks on a journey that should be simple, but quickly turns into a web of danger and deception.

games.name: Lighthouse of Madness
games.summary: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you in this island. Explore the enigmatic lighthouse, solve challenging puzzles and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity when facing the darkness of your mind.

games.name: Albatroz
games.summary: Leave your dull urban life behind and set out on a journey to find your lost brother, who disappeared while looking to reach a mythical mountain called Albatroz. Use your survival skills to traverse beautiful yet challenging landscapes, ranging from scorching coastal regions to freezing mountains. Manage your resources, strengthen your body, and improve your abilities as you face the wilderness head-on. Discover yourself as you find that the journey might actually be just as important as the destination.

games.name: A Liminal Place Remaster
games.summary: A Liminal Place RMSTER is a solitary game, and relaxing on some levels. ALPR Uses Body-Cam, Analog Horror and Found Footage style. Including realistic Liminal Spaces, and "Backrooms" levels.

games.name: Slash Quest!
games.summary: Forget your power fantasy. Slash Quest’s simple yet unfamiliar controls will put you in the shoes of an unlikely knight with a big heart, an even bigger weapon, and absolutely zero skills. But worry not! Just like Shep and Swordie’s friendship, before you know it everything will feel right and everyone will be counting on you to save the Queendom.

games.name: Eco Farm Green
games.summary: A clicker with global warming resource management in which your goal is to reduce your carbon footprint as much as possible while maintaining your plantation.

games.name: Glitch
games.summary: Glitch :) would have been a great, calm and fun game... If it weren't completely corrupted. A terrible virus has invaded the game's files and left it completely bugged. Fortunately, when even the hero of the story gets completely stuck, from the confines of the game's files, there's hope...

games.name: Ivayami: Cradle of Fog
games.summary: Four friends decide to visit an abandoned city. When the trip is is suddenly cut short by a car accident, Cynthia Moriyama must traverse through the dense fog of Ivayami searching for her missing friends. Beware, as the fog hides more than you imagine

games.name: RoboSync
games.summary: RoboSync is a puzzle game where you will need to use logical reasoning and precision to complete the challenges. Release and lock passages at the right time to synchronize your robots' movements and achieve perfect synchronization to release all the locks at the same time.

games.name: Zet Zillions
games.summary: Zet Zillions is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder where you use your cards to make freakish combinations and explode entire planets. BIG-BADDA-BOOM!

games.name: Keylocker: Turn Based Cyberpunk Action
games.summary: Keylocker is a Cyberpunk turn based rhythm JRPG inspired by the Mario&Luigi RPG series and Chrono Trigger, in which you play as the singer and songwriter, BOBO. Fuel your moves with the electric power of music in this unforgiving planet by using real-time execution of moves in rhythm game style! Battle the authorities, unlock the secrets of Saturn, play on your own bands' concerts and hack into the network to bring an end to this corrupt system, for better or worse.

games.name: Varg
games.summary: A love letter to the classic MS-DOS “boomer” shooter genre, in a setting loosely inspired by Brazil's most iconic UFO case. When your son goes missing, take to the streets in search of answers. Unravel the secrets of a shadowy corporation and an alien-worshiping cult that has taken over your town.

games.name: Asleep: Act 1
games.summary: Immersed in her nightmares, in a chaotic reality, confused and all alone. The only safe place is her room, but not forever... She wanders through an empty city and strange places while fleeing from creatures lurking in the darkness to find out what's going on. You are in the skin of Ana Lúcia.

games.name: Out Of Memories
games.summary:
A surreal, minimalist spooky ride through impossible geometry, deadly traps and caustic commentary from the observers of the player's attempt to stay alive for just a little longer, as a toxin kills them little by little.

The game has text graphics and uses the character set from the original PC from 1981. It's presented as if running on that hardware, on a green phosphor monitor - with just a hint of red.

games.name: Minha Casa
games.summary: Awakened in the middle of the night by her own anxiety, Robertha will have to face her own demons beyond her own home.

games.name: Little Eden
games.summary: In this mix of farming simulator and spaceship shooter, you control Little Eden, a flying farm-ship. Destroy planetoids, collect seeds to plant, craft ammunition and fight for survival against the terrible Pirate Coalition.

games.name: Nephenthesys
games.summary: Blast off on a treacherous mission to recover an unidentified energy source amidst an alien onslaught! Nephenthesys is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up presented in widescreen top-down 3D style.

games.name: Arashi Gaiden
games.summary: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game, with frantic combat, in the dash-and-slash style. Arashi is a Ronin from the Pocket Bravery universe, he was hired by his former master, Lobo, receiving the mission of defeating Ninjas and Matilha soldiers to recover 3 powerful relics from Japan.

games.name: Final Forge
games.summary: Defend your tower and protect the dwarf's treasure from marauding creatures in this roguelike survival game. Explore the region, collect resources, and choose the right upgrades. But be careful, don't leave your fortress empty for too long.

games.name: Divinastros
games.summary: An astronomical gambling game. Fight the Olimpians while each Zodiac sign affects your cards differently in a deeply satisfying deckbuilder game. Fight Greek beasts, discover Tarot Cards and climb the Olimpus searching for revenge.

games.name: Dominium
games.summary: In Dominium, you take on the role of a temporal agent tasked with preventing a time anomaly: a train explosion that will lead to the death of the man destined to invent the time machine. Utilize your investigative skills, navigate intricate time loops, and unravel the mystery behind this catastrophic event.

games.name: Frogue
games.summary: Embark in a journey to rescue your dog in Frogue. A bullet-hell time manipulation roguelike platformer.

games.name: Necrosphere64
games.summary: A 64×64 Metroidvania with only 2 buttons (neither of them jumps)

games.name: Toni Island Adventure
games.summary: Toni, a pizza-loving sailor dog, shipwrecks on a mysterious island. Solve challenging puzzles, defeat foes, unlock minigames, unravel the island's ancient magic to find your way back home, and don't forget to take a break for a hot slice of pizza!

games.name: Tears of Vanfell
games.summary: Tears of Vanfell is an action-packed dungeon crawler with roguelike and hack-'n-slash elements. Choose between a wide cast of characters and climb the Mountain as you swap weapons and grow stronger as a team of up to four player in online Co-op.

games.name: Vampire Hunters
games.summary: Create absurd builds by stacking up weapons and raining down crazy firepower on vampires and demons in this rogue-lite retro FPS. Can you be known as the most outrageous Vampire Hunter in all of Transylvania?

games.name: VirusRush + Hazard of the Ages
games.summary: Face powerful bosses in a soulslike challenge amidst bullet hell! Each one will test your adaptability, skills, and strategic thinking, as you are fragile and will need to manage your stamina to dodge with your dash amidst intense, fast-paced action! To progress, you don't just need to defeat them but also master the combats to achieve the best rankings and obtain the stars needed to unlock more battles.

games.name: Hands of Timber
games.summary: Hands of Timber portrays the journey of a little wooden doll that wakes up inside the mind of its creator. To find her father, she must wander through his memories... the good, the bad, and the incomplete ones...

games.name: Pavu
games.summary: Pavu is an action adventure game where we are going to follow a young boy's quest in search of answers about himself and humanity in a fantastical land filled with robots, challenges and encounters that was once habited by a human civilization that has vanished.

games.name: Momo and the Mine
games.summary: Help this charismatic mole collect matchsticks in an abandoned mine in this challenging platform game!

games.name: Le Fol
games.summary: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

games.name: Forgotten Mines
games.summary: Wreak vengeance and retake lost mines from goblins, orcs, skeletons, and demons in this small-scale tactical roguelite RPG. Build the perfect expedition team and turn the underworld red with each challenging, fast-paced run.

games.name: Deathbound
games.summary: Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. The forbidden city of Akratya is an unforgiving land that cannot be conquered alone. Bind with fallen warriors found throughout your crusade and dynamically transform between characters seamlessly in mid-combat with the unique 4-hero party system.

games.name: Exodus Checkmate
games.summary:
You're trapped in school and monsters appeared... The only way out? Playing real-life and mortal chess! Explore complex Gameboards in this First Person Dungeon Crawler and raise the affection with your teammates to get closer to them!

You are the king. You are the school's only salvation!

games.name: Lost Days 0: Queen's Dream
games.summary: Lost Days 0: Queen's Dream is a Sci-Fi visual novel for the Sega Saturn about Io, a pilot/spy who was sent to United Europe to investigate Cornelli, meanwhile, the arrival of a skilled assassin threatens her mission.

games.name: Just Plumbers in Hallowville
games.summary: Just Plumbers in Hallowville is a cooperative horror game where players must control two plumbers to fix pipes, running against the clock. All while trying to survive encounters with their peculiar customers.

games.name: Heavenstrafer
games.summary: Heavenstrafer is a fast paced movement shooter with a gun combo system that rewards aggressiveness and experimentation. Explore the ruins of hell and destroy angels (and demons) across three chapters filled with small but challenging arenas.

games.name: Code Bunny
games.summary:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

games.name: Sky Dust
games.summary: Sky Dust is set in a cyberpunk universe, taking place in a future where society has collapsed following a global disaster, and the lines between morality and ethics have become blurred.

games.name: Gyro Shooter
games.summary: A Multiplayer motion-controlled shooting game, using your phone as a gun on a screen connected via a local network.

games.name: Heartrender
games.summary: Welcome to the Null, a surrealist non-space between worlds, times and concepts, populated by outcasts and detritus from across existence. As a lone, self-serving agent of mayhem on a personal mission, sneak, brawl, shoot and swing your way through immersive, open-ended heists.

games.name: Violeta
games.summary: After feeling marginalized by society, a young trans woman decides to venture out into the post-apocalyptic world to find a place she can call home.

games.name: Kitty Rhythm TD
games.summary:
Welcome to the fair!
Help the cats to cheer up with music so the ball will be a success!
In this game, the song’s beat dictates when every move will happen.

games.name: Astro Pig
games.summary: A 90-s inspired lo-fi adventure puzzle platformer about a piglet astronaut and his intelligent ship.

games.name: Everloop
games.summary: You are trapped in an endless hallway. Observe your surroundings carefully to reach your destiny.

games.name: Doodle Harmony Ghosts
games.summary: Find and match 100 cute doodle pairs scattered all over the screen in this point-and-click game. Can you match them all?

games.name: Bioguard
games.summary: Bioguard is a tower defense roguelite with a biological theme. Help the immune system using a variety of towers, skills and special cards. Develop your strategy to protect your body from invading pathogens and prevent their passage to vital organs!

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Toys 'n' Traps
games.summary: Protect Toy's Town in this action-filled tower defense. Build crazy traps, shoot enemies, lead your own minion army, obtain new traps and upgrade them to defend your car base across 4 different environments with visuals inspired in toys.

games.name: Mechanines Tower Defense
games.summary: Position your EvoDogs against the threats of a machine-dominated future and enjoy this TOWER DEFENSE game with ROGUE-LITE elements!

games.name: Cozy Island Idle
games.summary: Cozy Island Idle is a cute and relaxing idle game where you catch all sort of fantasy fishes to showcase them in an Aquarium. You can sell them to turn a profit and customize your island.

games.name: Conradito Cafézito
games.summary: It costs the price of a coffee – but it lasts much longer! Conradito Cafézito, is an idle and incremental game where you unlock recipes, automate processes, and expand your coffee empire while watching your profits rise with every click!

games.name: Cidadão de SP Simulator
games.summary: Adapted from Molleindustria's The New York Times Simulator, Cidadão de SP Simulator is a newspaper simulator where you assume the role of a newly hired editor. To keep your job, you have to make three layers of society happy: The rich, Israel and the police.

games.name: The Four Paths
games.summary: The Four Paths is a game with a multilinear story and strategic battles where you will have new cards according to the paths you choose. Play as Roy and sacrifice everything in exchange for money. Play as William and atone for your sins with a brutal revenge.

games.name: Primateria
games.summary: Take a dive in a Card Game experience dipped in Roguelike and Deckbulding. Combine cards together to make them stronger, discover mysterious items imbued with magic, duel divine creatures, perform combos with infinite combinations and possibilities. Can you be the one to reach the surface?

games.name: Two Sisters
games.summary: Witness the obscure scenario of a massacre, in the shoes of the photographer Bárbara, who received an unusual proposal: To photograph a village with bizarre secrets from decades ago.

games.name: Machick
games.summary: Defeat the heavily armed army of anti-magic toads and free the forest from destruction. Machick is a casual game where you craft your own wands, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and choose upgrades to go further on the journey.

games.name: Dagger Froggy
games.summary: Dagger Froggy is a small action Roguelike, Where you face hordes of enemies... Cute? With each round you get stronger, But so do the cute creatures. >:)

games.name: Rocket Rats
games.summary: Rocket Rats is a survivors-like game where you defeat cheese-based astral bodies in space – as a rat! Clear waves of enemies, collect cheese, upgrade your gear, and conquer the moon!

games.name: Cyberwar: Neon City
games.summary: Explore a cyberpunk universe where monkeys rule. Challenge the fearsome Cyber Monkeys as you take on the role of a hero armed with a living shark weapon.

games.name: Mars 2120
games.summary: MARS 2120 is a metroidvania with engaging melee combat inspired by classics like Super Metroid, Castlevania: Symphony of the Night, or Guacamelee! With the use of special abilities tied to elements like ice, fire, and electricity help Sgt. Anna “Thirteen” Charlotte navigate the colony and battle her way through the secrets of Mars

games.name: RotorScape
games.summary: RotorScape is a shoot 'em up style game with a 2.5D perspective, where you fly a helicopter. You can collect different weapons to use in combat. The game has stages with different themes and climates, as well as threatening bosses. RotorScape proposes a 90s style of gameplay.

games.name: Food Boy
games.summary: Food Boy is a wholesome pizza delivery arcade game that everyone can play! Ride your bike through different streets, try to keep balance, and avoid obstacles to make more deliveries and get the highest scores.

events.name: Southeast Asia Games Onward 2024
events.description: Southeast Asia Games Onward (SEAGO) is an annual online community event that celebrates the growth and development of Southeast Asia gaming industry. Tune in for Southeast Asia Games Onward - Presentation on 29th December 2024 and SEA GO Steam Sale & Itch.io collection on 13th December until 9th January 2025.

games.name: Spooky Pixel Hero
games.summary: A chilling homage to retro gaming – Rediscover the magic of classic games and retro platformers with a terrifying twist. SPOOKY PIXEL HORROR combines the beloved aesthetics of vintage 2D pixel games with a deeply immersive horror narrative that will keep you on edge.

games.name: SoftWar Cyber Fight
games.summary: A Science-Fiction Visual Novel Role-Playing Game with a story centered on the cyberworld conflicts. New"SoftWars" are battles involving sentient softwares namely viruses and anti-viruses, deciding the fates of computer systems.

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Last Mech Standing
games.summary: VR rogue-like, arcade-style shoot-them-up. Pilot the Crimson Slayer, the last giant mech and humanity’s final hope. Slash waves of giant monsters with your sword & blast them with your minigun. Upgrade your weapons & tech along the way, find your fighting style, defeat bosses and level up!

games.name: Jiwa: The Damned Soul
games.summary: A first-person adventure set in an abandoned Indonesian hospital, where two content creators are in dire need of going viral. Explore alternatively as Sekar and Laras to discover and reveal all of the secrets you saw to the world.

games.name: Garden of Wandering Souls
games.summary: Garden of Wandering Souls is a Tower Defense game with a roguelite twist, featuring two unique mechanics: path building and tower attack range patterns that resemble puzzles, with narrative and visuals inspired by Indonesia’s Borobudur Temple, the world's largest Buddhist temple.

games.name: Hot Springs
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the warm waters and relaxing atmosphere of Japanese's Onsen

games.name: Xeroes
games.summary: Xeroes is a fast-paced brawl-action game with charming characters and innovative combat mechanics. Play with friends or solo across a variety of game modes and battle in a variety of familiar and mysterious locations across the world.

games.name: Class Zero Seven
games.summary: Class Zero Seven is a third person brawler that tells the story of a wide nation fight against substance abuse. Play as Rin, a newly transferred student with a mysterious background among her peers. Stand off against the Rivalry Gangs and the looming threat of The Wicked Children.

games.name: Mentari
games.summary: In a world frozen by The Stillness, one girl holds the power to undo the damage. Mentari is an action-adventure game where you take control of the titular heroine to make the world move again, through a unique, dance-based combat system.

games.name: Space Tales
games.summary: Space Tales is a real-time strategy game set in a retro-futuristic environment. Take on the role of a commander in the Intergalactic Planetary Expansion (I.P.E.) and immerse yourself in a thrilling mission to explore and conquer new planets, pushing the boundaries of the Human Empire.

games.name: Loading...
games.summary: You are a 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games.

games.name: M's Cases: Chapter 1 - Vanishing of Melisma
games.summary:
The first chapter of an adventure puzzle game. You will play as Mark, a cat detective just
starting out in a quiet little town where nothing much seems to happen. As you solve
one case after another, you'll slowly uncover the hidden mysteries that this sleepy town
has been keeping.

games.name: Going Up
games.summary:
How often have you stood and waited for an elevator, wondering why it’s taking so long,
why it’s moving so slow, and hey, why did it just pass your floor completely?

Going Up is a casual strategy game where you control groups of lifts in a skyscraper to
deliver passengers before they lose their patience. Optimise elevator movement to deal
with a fussy set of passengers: impatient CEOs, mean soldiers and confused tourists.
There is no one solution to elevator optimisation: every stage will have its unique
bottlenecks, passengers and problems.

Can you keep people moving, or will they have to take the stairs?

games.name: Zoomageddon
games.summary: Play as Oyen, an orange cat, in a post-apocalyptic world where you collect Zodiac Beasts abilities and challenge the Rat King. Zoomageddon blends bullet-heaven, dungeon roguelike, and base-building mechanics. Uncover story-rich inspired by Chinese Zodiac, unlock building, and discover quirky power!

games.name: Mage's Legacy
games.summary: Mage's Legacy: Explore the World of Magic

games.name: Threads of You: Beyond the Bay
games.summary: 1 broken down car, 2 weeks in a hidden seaside town, and 7 men waiting to sweep you off your feet. Will you follow the threads of destiny in Brine Bay?

games.name: Tikus Tales
games.summary: Tikus Tales is a colorful 3D platformer featuring Suki and Tuki—two daring mice on a quest to defeat rebellious creatures and free the imprisoned Zodiac guardians. Face off in multi-phase boss battles filled with combat, platforming twists, and charm!

games.name: Circle of Sparks
games.summary:
Bringing forth a fusion of Rhythm Games with Decorating - Circle of Sparks allows you to decorate your room, mix and match various decorative themes as you tap your way through the rhythm game, discovering and unlocking songs from an ensemble of artists.

With your party members, experience original, licensed, and even collaboration songs! Adopt pets as you make yourselves at home in the World of Sparks.

games.name: Rune Seeker
games.summary: Rune Seeker is a strategy card game with a turn-based format, developed to become a tactical universe.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Village Meow
games.summary: Play as Kiti who was a city cat that moved into Village Meow after Kiti’s owner died. Now Kiti is in debt by the local corrupted Mayor, Bos Oyen, after being tricked. Kiti has a choice to either pay off his debts or unite with other villagers to drive out Bos Oyen.

games.name: Surabaya Inferno
games.summary: Freedom or Death! Surabaya Inferno is a real-time tactics game based on the battle of Surabaya which occured at November 10th, 1945. Play as Surabayans fighting against the forces of Britain, Netherlands, and Japan in order to defend their independence in Indonesia!

games.name: Stagdraft
games.summary: Top-down 2D Pixel PvP set on Medieval Fantasy World Deploy to battle in Teambased PvP attempting to Capture Flags, Defeating Players, Looting NPCs, Defeat Bosses Gather, Craft, Battle, Loot your way up to conquer the Kingdoms

games.name: Comme Tu Veux
games.summary: Comme Tu Veux is a visual novel set in 1966 Saigon, focused on two 14-year-old school girls, Hồng and Như Ý, whose friendship falls apart. They meet again at an antiques market where Như Ý outbuys Hồng for a vase. Như Ý disappears, and Hồng's brother is found murdered.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
