Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Vague
games.summary: Vague is a first-person psychological horror inspired by early 2000s classic horror titles. Experience the unsettling atmosphere as you follow Raymond K. Fisher in his search for his missing family.

games.name: Taken Soul
games.summary: Taken Soul is a survival horror game developed by SOGA Studio. The protagonist play in third-person perspective, he must navigate through dangerous and tense situations, try to survive till the sun rises, and fight against dark forces to investigate the disappearance of his mother and sister.

games.name: Cursed Companions
games.summary: Co-op horror with voice activation where the game listens to what everyone is saying. Say the right words to save friends, but the wrong words bring chaos, death and laughs. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, seek treasure, and try to survive the mayhem. Play up to 8 players in Co-op Mode and up to 16 players in Traitor Mode.

games.name: F1st Strike
games.summary: F1st Strike is a turn-based game that combines elements of fighting games combos.

games.name: StellaGale: The Trials Of Faith
games.summary: Fight alongside your spirit-Brother through this handcrafted 2D hack-n-slash colosseum arena, set in the steampunk Roman Empire! Be the strongest gladiator and rise to the deadliest colosseum as you seek the truth of your father’s darkest secret.

games.name: Ark Odyssey
games.summary: Ark Odyssey is a top-down arcade shooter that lets you command an army of starships to fight against the force of void! Gather your fleet into formations, and build your team of evolving synergistic compositions. Order your army of Starforce through space and protect the cosmos!

games.name: Mala Petaka
games.summary: 2D Pixel Art Shooter inspired Sci-fi FPS runs on GZDoom. You play as 'Petaka', an angry amnesiac that just wants to kill every ugly green aliens and annoying drones he encounters while trying to restore his memories by exploring various universes through warp portals.

games.name: Glyphica: Typing Survival
games.summary: Glyphica is a typing-roguelike that blends survival and strategy. Type to shoot. Test your keyboard mastery, unlock powerful upgrades, and craft overpowered builds to destroy hordes of enemies.

games.name: The Gambit Lost to Time
games.summary: Become a time-travelling advisor seeking to shape this world towards her ideal future. Choose between one of four kingdoms to support, with the realization that today's friend is an enemy in another timeline. Bring out your best Gambits and lead your troops to victory!

games.name: Deflect Boy
games.summary: Deflect Boy is a top-down arena shooter, that instead of guns, you only have a shield. Deflect the bullets, acquire, and combine new skills to create unique deflection powers and survive until the nightmare ends.

games.name: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush
games.summary: Speedrunning precision platformer where you jump on buildings and invent crazy shortcuts to become the fastest driver in the city!

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.summary: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: Bootleg Steamer
games.summary: Bootleg Steamer is a top down tactical trading game. Using a ship to smuggle alcohol, earn steep profits while evading authorities. Invest earnings to hire more crew and purchase upgrades. Create criminal contacts to improve your operation with the goal of accruing a massive fortune.

games.name: Cats & Dice
games.summary: A roguelike dice-building game where the goal is to overcome an ever-increasing target score each round. Assemble a synergistic set of Cats and dice, go for crazy combos and try to attain as high a score as you possibly can. Master the synergy between cats and dice to win!

games.name: Darkchaser: Battletide
games.summary: [Darkchaser: Battletide] is a survivor-like game where players enter a world ravaged by monsters, arming themselves with various skills and relics to engage in fierce battles against countless enemies, becoming stronger through challenges!

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Margo: On The Brink
games.summary: Dive into sundered worlds of "The Brink" in search for truth in this 2D turn-based RPG. Draw strength from mysterious beings called the Lost Whispers and pay the ultimate price to recover the long lost truth.

games.name: Connect
games.summary: Connect is an RPG inspired by Mother 2: A story about unexpected phenomena that occur in the world. Billy, the person affected by this matter, must set out to find the truth of the phenomenon. So he found out that....what had happened was so surreal.

games.name: A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy
games.summary: A Tale of Saviors: Garuda Academy is a 2D turn-based RPG with narrative storytelling. Set in a modern world 10 years after the mystic beast war.

games.name: Pearl Rising
games.summary:
You play as Pearl, a young cadet, woken up when your city is under attack by the Bugs. Your job is to secure the area and find out what's going on!
The only good bug is a dead bug, they say.

games.name: Dongeng Bayang Kulit
games.summary: Dongeng Bayang Kulit is a turn-based RPG that is loosely based on Southeast Asian folklore. You play as the recently ship-less, Captain N'man and his mystical guide, Putri Matami as they travel in search for answers regarding a mysterious apparition that has taken to incessantly haunting N'man.

games.name: Sugary Shifter
games.summary: Sugary Shifter is a short, turn-based RPG that is easy to understand and finish without any guides. It features graphics inspired by 1980s video games.

games.name: Sojourn Through the Decade
games.summary: An autobiographical game focusing on the ten years of creating worlds and its respective characters, with The Sojourner seeing how his stories have fared since then.

games.name: Stellar Bewitching Remastered
games.summary: A Remastered version of the game "Stellar Bewitching!" With brand new character redesigns and art done by Berry B! A Sci-Fi turn-based RPG that takes place parallel to the events of Rave Heart. Featuring teenage drama, touching storylines, and boss battles the likes of which will test your turn-based knowledge!

games.name: Into Samomor
games.summary: A psychological horror action RPG where everyone can be eliminated and your choices change the entire plot.

games.name: Whispering Dream
games.summary: Aisly is a little boy who was having his sweet dream after a long time. Different from the usual, he was engaged in quite a realistic dream. As he goes, someone was trying to wake him up from his sleep...?

games.name: Luciel Angel Mission
games.summary: This is the story of the apprentice angel 'Luciel' who loves to study about the world. Once upon a time, all 3 worlds were ruled by God. after the war between The angels are led by 'Lucifer' the anti-God. Defeated and expelled, but then one day he disappeared, no one knew where he was. and gave the mission to Luciel for some reason.

games.name: The Haunted House
games.summary: Our heroine "Mikae Mitsu" lived in a house with his aunt after the death of her parents. Mikae was in the house when she woke up and saw the letter placed on her table. But she didn't care Because it was everywhere the water was going anywhere Mikae went to the bathroom. Enough to come back to the room, but suddenly, something unusual happened. Because of a sudden noise from behind her when she turned around, she discovered that a ghost had broken into the house, and Mikae hurried to hide, she began to feel anxious and afraid Then Mikae So find a way to get out of this house.

games.name: Prenup Struggles
games.summary:
Prenup Struggles is the game that is about the story of a young man from Buriram who wants to marry a woman, yet he wasn't able to do that because of the high prenup from the woman's father.

The young has no choice, but to move to the new city to fulfill his dream

Or not?

games.name: Protective Clothing
games.summary: Five people found themselves in a secluded, abandoned factory. Abducted for unknown reasons, the victims are faced with deadly traps as trust degrades by the minutes.

games.name: Legends of Crystal
games.summary: Legends of Crystal is a turn-based RPG that blends two cultures, namely Nusantara and Japan. It tells the story of a child chosen by a god who must save a crystal from evil. The crystal is divided into 6 powers due to the greed of jinns and mythical creatures in the past.

games.name: Missing Love
games.summary: In the early 2000s Somewhere in America, There is a serial killer who calls himself the Love Killer who likes to murder any couple indiscriminately For five years, you'll play Elijah Sanders, a private investigator whose partner is Lieutenant Anthony Williams. victim woman named Kate Hernandez.

games.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
games.summary: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

games.name: Farewell, My Dearest Love
games.summary: What if the only room for an overnight stay is haunted by supernatural stories? Can you survive until morning?

games.name: 77Survival Part I
games.summary: 77Survival is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players will control four characters who accidentally find themselves stranded on the rooftop of a 77-story building. Their mission is to survive as long as possible or venture down to the first floor to uncover the mysterious events happening in the building. Each character has unique abilities, allowing them to solve puzzles and complete missions. If all four characters die, the game is over.

games.name: There's an Only One Way Exit.
games.summary:
Dream is kindly illusion. Find the way to wake up, find the truth beneath the fog.

An interactive RPG game that you is someone who struck in the dream place, find the way to exit, true or lie this is no fault, it only meet the end.

games.name: Touhou The Excalibur: Mystic Arena of Reversal Spirits
Shepherd’s Plan
games.summary: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

games.name: Phantom Stars
games.summary: A Visual Novel of an investigating-dating idols: “When a new police officer has to go undercover as an 'idol group leader' to solve a case.”

games.name: Ann
games.summary: Ann, an art student finds herself trapped in the school when she accidentally broke one of the school's rules. With the help of the school's security guard, help Ann navigate her way out and uncover the secrets of the school before she becomes a permanent resident of the school.

games.name: MimiCries
games.summary: Investigate the mysteries of a haunted mansion as you solve various challenging puzzles in this Victorian-inspired, narrative-driven escape room game. With only your wit and a lantern to light the way forward, will the choices you make seal your fate, or open the path to freedom?

games.name: Tragedy Theater
games.summary: Tragedy Theater is an RPG Maker Horror game. You'll get the thrill of being chased by those mascots. Don't get caught. Help your friend, result puzzles and choose the choice that won't make our boy out of his mind.

games.name: Jigoku Train
games.summary:
Waking up to an unfamiliar place, what course of action will you choose?

Play as Ling, your average office worker having her usual shifts and living her usual life, woke up on the train one night, finding that she was not going to head to her usual destinations.

Not only that, you will also play another character! He wakes up with no memories on a train heading towards an unknown location. Grant is your average amnesiac guy.

Where are they heading, and what can they do in order to head back home? Or is there even any way home?

games.name: Mary Had A Lost Lamb
games.summary: Mary Had A Lost Lamb is a exploration psychological horror RPG Maker game on a microorganism who is finding her lamb. Do be aware this game is very dialogue heavy.

games.name: Twilight Horizon
games.summary: A surreal sci-fi horror RPG. Play as two protagonists, trapped in two doomed realities. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and survive industrial nightmares in a haunting journey through the Twilight Zone.

games.name: Loneliness Butterfly
games.summary:
Loneliness Butterfly marks the thrilling conclusion of Arachne's Anthology trilogy.

Picking up right after the events of Realm of Lament, this installment introduces Eddy Ruina, Feedra's wife and a lieutenant in Measuryville. Alerted by Penelope's email regarding Thomas's disappearance, Eddy joins the search. Their investigation leads them back to the events of Carnival, where they uncover the existence of the Soul Realm Gate, a potential path to Thomas. But is it truly that simple?

games.name: Rave Heart
games.summary: A Turn-Based Sci-FI RPG. Journey into the Galaxy of Xerxes and play as Klein, A Cipher, and personal bodyguard to Princess Ellemine, as he finds himself entangled in the ongoing struggle between the Errans and Draconians.

games.name: Love Esquire
games.summary: Love Esquire is a romantic-comedy dating simulator, with a nostalgic touch of old-school RPG combat. Lots of plots and backstories!

games.name: Adventure in Wachirawit World
games.summary: In this game, you will go on an adventure in Wachirawit's world.

games.name: Heroes of the Seasons
games.summary: Heroes of the Seasons is a turn-based boss-rush RPG. Hire 3 mercenaries to defend Christmas from Christmas haters who offer challenging battles. Customize & build your party with different mercenary compositions & equipment builds. Decorate your home & get to know your people.

games.name: BlueSkies 3
games.summary: BlueSkies 3 is a 2D fantasy turn-based JRPG featuring a magical world full of wonders. Journey with the young oracle named Candace Aethelmey and her friends, as they venture forth to join the Arcane Mastery Tournament. Along the way, they find new friends and unravel magical mysteries.

games.name: Wholesome: Heartdrawn
games.summary: Wholesome: Heartdrawn is a Turn-Based RPG and adventure game about Lyra, who creates her world to imagine her memories to escape from some things. Explore real and imagined worlds, and go on adventures. Lead Lyra and help her handle everything.

games.name: Gallium
games.summary: Play as a cool-looking knight and slay the Dark Lord in the world of Gallium!

games.name: Escape from the Cursed Convent
games.summary: Escape from the Cursed Convent is a narrative-driven adventure game set in a medieval girls' convent, offering a rich storytelling experience, and several gameplay styles including QTE, hunting, cooking, and puzzle-solving.

games.name: Exist.EXE
games.summary: Play as a game developer trapped in a digital world, hacking the environment to find a way out in his journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Cage: Story of Lust
games.summary: The story of the love of a fallen angel with a beloved angel. You have to make him love you and make this world colorful again!!

games.name: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy
games.summary: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy is an RPG Maker horror game that reimagines the Gorgons’ origin story, offering a fresh perspective on the ancient myth. Step into the role of Medyuu, a beautiful lamia with unsettling secrets. Her sisters seem to glimpse something different in her—a haunting gaze that pulls her into a path of strange encounters and eerie discoveries.

games.name: WiThu, It's Time To Go
games.summary: WiThu, It's Time To Go is an RPG Maker Horror puzzle game. You wake up in a familiar place. Something that everyone has is called a name, but you don't. Searching for who we are and the truth of these things. The adventures in mysterious lands are waiting for you.

games.name: Restoring Falmay
games.summary: An RPG about saving a fairy's homeland.

games.name: Khodam: The Contract
games.summary: A True First-Person Psychological Horror game inspired by Indonesian folklore about the protective unseen spirit, 'Khodam.' Play as Dara, a famous Southeast Asian horror streamer, as she unravels strange anomalies and seeks to uncover her true identity.

games.name: Find The Truth
games.summary: Find The Truth is a horror RPG puzzle game that revolves around a girl who has lost her memory due to an accident, and her journey to reclaim her lost memories. Your actions in the game will impact the story and lead to different outcomes.

games.name: Geomancers
games.summary: Geomancers is a PVP card game turn-based shooter where you command powerful elemental magic from a wide array of spells of your own choosing to destroy and create terrain, manipulate your mana and spells, or even summon powerful creatures to fight by your side.

games.name: The Stars Under Lockehurst
games.summary:
The Stars Under Lockehurst is a romantic supernatural mystery visual novel about a grad student visiting their friend in the small coastal town, Cape Lockehurst. Here, they unravel the mysteries behind recent disappearances and peculiar happenings around town.

Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s Call of Cthulhu and similar works, this game explores fear of the unknown and the unknowable, featuring a cast of unique, romanceable characters (who just might be a little... fishy).

games.name: Open Fire
games.summary: Open Fire is a game boy style arcade game heavily inspired by old game boy games. The game puts together deck building, card collections, and a fun real time battle system. Explore and fight four different sectors, free the island, and collect all the cards! Then do it all again as your collection grows stronger.

games.name: White Room: Mind’s Prison
games.summary: White Room: Mind's Prison is a psychological horror game. You're not allowed to make any sound. Entities will make you scream. Stay quiet! The day counter will increase as you survive! Survive as long as possible.

games.name: I Need Space
games.summary: Travel across the universe with your nebulous companion the Cosmicat, together revitalizing planets and discovering the cosmic truth of the universe.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin
games.summary: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin is a dark fantasy roguelite with hex-based, turn-based tactical combat. Command your forces, make impactful choices, and navigate a realm consumed by sin—will you restore order or surrender to darkness?

games.name: Night Drive
games.summary: Welcome to "Night Drive," a driving simulator that challenges you to navigate a seemingly endless night in search of anomalies to break a mysterious loop.

games.name: Hacky
games.summary: Become an elite hacker in cyberpunk typing simulator. Infiltrate networks, steal data by typing simple commands. Unlocking new abilities as you go deeper. No coding skills needed.

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

games.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
games.summary: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a Wuxia hack n' slash game. Play as the great fighter, Zhāng Yì Xiàn, who seeks revenge for the death of his family at the hands of China's powerful Gāo Tiān Qí. Dive into a tale of revenge, redemption, martial arts, and intense swordplay.

games.name: Zlime: Return Of Demon Lord
games.summary: Enter the world of Zlime, an action Roguelike game where you'll embark on a thrilling adventure in a demonic realm. Experience an unique transformation system, devour your foes, enhance your powers, and battle your way to victory! Prepare for an exhilarating and challenging gameplay experience!

games.name: Magic Caster
games.summary: Dive into a fast-paced wizard world where drawing gestures becomes your power! Defeat monsters, unleash potent spells, and expertly navigate the bullet hell to experience a new level of gaming excitement.

games.name: Not Monday Cafe
games.summary:
Build and manage your cute cozy cafe while working studying or streaming.
Farming and serving delicious dishes to adorable animal customer in your cafe on the bottom of your screen, all while you're working on other tasks and enjoying your day.

games.name: The Cope
games.summary: The Cope is a 2D, point-and-click game that presents the fear of the unknown. Your night shift client service job as a janitor will start with you getting entangled in a series of strange stories in The Cope mansion. Work cleaning and serving your client and find the truth of this mansion of fear.

games.name: The Land Beneath Us
games.summary: The Land Beneath Us is a turn-based rogue-lite action dungeon crawler. Use powerful skill combos and stylish weaponry to battle your way through the Underworld known as Annwn. Defeat the Seven Lords and rescue The Creator and her vital Soul-Tech.

games.name: Guardian Tactics: Deck of the Chosen
games.summary: Command a squad of guardians in a thrilling deckbuilding, roguelike card battle to save the world from an Android army invasion. Fight, fall, learn, rise again!

games.name: Spirit Mancer
games.summary: Slash, Shoot and Break demons, Capture their spirits and summon them out into your battle in the beautiful yet dangerous world of Inferno, Fight against hordes of demons from Ars Goetia and stop the evil queen with the power of the Spirit Mancer.

games.name: The Quarantine
games.summary: Experience a blend of survival horror and strategic management. Fortify your base, manage resources, and scavenge for supplies in a world overrun by monstrous creatures and corrupted by blight blooms.

games.name: Complex Sky
games.summary: Complex Sky is a vertical, automation, floating, flippable city-building simulation in the sky

games.name: Town Keeper
games.summary: Build a rabbit town and defend against the Fluffy Empire. Strategically place buildings and manage resources as your settlement grows, facing increasingly challenging invasions. Each victory unlocks new ways to play, expanding your options.

games.name: Astral Break
games.summary: Astral Break is a fusion of mech and roguelite action. Experience thrilling "thrust" controls that propel you through dynamic dungeons. Collect diverse modular armors to refine your combat style and experiment with endless synergies to craft your ultimate hero!

games.name: Overhours
games.summary: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

games.name: The Hell: City Builder of the Dead
games.summary: Welcome to the city-building game set in the depths of Hell. Assume the role of the Hell Governor and embrace the challenge of welcoming souls who perished in major, historically accurate human catastrophes. Are you ready to build and govern your own infernal city?

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: Kill The Music
games.summary: Auto-Attack to the Beat of the Music and Hit Rhythm Inputs to boost your Damage! Build up your Solo Meter to trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to mow down hordes of enemies!

games.name: Mirth Island
games.summary: You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!

games.name: Kyrie and Terra
games.summary: Explore Grand Terra's fantasy world through a Japanese RPG. Recruit Celestia, customize them, and gather skill cards and equipment to build your unique party. Save the world in this epic tale of money's power.

games.name: Lost Heaven Station
games.summary: Lost Heaven Station is a game BASE Build-Colony-Sim for players to manage crew to survive in their train and travel to find a ‘Lost Heaven’

games.name: Cats and Seek: Dino Park
games.summary: John and Emily are on a date to Dino Park. Turns out, not only are there lots of dinosaurs, but there are also many cats playing and hiding there ! Let's play hide and seek with the cats in Dino Park! Can you find them all?

games.name: Cats Around Us: Giant Cat
games.summary: We've hidden numerous cats in a silent comic about a giant cat causing chaos in a village. Can you find all those cats?

games.name: Cats and Seek: Kyoto
games.summary: Hi folks! In this third series, we will explore Kyoto and greet the cats there Let's play hide and seek with the cats in Kyoto!

games.name: Falling Rain
games.summary: Falling Rain is a third-person anime shooting RPG game with advance movement mechanic. Immerse yourself in a post apocalypse world and experiences the character struggle and follow the character to the end of their story.

games.name: Eat the Rich
games.summary: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

games.name: Dinner Defenders
games.summary: Protect your campfire cooking in Dinner Defenders, a roguelike tower defense game. Summon units and utilize combination of their skills and synergies to fend off the hungry goblins and orcs. Survive, and finally have your well-deserved meal in the middle of forest!

games.name: Not My Part
games.summary: This is story about 'Grace' who is on her way to the Sunday Lake camp, but something happens that makes her meet a famous serial killer at a motel along the way. In this horror movie-like scenario, what role will she play?

games.name: Blades of Mirage
games.summary: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

games.name: Trade Tales
games.summary: A cozy farming simulation meets entrepreneurial adventures. Create your legacy, Immerse yourself in a world of creativity, social interactions, and unexpected twists. Shape your story, build your own brand, and discover the joy of life in "Trade Tales." Your adventure begins now

games.name: Lola's Lutong Bahay
games.summary: Lola's Lutong Bahay is an immersive Filipino cooking simulation game where players step into the shoes of Dalisay, a budding chef learning traditional recipes from her beloved grandmother, Lola Felicia. Explore vibrant kitchen settings, master authentic Filipino cooking techniques, and embark on a flavorful journey to recreate iconic dishes. hone your culinary skills and celebrate the rich cultural heritage of Filipino cuisine in this heartwarming game.

games.name: Hotelnomaly
games.summary: Hotelnomaly is an endless loop anomaly hunt game where you play as a mechanic hired to fix an elevator in a lonely 1930s hotel. Discover eerie anomalies, navigate haunted corridors, and uncover dark secrets.

games.name: Destiny of Heroes
games.summary: Destiny of Heroes is a twin-stick, squad-based shooter set in occupied Indonesia at the end of World War II. Fighting Dutch and Japanese colonizers, you will lead the struggle for independence, in a heroic struggle against foreign tyrants. Liberty or death!

games.name: Scribblemania
games.summary:
Dive into a chaotic and surreal adventure where your artistic imagination is your greatest weapon! When your late-night spaceship sketch tears open reality, you and your best friend are thrust into an alien world teeming with bizarre creatures, quirky puzzles, and hilarious encounters.

Use your magical doodle device to draw shapes that come to life — smashing obstacles, fighting foes, and solving mind-bending challenges. Will your artistic genius save the day or destroy it? Grab your stylus and sketch your way to survival!

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: DreadHaunt
games.summary: Join the hunts as 5 agents in this multiplayer Co-op & PVP about horror and deception. One of you will be possessed then become a ghost, and the others must survive the haunting!

games.name: Comma
games.summary: Comma is a side-scrolling game that tells the story of a dream world where the player has to get out of there by following a mysterious figure.

games.name: Temukung: Cultivation in Drylands
games.summary: Live on driest land in Indonesia, The Timorese adapted this difficult situation with corn’s cultivation, but the imperialism created disruption in Timor. Now get ready to manage Timor’s farming as Temukung and face many difficult situations in Timor from middle 19th century until World War II

games.name: Parasomnia
games.summary: What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

games.name: Super Senseless Soccer
games.summary: The best football rogue-lite ever made! Super Senseless Soccer has a unique twist: start with a normal football game, then add a large variety of illegal modifiers and game-changing Upgrade Tickets in order to trigger ridiculous combos. It's super! It's senseless! It's SOCCER!!!

games.name: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name
games.summary: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name is a tactical rhythm RPG featuring a frail doctor in training named Hazuki who struggles with her new life of being part of a criminal organization disguised as a local restaurant.

games.name: Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends
games.summary: Qisah Tomang: Cycle Ends is a story-rich RPG. The story is set in an East Asia inspired fantasy world. Fight off the Demon Tomang and its minion and discover the truth behind the Cycle of Hatred and put an end to it in this classic pixel RPG.

games.name: Northwind
games.summary: Northwind is a monster-hunting roguelite deckbuilder with a tug-of-war combat twist, card crafting, and a mana management system inspired by Magic: The Gathering.

games.name: Robo Frenzy
games.summary: Build and battle in Robo Frenzy! Create dozens of weapons and construct inventions to crush gigantic gadgets in a sandbox action game that blends crafting with combat.

games.name: Identifile
games.summary:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

games.name: Plushie from the Sky
games.summary: A charming souls-like hack & slash. Play as a little fallen angel, explore dreamy landscapes, shoot down corrupted monsters and fight challenging bosses with a plushie.

games.name: Himig
games.summary: Himig is a cozy game about experiencing the calm, everyday moments of life, making memories and finding joy from little, mundane things, and letting those serve as an inspiration to shape the future ahead of you.

games.name: Table Flip Simulator
games.summary: Had a stressful day? Blow off some steam in Table Flip Simulator! This physics-based puzzler allows you to unwind as you throw or smash items with hilarious effects. From working as a barista to becoming the President of Antarctica, you can go beyond flipping the table – the world is yours to wreck!

games.name: Seed of Heroes
games.summary: Seed of Heroes is a bullet heaven game where players take on the role of warriors seeking glorious battles and get into the halls of Valhalla. Journey through various realms, take on hordes of enemies, collect treasures, and defeat bosses that will try to stop you. Pass the trials and tribulations and prepare for the Ragnarok.

games.name: Arsonate
games.summary: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

games.name: Jeepney Stories
games.summary: Jeepney Stories is a heartwarming, slice-of-life, funny and chill visual novel about family, chances, getting old and living in the third world.

games.name: Potion Promise
games.summary: In a medieval fantasy world, a young witch finds herself inheriting a massive debt from her parents. With only 30 days to repay it, she must rely on her potion-making skills and cunning to gather rare ingredients and fulfill the demands of her customers, while uncovering shocking truths behind.

games.name: Riftstorm
games.summary: Storms are coming, and there are rules you must follow. RIFTSTORM is co-op looter-shooter set in a world of myth and secret societies where you can play solo or co-op in a party of three.

games.name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
games.summary: "Thou Shalt Not Kill" is a VHS-style first-person walking simulator horror game. You play as Angel, a girl traveling through the forest who finds a VHS tape lying on the ground. She starts watching it, only to discover that the footage is unsettling and tells a mysterious story. As you watch the entire tape, you realize this is no ordinary VHS footage, and you are shocked by its revelations.

games.name: Craggenrock
games.summary: Craggenrock is a crafting shop management game taking place on a remote island after a great disaster. You play as Arlo, a young crafter seeking a name of his own replacing his former crafting master in the mining town of Pareho.

games.name: Garuda Emblem
games.summary:
Garuda Emblem is a beat ‘em up game with a taste of RPG content, where you can roam freely in the game’s beautifully hand-drawn world, get immersed in the story, and be the good journalist you are.

Play as Garuda Emblem members, a journalistic student activity unit that uncovers the truth behind the shady part of UNION. As the story unfolds, you’ll encounter various figures that’ll help you along in the journey. You can also upgrade your characters with different skills and abilities using your accumulated experience by beating your enemies to pulp!

Got bored of the main story? Refresh yourself with various side quests and mini games you can discover around the game’s world! Who knows, there might be secrets lying right in front of you all along!

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

games.name: Potion Punch Rivals
games.summary: Potion Punch Rivals puts your shopkeeping, potion punching skills to the test. Race against your rival to see who can take orders first, prep fastest, and serve best.

games.name: Poradora vs. Monsters of the World
games.summary: Poradora vs. Monsters of the World is a 2.5D action-adventure platformer where you travel across the coolest places on earth to defeat all the monsters and find all the mythological secret there! Now let's jump, shoot, slide, and defeat all the monsters! LET'S GO!

games.name: The Sun Shines Over Us
games.summary: An award-winning visual novel that dives into the lives and minds of high school students. While focusing on the stories of victims of bullying, The Sun Shines Over Us also explores the social, mental and emotional issues facing modern teenagers.

games.name: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
games.summary: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

games.name: Koibito no Nazo: Lover's Enigma
games.summary: In Lover's Enigma, you investigate your husband's mysterious death while balancing complex relationships and personal trauma. Navigate a web of secrets involving a hidden cult and key characters. Your choices shape the story and lead to multiple endings.

games.name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
games.summary: Build your diner. Grow exotic ingredients and create a menu for your intergalactic guests. Send expeditions to outer worlds in search of loot. Form alliances and rivalries with powerful factions and shape the fate of the galaxy. Welcome to the Diner at the End of the Galaxy.

games.name: Love In Tiny Spaces
games.summary: A bite sized quickie of a game, find your girlfriend and avoid her parents [and neighbours!] in this humorous tongue-in-cheek top-down stealth game! Navigate the corridors of the big city - then change it up using the powers of the Love Transport Authority(LTA), with love as your guide.

games.name: Jet Scalawag: The King of Shooters
games.summary: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! Jet Scalawag faces down the evil alien armada through time and space on worlds and expanses never before seen!

games.name: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers!
games.summary: Yay! Spring Trip with My Coworkers! is a Visual Novel created for Blossom VN Jam 2024 and Fuck Capitalism Jam 2024 as it's about a trip full of fun spring activities and complaining about your job.

games.name: Melan
games.summary: In Melan, the player as An will go everywhere and collect memories, thereby revealing some of what is happening in the game. The game is built in a storytelling format with situations that the player gradually discovers through interacting with the environment and NPCs.

games.name: Ticking Tea Time
games.summary:
A catastrophic bomb is rumored to have been planted by a notorious spy from the West. According to an inside source, the spy fled the scene aboard first-class cabin of Hesperia Express. As Eastside's top detective, you must go undercover as a train waiter to solve this mystery. Serve afternoon tea to investigate suspect passengers, all while a bomb ticks down and a national catastrophe looms.

Can you make the spy spill the tea?Serve up your investigation in Ticking Tea Time!

games.name: Talents
games.summary: Write your way to success with your talented yet rowdy co-founders in this game development-themed romance visual novel! Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Kriegsfront Tactics
games.summary: Kriegsfront Tactics is a procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia where you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Build your mecha squad, complete missions, and survive the front another day.

games.name: Unyielder
games.summary: Unyielder is an intense Boss-Rush Movement-Shooter with a flexible and exploitable Roguelite-Looter sandbox. Carve your way through the war-torn lands of Antarctica, Hunt down war machines and Assemble your arsenal of destruction.

games.name: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream
games.summary: Teenagers, Dreams, and Drugs. Unveil the secrets of South Jayakarta city, set two years after the ending of the original Troublemaker. The journey of the “Parakacuk” gang continues alongside the “Beyond Dream” band in South Jayakarta city in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

games.name: Verde
games.summary: Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations, and help the seedlets thrive!

games.name: Tanasurga
games.summary: Tanasurga is an Narrative driven RPG where you play as mecha mercenaries in alternate WW2 setting. Build your own mecha, recruit and lead a team of pilots with different characteristics and skills. Gain riches and determine how the war unfolds between 3 main factions.

games.name: Problem Solver Club
games.summary: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

games.name: Memento Dawn
games.summary: A colorful puzzle game that follows a lost child on a journey to search for her memories and helps her through the darkness by controlling light and shadow.

games.name: Garland Boy
games.summary: GARLAND FOR SALE! A game about a boy who earn his living by selling flower garlands to cars waiting in a traffic light at the intersection. Save enough money and follow his big dream. When the traffic light turns red, your job begins!

games.name: Onward: Asylum
games.summary: Going onwards as we escape this horrific asylum— an indie 2D horror sidescroller where your task is to get out of the facility without getting captured by the monster itself.

games.name: Keyboard Warrior RPG
games.summary: From the co-creator of Good Knight, master the Art of Combat Typing! Keyboard Warrior RPG is a typing game that mixes Roguelike, Dungeon RPGs, Beat Em Up, and Fighting Games in this beautifully styled game. An educational game to improve your typing skills and reading speed and learn foreign languages.

games.name: Larut
games.summary: A visual novel that retells the story of Nyai Roro Kidul.

games.name: Terminal Error
games.summary: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

games.name: Elimora
games.summary: Master Elemental Creatures in real-time deck-building adventure! Explore a fantasy world filled with magical creatures. Collect spirit fragments to summon and evolve companions, use cards to unleash powerful abilities, and uncover the secrets of the mystical realm to prevent its destruction.

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Graveless
games.summary: Graveless is a single-player third person dungeon crawler Hack and Slash Action RPG set in the realm of chaos when immortality is no longer a myth and fiction.

games.name: Starship Scramble
games.summary: Play an arena shooter roguelite where you build your own ship and survive through enemies' attack. You can even customize individual weapons, turning each one into a unique and formidable tool of destruction.

games.name: Tale of Ren: Searching for Heart Droplets
games.summary: Me...Mizu Ren Nanami… As a REN people, it's time to go on a mission to conquer the hearts of people in other realms. Then, the Rostania is the town where I was chosen to come here. to the pursuit of secrets that were never known before.

games.name: Fossilpunk
games.summary: Lead space dino settlers to rebuild your civilization and rise again! Start cities, expand borders, grow your economy, and master tactical battles. Unleash epic dino combos in this turn-based strategy game with 4X and Roguelite elements. Rawr!

games.name: Until Then
games.summary:
Mark, an average irresponsible high school student, tries to get by and find purpose in a humdrum life of scrolling, cramming, and traffic. He meets friends, both old and new, and embarks upon a seemingly never-ending trouble, until nothing is ever the same again.

Until Then is a contemporary adventure game inspired by the Philippines, its lifestyle, and culture. Featuring a smartphone where mechanics of modern living come into play, chat with your classmates and explore the depths of social networks, where your replies and interactions may pose consequences.

games.name: HR Simulator
games.summary: An HR management simulator about navigating workplace dynamics, hiring and training a diverse workforce, and balancing professional growth with personal life in a bustling cityscape.

games.name: Scarred
games.summary: Scarred is a first-person atmospheric horror puzzle game where you must uncover the truth about one of your schoolmates before it’s too late. Traverse a world of nightmares inspired by nostalgic Singaporean architecture as you fight to survive.

games.name: Afterlove EP
games.summary: Afterlove EP is a slice-of-life adventure about love, loss and music. Explore modern Jakarta as Rama in his journey to learn about himself, create music, find love and come to terms with the loss of his girlfriend Cinta, whose voice still lives on in his head.

games.name: Repeat After Death
games.summary: The task is simple, defeat enemies using various Characters. But, your past move will consume you the more you continue down the path. Discover the dungeon mysteries while engaging with the other dungeon dwellers

games.name: Rootmare
games.summary: Step into a world where the pursuit of beauty leads to unimaginable horror. As Nate, face off against mutated monstrosities and navigate a labyrinth of danger with limited resources. Expose the truth behind COSMIC’s experiments, while not succumbing to the nightmare within.

games.name: Weldiver
games.summary:
Each mission in Weldiver is a journey into the ocean’s depths, where players undertake the challenging work of maintaining offshore structures, performing emergency repairs, and replacing seabed infrastructure like optical cables, pipelines, and power lines.

Forty times more likely to die than the average worker... and every time I go down, the pressure waits. Trying to make me implode, drown, freeze... or worse.

games.name: Golf by the Way
games.summary: A fast-paced real-time mini-golf party game with no stroke count! Play as an actual golfer in real-time and go smack your friends’ golf ball or even your friends themselves.

games.name: Arsenic & Absinthe
games.summary: Arsenic & Absinthe is a blend of a chill bartender simulation with narrative-driven story. The player takes on the role of "Sylene", a bartender who recently began a new life; making drinks, serving unusual recipes of art, and listening to the stories of working-class customers. A simple life, however, is merely a dream for her as her haunted past returns. The player has to explore the night city and solve the pre-midlife crisis while getting caught in the notorious "Snow White" murder case once more.

games.name: Left Behind
games.summary: Left Behind is a hyper-realistic psychological horror game where you take on the role of a real estate agent with a client looking to sell you a property. Instead of a straightforward and quick interaction with the client, you find yourself thrust into a deeply unsettling and frightening situation.

games.name: Quacker Bros: First Heist
games.summary: Defend your loot from chicken mafias in this chaotic roguelike tower defense. Recruit unique duck defenders and unleash a barrage of wild attacks to protect your treasure!

games.name: The Chef's Shift
games.summary: The Chef’s Shift is a fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING.

games.name: Roguematch: The Extraplanar Invasion
games.summary: Roguematch is a Fantasy Turn based Rogue-like fused into a Match-3 layout, giving players many more ways to get out of challenging situations! With so much raw elemental magic at your command, theres even more to do than just smack and bash your way through creatures from the extraplanar realms!

games.name: Pryzm
games.summary: A survival adventure mystery with turn-based combat and escape parameters that change with every new 1 to 2-hour run. A visual novel that can be played like a speedrun.

games.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.summary: Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Who Murdered My Empress?
games.summary: “Who Murdered My Empress?” is a visually stunning romance visual novel set in a fantastical realm inspired by 19th century Vietnam. Assume the role of an Empress with a lavish harem of captivating men as you navigate intrigue, love, and mystery.

games.name: Cool Kid Cody
games.summary: In a world of Losers, Cool Kids and Gods, where Losers wish they were Cool Kids, Cool Kids wish they were Gods and Gods rule over all, Cool Kid Cody embarks on his quest for Godhood! All he's gotta do is achieve the impossible: transform the biggest Loser in school into a Cool Kid.

games.name: Pastopia
games.summary: Become a Memory Walker in Pastopia and restore the mystical lands of Talmanu. In this open-world adventure, team up with your Golem A.I companion to explore vast environments, solve puzzles, and unleash your creativity. Discover the lost memories of Pastopia and shape your own adventure!

games.name: Livingmare Cold Calls
games.summary: Your only fear is the fear of the unknown.

games.name: The Scourge
games.summary: The Scourge game tells stories revolving around urban legends from the 1990s in Saigon, Vietnam. The male protagonist is trapped by past sins caused by his and his family's mistakes. Now, he must confront and overcome the consequences to find a path to redemption, and you are him.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Ganyang Setan Alas: The Game
games.summary: Ganyang Setan Alas! The Game is a single-player shooter set in a haunted Indonesian forest, where four students, armed with a range of weapons, must survive relentless zombie attacks and escape a cursed fate.

games.name: Towerful Defense
games.summary: A roguelike tower defense where you control a single tower to fight against hordes of aliens coming from all directions. Pick your tower, equip up to 4 skills, and choose from a variety of traits and unique effect items to craft powerful builds that lead you to victory.

games.name: Of Blood and Descent
games.summary: A roguelike strategy RPG where each expedition shapes a multi-generational legacy. Explore, recruit allies, and continue your adventure through your descendants.

games.name: Relic Abyss
games.summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...

games.name: Divine Guardian
games.summary: Explore the enchanted Vietnamese jungle, combat mystical monsters, and rescue creatures on your quest to challenge the gods and restore harmony to the Universe as the DIVINE GUARDIAN, immerse yourself in an epic 2D hand-drawn refreshing adventure.

games.name: Playing God
games.summary: Speedrun your way across the nine circles of hell through 100 levels in this ultra fast-paced precision platformer, rebelling against the mysterious entity playing god.

games.name: Baro Kart
games.summary: Help Baro and his friends to save the universe from the evil witch doctor, race is the main challenge, and you are the savior.

games.name: Sticker Delight
games.summary: Sticker Delight is a short and playful cozy sticker game about completing errands to prepare New Year's dinner for family and friends. Play with stickers inside the game.

games.name: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged
games.summary: Thousands Layered Blade: Reforged is an action-packed action RPG game that immerses players in a stunning 3D world inspired by traditional sumi-e art, now enhanced with realistic brush stroke simulations.

games.name: Blackblade Revenant
games.summary: Blackblade Revenant is a Sekiro-like action RPG with parry-focused combat set during the fall of an ancient dynasty. Rise from the dead as Revenants and return to the mortal realm with one mission: Kill the King who cheated death.

games.name: Operatives: Revolve
games.summary: A cinematic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are physically activated "Machines". Enemies can strike, pierce, or bomb them to pieces. Install multiple components to modify your cards, and set off cascading chain reactions to destroy your enemies.

events.name: 2024 Indie Showcase Event
events.description: First ever indie showcase by Lone Wulf Studio LLC. Come see what cool projects indie devs have been up to in 2024

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Decline's Drops
games.summary: Grab your punching gloves, put your clogs on and smash your way in the world of Decline's Drops, a fully hand-drawn platform-brawler full of weird frogs, bizarre chickens and odd hydras! Avenge your destroyed garden and defeat the 6 heads of the Eternal Corp.! If you can, that is.

games.name: Fogpiercer
games.summary: Build your train to build your deck. Fight off bandits in a post apocalyptic world. Progress and unlock new train combinations with synergies. Get drivers to their final destinations.

games.name: The Void: An Incremental Roguelite
games.summary: Roll the reels to determine the outcome of your attacks! An unique mix of luck, strategy and incremental elements comes together in this colorful roguelite; battle out against other lost souls in turn-based combat while traversing through the void, trying to find answers to what you are.

games.name: Dreamed Away
games.summary: Dreamed Away is an emotional action-adventure RPG with psychological horror elements. Play as Théo, a boy lost in a dark, mysterious world. Explore a unique reality, duel against darkness in a unique, fast paced combat system and mind your choices.

games.name: Project_Structure_01
games.summary: Project_Structure_01 is first-person exploration game focusing on atmosphere and exploration of surreal liminal spaces that feature brutalist architecture.

games.name: Vaporwave Pinball
games.summary: Play LoFi digital pinball in a variety of cosy, chill locations. Explore a 90s operating system to find new worlds. Uncover hidden, corrupted files. For a couple of hours, escape the real world. Vaporwave Pinball is the ultimate "virtual holiday" destination.

games.name: Zooika
games.summary: Zooika is a casual puzzle game where you match animals in order to create a larger animal. It's a Suika style game with animals, leaderboards, challenges and achievements.

games.name: Grapplers: Relic Rivals
games.summary: Engage in fast-paced local PvP matches while unearthing ancient relics and harnessing their power to conquer your rivals. Dodge deadly traps, utilize your grappling hook, activate mystical runes, and master each relic to defeat your opponents and reign victorious in this thrilling PvP platformer!

games.name: Draconia
games.summary:
Play as one of six different dragon species and take over the sky or the land.
Follow the path of Taruk and uncover the story behind Draconia through quests, secret locations and various characters in singleplayer and multiplayer mode.

If you don’t want to play alone, join others in a multiplayer game or invite your friends to join your group or clan and level your characters together.

games.name: Out Of Memories
games.summary:
A surreal, minimalist spooky ride through impossible geometry, deadly traps and caustic commentary from the observers of the player's attempt to stay alive for just a little longer, as a toxin kills them little by little.

The game has text graphics and uses the character set from the original PC from 1981. It's presented as if running on that hardware, on a green phosphor monitor - with just a hint of red.

games.name: Alterium Shift
games.summary: Join three heroes in training as they learn to master their individual strengths and harness the power of Alterium Essence. With their training nearly completed, Dolion, their teacher, prepares them for the most important mission they've faced yet.

games.name: Berserker's Domain
games.summary: BERSERKER'S DOMAIN is a fast-paced, unhinged retro FPS freakshow with a roguelike loop, inspired by classics like Blood, Quake 1-3, and Doom, as well as modern shooters like Dusk, ULTRAKILL, and Doom Eternal.

games.name: Floridale Man: The Joy of Chaos
games.summary: Welcome to the sunny state of Floridale! Make the most of your stay by causing problems on purpose, mingling with hotties and gators, and embracing the chaos of life in this comedy physics collectathon.

games.name: Cataverse MVP
games.summary: You are a free cat, among many just like you. Listen to your instincts. | Focus | Execute | Repeat | Learn from your mistakes. This is the path to the Cataverse MVP.

games.name: Robo Dome
games.summary: Compete in the famed Robo Dome championship as Rei Castor. Test your ability in this roguelite shoot em’ up against a barrage of enemies and projectiles. Face off against giant robots and other contestants in an attempt to come on top of this year’s Robo Dome championship in Valhalla City.

games.name: Mech Tech
games.summary: In MECH TECH, Up to 8 players or bots duke it out locally in fast-paced battles! Switch between action and strategy gameplay at any time! From within your Command Tank, deploy your forces to the battlefield and use powerful abilities. Exit the Command Tank to join the fight in a powerful Hero Mech!

games.name: Kook
games.summary: In this fast-paced, retro FPS game with a Quake-like feel, players will battle Lovecraftian monsters in a Victorian-era steampunk world using crazy weapons and navigating mind-bending gravity.

games.name: Gentoo Rescue
games.summary: A puzzler about sliding penguins and walruses. Pickup items to push, pull, bounce, swap, stop, steal, or explode. Solve tightly-designed challenges in a world of puzzles inside puzzles inside puzzles.

games.name: Fist of the Forgotten
games.summary: Jump, punch, and slide through the remnants of civilizations using forgotten artifacts to augment your movement and combat abilities on a journey to find the last human holdouts where your brother might be.

games.name: Asteroid Colony
games.summary: In this real time strategy city builder game you will help humanity reaching beyond earth by establishing a permanent and thriving settlement in the asteroid belt. Settling in space comes with enormous challenges and dangers, which you will have to guide your people through

games.name: Darkbound
games.summary: Darkbound is a survival horror game where you play as a cat. Avoid the darkness, solve puzzles and help other survivors to escape the hospital.

games.name: Alpine Lake
games.summary: Kick back in the fresh mountain air and craft your ideal haven on the shores of Alpine Lake! Build, and decorate your inn to bring joy and prosperity to the community. Welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Farm, cook, and entertain them in your own unique way!

games.name: Kity Builder
games.summary: Explore relaxing deserted islands and build cute cities over them as Kity, the builder cat. Customize the buildings and environment at your own pace in a peaceful, stress-free setting.

games.name: Screech
games.summary: In "Screech," play as Astrix, exploring The Academy's secrets. Use a compass to travel through time, solve puzzles, and uncover the past. Collect gears and shards to activate a machine that captures knowledge in a "Screech." Discover the mysteries in this captivating puzzle platformer.

games.name: Kvlt
games.summary: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

games.name: It Consumes
games.summary: It Consumes is a roguelite arena-FPS in the dark. See by beating your heart and kill demons shrouded in shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new weapons, and conquer what lurks in the darkness.

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Falinere Fantasy
games.summary: Falinere Fantasy is a turn-based RPG Dungeon Crawler played via Twitch Chat. Your viewers can change between 7 different classes (Druid, Alchemist, Crystalsmith, Bard, Warrior, Rogue, and Wizard) and run through dungeons, leveling up and gaining skills as they traverse the land.

games.name: Noneworld
games.summary: NONEWORLD is a cute RPG set in a dying world. You are a Princess from another world, accompanied by an omnipresent Cheshire Cat. Only YOU and your fruity colored allies can LIGHT THE WORLD and return home safely.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: Turnip Mountain
games.summary: In this hands-on climbing platformer, chart your own path as you reach, swing and soar to the summit!

games.name: Torso Tennis
games.summary: A sports-like roguelike. DRAFT & GRAFT cursed limbs. Get horrible tattoos. Become a Tennis God.

games.name: Hyperslice
games.summary: Fast paced action arena roguelike where you defeat waves of enemies using your dash. Slice through enemies or push them to survive. Upgrade and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.

games.name: Wizordum
games.summary: Wizordum is a retro-inspired FPS with a focus on action and light puzzles. It blends the best features of classic fantasy shooters from the 90s with some modern aspects making it a unique experience. Take the role of a Cleric and fight against Chaos that roams the land - smash, burn and loot!

games.name: Year Unknown
games.summary: A story-based exploration game about the very far future, where humanity has conquered the universe. With the help of two Artificial Intelligences, explore the conquered universe and uncover your purpose in it.

games.name: PaperKlay
games.summary: PaperKlay is a short and sweet 3D platformer where you unfold, open and rotate the paper environment in order to freely explore the cardboard world.

games.name: CatboyZoom
games.summary: Become a catboy and zoom through the many handcrafted worlds in this FPS Platforming Speedrunner! Master your control over the source-inspired movement system and leave your best times for others to challenge!

games.name: MeowGun: Hell Denizen
games.summary: Fast paced action first person shooter. Earth has been invaded by demons. The demon rulers have evil laws. They found out you're transgender and are now hunting you. Slaughter large masses of transphobic demons, zombies and other monsters in colorful environments. The game runs on FTEQW engine.

games.name: Pinball Spire
games.summary: Action adventure meets pinball in this one-of-a-kind pinballvania adventure. When a mysterious spire appears from thin air, it's up to an intrepid pinball to bump, spin, shoot, and flip its way to the top and solve the tower’s mysteries!

games.name: Block Shop
games.summary: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.

games.name: Null State
games.summary:
Null State is a moddable CRPG built on classic gameplay styles and themes found in cyberpunk games from the late 80s and early 90s.

Inspired by classic cyberpunk stories (& other, older tales of downtrodden folk heroes), you will be tasked with helping the people in your community until you discover that your world is barely holding together — and about to be pushed over the brink.

games.name: Another Round
games.summary:
Another Round is a deckbuilder / slots-style game. Your goal is to stay in business and make your cyberpunk cafe into a social hub which everyone in the community enjoys.

There is no timer or countdown clock putting pressure on you to make decisions quickly; you will not need to do a lot of math or rely on perfect play to have a good time.

games.name: One Last Job
games.summary: One Last Job is a moddable team management game, where you work to build your reputation as a fixer by successfully completing jobs with your crew.

games.name: Upstream
games.summary: Play as a salmon journeying home in this challenging physics based platformer using only two buttons! Remember that on a voyage through innumerable obstacles and constant danger, it is your reaction to adversity that determines your success.

games.name: ACUVAC: A Suck And Blow Adventure
games.summary: ACUVAC is a vacuum physics simulator with action-adventure elements! Suck! Blow! Swing your hose around! Perform various ridiculous challenges! Clean your way to victory!

games.name: Orange Roulette
games.summary: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets. Can he survive what his captors have freshly squeezed for him?

games.name: Escape from Mutation Station
games.summary: A short, unconventional escape room experience. You are the candidate. You must find a way out of this room. Things are not as they seem.

games.name: Axyz
games.summary: Axyz is a retro gravity switching puzzle game that asks the player to use their environmental and spatial awareness to beat each level within the time limit. Soak in the vaporwave, switch gravity, collect tapes, and more in this tribute to 90s puzzle games.

games.name: Into the Restless Ruins
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you build the dungeon you fight through. Each night use your cards to expand the ruins then battle through them harvesting Glimour from the residents, so The Maiden may grant your heart’s desire. But be warned - eventually your trespassing will awaken The Warden.

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Explore the open seas and uncover the kingdom's dark secrets as you expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear every step of the way!

games.name: Gridhack
games.summary: Gridhack is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where you fight nonogram battles to hack your way on an intergalactic quest as you try to find out what happened to a planet called.. Earth?

games.name: Tales From The Arcade: Fartmania
games.summary: Welcome to the whimsical world of "Fartmania"! Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey through the skies with our unconventional hero – a pig who defies gravity with the power of flatulence!

games.name: Lab 77
games.summary: The game you will love to make your friends play. In Lab 77 you play as Specimen S539-77, making your way through the challenges of Lab 77's test chambers under the supervision of the Director. Place versions of yourself to bridge gaps, collect lab notes, avoid dangers and complete your training.

games.name: Space Scavenger 2
games.summary: Space Scavenger 2 is an Action-Roguelike where you scavenge for modules to build a hodgepodge spaceship. Upgrade and customize your ship on-the-fly to make the best of a terrible situation. Playful and colorful - who said you can't smack aliens with a huge hammer in space?

games.name: Stig
games.summary: A sokoban-style puzzle game about finding a path through colors

games.name: Classic Sport Driving
games.summary: A retro racer for racing lines lovers! Get back to 1990, try to read the road ahead, brake as late as possible, avoid missing the apex, exit curves at the limit and reach the next checkpoint!

games.name: Iron Village
games.summary: With the help of your railway, build houses, farms, warehouses, and more to create your village. Trade what your people make for other resources and gold to grow your village into a prospering town, and grow the railway into a powerhouse.

games.name: Tales of Eldoria
games.summary: The sun is gone. In a world trapped in eternal moonlight, guide Liora and her companions through the Arcadia dungeons in a story driven JRPG about sacrifice and the bonds formed when the world is already broken.

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.summary: Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across North America with tight arcade racing controls. A hybrid of Rally and circuit racing, from rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track.

games.name: Tempus Bound
games.summary: Tempus Bound is an artistically-driven pixel platformer with physics, puzzles and a speed running mode. In a desolate world, you play as a mysterious bushbaby/owl/fox hybrid with a dark past. Scramble across the world of wind temples & swamplands to reach your ultimate destination.

games.name: Wild Cosmos
games.summary: You crashed into an unknown asteroid belt. Explore this alien world, leap between asteroids and find a way to repair your spaceship.

games.name: Upg
games.summary: upg (pronounced up-gee) is a fast-paced bullet heaven auto-shooter where you focus on movement while your weapons do the shooting. dash through procedurally generated levels, collecting upgrades and taking down waves of enemies.

games.name: Xenotilt: Hostile Pinball Action
games.summary: Lightning strikes again!! Xenotilt, the sequel to the cult hit, Demon's Tilt. Get ready for another pinball fantasy. Xenotilt shreds the envelope with face-melting gameplay & graphics.

games.name: Critter Crossfire
games.summary: A genre-breaking fusion of Turn-Based Tactics and First Person Shooting made by a solo developer. Position your units in a detailed 3D environment and skillfully aim your shots with physics-based weapons. Collect and combine items to build unique loadouts from over 50 wacky weapons and upgrades.

games.name: Nightshift Galaxy
games.summary: Play as a freelance mecha-pilot in a satirical anime-scifi setting. Arcade-style combat with transforming-robots, spider-tanks, and high-speed fighter-jets.

games.name: Code Bunny
games.summary:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

events.name: Dojo System Showcase 2025
events.description: In this special event, we bring you a brief summary of the exciting indie games that will be part of our ecosystem. 🚀 Games that will surely give you something to talk about and that will fill your hours of laughter, fear, and, above all, entertainment in the purest indie style.

games.name: Avy, Fables of the Night
games.summary: Jump, glide, grab and throw items, push objects, make new friends and defeat your fears in dialogue-based battles to escape from the adorable nightmare island.

games.name: A-Red Walking Robot
games.summary: A-Red Walking Robot is a physics based toy robot simulator where you pilot tiny A-Red, a small clockwork operated robot that needs to overcome the trials it’s creator set in a workshop. A miniature nerve-wrecking/patience-proving journey where you are granted to fall… a lot.

games.name: The Bearer & The Last Flame
games.summary: The Bearer & The Last Flame is a dark fantasy action adventure. In a realm where death is rampant, a living soul has received his commission, to carry the last flame and light the lands of the night, the dark lands.

games.name: Barraka
games.summary: Barraka is a claymation adventure game full of puzzles and surprises. Join our brave heroine as she explores the spooky fair in the small town. Along the way, she will encounter weird and wonderful characters and challenges. You will also have fun with bumper cars, whack-a-mole, the haunted house, a mini circus and more! Barraka is a game that will delight your senses and imagination.

games.name: Die by Anything
games.summary: Welcome to Die by Anything! Make the right choices to survive a “normal day” in the ordinary life of a student or die trying in ways you would never imagine. Trust nothing, no one and try to survive as you figure out what's going on.

games.name: Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure
games.summary: Welcome to "Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure"! You're an amphibious dinosaur with the power of water. Face challenges, recover your stolen egg from a ninja, and surf in championships. 2D Jurassic action awaits!

games.name: Neon Blood
games.summary: The dual Viridis, separated between the luxurious Bright City and the dangerous Blind City, where inequality reigns until you, Axel McCoin, an idealistic detective, start a revolution to change the world in this cyberpunk RPG adventure.

games.name: Impawlse
games.summary: Take care of your kittens, decorate their space, play with them.... It's all about kittens! The ultimate cat experience awaits you!

games.name: Kaodi
games.summary: Kaodi is a brief, narrative-driven 2D platformer experience where you control Barren on his journey back home after playing a key role in the victory over the Republic of Shan. Explore a kingdom fractured by war and discover the scars it has left on its people.

games.name: Smile Thief
games.summary: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

games.name: Among Ashes
games.summary: Among Ashes is a terrifying first-person survival horror game. Your friend has sent you a link to a game that someone posted online, but as you play you quickly realize that something is terribly wrong. Whatever you do… KEEP PLAYING

games.name: Luminaria: Dark Echoes
games.summary:
Welcome to Luminaria Dark Echoes, the thrilling roguelike action role-playing game that fuses the intensity of Vampire Survivors with the strategic depth of Dark Souls!

In an alternate universe where the Industrial Revolution took a bleak turn and light became a scarce treasure, a world war has left humanity on the brink of extinction. However, among the ruins, a few brave survivors resist. Now, a dark entity emerges, corrupting souls and plunging the world into deep darkness.

games.name: Mycelium Heaven
games.summary: It's a cozy yet challenging puzzle game about a mushroom that devours zombies. You'll expand, grow and consume your way through the forest using your wit and reason.

games.name: The Sinking Forest
games.summary: A Japanese survival horror game full of tension, drama, and violence. If you like psychological horror games with exploration, puzzles, and limited resources, you'll enjoy an intense experience where every decision can mean the difference between finding Sayuri or getting lost in the forest forever.

games.name: Panik
games.summary:
Don’t panic!
PANIK is a puzzle game where you have to guide different characters to the goal. Sounds easy... but, can you manage it without panicking?

The panikers are scared and can’t move!
Find out how to calm these creatures and guide them to safety. Complete over 100 levels spread across 8 unique worlds and uncover all the challenges.

Meet the panikers!
Have you seen the one wearing a crown? What about the one with the magician’s hat? Or the robot? There’s even a ninja! Each one has unique abilities to help (or not) you solve each puzzle.

games.name: The Cerpan Project
games.summary: Welcome to Project Cerpan! As a new test subject, you will have to go through countless puzzles and tests that will put your intelligence to the limit. Embark on this new Graphic Adventure with Red Salazar and discover what mysteries are happening in Calle Larga.

games.name: Why Did The Chicken Cross The Road?
games.summary: A pixel-art shooter roguelike with almost infinity of options to upgrade your weapons. Will you be able to fly the coop and find the answers that your people have been searching for years?

games.name: Dark Life Excalibur
