games.summary: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords is a multiplayer game in the Zelda series originally released together with The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past for the Game Boy Advance. The game has many features not seen in the series and it requires at least two people to play and uses randomly generated dungeons. During the game, players must collect as many Ruppees as possible while solving puzzles and defeating enemies. When enough Ruppees are collected, the Great Fairy will give the players a key to open the unlockable level. At the end of each level, the one who collects the most Ruppees will be the winner.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
games.summary: The Game Boy Advance port of A Link to the Past has some small design differences with the original version, like Link's voice and an additional quest and dungeon unlocked after the completion of the main content. The new dungeon is only available after finishing Four Swords.

games.name: Wario Land 4
games.summary:
Wario's back for more...and more...and MORE!

Hey! You! Yeah, you! Listen up when Wario's talking to you! I just read about this legendary Pyramid of Gold, and you're gonna help me go explore it. There's lots of treasure in there for the taking, and I want it all. I'm sure there are gonna be all kinds of weird enemies and big, bad bosses in there, so if you don't think you can hack it, put the game down now. I don't want any losers making me jump into bottomless pits, you hear me?

-Wario invades the Game Boy Advance! See Wario in all his greedy glory as he explores vivid worlds made possible by the power of the GBA!
-Flex your muscles! Wario is no longer immortal, so you'll have your work cut out as you roll, punch and jump your way to tougher and tougher challenges. Wario will get stung by bees, zombified, bitten by bats, set on fire, and much more - what a way to make a living!
-Over twenty enormous stages await! Hunt down CDs for your listening pleasure, or collect treasure to spend on all-new items that you can use against the most bizarre bosses ever!

games.name: Metroid: Zero Mission
games.summary:
The full story of Samus Aran's first mission finally unfolds...

The first Metroid game just scratched the surface of the cataclysmic events on planet Zebes, and at long last the rest of the tale has come to light. Experience the first of Samus's legendary adventures through all-new cut-scenes and action sequences as the bounty hunter races through the deeps toward her showdown with the leader of the Space Pirates. But will the end of Mother Brain really mean the end of the story...?

Completion of the game unlocks an emulated version of the original Metroid game. Zero Mission also allow players to unlock the Metroid Fusion picture gallery by linking between Zero Mission and Fusion cartridges via the Game Boy Advance Game Link Cable.

games.name: F-Zero GX
games.summary: F-Zero GX is the fourth installment in the F-Zero series and the successor to F-Zero X. The game continues the series' difficult, high-speed racing style, retaining the basic gameplay and control system from the Nintendo 64 title. A heavy emphasis is placed on track memorization and reflexes, which aids in completing the title. GX introduces a "Story Mode" element, where the player walks in the footsteps of Captain Falcon through nine chapters, completing various missions.

games.name: SoulCalibur II
games.summary: SoulCalibur II for the Nintendo GameCube is an expanded port of the Arcade game, including Link from The Legend of Zelda as a playable character and new game modes.

games.name: Super Mario Party Jamboree: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
games.summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree is getting even more minigames and an upgrade on Nintendo Switch 2! The upgrade expands on the base game and adds Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay features, such as mouse controls, enhanced rumble, sound recognition, and modes that use a camera accessory (sold separately).

games.name: Bravely Default: Flying Fairy - HD Remaster
games.summary:
Bravely Default, the first title in the Bravely series, remastered in high definition for a single screen. Discover the origins of the classic Brave and Default battle system alongside new and enhanced features. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn!

This version includes two new minigames: Luxencheer Rhythm Catch and Ringabel’s Panic Cruise.

games.name: Kirby and the Forgotten Land: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Star-Crossed World
games.summary: In Star-Crossed World, a new story included in the upgrade pack, Kirby must use his abilities, including the all-new Mouthful Modes, to clear a trail through uncharted territory. The upgrade pack will include this new content which can be played in single-player and local co-op, as well as improved performance for the entire game.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Years 1-2 - Fighters Edition
games.summary: The Switch 2 version comes with exclusive game modes.

events.name: Jackbox Games Direct 2025
events.description: Join for the Jackbox Games Direct on Monday, April 7 at 8am PT / 11am ET to find out what's coming next for Jackbox Games!

games.name: The Jackbox Naughty Pack
games.summary: Bring the heat with a threesome of fun in Jackbox Naughty Pack. Find out who’s the best liar in Fakin’ It All Night Long, illustrate spicy prompts in Dirty Drawful, and answer questions like “How does this avocado get aroused?” in Let Me Finish.

games.name: The Jackbox Survey Scramble
games.summary: Discover how people across the country think! The Jackbox Survey Scramble is a collection of hilarious survey-based party games, using real one-word answers from real people. Really! Grab some friends and start guessing!

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 11
games.summary: The pack is back! The Jackbox Party Pack 11 transports your game night with 5 new mind-bending party games. Battle monsters with team-based trivia, sleuth through social clues, destroy wholesome jokes, create the kookiest of cookies, and noise-make your way through endless timelines of fun!

games.name: Trivia Murder Party 3
games.summary: Your favorite trivia-obsessed serial killer is heading to summer camp to put you through a sinister new set of minigames and murder. Take a stab at answering questions correctly, engage in luck and skill-based activities, and sabotage your fellow campers in order to survive the summer.

events.name: eastasiasoft Spring Showcase 2025
events.description: Join us for a look the latest projects we're working on for Spring 2025 and beyond. This showcase covers 22 titles across Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC for release in the months ahead. No matter your platform of choice, you won't want to miss this special presentation!

games.name: Hakuoki SSL: Sweet School Life for Nintendo Switch
games.summary:
Spring, a season of blessing for new encounters. Yukimura Chizuru knocks on the gates of a private academy, which has since been a boys' school. However, as of this year, Hakuou Academy opens its gates to co-education and Chizuru is the only female student enrolled. Thus, begins her first year.

This edition comes with cards and some other extras.

games.name: Dagger Froggy
games.summary: Dagger Froggy is a small action Roguelike, Where you face hordes of enemies... Cute? With each round you get stronger, But so do the cute creatures. >:)

games.name: Secrets in Green
games.summary: When a pretty plant in Alma's garden begins to speak to her, she knows that a dark mystery is afoot! But in Victorian England, women are often dismissed as nothing more than hysterical fantasists. Can you help Alma find her power, and solve this dangerous situation before it's too late?

games.name: Moving Houses
games.summary: A silly little physics-based game about moving on... or is it? Be neat, be careful, or be a chaos goblin. The choice is yours. But be warned, not all is as it seems in this quiet little house.

games.name: Hegzis
games.summary: Master the hex grid as you puzzle through colourfully chill stages, clearing lines and strategically using tools to assist!

games.name: Blazing Trail
games.summary: Escape failed! All we have left is our will to survive, the endless hordes of enemies, and enough bullets to rip them all to shreds. Blazing trail. Vertical co-op shooter, offering accessible, action-packed gameplay.

games.name: Submarine Survivor
games.summary: Dive into the ocean's depths, face fearsome sea creatures, and collect their experience crystals. Upgrade your submarines with various combinations of weapons and chips.

games.name: Moe Waifu H: Push-Box
games.summary: Brainteasing block puzzles have never looked so inviting! In Moe Waifu H Push-Box, you’ll meet 5 female companions who will test your problem-solving skills and reward your cleverness.

games.name: Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC
games.summary: Get ready for adrenaline-fueled racing fun as you climb your way through the motorsports ranks in pure arcade style! Super Engine GT Turbo SPEC is all about speed and pushing your driving skills to the limit.

games.name: Starlight Legacy
games.summary: Forge your own legacy in Starlight Legacy! Explore the vast Evaria Kingdom in beautiful 2D pixel art graphics, an exciting turn-based battle system, and a non-linear story.

games.name: Okko the Exiled
games.summary: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure, where you stomp, launch, and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the demon lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

games.name: Notice Me, Leena-Senpai!
games.summary: Oh no! The Demon Lord is attacking! Help Leena-senpai defend her town against a horde of demon lord goons!

games.name: StarLightRiders: HyperJump
games.summary: StarLightRiders: HyperJump is a fast paced and frantic multiplayer arcade shoot em up. Protect the solar system from the alien invasion and stop them from eliminating all life on Earth! Take control of the powerful HyperJump ships and blast the hell out of everything that moves.

games.name: Knight's Night!
games.summary: Knight's Night! is a retro-style 1-bit platformer. Collect items, unlock new abilities, and make your way into the evil wizard's castle to save the kingdom!

games.name: Keeper's Toll
games.summary: Rise, fallen hero! Keeper's Toll, a harrowing journey into a dark and retro world that demands skill and courage. Every moment could be your last, but with each setback, you grow stronger. Embrace the challenge, overcome daunting foes, and cleanse the world of its cursed lands.

games.name: Makis Adventure
games.summary: Makis Adventure is an Action- Platformer with shark demons. Fight, dash, swim and bite your way through 3 different dungeons. Let the inner shark out! Face many different opponents and defeat powerful bosses.

games.name: Endlight
games.summary: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos. Fly through surreal landscapes desperately trying to get hoops. Dodging is impossible, so start smashing.

games.name: King of Ping Pong: Megamix
games.summary: Table tennis meets arcade fighter in this fast-paced action-packed journey to become the best in the world. Defeat a series quirky characters utilizing quick wit and precise timing to secure victory in increasingly challenging matches!

games.name: Exo-Calibre
games.summary: Meet the Ex-Calibre Knights, elite pilots in state-of-the-art exo-mechs, defending peace, justice and hope across the world! The Exo-Tech corporation is dedicated to developing advanced weapons and defenses to aid humanity, but when AI drones go haywire and start attacking the populous, it’s up to you to take control of the Ex-Calibre Knights and restore order by any means necessary!

games.name: Without A Voice
games.summary: In the depths of a forest, an exiled princess whiles her time in solitude. One day, a mysterious, beautiful maiden appears, throwing her world out of its alignment. A dark fantasy visual novel following the intertwining paths of these two women. In seven days, the wheel of fate will splinter...

games.name: Super Mining Mechs
games.summary: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

games.name: Tiny Pixels Vol. 2: Stormy Knights
games.summary: Step into the armored boots of an overzealous knight as you fight across the continent rescuing princesses from monstrous captors in Stormy Knights! Strategic real-time combat ensues as you storm the halls of each castle in side-scrolling pixel art style, from medieval Europe and mystical Persia to feudal Japan and more, all accompanied by an original retro soundtrack!

events.name: The Triple-i Initiative 2025
events.description:
Get your eyeballs ready for 30+ game announcements in 45 minutes. No ads, no host, just games.

Prepare for world premieres, exclusive gameplay reveals, launch dates, demo releases and more on April 10th, 2025 at 9am PDT/noon EDT/6pm CEST.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

games.name: Tears of Metal
games.summary: Tears of Metal is a medieval hack-and-slash co-op roguelike. Carve through hordes of enemies to reclaim your island with the help of your formidable Scottish battalion. As you advance deeper into the trenches, uncover more about the mysterious Dragon Meteor and the treacherous enemy invasion.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Endless Legend 2
games.summary: With a mysterious, ever-changing world, unique factions, and epic storytelling, the much-awaited sequel to the strategy game classic ENDLESS Legend is here, opening a new chapter of the award-winning ENDLESS universe. Write your legend and unveil the secrets of a dreamlike ocean-planet on the verge of extinction.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless open world survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Star Birds
games.summary: Star Birds is a cheerful asteroid base-building and resource management game. Discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks and guide your colony of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons!

games.name: Escape Simulator 2
games.summary: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: Enshrouded: Thralls of Twilight
games.summary: Here we are with our sixth update! We’re thrilled to bring you Thralls of Twilight, a new update designed to make the Shroud more inviting and more dangerous than ever, adding some new gameplay mechanics, as well as a huge number of new locations to explore, and a bunch of gameplay improvements and additions. We've also updated a slew of locations and points of interest across the world, and as always, a bunch of miscellaneous other fixes and improvements!

games.name: Timberborn
games.summary: Humans are long gone. In a world struck by droughts and toxic waste, will your lumberpunk beavers do any better? Timberborn is a sandbox city-building game featuring ingenious animals, vertical architecture, water physics, and terraforming. Contains high amounts of wood.

games.name: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect
games.summary: Embrace the enthralling explorations and challenges with your characters, each uniquely customized through roguelite gameplay. Discover the truth of the world during the adventure, and alter the course of human destiny through your choices.

games.name: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect x Dead Cells
games.summary:
New Playable Character (Prototype) – The Prisoner
Step into the boots of the iconic Prisoner from Dead Cells, wield 27 signature weapons, skills and mutations from the original game as well as 20+ combo variants that pay tribute to other Dead Cells’ iconic gears.
Exclusive Challenge Biome
Dive into a new roguevania-inspired challenge biome built for The Prisoner, where Dead Cells’ fast, fluid combat meets BBEE’s satisfying combos!

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Blacksmith Master
games.summary: Manage your own medieval smithy in Blacksmith Master and supervise the entire process from mining ores and gems to designing and selling finished products. Forge everything from weapons and armor to tools and cooking utensils to fund your craft and become the Blacksmith Master.

games.name: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
games.summary: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Explore the map solo or in multiplayer, triumph in iconic battles and establish peace on a continent where it was never an option.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor
games.summary: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor is a single player survivor-like auto-shooter. Wield the full arsenal of Deep Rock Galactic, take on hordes of lethal aliens, mine riches, and unlock powerful upgrades. It's one dwarf against all of Planet Hoxxes!

games.name: The Alters
games.summary: Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

games.name: SpeedRunners 2: King of Speed
games.summary: The ultimate competitive platformer is back! Outrun, outjump, and outsmart your rivals in cutthroat online/local races, now up to 8 players. Master the movement, learn meticulously designed maps, use powerful pick-ups, swing around with a grappling hook, and don't get knocked off-screen!

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Super Fantasy Kingdom
games.summary: A roguelite city builder set in a relaxing fantasy world. Explore and rebuild your kingdom to bring it back to its former glory. Defeat hordes of enemies with an always unique team of defenders. Harvest, capture, build, mine, cook, brew, feed and grow. But be prepared to watch it all burn!

games.name: X4: Foundations - Diplomacy Update
games.summary: At the core of the 8.00 update for X4: Foundations is the new Diplomacy system, which will make the sandbox and economy simulation elements of X4: Foundations shine in new ways. The Diplomacy system is a deeply integrated new gameplay feature, built around three main components: A new embassy facility, a new class of hireable NPCs (Agents) who can be specialized in negotiation or espionage, and the ability to trigger and influence dynamic diplomatic standing between NPC factions.

games.name: Rematch
games.summary: Control one player on your team and compete in fast-paced 5v5 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Team up with your friends and join the action.

games.name: Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama
games.summary: Become a Showstopper of SaGa legend in Vampire Survivors: Emerald Diorama

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Shapez 2: Factory
games.summary: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

games.name: Necesse
games.summary: Build, quest, and conquer across an infinite procedurally generated world. Play alone or with friends as you establish a settlement and explore deep dungeons, fight monsters and bosses, mine rare ores, craft magical equipment, recruit specialists for your colony, and more!

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Morbid Metal
games.summary: Morbid Metal is a stylish fast-paced hack’n’slash action rogue-lite. Shapeshift into powerful characters in real time, chain impactful combos, and tear through waves of deadly machines and brutal bosses.

games.name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.summary: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

games.name: Cloverpit
games.summary:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

games.name: No, I'm Not A Human
games.summary: An intimate story about a disaster and guests from underground. People are breaking into your home, but not all of them are true people.

games.name: Katana Zero DLC
games.summary: This isn't a Chronos hallucination - the free Katana ZERO DLC is finally nearing completion. Get ready to continue Zero's journey right where it left off - and glimpse into his murky past. Featuring all new characters, levels, gameplay and story, this massive DLC promises to be worth the wait. Come play, my lord.

games.name: Into the Fire
games.summary: Race an exploding volcano in this high-risk extraction survival. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

events.name: Inazuma Eleven V HEROES SHOWCASE 2025 Release Date & Final Specs Presentation
events.description: This stream is packed with tons of new info, including the reveal of the release date of “Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road,” as well as information on the final game features.

games.name: Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road
games.summary: The latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "Inazuma Eleven!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 4,500 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

events.name: INDIE Live Expo: 2025.4.13
events.description:
INDIE Live Expo an information filled program for all the indie gamers around the world!
In this program, we will be introducing the hottest news of more than 100 indie games!
You WILL find the best game for you!

games.name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
games.summary: Asuha, a self-proclaimed gambling prodigy, challenges the Witch ruling the gambling district. Poised to win, she is defeated by a mysterious power. An adventure of gambling, exposing frauds and earning fortunes through poker.

games.name: Fubuki: Zero in on Holoearth
games.summary: 『FUBUKI ~zero in on Holoearth~』is a high-speed pixel action game where you control the protagonist, Shirakami Fubuki, and battle using swords and skills.

games.name: Refind Self: The Personality Test Game
games.summary:
All players approach games in varied ways, making different choices.

No one ever plays in exactly the same way. Indeed, how a person plays can be an indicator of their personality...

And Refind Self is a game where you can learn all about that personality.

games.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost
games.summary: A rhythm game in which players can play popular arrangements of Touhou Project songs. A rebuild of "Touhou Danmaku Kagura" as a stand-alone version with a completely new storyline.

games.name: HighKing
games.summary: Use your mouse to climb the mountain. The road is very steep and long. But don't worry. You can use your arms and legs for this climb.

games.name: Keyword: A Spider's Thread
games.summary: Become an investigator in Keyword, a narrative thriller where you’ll depend on skills of logical deduction, hacking, and social engineering to solve challenging puzzles as the only means of finding your missing daughter.

games.name: Sairento VR
games.summary:
Sairento VR is one of the most popular action VR games in the world and the only one where you get to play a cyber ninja. Perform triple jumps, wall runs, power slides, back flips and slow time down while blasting away at a foe before landing to deliver a lethal strike on another. Kit yourself with katanas, firearms, bows, throwing glaives and legendary relics.

Experience the iconic "bullet-time" scenes from The Matrix, blended with the slow-motion mayhem of the Max Payne game series, all while looking and feeling as badass as the Bride from Kill Bill.

games.name: BrokenLore: Low
games.summary: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

games.name: Neko Odyssey
games.summary: Here’s a slightly unusual Casual Adventure game where the main gameplay centers around taking pictures of cats. The pixel art graphics in a 3D setting create a charming atmosphere reminiscent of Japanese animation.

games.name: Mika and the Witch's Mountain
games.summary: Soar with the wind on your broomstick, deliver packages to your friends, and explore a vibrant sandbox world in a coming of age adventure about an aspiring witch!

games.name: Kitten Food Alley
games.summary: Kitten Food Alley is a casual management sim with the theme of petting cat. You can open various food shops and adjust food recipes, produce food by petting cat employees. Unlock various tools to automate petting. Enjoy the stress relief of cyber cat petting!

games.name: Hypotheses on the Symmetry between Vision and Hands
games.summary: The hypothesis regarding vision-hands symmetry is a validation experiment where separate characters are controlled with the left and right hands. It measures the connectivity and enhancement of cognitive character recognition through both hands and vision.

games.name: Rogue Voltage
games.summary: The engineering roguelike. Construct your combos by wiring circuits. Build crazy machines to zap the monsters and trigger satisfying chain reactions. Discover devastating synergies and create overpowered builds.

games.name: Dungeon Dev
games.summary: The demon lord, who has been secretly trading with the human kingdom's king, summons you and requests your help in developing a special dungeon. It's none other than a dungeon where is narrowly defeated by the heroes!

games.name: LoneStar
games.summary:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

games.name: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain
games.summary: Noroi Kago: The Grudged Domain is a four-player co-op survival horror game centered on the supernatural "Yokai" from Japanese folklore. Trapped in a cursed domain, you and your companions must work together to endure the curse, hide from the terrifying Yokai, and find a way to escape.

games.name: Time To Live
games.summary: A story of living with a woman whose identity remains unknown for 30 days.

games.name: Muffles' Life Sentence: Episode 2
games.summary: EPISODE 2 of Muffles' journey. A darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

games.name: GuGu Pizza: Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, This is Just Not Right!
games.summary: GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...

games.name: Learning Factory
games.summary: A base building game with a relaxing atmosphere and complex structure. Build a giant factory on a multi-layered map, gather resources, craft and sell items to cats, collect cat data and process it with machine learning to establish Catopia on Mars!

games.name: Order 13
games.summary: Pack orders and ship them out. But the warehouse holds more than just inventory.

games.name: Going Medieval
games.summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Replay Bell Suika Slot Like Game
games.summary: A merge puzzle inspired by slot machine icons! Start with replays, then bells, watermelons... and grow them in order, aiming to hit the rainbow seven to enter bonus time! With a continuation rate over 50%, let's earn massive scores during bonus time!

games.name: Moonbase Lambda
games.summary: Moonbase Lambda is a horror survival game which you have to escape from a procedurally-generated maze. The premise of the game is that an unidentified creature breaks into the moonbase, which leaves you no choice but to survive and escape from it.

games.name: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG 2: Shinyuu no Shin no Sugata ha Daimaou
games.summary: Netabare ga Hageshisugiru RPG 2 is a Japanese RPG released in 2024. The game features spoilers throughout the story.

games.name: Chessarama
games.summary: Chessarama is a collection of chess-inspired puzzle and strategy games that use chess pieces and their established move sets, then reimagines their goals and themes. Solve challenges, unlock collectibles, and compete against each other on the leaderboards. Welcome to Chessarama!

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
games.summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

games.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option
games.summary: In the RTS-game “Diplomacy is Not an Option” you will become a medieval feudal lord in a midlife crisis. Due to your position you must constantly make hundreds of decisions a day related with city management and economic development. You are tired of this monotonous and, so it seems, meaningless existence. But things are about to change: hordes of bloodlusted enemies, swarms of scary monsters and crowds of rebellious peasants at any second can bring some life to your working schedule.

games.name: The Shojing
games.summary: "SHOJING" is a casual game where you control a cat and break a shoji screen. It's a cat, so it's just about permissible, but humans should never try to imitate this.

games.name: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
games.summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

games.name: Robot Girl's Dream: Robot Battle Championship
games.summary: This game is an RPG game that follows the growth of a robot girl who has lost her memories. Players can aim for victory in the robot battle tournament, the main objective, and also enjoy interactions with both humans and robots.

games.name: Cluckmech Oasis
games.summary: "Cluckmech Oasis" is a tower defense Roguelike with top-down shooting, players will play the battle chicken and its partners, in the journey to collect a variety of strange defensive machinery, a large number of plant enemies, along the way to escort base vehicles to save the world!

games.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
games.summary: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic power of SWAP, using it to Copy & Paste textures within the game world. Turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines as you ride hay bales, explore, fight, and solve puzzles throughout Riverside. Unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game that literally lets you change the world!

games.name: Prize Denied
games.summary: Prize Denied! Manage a claw machine arcade in this cozy management sim. Build challenging claw machines and play surprising cards to stop players from getting a prize! Earn money to unlock new arcades, collect cards, upgrade machines, and become the best arcade in the...UNIVERSE!

games.name: In a World After People
games.summary: A robot awakens alone in a desolate world where humanity has vanished due to a plague. In this side-scrolling pixel art adventure, the robot, having lost its memory, retraces its past interactions with humans to rediscover the meaning of "love."

games.name: Empyreal
games.summary: Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG. In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation.

games.name: Bionic Bay
games.summary: An ordinary man in an extraordinary world. Bionic Bay is a new kind of a 2D platformer. It introduces a unique Swap mechanic, allowing players to interact with the physics-based world in new ways. The immersive gameplay is completed by spectacular environments and creative level design.

games.name: Abyss Ring
games.summary: Survive, cook, and conquer the depths! In this survival roguelike, cook monsters to stave off hunger through 100 floors of dungeons. With over 200 equipment and randomly generated dungeon, every playthrough offers fresh challenges and endless possibilities.

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Cash Cleaner Simulator
games.summary: Start your money laundering business in this chill simulator! Use various not-so-powerful tools to restore dirty money bills and some unusual items to their full, crisp potential! Spend your hard-earned crypto to upgrade and cozy up your lab! The cash is in your hands!

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Hololive Holo's Hanafuda
games.summary: Holo's Hanafuda is banter-filled hanafuda battler featuring hololive talent!

games.name: Yokai Landlord: Monster Mystery!
games.summary: A Werewolf game-style social deduction adventure where you play as the landlord of an apartment and try to uncover the Yokai hiding among your residents. Not just a mystery adventure, this is a heart-warming tale of character growth.

games.name: Flower in Us
games.summary: Flower in Us is a short, story-driven mystery adventure that invites players to unravel hidden secrets.

games.name: Cat Golf
games.summary: Cat Golf is a fresh and exciting action-golf game where you can tee off in all sorts of unexpected places across a city! The star of the show? A round, adorable cat! The golf course is an Japanese town. Set off on a laid-back, carefree adventure as you and your cat zip freely through the city!

games.name: Stario: Haven Tower
games.summary: Build a vertical city in a world of a tower. Lead the dwellers to gather resources from the sky and build upwards. Make vertical transport and climbs up. Explore the creatures and sceneries in higher skies.

games.name: Biped 2
games.summary: Adorable robots are back to save the day! Explore an unknown planet in this puzzle action-adventure game and experiment with our unique, innovative mechanics solo or in co-op with up to 4 players!

games.name: Kabuto Park
games.summary: Enjoy summer in Kabuto Park! Capture the cutest bugs, train them and win the Summer Beetle Battles Championship in this little bug collection game! Upgrade your equipment to find rarer, stronger and shinier beetles, butterflies, bees or dragonflies.

games.name: Effulgence RPG
games.summary: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Solateria
games.summary: In a world where the Litt have perished, a small pyron warrior embarks on a journey to find the King, the Primordial Flame, the last hope to save the world. Defeat mighty foes, unleash fiery attacks, and master parrying. Explore a beautifully hand-drawn world and uncover its secrets.

games.name: Beak Island Visitor Center
games.summary: Congrats! You're now in charge of Beak Island's visitor center. This old gem's a bit rusty, and help's scarce, but don't let that stop you! Spruce up the island, cook up some treats, and bring back the buzz from 50 years ago. It's all in your hands now!

games.name: Afterblast
games.summary: Afterblast is a challenging FPS rogue-lite action game. Play solo or in co-op. Features dynamic gameplay with randomly generated dungeons, so don't hesitate to obtain the power, unlock new loot, and find a way to save your planet. Stand up against the gods and fight against hordes of monsters.

games.name: Worshippers of Cthulhu
games.summary: LEAD the CULT OF CTHULHU. Decide the fate of your followers, perform eldritch rituals, and master the art of city-building in a world where the line between sanity and madness blurs. Can you endure the horrors you unleash?

games.name: The Electrifying Incident: A Monster Mini-Expedition
games.summary: An adorable bite-sized adventure from the creators of A Monster’s Expedition - explore the facility, avoid the live electricity, and repair the malfunctioning reactor.

games.name: CleanFall
games.summary: CleanFall is a survival rogue-lite that prizes player freedom and creativity. Build mobile death machines to fight off ravenous hordes, craft and alchemize gun turrets, and tunnel through subterranean ecosystems crawling with nameless horrors.

games.name: NanoApostle
games.summary: NanoApostle is a dark sci-fi boss rush action game featuring intense reaction-based combat and the unique "Destruction Point" system. Play as Anita, a child augmented with lethal nanomachines, as she battles against twisted cybernetic experiments to escape a top-secret facility.

games.name: V.E.D.A: The Awakening of Souls
games.summary: V.E.D.A is a Soulslike training game with weighty combat and exploration. The protagonist, awakened with no memory, undergoes combat training in a training simulator and uncovers hidden secrets. You too can enter the Soulslike genre. Don't hesitate.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: "Shall we do something immoral?" A demon-teasing adventure where you summon unique kemono and gather magical powers to restore the naughty demon "Debirun's" form!

games.name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising - Additional Character Set - Sandalphon
games.summary:
Set Contents:
• Playable Character: Sandalphon
• Premium Avatar: Sandalphon
• Badge: Sandalphon
• Weapon Cutout: Apprentice
• Figure Studio poses 1–6 and expressions 1–7 for Sandalphon

games.name: Eclipsium
games.summary: Eclipsium is a trippy and surreal horror game that will take you on a journey through darkness and confusion. In this haunting and immersive experience, you'll need to traverse a dark and twisted world to reach a tower that's looming in the distance.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Brave New Wonders
games.summary: Command automatons with customized instructions to build Brave New Wonders in this factory automation game. You can deploy your automatons to explore a post-apocalypse world, discover ruins from the past, battle, collect resources and make your automated factories thrive!

games.name: TurboSquad
games.summary: TurboSquad is a racing party game where you don't drive but sabotage the race! Use traps, weapons and sneaky tactics to outsmart your rivals. Play solo, online or locally in colorful tracks full of loops, jumps and surprises.

games.name: Dream Garden
games.summary: An easygoing simulation game about creating tiny garden dioramas. Use a wide selection of plants, decorations and tools to build and nurture the garden retreat of your dreams.

games.name: To the Grave
games.summary: To the Grave is a 2d horror adventure puzzle game full of oriental elements. The young girl's father died in an accident and her mother insisted on taking his body back to her hometown for burial. After solving many crises in the mysterious village, they gradually approach the truth.

games.name: Cosmolace
games.summary: A narrative-driven puzzle game that combines "optical illusions" with "single-stroke puzzle" as its theme. Players rotate their perspective in a 3D space, using optical illusions to connect vertexes and segments, completing the patterns in each level with a single stroke.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Let Them Trade
games.summary: Build a network of cities that produce and trade resources, upgrade your castle, and protect the cities from cheeky bandits.Tinker with the economy at your own pace, and watch the charming wooden world grow into a lively and thriving kingdom.

games.name: Small Spaces
games.summary: Small Spaces is a relaxing game about turning small apartments into beautifully designed dioramas you'd want to live in. From a simplistic flat in Tokyo to a victorian townhouse in San Francisco. Your only limit is the space itself.

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Shrink Rooms
games.summary: Run! The rooms are shrinking! A puzzle game Demo about escaping from shrinking rooms. Every step counts if you want to make it out alive! Complete box-pushing puzzles within a limited number of steps or be crushed into a puddle of meat by the pressing walls of the level!

games.name: Bandit Knight
games.summary: Step into the boots of a master thief in Bandit Knight! Outsmart enemies, steal legendary treasures, and navigate a vibrant 2.5D pixel world. Customize your tools, unlock upgrades, and rise to become the ultimate King of Thieves!

games.name: The Greenening
games.summary: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

games.name: Ritual Party
games.summary: In Ritual Party you get to summon Cthulhu with your friends! Work together (or not) with 1-4 players to perform wild rituals, unlocking cosmic horrors from the Cthulhu mythos. Chaotic party game where summoning eldritch beings is only half the fun!

games.name: Chrono Sword
games.summary: Chrono Sword is a pixel art souls-like action adventure game with time travel. It has incredible pixel art, contextual combat and an epic story as it's features.

games.name: Go North
games.summary: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

games.name: Sanctua
games.summary: Sanctua is a thrilling co-op party game where players must work together to survive and escape a cursed tomb. One of them is corrupted and will play as an ancient entity that hunts other explorers.

games.name: Bunny
games.summary: "BUNNY" is a side-scrolling action game where Bunny and Smallbird embark on an adventure to find their friends. Control Bunny as you navigate through stages, overcoming obstacles and squeezing through walls. There's no game over, so everyone can play through to the end.

games.name: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall
games.summary: In this new reality, where monsters seem closer, enemies stronger and your petitioners struggling more than ever, your duties as a King must continue. It will be your responsibility to rebuild the trust of your kingdom, protect your family and survive the upcoming winter.

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Mind Diver
games.summary: Restore a broken mind to solve a twisted case. Investigate a couple's most intimate moments and piece together the events of a fateful night. Pick what to investigate, deduce awful truths, and solve a dark mystery. But most of all, Mind Diver: find the lost love. Before it's too late.

games.name: Cannoneer Girls
games.summary:
"1·Shot·1·Reload" High school girls in pixel art battle in a chaotic 3-on-3 cannon brawl! Drive opponents to the brink and blast them away with a cannon shot!

Hougeki Shoujo is a 3-vs-3 competitive 2.5D shooting action game where high school girls battle it out with their trusty cannons! The game features a single-reload, single-shot system—you only have one chance to dodge an enemy shot to avoid immediate elimination! Win a round by wiping out the opposing team. The first team to win three rounds claims victory! Encircle your opponents and seize victory with a decisive shot! The game features simple, intuitive controls. You can tell when your shot is ready by the ammo icon that appears next to your character’s username. Use cute emotes and chat with your allies and opponents!

games.name: One Card One Shot: Mafia
games.summary: Enter the world of the mafia, with an agile and dynamic Card Game that will challenge you in your free moments or addict you for hours! Choose a mission and hit the target in seconds! What awaits you with each card turned over? Will you become the legend feared by all or will you fall into oblivion?

games.name: Torchr Runners: Demastered
games.summary: It's an online co-op indie, runner 3d platformer with a bit of puzzle and surreal. "Carry your flickering torch through perilous puzzles in this retro-inspired cooperative platformer. Work together to keep your sanity intact, beat mind-bending challenges, and survive the misanthropic taunts of the "Torcherer" – all while racing against time before your light runs out!"

games.name: Goodbye Seoul
games.summary: Six months before the asteroid strike, and a new beginning. Goodbye Seoul is a narrative puzzle adventure set in a desolate yet hauntingly beautiful post-apocalyptic Seoul. Will you uncover the truth before time runs out?

games.name: Dobbel Dungeon
games.summary: Gather your party, roll your dice and embark on a quest to discover why the local wildlife has suddenly turned evil! No two adventures are the same in this dice-powered tactical RPG!

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: Nitro Gen Omega
games.summary: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.

games.name: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
games.summary: The citizens led by Saitama rise up in rebellion! The epic battle to defeat Tokyo begins now! Get hooked on the unique, wobbly limb controls! Dash through 3D-rendered "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" worlds in this innovative platformer like no other!

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Infinity Sweeper
games.summary: Infinity Sweeper is similar to the classic Minesweeper, but turned into an endless rogue-lite adventure. Navigate through an ever-expanding grid filled with dangerous traps, enemies, and valuable treasures, trying to survive as long as possible.

games.name: Öoo
games.summary: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

games.name: Rizuhuritan! Rhythmic Flip (Re)Turn
games.summary: It is a journey that guides lost beings home "Rizufuritan!" is a Memory-based Flip-and-Rhythm Game where you memorize living things and press your favorite key to the Rhythm

games.name: Magical Girl Critical Deluxe
games.summary: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

games.name: Crescent Tower
games.summary: Aspire to reach the top of Crescent Tower that appears just once every 50 years! An authentic 8-bit style dungeon crawler RPG with a retro level of difficulty, where you repeatedly explore, level up, and traverse dungeons!

games.name: Sky the Scraper
games.summary: This is a building cleaning Roguelike action game, about a young man named Sky, who chases uncertain dreams as a building cleaner. Conquer thrilling randomly changing high-rise stages, upgrade skills and gear with your money and will, and find your path within a two-month limit.

games.name: The Amazing Crackpots Club!
games.summary: The Amazing Crackpots Club! is a fast-paced, action-packed magic duel in a 2D arena, where wizards throw powerful spells trying to destroy the opponent’s pots, while using mobility and defensive abilities to protect their own pots from incoming attacks.

games.name: Mottainai Ghost
games.summary: Don't allow food waste! A horror-flavored, exploration-based gluttonous adventure game where you aim to escape the apartment while running from the MOTTAINAI GHOST!

games.name: Labyrinth of Touhou Tri: The Dreaming Girls & The Mysterious Orbs
games.summary:
A Fanmade Touhou Project DRPG With Not-So-Easy Boss Fights!
The girls of Gensokyo weave together a dungeon RPG with an estimated playtime of 30~50 hours. Pick a frontline of 4 and a rear of 8 to form a party of 12 characters out of a pool over 40+ and conquer extensive dungeons!

The girls of Gensokyo weave together a DRPG with not-so-easy boss fights! Form a party of 12 allies out of a pool of 40+, and create with 1000+ skills to choose from! Hack, slash, and grow stronger, then make builds (or counter-builds!) to take down powerful bosses awaiting you in the dungeons.

games.name: 5omeday
games.summary: You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days and have the ability to kill her instantly at any time with the push of a button in this multi-ending visual novel.

games.name: Gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer co-working sandbox with character customization, room building, and productivity tools. Focus, study, work, and relax together with friends and players around the world.

games.name: BatteryNote
games.summary: This is an adventure game. You, a mechanic, have picked up three robots from a scrapyard. You can select one of them and charge and converse with them within a time limit. How you treat them will change their reactions, and the ending of the game will change little by little along with their fate.

games.name: Doomed Otaku
games.summary: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

games.name: Henry Halfhead
games.summary: Meet Henry, merely half a head, but with the peculiar ability to possess and control any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to progress through Henry’s not-so-ordinary everyday life.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Dunebound Tactics
games.summary: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.name: Hotel Barcelona
games.summary:
"Hotel Barcelona," where serial killers from all over the United States are said to have gathered. You must defeat them and check out before all the blood is spilled.

Japanese game creators SWERY65 and SUDA51 have teamed up to create this ambitious work. Don't miss it.

games.name: Fruit Mountain Party
games.summary: A brand new game in the hit 3D puzzle game "Fruit Mountain" where you combine fruits to make them bigger is finally here! This time, it's fruit battles!? There are plenty of versus modes that everyone can enjoy! Get together for online or local multiplayer! Keep stacking those fruits!

games.name: Super Shinobi Den
games.summary: A unique ninja action game that's easy to clear but hard to master—featuring huge jumps inspired by The Legend of Kage and a combo-based scoring system where you spend points to unleash powerful skills.

games.name: Ritual of Raven
games.summary: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

games.name: Break Siege
games.summary: Break Siege is a train-themed deck-building rougelike game in which you constantly construct your own deck and breakthrough forces of the Empire in intense, real-time battles.

games.name: Final Outpost: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Final Outpost is a survival strategy base-builder. You lead the last survivors of the apocalypse. Assign roles, craft tools, and manage resources carefully. Construct buildings, level up your citizens, and fortify your town against hordes of zombies. How many days can you survive?

games.name: Pools
games.summary: Liminal space game with focus on eerie exploration and immersion instead of typical horror. Navigate through endless alike rooms. Explore, orient, get out.

games.name: RrrrrAbbits
games.summary: Protect... Grow... The herd is everything! As the leader rabbit, your mission is to rescue your captured friends and protect your herd! If you lose your herd, it's game over! Find and recruit allies with special abilities to strengthen your herd, and challenge the crows' dungeons!

games.name: Ramen Simulator
games.summary: Ever dreamed of crafting the perfect bowl of ramen? In Ramen Simulator, you can unleash your creativity and build your own unique ramen style!

games.name: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
games.summary: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

games.name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
games.summary: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

games.name: The Battle Orks
games.summary: The Battle Orks is a fast-paced strategy game that combines deck-building mechanics with real-time PvP combat. Summon your Orks by pulling levers, and watch the battlefield come alive! Trigger three matching symbols to unlock an additional powerful hero—deploy them wisely to crush your enemies!

games.name: Biped
games.summary:
Biped is a coop action game with physics. Take Aku and Sila on a fun and bonding adventure, overcoming original challenges and saving Earth from going dark.

- 30 exotic stages to explore, many secrets to uncover
- supports both local 2 player coop and solo play
- collect treasures and customize your bipeds

games.name: Hungry Meem
games.summary: Meems, the hungry creatures that live under the World Tree, are in danger of extinction! Let's make the Meems' lives happy by exploring around the World Tree with them and developing their settlement!

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
games.summary: 'Marisa of Liartop Mountain' is an adventure-roleplaying game, where you, the player, will play as Reimu and explore a mountain of books filled with mysteries and lies in search of the whereabouts of the missing Marisa.

games.name: Soulmask
games.summary: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

games.name: Bokura: Planet
games.summary: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

games.name: Rise of Rebellion
games.summary: "Rise of Rebellion" is a 3D action RPG that pursues the tension of confronting strong enemies and sweating in your hands. People worshiped God and the land where God dwelled. Survive the battlefield by mastering the deep tactics of melee weapons and the energy "May" derived from the earth.

games.name: Mochi-O
games.summary: A doomsday land defense adventure in which you raise MOCHI-O, a weapon of annihilation that looks a lot like a hamster, to protect your country. Pet and raise MOCHI-O to defeat the oncoming enemies and fight through the tender post-apocalypse.

games.name: Type-Noise: Shonen Shojo
games.summary: Traumatized youth trapped in 'Noise Scramble City', a labyrinth of their own fears. Amnesiac teens solve puzzles in a multi-ending escape adventure.

games.name: Sultan's Game
games.summary: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist. The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

games.name: Sofia in Exchange for Lies
games.summary: Peek into the sins and memories of five personalities through surveillance cameras. This is an immersive, mystery adventure game that unravels the thoughts of the dark past that lie dormant inside Sofia, a suspect in the murder of a presidential candidate, and uncovers the truth behind the crime.

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

games.name: Do Not Play
games.summary: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

games.name: GilGul
games.summary: Why Do People Want to Die? Why Don't People Want to Die? This is a story about a group of girls in a world that exists in limbo between life and death. Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

games.name: Yunyun Syndrome!?: Rhythm Psychosis
games.summary: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this world with your degen otaku-posting.

games.name: Garden of Witches
games.summary: Garden of Witches is a cute roguelike action game full of danger. Help the protagonist, Sil, as she tries to round up her unruly fellow witches and save the Garden.

games.name: Undergrounded
games.summary: “Undergrounded” is a puzzle adventure where you explore a dungeon formed by the accumulation of American history. Become Scott, who wandered underground in search of his lost engagement ring after failing to propose to his girlfriend, and plumb the depths of the past itself with your buddy Canary!

games.name: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death
games.summary: Rhythm Witch: Beat Death is a game that melds rhythm and survival. Attack to the rhythm of the music while dodging monsters who move and attack to the beat. On your journey to eternal beauty, defeat dancing freaks, ghouls, dragon, and more!

games.name: Alice's World
games.summary: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

games.name: Hyke: Northern Light(s)
games.summary: The young witch Hyke's adventure begins! A thrilling 2D top-down action pixel RPG. Relax and camp with your companions!

games.name: My Little Puppy
games.summary: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

games.name: Magical Princess
games.summary: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

games.name: DMZ: Nuclear Survival
games.summary: DMZ: Nuclear Survival is a multiplayer open-world survival crafting game set in a post-apocalyptic world after nuclear war. Build a private military company, train survivors as soldiers, explore a vast procedurally generated map, uncover relics from ancient ruins, and fight for survival.

games.name: Mario Kart World
games.summary: Mario Kart World is a kart racing game for the Nintendo Switch 2, featuring characters from the Mario franchise. It introduces an open-world design to the series, allowing players to drive freely between courses rather than selecting them from a menu. Races support up to 24 players and include new mechanics such as off-roading, boat racing, rail grinding, and wall riding. The game features a Knockout Tour elimination mode where racers compete across connected courses with periodic eliminations at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode for open exploration and collectible-finding.

events.name: Playdate Update: Season 2
events.description: Join us for our next Playdate Update, diving deep into everything you need to know about Season Two!

games.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
games.summary: is a game about digging... for dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

games.name: Shadowgate PD
games.summary:
Shadowgate is one of the most well-known and beloved point-and-click adventure titles in gaming history. As one of the original titles in the popular MacVenture series that went on to be celebrated on the NES, GBC, and Nintendo 64, Shadowgate quickly endeared players with its fantastic atmospheric soundtrack, perilous locations to progress through, countless puzzles to solve, and more ways to gruesomely die than gamers previously thought possible.

Developed by Pixel Ghost, Shadowgate PD is being lovingly reimagined for the Playdate console using Pulp, a web based game making tool made by Panic.

games.name: Taria & Como
games.summary: Taria & Como is a physics-based puzzle platformer where movement is built around swinging instead of jumping. Play as Taria, a young girl with a prosthetic leg, as she rescues her little sister Como in the midst of a world that constantly underestimates her. Separated after a disaster, Taria wakes up in a hospital where she’s forced to use an “approved” prosthetic that limits her mobility. Undeterred, she takes control of her own fate, using ingenuity and sheer determination to escape and find her sister.

games.name: The Whiteout
games.summary: The Whiteout is a chapter based, narrative-driven adventure game that takes place in the not-too-distant future. You’ll play as a lone traveler in a dangerous and broken world: society has collapsed, food is scarce, and trust is not affordable.

games.name: CatchaDiablos
games.summary: A tiny roguelike where you play as a little guy on a quest to capture all the Diablos stranded on a distant moon.

games.name: Wheelsprung
games.summary: In Wheelsprung, you’ll flip, weave, and launch through obstacle-filled courses in a whimsical, hand-drawn world. Bounce off seesaws, soar between bookshelves, and discover hidden surprises. Nail the perfect run, beat your best time, and climb the leaderboards to prove you're the fastest squirrel on two wheels.

games.name: Long Puppy
games.summary: You are Long Puppy and it's the best time of the day - it's time to play fetch!

games.name: Chance's Lucky Escape
games.summary: Chance, the luckiest dog in the world, is called to the rescue by the evil genius, Snowball.

games.name: Tiny Turnip
games.summary: Crank your way to the stars in

games.name: Black Hole Havoc
games.summary: Black holes are appearing all over the galaxy and wreaking havoc. Match the size of the black holes, aim your cannon and avoid the obstacles to eliminate the black holes and save humanity.

games.name: Otto’s Galactic Groove!!
games.summary: Alien music producer Tomie needs inspiration! In this rhythm-action game designed specifically for the Playdate console, it's up to her pet space sea slug Otto to find it in the furthest corners of the galaxy.

events.name: Galaxies
events.description: The Galaxies games showcase is a vibrant new event that leans in to everything that makes Twitch a great place to discover exciting new games! See you in chat on April 17th at 9pm CEST / 12pm Pacific /3pm Eastern.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: Painkiller
games.summary: The classic Painkiller series is back! Battle through Purgatory in fast-paced co-op action, wielding infernal weapons against relentless demonic hordes. Condemned for your sins, the Voice of the Creator offers you a chance at redemption. Will you seize it or be lost to darkness?

games.name: Deliver At All Costs
games.summary: Deliver At All Costs is a thrilling action game where destruction, absurdity and intrigue collide! Step into the shoes of Winston Green — a down-on-his-luck courier with a fiery temper and a mysterious past — as he delivers highly unconventional cargo, leaving a trail of havoc and chaos behind him.

games.name: Lily's World XD
games.summary: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.summary: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

games.name: Ready or Not
games.summary: Ready or Not is a tactical first person shooter which places you in the boots of an elite SWAT team, tasked with diffusing hostile situations in intense, claustrophobic environments. It's set in a nondescript modern America, where an income disparity between the classes have become unsustainable and the country has been plunged into havoc. Bring order to chaos with up to 8 players in cooperative play, battle enemy squads in a close player-vs-player environment, or command AI in a striking single-player mode.

games.name: Demonschool
games.summary: Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.

games.name: Castle Craft
games.summary: Castle Craft is a game where players build huge castles in an ancient war-torn world and defend them against hordes of enemies in chaotic siege battles of epic proportions. Castle Craft is a unique blend of voxel sandbox, action, and horde defence.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2
games.summary: PowerWash Simulator is back, bubbling with fresh locations, soap-erior equipment and splashy features. Effortlessly transform soiled surroundings into clean, serene scenes, solo or with pals. Satisfaction is a spray away!

games.name: L.A.P.D. 2195
games.summary: A modern re-imagining of the classic game "Future Cop L.A.P.D.”, you are a rookie cop in the Advanced Weapons and Tactics Unit of the Los Angeles Police Department in the year 2195.

games.name: Black Desert
games.summary:
Black Desert is a game that tests the limitations of MMORPG
by implementing remastered graphics and audio. Enjoy exciting combat and siege,
exploration, trading, fishing, training, alchemy, cooking, gathering, hunting, and more in the vast open world.

games.name: Windblown
games.summary: Brave the Vortex and dash your way to greatness in this lightning-fast action roguelike from the creators of Dead Cells. Alone or in coop, become the ultimate killing machine as you enhance your skills and master your weapons in search of that perfect run.

games.name: Beyond Astra
games.summary: Beyond Astra is a real-time 4X sci-fi grand strategy game. Expand your own civilization, explore captivating and mysterious planets and star clusters, interact with your citizens and other life forms and shape your destiny through nearly infinite possibilities.

games.name: Lost Skies
games.summary: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

games.name: Golf Gambit
games.summary: Mini-golf with traps, tricks, and tornados! Deploy your traps to mess with your opponents or find a new path to a hole-in-one! Golf Gambit is a fun and frantic mini-golf party game for up to 8 players.

games.name: Hello Again
games.summary: Welcome to the world's coziest time loop! Hello Again is a puzzling adventure game set on an island filled with ancient ruins. Explore strange structures, solve clockwork puzzles, and befriend cute characters to uncover the island's secrets and break the loop.

games.name: Electro Bop Boxing League
games.summary: Climb the ranks and claim your spot among the greatest mechanical fighters in this Atompunk / Electro Swing themed auto-boxer! Outfit your boxer with a variety of parts, abilities, belts and crew upgrades earned through single matches or career mode!

games.name: Hear Tell of Hauntings
games.summary: Deep in the mountains of wild west-era Montana, former outlaw Adelaide Clancy ventures to the desolate remains of the Wraith estate in this third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Sub-Verge
games.summary: Conversation is a dangerous game. Manipulate a fractured band of renegade divers to reach the depths of this short narrative puzzle. Uncover alliances and expose betrayals — before something horrific from the dark abyss silences you all. Don’t let the conversation get too deep.

games.name: Asuka: The Ascent
games.summary: Enter Asuka’s world of intense street races across Japan’s iconic mountains. Tune and personalize JDM cars as you face fierce rivals, uncover secrets, and forge alliances. Follow a manga-inspired story filled with mystery where nothing is as it seems, until the very end.

games.name: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
games.summary: Shoot paint, mix colors, and solve puzzles in this adventure about friendship and redemption. Just don't enter that portal to another universe, and everything will be perfectly fine.

games.name: Vending Dokan!: Kozy Kiosk
games.summary: Build a vending machine empire in this cozy idle sim! Manage staff, decorate locations, and watch your business thrive. Play actively or let it run passively in the background with relaxing music to enjoy while you work or unwind.

games.name: Unbeatable
