games.summary: Unbeatable is a rhythm-adventure game where music is illegal, and you do crimes. talk your way through trouble as you explore vibrant locales. Fight your way through exciting arcade-perfect rhythm setpieces, featuring an original soundtrack by Peak Divide.

games.name: Polterguys
games.summary: Polterguys is a fun-for-all-ages multiplayer game - a supernatural mix of whacky powerups and fast paced chases. The polterguys (ectoey little creatures) possess everyday objects to run around a quirky playlist of fantasy and real-world settings with a super-clear objective, which is to escape the Monster that is hunting them.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.summary: Plunge into the chaotic cybermyth roguelike world of Neon Abyss 2! With diverse combat styles and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic and action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: Sintopia
games.summary: Build the resurrection business of your dreams with Sintopia! You are charged with managing the bureaucratic administration of Hell, your team of Imployees punish the dead souls for their Sins, generating a profit to help you build and sustain your Hellish empire.

games.name: Empyreal
games.summary: Empyreal is a complex, challenging, feature-rich action RPG. In a far-flung corner of the galaxy an Expedition arrives on a hitherto unexplored planet to find a colossal Monolith built by a lost civilisation.

games.name: Wraith Ops
games.summary: Wraith Ops is a fast-paced FPS shooter focusing on satisfying gunplay and back-to-basics playstyle. Its main goal is to bring together objective-based gameplay with a focus on teamwork, fast movement, snappy combat and more realistic/tactical features loved by many. Learning from its peers, we believe that realistic features and gameplay elements can work not only by putting obstacles in your way but by helping you overcome them, enhance the experience and improve your immersion.

games.name: The Legend of Baboo
games.summary: Young Sepehr and his loveable dog, Baboo, set off on a harrowing quest to save their family from the mystical forces of an ancient evil. Embark on an action-adventure, story-driven journey and explore a vast, magical world caught in a battle between light and dark.

games.name: Three Blades Ranch
games.summary: Three Blades Ranch is a ranching management simulator set in the wild west with a high fantasy twist. After a dragon destroys your ranch it's up to you to rebuild, resettle, and reclaim your homestead from the beast's fiery claws.

games.name: Pieced Together
games.summary: Pieced Together is a cozy scrapbooking game that takes you on a heartfelt journey about friendship and getting older. Sort items, solve gentle puzzles, and decorate the scrapbook as you uncover the story piece by piece.

games.name: The Palace on the Hill
games.summary: An open-world adventure, exploration game where you tend to your farm, talk to villagers and collect stories from them to make beautiful Indian miniature inspired paintings in your own unique way.

games.name: The Wilds of Dacrima: Field Notes from a Poorly Supervised Alchemist and his Clockwork Robot Companion
games.summary: Uncover the secrets of the forest in this tale of two unlikely friends, with alchemist Edric Tayte and L-P1N. Forage for weird and wonderful ingredients, brew Potions to empower you with potent abilities, and all the while discovering that this adventure isn't quite what it seems..

games.name: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
games.summary: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

games.name: Tempest Rising
games.summary:
Tempest Rising seamlessly merges the classic action of real-time strategy (RTS) games from the ‘90s and 2000s with modern production and performance standards. Encounter a battle-scarred 1997 in an alternate timeline where the Cuban Missile Crisis went nuclear. In the fallout from the war, a strange red electrical vine known as Tempest started spreading across the planet and changed the course of history.

Tempest Rising gives players full command as they build up their bases, lead armies into battle, and execute bold strategies to emerge victorious. Experience the story of two different factions across two campaigns with deep and rewarding gameplay that keeps the focus on strategy and skill, with built-in customization options that let players approach the game their own way in both single-player and multiplayer.

games.name: Rivals Hover League
games.summary: 'Rivals Hover League' is a vehicular combat PvP game where players battle in arenas across the galaxy using hover vehicles with various abilities. Join your teammates and show off your skills - hover, boost, shoot your way to become the MVP!

games.name: [Redacted]
games.summary: In [REDACTED], a fast-action isometric roguelike, a shadowy agent watches Black Iron Prison spiral into chaos. As one of the last guards, fight through monsters, rivals, and reanimated corpses of your fellow guards to escape the penitentiary alive.

games.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
games.summary: Team-up, brawl and build in this co-op action game that blends hack and slash combat with roguelite-inspired missions and town-building progression that goes beyond the run! Unlock and upgrade gear, rescue robot allies, and lead the resistance against the world-dominating Combots!

games.name: Trench Tales
games.summary: A story-driven third-person action game set in a dark, alternative world between WWI and WWII. Harness unique powers, customize your arsenal, and navigate haunting Gothic landscapes. Battle fallen soldiers as you uncover the mysteries of this realm.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: Bionic Bay
games.summary: An ordinary man in an extraordinary world. Bionic Bay is a new kind of a 2D platformer. It introduces a unique Swap mechanic, allowing players to interact with the physics-based world in new ways. The immersive gameplay is completed by spectacular environments and creative level design.

games.name: Neighbors: Suburban Warfare
games.summary: NEIGHBORS: Suburban Warfare is a lighthearted, team-based PvP game about neighborhood warfare! Deploy traps and barricades to defend your own house. Use the tools from your surroundings to acquire crazy item to get the better of your Neighbors!

games.name: Len's Island
games.summary:
Len’s Island is a blend of peaceful building, farming, and crafting, mixed with intense skill-based combat with roguelike dungeon crawling and open-world exploration. Venture through the world that combines procedural generation with hand-made levels that make every world different.

You’re new to the small town on this beautiful island. Even though you only have the tools in your backpack, you’re determined to make a new life for yourself. Create your new home and plant crops to sustain yourself (or sell in the market), and relax on the pier and fish for your dinner. Or let your adventurous side take over and wander the 30 different islands, exploring different biomes, and venturing deep into caves to unearth the secrets of the islands.

games.name: ChainStaff
games.summary: ChainStaff is a brutal action-platformer with a transforming spear and grappling hook, blazing weapon upgrades, and a rocking soundtrack. Aliens have taken over the Earth! Swing, shoot, and spear your way through hordes of mutating monstrosities and bone-shaking boss fights.

games.name: DeadWire
games.summary: Hack, link, and shoot in a fast-paced top-down cyberpunk shooter. Create devastating chain reactions to outwit enemies, break records and save your childhood mentor from a ruthless syndicate

games.name: The Knightling
games.summary: The Knightling is a platforming action adventure where you play as an aspiring knight in search of their missing mentor, Sir Lionstone. Equipped with only a legendary shield, you’ll brave your way through the lands of Clesseia to become the unlikely hero.

games.name: FBC: Firebreak
games.summary: FBC: Firebreak is a 3-player cooperative first-person shooter set within the enigmatic Federal Bureau of Control (FBC). As the Bureau’s headquarters faces a deadly and prolonged siege by otherworldly forces, only Firebreak—its most adaptable response unit—has the skills and courage to restore order.

games.name: Nitro Gen Omega
games.summary: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.

games.name: Demon Spore
games.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

games.name: Ninja Party
games.summary: Ninja Party is a free parkour action game from the creators of Shadow Fight and Vector. Compete with other players in fun challenges for the title of the best ninja!

games.name: Nice Day for Fishing
games.summary: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

games.name: Vector Strike
games.summary: Vector Strike is a fast-paced, physics based, non violent digital sport where mastery and teamwork are key to win. Shoot, double-jump, wall run, slide, dash, pass and score goals in intense matches where every decision counts. Pick your striker from a roster of powerful characters, each with unique abilities to master.

games.name: Dead Format
games.summary: Dead Format is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

games.name: Spine
games.summary: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

games.name: Covenant
games.summary: Covenant is a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.

games.name: Death Crown
games.summary: Death Crown is a minimalist real time strategy game in a 1bit style, where you will be play Death herself, commanding her legions of death, and punishing humanity's Kingdom for its overconfidence.

games.name: Four Last Things
games.summary: Four Last Things is a very silly pythonesque adventure made from Renaissance-era paintings and public domain recordings of classical music. It is about sin, and the Four Last Things – Death, Judgement, Heaven and Hell – and strives to be intelligent and ridiculous in equal measures.

games.name: Kids
games.summary: Kids allows you to move with and against crowds until everyone is gone. It is a short interactive animation drawn by Michael Frei and coded by Mario von Rickenbach, their second collaboration after the award-winning project Plug & Play.

games.name: Supermarket Times
games.summary: A surreal supermarket shopping simulation. Explore a strange and thrilling supermarket like no other. Chat with the local "hoi polloi", complete legendary supermarket tasks and buy the products of your wildest dreams!

games.name: Vampire Therapist
games.summary: Guide vampires through centuries of emotional baggage, decades of delusions and the odd bout of self-loathing with real cognitive behavioral therapy concepts and become a Vampire Therapist! Even vampires need a shoulder to cry on when a neck to bite just won’t do.

games.name: Pool Panic
games.summary: Pool Panic is the world’s least realistic pool simulator. Play as a mischievous, and dare we say, oblivious cue ball in a giant game of pool that sprawls across a colorful cartoon overworld with more than 100 levels. Explore jungles, deserts, carnivals, cities and more while knocking around a peculiar cast of billiard balls, most of which won’t appreciate being pocketed.

games.name: Windowkill
games.summary: Windowkill is a twin-stick shooter, but the game window itself is constantly closing in on you. Shoot the window edges to push it around your screen as you fight and dodge enemies and bosses in their own windows.

games.name: Occlude
games.summary: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.

games.name: Acolyte
games.summary: Acolyte is a dynamic narrative experience that gives you your own Acolyte; a digital assistant you can talk to freely with unlimited dialogue options. Just like a real conversation.

games.name: Motorslice
games.summary: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure.

games.name: Bombshell Blitz
games.summary: BOMBSHELL BLITZ is an explosive twin-stick tank shooter with minor roguelite elements. Upgrade your tank and ace your combat exams to impress your cute supervisors with the highest scores you can!

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven roguelike with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: Rogue Mansion
games.summary:
Rogue Mansion is a survival horror game combined with the best of the roguelike genre! Explore a procedurally generated mansion that changes every time you play, and becomes more dangerous and unpredictable according to your level of fear.

Experience the game in different ways, by choosing from multiple unique characters, each with their own equipment, specialist perks, and motivations.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Demon King
games.summary: Venture through the Labyrinth Of The Demon King, solving puzzles and fighting fearsome monsters in an epic quest to track down the demon who betrayed your lord and end it’s life.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Paper Animal Adventure
games.summary: Paper Animal Adventure is a cute roguelike game where you can explore a colorful world, fight scary enemies, and relax with your friends at the campfire! Will you be the one to seal the timelines and find the missing king?

games.name: Under the Island
games.summary: A 2D Action RPG set in a fantasy world inspired by the 1990s. Explore an island, fight monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the mystery of an ancient civilization. Help the inhabitants and interact with the plants and animals of the island.

games.name: Windswept
games.summary: Our feather-shelled heroes were swept away by a storm, and they need your help! In this '90s-inspired platforming adventure, take on over forty handcrafted stages to discover the secrets of their world, the moon and beyond!

games.name: EbiTapes
games.summary: Go on an adventure to meet fun new friends, help them out, and create delicious beats along the way! Record the sounds of the world and make your own cool music.

games.name: Zwaard
games.summary: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

games.name: Sonzai
games.summary: Sonzai is a 2d, action-brawler platforming RPG. The town of Kumotoshi holds secrets. A new life, new people, new spirits. What are the threads that bind people together? What is the nature of magic? All presented in a beautiful, inky art style - with every single frame of animation hand drawn.

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: Tuscany has been obliterated by Thunder Goober for his own entertainment! Play as Lambypoo and adventure through the broken land of Tuscany, either making friends and having them join your team or defeating enemies for their EXP in your efforts to save your cousins and reunite Tuscany.

games.name: Hyper Team Recon
games.summary: Hyper Team Recon is an adorable 3D platformer about three aliens and their adventure across Earth! As a shapeshifting alien, morph into friends and foes alike to copy their forms and gain unique abilities to use with them! Travel across the world, solve puzzles, and fill your scrapbook!

games.name: Dungeon Gals
games.summary: A small polycule-turned-crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges!

games.name: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

games.name: Thief's Roulette
games.summary: Thief's Roulette is a Story-Driven Puzzle game inspired by the Zero Escape and Danganronpa game series. Taking the narrative heavy design of visual novels and combining it with immersive, first person puzzle gameplay, Thief's Roulette hopes to be a unique gaming experience.

games.name: The Girl from Arkanya
games.summary: Arkanya is a 2D adventure RPG about an aspiring young treasure hunter named Marisa and her capybara companion! Explore deep within the jungles of Amazonia, discover a deep alternate world history, and amass your fortune as you strive to become the world's greatest treasure hunter!

games.name: Elementallis
games.summary: Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples.

games.name: Ova Magica
games.summary: Experience a colorful farm game inspired by the classics! Train cute blob creatures, take care of your farm and make friends with the people of Clover Town.

games.name: Hero.EXE
games.summary: Hero.EXE is a card collecting action RPG. With visual novel cutscenes and grid based action combat; modeled off of the classic Battle Network series. Choose your Ava wisely, as you both become a central part of the story!

games.name: SteamDolls: Order of Chaos
games.summary:
In the mist of time, society is eaten by industry, and its citizens oppressed by an authoritarian and omniscient cult.

The Whisper (David Hayter), a violent anarchist, dreams about a revolution that will destroy the order of things. He devotes himself to expose the dark side of those in power and bring awareness to the people.

His obsessive quest for the ultimate truth will throw him into a world of betrayal and sorcery where the only certainty is the imminent end of the world.

SteamDolls is a steampunk inspired metroidvania with a grimy touch of brutality, featuring AAA talent like David Hayter. Lose yourself in a labyrinthine city, full of secrets and madness, and reveal the truth lurking in the shadows. You know but four words: Action, Exploration, Stealth, and Blood.

games.name: Alisa: The Parting
games.summary: Alisa: The Parting is an unforgettable action packed adventure, that looks and plays exactly like a late 90's and early 2000's 32bit game. With crispy pixely polygons and pre-rendered backgrounds and cinematics, Alisa: The Parting is enjoyable in both solo and co-op play.

games.name: Crypt Custodian
games.summary: Crypt Custodian is a charming metroidvania about cleaning up the afterlife. Play as Pluto- a mischievous cat who has died, and is sentenced to be the afterworlds janitor... forever! Hang out with other doomed ghosts, battle beasts, and explore a vastly expansive landscape.

events.name: Playism Game Show 2025.4.25
events.description: PLAYISM Game Show 2025.4.25 will showcase 13 upcoming titles to be released from Spring 2025 onwards, as well as announce news about our participation in PAX East, the game event to be hosted at Boston, USA from May 8 to May 13, 2025.

games.name: Motionrec
games.summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

games.name: Mind Diver
games.summary: Restore a broken mind to solve a twisted case. Investigate a couple's most intimate moments and piece together the events of a fateful night. Pick what to investigate, deduce awful truths, and solve a dark mystery. But most of all, Mind Diver: find the lost love. Before it's too late.

games.name: Valkyrie of Phantasm
games.summary: Control characters from the Touhou Project series in this shooting action game featuring high-speed aerial versus combat! Danmaku battles faster than you've ever seen will unfold in the skies of Gensokyo as you use your mobility to dodge countless bullets flying at you with a variety of spells.

games.name: From Madness with Love
games.summary: This is a dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with! For some reason, you just can't communicate with the guy you like... An unusual yet extraordinary experience with a cute pixel art style, fully voiced in Japanese.

games.name: Behind the Frame: The Finest Scenery / The Star Named Eos
games.summary:
Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS, two adventure games by the critically acclaimed Taiwanese indie game studio Silver Lining Studio, released together as a set in a special physical edition for the Nintendo Switch.

Both are games where you can interact with a gorgeous hand-drawn world with panorama technology to solve puzzles. Behind the Frame is themed around paintings, while The Star Named EOS is themed around photographs, but both are storytelling puzzle adventures that each feature a heartwarming story about the people you love.

games.name: Skateboard Knight
games.summary: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down the lanes. Horizontal movement and attacks are all auto!

games.name: Glaciered
games.summary: Glaciered is an action-adventure indie game that takes place on a glacier-covered Earth 65 million years in the future. Play as a Tuai, a species evolved from birds, to soar through the seas and fight against the threats to this new golden age of life.

games.name: Break Arts III
games.summary: Freely customize your own robots to win high-speed matches! With the brand new Co-op Mode and Diorama Mode, this game is a fresh new addition to the series.

games.name: Cato: Buttered Cat
games.summary: Buttered cat paradox puzzle platformer game

games.name: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double
games.summary: Urban Legend Hunters 2: Double is an immersive adventure game where you investigate urband legends in a modern city.

games.name: Nitro Express
games.summary: Nitro Express is a 2D side-view gun action game with pixel-art graphics. The game utilizes a 360° free aiming system. You play as a member of the "Atypical Vehicle Disposal Squad" division of the Nitro City police force, tasked with destroying a variety autonomous mechanical drones known as "Companions," which have gone rogue and are wreaking havoc throughout the city.

games.name: Outrider Mako
games.summary: Take on the role of Mako on her quest to seek out and subsequently deliver her, uh, deliverables in this top-down view 2D action game. Jump on top of your enemies and slime them with goo to stop them in their tracks! Get those deliverables delivered!

games.name: Nidana
games.summary: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.

events.name: FGS Live from Gamescom LATAM
events.description: Tune in on May 2, 2025 to watch FGS Live From gamescom latam, a digital broadcast showcasing the most exciting game trailers, developer interviews and show floor demos from one of the biggest gaming events in the world.

games.name: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers
games.summary: Wuchang: Fallen Feathers is a soulslike action RPG set in the land of Shu during the dark and tumultuous late Ming Dynasty, plagued by warring factions and a mysterious illness that spawns monstrous creatures.

games.name: The Shadow Syndicate
games.summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

games.name: Rematch
games.summary: Control one player on your team and compete in fast-paced 5v5 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Team up with your friends and join the action.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Revenge of the Savage Planet
games.summary: Revenge of the Savage Planet is an upbeat, satirical action adventure Sci-Fi. Jump, shoot and collect your way across vibrant alien worlds, uncovering new gear and upgrades, while discovering various hidden secrets.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo
games.summary: An adventure where you’ll meet the many good and not-so-good folks of Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.

games.name: Assetto Corsa EVO
games.summary: Assetto Corsa EVO is the sequel to 2014’s racing simulator Assetto Corsa, which featured a range of road, track, racing, historic and drift cars as well as laser-scanned tracks

games.name: Dreadzone
games.summary: Dreadzone is a survival game set in a deadly quarantine zone. Scavenge for resources, craft tools, build shelter, and survive against dangerous animals, zombies, mutants, and other survivors. Explore the zone where desperation drives everyone to do whatever it takes to survive.

games.name: Recharge
games.summary: Recharge is an RC car racing game built with Unreal Engine and ray tracing, offering realistic graphics. Designed for both RC enthusiasts and casual players, it combines thrilling races, deep customization, and diverse game modes—blending precision with excitement for a dynamic racing.

games.name: Blades of Fire
games.summary: Introducing Blades of Fire, an all-new action adventure that takes you across a beautiful world full of uncertainty and challenge. You take on the role of Aran de Lira, firstborn of the King’s Ward. The newly crowned Queen Nerea has cast a powerful spell that turns steel into stone and only her arms of abominations wield the divine metal against which other blades shatter…

games.name: The Alters
games.summary: Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: To a T
games.summary: to a T is a 3D narrative adventure game developed by Keita Takahashi and the uvula team, with a strong focus on character, interaction, story and exploration. Play as a teenager (Teen), with a unique posture just trying to live a normal life in a small coastal town. Explore the town along with the help of Teen’s loyal dog and loving mother. While going to school and contending with bullies, Teen discovers a new ability granted to them by their extraordinary posture, and they start to uncover more about their mysterious lineage.

games.name: Little Mage
games.summary: Little Mage is an action-packed 2D Metroidvania where you play as an Æther Mage in a beautifully hand-drawn, high fantasy world. Explore the shattered city of Hornedrose, unleash elemental magic, battle fearsome bosses, and uncover the secrets of a world on the brink of destruction.

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire
games.summary: Join private investigator Jack Pepper on a guns blazing, jazz-fueled adventure in MOUSE: P.I. For Hire. MOUSE combines the charm of hand-drawn rubber hose animation inspired by the classic cartoons of the 1930’s with the adrenaline and action of an explosive first person shooter.

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: Diablo Immortal
games.summary: Diablo Immortal is a mobile Massively Multiplayer Online Action RPG (MMOARPG) co-developed by Blizzard Entertainment and NetEase, coming exclusively to Android, iPhone and iPad.

games.name: Football Heroes League
games.summary: Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls.

events.name: Latin American Games Showcase: Gamescom LATAM

games.name: Hell Clock
games.summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: Corebreaker
games.summary: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

games.name: Cyberwar: Neon City
games.summary: Explore a cyberpunk universe where monkeys rule. Challenge the fearsome Cyber Monkeys as you take on the role of a hero armed with a living shark weapon.

games.name: Deathbound
games.summary: Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. The forbidden city of Akratya is an unforgiving land that cannot be conquered alone. Bind with fallen warriors found throughout your crusade and dynamically transform between characters seamlessly in mid-combat with the unique 4-hero party system.

games.name: Forgotten Mines
games.summary: Wreak vengeance and retake lost mines from goblins, orcs, skeletons, and demons in this small-scale tactical roguelite RPG. Build the perfect expedition team and turn the underworld red with each challenging, fast-paced run.

games.name: Gaucho and the Grassland
games.summary: Gaucho and the Grassland is an Animal Farm Sim game where you need to gather resources, explore the land, breed animals and much more, to overcome the challenging life on the grasslands. The world of Gaucho is a mystical wildland, inspired by South Brazil's culture and its local tales.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

games.name: Remnants of the Rift
games.summary: A real-time roguelike action game where time is on your side. Play, pause and plan in a stylish retro-future invaded by another dimension, and ride the frequencies between worlds to discover the secrets of a new reality.

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: Welcome to DKR a chaotic 6-player party brawler where you bounce, punch, and outwit your friends (or enemies) in explosive arenas full of traps and nonsense. Don’t die. Try not to cry. Blame your controller. It’s all part of the RUMBLE.

games.name: Take Us North
games.summary:
Take Us North is a narrative adventure survival game that follows the journeys of migrants and asylum seekers on their way to cross the US-Mexico border.

Inspired by real-world stories, Take Us North aims to foster greater awareness and empathy about some of the most crucial global issues of our time.

games.name: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo
games.summary: An adventure where you’ll meet the many good and not-so-good folks of Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.

games.name: Sopa: Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.summary: Emotional narrative adventure about the things we pass along. Inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and The Little Prince.

games.name: Wander Stars
games.summary: Wander Stars is a turn-based RPG with roguelite elements where you make your own attacks by combining words! Create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in this story-driven adventure inspired by 90s anime.

games.name: Super Farming Boy
games.summary: Your farm is under attack! Fly, harvest, grow crops & whack enemies with your shape-shifting one-button superpowers as you seek revenge from your evil nemesis, Korpo, who has captured your mom & friends! An action-puzzle farming sim featuring chain reactions and combos.

games.name: Dunjungle
games.summary: A 2d action-packed roguelike about an ape protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!

games.name: Hidden in my Paradise
games.summary: Hide objects, decorate, and replicate cool snaps in this cozy hidden-object game where you can create little paradises!

games.name: Escape of The Hammer Princess
games.summary: A retro-styled rampage in both 3D and 2D! After years of waiting to be rescued, the Princess has decided to rescue herself. Escape as the princess in exciting retro-styled 3D, and relive the deaths of her would-be rescuers in classic 8-bit 2D! Bash some Skulls, Break Stuff, and Rise as a Legend!

games.name: Idle Waters
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of the screen while you do other things. CATCH, COLLECT and DISPLAY fishes!

games.name: Keylocker: Turn Based Cyberpunk Action
games.summary: Keylocker is a Cyberpunk turn based rhythm JRPG inspired by the Mario&Luigi RPG series and Chrono Trigger, in which you play as the singer and songwriter, BOBO. Fuel your moves with the electric power of music in this unforgiving planet by using real-time execution of moves in rhythm game style! Battle the authorities, unlock the secrets of Saturn, play on your own bands' concerts and hack into the network to bring an end to this corrupt system, for better or worse.

games.name: Saviorless
games.summary:
"Savior" is the first independent videogame created entirely in Cuba. It is an animated 2D platformer that utilizes timing mechanics and other experimental elements more similar to non-games and other less commercial aspects of videogames.

The story begins when your protagonist, a "Little God," awakes a strange dream to discover that his world is disappearing. From here begins a frantic search through eight levels, where you try at any cost to find the Creator of the Universe, "The Great God," with the sole purpose of saving your home. But on your way, you very soon discover that you are but an character in an unfinished story, and all the reality around you is only a segment of a colossal game is beginning to collapse.

On this idea, that reality is nothing but a fiction, "Savior" creates an experience where the user will be constantly faced with atypical and surprising situations. We wish to give players the most personal and emotional game possible, and every day we’re working hard at the completion of this project.

games.name: Slime Heroes
games.summary: A game where the slimes are finally the heroes. Play together with your friends as adorable slimes - the only creature that can save the world from an evil corruption. Find different weapons and create your own unique magic abilities to express the way you want to adventure.

games.name: Dreamcore
games.summary: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

games.name: Saborus
games.summary: Saborus, a gripping horror adventure! Guide the brave chicken, through a deadly slaughterhouse. Solve chilling puzzles and face relentless pursuit. Can you survive?

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Wind Runners
games.summary: For centuries, the Realm uses fear and its military superiority to keep the Zarah Igna System under control, but a group of rebellious Ishma arises to fight its tyranny. With their superior aerial combat skills, the Wind Runners will bring freedom to all who live under the shadow of oppression!

games.name: Scalpel, Please!
games.summary: Assist in the curious surgery of a mythological creature. Provide information via voice commands, hand over tools, and manage various modules of the operating room without forgetting the patient's vital signs.

games.name: Fade
games.summary: Fade is a 2D puzzle-platformer game where the player must alter the visibility and perception of their environment by changing its color.

games.name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
games.summary: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Combine moves for traversal, fight the city's rival crime lords, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

games.name: Debtors' Club
games.summary: Be the tax collector of a shady city hall in this narrative-driven resource management game. Talk to debtors, manage a team, make difficult choices, and challenge the city's moral decay. It's their money, but it's your job.

games.name: E-Lich: Corporate Souls
games.summary: There’s no R.I.P at E-Lich Corp! Explore the afterlife in this roguelite bullet heaven that is all about humor, insane power-levels, replayability and awful office jokes. Reap souls along your undead coworkers in a company that values your life. And death. Literally.

games.name: Mechanines Tower Defense
games.summary: Position your EvoDogs against the threats of a machine-dominated future and enjoy this TOWER DEFENSE game with ROGUE-LITE elements!

games.name: Mullet Madjack
games.summary: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… of your enemies!

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary: Fast-Paced Lane-Based Action Brawler. The legendary Changers 7 heroes must fight a new threat that changes the citizens of Sunny Point into terrifying beings! But as they investigate and defeat "villain of the week" like enemies, they suspect that someone from their own group may be behind it all.

events.name: Gearbox Main Theater Show at PAX East 2025
events.description: Gearbox is live at the Main Theater Show at PAX East 2025!

games.name: Risk of Rain 2: Alloyed Collective
games.summary: Lured, enslaved, and left to rust. The Alloyed Collective now stirs from the scrap of their fallen allies, driven by a singular purpose: returning home. Master two new Survivors and descend deep into Petrichor V to take on the Alloyed Collective’s ultimate creation.

games.name: Borderlands 4
games.summary: See if you have what it takes to go down in history as a legendary Vault Hunter as you search for secret alien treasure, blasting everything in sight.

events.name: Virtua Fighter Direct 2025 Spring
events.description: Tune into the latest Virtua Fighter announcements!

games.name: Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.
games.summary:
Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O. takes the gameplay of Virtua Fighter 5 and raises it to new levels! Rollback Netcode support, gorgeous 4K visuals and additional content make it the best version of this legendary game ever.

The legendary fighting series makes its Steam debut with Virtua Fighter 5 R.E.V.O.! Challenge the greatest fighters in the world in the ultimate remaster of the classic 3D fighter,now featuring Rollback netcode support, gorgeous 4K graphics, and all the bone-crunching, martial arts combat of the renowned original. Battle through classic VF modes like Arcade or Rank Match, create your own custom online tournaments and leagues with up to 16 players, or learn from the best in Spectator Mode. Master your fighting style to defeat all challengers in the Fifth World Fighting Tournament and become a Virtua Fighter legend!

games.name: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
games.summary: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

games.name: Gravelmon
games.summary: Gravelmon is a mod add-on for the Cobblemon mod that aims to bring classic, iconic or historically significant fakemon from your favorite fan-games and rom-hacks to minecraft!

games.name: Pokémon Peach Version
games.summary: Welcome to the Celto Region, the setting of Pokémon Peach Version, which is inspired by Ireland! The goal of our rom hack is to capture and emulate a familiar, yet new Gen 3 experience. You will journey throughout Celto, completing the gym challenge, meeting various characters, and venturing through all four seasons along the way. Some will aid you on your journey, while others may stand in your way to the top!

games.name: Pokémon Lime Version
games.summary: Welcome to the Celto Region, the setting of Pokémon Lime Version, which is inspired by Ireland! The goal of our rom hack is to capture and emulate a familiar, yet new Gen 3 experience. You will journey throughout Celto, completing the gym challenge, meeting various characters, and venturing through all four seasons along the way. Some will aid you on your journey, while others may stand in your way to the top!

games.name: Pokémon Blooming Beast
games.summary: One year ago, your gym leader title was revoked and you were forced into an early retirement. But when a new opportunity brings you to the Hallio region, you'll find yourself enveloped in a region-spanning conspiracy. Just like in any mainline game, you'll catch Pokemon and battle gym leaders, but you'll also ask questions, team up with characters, and investigate the history of the region to figure out Hallio's biggest secret: Who is the Beast?

games.name: Pokémon Duelist
games.summary: A Pokémon fan game inspired by the likes of various trading card game-based shonen anime like Yu-Gi-Oh!, Yu-Gi-Oh! GX, and Duel Masters.

games.name: Pokémon Pisces Version
games.summary:
A completely new sequel to Pokemon Emerald with 200+ new Pokemon. We hope you enjoy all of the new footage and look forwards to the romhack releasing by the end of the year.

As featured in F3 2024!

games.name: Pokémon: Salt & Shadow
games.summary:
Pokémon meets Dark Souls.

Defy the perils of Cradle Island in Pokémon: Salt & Shadow. Explore a vast, interconnected world with dozens of possible paths to the end.
Be warned, the challenges ahead are unfair and some may seem truly impossible.

games.name: Spectrobes GBA
games.summary: A rom hack which aims to recreate the original Spectrobes game, but within Pokémon FireRed.

games.name: Celia's Stupid Romhack
games.summary: Celia's Stupid Romhack is a comedy puzzle romhack of Pokémon FireRed, designed for everyone who loves Pokémon!. Enjoy a cavalcade of hilarity, nonsense, and fun! Grab some friends and sit around and enjoy the show together! Every line of dialogue is quirky and fun, and every Pokémon has been changed in some way.

games.name: Pokémon Potassium
games.summary: Pokémon Potassium is a Fan-Made game in RPG Maker XP and Essentials based around Pokémon, where a streamer makes the game. At the same time, the chat does every decision, like what New Fakemon, new items, new moves, etc. This takes place in the Banerica region and joins us in the wacky lore of the lucky Chatters that got picked to be in the game. Every chatter or viewer contributes to the game, whether you are just watching the game grow or helping with Sprites, Art, Music, and such.

games.name: PostScriptum
games.summary: Follow the steps of the protagonist, a melancholic young adult stricken by unemployment and paralyzed by a chronic care-free and lethargic attitude. His redemption-seeking and guilt-averting efforts are eventually met with a job interview, at none other than the Pokemon Couriers, a prestigious, esteemed, and highly regarded organization. Setting his sights on the future, he attempts for the last time to begin anew.

games.name: Pokémon Coda
games.summary: Pokémon Coda is a short plot-driven game focused on narrative and world-building.

games.name: Pokémon Beyond DX
games.summary:
On a planet far, far away, lies the galaxy's greatest mystery... a collection of hermetic tombs that seemingly defy all logic.
10 Standard Years ago, the tombs began to open... Unbeknowst to the people of the Pangalactic Empire, the fate of the galaxy was about to change forever.

games.name: Pokémon Lost World: Echoes of Eternity
Pokémon Ageless
games.summary: A grand adventure set in the diverse Muzon Region! At the heart of the conflict lies the sinister Team Umbra, an ancient organization obsessed with achieving immortality. Their failed attempts to harness the power of the legendary Ho-Oh resulted in the creation of Corrupted Forms—feral Pokémon mutated by experimental exposure to chemicals found in the region’s Flabébé population. Team Seraphs is a resistance group fighting to protect Muzon’s ecosystems and its people, aiming to stop the spread of these dangerous mutations. You’ll take on the role of either Carter or Grace, twin siblings from the wealthy Salone family who receive rare Pokémon from Professor Agerwood and begin a journey across the region’s eight gyms. Along the way, you'll face rivals like Micah, meet allies such as the former Hoenn Champion Raisen, and unravel the truth behind Team Umbra’s century-long legacy.

games.name: Doki Doki Pokémon Club!
games.summary: "Doki Doki Pokémon Club!" follows Natsuki, Yuri, Monika, Sayori, and the main character as they get sucked into the Pokémon world. They have to work together to try and find their way out of the game. However, the personal problems they keep to themselves always find a way to hurt those around them and stop them in their journey.​

games.name: Tower of Ashes
games.summary: Tower of Ashes is a roguelite game made for the Eevee Expo Game Jam 10 by Brawligator and PikachuMazzinga.

games.name: Pokémon Berserk Version
games.summary:
The Awakening Phenomenon is a phenomenon we have recently discovered by using the power of the Berserk Gene found from different types of species of Pokémon.

It temporarily increases your stats in battle, although the phenomenon still has a couple of quirks so you may not want to use it all the time, or else your Pokémon may have some... Unfortunate side-effects.

games.name: The Slowpoke Shack
games.summary:
Archer and his partner Growls the Growlithe have recently moved to Silverspring Town and opened The Slowpoke Shack.

Running a successful restaurant was never going to be easy, but Archer never expected so many difficult challenges to come his way...

games.name: Pokémon: A Star in the Desert
games.summary: A new adventure heats up in the world of Pokémon, with yourself starring as one!

games.name: Pokémon Covenant
games.summary: A life of poor decisions has led you to this moment, the moment where you commit your greatest transgression. In the final moment, you are saved by a mysterious figure and given a chance at redemption. Can you, with your memories wiped and true goal unclear, fulfil the terms of your unbreakable covenant and be born anew? You must traverse the ethereal land of Varia and overcome the seven Vices that represent the aspects of your shattered heart, endeavoring to collect the mementoes along the way that will allow you to piece together your forgotten past.​

games.name: Pokémon HGSS: Sevii Islands
games.summary: Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver: Sevii Islands is a Pokémon Fan Game created by PurpleZaffre using RPG Maker XP and Pokémon Essentials v16.2.

games.name: Pokémon Decay
games.summary:
Pokémon Decay is supposed to be a best of the first four generations.
It's intended to give the player as much nostalgia as possible by referring to the storylines of the old games.

Due to natural disasters the four regions Kanto, Johto, Hoenn and Sinnoh collided and became one big Region, the Talem Region.
The player wakes up and can't remember what happened. He has to find out what caused those natural disasters.

games.name: Pokémon Sors 2
games.summary: The International Police has set its foot in Hupest after the events of Pokémon Sors. Siara's staff was arrested and the organization was disbanded, Asher's group wasn't safe from law either. While Asher and Valora did not face any charges, Jackson (Asher's father) and Prof. Ivo were facing charges, however due to a deal between Asher and the IP they were given a pardon, in return of their knowledge of Eclipsing, support in research and Asher's Eclipsing related artifacts. 3 years later in Aclyn (the International Police's main HQ's location), the IP is organizing a new ITP Group after the collapse of the trio from Pokémon Saiph 2. Micah left the police and his location is unknown, and Darlo was laid off due to the Regris incident. Lori is tasked with organizing and leading a new, larger ITP Group. Around the same time Asher decided to break his deal with the IP and raided Aclyn's HQ to steal the artifacts. His reasons and motives are unknown to the police. Due to these turn of events, a young citizen of Aclyn, Rene/Haru decides to become a cadet in Lori's new ITP Group at the International Police, and a year later they become an official cadet. Will they be able to climb the ranks? Will they become part of something bigger than what they ever imagined? Find out in Pokémon Sors 2!

events.name: Persona 5: The Phantom X Transmission Vol. 2: Release Date Announcement Special
events.description: We will share the latest information about the Persona series' newest title, Persona5: The Phantom X, including details on the release date and the English version rollout.

games.name: Persona5: The Phantom X
games.summary: Persona 5: The Phantom X is a spin-off of Persona 5, and is officially authorized by SEGA with deep involvement by Atlus.

events.name: Creature Feature
events.description: The first ever Creature Feature will include updates, announcements, and shenanigans from all Creature label studios. You will see brand new game announcements, new content for some of your favorite games, and a few surprises along the way.

games.name: Adepts Arena
games.summary: Adepts Arena is a first-person adventure for both flat-screen and VR, featuring advanced physics-based effects. Master the power of the earth element, learn new abilities from ancient spirits, and aid them in their war against the sinister Golem Army!

games.name: Laser Dance
games.summary:
From the creator of Cubism comes LASER DANCE, a mixed reality game that turns your living room into a laser obstacle course straight from a spy film!

Players move between two buttons on opposite ends of their living room, traversing a sequence of laser patterns which adapt to the room’s size and layout. Different laser patterns will have them move in different ways, as they dance, dodge, and crawl their way to the finish line.

Easy to learn but hard to master - Laser Dance’s deceptively simple gameplay makes for a perfect party game to get both newcomers and seasoned VR players moving in mixed reality!

games.name: Thrasher
games.summary: Thrasher is a mind-melting cosmic racer and an essential audiovisual experience. Swoop, dash and thrash across the void, taking on wild bosses in a race for survival that begins at the dawn of time.

games.name: The Light Brigade
games.summary: A roguelike VR shooter with realistic gunplay and immersive light magic. Ascend the ranks of The Light Brigade to unlock new weapons, upgrades, classes, and abilities as you fight to restore light to the darkness.

games.name: Budget Cuts Ultimate
games.summary:
Zip, sneak, and stab your way through a heart-pounding dystopia filled with evil robots! What began as a cost-cutting strategy has spiraled out of control, and now it’s up to you to save humanity from being optimized out of existence. Budget Cuts Ultimate is the essential VR action stealth game, containing all previously released games and content updates.

As your last human co-worker is hauled away, a mysterious briefcase from someone on the outside is delivered to your desk. You need to get to the bottom of what is going on at TransCorp.

Sneak around enemy robots by climbing through air ducts and service tunnels, or embrace violence by unleashing a fistful of knives, quivers of arrows, grenades, and coffee mugs onto their unsuspecting circuits. Once you’ve completed your mission, test your skills in the arcade with multiple modes, difficulty levels, and scoring.

games.name: Garden of the Sea VR
games.summary: You wake up on a small island in a magical world. Grow your garden, nurture local creatures, furnish your home or adventure across the seas to explore more islands and gather new resources. This world is for you.

games.name: Garden of the Sea
games.summary: A chilled-out life sim where you play, craft, and explore across magical islands. Build a house, grow a garden, nurture animals, adventure across the surrounding ocean, and make yourself at home!

games.name: Crossings
games.summary: Explore and Fight your way through an ever-changing world in a quest for vengeance and survival in an epic Adventure through the Norse afterlife. Meet fellow lost souls in seamless and wordless VR Co-op as you Block, Dodge, Strike and Power your way through Trolls, Draugr and other dark beings.

games.name: Wordbound
games.summary: Wordbound is a mixed reality puzzle game where the world is made of words. Take a journey to unscramble the world, solve daily challenges, and craft your own puzzles to share with friends!

games.name: Prison Boss VR
games.summary: Prison Boss VR is a crafting and trading game using room-scale to turn your VR space into a jail cell! Craft cigarettes, alcohol and cookies for other inmates! Customize your cell as your reputation grows! Earn cash until you can’t store it anymore and become the Prison Boss!

games.name: Crime Shop Simulator
games.summary: Crime Shop Simulator: A Prison Boss Game is a VR crafting game where you play as a shop owner smuggling prohibited stuff. Produce and sell beers, erotic magazines, cigarettes, and more! But watch out, the police are cracking down on contraband!

games.name: Winds & Leaves
games.summary:
Learn to read the signs of the various climates, awaken old landmarks, and grow your own forests in this PlayStation VR flora builder.

Stranded in a barren landscape, you are the only being capable of mastering the ancient art of growing vegetation.

Journey across the Steppe to discover landmarks left behind from a previous time. Uncover their secrets in order to unlock new equipment and gather ancient dormant seed varieties. Find the perfect conditions to plant them in and you'll witness magnificent trees grow to maturity and transform the landscape.

games.name: Broken Edge
games.summary:
Broken Edge is a VR multiplayer fantasy dueling game where you embody historical sword fighters. Use their unique techniques and powers combined with cutting-edge fencing mechanics to claim victory against online components and climb the ranks!

All characters are equipped with unique weapons, coupled with their own distinctive martial arts style. Learn to master these ancient fighting patterns to awaken the energy of your blade and dominate your foes online.

games.name: Compass
games.summary:
Compass is an open-world VR flying adventure set among otherworldly skies.
You are a scout flying ahead of a wandering Caravan, charting safe routes through unknown skies.

Pilot your ship across shifting landscapes, navigate hazardous environments, solve physical puzzles with grapples, upgrade your vessel, and uncover the secrets of a sky where something stirs within the clouds.

games.name: Maestro: Duel of the Fates
games.summary: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication with a classic Star Wars twist. This new DLC is fitted with the iconic Duel of the Fates from Star Wars Episode 1 and will be launching on June 20 for PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2), Meta Quest, and SteamVR.

games.name: Starship Home
games.summary: Traverse the galaxy in a starship bound for discovery! Prepare your living room for lift off as you depart on a cozy interplanetary expedition to collect, nurture, and befriend plants from around the galaxy. Immerse yourself in the mystery of an interstellar crisis from the comfort of your own home.

games.name: Deadly Delivery
games.summary: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 3 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans.

games.name: We Are One
games.summary: Work together with yourself in VR! We Are One is a puzzle shooter where you solve mind-bending puzzles by cloning yourself and playing with time loops. Cleverly plan ahead and cooperate with your own clones - the only help you really need (and get) is yourself!

events.name: SideQuest Indie Spotlight - Summer 2025
events.description:
The future of VR starts here!
Join us as we shine a spotlight on the boldest, most original creations in indie VR of 2025!

games.name: Titan Isles
games.summary: Titan Isles is a co-op action adventure game for VR platforms. Join up to 3 friends to battle giant Titans with unique weapon and traversal combos.

games.name: Banter
games.summary: Banter is a social experience in virtual reality; you can meet new people and visit various worlds. Banter has various events you can join daily!

games.name: Maestro
games.summary: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication.

games.name: Adepts Arena
games.summary: Adepts Arena is a first-person adventure for both flat-screen and VR, featuring advanced physics-based effects. Master the power of the earth element, learn new abilities from ancient spirits, and aid them in their war against the sinister Golem Army!

games.name: Deadly Delivery
games.summary: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 3 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans.

games.name: Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

games.name: Iron Guard: Salvation
games.summary: Step into the world of IRON GUARD: Salvation, a sci-fi Tower Defense game with real-time strategy elements. Build your defenses, upgrade turrets, and fend off waves of relentless robots with your handheld drone - your tactical brilliance is humanity’s last hope!

games.name: Boom Boom Hamster Doom
games.summary: Strategically maneuver your Combat Hamsters armed with an arsenal of powerful weapons across procedurally generated, fully destructible terrain. Dodge deadly mines, trigger explosive barrels to outsmart your foes, and fight to be the last Coham standing!

games.name: CloserLook VR: Oldways
games.summary: CLoserLook: Old Ways, a captivating interactive story VR adventure game set in modern day west Africa. Awakening in a locked university administrative building, you'll need to solve a series of intricate puzzles to find your way out. As you navigate through the game, explore secret locations and uncover a gripping narrative that delves into themes of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal.

games.name: Final Fury
games.summary: A multiplayer VR fighting game created by Kluge, studio behind the dance-action VR rhythm game Synth Riders.

games.name: Table Party
games.summary: Welcome to the fantastic boardgame world! If you want to play board games in VR, download Table Party right now! You can enjoy a variety of content in a wonderful virtual space with everyone. Enjoy 9 board games and 4 casual games in a fantastic virtual world with the cool look I imagined! Have fun!

games.name: Tammuz: Blood & Sand
games.summary: A mythic VR puzzle-box adventure where ancient mechanisms come alive beneath your hands. Solve over 20 unique trials inside a divine cube prison and uncover Mesopotamian secrets that blur the line between reality and legend.

games.name: Memoreum
games.summary: MEMOREUM is a VR sci-fi action horror campaign. The Ichor Infection has taken over the last ship of humanity. You are Dr. Otto Hudson, fighting to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak as your fragmented mind slips from reality.

games.name: The Doctor's Room
games.summary: The Ultimate Mixed Reality Demo for Quest 2 and above. The Doctors Room is the perfect spooky but not-too-spooky puzzle game where you must search The Doctors Room for the passcode to return to the ground floor! Your space will be transformed as a mysterious elevator appears in your room, taking you down to The Doctors Office.

games.name: Strayed
games.summary: Strayed is an open-world multiplayer VR survival game focused on player vs player interaction. Explore randomly generated islands, abandoned structures, and the vast wilderness to gather resources for survival. But be aware; There are dozens of other online players with the same goal.

games.name: Going Loco
games.summary:
Armed with spare bits of road, railway, and anything else to hand, take on the role of a city planner as you repair the routes for vehicles on your charming, low-poly city map.

Your targets will travel at different speeds, and they may travel on custom routes, so you will need to get creative and build around their various requirements. You may need to block access one way in order to free up another, or send cars in a loop to let a bullet train pass through.

This charming puzzle game should be easy to learn, but hard to master in order to attain all the 3-star scores. Can you perfect every level??

games.name: Motion Soccer Pro
games.summary: Motion Soccer PRO immerses you in 11v11 matches that you'll experience in a whole new way thanks to Virtual Reality: control the game from an aerial view, play in first person with classic controls, or use real movement to control the player's feet. Get ready to dominate the field!

games.name: Journey Up
games.summary: Gain sentience and climb up out of the mines and beyond on your own or online with up to 4 players. Play with checkpoints or without for a more tense experience. Supports VR and desktop monitor mode. Can you reach the top?

games.name: Knights of Neon
games.summary:
Knights of Neon is an action packed Hack n' Slash with RPG elements set in the retro realm of Cyberspace.

Prepare to immerse yourself in a thrilling fusion of medieval valor and futuristic cyber-warfare with "Knights of Neon," the ultimate VR combat experience.

games.name: Mythic Realms
games.summary: Bring the adventure to your living room in Mythic Realms’ mixed-reality fantasy adventure. Test your skills and gather loot to build up your very own VR kingdom. Mythical creatures and epic boss fights await in this RPG roguelite.

games.name: Battlegrounds
games.summary:
This is Battlegrounds - your free multiplayer medieval sandbox where you mine, explore, and fight across the Kingdom.
Explore mysterious caves, pull off impossible stunts, or dive into the madness of medieval mayhem. Whether you're exploring the biomes with your friends or exploding them with cannons, the Kingdom thrives on your actions.

games.name: Tube Time
games.summary: Grab a tube and dive into the vibrant, colorful world of Tube Time! Drift through stunning canyons, shifting skies, and flowing waters, all while soaking in the perfect mix of chill vibes and immersive fun.

games.name: Floating World
games.summary: 【Survival】|【Building】|【Sandbox】 Start with just a raft, the rest is up to you!

games.name: FastHands
games.summary: FastHands is a VR "Parkour Playground" set in a stylised quantum realm where the world forms and disintegrates around you. Climb the leaderboards on the race tracks, play mini-games and special multiplayer battle modes with friends and explore mysterious anomalies in the narrative adventure. It supports controllers but has a unique hand-tracked locomotion system for maximum immersion.

games.name: Hellfire Rampage VR
games.summary: HELLFIRE RAMPAGE is a thrilling VR adventure where you, as the inventor of teleportation, hunt for crystal essences to unlock a portal to dangerous dungeons. Battle hellish creatures using a vast arsenal of interdimensional weapons. Unique combat mechanics and challenges are awaiting!

games.name: Rhythmic
games.summary: RHYTHMIC combines the fast-paced VR rhythm-game genre with tactical tower defense. Collect magical particles in tune with epic music and skillfully unleash powerful spells upon invading enemies to defend the people whose only hope is your prowess!

games.name: Flic and Flac
games.summary:
The seven magic crystals are in danger. The world is under attack by Flic and Flac, two rogue creatures causing chaos and destruction.
Step into the action in this thrilling VR experience, armed with laser blasters, you'll blast your way through waves of enemies, collect yellow and red stars to rack up points and for the highest scores, hit the green musical notes in sync with the beat.

Flic and Flac is an electrifying blend of action, rhythm, and skill. Are you ready to save the crystals and become the ultimate VR hero?

games.name: Beauty Salon Simulator VR
games.summary: Step into the ultimate virtual beauty salon experience! Transform your clients with a variety of makeup, pedicure tools, extensions, accessories and outfits in this creative and relaxing simulation sandbox. Customize every detail of their look, snap stunning photos, and let your imagination shine!

games.name: Epyka
games.summary: Epyka is an adventure, puzzle, narrative VR caper into the mysteries and blunder of a forgotten society. Reveal secrets by deciphering clues, decoding hidden messages, and revealing veiled pathways on your quest to finish what your father started and finding out what happened to the world's first civilization. The game's short length and squabble from characters doesn't diminish the fact that Epyka is incredibly charming and the gameplay is so intriguing all the way through that your only complaint might be that you want more.

games.name: BattleGroupVR2
games.summary: BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

events.name: NetEase Games 520 Online Conference 2025
events.description: With more than 30 games expected to be showcased, the yearly NetEase Games 520 Online Conference will take place on May 20th, 2025, and be livestreamed across BiliBili, Douyin (TikTok), Kuaishou (Kwai), Weixin (WeChat) Channels, Xiaohongshu (RedNote), and CC Live.

games.name: Where Winds Meet
games.summary: Where Winds Meet is a free-to-play wuxia action-adventure RPG set in China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Players take on the role of a wandering adventurer known as a youxia, wielding a variety of weapons including swords, spears, fans, and umbrellas, each paired with distinct martial arts styles. The open world spans multiple regions and supports both single-player and multiplayer modes, with cooperative dungeons, PvP arenas, and a range of casual activities. Combat combines light and heavy attacks, martial art skills, mystic arts, and defensive maneuvers like dodges, blocks, and deflects.

games.name: Fantasy Westward Journey
games.summary:
Turn based MMORPG in China from 2003, based on a classic novel: journey to the west.
Had its peak concurrent player number of 2.71 million around its 10th birthday.

games.name: Westward Journey Online
games.summary: Chinese MMORPG, based on the classic Chinese novel Journey to the West. At its height, it was the most popular MMORPG in China.

games.name: Justice Online
games.summary: Justice is a martial arts MMO based on Wen Rui'an's novel The Four Great Constables. Pick from over six different classes, each with unique skills and abilities. Engage in fast-paced and fluid combat made possible by NetEase's custom in-house engine. Play through the campaign chapters and meet NPCs with their own stories to tell, with all threads coming together to weave an epic tale. Fight in epic PvE boss battles, PvP streetfighting skirmishes, and massive PvP wars.

games.name: Naraka: Bladepoint
games.summary: Naraka: Bladepoint is a 60-player action Battle Royale offering players insane mobility powered by parkour and grappling hook, a vast arsenal of melee and ranged weapons, and a roster of characters with powerful abilities—transform yourself into a gigantic Vajra Warrior and crush your enemies!

events.name: Six One Indie Showcase - May 22nd, 2025
events.description: The sixth Six One Indie Showcase airs on May 22nd, featuring never-before-seen world premieres, digital showcase debuts, and exclusive news from indie developers and publishers from across the globe. Once the Showcase ends, audiences are able to delve deeper with developer interviews, hands-on previews, and the Six One Indie Showcase Steam Event featuring discounts and demos from both Showcase participants and indies on our radars.

games.name: GuGu Pizza: Delivering Pizza to the Space Station? Boss, This is Just Not Right!
games.summary: GuGu Pizza’s motto is to deliver anywhere! So couldn't refuse the pineapple pizza order that came from the space station. Eventually, the pigeon deliveryman begins a high-altitude jump to deliver pizza to space, passing through the city, forest, and sky...

games.name: Lonely Mountains: Snow Riders
games.summary: Test your skiing skills in serene mountain scenery. Perform tricks, discover shortcuts and try to best your time in the snowy followup to Lonely Mountains: Downhill. Enjoy the slopes alone, participate in thrilling online multiplayer races or gather your friends and conquer the mountains together.

games.name: Leftovers KO!
games.summary: Leftovers KO! is a Punch-Out-inspired, hand-drawn animated boxing game where you fight a bunch of leftovers. After a long day at work, you come home to find that your uneaten food has come to life—and it's here to beat you up... with its hands! Defeat them all and uncover the truth!

games.name: Equinox: Homecoming
games.summary: Saddle up with friends and investigate a dark mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. For fans of horses, murder mysteries, and cozy exploration!

games.name: Leila
games.summary: Enter the world of an everyday woman as you explore her past in this point & click narrative game. Hand-drawn animations bring her memories to life, and thought-provoking puzzles lay bare the reasons behind her choices. Immerse yourself in a story unfolds as you decipher its intricate pieces.

games.name: Fraymakers
games.summary: Fraymakers is a full-featured modular platform fighter from McLeodGaming, the creators of Super Smash Flash 2, the most popular Smash Bros. fan game on PC. It features a main cast of beautifully sprited and hand-animated characters, detailed stages from their worlds, and a massive selection of assists from a broad selection of indie titles!

games.name: Truth Scrapper
games.summary: You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: 1000 Deaths
games.summary: 1000 Deaths is a 3D adventure platformer about interpersonal conflicts and the effects of the media. Play fast-paced episodes and discover wildly different endings with each play through. Switch perspectives from a pool of eclectic characters, making decisions that you'll take with you to the grave.

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime
games.summary: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.

games.name: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
games.summary: Join Selene in a charming platforming and puzzle adventure, where her ability to absorb and emit light from various flowers is key to activating mechanisms, overcoming obstacles, and navigating through environments that adjust depending on how you wield the light.

games.name: Cast n Chill
games.summary: Cast n Chill is a cozy idle (and active) fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

games.name: Future Vibe Check
games.summary: Future Vibe Check is a musical automation game where your factories don’t just produce goods—they make music. Summoned by Infinity, you must rebuild reality. The call of endless optimization will be sublimated into sound. Automate the Vibe. Defend the Vibe. Become the Vibe.

games.name: Fretless: The Wrath of Riffson
games.summary: In this turned-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

games.name: Away From Home
games.summary: A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!

games.name: Anatine
games.summary: Anatine is a pixelated metroidvania game that contains organic musical elements. Play the flute to interact with the environment or unleash powerful magic!
