With each move, you step into the lives of three unique characters, uncovering their personal stories through the items they take with them—or leave behind.

games.name: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
games.summary: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

games.name: Hotel Galactic
games.summary: Hotel Galactic is a cozy management game inspired by Studio Ghibli's classic pictures. Build the tourist destination of your dreams, oversee and unite your staff to forge a quirky family, and make new friends as you explore this wholesomely nostalgic world.

games.name: Discounty
games.summary: Manage your own discount supermarket! Get caught up in small-town drama, organize and plan your shop's layout, and strike lucrative trade deals as you expand your secretive aunt's business empire. Selling more frozen fries will surely heal this broken community...right?

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

games.name: Outside the Blocks
games.summary: Unleash your creativity and design your own diorama in Outside the Blocks ‒ a full-featured model builder. Shape the terrain, assemble modular houses, add decorations and put your creation on display!

games.name: Clawsome
games.summary: Control a claw in a chaotic world where grabbing prizes is harder than it looks! Avoid moving platforms, disappearing objects, and unexpected twists while building your own diorama with the trophies you collect.

games.name: The Berlin Apartment
games.summary: The Berlin Apartment tells the moving stories of inhabitants of an apartment in the city of Berlin over the last 120 years in several unique, emotional episodes as a character-driven adventure game.

games.name: Sheepherds!
games.summary: Sheepherds! is a cozy co-op party game where you and your sheepdog buddies guide colorful flocks through beautiful landscapes to sheer their wool. Take your time and have fun barking, running and discovering magical places together— or take on challenges to win even more treats!

games.name: The Great Coffee Caper
games.summary: A cute and cozy RPG where it's up to Detective Hootsworth to figure out who stole the town's coffee beans. Uncover clues in fast-paced clue battles, question the charming townsfolk, and figure out hoooo dunnit!

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: Anxiety Puppy
games.summary: Anxiety Puppy is a 2D interactive narrative game that focuses on anxiety. In the game, anxiety is personified as a little puppy. Players will explore its story and try to coexist with it. Go find its traces and give it a hug.

games.name: Shiba Sweet
games.summary: Woof! You step into the paws of a novice Shiba chef who inherits a dessert shop from your retired grandma. You'll buy ingredients, bake desserts, and sell them in bento boxes. Use your earnings to upgrade the kitchen, decorate the shop, and unlock new recipes to create the best bakery ever!

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Puni the Florist
games.summary: Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions. Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Mecha
games.summary: Mecha is a 3D puzzle platformer that follows Coni’s journey to find and fix her errant creations. Along the way, she learns the importance of accepting the challenges she faces and finding greater purpose.

games.name: Dosa Divas
games.summary: Platform through a vibrant world in an upgradeable mech and cook delicious meals. Fight off corpos in turn based combat, discover new recipes, build up your reputation with local communities, and bond with friends and family on a journey to taste everything life has to offer.

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
games.summary: “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe” is a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, peruses antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him for fear of losing your head.

games.name: Gemporium
games.summary: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in Gemporium, a casual mining simulation management game. Keep your finances in check as you juggle a growing gem emporium while simultaneously paying off a generational debt. There's only so much time in the day!

games.name: On-Together
games.summary: A social chatroom game to work, play games and hang out with your friends. Stay connected while you work, then use breaktimes to chat, chill, chew bubblegum and more!

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Milano’s Odd Job Collection
games.summary: Milano is on her own for summer vacation, and she’s ready to live her best life! Take on part-time jobs, personalize your home, or spend the day eating popcorn at the park. Experience this retro classic for the first time outside of Japan, now with modern improvements.

events.name: Latin American Games Showcase: Summer Game Fest 2025 Edition
events.description: Showing off 39 games with release dates, world premieres and so much more.

games.name: Will: Follow the Light
games.summary: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

games.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
games.summary: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

games.name: Perfect Tides: Station to Station
games.summary: A point n' click sequel to Perfect Tides about the momentum and whiplash of young adulthood.

games.name: Ministry of Order
games.summary: You’ve been assigned to the Maternity Ward in a totalitarian 1920s state. Reunite newborns with their rightful parents using a simplified genetics puzzle - no mistakes allowed. Obey the regime, join a secret conspiracy, or forge your own path.

games.name: LongStory 2
games.summary: Award-winning LongStory gets a sequel! The Weasel Heights gang continues to surprise and delight as you learn more about yourself, friendship and love. Play as the gender of your choice and date the friend you like best. Throw a big mystery in the mix and you’re in for an adventure!

games.name: KreatureKind
games.summary: KreatureKind is an approachable and wholesome Card Battler/Deck Builder game about helping monsters, rather than killing them.

games.name: Death & Faeology
games.summary: In a world where the fae-touched fall prey to a sinister killer, only a faeologist can uncover the truth. A dark academia murder mystery narrative game inspired by Strange Horticulture and the Ace Attorney series.

games.name: Unseen Diplomacy 2
games.summary: You're a Secret Agent during a dangerous time, Evil-doers are plotting to destroy the world. Complete missions, manage your agents & use Intel to narrow down the plot & save the Earth. Play a real-life VR obstacle course using every inch of your room - you will run, roll, sneak & hack to victory!

games.name: Summer Camp
games.summary: Summer Camp is a Narrative Party Game about telling the story of a perfect summer - but the player who leads in the action-packed mini-games seizes control of the narrative!

games.name: Nano Neighbors
games.summary: An online idle game that brings life to the bottom of your screen with friendly androids called NANOs. Customise your NANOs, choose their occupation, build and design their perfect home, and invite your friends' NANOs over to hang out, join mini-activities, and interact.

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Ascend to Zero
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

games.name: Drywall Eating Simulator
games.summary: Drywall Eating Simulator is a physics-based 3D adventure game where you are pushed to the limits of human (or nonhuman) tolerance by the people you encounter in our world, and the only pressure release that you have is in the name of the game (eating drywall)

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: You've come to help your Granny after a terrible storm destroyed her cottage and wreaked havoc in her idyllic coastal town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and uniting the townsfolk? Connect with nature by foraging, gardening, and cooking, then try out your new skills in the real world!

games.name: Kokoro Kitchen
games.summary: In this delightful farm-to-table cooking game, you’ll restore a cozy Japanese restaurant, cultivate a bountiful garden of fresh ingredients, and prepare mouth-watering Japanese dishes for hungry locals. Use your culinary skills to help bring a little life back to the spirit world!

games.name: On-Together
games.summary: A social chatroom game to work, play games and hang out with your friends. Stay connected while you work, then use breaktimes to chat, chill, chew bubblegum and more!

games.name: Cozy Room Decorator
games.summary: Step into the world of Cozy Room Decorator where you’re the chief curator of cozy and it’s up to you to define what cozy means. Whether that means a lived-in kitchen space filled with sweets, or a tech-laden game room, the combinations are waiting to be explored. Dive into a world of boundless imagination and creativity with a treasure trove of hundreds of items, each brimming with endless possibilities. Equipped with your very own room, this whimsical isometric room design game invites you to unleash your inner interior decorator.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Ila: A Frosty Glide
games.summary:
Set foot on a magical island and immerse yourself in a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training with her trusty skatebroom. Explore, find secret places, collectables, and improve your magic and flying abilities as you make your way to the summit.

Explore a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training. Start your journey fueled by determination and your trusty skatebroom. Find secret places, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

Who needs a broom when you have a skatebroom? Soar through snowy mountains and enchanted forests, feel the wind as you cross stunning landscapes. Master and upgrade the magic of your to soar higher and farther.

Explore ILA’s small open world at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks, uncover treasures, and unlock secrets flying on your skatebroom. Each discovery rewards you with valuable items and deeper lore, enriching your magical journey.

Collect special items and coins to personalize ILA’s outfit with stylish hats, capes, and skatebrooms to reflect your unique style. As you progress, access new skatebroom upgrades to improve ILA’s flying powers.

Feel the magic and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack composed by Joaquim Scandurra (Sku), which builds up and grows with you as you approach the summit.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: A Heavy Morning
games.summary: You know the feeling of struggling to get out of bed? In A Heavy Morning, you will play as a young girl battling with her own mind. Your only objective? Get out of bed and get to work on time.

games.name: Spilled!
games.summary: Clean up ocean waste in this relaxing & satisfying cozy game! Recycle, earn coins, upgrade your boat, repeat! Explore and clean up new areas with more waste and new challenges!

games.name: Prison of Husks
games.summary: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: Roots Devour
games.summary: Extend your roots, imbibe fresh blood, and expand without end. Roots Devour is a strategic exploration game centered around a card-connecting mechanism. Drive your frenzied roots through swamps and over frozen mountains, invading human cities until the darkness... descends.

games.name: Lily's World XD
games.summary: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Dark Hours
games.summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

games.name: Provoron
games.summary: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

games.name: Downhill
games.summary: Experience unlimited power in DOWNHILL, a unique 4th wall breaking action RPG. Take control of a human girl named Fade and become her best friend or her worst enemy as you guide her down the mountain. Her fate is yours to decide, as well as the entire realm's.

games.name: Voyagers of Nera
games.summary: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative seafaring survival-crafting game for up to 10 players. Sail across a magical ocean world, skim along the waves, and protect lost nature spirits from monsters emerging from the depths.

games.name: Re:Fresh
games.summary: Restore your town as you run, jump, and dash through cozy locales while helping lovable townsfolk! Become immersed in a tight-knit community of animals and robots while becoming the town hero in this heart-warming solarpunk adventure.

games.name: Equinox: Homecoming
games.summary: Saddle up with friends and investigate a dark mystery, where each trail leads to wonder and intrigue. A string of events has set the idyllic island on edge. Discover the truth behind your mother’s disappearance and a local's sudden death. For fans of horses, murder mysteries, and cozy exploration!

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: Ascend
games.summary: Ascend is an adventure puzzle game where a young woman must navigate to the top of a mystical mountain learning the secrets of both the past and the future to find the balance in all aspects of life.

games.name: Wander Stars
games.summary: Wander Stars is a turn-based RPG with roguelite elements where you make your own attacks by combining words! Create your own fighting techniques, befriend your rivals, and explore the universe in this story-driven adventure inspired by 90s anime.

games.name: Neverway
games.summary: After quitting her dead-end job, Fiona starts over on a farm and becomes the immortal herald of a dead god. Make friends, fight through horrors and pay your debt in this nightmarish life sim RPG.

games.name: 9 Kings
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

games.name: White Knuckle
games.summary: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Bubumbu
games.summary: Bubumbu is a short and wholesome hidden objects game with a unique twist in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters.

games.name: Code Bunny
games.summary:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

games.name: Greak: Memories of Azur
games.summary: Greak: Memories of Azur is a beautiful single-player puzzle platformer adventure. You will take the role of three siblings: Greak, Adara and Raydel to guide them through the lands of Azur. Alternate control between them and use their unique abilities to escape from the Urlag invasion.

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

games.name: LAN Party Adventures
games.summary: Okay, Pedro is AWOL, and you have to get this LAN Party set up at the Game Store for the session later. Connect cables, install software, and solve puzzles all while you and the gang uncover the mystery of your missing friend.

games.name: Islets Defense
games.summary: Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game where you build a small village to earn resources and defend your castle.

games.name: Ironhive
games.summary: Ironhive is a deckbuilding strategy game about surviving in a dying world. Build your colony, ensure the survival of your people, create a legacy that will be passed on to the next generations. As the Ironlord, you are their only remaining hope.

games.name: Teeko
games.summary: Platformer meets tower defense in this story-rich game inspired by the Costa Rican Día de Las Mascaradas festival. One day, grandma Tita's kids get possessed by the spirits of the gigantes and begin to wreak havoc upon the land. It's now up to her pet sloth, Teeko, to save their town.

games.name: Lurks Within Walls
games.summary:
Lurks Within Walls is a tense survival horror game combining modern dungeon RPGs' exploration elements with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore a series of cursed environments filled with terrifying creatures illustrated by the renowned artist Trevor Henderson.

A building under quarantine. Residents isolated. Those who failed to isolate themselves now stagger through the corridors, contaminated. But it's not just the infected residents—the darkness conceals other anomalies. It feels as if the building itself is alive.

games.name: Block Block Block
games.summary: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary: Fast-Paced Lane-Based Action Brawler. The legendary Changers 7 heroes must fight a new threat that changes the citizens of Sunny Point into terrifying beings! But as they investigate and defeat "villain of the week" like enemies, they suspect that someone from their own group may be behind it all.

games.name: Corebreaker
games.summary: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

games.name: Monstabox
games.summary: Monstabox: A turn-based 1v1 battle game mixing strategy & action. Choose monsters, cast spells, roll to attack, and unleash ultimates. Win by securing the Star after KOing your opponent. Play cross-platform & compete worldwide!

games.name: Tormented Souls II
games.summary: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: Taria & Como
games.summary: Taria & Como is a physics-based puzzle platformer where movement is built around swinging instead of jumping. Play as Taria, a young girl with a prosthetic leg, as she rescues her little sister Como in the midst of a world that constantly underestimates her. Separated after a disaster, Taria wakes up in a hospital where she’s forced to use an “approved” prosthetic that limits her mobility. Undeterred, she takes control of her own fate, using ingenuity and sheer determination to escape and find her sister.

games.name: Dig! Dig! Dino!
games.summary: is a game about digging... for dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

games.name: CatchaDiablos
games.summary: A tiny roguelike where you play as a little guy on a quest to capture all the Diablos stranded on a distant moon.

games.name: Quest Master
games.summary: Quest Master is a dungeon maker inspired by the classics that first made us love dungeon crawling. Unleash your imagination, alone or in local co-op, to make dungeons full of puzzles, traps and monsters. Upload them for others to explore and challenge yourself with other players’ creations.

games.name: Kulebra and the Souls of Limbo
games.summary: An adventure where you’ll meet the many good and not-so-good folks of Limbo. Use your wits and keen eye to gather clues from the residents and find items that will help uncover the mystery of Limbo and its curse that traps souls into repeating the same day on loop.

games.name: Outlanders
games.summary:
Outlanders is a charming town-builder simulation game that lets you play as the leader of a group of regular people building a town together. Some want to survive, while others want to build amazing things. It’s up to you to guide them towards their goal.

Take control of the will of a town leader and balance your resources carefully to lead the town to prosperity. Every choice you make directly affects the progress of your town and has an impact on the happiness of your followers.

games.name: Mind Keeper
games.summary: Mind Keeper is a roguelite shooter and base-building game where you have to construct your own stronghold, which is a representation of your mental integrity, and you must defend it from the relentless waves of inner demons determined to destroy you.

games.name: Kingdom of Cards
games.summary: From cropland to forest, from academy to conqueror's guild, expand territory of your kingdom. As the kingdom grows, crises will quietly arise. No worries: prepare to use the resource cards to train a group of powerful guardians to eliminate enemies and protect your kingdom.

games.name: Dreamcore
games.summary: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

games.name: Oscuro Blossom's Glow
games.summary: Join Selene in a charming platforming and puzzle adventure, where her ability to absorb and emit light from various flowers is key to activating mechanisms, overcoming obstacles, and navigating through environments that adjust depending on how you wield the light.

games.name: The Shadow Syndicate
games.summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

games.name: PancitoMerge
games.summary: Drop, merge, and stack colorful pan dulce to create bigger, tastier treats. Master the art of sweet combos while avoiding a crumbling mess! With charming visuals and simple gameplay, this cozy puzzle adventure celebrates the joy of Mexican baking. Perfect for quick sessions or beating high scores.

games.name: Le Fol
games.summary: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

games.name: Idle Waters
games.summary: A relaxing idle fishing game that waits for you at the bottom of the screen while you do other things. CATCH, COLLECT and DISPLAY fishes!

games.name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a grim survival horror game where you investigate the secrets of an ancient monastery, solve intricate puzzles, and face terrifying nightmares that haunt its shadowy halls. Hunt the Haunt.

games.name: Teios' Journey
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Gunny Ascend
games.summary: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure — Stack, Adapt, Escape! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Despelote
games.summary: Despelote is a soccer game about people. Get immersed in the streets and parks of Quito through the eyes and ears of eight year old Julián. Dribble, pass and shoot your soccer ball around town, and see what happens when you kick it someone's way. Feel the city change as Ecuador comes closer than ever to qualifying for the World Cup.

games.name: Albatroz
games.summary: Leave your dull urban life behind and set out on a journey to find your lost brother, who disappeared while looking to reach a mythical mountain called Albatroz. Use your survival skills to traverse beautiful yet challenging landscapes, ranging from scorching coastal regions to freezing mountains. Manage your resources, strengthen your body, and improve your abilities as you face the wilderness head-on. Discover yourself as you find that the journey might actually be just as important as the destination.

games.name: Euclid's Inferno
games.summary:
Euclid's Inferno is a fast-paced 2D shooter where math is your enemy. Play as the father of geometry, explore a hellish version of the works of ancient mathematicians, and defeat polygonal beasts as you upgrade your geometric arsenal.

Euclid has found himself trapped in a demonic version of his magnum opus The Elements and must traverse the 2D plane and fight against hordes of mathematical constructs.

Defeat enemies and bosses inspired in greek mythology and the fundamentals of mathematics.

Pick up new weapons and abilities as you venture deeper into the abstract realms of geometry and arithmetic. Launch points, cast rays and trace circles to defeat your enemies.

Become the geometer of your own worlds with the custom level editor.

games.name: Grizzly Man
games.summary: 1983, Alaska... During the Salmon Run, a deadly figure known as The Grizzly Man terrorizes a group of tourists led by Bob, an amnesiac former Man in Black. Survive the journey or become the catch of the day in this breathtaking pixel-art interactive fiction with heart-pounding pace!

games.name: Remnants of the Rift
games.summary: A real-time roguelike action game where time is on your side. Play, pause and plan in a stylish retro-future invaded by another dimension, and ride the frequencies between worlds to discover the secrets of a new reality.

games.name: Lost Vulcan
games.summary: Lost Vulcan is a platform game that combines the adrenaline of roguelites with the spirit of classic arcade titles. Play as a brave treasure hunter and enter 'Vulcan', an abandoned interstellar ship said to be filled with legendary riches... and mortal dangers.

games.name: Chunky Jump!
games.summary: Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: Dono's Tale
games.summary: Relive the glory days of the 16 and 32-bit era in Dono's Tale. A super cute and colorful platformer about a hungry little dragon! Jump, dash, climb, and shoot your way through detailed and colorful worlds in order to get back your precious fruit!

games.name: Leap Galaxy
games.summary: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

games.name: Eagle Knight Paradox
games.summary: Eagle knight paradox takes you (the player) into a doble experience, one of them is the role of a powerful mecha trying to protect a space city from space fanatics. On the other hand, the game sets you as the role of Ian (the pilot) building relationships around the city or whats left of it.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

games.name: The Trolley Solution
games.summary: The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

games.name: Gaucho and the Grassland
games.summary: Gaucho and the Grassland is an Animal Farm Sim game where you need to gather resources, explore the land, breed animals and much more, to overcome the challenging life on the grasslands. The world of Gaucho is a mystical wildland, inspired by South Brazil's culture and its local tales.

games.name: Bubblegum Galaxy
games.summary: Bubblegum Galaxy is a cute building strategy game about rebuilding the galaxy tile by tile. Discover and design new planets, complete missions, explore your office and befriend your co-workers... all while trying to find out who deleted the galaxy!

games.name: Damned 2
games.summary: Damned 2 is a asymmetrical multiplayer (4vs1) horror game where a group of survivors must come together to solve puzzles and escape an immersive environment while another player takes the role of a unbeatable monster ready to slay all trespassers.

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: Welcome to DKR a chaotic 6-player party brawler where you bounce, punch, and outwit your friends (or enemies) in explosive arenas full of traps and nonsense. Don’t die. Try not to cry. Blame your controller. It’s all part of the RUMBLE.

games.name: Piss Off
games.summary: Control creatures with gross abilities and compete in absurd frantic battles in this action platformer game. Piss, spit, shit and make your friends taste every fluid you can get on them before they do the same to you. Try not to lose your hair and skin to the corrosive fluids of the other creatures and watch out for the aliens!

games.name: Kernel Hearts
games.summary: Gather your allies. Eliminate Angels. Transform into a Magical Girl. Slay god. Kernel Hearts is a Multiplayer Co-Op Roguelike Action RPG about four magical girls and their attempt to save a world that's drowning in ashes

games.name: A.I.L.A
games.summary: A.I.L.A. is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Demonschool
games.summary: Demonschool is a new-style tactics RPG where motion equals action. Defeat big weirdos in between the human and demon worlds as Faye and her misfit companions, while navigating university life on a mysterious island.

games.name: Dragon Is Dead
games.summary: Dragon is Dead is a hack-and-slash, roguelite action platformer. It offers tons of customization fun with different character skill trees and legendary equipment. Overcome repeated deaths to defeat Guernian, the leader of the Dark Dragons.

games.name: Monsters Are Coming!
games.summary: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Cats Around Us: Black Cat
games.summary: We've hidden a bunch of cats in a silent comic about a black cat that always blends into the shadows. Can you find them all?

games.name: Art is Rifle
games.summary:
Unleashing the Chaos in Shooter Puzzle Genre!

Art is Rifle is an open-world, FPS puzzle game with rhythmic bullets and psychedelic art styles. Powered by Unreal Engine 5 and much passion.

Experience a psychedelic adventure through first-of-its-kind mind altering core gameplay mechanics, beyond visual and auditory designs!

Dive into a world of puzzles where tutorials are optional, and discovery is key! Your solutions, your style. Puzzles are your canvas, solve them your way!

Weaponize your art through a symbolic journey of cultural exploration.

The whole world is your drum kit!

Immerse yourself in a visually striking game that dances with a fusion of intense colors and mind-altering, psychedelic elements.

games.name: Montabi
games.summary: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: I Need Space
games.summary: Travel across the universe with your nebulous companion the Cosmicat, together revitalizing planets and discovering the cosmic truth of the universe.

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Glyphica: Typing Survival
games.summary: Glyphica is a typing-roguelike that blends survival and strategy. Type to shoot. Test your keyboard mastery, unlock powerful upgrades, and craft overpowered builds to destroy hordes of enemies.

games.name: Mirth Island
games.summary: You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!

games.name: Table Flip Simulator
games.summary: Had a stressful day? Blow off some steam in Table Flip Simulator! This physics-based puzzler allows you to unwind as you throw or smash items with hilarious effects. From working as a barista to becoming the President of Antarctica, you can go beyond flipping the table – the world is yours to wreck!

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Until Then
games.summary:
Mark, an average irresponsible high school student, tries to get by and find purpose in a humdrum life of scrolling, cramming, and traffic. He meets friends, both old and new, and embarks upon a seemingly never-ending trouble, until nothing is ever the same again.

Until Then is a contemporary adventure game inspired by the Philippines, its lifestyle, and culture. Featuring a smartphone where mechanics of modern living come into play, chat with your classmates and explore the depths of social networks, where your replies and interactions may pose consequences.

games.name: Shepherd’s Plan
games.summary: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

games.name: GigaBash: MechaJuras
games.summary: This free DLC adds “MechaJURAS”, an original character from GigaBash to the game. Equipped with a unique moveset featuring its massive Rocket Drill to decimate Titans, and a Grapple Claw to grab foes from afar, MechaJURAS is ready to roll out!

games.name: Compensation Not Guaranteed
games.summary: Peek into Southeast Asian politics through a lens darkly. Check ownership for authenticity, listen to stories, decide who should give up their land in the name of PROGRESS!

games.name: Never Ending Beyond
games.summary: The only roguelite where you must pet animals to survive. Each animal comes with its own unique weapons and passive abilities. Pet animals, mixing and matching abilities to create unique skill builds and conquer the Beyond.

games.name: Zhen: Shattered Legacy
games.summary: Zhen: Shattered Legacy is a Twin-Stick, Action-Adventure where you play as a Robot Warrior Monk sent to investigate a decrepit realm in order to restore the righteous way of Kung Fu.

games.name: Kill The Music
games.summary: Auto-Attack to the Beat of the Music and Hit Rhythm Inputs to boost your Damage! Build up your Solo Meter to trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to mow down hordes of enemies!

games.name: Not Monday Cafe
games.summary:
Build and manage your cute cozy cafe while working studying or streaming.
Farming and serving delicious dishes to adorable animal customer in your cafe on the bottom of your screen, all while you're working on other tasks and enjoying your day.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
games.summary: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: Identifile
games.summary:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

games.name: Mala Petaka
games.summary: 2D Pixel Art Shooter inspired Sci-fi FPS runs on GZDoom. You play as 'Petaka', an angry amnesiac that just wants to kill every ugly green aliens and annoying drones he encounters while trying to restore his memories by exploring various universes through warp portals.

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

games.name: Operatives: Revolve
games.summary: A cinematic roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are physically activated "Machines". Enemies can strike, pierce, or bomb them to pieces. Install multiple components to modify your cards, and set off cascading chain reactions to destroy your enemies.

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

games.name: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
games.summary: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

games.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
games.summary: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game focused on restoring dirty items to their pristine state. Use a variety of tools to return objects to their original appearance. As you clean each item belonging to the protagonist, reflect on the significance and stories behind them.

games.name: Kriegsfront Tactics
games.summary: Kriegsfront Tactics is a procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia where you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Build your mecha squad, complete missions, and survive the front another day.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.summary: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Bossfight Tactics
games.summary: A cute and approachable turn-based tactics roguelike, where you become the Bossfight if you win.

games.name: The Fractured Shimmer
games.summary: The Fractured Shimmer is a 2.5D pixel-art survival horror adventure where you follow Eddy, a journalist investigating a string of unsettling murder cases.

games.name: Loading...
games.summary: You are a 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games.

games.name: Eat the Rich
games.summary: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Overhours
games.summary: From building makeshift traps, to defending her new friends from danger and taking back precious time. Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a dystopian media agency that steals time. One employee, together with an unexpected ghostly partner, is trying to retrieve it all.

games.name: Bathhouse Creatures
games.summary: Ready, set, bath! Build and manage your bathhouse for animals in this casual and cozy management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard-earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!

games.name: Burning Sword: Death Sun
games.summary: Burning Sword: Death Sun is a Wuxia hack n' slash game. Play as the great fighter, Zhāng Yì Xiàn, who seeks revenge for the death of his family at the hands of China's powerful Gāo Tiān Qí. Dive into a tale of revenge, redemption, martial arts, and intense swordplay.

games.name: Upin & Ipin Universe
games.summary: Explore the vibrant world of Upin & Ipin Universe—an open-world adventure inspired by kampung life, full of local charm, culture, and heartwarming stories from Malaysia.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: No Straight Roads 2
games.summary: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

games.name: Imagine Earth
games.summary:
In Imagine Earth, players must protect and nurture a fledgeling space colony while wrestling against the forces of corporate greed and climate change. Establish trade, research new technologies, form alliances and wage economic warfare in a real-time battle for galactic survival.

Features:

Boldly Go: Imagine Earth is a real-time planet simulation and a build up strategy game. Your job as a space colony manager is to explore distant planets, build up profitable colonies, and trade resources into space.

Many ways to play: A multi-planet story campaign, ‘competition’ mode with five enemy factions, ‘free play mode with endless procedurally generated challenges, and a Planet Editor with custom building and terraforming.

Hold the line: Use tower defence mechanics to protect your colony from invading aliens, marauding space pirates, and swarms of locusts.

Hostile takeover: Form alliances with other colonies and intergalactic traders, or wage crafty economic warfare to secure total financial dominance for your planet.

Carbon footprint: Earth has been destroyed by an ecological collapse - will your new home go the same way? Keep your worldwide emissions to a minimum, or else suffer rising sea levels, freak weather events, and more.

games.name: Longleaf Valley
games.summary: Longleaf Valley is in danger and it’s your job to save it! Design and create your own wildlife reserve: build habitats, rescue animals and restore the forest.

games.name: Hawthorn
games.summary: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures. Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

games.name: World Reborn
games.summary: After a cataclysmic event fractures the world into many fragile realities, you've been recruited to be part of a community of heroes to save one of the realities—and our own—from a nefarious force called the Rot.

games.name: The Great Ocean
games.summary: Dive into adventure-missions in the earth’s oceans. Explore in your high-tech submarine fascinating spots like the Galapagos or the Deep Sea. Use your upgradeable tools to solve quests when you free jailed whales, or explore sunken WW2 battleships. Swim with majestic whales, sharks and sea turtles. And take real action to save the oceans.

games.name: Avakin Life
games.summary: The amazing virtual world where you can become the person you always wanted to be! Browse thousands of clothing items from amazing fashionable brands to create your perfect look. Explore incredible locations and chat with millions of players from all around the world! Hang out in your customisable apartment where you can relax with friends, or simply enjoy the company of your very own virtual pet. Join up now, and invite your friends to explore the ever-growing virtual 3D world of AVAKIN LIFE!

games.name: Fishing Clash 2020: Fish Catching Games
games.summary:
Millions of anglers already played Fishing Clash! Join them!
The most popular hobby now in your pocket! Start catching fish species in Fishing Clash - free fishing simulator and new 3D game from Ten Square Games, the producer of Let's Fish app. High time to go fishing!

games.name: Puzzle Adventure
games.summary: Puzzle Adventure is a 3D mystery adventure game, filled with unique puzzles and logic riddles. Find hidden magical artifacts, treasures, and crystals, explore a supernatural world full of monsters, beasts, paranormal beings, and hidden enchanted objects.

games.name: Battle Cars
games.summary: Where speed meets destruction. Drive fast, shoot faster. Race, fight, winGet ready for high-octane PvP multiplayer battles in Battle Cars!

games.name: Standoff 2
games.summary: Standoff 2 is a free-to-play first-person action shooter with over 300 million installs worldwide. Immerse yourself in the engaging world of tactical battles and dynamic firefights in the free-to-play multiplayer shooter genre.

games.name: Sweave
games.summary: Sweave is a hyper-casual game that showcases African culture through unique patterns, weaves, and symbols.

games.name: Zoo Craft
games.summary: Dive into Zoo Craft - Experience the Ultimate Zoo Simulator and Animal Game where you prove your skills as a zookeeper tycoon by transforming a tiny zoo town into the greatest wildlife park paradise on the planet! Ready, set, build, and care for your animals to become the top zookeeper!

games.name: Orna
games.summary:
Geocaching meets the classic turn-based RPG.

In this unique GPS powered multiplayer RPG, enjoy turn-based combat, collect and upgrade your weapons and armor, compete in PvP battles, battle through dungeons, slay dragons, and claim real world landmarks online with your mobile device, wherever you are.

games.name: Hay Day
games.summary: Hay Day is a totally new farming experience with smooth gestural controls lovingly handcrafted for your Android and iOS devices.

games.name: Art of Solitaire
games.summary: Level up your chill time with Art of Solitaire. Forget boring card decks – we’re teaming up with real indie artists to design every card, bringing you gorgeous, original artwork. Build your ultimate card collection as you flick through Patience, Pyramid, and Spider. De-stress with a good FLICK!

games.name: King of Meat
games.summary:
King of Meat is a co-op party platformer, pitting up to 4 players against devious dungeons filled with puzzles to solve, challenges to traverse, and ridiculous monsters to fight.

Progress through official and community-built dungeons to unlock new abilities and gear on your way to becoming the ultimate contender!

games.name: Sociable Soccer 25
games.summary: Embrace the excitement of the world's favorite sport in Sociable Soccer 25. Created by legendary game designer Jon Hare, Sociable Soccer 25 features his signature fast-paced, arcade-style and intuitive gameplay, enriched with multiplayer head-to-head matches and collectible player cards.

games.name: Sunshine Days
games.summary:
You've been gifted the keys to a home of your own! Explore your new neighbourhood, with your friends and a cast of kooky characters full of heart!

Play with new friends and old, helping Mayor Sylvie and the other residents to make this mountain hamlet into a thriving and green community.

Your home is yours to personalise as you desire, but the village at large is one big community. Share and explore this new world together!

games.name: Exoborne
games.summary: Exoborne is an open-world, tactical extraction shooter set in a world torn apart by extreme forces of nature. Customize powerful exo-rigs to gain strategic advantage in ever-changing weather conditions. Face hostile factions, enemy players, and Mother Nature herself in intense high-stakes sessions.

games.name: Bahamut and the Waqwaq Tree
games.summary: Discover a once-thriving ocean, now tainted by enigmatic dark forces. Your quest: decipher the mystery and rekindle the ocean's radiant light.

games.name: Azooma Escape
games.summary: Hide. Dodge flying slippers. Avoid that "ONE" uncle determined to feed you. Your mission: escape Uncle's celebration alive and unfed. This culturally rich stealth comedy follows an introverted teen fleeing the world's most persistent hospitality. Can you survive the family gathering?

games.name: Avatar: Realms Collide
games.summary:
A time of peace and harmony is disrupted by a dangerous cult devoted to a dark entity from the Spirit World. As the cult’s power and influence grows across the land, so too does chaos, wreaking havoc and consuming lives, leaving the ashes of formerly serene societies in its wake.

Now, you must face your destiny and embark on an epic journey to recruit powerful benders from across the land, discover heroes of legend and forge alliances with other powerful leaders to restore harmony and balance to the world!

games.name: Ritual of Raven
games.summary: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

games.name: The Walking Dead
games.summary: The Walking Dead: Season One (also known as The Walking Dead: The Game) is an episodic interactive drama graphic adventure video game developed and published by Telltale Games. Based on Robert Kirkman's The Walking Dead comic book series, the game consists of five episodes, released between April and November 2012. It is available for Android, iOS, Kindle Fire HDX, Microsoft Windows, Mac OS X, PlayStation 3, PlayStation Vita, Xbox 360, PlayStation 4 and Xbox One. The game is the first of The Walking Dead video game series published by Telltale.

games.name: Banyu: Reclaiming Hope
games.summary: The northern coast of Java has been transformed into a sunken world due to climate change. Surviving communities now float above the water, working hand-in-hand together and rebuild with the remnants of the past. You are a lone sailor, navigating this solarpunk world with a dream to restore the Great Array — not to speak to the stars, but to catch the sun.

games.name: Lumina
games.summary: Rebuild a city abandoned after a disastrous flood in this solarpunk sim!

games.name: Sky Patch
games.summary: A peaceful 3D farming platformer and puzzle adventure where players must revitalize quiet, floating islands.

games.name: Solar Savage
games.summary: Build your vehicle, roam the lands, live your best SolarPunk life!

games.name: Klondike Adventures
games.summary: Welcome to Klondike! Help main characters Kate and Paul with tricky situations during their travels in the North! The wild lands of Alaska hide many thrilling adventures. Build the world of your dreams and enjoy your Gold Rush city and farm!

events.name: Future Games Show: Summer Showcase 2025
events.description:
The Future Games Show Summer Showcase, hosted by Laura Bailey (Abby Anderson, The Last of Us Part II) and Matthew Mercer (Vincent Valentine, Final Fantasy VII Rebirth), will highlight some of the most  exciting games on the horizon, bringing viewers world premieres, exclusive game demos, developer interview and new trailers from upcoming AAA and indie studios. Featuring more than 40 games including a new trailer for Supermassive Games’ Directive 8020, an interview with Mafia: The Old Country developer, Hangar 13 and a new trailer for Crisol: Theater of Idols from Blumhouse Games.

In addition, FGS Live From Los Angeles returns for its third show this year. Airing straight after the Summer Showcase, FGS Live From will be hosted by the channels own Jules and Amy and will feature more exclusive trailers, news and interviews from the summer showcase season.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: Echoes of the End
games.summary: Embark on a perilous journey to rescue your brother and prevent a looming war. Harness the power of devastating magical abilities to conquer enemies, traverse treacherous landscapes, and unveil the hidden history of Aema.

games.name: Whispers in the Fog
games.summary: Whispers in the fog is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a mysterious forest with haunted locations that will give you a terrifying experience. With realistic atmosphere, scary encounters and only a flashlight to light your way, unravel the mystery that is beyond the forest.

games.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
games.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG set in the universe of The Seven Deadly Sins. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

games.name: Herdling
games.summary: Guide a herd of mysterious creatures on a stirring and beautiful journey into the mountains… and beyond.

games.name: Sleep Awake
games.summary: First-person psychedelic horror set in the far future. In the last known city on Earth, people are disappearing in their sleep. Those who remain exist in a crisis of reckless experiments to keep awake. Katja must navigate depraved death cults, otherworldly forces, and the ever-present horror of The HUSH, to save herself and those who rely upon her.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
games.summary:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

games.name: The Explorator
games.summary: Explore mysterious counter-zones and brave dangers to discover priceless treasures buried beneath the ruins of Atlantis.

games.name: Constance
games.summary: Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action adventure featuring a paintbrush-wielding artist, striving to escape from a colorful but decaying inner-world, created by her declining mental health.

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: Call of the Elder Gods
games.summary: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

games.name: Ascendant.com
games.summary: Ascendant is a squad-based tactical FPS with serious balls. Each match is different, with game-changing events and adrenaline-fueled battles. Set in a dynamic BioPunk world where everything wants to kill you; fight to extract resources, and get out with more than just your dignity.

games.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.summary: From the world of "Lost Eidolons" comes an all-new turn-based strategy RPG. Stranded on a mysterious island with scattered memories, your only means of survival is to fight. Recruit allies, undertake a perilous journey, and battle to reclaim what you've lost... no matter how many deaths it takes.

games.name: Popucom
games.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs
games.summary: The Bureau of Fantastical & Arcane Affairs is a comedic first-person narrative adventure. As an inspector at the Bureau, the fate of this fable is in your hands. Do your job, fix the shambled story — or, don’t. When you're done, step into the hero’s boots and see what sort of tale your work wrought.

games.name: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite
games.summary: Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Hirogami
games.summary: Explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. Embark on a mystical journey to save your fragile home from deadly digital invaders. Take on animal forms to traverse the landscape, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and save the realm.

games.name: Eve Frontier
games.summary: EVE Frontier is an in-development, crowd-built virtual world and player-driven sandbox. As a space survival simulation its inhabitants will find themselves awakened within a shattered region of space, warped by the presence of supermassive black holes gravitationally bound in a macabre dance. Rogue AI infests its depths; corrupting and consuming the remnants of what still stands.

games.name: Formula Legends
games.summary: From the golden age to the modern era, race through time in Formula Legends. Master reimagined circuits, command legendary cars, and chase glory across decades of motorsport history. A love letter to Formula racing, where speed, skill, and strategy define the champion.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

games.name: Phase Zero
games.summary: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Two survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and escape the town in this classic survival horror. Can you make it till dawn?

games.name: Bloodgrounds
games.summary: Delve into roguelike arena combat and city management where core gameplay features strategic battles, town development, and character growth. Command Gladiator units and navigate various mechanics for a comprehensive gaming experience.

games.name: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
games.summary: Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

games.name: Ahoy
games.summary: First person multiplayer action/adventure game set during the Age of Sail. Providing an authentic interactive experience of the 18th century Caribbean through sailing, combat, trade and social mechanics.

games.name: Flick Shot Rogues
games.summary: Flick Shot Rogues is a turn-based rogue-lite that turns movement into a skill shot! Aim and flick your hero to ricochet through levels, dodge enemy attacks, and smash your foes with crazy trick shots. Featuring near-endless replayability, fun upgrades, and a ton of mayhem.

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Ascend to Zero
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what it's like to stop the time? Ascend to ZERO is a time-control roguelike, in which you can use your special ability to stop the time itself and efficiently fight your way through the top. Freeze the time to dodge opponents' attacks using your unique ability, and always hold a higher ground for the combat. However, don't forget that the time allowed for you is confined.

games.name: Animalkind
games.summary: Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Use your powerful mech to establish your ideal town and recruit a variety of characters to join you. It's the paw-fect game to play with up to 3 friends!

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: Scum
games.summary: Scum aims to evolve the multiplayer open world survival game with unprecedented levels of character customization, control and progression, where knowledge and skills are the ultimate weapons for long-term survival. Combining the methodical planning and management of hardcore survival with optional PvP ‘network events’ available to everyone at anytime, SCUM strikes a unique balance between complex simulation and intense action in the next generation of survival game.

games.name: Deathground
games.summary: Deathground is a solo and co-op survival horror game that throws players into a desperate battle for survival against deadly AI dinosaurs.

games.name: Hell is Us
games.summary: If war is the closest we get to hell on earth, it's because Earth harbours the worst of demons: humankind. In an isolated country ravaged by infighting, discover the secrets of your past and deal with the repercussions of a mysterious calamity.

games.name: Fading Echo
games.summary: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Truxton Extreme
games.summary: Truxton Extreme, which inherits the DNA from legendary arcade masterpiece Truxton, is a collaboration with manga artist and Toaplan alumni Junya Inoue.

games.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
games.summary: Team-up, brawl and build in this co-op action game that blends hack and slash combat with roguelite-inspired missions and town-building progression that goes beyond the run! Unlock and upgrade gear, rescue robot allies, and lead the resistance against the world-dominating Combots!

games.name: Joe & Mac: Retro Collection
games.summary:
Grab your club/hammer, the Stone Age is back and bigger than ever!

For the first time, three legendary adventures from the Joe & Mac universe are united in a single collection. Step back in time and join your favorite cavemen in their wildest escapades through jungle mayhem, fighting dinos, and stone-age fun.

Joe & Mac Caveman Ninja: The original arcade hit that started it all. Rescue the village’s women from a gang of Neanderthals and face off against deadly dinos.

Congo’s Caper: A wacky spin-off full of high-flying action, mischievous monkeys and even more prehistoric madness.

Joe & Mac Lost in the Tropics: A tropical sequel where our heroes get new weapons, face new enemies and must defend the Tiki Village

Three full games, one epic Stone Age experience. Whether you are a nostalgic fan or a curious newcomer, this collection is your ticket to relive or discover the colorful chaos of Joe & Mac.

Welcome to the pre-hysterical jungle!

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Ground Zero
games.summary: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! Hark the Ghoul offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Hela: Of Mice & Magic
games.summary: See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.

games.name: Luto
games.summary:
This is a story about death.

Luto is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.

games.name: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping
games.summary: When spookiness strikes a luxury campsite, the one and only Duck Detective is summoned to quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratata Arts and TVT have announced Ratatan, a new rhythm action game from the creator of Patapon previously teased as Project JabberWocky.

games.name: Reach
games.summary:
The ground-breaking cinematic action-adventure from nDreams Elevation – the VR immersion expert’s pioneering new studio.
