Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Make every move matter to shape your destiny. Are you ready to make the leap?

games.name: Agatha Christie: Death on the Nile
games.summary: Death on the Nile is an adventure-detective game, offering a fresh twist on Agatha Christie’s famous story. Set in the lively 1970s, play as Hercule Poirot and detective Jane Royce as they solve two connected mysteries. Dive into a journey filled with intrigue, deception, and unexpected revelations.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Scooby-Doo
games.summary: Pinnacove needs your help! The once peaceful town has become witness to supernatural events. So let's do what you do best, Flipper, clean up the mess! Luckily, you’re not alone. With the help of Scooby, Shaggy and the rest of the Mystery Inc. gang follow the clues and discover an old mystery.

games.name: Mafia: The Old Country
games.summary:
Mafia: The Old Country is a third-person action-adventure game set in early 1900s Sicily. It follows Enzo Favara, a former forced laborer who joins the Torrisi crime family in search of a better life and becomes involved in the violent world of organized crime.

The game follows a linear narrative structure and combines gunfights, knife combat, stealth, and exploration. Enzo travels across Sicilian towns and countryside on foot, horseback, and in period automobiles while carrying out assignments for the Torrisi family.

games.name: Tenet of the Spark
games.summary: Tenet of the Spark is a cinematic action game where you seamlessly switch between 3 timelines — modern day, Viking age, and Aztec world — to get the edge in battle. Crush enemies, solve time-bending puzzles, and explore 3 distinct worlds full of rich history and unique characters.

games.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
games.summary: What would you do if your blood were your only weapon? How much would you sacrifice your life? Experience the unholy island of Tormentosa in this twisted first-person adventure full of horror and action where only your blood can be used to defeat the impious creatures that roam therein.

games.name: Ritual Tides
games.summary: Ritual Tides is an first-person horror game set on a fictional British island, drenched with Lovecraftian terrors.

games.name: Guardians of the Wild Sky
games.summary: Survive, build, craft and explore a vast magical world as you capture and bond with powerful Guardians. Captain your own airship and sail the cloud seas. Build everything from cozy homes to flying castles. Explore this world solo or with friends; the skies are yours to conquer!

games.name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
games.summary:
The original System Shock 2 is a genre-defining experience that established innovative gameplay mechanics that are a staple of the FPS and RPG genre today. Delve through the corridors of the derelict ship Von Braun and immerse yourself in the story rich atmosphere and environments. Explore deck by deck and unravel the horrifying fate of the Von Braun and her crew.

System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary modernizes the 1999 sci-fi horror classic using Nightdive Studios’ proprietary KEX Engine for a definitive version of the game featuring Enhanced Characters, Weapon Models and Animations, Up to 144FPS performance with ultra-widescreen support, Optimized Controller support, 50 Achievements to unlock, Additional Mod Support and Quality of Life Improvements.

games.name: Necrofugitive
games.summary: Necrofugitive is a brutal 2D action platformer about the prison escape of an evil shapeshifter and his attempts to evade the realm's justice. Experience fast paced combat and intense fight or flight decisions as you are pursued by lawmen and merciless bounty hunters.

games.name: Berserk B.I.T.S
games.summary:
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

Collect and craft a plethora of battle chips to be used in real-time during battle. Each battle chip is placed in an ever growing library that you can strive to fill out. Get medals for completing tasks or kick back and spend time decorating your perfect HOME NET.

Level up your B.I.T by dropping them on a mission and taking on the internet, exploring different biomes! Be involved and monitor their battles and use battle chips you've collected in real time and help your B.I.T succeed - or sit back and relax, work on other tasks while you send your B.I.T to handle business!

games.name: Phantom Squad
games.summary: As a team of 2-4 players, communicate, plan, execute and improvise to succeed in this online coop, fast-paced, brutal top-down shooter where tactics are as crucial as skill.

games.name: Prison of Husks
games.summary: A nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife. Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts as you battle pigment-hoarding bosses and seek your lost love.

games.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Antro
games.summary: ANTRO. The underground revolution.An introspective journey to an underground world where music will be your ally.

games.name: Animo Stars Arena
games.summary: A new take on third person shooters with crazy mech customizability. Hop into your battle ready machine and start raking up rewards in competitive matches or compete with your friends in custom ones.

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Deepest Fear
games.summary: DEEPEST FEAR is a sci-fi horror FPS with a retro-future aesthetic. Deep beneath the ocean, a long dormant secret has been unearthed which throws mankind’s future into jeopardy.

games.name: Mixtape
games.summary: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

games.name: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown
games.summary: Thrive: Heavy Lies the Crown is a complex city builder, where the fate of your kingdom hinges on your every decision. Explore this medieval land alone or with friends, make tough moral choices and conquer your foes in RTS combat. Will you struggle to survive, or find the strength to Thrive?

games.name: Davy X Jones
games.summary: Ascend to the highest fathom of a pirate underworld with the infamous Davy Jones on this action-packed, revenge-driven journey. Control the captain's headless body, stay on pace with his autonomous skull and keep his legend alive.

games.name: Blind Descent
games.summary: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

games.name: Date Everything!
games.summary: Date Everything is a sandbox dating simulator set in the comfort of your own home, featuring 100 fully voice acted datable characters! Let the romance flow between your bed, smoke alarm and… Overwhelming Sense of Existential Dread? Are you ready to Date Everything?

games.name: Legends of the Round Table
games.summary: Lead the Knights of the Round Table through King Arthur's legend in a unique RPG, full of honor, magic and romance. Plunge into a colorful world inspired by medieval art, tales and music. Undertake perilous quests and fiercely defend your kingdom to make the flower of chivalry blossom again.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game
games.summary: Terrifier: The ARTcade Game, a bloody retro fighting beat em up with frenetic action and a lot of fun and references to the Terrifier franchise.

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: Dimhaven: The Lost Source
games.summary: After several years, the team behind Quern - Undying Thoughts is back with new mysteries to unfold. Explore Dimhaven, solve mind-bending puzzles and uncover the truth behind the Ravenwood legacy in this first-person adventure.

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.summary: Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival MMO set on the desert planet Arrakis. Players create a custom character and must manage thirst, maintain stillsuits, and contend with environmental hazards like sandstorms, extreme heat, and roaming sandworms. The game involves scavenging resources, crafting equipment, building shelters, and competing with other players to harvest and transport spice. As players progress, they advance through phases from basic survival to leading a guild, eventually participating in faction warfare between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. The game features both PvE and PvP zones, with a Deep Desert area that reshapes weekly through Coriolis storms.

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

events.name: Frosty Games Fest - June 2025
events.description: A new showcase of upcoming and recently released video games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand, which will be presented online via livestream.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: Mars First Logistics
games.summary: Mars First Logistics is a physics-based open-world simulation game, where you design, build and control your own mechanical creations to deliver important cargo between colony stations on Mars. Earn credits, unlock new technology, upgrade your vehicle and tame the hostile Martian landscape.

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: Toroa: Skycall
games.summary: Soar, swoop and glide across the vast Pacific Ocean as Toroa, the Northern Royal Albatross. Discover the hidden wonders of the sea and sky on your epic journey home with the help of Māori God of the winds, Tāwhirimātea.

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Bones: Wandering Soul
games.summary: Sneak past the living. Speak for the dead. Solve your way through a strange city, limb by limb, as a skeleton with no memory in a story-rich puzzle adventure full of mystery and meaning.

games.name: Matchmaker: Dungeon Heart
games.summary: Matchmaker: Dungeon Heart is a narrative-driven dating & romance sim featuring match-3 gameplay. As powerful forces draw near, a Lich raises you from the dead, and tasks you with protecting the dungeons of Torkadall. As you train with the monstrous inhabitants, you may find yourself falling in love.

games.name: Nullstar: Solus
games.summary: Be. Faster. You are a corporate scavenger drone, sent to rip through the decaying corpse of a dying world to salvage its nullstar. Master flight, thrusters, and face ancient guardians and hazards in 80 precision platformer levels set in the ruins of a civilization where all is not as it might seem.

games.name: Cast n Chill
games.summary: Cast n Chill is a cozy idle (and active) fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

games.name: Tea, Please!
games.summary: Tea, Please! is a short 30-minute game that explores the contrast between the drudgery and noise of office life and the surprising happiness and peace gained through remote work during lockdown.

games.name: BraveCart
games.summary: A narrative turn-based puzzle adventure about an abandoned shopping cart who defies two empires and sparks a revolution!

games.name: Anticitizen: Red
games.summary: Use bullet time, a variety of movement mechanics and an improvised arsenal to outwit and outgun biker gangs and corporate police in an American-occupied cyberpunk Australia. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, delve into the lore of the new American empire, and stay for the larrikin charm.

games.name: Key Fairy
games.summary: A hand-drawn, pacifist, folkloric, bullet-hell. Grapple and dance around monsters to collect their shattered stars, weave your way through twisting paths, encounter strange folk, uncover ancient magic, and evade forgotten gods in this frenetic 2D action-adventure.

games.name: Finely Diced
games.summary: Chefs are mercurial at the best of times, and catastrophically explosive at their worst. In this hospitality roguelite, your family's restaurant is balanced on a knifes edge. You have the ingredients, the stove is on, now you just need to cook.

games.name: Reaprieve
games.summary: Death Is Our Beginning

games.name: Corporeal
games.summary: A paranormal mystery where you piece together a haunted family photo album. As the sole survivor of unexplained events in the 1990s, search for answers in an archive of photos rescued from the ruins of your childhood home, manipulate the past, encounter specters & map your cursed family history.

games.name: Dredge
games.summary:
Dredge is a fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your vessel and dredge the depths for long-buried relics. Explore the stories of the strange locals and discover why some things are best left forgotten.
Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

games.name: Sub-Verge
games.summary: Conversation is a dangerous game. Manipulate a fractured band of renegade divers to reach the depths of this short narrative puzzle. Uncover alliances and expose betrayals — before something horrific from the dark abyss silences you all. Don’t let the conversation get too deep.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Unaccessible
games.summary: Unaccessible is a third-person wheelchair platformer about struggling to get a health insurance claim approved on a mysterious island without accessibility ramps. Tackle stairs, climb obstacles and hop your way through the pain of the claims approval process.

games.name: Power Sink
games.summary: Power Sink is a Puzzle-Platformer, set in the depths of an underwater hydrothermal power plant. Explore and repair the station before it falls to pieces from the pressure of the sea and the heat from below.

games.name: Tempopo
games.summary: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

games.name: Which Way Up: Galaxy Games
games.summary:
Which Way Up: Galaxy Games is a family friendly party game that gives unique freedom of movement by allowing you to run on walls and ceilings, orbit around planets, or fall across entire levels by manoeuvring through gravity fields.

Before The Universe existed, the Space Sprites banded together one-by-one to see a dream come to fruition: the dream of life itself. As The Universe began to take shape, so too did space. But space is unpredictable, and creating life is tiresome work. So, the Sprites took it upon themselves to create a pastime. The Galaxy Games.

Each event features its own unique bite-sized challenge where up to 4 players can compete. Eject your friends into space as you race across gravity fields, score a goal with an entire moon, leap across planets to escape a black hole, and capture and hold zodiacal constellations.

games.name: Apothecary of City X
games.summary: Run a warm, cosy apothecary in a cold, dark city. Grim-cosy management sim with card combat and loveable weirdos.

games.name: Winnie's Hole
games.summary:
Join Winnie on a new adventure, from within!
Play as a virus in his body and mind. Capture cells to mutate and build a deck of actions to unleash in combo-driven combat.

A genre-blending roguelite with a dark yet charming story. Embrace discomfort - Sometimes we can't help being seen as a monster...

games.name: Slumbering Woods
games.summary: Explore a wild fungal forest and cultivate it by planting mushrooms that spread and transform the land. Open new paths and help a remote village thrive.

games.name: Isopod: A Webbed Spin-off
games.summary: You're a tiny pill-bug in a big world! From the creators of Webbed. Roll, zip, and slam your way through the gorgeous landscapes of the Australian bush, unite your fellow bugs, and fight back the greedy Fire Ant Conglomerate!

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: Tryhard
games.summary: Turn-based sports RPG about managing an underdog rugby club in New Zealand. Outsmart opponents and upgrade your squad, but also feed your dog and go on dates, in this epic saga of love, betrayal, and community sports.

games.name: Burger Bois
games.summary: A food truck simulator about flavor, not labor. As chief burger designer, craft perfect sandwiches and turn your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces - or disasterpieces! No recipe, no 'one-right-answer': just let your tastebuds take you to the top.

games.name: Foodomina
games.summary: Play as two personified food girls- Takoyaki & Tempura- in their cosmic battle against mold people! Explore a food-themed galaxy, rich in flavour, make friends, & engage in absurd pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from infection! But mold people used to be food people- Maybe there's another way?

games.name: Doggy Don't Care
games.summary: Unleash adorable chaos as a mischievous pup! Explore, collect, and smash your way around the house & beyond in this cheeky adventure. Fetch the approval of your feathered friend, Rocko the Parrot, by digging into a list of fun-filled tasks. It's sure to be a pawsitively unforgettable day!

games.name: Microvania
games.summary: Explore a tiny world, find upgrades, discover hidden paths, and battle bosses in this retro-style metroidvania action platformer.

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic
games.summary: A first-person, turn-based journey into the occult. Who will stand with Aleister at the end of days?

games.name: Malys
games.summary: Expose, endure and expel evil from innocents on your hunt through a corrupted city. As Noah, former priest turned demon-hunter, you'll perform exorcisms, forge precarious alliances and strengthen your deck of arcane tricks in this unholy roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Jupiter Junkworks
games.summary: Fast paced arcade puzzle action awaits you in Jupiter Junkworks! Complete arcade puzzle contracts to earn resources while rebuilding and upgrading a ruined spaceship junkyard. All set in a sci-fi narrative campaign mode where you'll join an unlikely trio of travellers as they overcome challenges.

games.name: Match & Mastery
games.summary: Match & Mastery is a Turn-Based Tactics game with a Match-3 twist. Master your Magic, unleash powerful spells, and face challenging foes to free the land from a deadly magical blight.

games.name: Schrodinger's Cat Burglar
games.summary: A puzzle heist adventure with a quantum flavour! The player controls Mittens the cat as she stumbles into a quantum experiment and gains incredible new powers - the ability to be in two places at once. Explore, solve logic puzzles and evade capture by pest control robots to ultimately save the day!

games.name: Sping
games.summary:
Sp!ng is like a stress ball for your brain!
Experience the zen and skillful world that is Sp!ng.
With only one touch, flow through hundreds of hand-crafted levels.
Unlock new themes that change the look and feel of your experience.
Earn new characters and perfect levels to unlock new challenging modes.

games.name: Misc. A Tiny Tale
games.summary: Embark on an adventure as a tiny robot made of miscellaneous parts. Collect trash, coins, cogs, and more as you help friends around you. Make the world a better place, one tiny task at a time.

games.name: Innkeep
games.summary: Innkeep is an immersive job sim with an RPG core and a dark twist. Run your own fantasy world inn. Serve ale. Share rumors. Tell jokes. Rob your guests…?? Well, maybe just a little.

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

games.name: Snow Cone
games.summary:
Snow Cone is a penguin-themed puzzle game where you arrange snowballs into elegant Snow Cones to match customers' orders in dozens of challenging puzzles. Meet interesting characters and expose the truth behind the city's shady penguin underbelly.

Features handcrafted puzzles, pixel-art graphics, and a jazz-inspired soundtrack.

games.name: Rollick N' Roll
games.summary: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

games.name: Cyber Paradise
games.summary: Revive Mini the Dog digitally through 2D roguelite actions; craft her cyber paradise with beloved moments, like sniffing dog butts XD. Uncover a deeper dystopian narrative and strengthen friendships in cafe chats—a frenetic yet cozy journey.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Draculesti
games.summary: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

games.name: How Was Your Day?
games.summary:
Caught in a strange time loop and with her beloved dog, Beans, missing, 13-year-old Diya discovers that building meaningful connections is key to solving the sinister mystery in this beautifully illustrated 80s-themed narrative adventure. Can Diya break free from the endless cycle and find Beans?

Video game enthusiast and moody 13-year-old Diya’s day starts out rough. It’s the late 80s, and on top of the usual teenage angst—school, bullies, cliques, and annoying adults—Diya’s just moved to a new country, has no friends, and her once-close relationship with her brother is souring. Ugh! But when the only light in her life, her beloved dog Beans, vanishes without a trace, and she finds herself trapped in a mysterious time loop, Diya’s day goes from bad to worse.

Groundhog Day meets Stranger Things in this narrative-driven, point-and-click adventure that brings a supernatural twist to an ordinary teen’s life. Journey through Diya's repeating day, where every interaction could hold the key to breaking the loop and unlocking the truth about Beans' disappearance.

games.name: Total Chaos
games.summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

games.name: Parasensor
games.summary: When Marisol starts a new life as a telecom technician, she finds herself out of her depth in a mutating city. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

events.name: Ñ3 2025
events.description: An upcoming showcase featuring more than 60 games made by hispanic-speaking game studios.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Burgie's Cozy Kitchen
games.summary: A relaxing kitchen game. Manage your burger joint restaurant: minimize the game in the corner of your desk while you do your business and wait for new orders. It can also connect to your Twitch chat to welcome your viewers.

games.name: Infiniclick
games.summary: Combine, automate and upgrade programs to amass a fortune! Infiniclick is a relaxing (or not, it's up to you) incremental game in which your goal is to pay an unfair debt with Fun Corp.

games.name: Why Did The Chicken Cross The Road?
games.summary: A pixel-art shooter roguelike with almost infinity of options to upgrade your weapons. Will you be able to fly the coop and find the answers that your people have been searching for years?

games.name: Your House
games.summary: A narrative puzzle-thriller that blurs the lines between games and books, reality and fiction, puzzles and storytelling.

games.name: Hidalgo
games.summary: Embark on the most iconic and cozy adventures from the classic novel "Don Quixote of La Mancha". In a handcrafted, colorful puppet world, you'll battle windmills, be knighted, will solve puzzles with Don Quijote and Sancho and fight for the love of your beloved Dulcinea.

games.name: Bubble Ghost Remake
games.summary: Guide a small ghost and its bubble through an enchanted castle full of dangers and challenges in this incredible remake of the popular classic "Bubble Ghost". With over 40 levels of skill that include ingenious puzzles and challenging obstacles, get ready for hours of addictive gameplay.

games.name: Unicorn Wars
games.summary: The Magic Forest is in danger. In the midst of an ancient conflict, the brothers Azulín and Gordi, together with an inexperienced group of recruits, embark on a mission to save their home. Honour, pain and cuddles!

games.name: Figure it Out!
games.summary: A puzzle game with an eye in it. And it's free. The game, not the eye.

games.name: Impawlse
games.summary: Take care of your kittens, decorate their space, play with them.... It's all about kittens! The ultimate cat experience awaits you!

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

games.name: Gods vs. Horrors
games.summary: Recruit gods from different mythologies, buff and upgrade them, arrange them in perfect formation, and create thousands of synergetic builds! Gods vs Horrors is a roguelike card autobattler in which you coordinate gods to defend the Earth against cosmic horrors.

games.name: Little Lighthouse of Horror
games.summary: A pixel art psychological horror game inspired by the Flannan Isles mystery. Manage a remote lighthouse, handle limited resources, and confront eerie occurrences as isolation erodes your sanity. Multiple endings await based on your choices and actions. How long can you last?

games.name: Vangaro Tactics
games.summary: Command colorful troops into tactical turn-based battles in Vangaro Tactics! Infiltrate enemy outposts on the Stealth Missions: mine, recruit, move wisely, and you'll stand a chance. Know your commanders and exclusive units to make the most of each faction.

games.name: Cards and Fables
games.summary: Cards and Fables is a deck-builder with a strong roguelite component: strengthen your deck, create synergies, and face powerful enemies.

games.name: Wings of Endless
games.summary:
Wings of Endless" is an action RPG that captivates with its platforming elements and a rich, pixel-art visual style. The game unfolds the story of Hariku, a confident bounty hunter whose routine mission evolves into an expansive quest, revealing the layers of a long-forgotten war. Accompanied by Owly, his mysterious talking owl, and a cast of unexpected allies, Hariku's journey spans across diverse and vivid landscapes filled with secrets, from desolate deserts and lush forests to icy expanses and marshlands​​​​.

The gameplay is dynamic, emphasizing a combat system that allows players to control three distinct heroes, each with unique abilities, and switch between them in real-time to unleash powerful combos. This system, alongside a vast world ripe for exploration, numerous side missions, a variety of challenging enemies, and intricate puzzles, ensures a gameplay experience that is both engaging and rewarding. Additionally, the game features a crafting system for consumables, further enriching the gameplay with strategic elements​

games.name: City of Dolorosa
games.summary: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

games.name: Dark Life Excalibur
games.summary: Dark Life: Excalibur is a fantasy action adventure that tells the story of Aron, a human who is linked to the most famous and legendary sword of all time: Excalibur.

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: The War in Chiapas
games.summary: Control a group of young people who enter the jungle of Chiapas, Mexico, in the eighties, to form a guerrilla whose objective is to create an army to overthrow the government through a new revolution, however, a paramilitary group appears unexpectedly.

games.name: Astro Prospector
games.summary: Astro Prospector is an incremental bullet heaven about mining cofferoids and fighting SpaceCorp. Collect resources, upgrade your ship and become unstoppable. Return AstroCoffee to humanity!

games.name: Backrooms Level X
games.summary: Enter the disturbing world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces. 13 levels and giant enemies await you in this unique experience.

games.name: Echoes of Nara
games.summary: Step into Sognaris where Nara must make his way through the nightmares of its inhabitants. Explore a variety of 2D and 3D worlds with unique mechanics and different visual styles overcoming the fears that may arise.

games.name: Exes Assault!!
games.summary: A BL Bara Romantic Comedy Visual Novel

games.name: Make Your Move
games.summary: Make your Move is a roguelike game where you control the map like a rubik's cube. Create combinations to improve your stats, discover new cubes, get equipment, and battle for resources to protect your world from the void.

games.name: No Vacancy Tonight
games.summary: Imagine waking up trapped in an abandoned motel. When you manage to get out of the room, a phone rings in the distance... In this point & click adventure game in 3D, you will have to use your wit to solve puzzles and find out what happened.

games.name: Panik
games.summary:
Don’t panic!
PANIK is a puzzle game where you have to guide different characters to the goal. Sounds easy... but, can you manage it without panicking?

The panikers are scared and can’t move!
Find out how to calm these creatures and guide them to safety. Complete over 100 levels spread across 8 unique worlds and uncover all the challenges.

Meet the panikers!
Have you seen the one wearing a crown? What about the one with the magician’s hat? Or the robot? There’s even a ninja! Each one has unique abilities to help (or not) you solve each puzzle.

games.name: Railpunk Mayhem
games.summary: All aboard! Enjoy a unique, fast-paced roguelike action experience. In Railpunk Mayhem, survive relentless waves of enemies at breakneck speeds, build a powerful train to manage your crew, and strategically plan your route to the source of chaos.

games.name: Rumbral
games.summary: Rumbral is a dark, puzzle platformer set in a seemingly forgotten world. Find your way in this desolated place while trying to recover your memories and find out who you really are.

games.name: Starduster
games.summary: STARDUSTER is a musical and arcade game wrapped in an abstract aesthetic with neon lights designed for players who enjoy difficult challenges and seek to push their own limits.

games.name: Stars in the Trash
games.summary: Stars in the Trash brings the magic of animated movie classics into a narrative-driven platformer that combines action, exploration and puzzles. Tired of feeling trapped at home, Moka, a spoiled cat decides to run away and seek adventure. Explore, make friends, fight, and escape from the kennelman.

games.name: The Well's Blessing
games.summary: Explore the mystical sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

games.name: Thumps & Blows
games.summary: Chaos and fun are guaranteed in this fighting game, where a quirky cast of stickmen battle each other using ridiculous techniques in fast-paced fights with easy-to-learn yet unexpectedly deep mechanics.

games.name: Falling Stars... And Other Celestial Objects
games.summary: Design the perfect defence system for the city in this physics-based game. Stop the falling celestial objects with turrets, fire, lightning, portals and more! 50 levels that will challenge your ingenuity and creativity.

games.name: Deriva
games.summary: Pilot a submarine through a world swallowed by the ocean and explore what remains of civilization. Catch unique creatures, trade across floating cities, and upgrade your vessel in a narrative adventure with exploration, resource management, and meaningful encounters.

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

games.name: Sands of Hope
games.summary: Explore the sandy landscapes of Cydonia as you use your ancestral powers to build and attach magnetic cubes, find energy cores to restore the land's water flow and meet other villagers with the help of a loyal dog!

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: Retrieval
games.summary: Retrieval is a cinematic horror and action-adventure game. The plot follows the experiences of Hana Loshe, a commander of a research team on a planet 18.6 billion miles away from Earth. Hana Loshe will fall by accident in a subway base where she will discover all the horrors that the base hides.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
games.summary: What would you do if your blood were your only weapon? How much would you sacrifice your life? Experience the unholy island of Tormentosa in this twisted first-person adventure full of horror and action where only your blood can be used to defeat the impious creatures that roam therein.

games.name: Oddli: A Satisfying Game
games.summary: ODDLI is a casual puzzle game about creating satisfying loops. Solve moving puzzles where the only obstacle is your past self. Reach the goal with your character, avoid your previous movements and watch it repeat your path. Continue reaching goals, while creating mesmerizing choreographies!

games.name: RailGods of Hysterra
games.summary: Embark on a co-op survival journey for 1-5 players through a post-apocalyptic Lovecraftian world! Command and evolve a living, monstrous train, craft weapons, build a mobile base, gain powers, and face the Great Old Ones. Explore an ever-changing world, hold on to your sanity, and ascend to godhood!

games.name: Suizokukan Project
games.summary: Turn your desktop into an aquarium! Fish, collect, earn, and decorate your aquarium. Suizokukan Project makes for the perfect companion while you do menial work in your computer.

games.name: Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure
games.summary: Welcome to "Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure"! You're an amphibious dinosaur with the power of water. Face challenges, recover your stolen egg from a ninja, and surf in championships. 2D Jurassic action awaits!

games.name: Stay
games.summary: In this narrative roguelike you will have to survive a post-apocalyptic world from your cabin. Choose well who you let into your home, manage the available resources, and look for the best strategy to go ahead at the end of the world. Survive with your team, or die along the way.

games.name: Codebreakers VR
games.summary: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

games.name: In Silico
games.summary: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

games.name: Kity Builder
games.summary: Explore relaxing deserted islands and build cute cities over them as Kity, the builder cat. Customize the buildings and environment at your own pace in a peaceful, stress-free setting.

games.name: Into the Grid
games.summary: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

games.name: Aureole: Wings of Hope
games.summary: At sonic speeds, Aureole: Wings of Hope takes platforming to the literal skies! Join Ramila and Ryleth on their crusade to reclaim their home from demonic forces in this unique physics-based side-scrolling game.

games.name: Biogenesis
games.summary: Detective Jodie follows the trail of Madeline to the enigmatic Ravenwood Hotel, a place full of secrets. Solve puzzles, manage a classic inventory, and face deadly enemies and bosses. Explore side missions to gain combat advantages. Every corner brings you closer to the truth.

games.name: Candy Rangers
games.summary: Go on a single player, On-Rails Shooter Adventure in Candy Rangers and match 4 colors with 4 rangers! Each ranger can take down enemies that match their color, and it's up to you to use each one accordingly! Can you match them all?

games.name: Darby is Here Forever
games.summary: Help our little vampire Darby getting out from his eternal prison. Log on into a difficult 2D pixel platformer, find out secret rooms, defeat great bosses and end up discovering why Darby has been imprisoned in his own castle!

games.name: Darkbound
games.summary: Darkbound is a survival horror game where you play as a cat. Avoid the darkness, solve puzzles and help other survivors to escape the hospital.

games.name: Double Trip
games.summary: Double Trip is a tile-based sokoban game about solving puzzles with the help of two friendly characters. Travel through a beautiful island by learning how its different elements interact with each other.

games.name: Decrypto Project
games.summary: Our algorithm has chosen you for inclusion in the Decrypto Project. Your job is simple: we send encrypted texts, you decipher them. Loyalty and diligence will be rewarded with upgrades and customization options for your system. Disobedience and sabotage will be punished.

games.name: Eyes on the Exam
games.summary: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.

games.name: Gnaughty Gnomes
games.summary: Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes! Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.

games.name: Katana Dragon
games.summary:
Katana Dragon is an action-RPG adventure and dungeons exploration, where you play as the ninjas Shin and Nobi in their quest to end the curse that hangs over Sogen.
Learn ninja skills, upgrade your Dragon Gems, equip the Cursed Seals and level up. Avoid traps, solve puzzles and fight powerful enemies.
Your ninja way begins!

games.name: Idolz
games.summary: The most badass online multiplayer fighting game, where you can kick your friend's or your favorite idol's ass. It's not just about throwing punches, but also insults and trash talk. The war is on!

games.name: Battlecore Robots
games.summary: Customize your own mech: Use swords, bombs and all kind of weapons to defeat your oponents in frenetic battles with unique abilities! Play up to 4 players locally or online with Steam Remote Play. Enter the Battlecore arena!

games.name: Sandloop
games.summary: Help Hura save her village from invaders by exploring the intricate lands of Iman and gaining ancient skills that will enhance her mobility!

games.name: Toy Tactics
games.summary: A physics-based RTS game with a unique control system. Lead legendary warriors from distant ages in their quest for glory! Command your troops by just drawing your formations on the battlefield. Surround, ambush, deceive.. faster than ever! Your imagination is the limit.

games.name: Army Moves Overdrive
games.summary: Reboot of the 1986 classic from Dinamic. Aimed at modern players, in this reinterpretation of World War II, we take control of Derdal, a special operations team soldier, with a variety of gameplay types and many surprises.

games.name: The Visitor Effect
games.summary: What if your world was a lie? Outsmart inventive puzzles to escape the glitching simulation that holds you captive. Question reality and uncover a dark conspiracy while evading rogue security systems in this innovative puzzle-adventure.

games.name: Zen Garden
games.summary: Zen Garden is a relaxing logic game about creating your own Japanese-style garden settings. Through block play and decoration, you can solve puzzles in multiple ways, expressing your imagination and advancing through the story.

games.name: Detective Firefly
games.summary: In Detective Firefly, your job is to solve cases by meticulously filling in the report with the locations and actions of all suspects at the time of the murder. Interrogate all witnesses, search for evidence, and form hypotheses to uncover the identity of the criminal and bring them to justice.

games.name: Fatal: Unleashed Darkness
games.summary: Horror, tension, and vulnerability. Fatal: Unleashed Darkness immerses you in a survival horror experience set in 1974 Texas. Trapped inside a motel scarred by biological trauma, you must explore carefully, survive the unknown, and find a way out before it is too late.

games.name: Ashgard: Infinity Mask
games.summary: Infinity Mask is a third-person platformer set in a rich Norse mythology-inspired world. Engage in intense combat, navigate dynamic environments, and solve challenging puzzles. Experience a deep narrative and innovative gameplay, offering a seamless and immersive adventure.

games.name: Walk The Frog
games.summary: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles. It’s a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style.

games.name: Train Jumble
games.summary: Travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all passengers are happy with their seats.

games.name: Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel
games.summary:
In "Super Chipflake Ü: Quest for the Uncooked Schnitzel", your stomach is rumbling, and there's only one solution – find the ingredients and cook the world-famous schnitzel! But even in Schländ, the schnitzel-loving country, it won't be easy!

Embark on a quirky adventure filled with unexpected encounters, platforming challenges and a fun merging mechanic. Explore a world brimmed with secrets, strange characters, and even stranger problems. Dig, swing, and sprint your way through a lovingly designed environment, where surprises await around every corner.

games.name: Tiny Auto Knights
games.summary: An asynchronous PvP Auto Battler where you have to recruit and upgrade heroes and place them strategically on the battlefield to compete against other players.

games.name: Oku
games.summary: Become a zen monk and embark on a journey towards spiritual growth. Ride the wind across artistic Japanese landscapes as you write Haiku-like poems to capture the beauty of nature and unlock forgotten paths.

games.name: Nirih
games.summary: Fly across worlds in pursuit of tainted souls that will corrupt the realms they inhabit. Boost your speed by following their trails and battling their creations, while dodging obstacles in your hunt.

games.name: Later
games.summary: A short hidden object adventure about doing things later. Search, find, and don't lose yourself.

games.name: Fata Deum
games.summary: Inspired by the god games of old, Fata Deum lets you mold settlements and townsfolk in your image. Will you raise the settlements to splendor, or spur them on to violent debauchery and demons? Watch as a living world grows under your whims.

games.name: Medieval Frontiers
games.summary: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

games.name: Highreach
games.summary: When calamity struck, the world of Highreach was shattered. In this open-world survival game, build encampments, rescue survivors, and soar across the skies on your airship to explore a lost world and uncover the truth.

games.name: Cralon
games.summary: Cralon is an authentic 3D dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

games.name: My Little Cafe Nightmare
games.summary: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

games.name: A Story of Questions
games.summary: You are trapped, unable to walk, only a desk in front of you. The voice you hear is that of a woman on a speaker. Solve puzzles, interact with your surroundings, and make weighty decisions as you uncover a strange and disturbing story in this supernatural single-player horror mystery.

games.name: Ayna: Shattered Truth
games.summary: Become water. Be shapeless, be formless, be fluid. All living things are from water and you can transform water into what it needs to be. Dive into this newly crafted fairytale and take on the journey of finding your place in this Metroidvania fantasy world.

games.name: Crownbreakers
games.summary: Insatiable, hyper-charged capitalism has the magical city in a chokehold. Crash into the tyrants' districts and build your deck as you push forward. Use your heroes and your cards to fight back against criminal syndicates and demonic billionaires in this turn-based card-game brawler.

games.name: Cosmic Run
games.summary: Cosmic Run is a single player space roguelite game. Take on hordes of galactial enemies, build your ship strategically to overcome the hurdles, improve your stats to stand longer and flee the Zogark family from the galaxy. Fight, Build, Survive, Escape!

games.name: Liha
games.summary: Liha is a zero-gravity action-roguelike shooter that plunges you into forsaken, anomaly-warped derelicts. Navigate in full 360° freedom, scavenge rare tech, and upgrade your ship - but beware: Every descent is a high-stakes gamble between escape and total loss.

games.name: Replicore
games.summary: Replicore is a co-op shooter set in an ancient sci-fi world. Transform into your Core to roll, dash or throw your team members into the action or pull them out of tight spots to navigate the challenges of the mysterious ruins. Experience the first true Core-operative gameplay!

games.name: G-Rebels
games.summary: G-Rebels: An action-packed combat flight sim in a dystopian open world full of intrigue, free exploration and dangerous missions. As part of an elite unit, it is your job to ensure law and order. A secret mission calls everything into question: are you on the right side or part of a conspiracy?

games.name: Hello Space
games.summary: Dive into a 2D action game where you control a spaceship, defeat enemies and overcome deadly traps. Extend your arsenal by collecting new weapons and technologies for your ship that you will need to conquer four different dungeon-like worlds, all connected by an open space full of surprises.

games.name: Warding Witches
games.summary: Warding Witches offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging, amplified by an intuitive scoring system that weaves into gameplay seamlessly.

games.name: Rootbound
games.summary: A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.

games.name: Desktop Fishing
games.summary: Desktop Fishing is a cozy idle game that sits in the corner of your screen. Go about your usual desk work (or don't) while your frog buddy catches fish, discovers new outfits, and unlocks fishing spots.

games.name: Mukke
games.summary: Mukke City is about to take its musical turn! Help the new music scene by getting your self-created music on the radio, rocking the local music venues and hanging out with your newfound friends! MUKKE lets you make your own way between laid-back everyday life and gripping intrigue!

games.name: Match Tree
games.summary:
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a deckbuilding roguelite where you delve into the life of the last lighthouse keeper through immersive card dioramas. Customize your deck with a unique card crafting mechanic, explore fragmented memories, and uncover the secrets of the lighthouse.

games.name: Frisia: Tales & Tides
games.summary: In Frisia you start on an uninhabited Northsea island and are tasked with building a picturesque and cozy village in harmony with the sea.

games.name: Stuntboost
games.summary: Race against time on tracks of cardboard and toys to break records, climb leaderboards and become the fastest skater your online-neighborhood has ever seen!

games.name: Thumblemania
games.summary: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

games.name: Tow Game
games.summary: Your beloved old car has broken down and needs to be towed! Hooked and hauled - time for the garage! But will you get there in one piece? The tow truck is in a hurry!

games.name: Sling-A-Thing
games.summary: Sling-A-Thing is a mind-boggling comedy action puzzler. Throw and transform into an extreme variety of cartoon characters and objects to find your way to the exit.

games.name: Greta Sees Ghosts!
games.summary: Greta Sees Ghosts! is a lovingly crafted cozy adventure filled with quirky ghosts, witty dialogue, and clever shape-based puzzles. Explore remote islands, help the dead move on, and uncover Greta’s quietly touching story — one odd encounter at a time.

games.name: Star Birds
games.summary: Star Birds is a cheerful asteroid base-building and resource management game. Discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks and guide your colony of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons!

events.name: Xbox Games Showcase 2025
events.description:
It all begins with our annual Xbox Games Showcase, bringing you a look at upcoming titles from across our first-party studios, in addition to incredible new titles from our third-party partners across the globe. This year, the show will be digital-only – our livestream will bring you everything you’ll need to know about what’s next for Xbox, no matter where in the world you’re watching.

Immediately following Showcase, The Outer Worlds 2 Direct will bring you inside the walls of Obsidian Entertainment, revealing new gameplay, details, and developer insights, straight from the people making the sequel to the award-winning, first-person sci-fi RPG.

games.name: The Outer Worlds 2
games.summary: The Outer Worlds 2 is the sequel to the award-winning first-person sci-fi RPG from Obsidian Entertainment.

games.name: High on Life 2
games.summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.name: Super Meat Boy 3D
games.summary: Super Meat Boy 3D is a tough as nails platformer where you play as an animated cube of meat who's trying to save his girlfriend (who happens to be made of bandages) from an evil fetus in a jar wearing a tux – IN 3D!

games.name: Ninja Gaiden 4
games.summary: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

games.name: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: The Order of Giants
games.summary: There is a myth of a beast in the hidden depths of Rome, rumored to guard a terrible secret. Indiana Jones and the Great Circle: The Order of Giants DLC is an all-new story chapter that takes Indiana Jones to the ancient streets of Rome where forgotten catacombs twist into something far more sinister. Indy must outwit a dangerous cult and decipher intricate puzzles designed by emperors to uncover the dark legacy of the Nephilim giants.

games.name: Beast of Reincarnation
games.summary: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

games.name: Grounded 2
games.summary: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

games.name: Cronos: The New Dawn
games.summary: Cronos: The New Dawn is a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game that throws you into the heart of a deadly struggle against overwhelming foes, all while uncovering the mysteries of a twisted time travel story.

games.name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Seasons of the Worm Cult
games.summary:
Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 1 launches on June 2 for PC/Mac and June 18 for Xbox and PlayStation consoles and is included as part of the 2025 Content Pass. In this new storyline and zone, you must uncover and investigate the Worm Cult’s new base of operations on the tropical island of Solstice.

In Part 1, as you explore Western Solstice, you will quickly discover that the Worm Cult is far from defenseless. They’ve erected a massive arcane barrier using soul magic—the Writhing Wall—that divides the island, and for now, Eastern Solstice (and its secrets) is sealed off by this arcane edifice.

Despite being a zone divided, you will find that Western Solstice is full of challenges and rewards, including new World Bosses, Delves, a Public Dungeon, and a brand-new Trial, the Ossein Cage. There are 16 Antiquities (including three new Mythic items), four new Trial item sets (including Perfected versions), and a host of other rewards, including even more item sets, and a ton of Collectibles, from crafting motifs to pets. You’ll also receive a 10% experience boost from adventuring in Solstice all year!

Seasons of the Worm Cult Part 2 arrives in Q4 and gives you the opportunity to finally uncover just what these villains have been hiding behind the arcane barrier. Be warned, Eastern Solstice is far less welcoming than the previous territory, thanks to the Worm Cult’s malign influence.

Solstice’s second half introduces yet more challenges and rewards, with additional World Bosses, Delves, another Public Dungeon, and new rewards both exclusive to the new content and shared across the unified Solstice zone. You can expect three new overland item sets (giving Solstice six in total once Part 2 unlocks), three more Mythic items, and many more items and collectibles to earn.

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear
games.summary: Unleash 12 new gods in a mythic Japanese campaign and multiplayer. Command powerful samurai, shadowy ninjas and creatures from Japanese mythology in this epic expansion.

games.name: Mudang: Two Hearts
games.summary: MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

games.name: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf
games.summary: Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey with Lana and her loyal companion Mui. Whether you're a returning hero or a new adventurer, step into a world where a new, ancient mystery emerges from Novo's hidden depths. But as they scour these depths, a new threat will put their unbreakable bond to the ultimate test, guiding Lana to confront her destiny amidst encroaching shadows.

games.name: Fallout 76: Gone Fission
games.summary:
Grab your tackle box and your waders and head for the water, because the Gone Fission update reels in a huge new feature: Fishing!

This peaceful wasteland activity lets players catch fish in any water where they can swim. Now you can chill out with your friends at your favorite radioactive body of water in any region of Appalachia and catch more than 30 new fish. Players can even collect and cook a batch of nutritious new recipes with the fish they catch.

games.name: Solo Leveling: Arise
games.summary: Solo Leveling: Arise is an action RPG based on the South Korean web novel of the same name.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4
games.summary: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 is a remake of the two skateboarding games originally released in the early 2000s. Players perform tricks, complete objectives, and explore varied skate parks across global locations. The gameplay emphasizes fluid controls, combo chaining, and arcade-style challenges. Each title features a roster of professional skaters, along with customizable characters and gear. The collection preserves the core mechanics of the originals while offering updated visuals and performance on modern platforms.

games.name: At Fate's End
games.summary: At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

games.name: Gears of War: Reloaded
games.summary: The original Gears of War returns, faithfully remastered and natively optimized for more platforms than ever before as Gears of War: Reloaded. Experience the origins of one of gaming’s most acclaimed franchises like never before. Featuring 4K resolution, up to 120 FPS support, and the ultimate multiplayer experience with cross-progression and cross-play, across all platforms, this is the definitive way to experience the game that started it all.

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

games.name: Sea of Thieves: Smuggler's Tide - Season 17
games.summary: Order of Bone and Blade Skeletons have been hard at work in the Skeleton Forts, installing traps and hoarding weaponry – and now they’re under assault by the Dark Brethren’s Phantom fleet! Carve your way through this mêlée, unlock the Weapons Cache by defeating a Master of Arms whose skull serves as the key, then slay your way through the remaining threats to stake your claim to the Vault…

games.name: Invincible Vs.
games.summary: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.summary: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade is an enhanced and expanded version of Final Fantasy VII Remake that features a new episode starring Yuffie and introduces an exhilarating new story arc with numerous gameplay additions for players to enjoy.

games.name: Final Fantasy XVI
games.summary:
A single-player action RPG set in a high-fantasy world where warring nations and powerful summoned Eikons shape political intrigue and personal vengeance. Players control Clive, a former shield bearer whose life is upended by tragedy. Engage in fast-paced, tactical real-time combat that blends heavy weapons, Eikon-driven abilities, and cinematic set pieces.
Deeply narrative-driven, the game emphasizes character development, expansive locales to explore, and dramatic boss encounters while offering layered combat customization through combos, parries, and skill upgrades.

games.name: Keeper
games.summary: From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is a story told without words, in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
games.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is a first-person shooter set in 2035, co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software. The game features three main modes: a cooperative campaign playable with up to four players or solo, multiplayer with 6v6 and 20v20 modes, and the round-based Zombies mode. Multiplayer features a perk system split into combat specialties, weapon prestige progression, and scorestreak rewards.

events.name: RPG Direct 2025
events.description:
You encountered an indie RPG celebration: RPG Direct!
Embark on new quests with sales on the latest releases and discover the future of indie RPGs delivered directly to you on June 8 at 12PM PT/3PM ET/8PM BST!

games.name: Super Lesbian Animal RPG
games.summary: Melody has decided to become a healer in this classic-inspired turn-based RPG about love, anxiety, and fighting funny-looking monsters in dungeons.

games.name: Java Saga
games.summary: Order up! Join Mornin’ Jo and D’Caff, the mischievous mixologist duo, on their daily grind as baristas in Suburb City! Keep a healthy work/fight balance as you serve customers and take down the dastardly cronies of T.E.A. Inc in Turn-Based combat in this zany Action RPG!

games.name: Reindeer Story
games.summary: Reindeer Story is a 2D Adventure RPG! Run, Jump and Battle through 6 chapters of this Wintery Epic! Fight foes in turn based battles with a real-time element, dodge enemies attacks in the Battle Zone and retaliate with Z-Skills!

games.name: Star Fiction
games.summary: Star Fiction is an indie RPG about the unusually weird journey of four creatures and their struggles to save the world. It blends classic RPG mechanics with a touch of real-world oddity to create a fresh and unique experience.

games.name: Dog Adventure Harmony
games.summary: A fictitious RPG where you search for your lost dog in a fantasy world. Fight make-believe monsters and dodge creative bullet hell attacks. Meet its imaginary characters... and their creator if you'd like.

games.name: Sea of Souls
games.summary: Discover the secrets of the cycle of reincarnation in Sea of Souls! A Turn-Based RPG with various Metroidvania elements to help you explore the world.

games.name: PsychexFuse
games.summary: A lovingly hand-drawn adventure into esoteric worlds filled with threats, puzzles and horror. Help, save and clash with past versions of yourself, and unravel the mystery behind two and a half gods at war.

games.name: Athenian Rhapsody
games.summary: Athenian Rhapsody is a turn based RPG which includes intense and fast paced real-time-dodging. You'll be faced with many challenges, and you'll have to fight your way through the world by either fighting, or awkwardly trying to make friends with your opponents through pick-up-lines, mean jokes, memory games, and other strange and funny interactions.

games.name: Lost Inside: Act 1
games.summary: Lost Inside is a non-traditional, character-focused, action-adventure RPG about a human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World.

games.name: Connected Fates
games.summary: A story-driven puzzle adventure game with unconventional game mechanics.

games.name: Momoinc
games.summary: Explore the underground, customize your party, fight clogs and uncover secrets in this turn based RPG about the lives of funny looking plumbers.

games.name: Astral Guard
games.summary: Astral Guard is an interplanetary RPG adventure following a group of aliens trying to stop a vicious hivemind from taking over the solar system. Find friends, fight foes, and travel the stars!

games.name: Oddventure
games.summary: Oddventure is a lore-rich turn-based RPG set in a cursed fairytale world. Fight your inner demons and reach for the spark of hope, or stare directly into the abyss.

games.name: Robo Sham Boro
games.summary: Yo! Rock paper scissors, rock paper scissors, rock paper scissors! It's an RPG about rock paper scissors! Go on a wacky adventure full of personal growth and rock and paper and also scissors to figure the dark secrets behind a Christmas murder, smart guy.

games.name: Bagdex
games.summary: The journey begins! Collect over 160 creatures inspired by Brazilian culture, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

games.name: Escape from Ever After
games.summary: When a greedy megacorp with the power to enter storybooks takes over Flynt Buckler’s fairytale world, he must get a job to sabotage them from within! Climb the corporate ladder, fight in stylish, snappy combat, and dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!

games.name: Tales From The Other Side
games.summary: Tales From The Other Side, a game about discovering who you are! Deal with foes with VIOLENT interactive attacks, or choose a DIPLOMATIC path by engaging in friendly conversation with them. Make a choice and return back to the ABYSS! A game by Levc.

games.name: Off
games.summary: “I’m the Batter. I’ve been entrusted with a sacred mission.” -- One of the most influential RPGs of the last 20 years is finally coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch. Take control of the Batter as he seeks to purify an uncanny and hopeless world haunted by specters, guided by a cryptic, grinning cat called The Judge.

games.name: Knock on the Coffin Lid
games.summary: Help the main character, that has risen from the kingdom of dead, return home and fulfill his destiny. Unravel the tangle of plot intricacies and the motives of the characters - or let fate lead you.

games.name: Franken
games.summary:
A new RPG from splendidland appears out of nowhere!

In "Franken", a hero fights monsters to become stronger so they can save the world.

games.name: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name
games.summary: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name is a tactical rhythm RPG featuring a frail doctor in training named Hazuki who struggles with her new life of being part of a criminal organization disguised as a local restaurant.

games.name: Fight Life: Vanguard
games.summary: Engage in strategic turn-based combat, manage and upgrade each character, and strive to reclaim harmony in a world on the brink of oblivion. Take on the mantle of leadership as you guide a mercenary squad through perilous landscapes, selecting your comrades from a diverse pool of skilled recruits.

games.name: Lords of Ravage
games.summary: Become the Final Boss! Play any way you want, combine followers from different factions, and win spectacular turn-based battles. Expand your Empire of Darkness and seek a powerful artifact that can change the fate of the world.

games.name: Book of Hours
games.summary: Book of Hours is an elegant, melancholy, combat-free RPG set in an occult library, from the makers of BAFTA-nominated Cultist Simulator and the creator of Fallen London and Sunless Sea.

games.name: Duil
games.summary: Duil - Action platformer with RPG and Roguelike elements. A fascinating journey in a mysterious world full of secrets and surprises. Collect loot, upgrade your character, destroy enemies. The final of the game will depend on your decisions.

games.name: Synchro
games.summary: Uncover the corporate lies! Assemble your underground roguelite team and rise to the top in the cyberpunk world of Synchro. Use telepathy to read the thoughts of citizens and the plans of your enemies to outsmart them in tactical, turn-based combat.

games.name: Folk Hero
games.summary: Folk Hero is an action-slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the world of Slavic fantasy. Explore the ever-changing island, find treasures, combine weapons and artifacts to defeat mythical enemies. Challenge your skills! One life, one attempt.

games.name: Underquest
games.summary: Cute fantasy roguelite with backpack mechanics. Combine items to create powerful skills and use them in fast-paced combat. Explore randomly generated dungeons in the Underkingdom and discover the secrets of its inhabitants!

games.name: Twilight Wars
games.summary: Twilight Wars is a dungeon crawler set in a cyberpunk world where secret agents battle for corporate interests. Bring back a secret organization, recruit and equip a team of specialists - and eliminate those who stand in your way!

games.name: Boomerang Jack
games.summary: Boomerang Jack is an action-adventure RPG with free-flowing combat. String together boomerang attacks with kinetic movement and upgradeable powers. Embark on a globe-trotting quest to stop the Pirate King.

games.name: Yunashi no Yume
games.summary: HYPERxFANTASY is an experimental narrative RPG set in a brutalist dystopian underworld teetering on the edge of digital ascension. As Dreamer, players navigate an endless megastructure, using a versatile glider to traverse its vast, abstract spaces and advance non-linear storylines through branching dialogue. Tasked by the enigmatic Executor to "digitize everyone" and save them, players will soon question the cult-like hierarchy of this desolate dreamscape, uncovering a conspiracy at the core of the Singularity itself.

games.name: Soul Ryder RPG
games.summary: A surreal Turn-Based RPG / 2D Platformer inspired by the Mario RPG series.

games.name: Rue Valley
