Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Cozy Kitchen
games.summary: Step into a fresh new corner of Spirit City's room with the Cozy Kitchen DLC! This feast of a DLC expands your Spirit City experience with a brand-new kitchen area. New items, spirits and activities await!

games.name: Not Monday Cafe
games.summary:
Build and manage your cute cozy cafe while working studying or streaming.
Farming and serving delicious dishes to adorable animal customer in your cafe on the bottom of your screen, all while you're working on other tasks and enjoying your day.

games.name: Parcel Dash
games.summary: Parcel Dash is a fast paced, arcade like time trial. Plan the most efficient route to deliver packages as fast as you can and compete in online leaderboards.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Setup Savior
games.summary: Set out on a creative journey, organize, decorate, and level up clients setups as you chase your dreams and build your business as the “Setup Savior”. Tidy up and refurnish rooms, decorate surroundings, and sell old furniture to purchase new, unleash your creativity and achieve your vision!

games.name: Lady Dracula
games.summary: An evolution of the Classicvania genre and a return to the glory days of precision platforming, retro challenge and gothic atmosphere. Transform yourself into a wraith, a spider and a bat to fly, climb and blast your way across Transylvania to do battle with Lady Dracula at her castle keep.

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: In this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania you dive into the ruins of Atlantis. As a small robot you control the water level in various rooms to solve puzzles and discover the mysteries of an ancient society.

games.name: AM Archaic Memories
games.summary: It's a 3D platform about the dreams and nightmares of a 90-year-old being.

games.name: Delusion Out of Space
games.summary: Delusion Out of Space is an atmospheric first-person science fiction adventure game with an unforgettable story, a unique world, and supernatural alien technologies.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Find This Pixel Anomaly
games.summary:
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.

Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.

games.name: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
games.summary: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

games.name: Whistle Pig
games.summary: In this narrative action adventure, experience both the beauty and the brutality of the natural world through the eyes of a mother groundhog on a quest for revenge.

games.name: Ritual of Raven
games.summary: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

games.name: The Wide Open Sky Is Running Out of Catfish
games.summary: A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish. Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky.

games.name: Catto's Post Office
games.summary: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting new and old friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents.

games.name: The Well's Blessing
games.summary: Explore the mystical sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

games.name: Draggin'
games.summary: Capture Draggins by draggin' the mouse in this casual arcade roguelite! Click-and-drag to cast spells on enemies and get your fill of wave battlin', achievement huntin', upgrade unlockin', rinse-and-repeatin'!

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a deckbuilding roguelite where you delve into the life of the last lighthouse keeper through immersive card dioramas. Customize your deck with a unique card crafting mechanic, explore fragmented memories, and uncover the secrets of the lighthouse.

games.name: Nomia
games.summary:
Nomia is a story-rich tactics roguelike where two heroes coordinate to execute brilliant skill combos.

Guide a warrior and a wizard through a mystifying tale. Harness grid-based strategy and deep deckbuilding mechanics to battle gorgeously illustrated foes. Blast monsters off cliffs, steal their cards, and sling spear and spell to reach the horizon.

games.name: Best Served Cold
games.summary: Can you mix a cocktail while eye-to-eye with a criminal? Find out in Best Served Cold, a murder mystery set in a bustling speakeasy where you serve customers, make friends and enemies, and solve crimes. At the Nightcap bar, prohibition is a killer… and so are some of your customers!

games.name: Banned Together
games.summary: A queer mystery game about book banning. Play as Ruby (they/them), a journalism major on a surreal, after-hours adventure to investigate the disappearance of books from their college library.

games.name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
games.summary: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

games.name: Sock Dating Simulator
games.summary: A 100% serious game where you turn into a sock... and seduce other socks!

games.name: In Ashes
games.summary: An unexpected quest has reached your sleepy town. Once again, you must raise your weapon and step into the boots of a weary, burnt out adventurer. When faced with a choice, what kind of hero will you be? In Ashes is a choice-driven fantasy visual novel about adventurers, monsters, and the forgotten.

games.name: Unmasked Truths: Shattered Dreams
games.summary: 11 world-renowned experts are trapped together and must cooperate to survive... until conflicts arise, and they discover the greatest threat to their lives isn't the system they're resisting: it's each other! Discover the truth of who's living a lie in this fully voiced murder mystery adventure.

games.name: All Hands on Deck
games.summary: All Hands on Deck is a co-op puzzle platformer game. Use Rock, Paper, Scissors and various items together to solve puzzles, traverse through playful worlds and save plushies. Everyone can share the same experience! Just swap items and you're good to go. How handy is that!

games.name: Cozy Beach
games.summary: ️Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an enchanting tropical beach where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

games.name: Cyber Paradise
games.summary: Revive Mini the Dog digitally through 2D roguelite actions; craft her cyber paradise with beloved moments, like sniffing dog butts XD. Uncover a deeper dystopian narrative and strengthen friendships in cafe chats—a frenetic yet cozy journey.

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Desktop Cat Cafe
games.summary: Build your dream cat cafe in this tiny cozy management sim that lives at the bottom of your screen! Unlock exciting new recipes, decorate your space with our wide variety of goodies, and hire cute staff to take care of the cafe while you're doing other things.

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: Flowerbud
games.summary: A narrative-driven flower shop management and relationship sim where YOUR choices shape the town’s future. Customize your flower shop, craft unique items, and unlock different outcomes through branching dialogue and evolving relationships.

games.name: Gemporium
games.summary: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in Gemporium, a casual mining simulation management game. Keep your finances in check as you juggle a growing gem emporium while simultaneously paying off a generational debt. There's only so much time in the day!

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Inkshade
games.summary: Inkshade is a turn-based tactics game carved out of strange wooden miniatures, wrapped in a web of locked rooms, and orchestrated by an otherworldly game master. Victory is not guaranteed, and the only constant is the cruel black ink that flows within the pieces.

games.name: Magical Delicacy
games.summary: A wholesome pixel art platformer. Cook magical delicacies from a vast collection of ingredients in your own shop. Explore an unfamiliar town and deliver tasty treats to the townsfolk. Learn new ways to traverse, discover secrets, and experience a unique witchy world.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

games.name: Reality Break
games.summary: Rewrite the Universe! Pilot an agile starfighter, upgrade it with randomized loot, and unleash mystical fate energy to alter the fabric of spacetime itself!

games.name: Plush Party
games.summary: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

games.name: Sticky Business: Book of Shadows
games.summary: Add a little magic to your sticker shop with the Book of Shadows DLC! Craft enchanted stickers, explore witchy new stories, and charm your customers with mystical goodies in this cozy, spellbinding expansion. The coven is waiting!

games.name: Timelake: Time Travel Tactics
games.summary: Timelake: Time Travel Tactics is a roguelite strategy game where you control time itself to outsmart enemies and navigate a shifting city. Predict enemy moves, set traps, and execute synchronized combos. Manage precious resources as you explore a dreamlike world filled with mystery, cosmic horror, and ever-changing challenges. Every decision ripples through time, offering endless strategic possibilities.

games.name: Roombattle
games.summary:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.

Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

games.name: Roadside Egg Stand
games.summary: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

games.name: Spilled!
games.summary: Clean up ocean waste in this relaxing & satisfying cozy game! Recycle, earn coins, upgrade your boat, repeat! Explore and clean up new areas with more waste and new challenges!

games.name: The Tennis Academy
games.summary: The Tennis Academy is a solo-developed action fantasy RPG and dating sim. Uncover the mysteries of the castle-like school while fighting wacky tennis duels with hand-drawn 2D animated characters. Live your best college life, rizz up classmates to become your Doubles Partners, and save tennis!

games.name: Quality Dreams, Reasonably Priced
games.summary: Work as a body modification consultant in a dystopian future. Talk to clients, make recommendations, and decide how much to upsell them. Your choices will impact each of their lives. Balance helping others with earning enough to save your sick rabbit.

games.name: Sunny Trails
games.summary: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

games.name: Tailside: Cozy Cafe Sim
games.summary: A charming RPG where you'll discover the joys of running your own cozy cafe. From brewing the perfect cup of coffee to making friends with the locals, experience a blend of relaxation and adventure during your own coffee break.

games.name: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets
games.summary: Tako no Himitsu: Ocean of Secrets is an indie Action RPG made as a tribute to the Game Boy Advance era of gaming. A spiritual successor to Save me Mr Tako, play in a world where Octopuses were erased from history.

games.name: The Grey Road
games.summary: Enter a world of road trip horror in this procedurally generated driving adventure. Face hazardous environments, deadly weather, and gigantic monsters. Scavenge for supplies, navigate obstacles, and search for safehouses - but remember: you are never truly safe.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Until Oblivion
games.summary: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.

games.name: Urban Jungle
games.summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.summary: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

games.name: Little Aviary
games.summary: Little Aviary is a relaxing idle bird collector that sits at the bottom of your screen! Hatch unique birds, sell them, decorate, then watch them fly around your screen and perch on top of your other windows!

games.name: Xochi's Apothecary
games.summary: A deceptively cozy narrative game about an alchemist that immigrates to a new country and opens an apothecary. Get to know your weird and wonderful community, brew the potions your customers need, and use your words to stir up a country on the brink of change.

events.name: Little Nightmares Showcase
events.description:
Something unsettling is coming. It's closer than you think.
Are you ready to face it, little ones?
Prepare for the Little Nightmares Showcase.

games.name: Little Nightmares III
games.summary:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

games.name: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
Little Nightmares is a puzzle-platform horror adventure game developed by Tarsier Studios and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment. Set in a mysterious world, Little Nightmares follows the journey of Six, a hungry little girl who must escape the Maw, an iron vessel inhabited by monstrous, twisted beings.

The Enhanced Edition improves upon the original release by supporting 4K resolution at 60 FPS and enhancing visual effects, including RTX reflections, improved water effects, additional particles, and volumetric lighting.

It also offers players the option to choose between Quality Mode or Performance Mode, allowing them to prioritize either visual fidelity or frame rate based on their preferences.

games.name: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
games.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

events.name: Eternalverse Showcase 2025
events.description: A special event featuring standout games from creative developers and supporting networks. Inspiring moments, exciting reveals, and a bright future for gaming!

games.name: Luminous Nights
games.summary: Embark on an adventure inspired by popular Fantasy Action RPGs. Travel to different realms fighting monsters and gaining new abilities as you seek to bring back peace to the Luminous Realms.

games.name: Mojito Woody's Rescue
games.summary: MOJITO Woody's Rescue puts you on a journey to find your best dog friend Woody, who has been kidnapped by an evil Cucumber, in a cute 3d adventure with sandbox levels, platforming challenges and exploration zones. Inspired by Super Mario 64 - Odyssey / Banjo Kazooie / Celeste

games.name: Motorslice
games.summary: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure.

games.name: OctoMaze
games.summary: Priceless artifacts were stolen long ago from octopus tribe by their eternal rivals – disgusting parasites. These parasites infested the entire realm since then. To stop parasites from spreading and save the tribe, artifacts have to be returned, or everything is lost.

games.name: My Father Lied
games.summary: My Father Lied is a first person point and click mystery game that tells the story of Huda, who finds herself following an unfathomable secret regarding her father’s 20 years disappearance.

games.name: Velcira Chronicles: The Veil of Alba
games.summary: Velcira Chronicles: The Veil of Alba is an Action-adventure 3D game focused on exploration, horror elements, combat and puzzle solving.

games.name: PaperKlay
games.summary: PaperKlay is a short and sweet 3D platformer where you unfold, open and rotate the paper environment in order to freely explore the cardboard world.

games.name: Riven Crown
games.summary:
Riven Crown is a dark, atmospheric Souls-like Action RPG where death is not the end but the beginning of a mythic descent through layered realms beyond life. Set in a decaying dimension ruled by a corrupt monarchy and haunted by the remnants of lost civilizations, the world is steeped in mystery, ritual, and the echoes of a forgotten society.

Blending classic Souls-like combat with a deep, combo-driven fighting system, Riven Crown introduces a fresh, high-skill twist to the genre. Each weapon comes with its own unique combo routes designed to be memorized, mastered, and chained together with precision. It's an approach that rewards muscle memory and strategic timing, especially during tense encounters with relentless, unforgiving enemies. We call it a “Souls-Fighter” a brutal fusion of methodical combat and stylish execution, built for players who crave both challenge and mastery.

games.name: Shrine's Legacy
games.summary:
Shrine's Legacy is a SNES-like action adventure RPG where you’ll wield elemental magic to explore the nooks and crannies of Ardemia and battle a rising evil. Play single player or with a friend in co-op!
Shrine’s Legacy lets you harness elemental Gemstones to cast spells in real-time both to defeat foes and remove obstacles! Meet intriguing characters along the way as the two heroes journey to restore the Sword of Shrine.

games.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
games.summary: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic power of SWAP, using it to Copy & Paste textures within the game world. Turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines as you ride hay bales, explore, fight, and solve puzzles throughout Riverside. Unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game that literally lets you change the world!

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Trench Tales
games.summary: A story-driven third-person action game set in a dark, alternative world between WWI and WWII. Harness unique powers, customize your arsenal, and navigate haunting Gothic landscapes. Battle fallen soldiers as you uncover the mysteries of this realm.

games.name: Ultra Mega Cats
games.summary: Ultra Mega Cats is a high-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. As a player, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs, escaping their corporate prison.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Berserk B.I.T.S
games.summary:
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

Collect and craft a plethora of battle chips to be used in real-time during battle. Each battle chip is placed in an ever growing library that you can strive to fill out. Get medals for completing tasks or kick back and spend time decorating your perfect HOME NET.

Level up your B.I.T by dropping them on a mission and taking on the internet, exploring different biomes! Be involved and monitor their battles and use battle chips you've collected in real time and help your B.I.T succeed - or sit back and relax, work on other tasks while you send your B.I.T to handle business!

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Advent Neon
games.summary: Hyperactive 2D action platformer with wicked fast attacks, omnidirectional dashing, and time-freezing! Play well enough to transform and unleash 100% power!

games.name: An Amazing Wizard
games.summary: An Amazing Wizard is a 2D fast-paced metroidvania-inspired spell-slinging combat RPG game with detailed pixel art. You play as a wizard from legend, wielding the magic of 7 elements cast by mysterious hands. Enhance your spells and melee weapons, defeat enemies to level up and choose from 250 perks. Discover and equip 250 artifacts, and merge 100 unique spells in any desired order. Collect your lost memories and uncover the hidden truth about this world.

games.name: Astral Break
games.summary: Astral Break is a fusion of mech and roguelite action. Experience thrilling "thrust" controls that propel you through dynamic dungeons. Collect diverse modular armors to refine your combat style and experiment with endless synergies to craft your ultimate hero!

games.name: Aokaki
games.summary: Aokaki is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you play as an isopod ronin. Explore fun and challenging levels while battling against the forces of the evil Shogun in this bug inhabited pixelart world.

games.name: Before I Go
games.summary: Explore the haunting, dreamlike fantasy world of BEFORE I GO, a punishing Metroidvania where you embody the innocence of an inner child on an allegorical odyssey towards death acceptance. The end is inevitable, but will you brave the journey?

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
games.summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

games.name: Constance
games.summary: Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action adventure featuring a paintbrush-wielding artist, striving to escape from a colorful but decaying inner-world, created by her declining mental health.

games.name: Crimson Capes
games.summary: Crimson Capes is a soulslike Action-RPG taking place in a Sword & Sorcery setting. Engage in fluid 2D pixel art swordplay, hunt witches, track monsters and experience the age of high adventure.

games.name: Catatonic Game
games.summary: Catatonic Game is a hand-drawn, 1930s-inspired puzzle-platformer adventure set in the mysterious New Marilyn City. Developed by a passionate indie team of four cousins from Bahrain under the company Fred Da Dead Productions, the game explores a world of anthropomorphic animals, hidden secrets, and surreal environments. Players will follow Katrina, a lost cat, as she embarks on a pacifist quest to uncover her true identity and return to her reality, solving puzzles and interacting with eccentric characters along the way.

games.name: Crowned in Steel
games.summary: Crush your enemies, struggle against fate and become the usurper in this brutal Action-Adventure game inspired by heroic classics.

games.name: Fur Squadron Phoenix
games.summary: Embark on an action-packed adventure in this on-rails space shooter. As a trainee pilot, you will fight in strange virtual worlds. Master your ship, upgrade your skills and protect the federation from an imminent threat. Are you up for the challenge?

games.name: GearGrit
games.summary: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

games.name: Go Slimey Go!
games.summary: Go Slimey Go! is an easy-to-pick-up game for players of all ages! Help Slimey, our tiny slippery protagonist, visit his friends for some well deserved teatime after some thrilling platforming challenges! Just make sure not to get caught in the middle of the ultimate showdown between good and evil!

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Tonin
games.summary: Slice and kick your enemies away! An open-world Japanese-style × Sci-Fi slash action game!

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

events.name: IndieMania 2025 The Sequel!
events.description: IndieMania is the ultimate online event for indie game lovers. It’s a digital showcase of the best indie games from developers all around the world, featuring exclusive demos, interviews, live streams, and more. Whether you’re into action, adventure, puzzle, or simulation, you’ll find something to suit your taste at IndieMania. Join us in 2024 for our first online event and discover the hidden gems of the indie gaming scene.

games.name: Lords of Ravage
games.summary: Become the Final Boss! Play any way you want, combine followers from different factions, and win spectacular turn-based battles. Expand your Empire of Darkness and seek a powerful artifact that can change the fate of the world.

games.name: Ungaland!
games.summary: "Dive into a prehistoric world of adventure where the power of primal seeds changes everything. Unlock abilities, attach them to your weapons, and face challenges in a vibrant land full of action, and surprises."

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

games.name: Eyes on the Exam
games.summary: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.

games.name: The Obsessive Shadow
games.summary: The Obsessive Shadow is a VR Survival horror game about fending off a home intruder. Keep yourself safe with nothing but a flashlight and the naked eye...

games.name: PaperKlay
games.summary: PaperKlay is a short and sweet 3D platformer where you unfold, open and rotate the paper environment in order to freely explore the cardboard world.

games.name: Abyss X Zero
games.summary: Explore an expansive world in this 3D Metroidvania with enormous dungeons and stylish combat. Take control of two different characters, fated to battle each other: Codename A and Codename Z, both legendary heroes with unique abilities that change how you fight and interact with the environment.

games.name: Canvas Infernum
games.summary: Canvas Infernum is a strategic tile-placement landscape builder where you craft a surreal Renaissance-inspired hell using real historical art. Seal pacts that shift gameplay dynamics, blending classic board game mechanics with roguelike elements and story-driven progression

games.name: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
games.summary: Pirates Outlaws 2 is a swashbuckling roguelike deckbuilder. Collect & fuse cards, gather powerful relics and adapt your strategy during each run. Become a reputed pirate, loot the Sea Masters, challenge giant creatures and triumph in the great Arena!

games.name: Stoned
games.summary: Three stoners accidentally become possessed by the soul of an Ancient Cosmic Wizard and gain magical powers. They then go on an adventure to try and get rid of said powers. A Turn-Based RPG with a unique story and "pong-style" battle mechanics.

games.name: Packed Lair
games.summary: Villainous base-builder mixed with inventory management auto-battler roguelike! Draft buildings, pack them carefully into your cramped lair to create powerful synergies and send your army of minions to deal with the endless hero problem. Why won’t they just leave you alone?

games.name: Visagens
games.summary: Visagens is an action-focused, 2D side-scroller shooter. Ispired by games like Sunset Riders and Castlevania. Play as Bento, a blind cowboy, armed with a mysterious gun and supernatural powers. In a quest to Cleanse the lands from the demonic scourge of the Visagens and avenge his family.

games.name: Misgiven
games.summary: Misgiven is a 2D sci-fi adventure about the lump in your throat and how difficult it can be to say certain things. Stranded in a city of masks and toxic fog, find people you can trust and, via a tangible dialog system, experience how scary and awkward, but also how fulfilling, communication can be.

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Sliding Hero
games.summary: Sliding Hero is a top-down puzzle Metroidvania where you slide in a single direction until hitting an obstacle. Trapped in a sinister 1700s Venetian villa, explore a world inspired by Venice’s carnival that will test your wits to overcome challenges, uncover secrets, and unmask your destiny.

games.name: Into the Grid
games.summary: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.summary: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Adapt
games.summary: To survive, you must guide your species through a constantly changing world. Compete with strange creatures for food and territory, and find your niche through careful evolutionary choices. The real question is not if you can survive, but for how long.

games.name: Button Man
games.summary: Button Man is a side-scrolling adventure game set in a fictional Nova Scotia during prohibition. After years of being the henchmen to the local bootlegging kingpin your job now is to find who killed him and protect the town from what’s coming to it. Explore Kingsport and learn the truth!

games.name: Xenopurge
games.summary: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

games.name: Dunebound Tactics
games.summary: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.name: Biomeat Huskworld
games.summary: This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.

games.name: Crypt Robbery
games.summary: Explore, achieve, hide, and fight in this chilling, one-of-a-kind adventure—a first-person shooter survival-horror game. Do you dare to enter a creepy cemetery at night? Can you escape the horrors lurking in an underground crypt where evil reigns? Prove how brave you are now in Crypt Robbery!

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Cafe New York 9/11
games.summary: In Café New York, Step into the life of Sameer, a Pakistani American living in NYC during the week of 9/11. Sameer must navigate rising tensions, protect his family, and make impossible choices. Decisions that will shape his future and the fate of those around him in a city forever changed.

games.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
games.summary: Tiny paper - Big adventure! Soar, sail, and roll to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and imagination

games.name: Durga: The Lionhearted
games.summary: Play as Durga, a fearless village girl on a journey of survival and self-discovery. A story driven RPG blends puzzles with adventure into the Indian forest. Unravel ancient Indian tales, face wild beasts, and embrace a legacy that transforms her from a brave villager to a guardian of culture.

games.name: Lanesplit
games.summary: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

games.name: Sydless
games.summary: Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

games.name: Katanaut
games.summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

games.name: MechAnimals
games.summary: Gear up for mayhem: From the creative minds behind Kung Fu Panda and The Mario Movie, MechAnimals combines Roguelite progression and Beat 'Em Up action featuring cute tiny animal MECH PILOTS!

games.name: Cabbie!
games.summary: Buckle up and blast through vibrant bite-sized cartoon worlds. Drive, drift & deliver your way to victory solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op, or clash in competitive Taxi Tag mayhem!

games.name: Hyperslice
games.summary: Fast paced action arena roguelike where you defeat waves of enemies using your dash. Slice through enemies or push them to survive. Upgrade and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.

games.name: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos
games.summary: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

games.name: Art of Blades
games.summary: Art of Blades is a hand-drawn top-down isometric simple hack-and-slash. The art is inspired by Japanese manga and anime. The gameplay is a very simple hack-and-slash based on rock paper scissors. Scissors to attack, rock to block, and paper to dodge.

games.name: Ecosystem
games.summary: Grow and modify an ecosystem, with simulated evolution by natural selection creating the lifeforms that inhabit it. All the creatures in the trailer evolved on their own in the game. None were hand-edited!

games.name: Ctrl.Alt.Deal
games.summary: With your superior intelligence and sneakiness, you can find a way to escape from this heartless megacorp! (As long as no one realizes you’re actually a self-aware AI...) Spy on humans, offer them deals, and negotiate your way to freedom in a turn-based strategy game of corporate dysfunction.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: The Paradogx Incident
games.summary:
Step into "The Paradogx Incident," where puzzle-platforming meets rhythmic precision. Guide Dox the dog through mind-twisting, recursive puzzles in a dynamic, beat-driven world and rhythm levels.

Enjoy full controller support and an adaptive soundtrack that changes with every dimension.

Experience a unique blend of genres in this innovative adventure!

games.name: RetroBlazer
games.summary: Take on the mantle of the Pyramid Guard, go up against the cybernetic Ark Legion, and rid the kingdom of a spectral blight. Combining the charm of Saturday Morning Cartoons and the bombastic action of late 90s shooters, RetroBlazer recaptures a golden era of frantic, fast-paced, first-person action.

games.name: Cosminers
games.summary: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

games.name: Primordial Empire
games.summary: Primordial Empire is a side-on colony sim on the microscopic level. Cultivate a colony of microbes, plants and animals from small beginnings to mutualistic paradise. Connect the web of life in a tangle of nutrients and trophic balance. Scratch out a living and claim your empire from the rock itself!

games.name: Ethra
games.summary: EthrA is an RPG/Adventure and open world game that revolves around the misadventures of two characters: Bob and Veil. Both will explore the land of EthrA and uncover a thousand year lie the world already forgot about.

games.name: About an Elf
games.summary: Explore 4 magical, mysterious lands. Decipher indecipherable crystal visions! Fight an assortment of evil monsters, each more monstrous than the last! About an Elf is a point-and-click-ish, RPG-ish, visual-novel-ish game of gigantawesome proportions. Do you have what it takes to have what it takes?

games.name: Ved: Journey Beyond the Cube
games.summary: Ved is trapped in a strange world, transformed into a cube. Solve puzzles, unlock hidden powers, and explore a shifting reality to find a way back home.

games.name: Ultra Mega Cats
games.summary: Ultra Mega Cats is a high-paced roguelike cooperative third-person shooter. As a player, you control one of the Mega Cats, armed to the fangs, escaping their corporate prison.

games.name: Dodo Duckie
games.summary: Aliens abducted your chicken friends! Play as Dodo, a brave but slightly clueless duck on a mission to bring them home. The twist? Swap between 2D and 3D perspectives INSTANTLY to solve platforming puzzles and explore a cozy, charming world full of surprises

games.name: Strange Seed
games.summary: Evolve your creature using parts from mammals, birds, insects, and even dinosaurs! From your humble beginnings as a shape-shifting slime, build up your genetic potential and adapt your way through the islands of New Haven.

games.name: Bagdex
games.summary: The journey begins! Collect over 160 creatures inspired by Brazilian culture, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Gloomy Eyes
games.summary: A cozy horror, “self-coop”, adventure about two unlikely souls who forge a forbidden bond and journey together to find the sun. Explore eerie yet charming Tim Burton-esque levels, switch between two unique characters, and solve brain-teasing puzzles.

games.name: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
games.summary: Dash, dodge, and dive through the ultimate Japanese gameshow experience! Up to 4 contestants race through chaotic obstacle courses across Japan, filled with hilarious hazards and obscure obstacles. It’s so crazy, you’ll be shouting ‘Konnichi-what?!’ instead of ‘Konnichiwa!’

games.name: Quacolé Tennis
games.summary: Face the most unexpected opponents in completely crazy tennis matches. Win tournaments, overcome obstacles, and defeat giant monsters using the power of your racket! Embark on a solo adventure or invite a friend to explore the world of Quacolé Tennis in doubles matches.

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

games.name: Switcheroo
games.summary: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

games.name: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World
games.summary: The time of glory has passed, and a new era has begun. Historian called this era "The time of ash and dust" A Slayer Enter the tower to save the world

games.name: Arms of God
games.summary: Gear up for a battle through hell in this next-gen autoshooter with Doom-inspired gore vibes, metal music, roguelite mechanics, and a satisfying combat feel. Wield five weapons at once, upgrade and merge them to forge indestructible builds, and bring divine justice to a world on the brink of chaos.

games.name: Winnie's Hole
games.summary:
Join Winnie on a new adventure, from within!
Play as a virus in his body and mind. Capture cells to mutate and build a deck of actions to unleash in combo-driven combat.

A genre-blending roguelite with a dark yet charming story. Embrace discomfort - Sometimes we can't help being seen as a monster...

games.name: Roombattle
games.summary:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.

Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

games.name: Going Medieval
games.summary: Build and manage your own castle settlement in a land reclaimed by wilderness. With detailed management, survival strategy, and a moddable sandbox world, Going Medieval challenges you to build the mightiest colony this side of the apocalypse.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Royalty Free-For-All
games.summary: Royalty Free-For-All is a hand-drawn cartoon Party Brawler featuring an original cast of characters inspired by the public domain! Join Dorothy, Sweeney Todd, Mother Goose, and more as they duke it out in hand-drawn platform fighting mayhem!

games.name: Ruffy and the Riverside
games.summary: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic power of SWAP, using it to Copy & Paste textures within the game world. Turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines as you ride hay bales, explore, fight, and solve puzzles throughout Riverside. Unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game that literally lets you change the world!

games.name: Stip
games.summary: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

games.name: Fading Serenades
games.summary: Hike, jump, and climb to traverse the treacherous terrain of the island to help villagers deliver parcels and complete their tasks and requests. Experience a story of vanishing traditions, a missing scientist, and an unfolding mystery. Serenading a quieter life, the island calls!

games.name: Green Again
games.summary: Green Again is a relaxing colony simulation game. Help a tribe of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots. Build, decorate, and expand your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and return the land to its former green state!

games.name: Astro Architect
games.summary: Astro Architect is a city-builder game, where your employees votes define what you build. As an architect working for the corporation, build your own space station, expand your influence, take care of your employees needs, manage logistics and space expeditions.

games.name: Hogtie
games.summary: Dive into Hogtie, the ultimate Sokoban puzzle adventure where you wrangle mischievous pigs with your trusty lasso and guide them back to their pens! Explore different biomes, navigate tiles with unique effects, and enjoy character customization to make the gameplay experience truly yours.

games.name: Above Snakes
games.summary: Piece by piece, create your own world and survive in this Wild West-inspired survival RPG. Craft, farm, hunt, build your base, and fight in order to stay alive.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: My Cozy Room
games.summary: Design and decorate your dream space in this relaxing sandbox game! Choose from multiple room layouts, arrange over 500 furniture pieces and decorations, and craft the perfect cozy atmosphere that matches your style.

games.name: Cottonville
games.summary: Create, farm, and style in Cottonville - a cozy dress-up game with farming and sim mechanics!

games.name: Cupiclaw
games.summary:
Cupiclaw is a cute & frantic claw machine roguelike deckbuilder.
Grab unique prizes, build powerful combos, face chaotic machines… and claw back your relationship!

games.name: Duo Games
games.summary: Fun, fast, and fiercely competitive – perfect for two players on one Nintendo Switch!

games.name: Chonkers
games.summary: Chonkers is a cozy and relaxing idle game. Adopt the cutest fur balls and watch them ramp up the chonk scale as you play with them. Find them a new family. They’ll pay A LOT for your hefty chonker! Complete your collection by finding all the breeds and the rarest space cats!

games.name: Leafko
games.summary: Leafko is a turn-based RPG set in a magical forest. Meet a new character in each chapter and explore dungeons overtaken over by nature.

games.name: Horticular
games.summary: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

games.name: Kity Builder
games.summary: Explore relaxing deserted islands and build cute cities over them as Kity, the builder cat. Customize the buildings and environment at your own pace in a peaceful, stress-free setting.

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Zombies Overloaded
games.summary:
Zombies are everywhere! Arcade-inspired shooter, where relentless waves of undead creeps shamble, sprint, and swarm at you in a cramped room! Your only chance? A wild arsenal of weapons and just enough skill (and blind LUCK!) to keep the hordes at bay.

Strap in and embrace the chaos! Trapped in an inescapable room, you’ll take on endless waves of zombies, mowing them down by the hundreds with randomly spawning weapons. Every five waves, a pissed off boss shows up to ruin your day. Survival demands quick reflexes, clever strategy, and just a pinch of madness! First release contains 2 rooms, No-Escape and Cornered. Try to master each!

games.name: Ways of Alchemy
games.summary: Become a medieval alchemist in this card game. Grow, craft, and brew your way to power. Hire adventurers, discover ancient recipes, and master the art of alchemy. No wands are required — just wit and wisdom.

games.name: Legends of Castile
games.summary: Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.

games.name: Tiny Lands 2
games.summary: Take your perception into a new dimension with the relaxing sense of photorealistic miniature scenes in Tiny Lands 2. Find the differences and stories by exploring handcrafted 3D dioramas. Can you find them all?

games.name: Innkeep
games.summary: Innkeep is an immersive job sim with an RPG core and a dark twist. Run your own fantasy world inn. Serve ale. Share rumors. Tell jokes. Rob your guests…?? Well, maybe just a little.

games.name: WaxHeart
games.summary: An atmospheric horror 3D platformer about a wax boy with a lantern for a heart, journeying through a dark, ruined world.

games.name: Mojito Woody's Rescue
games.summary: MOJITO Woody's Rescue puts you on a journey to find your best dog friend Woody, who has been kidnapped by an evil Cucumber, in a cute 3d adventure with sandbox levels, platforming challenges and exploration zones. Inspired by Super Mario 64 - Odyssey / Banjo Kazooie / Celeste

games.name: Nekogumi
games.summary:
Join Bruce, a tuxie who loves to cosplay and roam around town. Spruce up the cat café and buy all sorts of wardrobe items you want. Gather your brigade and let your curiosity guide you, you get a free pass as a cat boss~

Nekogumi is a single player, third person cafe-adventure game. It is a cozy game where you’d find companions among silly and funny animals and work together to protect and bring prosper to the neighbourhood.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

games.name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
games.summary: Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

games.name: Sak'd
games.summary: Sak'd is an action-adventure platform game wherein players assume the role of Sak, a not-so-ordinary pillow accidentally brought to life, imbued with powerful weapon wielding, spell-casting, monster-smashing abilities and sent on a quest to destroy evil.

games.name: Fish Stick Protocol
games.summary: Gather up to 8 players and dive into chaotic procedural dimensions to collect artifacts for the Owner's peculiar galleries.

games.name: Hounded
games.summary: You are Duke, a determined young Border Collie who is searching for their lost master, the leader of The Rebellion. Hounded by a cunning hunter, can you track the scent, unearth the power of The Tide and find your way home?

games.name: AstraPuffs
games.summary: Astrapuffs is an agentic NPC multiplayer that is set to revolutionize the cozy gaming genre. Our advanced AI-driven NPCs create dynamic, responsive, and immersive stories that adapt to the player interactions in real-time.

events.name: Capcom Spotlight 6.26.2025
events.description: Join us for a 40-minute livestream featuring news and extended commentary with developer interviews. Featured games: Monster Hunter Wilds, Resident Evil Requiem, PRAGMATA, and Street Fighter 6.

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - Sagat
games.summary: Sagat is the first DLC character in the Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Character/Ultimate Pass. The Emperor of Muay Thai. He was once one of the highest ranking members of Shadaloo, but has since left the criminal organization. He currently lives deep in the mountains, focusing only on his training.

games.name: Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess
games.summary: Fend off foul creatures and lead the Spirit Stone Maiden on her path. Kunitsu-Gami: Path of the Goddess is a brand new title which upholds Capcom's legacy of original and innovative works. This labor of love follows in the tradition of truly unique titles such as Okami and Shinsekai – Into The Depths. Explore an incredible world in which traditional Japanese aesthetics are brought to stunning life by the power of RE Engine. Enjoy a unique gameplay experience blending action and strategy. Witness an epic clash between the spirit realm and mortal man.

games.name: Capcom Fighting Collection 2
games.summary:
Capcom's newest fighting collection hits the stage!

Choose from fan-favorite games like Capcom vs. SNK 2: Mark of the Millennium 2001 and Project Justice to 3D action games like Power Stone and Power Stone 2 in this collection of eight classic fighting games!

Each game in the collection can be played online or co-op!

Get back in the ring and duke it out in battles that everyone rumored, but no one believed!
Whether it's with a rival new or old, give it your all and strive for victory!

games.name: Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny
games.summary: Reclaim your destiny. Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny returns with higher resolution graphics and modernised controls to perform issen critical counter attacks and intense swordplay. Experience this dramatic revenge story set in Feudal Japan.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 2
games.summary: The second Title Update for Monster Hunter Wilds features the return of Lagiacrus and Seregios, Arch-Tempered Uth Duna, layered weapons, and the Festival of Accord: Flamefete event.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 3
games.summary:
A special collaboration with FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, the hit MMORPG, is coming in Title Update 3!
Experience a fanciful story featuring characters who have wandered from the faraway realm of Eorzea—the world of FINAL FANTASY XIV Online.
Get ready for a surge of awesome collaboration content!

events.name: Bandai Namco Summer Showcase 2025
events.description: The Bandai Namco Summer Showcase is back! Brand new game reveal from MY HERO ACADEMIA, new trailers, and more!

games.name: My Hero Academia: All's Justice
games.summary: SMASH through My Hero Academia’s final story arc and triumph over your foes in spectacular 3v3 battles! Follow the trials of Deku and other characters in the Final War between Heroes and Villains!

games.name: Code Vein II
games.summary:
Code Vein II is an action role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world where Revenants are being transformed into hostile "Horrors." A Revenant Hunter must partner with a time-manipulating companion named Lou.
Gameplay features third-person action combat and deep RPG progression, emphasizing specialized Blood-based mechanics and character customization. An evolved Partner System enhances tactical cooperation with AI companions during exploration and high-difficulty boss encounters. Success depends on mastering diverse weaponry and temporal abilities to survive a world defined by memory and ruin.

games.name: Patapon 1+2 Replay
games.summary: Remastered bundle of the original critically-acclaimed Patapon and Patapon 2 which were released in 2007 and 2008.

games.name: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
games.summary: In this Roguelite set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

games.name: Death Note: Killer Within
games.summary: Death Note: Killer Within is an online social deduction game for up to 10 players. Players will be split into two teams with different objectives. To win the game, players will need to figure out each other’s identities and either eliminate L who threatens Kira's power or seize the Death Note.

games.name: Shadow Labyrinth
games.summary: Shadow Labyrinth is a 2D action platformer and a genre-twisting alternate take on the iconic PAC-MAN. As The Swordsman, you wake on a mysterious planet amidst relics of wars past. To survive you will discover secrets, consume your enemies, and grow from prey to apex predator.

games.name: Little Nightmares III
games.summary:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

games.name: Everybody’s Golf: Hot Shots
games.summary: Everybody’s favorite golf game series finally returns to the fairway! Hit the green with a variety of unique characters and courses in online and offline AND single and multiplayer modes!

games.name: Super Robot Wars Y
games.summary: Super Robot Wars is a grid-based tactical combat RPG that brings units and pilots from a variety of anime together to battle their mutual foes. Rise, Unite, and Triumph!

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.name: Tekken 8: Fahkumram
games.summary:
Thunderous Roar Garuda
The undefeated Muay Thai champion is joining the fight!

While his wife and daughter are held hostage, Fahkumram remains under the control of the Thai military. With the belief that he will one day reclaim his sole purpose for living, Fahkumram has been sent to the battlefield in a military breaching vehicle.

games.name: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - Daima: Adventure Through The Demon Realm Part 1
games.summary: Part 1 of an additional story set in the world of the Dragon Ball DAIMA anime series: DAIMA: Adventure Through The Demon Realm.

games.name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger
games.summary: The latest in the Digimon Story series is finally here! In this RPG, unravel a mystery that spans across the human world and the Digital World, collecting and raising a wide variety of Digimon to save the world.

events.name: Festival Jogatório: 3° Edição
events.description:
The Festival Jogatório is now in its third edition as an event that brings the public closer to independent Brazilian game developers.
With a focus on digital and analog games, the festival promotes the exchange of experiences, encourages experimentation and contributes to strengthening national game production.
The event offers the public the chance to test games in development, meet developers and buy products related to the gaming universe.
Tables with developers of digital games, board games and RPGs present game tests, which are fundamental for improving and adjusting projects.

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: Avoren
games.summary: You are assigned to explore worlds and realms totally lost to sanity, face mystical creatures with elemental powers, and try to stay alive! Find fuel and keep the train going!

games.name: Code Bunny
games.summary:
The planet of Lumna is threatened by a group of terrorists called Mad Bunny! Join Axel and Hazel on their mission to fight them, as they discover more about the world and its people, in this fast-paced 2D-action platformer!

Code Bunny is a momentum-based, melee-oriented platformer where the action is nonstop! Master both character's play styles to deliver flashy and exciting attacks that rip and bounce through enemies and levels!

games.name: Condemned: No Escape
games.summary: Condemned: No Escape is an adventure puzzle game inspired by the Game Boy era. Explore a mysterious place filled with destructive platforms, traps, and holes. Use your wits and precise jumps to collect keys, unlock paths, and uncover secrets as you try to escape.

games.name: Cordels & Spells
games.summary: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

games.name: Cruzcredo: Become a Legend!
games.summary: Rise from the grave and stumble though the streets of Casca Dura, a city buzzing with mysteries, wacky gossip and some good ol' chaos thanks to the "Cruzcredo Curse". Flying rats, a vengeful ghost bride and, oh boy, the skinwalkers... Save Casca Dura from it's doom and become a legend!

games.name: Cyber Haze
games.summary: Cyber Haze is a retro-style 2.5D platformer in which Haze, a delivery robot, must defend his world against a horde of viruses that have begun to take over the digital world!

games.name: Divinastros
games.summary: An astronomical gambling game. Fight the Olimpians while each Zodiac sign affects your cards differently in a deeply satisfying deckbuilder game. Fight Greek beasts, discover Tarot Cards and climb the Olimpus searching for revenge.

games.name: Folklorests
games.summary: In the bowels of the Amazon forest, ancient treasures and terrors await you. Face vengeful spirits and folkloric creatures in Folklorests, a hack ‘n slash that mixes classic action with strategic exploration in a dark and vibrant world.

games.name: Goblin Quest: Void
games.summary: Goblin Quest: Void is a local platformer game. The aim is to cooperate with the other players to complete the various stages and challenges.

games.name: Hysteric Kingdom
games.summary: Hysteric Kingdom is a hack 'n' slash game with frame-by-frame animations in a medieval setting inside its own universe, where you control the protagonist Afortunado. After a great tragedy, he ends up in prison and can only count on the help of a mysterious sword that appears to be more than just a weapon...

games.name: KiroKiro BoBon
games.summary:
You control KiroKiro: a crazy yellow creature who’s always traveling, always spinning, and always hungry for stars!
He runs through psychedelic haunted places, jumps over danger, dashes through space, and causes mischief wherever he goes!

games.name: Le Fol
games.summary: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Looppip is a magical seed that carries an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the bee hives, essential for the survival of life on Earth, and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

games.name: Love Sick Cats
games.summary: Love Sick Cats is a fast-paced roguelike about revenge. Play as Sashi, a cat hunting down her nemesis across infected zones. A parasitic alien entity is spreading through the planet, warping animal bodies into grotesque forms. Kill everything, survive, and discover a macabre, tragic story.

games.name: Mangút
games.summary: Face the struggles of Gil, a tireless app delivery worker racing against time to pay the bills. Swing through hand-painted levels with a unique grappling hook and make tough choices.

games.name: MechaBlade Hero
games.summary: MechaBlade Hero is an indie action adventure game where you control a robot fighting your way through an army of robots to get out of a giant tower. Face enemies and gain new weapons, solve puzzles and platform challenges in this challenging hack and slash.

games.name: MegaBattle
games.summary: Build robots and enter the arena to battle! Robots have taken control of the galaxy and now humans must build bots to fight in the MegaBattle Arena. MegaBattle combines the best of the CCG with innovative mechanics such as unique mana mode, opponent reading attack and a fast card draw system.

games.name: In The Hours of Darkness
games.summary:
Enter the world of In The Hours of Darkness, an action-adventure 2D game, set in a city where magic is commonplace, and danger and wonder lurk in each corner.

As unemployed artist Rex Nemo, explore the City of Shores as you try to solve the riddle of a magic book, before its too late. Use acrobatic skill, combat prowess, and an assortment of spells in order to outsmart your foes and unlock the secrets of the City.

games.name: Pivot of Hearts
games.summary: Game developer Wén Xiàn has a second chance at love, but it’s not what he expects. Will he be able to stray off the beaten path and find true happiness? Play your cards right and find out in Pivot of Hearts, a non-monogamous visual novel!

games.name: Reports from Vera Cruz
games.summary: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

games.name: Retro Arsenal
games.summary: Live the dream of incorporating your favorite retro games into powers that will help you defeat hundreds of monsters in your path. In Retro Arsenal, you will immerse yourself in a 2D and 3D world bringing together the past and future of technology in this frantic adventure. Find the cartridges, eliminate everyone in your path, escape with your life.

games.name: RhythMania
games.summary: An upcoming vibrant rhythm anthology filled with over a dozen dynamic mini-games with minimalistic inputs across musical genres and visual styles!

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Roller Heist
games.summary: Roller Heist is a stylish action game where you glide through museums around the world recovering looted pieces. Armed with a paintball gun, skate and splat your way past security guards and repair history.

games.name: Slash Quest!
games.summary: Forget your power fantasy. Slash Quest’s simple yet unfamiliar controls will put you in the shoes of an unlikely knight with a big heart, an even bigger weapon, and absolutely zero skills. But worry not! Just like Shep and Swordie’s friendship, before you know it everything will feel right and everyone will be counting on you to save the Queendom.

games.name: Subversive Memories
games.summary: Subversive Memories is a story driven survival horror set in Brazil during the last military dictatorship. Explore the backrooms of an oppressive regime, escape ominous presences and scavenge every corner of this land in search of your ██████.

games.name: Super Dash
games.summary: Dash through enemies, collect power ups and survive waves of enemies in this fast paced bullet-hell

games.name: The Last Love Letter
games.summary: The Last Love Letter is a challenging 2D platformer set in World War II. Control Antonio, a wounded carrier pigeon unable to fly, must cross dangerous trenches to repair radio antennas and retrieve love letters left by fallen combatants.

games.name: The Stochastic Dungeons of Apogee
games.summary:
"When the moons reach their apogee, the world's protective seal shall weaken, thus bringing forth entities and events never before seen."

Each run will be a different experience; the weapons you acquire may never be acquired again, and your most reliable tool is your knowledge of the elements within the dungeon.

games.name: TinyAttack
games.summary: Tiny Attack is an action roguelite game. Fight against hordes of enemies in procedurally-generated levels with distinctive themes. Loot items, defeat bosses in uniquely designed fights, and survive until you find the truth.

games.name: Toni Island Adventure
games.summary: Toni, a pizza-loving sailor dog, shipwrecks on a mysterious island. Solve challenging puzzles, defeat foes, unlock minigames, unravel the island's ancient magic to find your way back home, and don't forget to take a break for a hot slice of pizza!

games.name: A Sunday Afternoon
games.summary: Help the insecure Lucas, and his sassy best friend Carol, explore a watercolored São Paulo and solve puzzles to complete a sticker album to gift his secret crush, Leo, in this cute-as-heck visual novel!

games.name: Pimbolas
games.summary: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.

games.name: Coralina: Illacrimo
games.summary: Lost in nostalgia, surrounded by ghosts, Coralina goes through the Elysian Fields to find a long lost alchemy artifact, all before the world ends. The girl that can enter memories travels through these Posthumous Lands once again, in her own Psychedelic Odissey.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: Century of Anticipation
games.summary: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl, your only company is yourself. In this short adventure, your challenge might be the toughest of all: make time pass again!

games.name: Morro Acima
games.summary: Morro Acima is an open-world 3D platformer with a focus on missions where you do parkour in the favela of Morro da Abobrinha. Explore and find secrets while helping the locals with their crazy stories and strengthening the surrounding community with your skills. From rooftop to rooftop, Morro Acima!

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

events.name: State of Play: Ghost of Yōtei
events.description: The broadcast will feature over 20 minutes of gameplay hosted by Sucker Punch Productions creative directors Jason Connell and Nate Fox, including a look at Atsu’s new weapons, new ways to personalize your journey, new special modes, and more.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei
games.summary:
