The game takes place 300 years after Ghost of Tsushima. Set in the lands surrounding Mount Yōtei, a towering peak in the heart of Ezo, an area of Japan known as Hokkaido in present day.

The area is outside the rule of Japan, and filled with sprawling grasslands, snowy tundras, and unexpected dangers.

events.name: Resident Evil: Survival Unit - Online Showcase
events.description: The Official Announcement for Resident Evil Survival Unit, a new mobile strategy game.

games.name: Resident Evil: Survival Unit
games.summary:
Dive in the world of "Resident Evil Survival Unit" for the ultimate survival experience, where strategy means everything!

In the world of “Resident Evil Survival Unit,” strategy holds the key to survival.
As an unknown infection spreads, the city crumbles in the blink of an eye.
You are left stranded in the ruins with a group of isolated survivors.
Build your base, secure resources, and expand your influence to carve out a path to survival!

games.name: Elsewhere Electric
games.summary: A puzzle game powered by two: Navigate a mysterious facility to charge devices, solve puzzles, and reconfigure the map as you see fit. Uncover the secrets of the facility that await you both at its confounding core. Bring your friend, because you will not survive alone.

games.name: Walkabout Mini Golf: Venice
games.summary: Make memories and birdies on a romantic mini golfing holiday through the beautiful canals, historic shops and sun-filled piazzas of this favorite Italian destination. Discover for yourself why Italians call this magical place Serenissima ("most serene").

games.name: Hide The Corpse
games.summary:
Hide the Corpse is a VR physics-based game where players must hide a body within four minutes across six distinct environments, including a zero-gravity spaceship and an underwater shipwreck.

With quirky humor and immersive gameplay, players will face chaotic fun as they erase evidence and solve creative puzzles. Now featuring a sandbox mode, unlockable levels, and hilarious character skins, Hide the Corpse delivers fast-paced thrills and endless laughs.

games.name: Virtual Skate
games.summary: Experience next level board control, skate with friends, and film insane tricks in the most immersive skateboarding game ever made.

games.name: Rager
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled excitement of this melee combat rhythm game! Master weapon of your choice – sword, mace, claws, hammer, axe, your own fists and many more! Stunning visuals and spatial audio technology puts you right in heart of the action.

games.name: Trenches VR
games.summary: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

games.name: Fatherhood Legacy
games.summary: Fatherhood Legacy is an immersive narrative that follows Bryson, a young gamer, as he clashes with his father, Booker, over his future. Through an emotional journey across the city and a meditation-induced flashback to Booker’s past, the two learn to communicate, discover their similarities, and begin overcoming their family’s wounds. Blending interactive storytelling with Black history, gaming culture, and emerging technology, this project explores healing, resilience, and the power of understanding across generations.

games.name: Fixer Undercover
games.summary: Welcome to DIY Espionage - a VR puzzle adventure where everyday tools and found objects become your problem-solving kit. Go undercover as a repair worker inside a prison, investigate a mysterious rehabilitation program through various challenges, and make your escape with the truth.

games.name: The Phoenix Gene
games.summary:
The Phoenix Gene is an adrenaline-fueled VR quest for immortality.
Control a fierce phoenix, Firestorm, and genetically enhanced Jackie, bonded by fate and driven by the collapse of the Slipstream multiverse.
Total Immersion. Total Action: Fly, dodge, and move your body in this adventurous ‘schumupp.

games.name: Sportvida CyberDash
games.summary: Sportvida CyberDash is a VR running game that delivers both stress relief and thrilling challenges. Set in a high-speed, futuristic world of light and technology, you’ll embark on an intense adventure where sprinting, dodging, and smashing obstacles offer an unparalleled sense of release.

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Chess Club
games.summary: The greatest strategy game of all times! Select a stunning environment and challenge your friends, our AI, or one of the millions of Chess fans around the world.

games.name: Memoreum
games.summary: MEMOREUM is a VR sci-fi action horror campaign. The Ichor Infection has taken over the last ship of humanity. You are Dr. Otto Hudson, fighting to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak as your fragmented mind slips from reality.

games.name: Zero Caliber 2
games.summary: Get ready to experience the thrill of your life in Zero Caliber 2, the sequel to the critically acclaimed Zero Caliber VR! Cinematic action, explosions, tons of weapons to unlock, a full-blown single player/Co-op campaign, PvP, airstrikes and a VR experience you'll never forget! Coming in 2024.

games.name: Crime Shop Simulator
games.summary: Crime Shop Simulator: A Prison Boss Game is a VR crafting game where you play as a shop owner smuggling prohibited stuff. Produce and sell beers, erotic magazines, cigarettes, and more! But watch out, the police are cracking down on contraband!

games.name: Banners & Bastions
games.summary: Banners & Bastions is a 3D tabletop real-time strategy game in mixed reality. Command your troops and fortify your kingdom to defeat the enemy in dynamic and epic battles!

games.name: Of Lies and Rain
games.summary: Of Lies and Rain is a story-driven first person shooter built exclusively for VR. Set in a dark, sci-fi, post-apocalyptic world, at the edge of the real and digital realm. You’ll fight to reclaim your past and save humanity from the brink of extinction.

games.name: Fruit Golf
games.summary: Ever dreamt of putting a pineapple down a pirate ship while your friends go full sabotage with sharks and exploding barrels? Fruit Golf turns every swing into a chaotic, laugh-out-loud party in VR. It’s a game that the whole family will go bananas fore!

games.name: Sky Runner
games.summary: Take control of agile, heavily-armed drones bristling with explosives and defend your home from waves of hostile missile launchers that emerge from every corner of your room. Quick thinking and sharp reflexes are your keys to survival. But there's more at stake; a hostage is trapped in the environment. Can you outmaneuver the enemy, rescue the innocent, and claim victory?

games.name: Exer Gale
games.summary: Exer Gale is a virtual reality arcade game for those who wish to fly and get away. The game gives you the freedom to glide, dive and climb in charming tropical environments using your body.

games.name: BlackGate
games.summary: In this asymmetrical multiplayer experience, every player has a unique role to play, with one ultimate goal: survival. Up to 4 Engineers are pit against an alien specimen controlled by a 5th player.

games.name: Bearly Escape
games.summary:
Wild animals should roam free, but Kidd, a deranged scientist (the game’s antagonist), ventures into the forest to capture animals and use his twisted “X Serum,” he freezes the animals and subjects them to extraction and compression devices that strip away their consciousness, trapping it inside dolls. These dolls are then stuffed into claw machines, imprisoning the creatures in a nightmarish state.

As the protagonist, you ( a forest protection volunteer) lead a peaceful life in Everwood, a town nestled near the forest—until one day, your beloved dog, Robin, goes missing. This leads you to discover Kidd’s sinister lab, where you discover his horrific experiments. Now, it’s up to you to embark on a daring mission: free the trapped consciousness of the animals, rescue them from the claw machines, and help them escape the clutches of Kidd’s evil control, venture dangerously through forest terrane to escape, ultimately returning them to their natural habitat.

The stakes are high, and time is running out. The wild is calling. It’s time to claw your way to justice!

games.name: Smasher
games.summary: An arcade VR action shooter set in a world of cyberpunk. Try all the armory in one go: shoot, throw, pick another one. Cast spectacular spells. Fight badass bosses and be badass yourself. Even deflect rockets with trash can lids!

games.name: Grit & Valor: 1949
games.summary: Command an elite squad of Mechs in this alternate World War 2 dieselpunk real-time tactics roguelite. Think fast, battle the Evil Axis forces, and neutralise their HQ. Upgrade your Mechs and Pilots, and develop new strategies to defeat the enemy!

games.name: How to God
games.summary:
Are you a wise and benevolent leader, or a vengeful deity? Will you assist your villagers, or throw them into the sun?
In How to God, a sandbox God Simulation game, you alone choose how to shape your world. Command your followers, experiment with alchemy, build up your villages, and make the choice between good and evil. No judgement from us, of course - only you can choose How to God.

games.name: Slap Fighter
games.summary: Step into Slap Fighter, the first VR game of slap fighting! Use elemental powers, execute epic combos, and uncover dark secrets in a dystopian city ruled by the Slap Syndicate.

games.name: Velociblaster
games.summary: EVOLUTION. TAKES. FLIGHT. Become a dinosaur and blast away your enemies with high-tech blaster cannons! Engage in multiplayer PvP aerial combat using rocket thrusters to fly. Outmaneuver and outwit your velociraptor rivals in intense, fast-paced battles.

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Chrono Hunter
games.summary: Step into the thrilling world of Chrono Hunter, a native VR immersive adventure that combines enjoyment of FPS, Roguelite, and RPG genres. As a time traveler agent equipped with amazing abilities and weapons to explore to experience through diverse and meticulously crafted levels.

games.name: What Comes After
games.summary: What remains when everything falls apart? What Comes After is an episodic VR narrative experience set in the ruins of a forgotten settlement, abandoned by the world, but not by those who still call it home.

games.name: Virtual Hunter
games.summary: Prepare for a hunting experience of a lifetime. Virtual Hunter brings realistic hunting to virtual reality. Pack your gear and put your hunting skills and tactics to the test in the open wilderness.

games.name: NightClub Simulator
games.summary: seduce girls or get into fights, you can do anything in a virtual nightclub that you can't do in real life whether its in multiplayer or single player.

games.name: Scared by Squares
games.summary: A creepy VR exploration game where you navigate liminal spaces, avoid roaming cubes, and uncover hidden anomalies in eerie block-filled mazes.

games.name: On Point
games.summary: Experience classic 90’s arcade vibes with On Point, a fully immersive light-gun shooter for VR. You'll have to think fast and shoot faster as you blast your way through over 30 wacky minigames designed for all ages and skill levels.

games.name: Reach
games.summary:
The ground-breaking cinematic action-adventure from nDreams Elevation – the VR immersion expert’s pioneering new studio.

Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Make every move matter to shape your destiny. Are you ready to make the leap?

games.name: Squishies
games.summary: Help stranded Squishies find their way back home in a fantastic miniature 3D universe! Squishies is a single player, puzzle platform experience, built exclusively for PlayStation VR. Solve puzzles and save Squishies, or be creative and build your own levels—then share them with the community!

games.name: Dreams of Another
games.summary: Dreams of Another is a third-person exploration-action game built around the philosophical theme, “No Creation Without Destruction.” Rather than destroying objects by shooting—as in traditional shooting games—here, your shots materialize and create the world. This unconventional mechanic offers a gameplay experience that challenges the norms of the genre and invites players into a whole new dimension.

games.name: Unseen Diplomacy 2
games.summary: You're a Secret Agent during a dangerous time, Evil-doers are plotting to destroy the world. Complete missions, manage your agents & use Intel to narrow down the plot & save the Earth. Play a real-life VR obstacle course using every inch of your room - you will run, roll, sneak & hack to victory!

games.name: Dixotomia
games.summary: Dixotomia is a roleplaying VR shooter in a world of a science-fiction dystopia. Dive into the daily life of a SpecOps contractor, who is forced to fight vampires while also trying to stay sane without giving in to infection himself. Can he return back unchanged?

games.name: Paper Craft
games.summary: A VR platformer that takes place in a world of arts and crafts! Run, swing, ride, hover, and platform your way through 20 campaign levels. Create and share your own levels worldwide with our easy to use level editor!

games.name: Grokit: Purrtropolis
games.summary:
Welcome to Purrtropolis – Grokit’s fuzziest update yet!

In this summer update, we’re introducing a whole new environment, fresh mini-games, new music, a progression system, and a bunch of quality-of-life improvements based on your feedback.

games.name: Elemental Towers
games.summary: A dynamic adventure in a world of magic, blending puzzle elements with arcade. Rebuild magical towers while defending against dragons and mastering ancient elemental runes.

games.name: Jungle Man
games.summary: Jungle Man is a wild, hand-tracked platformer built exclusively for Quest 3 and 3s. With over 70 handcrafted levels, full-room movement, and no controllers required, Jungle Man transforms your real-world space into a chaotic, hilarious, and surprisingly difficult jungle adventure.

games.name: Contractors Showdown: ExfilZone
games.summary:
Enter ExfilZone, the immersive extraction-based game mode in Contractors Showdown, where every decision could mean life or death. ExfilZone introduces a deep progression system intertwined with dynamic missions, challenging you to survive, complete objectives, and extract with your hard-earned loot.

Craft your ultimate loadout with the one and only VR Gunsmith System, featuring over 50 weapons and thousands of combinations. Customize attachments, tweak components, and design unique color schemes to dominate with style.

Take on missions from unique vendors, ranging from elimination contracts and reconnaissance tasks to planting trackers and resource gathering. Completing these missions builds loyalty with vendors, unlocking new weapons, gear, and upgrades to expand your arsenal.

games.name: Verse VR
games.summary: Immerse yourself in beautiful landscapes full of poetry, music, and art from around the world. Relax in a Chinese garden, explore the ruins of a mythical land, discover the joy of a West African village, and lose yourself in a Victorian conservatory. Welcome to a VR experience unlike any other.

games.name: System Critical III
games.summary: Step into the fast-paced, high-energy world of System Critical 3, the ultimate VR platformer-shooter designed exclusively for PSVR2. With intense gunplay, gravity-defying jumps, and mind-bending virtual environments, you’ll navigate a futuristic cyber-realm where every battle is a test of skill and reflexes. Experience ruthless boss battles, traverse dynamic landscapes, and master an arsenal of powerful weapons—all in stunning virtual reality.

games.name: Hidden Memories of the Gardens Between
games.summary: Bend time at will, as childhood best friends Arina and Frendt journey across islands filled with precious mementos from the seminal moments of their time together. Explore a captivating narrative completely reimagined for VR with 40 new puzzles scattered across the story.

games.name: World War Z VR
games.summary: Based on the hit game World War Z that has now captivated over 25 million players, World War Z VR is an immersive single-player first-person shooter experience with reimagined locations to explore. Take on huge swarms of zombies across three difficulty levels and choose your operator, weapons, and perks to create unique playthroughs.

games.name: Vivarium: Summer Vacay Update
games.summary: There will be 3 new animals, some tropical trees, beach figures and some special new features added to the game!

events.name: TactiCon 2025 Showcase
events.description:
It's time for the Kickoff Show of TactiCon 2025 with our host ReneeSky!

Let's start our strategy game celebration with the Showcase featuring a ton of surprises from the most awaited games, and exclusive new titles and announcements! TactiCon is a digital convention hosted on Steam celebrating strategy video games. The event highlights the brilliant and creative minds who develop strategy games and gathers the players who love them.

games.name: Becoming Saint
games.summary: Choose your doctrine and preach across medieval Italy in this real-time strategy roguelike. Gather your diverse cast of followers, venture out to convince and convert new believers, conquer towns, and strive to become a saint in your lifetime — or die trying.

games.name: As We Descend
games.summary: The roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Recruit, upgrade, and deploy your forces in tactical battles against corrupt creatures. Make hard decisions in humanity’s final city to bolster your odds. Will you break the cycle of endless descent?

games.name: Xenopurge
games.summary: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

games.name: Echoes of the Architects
games.summary: Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.

games.name: The Scouring
games.summary: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use modding tools to create custom game modes! Join The battle!

games.name: He is Coming
games.summary: He Is Coming is a roguelite auto battler where you have to collect and combine powerful items in order to defeat the demon king and his minions. Upgrade your weapon, discover hidden treasures and survive, because whether you're prepared or not, he is coming!

games.name: New Arc Line
games.summary: Take a stand in the eternal conflict between Arcane Magic and Steampunk Revolution and tip the uneasy balance between sorcery, elves, dwarves and mysterious monsters on one side and steampunk gadgets, zeppelins, and tesla guns on the other in this single-player, party-based, story-rich RPG.

games.name: Dead In Antares
games.summary: Dead in Antares is a turn-based survival management game with RPG elements, set on an alien planet. Lead a crew of survivors sent on a mission to save humanity. Manage their needs, strengthen their teamwork, and explore this mysterious world to find a way back home.

games.name: Stronghold: Crusader - Definitive Edition
games.summary: Gird your loins and sharpen your steel! Besiege 20 unique enemy lords and battle friends online, in this expanded remaster of the classic 'castle sim'. Relive history with new units, AI opponents, visuals, audio, campaigns, skirmish trails, co-op and larger maps.

games.name: City Tales: Medieval Era
games.summary: City Tales is a medieval city builder, allowing you to unleash your creativity and shape vast cities that break outside a traditional grid. Plan each district for your citizens needs and aid your companions in their tales, creating a city to be proud of!

games.name: Reus 2: Everglades
games.summary: Bring the Wetlands to life in Reus 2! This expansion adds over 60 new biotica, micros to help support growth and more human leaders join the roster. With new eras to explore, find all the new ways to fill the universe with more life!

games.name: Drill Core
games.summary: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

games.name: Every Day We Fight
games.summary: Caught in a time loop, your band of resistance fighters is humanity’s last hope. Real-time exploration meets turn-based tactics and roguelite strategy as you learn new abilities, seek out new weapons, and develop new techniques to overcome the mysterious alien threat.

games.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option
games.summary: In the RTS-game “Diplomacy is Not an Option” you will become a medieval feudal lord in a midlife crisis. Due to your position you must constantly make hundreds of decisions a day related with city management and economic development. You are tired of this monotonous and, so it seems, meaningless existence. But things are about to change: hordes of bloodlusted enemies, swarms of scary monsters and crowds of rebellious peasants at any second can bring some life to your working schedule.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

events.name: Dames 4 Games Slumber Party Showcase
events.description: The Dames 4 Games Slumber Party Showcase is here! We’re highlighting incredible games from women and femme devs with exclusive reveals, spotlights, and more. It’s a celebration of the creators and teams pushing this industry forward and you’re invited! Come through, co-stream it, or just hang out and support the work. It's a whole vibe!

games.name: Pungo
games.summary: Two cats, a ball of yarn, and a duel full of reflexes and fun. Play against a friend or solo, use surprising power-ups, and unlock adorable kittens. Will you be the most agile on the field? Catch the yarn ball and show off your skills in Pungo!

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: Flowers and Favours: Florist Simulator
games.summary: Flowers And Favours is a relaxing cozy florist sim. Run your own flower shop, experiment with a stunning variety of florals, and craft unique bouquets for your adorable customers. Your floral journey begins today!

games.name: The Wandering Village
games.summary: The Wandering Village is a city-building simulation game with survival and rogue-like elements. Build a village on the back of a giant, wandering creature, farm crops and forage resources to keep your villagers alive and form a symbiotic relationship with your giant host to survive together in a hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Voyagers of Nera
games.summary: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative seafaring survival-crafting game for up to 10 players. Sail across a magical ocean world, skim along the waves, and protect lost nature spirits from monsters emerging from the depths.

games.name: Cozy Beach
games.summary: ️Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an enchanting tropical beach where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

games.name: Project Shoreline
games.summary: Explore, Clean & Restore as a Cute Character in this Cozy Cleaning Mini-Adventure!

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: RollerGirl
games.summary: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

games.name: Plush Party
games.summary: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

games.name: Sunny Trails
games.summary: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

games.name: Wish Upon a Llama
games.summary: Embark on a delightful journey of breeding and raising adorable animals like llamas, bunnies, and capybaras while building meaningful relationships with the residents of Llama Town. What unique animal breeds will you discover and whom among the townsfolk will you befriend? Adventure awaits!

games.name: Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery
games.summary: Lock and Key: A Magical Girl Mystery is a romantic thriller starring a married couple of former Magical Girls. Along with and old friend and a new protégé, they'll undertake one last journey to free Chicago from the terrifying grip of a mysterious serial killer.

games.name: Bookbinding
games.summary: A quiet bookshop. A magical past. A murder and Tarot cards that can twist fate itself. Craft beautiful covers, read between the lines of your customers’ lives, and decide which secrets deserve to stay hidden… including your own.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Brave New Wonders
games.summary: Command automatons with customized instructions to build Brave New Wonders in this factory automation game. You can deploy your automatons to explore a post-apocalypse world, discover ruins from the past, battle, collect resources and make your automated factories thrive!

games.name: Agent of Veil
games.summary: Spies. Secrets. Puzzles. Office gossip? Puzzle your way into the covert world of espionage as a potential recruit for an elusive spy agency in Agent of Veil, a puzzle adventure. Pass an unconventional spy interview, solve puzzles, answer quirky questions and uncover the agency's secrets.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Slackjaw
games.summary: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.

games.name: Sol Mates
games.summary: Steer, shield, and blast your way through space in this chaotic co-op party game. You and your ragtag crew will take on missions, make quick decisions, and work together to make a name for yourself in the vast expanse of the universe.

games.name: Seeds of Calamity
games.summary: Take part in healing after the Great Calamity. Tend your farm, complete quests for the villagers, and explore dungeons filled with challenge and treasure in this cozy, solo-developed farming sim. Build a new life in a recovering world with your fluffy Spellbook Companion.

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Pixel Cross Stitch: Color by Number
games.summary: Relax and create beautiful pixel art with color-by-number and cross-stitch fun!

games.name: Jump the Track
games.summary: You're Sam, a young dreamer struggling in the gig economy. However, tonight may change everything. In this absurd comedy, fight your inner battles, rally your forces, and get ready to overthrow the system!

games.name: Curiosmos
games.summary: Curiosmos is a whimsical cosmic sandbox game where you build your own solar system by hand, crafting planets, moons, gravity, atmosphere, and even life! Embark on a quest to discover the secrets of the universe!

events.name: BitSummit The 13th Summer of Yokai
events.description: Japan’s Industry-Leading Independent Game Development Festival in Kyoto!

games.name: Until Then
games.summary:
Mark, an average irresponsible high school student, tries to get by and find purpose in a humdrum life of scrolling, cramming, and traffic. He meets friends, both old and new, and embarks upon a seemingly never-ending trouble, until nothing is ever the same again.

Until Then is a contemporary adventure game inspired by the Philippines, its lifestyle, and culture. Featuring a smartphone where mechanics of modern living come into play, chat with your classmates and explore the depths of social networks, where your replies and interactions may pose consequences.

games.name: Timemoon
games.summary: This cab is a time machine. Become a cab driver on the moon and solve the mystery of the president's assassination in this sci-fi time travel visual novel.

games.name: Thank You For Your Application
games.summary: Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

games.name: Tempopo
games.summary: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

games.name: Tampopo
games.summary: Tampopo is a heartfelt RPG adventure with unique physics-based combat. It is set in a strange world with strange characters. It is a lighthearted game that will make you laugh but it has a hidden darkness to itself which will gently unfold until it wraps all the way around you.

games.name: Sunset Hills
games.summary: The player takes on the role of Nico, who travels by train to each city to visit his former comrades, encountering a variety of people and events on the journey, and gradually learning about different life through solving assorted puzzles along the way. As they reunite, they recall their past experiences in the war, unravelling the war and Nico’s past, and gradually revealing the true purpose of Nico’s journey.

games.name: Sonokuni
games.summary: Sonokuni is a hardcore high-speed action game. In a world of bio-science fiction and Japanese mythology, manipulate time and space to protect your dying country from the forces of a superpower. This experience is truly HIPHOP as you continue to struggle for a solution other than violence.

games.name: Serial World
games.summary: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

games.name: Sea Fantasy
games.summary: Save the world by fishing! This is a brand new action RPG game where you stand on an adventure to fish the SeaAZ, the marine life of this world, in a vast pixel world. This is not a peaceful fishing game. The destruction of the world is imminent....

games.name: Sausage Legend: Arena
games.summary: Sausage Legend is a 3D physics-based fighting game where players clash their sausages in battle. You take on the role of a medieval slave, forced to fight in the "Sausage Duel," a pastime of the nobility. To gain your freedom, you must emerge victorious in this mad contest.

games.name: Sauna 2000
games.summary: Story driven comedic Sauna Simulator / Mystery Horror Game. Heat a Finnish sauna without actually going to Finland.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Old School Rally
games.summary: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

games.name: Oddada
games.summary: A tiny musical world, where houses sing, machines drum, and you create music with them. Ob-la-di, Ob-la-da, Oddada!

games.name: No Players Online
games.summary: you find an abandoned fps game on an old computer. you decide to play it.

games.name: Never's End
games.summary: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

games.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
games.summary:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

games.name: Motionrec
games.summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

games.name: Nitro Gen Omega
games.summary: A Spaghetti Anime turn-based tactical RPG where you lead a crew of mercenaries through wastelands overrun by ruthless machines. Engage in high-octane cinematic Mech battles, recruit pilots and grow relationships. Play solo or join an online world where every character is procedurally generated.

games.name: Miniatures
games.summary: Miniatures is a collection of strange tales where childhood imagination and reality merge with darker undercurrents of mystery and magic. Explore a vast seascape, build odd furniture, feed a lizard and play with sand castles.

games.name: Million Depth
games.summary: Embark on an adventure, exploring a million subterranean floors of a fallen Earth. Trace the remnants of humanity that once dwelled below, all in search of "YOU". Utilize a crafting system that transforms your drawings into weapons to survive the challenging underground world.

games.name: Love Eternal
games.summary: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more.

games.name: LoneStar
games.summary:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

games.name: Liminal Void
games.summary: This is a survival horror dungeon crawler in which you snatch souls, cast spells, and die repeatedly. Through death, you reach Liminal Layer 444: the lair of the Void Gods. Humanity requires them to be erased from existence to prevent another apocalypse.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Last Moon
games.summary: The Moon is falling, malicious creatures appear, the world falls in chaos! Last Moon is an Action-RPG greatly inspired by the mythical titles from the 90s! Explore a mesmerizing, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers, face tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: Keep Driving
games.summary: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

games.name: Instants
games.summary: A heartwarming journey through time. Use your wits and creativity to lovingly craft photo albums and piece together the story of one family throughout the generations.

games.name: Yuri Sword Saga
games.summary: This is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up game set in a beautifully drawn Japanese world where you can slay enemies and bullets with simple controls. Parry enemy attacks and use a variety of special moves to defeat powerful demons and evil monsters.

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Threat: Scream and Escape
games.summary: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

games.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
games.summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

games.name: The End of History
games.summary:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: Squid Grid
games.summary: Welcome to Squid Grid! A free puzzle challenge about a squid on a grid. Unique sokoban mechanics, cute art, and hand-crafted levels will give you a puzzle experience you won't forget. Get Squid Griddin'!

games.name: Sonic Valkyria: Kanon
games.summary: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

games.name: Slot & Dungeons
games.summary: "Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots. While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

games.name: Skill Hockey
games.summary: ``Skill Hockey'' is a super exciting new air hockey game where you enter commands during play to activate flashy special moves and drive the puck into your opponent's goal!

games.name: The Shojing
games.summary: "SHOJING" is a casual game where you control a cat and break a shoji screen. It's a cat, so it's just about permissible, but humans should never try to imitate this.

games.name: Rope-Kun Adventure
games.summary: A very unique rope action game in which the main character "Rope-kun", who wields a rope, overcomes various gimmicks! The possibilities for ropes are endless, from carrying objects, to bouncing balls, to tying up and defeating enemies! Overcome with him the many difficulties that await you!

games.name: Room 502
games.summary: A cynical high schooler, Hae-eun's mundane life takes a colorful turn as she and her dorm roommates in Room 502 unravel mysterious incidents on campus. This game blends academy life, mystery, and youth in a captivating detective adventure.

games.name: Robo Oh vs. Uchu Mega Fight
games.summary: With simple 2-button controls,anyone can jump in and enjoy the thrills of tag-team fighting action. This game is developed using the 8-bit fantasy console PICO-8.Experience the dynamic animations that push the limits of this tiny engine!

games.name: Questy Chess
games.summary: Deep in an ever advancing computer, forgotten and unchanged, remains chess program v1. Peace is shattered by a software update! Can you stop the invading bytes before being overwritten?

games.name: Project Solaris
games.summary: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

games.name: Panthalassa
games.summary: Panthalassa is a Point and click and visual novel set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI trying to uncover the memories of their body's previous owner. The game makes you experience the world through different user interfaces, where the physical and digital worlds collide.

games.name: One More Plate
games.summary: One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you'll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: MeloMisterio: Play Your Melody
games.summary: The melody you play moves the world — experience a brand-new kind of musical 3D platforming action.

games.name: Menherarium
games.summary:
This game is a deck-building roguelite where you must keep winning blood-staked Cee-lo against a super clingy girl.

Modify the dice faces, use cheating items when necessary, and overcome her unreasonable demands to win the bets.

Your goal is to survive the life-and-death Cee-lo.

games.name: Mandragora: Whispers of the Witch Tree
games.summary: Mankind has surrendered the world to the monsters. People hide away behind walls of brick and palisades of ignorance, constructed by their leaders. Joy and delight are coveted jewels, out of reach of the masses. This is not the world you were promised. Travel by night and take it back. Journey through a world in decline, slowly falling prey to the damaging effects of Entropy. Fight against vicious enemies, challenge unique, deadly bosses, meet new allies, enemies, and every shade in-between, and make harsh moral choices. There are many paths worth taking. Choose yours.

games.name: Symbiosis
games.summary: Online cooperative or solo survival and action RPG set in a procedural alien world. Explore, survive, battle bosses and gather resources to customize your equipment and defend your bases from creatures drawn by the electromagnetism of your technology.

games.name: Kletka
games.summary: Kletka is a co-op horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: Joltt: Battle Pillars
games.summary: A hyper-accessible 2D fighting game where challengers face off in magical jousts. Outmaneuver your opponent's attacks and knock them off their pillar to be the last one standing. No close combat. No blocking. Dodge and counter everything to be victorious!

games.name: Jelly Troops
games.summary: An online action RTS where the tide can turn in a flash! Fight exciting battles where you recruit golems to battle your opponent’s slimes, cleverly redirect their slimes with walls, or sneakily steal their flag to make a dramatic comeback.

games.name: I Write Games Not Tragedies
games.summary: An emo-inspired narrative rhythm game exploring growing pains, addiction, romance and music. Scream with Ash as he makes the transition from baby bat to elder emo, guide him through his growing pains, and help him navigate his dirtbag life through music.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: Haunted Streamer
games.summary: Live-stream Japan’s most haunted ruins. Capture ghosts, grow your channel… and survive.

games.name: Haunted Room! Urami-chan
games.summary: In this "life-intervention watching game," you control the earthbound spirit "Urami-chan." Travel between an apartment's past and present to change the murdered resident's future. The game unfolds in semi-real time, tasking you to watch over the resident and intervene.

games.name: Hailing from the Abyss
games.summary: Hailing From the Abyss is a rhythm game with a unique duel setup. Beat powerful enemies in rhythmic battles by using consumables, acquiring power-ups, and skill. Guide Suri while she faces her past memories in style and rhythm!

games.name: Frostbound
games.summary: FrostBound is a roguelike tower defense card game set in an endless, frozen winter. Take command as you build your garrison, explore the snowy wilderness, gather vital resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies.

games.name: Electrogical
games.summary: "Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic" is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging "piece placement," "number manipulation," and "score selection" to aim for a high score in each stage.

games.name: Drunken Rogue
games.summary: The rowdy adventures of drunk-as-a-skunk Rogue Lita and Vampire of Demise Endo! Stagger around traps and stumble through demon assaults. Make your way to the dungeon's deepest depths—rumored to contain the most precious of booze!

games.name: Die Deep
games.summary: Die Deep delivers a pure and focused combat experience - it’s all about reading your foes and mastering your timing to strike back. Nothing stands in your way but combat! Dive into a constantly changing abyss, take down every enemy in your way, and enjoy the ultimate head-to-head battle experience.

games.name: Depth:Origin
games.summary: Depth:Origin is a rhythm game that takes the approach of a shooting game. ・Shoot the enemies that attack you in time with the rhythm ・Avoid the boss's attacks in time with the music Use these two actions to save energy for your ship and defeat the boss.

games.name: Demon Raiders: Bloody Gems of Blood
games.summary: A vulgar, cute & competitive party game! Stab your friends (2~4 players) and splatter their blood across loads of levels! Pools of blood will spawn rotten-blood monsters and power-up chests! Get stabbed! Get eaten! Never die! Even if you become poop! Single player co-op campaign also in development!

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

games.name: Culture House
games.summary: Culture House is a nurturing + adventure game based on biological cultivation experiments. Set in a building influenced by 20th-century modernist houses, the game portrays serene and strange days, unravels the mysteries hidden behind the experiments, and culminates in the arrival of the apocalypse.

games.name: Break Siege
games.summary: Break Siege is a train-themed deck-building rougelike game in which you constantly construct your own deck and breakthrough forces of the Empire in intense, real-time battles.

games.name: Blood Bar Tycoon
games.summary: Blood Bar Tycoon is a vampire bar management game. Build bars and blood factories, lure humans to harvest their blood, process it, and serve your customers: other vampires. Research quirky machines and deal with hunters! Expand through Crimson City to become a mighty Elder!

games.name: Beat Tokyo with Jimotoism
games.summary: The citizens led by Saitama rise up in rebellion! The epic battle to defeat Tokyo begins now! Get hooked on the unique, wobbly limb controls! Dash through 3D-rendered "hometown (jimoto: your local roots)" worlds in this innovative platformer like no other!

games.name: Ballad: As the Music Goes
games.summary: Ballad is a musical cosy 3rd person 3D adventure game. Explore several biomes, discover melodies in order to call, help, sooth, interact with the world and villagers around you thanks to your Kalimba ! Or just chill and jam in a colorful place, whatever you choose, magic of music awaits you !

games.name: Awaking Beauty
games.summary: Let’s save the world through dreaming—together! "Awaking Beauty" is a two-character roguelite action game that blends sci-fi and fantasy. You’ll play as selected high school girls piloting dream-diving mechas to rescue those trapped in the dream world.

games.name: Autopanic Zero
games.summary: Autopanic Zero is a minimalist twinstick shooter survival game. A quick 10 minute fun.

games.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit
games.summary:
"Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit" is a mystery adventure featuring a public security duo tackling supernatural cases.

Players take on the role of Tsujitsuma, a member of the "Angelic Agency" investigating "Ghosturbance Cases." The game progresses through three phases: (1) Conversation Part, (2) Deduction Part, and (3) Salvation Part.

Players navigate these phases to uncover the truth behind each incident.

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

games.name: A Passing in the Night
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a third-person adventure game in which you take a timed, one hour-long night walk. Explore a reactive and surreal neighborhood where reality bends and spirits lurk in the shadows. Converse with other lost wanderers and reclaim hope in a bleak world.

games.name: Hotel Barcelona
games.summary:
"Hotel Barcelona," where serial killers from all over the United States are said to have gathered. You must defeat them and check out before all the blood is spilled.

Japanese game creators SWERY65 and SUDA51 have teamed up to create this ambitious work. Don't miss it.

games.name: Horticular
games.summary: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

games.name: Hauntii
games.summary: A beguiling adventure in which you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world - haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

games.name: Gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer co-working sandbox with character customization, room building, and productivity tools. Focus, study, work, and relax together with friends and players around the world.

games.name: Electro Bop Boxing League
games.summary: Climb the ranks and claim your spot among the greatest mechanical fighters in this Atompunk / Electro Swing themed auto-boxer! Outfit your boxer with a variety of parts, abilities, belts and crew upgrades earned through single matches or career mode!

games.name: Earthion
games.summary:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Dunjungle
games.summary: A 2d action-packed roguelike about an ape protecting the jungle from the rise of a corruptive power. Explore ever-changing dungeons, fight weird enemies and gear up with lots of weapons and relics you can combine for a new experience every run. Explore, fight, die, and repeat!

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: Cloudheim
games.summary: Ragnarok shattered the world, the gods have chosen you to shape the next one. Cloudheim is a cooperative action RPG blending crafting with chaotic physics-based combat. Gather your allies, craft your weapons, and upgrade your shop in the sky to bring harmony to a broken realm.

games.name: Cassette Boy
games.summary: All you see is all there is - Cassette Boy: an RPG where what exists depends on you.

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
games.summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

games.name: Bokura: Planet
games.summary: "Back to the same planet, together... That's all I wanted..." BOKURA: planet is a two-player puzzle adventure that explores new possibilities in cooperative gaming. Players take on the role of the crew on a space exploration ship as they try to escape from a planet where they have crash-landed on.

games.name: Bits & Bops
games.summary: Bits & Bops is a collection of original rhythm mini-games. Featuring over 20 mini-games filled with catchy music, snappy gameplay and gorgeous, hand-drawn animation, Bits & Bops is sure to brighten your day.

games.name: Berserk or Die
games.summary: This is an action game in which players attempt to survive by defeating a number of enemies which appear from the left and right sides of the screen. Use a unique keyboard-banging control scheme for maximum dopamine! Go Berserk, or Die!

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter
games.summary:
From the makers of HANA, comes a life sim JRPG for Playdate and PC about living in an apartment complex that's infested with monsters.

Use your sick baseball skills to exterminate monsters from your neighbors' apartments as a part-time devil hunter!!

Save up money for convenience store runs, and to pay off your overdue rent!!

CRANK to use the elevator and baseball bat!!

games.name: Anatine
games.summary: Anatine is a pixelated metroidvania game that contains organic musical elements. Play the flute to interact with the environment or unleash powerful magic! In the dangerous world of Avenis, battle against the Eidolons and confront powerful enemies to uncover the many secrets of this lost world.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.summary: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
games.summary: “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe” is a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, peruses antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him for fear of losing your head.

games.name: A Date with Death
games.summary: Fight against and romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a chat simulator visual novel where you date the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through fully voiced video calls.

games.name: 1000 Deaths
games.summary: 1000 Deaths is a 3D adventure platformer about interpersonal conflicts and the effects of the media. Play fast-paced episodes and discover wildly different endings with each play through. Switch perspectives from a pool of eclectic characters, making decisions that you'll take with you to the grave.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: The Brew Barons
games.summary: A tranquil world becomes ever more corrupt by the day, spoiled by a pirate organization that forcefully impose their brewing monopoly over the lands. It's up to you to explore, forage, craft, sell and deliver your brews to overthrow the corrupt pirate organization and restore peace.

games.name: Children's Garden
games.summary: Welcome to a puzzle game where your goal is to guide young souls to peace. Set in Sai no Kawara, a hell for children, you’ll stack the divine toy "Gift" bestowed by the gods. Discover their memories and the stories they left behind.

games.name: Wretch: Divine Ascent
games.summary: A dark fantasy 1v1 auto battler game with 3D action elements inspired by Backpack Battle You have a complete backpack that allows you to purchase various items (equipment, accessories, skills, etc.), creating a powerful build unique to you.

games.name: Steel Knight's Armis
games.summary: "Steel Knight's ARMIS" is a roguelike robot game. Lead the rebellion through five chapters, fighting against the Imperial Army and Earth Federation. Customize and upgrade your robot to survive the intense battles ahead.

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: 10 Seconds Dash!
games.summary: Ten-Second Takeover! is a 2D jumping action game with an extremely short time limit of 10 seconds to enjoy a new sense of tension and achievement. Enjoy the ultimate time limit combined with cute character graphics and fast-paced music.

games.name: 4Dead
games.summary:
The only way to live is to eat!

Control the strongest invincible creature, "No. 42," who dies in 4 seconds, defeat the alien invaders, and survive!

games.name: Colorful Mines =Slide=
games.summary:
"COLORFUL MINES =SLIDE=" is a puzzle game that combines minesweeper and slide puzzle into 3D.

Click "＜" "＞" to slide the colored panels, and clear the stage if all the numbers match the colors and numbers of the surrounding panels.

games.name: Earth Atlantis 2
games.summary: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

games.name: Esophaguys
games.summary: Esophaguys is a silly local multiplayer party game where you play as old folks with elongating necks. Stretch your necks together to find your lost kin and compete against each other for long-necked glory!

games.name: Aksun
games.summary: Aksun is an action roguelite based on Korean shamanism and the afterlife.

games.name: Crazy Sonic
games.summary:
The ultra-fast vehicle you control, CRAZY SONIC, accelerates the more you crank.
Your goal is to reach the finish line within the time limit by dodging obstacles that appear across highway lanes—using lane changes and speed control to your advantage.

games.name: Curtain Drop
games.summary:
This game is played by using the player's hands to create “shadow pictures” on the screen.

Instead of using common input devices such as a controller or mouse, the player actually creates shadow pictures on the screen in real space, and all operations are performed by the shadow pictures. The created shadowgraphs are captured in the game world through the camera and begin to move as characters. Different movement patterns and characteristics are automatically set for each character, and based on their performance, they engage in auto-battles with enemy characters. Character performance is determined based on the shape and size of the base shadowgraph, so the key to the game is how creative you can be in order to create powerful characters.

games.name: Flip Panic!
games.summary: It's a fast-paced, 30-second territory-control action game for up to 4 players, featuring a hand-made game board called the "MatricSwitch". This dazzling board is filled with 256 full-color LED buttons arranged in a 16×16 grid.

games.name: Fragile Hero and the Immortal Frog
games.summary: This is a 2D action game where a high-powered but fragile protagonist teams up with an invincible frog who follows behind.

games.name: I Am a Dorm Resident (but Cat)
games.summary: This is the corridor of a student dormitory with a hundred-year history… and you find yourself sleeping in it. You awaken as a cat, your memories lost. Paws in place of hands, fur covering your face — the only thing you remember is that you were once a resident here. But fortunately, the one you’ve transformed into is ‘Bon’, the dorm cat loved by everyone. Stroll through the corridors, chat with the dorm residents, receive treats, run errands, and when you’re tired, curl up for a nap under the kotatsu. While enjoying this carefree moratorium that only a cat can enjoy, search for the secrets hidden within the dorm and the memories you’ve lost.f

games.name: Hello World: a developer story
games.summary: The developer narrates. The world evolves. The fourth wall breaks. Welcome to Hello World, a charming Narrative Physical Adventure where you play a game as it's being created live.

games.name: KaruQ
games.summary:
Numbered ghosts appear on the screen.
You can defeat them by hitting them with flames of the same number.

Flames can be merged (multiply) or split (divide).
You can also add 1 to a flame using a match.
Use these tricks to create different number flames and take down the ghosts.

games.name: Lexiblocks
games.summary: Lexiblocks is an educational AR game that turns physical wooden blocks into a magical spelling adventure. Kids spell words using real blocks, and the iPad brings them to life through augmented reality.

games.name: Sandbox
games.summary: "Sandbox" is an experimental project that replaces the medium of oil paint with a game engine.

games.name: Thumbylina
games.summary: Thumbylina is a fingertip-sized life simulation game device designed to be your daily companion. When you set a timer during study or exercise, your in-game character joins you in self-improvement—unlocking new outfits and hairstyles as you progress. Unlike smartphone or PC timer apps, Thumbylina is completely offline, allowing you to focus without any distracting notifications.

games.name: Tournamentris
games.summary: This is a new type of merge puzzle game with the theme of ‘tournament table x falling block puzzle’. To clear the rising panels, drop the pieces and stack them to complete the ‘tournament’!

games.name: Rhythm Animal Café
games.summary: Welcome to ​Rhythm Animal Café​! Animals' daily chaos meets funky beats: boss hype, colleague woes, your slacking, unfair blame—all become hilarious one-tap rhythm games! Simple controls, joyful groove. Feel music fuse with daily life’s warmth!

games.name: Cthulhu Kitan: Ryuuguu no Shi The Game - Insuma Machi-hen
games.summary: This is an RPG with a strong story element featuring a unique setting combining the 'Cthulhu Mythos' and Japan's 'Ryugu Legend.' Along with the mysterious three sisters, solve the strange incidents in the mysterious town of 'Insuma Town'!

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratata Arts and TVT have announced Ratatan, a new rhythm action game from the creator of Patapon previously teased as Project JabberWocky.

games.name: Stray
games.summary:
Stray is a third-person cat adventure game set amidst the detailed neon-lit alleys of a decaying cybercity and the murky environments of its seedy underbelly. Roam surroundings high and low, defend against unforeseen threats and solve the mysteries of this unwelcoming place inhabited by nothing but unassuming droids and dangerous creatures.

See the world through the eyes of a stray and interact with the environment in playful ways. Be stealthy, nimble, silly, and sometimes as annoying as possible with the strange inhabitants of this foreign world.

games.name: Inscryption
games.summary: Inscryption is an inky black card-based odyssey that blends the deckbuilding roguelike, escape-room style puzzles, and psychological horror into a blood-laced smoothie. Darker still are the secrets inscrybed upon the cards...

games.name: Cult of the Lamb
games.summary: Cult of the Lamb casts players in the role of a possessed lamb saved from annihilation by an ominous stranger, and must repay their debt by building a loyal following in his name. Start your own cult in a land of false prophets, venturing out into diverse and mysterious regions to build a loyal community of woodland worshippers and spread your Word to become the one true cult.

games.name: Season: A Letter to the Future
games.summary: Close your eyes, take a deep breath and let yourself be carried away by the great journey of Season, a third-person atmospheric adventure bicycle road trip game. Explore the world through the eyes of a young woman. Collect artifacts and memories before a mysterious cataclysm washes everything away.

games.name: GigaBash
games.summary:
GigaBash is a 4 player arena brawler, play from a colorful cast of characters inspired by classic monster tropes, each with their own unique skillset. Rampage around the world in familiar battlegrounds, such as cities & jungles, each with a unique mechanic designed. Transform into an S-class Titan for an epic comeback, or dominate your foes in style with your Ultimate. The game emphasizes on accessibility & pure fun, seeking to unite players on the couch for a casual bash or a competitive brawl.
About th

games.name: Soulvars
games.summary: Get ready to ignite your Soul! Soulvars is a pixel art, turn-based deckbuilding RPG inspired by classic JRPGs with a modern twist. Unravel a dark conspiracy as your party of Soulbearers faces off against invading Dominators in dynamic, action-packed battles.

games.name: Humanity
games.summary: A unique blend of puzzle-solving and action-platforming. Play a lone Shiba Inu charged with commanding massive, marching crowds to the goal in Story Mode, or browse a wide array of user-made levels crafted via the in-game Stage Creator!

games.name: Tchia
games.summary: A tropical open-world adventure. Climb, glide, swim, and sail your boat around a beautiful archipelago in this physics-driven sandbox. Use Tchia's special ability to take control of any animal or object you can find, and Jam on your fully playable Ukulele. A game inspired by New Caledonia.

games.name: A Space for the Unbound
games.summary: A coming-of-age adventure where you follow two high school sweethearts on a journey of self-discovery at the end of their high school years while facing the end of the world. Explore 90s Indonesian town, uncover its secrets, use supernatural powers to dive into people's hearts, and pet cats.

games.name: Oni: Road to be the Mightiest Oni
games.summary:
Break your enemy's heart to reclaim your pride.
Kuuta, a demon, once challenged a man to a battle and was defeated.
At last, he arrives at Kisejima Island. He and his partner Kazemaru, whom he met on the island, overcome their ordeal as one, gaining new strength along the way.
This time, will the duo be able to achieve victory?
Join Kuuta on his adventure to get revenge against Momotaro, a demon masquerading as a man.

games.name: PixelJunk: Scrappers Deluxe
games.summary: Clean up the streets of Junktown as a team of robot garbage collectors. Trash your opponents with up to 4 players or go it alone in this beat ‘em up that’s also a clean ‘em up!

games.name: Nour: Play with Your Food
games.summary: Nour is an experimental food art game designed to make you hungry. Free from the constraints of scores, time limits, and realism, Nour lets you play with your food as if you're a kid again, with no mess to clean up.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge
games.summary: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Shredder's Revenge is a side-scrolling beat 'em up developed by Tribute Games and published by DotEmu. Inspired by the 1987 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles animated series, the game pays homage to classic TMNT titles like Turtles in Time, featuring retro-inspired pixel art and dynamic combat. Players control Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, Raphael, or other allies, each with unique abilities, as they battle through various levels to thwart Shredder and Krang's plans to conquer New York City. The game supports solo play or co-op for up to six players, blending nostalgic design with modern gameplay mechanics.

games.name: TrinityS
games.summary: TrinityS condenses the thrilling elements of MMO RPG endgame encounters into a white-knuckle, "Boss Rush" cooperative online action game for up to three players. Skip the MMO level grind and face off against fearsome foes that require precise coordination to defeat!

games.name: Sky: Children of the Light
games.summary:
"Embark on an unforgettable social adventure and an ever-expanding world.

Sky: Children of the Light is a heartwarming and beautifully animated social adventure experience designed to be played together by you and your loved ones.

Set in a wonderland above the clouds, Sky invites you and your friends to fly up to explore the buried mysteries together and rebuild a fallen kingdom for its ancient inhabitants. Using your courage and compassion, players must connect as a community to share and build on their flame to spread light back into the world."

games.name: Viewfinder
games.summary: Viewfinder is a puzzle game where you can reshape the world around you by taking photos with an instant camera.

games.name: Eternights
games.summary: Eternights is a dating action game where you try to make the most out of life during the apocalypse. Monday: Go on a date. Tuesday: Clear dungeon. Friday: Freak out! The clock is ticking!!

games.name: Away: The Survival Series
games.summary: Inspired by nature documentaries, Away: The Survival Series takes you on the Sugar Glider's breathtaking journey into the wild. As cataclysmic storms bear down on the planet, immerse yourself in nature and explore a vibrant world brimming with life, but beware of the dangers that lie ahead...

games.name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
games.summary: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

games.name: Shibuya Scramble Stories
games.summary:
Game designer and 428: Shibuya Scramble executive producer Jiro Ishii has announced the launch of a new “Shibuya Live-Action Adventure Game.” Led by general director Ishii and screenwriter Yukinori Kitajima, the project will be a live-action adventure game set in Shibuya.
The game itself will use an “ensemble drama” system—a synchronized story with multiple protagonists, in which players experience a multiple-perspective structure that shifts between each character’s viewpoint.

games.name: Live Hard, Die Hard
games.summary: I can't live like this! But, I won't die like this either! Do you want a mix of hard battles and cutting-edge medical treatment?! Then Live Hard, Die Hard is the strategy game for you! Use violence and science to stop the invasion and get those pesky aliens off of our planet!

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: Soma
games.summary:
SOMA is a sci-fi horror game from Frictional Games, the creators of Amnesia: The Dark Descent. It is an unsettling story about identity, consciousness, and what it means to be human.

Enter the world of SOMA and face horrors buried deep beneath the ocean waves. Delve through locked terminals and secret documents to uncover the truth behind the chaos. Seek out the last remaining inhabitants and take part in the events that will ultimately shape the fate of the station. But be careful, danger lurks in every corner: corrupted humans, twisted creatures, insane robots, and even an inscrutable omnipresent A.I. You will need to figure out how to deal with each one of them. Just remember there’s no fighting back, either you outsmart your enemies or you get ready to run.

games.name: Roombattle
games.summary:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.

Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

games.name: Espina
games.summary: Enter Rose, a brave young rebel battling her way through a deadly sci-fi megastructure in search of her missing sister. Dive into fast-paced, thug-filled hack-and-slash action, explore a bold, clichéd world, and embark on a rebellion fuelled by mystery, momentum, and emotion.

games.name: Inorbs
games.summary: A narrative adventure about grief and forging new bonds in a universe of magical stones and light.

games.name: Botsu
games.summary: Fight your friends in hilarious sandbox sports: Boxball, Sumo Survival, and Stockpile. Wrestle your way to victory online or split-screen in unique matches. Unlock outrageous outfits and pull off awesome moves to flex your skills!

games.name: Skate Story
games.summary: Ollie, kickflip, and grind your way through the ash and smoke of the Underworld as you take on a seemingly impossible quest. Skate fast to destroy demons and save other tortured souls on your journey from a fragile beginner to a hardened skater.

games.name: Ball x Pit
games.summary: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite where you battle hordes of monstrous enemies with your arsenal of ricocheting balls.

games.name: Forestrike
