games.summary: Forestrike is a tactical kung-fu fighting game with a supernatural twist. Use your 'foresight' ability to visualize fights before they happen and hone your skills then rumble in reality, where defeat means starting over from scratch.

games.name: Baby Steps
games.summary: Play as Nate, an unemployed failson with nothing going for him, until one day he discovers a power he never knew he had… putting one foot in front of the other. Explore a world shrouded in mist, one step at a time. Hike the serene mountains by placing each footstep yourself, in original physics-based gameplay from the minds behind Ape Out and Getting Over It. Take in the sights, fall in love with the local fauna, and try to find meaning in a wasted life.

games.name: Possessor(s)
games.summary:
Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

Play as Luca, the host, and Rehm, her less-than-cooperative counterpart, as they explore a quarantined city ripped apart and flooded by an interdimensional catastrophe. Their only hope of survival is by learning to co-exist.

Possessor(s) takes place across the interconnected sprawl of a destroyed mega-city, from collapsed skyscrapers to an abandoned aquarium, all riddled with secrets. Hauntingly beautiful 3D environments form a stunning backdrop over which hand-drawn and animated characters, and mysterious sci-fi horror action take center stage.

Choose multiple paths in an open-ended world structure as you look to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Meet a cast of engaging characters, each with their own heart-breaking story to follow in the aftermath of the devastation.

Gameplay is centered around tight, fast-paced platforming with a range of unique movement abilities that extends to its tense, precise, combat. Balance ground and air attacks, replete with combos and juggles as you encounter a variety of deadly enemies and challenging bosses. Find and unlock a wide array of powerful weapons and upgrades to bolster your arsenal and explore previously inaccessible areas.

games.name: Dimension Ascent
games.summary: A puzzle action platformer where shifting your perspective lets you cross dimensions! Use the “Eyes that See the World” to uncover hidden truths.

games.name: Harma
games.summary: Harma began with the belief of humans overcoming hardships. We have created an immensely challenging strategic card game that befits this theme. If you are someone who doesn't shy away from life's trials and faces them head-on, this game is for you.

games.name: Doomed Otaku
games.summary: "Real friends exist in the online world!" The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

games.name: Monowave
games.summary: Monowave is a whimsical puzzle-adventure platformer about the transformative power of emotions. Explore beautiful landscapes and empathize with its quirky denizens to restore harmony in an emotionally turbulent universe.

games.name: Module:Berserk
games.summary: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

games.name: Staffer Retro
games.summary: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

games.name: Bakudo
games.summary: Bakudo is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite Bakudo academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

games.name: Anthem#9
games.summary: Combine Gems to unleash Skills in ANTHEM#9, a deck-building rogue-lite puzzle-battler! Customize your Recipes for a wide variety of deck ideas, and explore the thrilling story of secret agents fighting for world order.

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: No Straight Roads 2
games.summary: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

games.name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Unyielder
games.summary: Unyielder is an intense Boss-Rush Movement-Shooter with a flexible and exploitable Roguelite-Looter sandbox. Carve your way through the war-torn lands of Antarctica, Hunt down war machines and Assemble your arsenal of destruction.

games.name: Faith: The Unholy Trinity
games.summary: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, insane cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Scare" of the 1980s.

games.name: The Sandbox
games.summary: The Sandbox is a community-driven metaverse where players can build, own, and monetize their experiences. Originally launched on Ethereum, the platform has now migrated to Polygon (POL), bringing faster transactions and lower fees. Create voxel-based worlds, design interactive games, and trade digital assets using $SAND, the utility token powering this ever-evolving virtual universe.

games.name: Gotta Protectors: Cart of Darkness
games.summary: Protect the Princess, Smash Castles, and Pulverize Foes. Will You Be the First to Collect All 948 Game Carts?

games.name: Ouritsu Anapoko Gakuen
games.summary:
Ouritsu Anapoko Gakuen is a scenario-style RPG following adventuring students over the course of three years before they graduate the academy.

Royal Anapoko Academy sees players controlling a four-person party a seamlessly transitioning between exploration and combat. Players need to strategically use skills that hinder enemies, taking advantage of access to a special command that lets them see the enemies’ upcoming actions.

games.name: ShapeHero Factory
games.summary: ShapeHero Factory is a game that fuses the factory simulation, roguelite, and tower defense genres. Use different shape combinations to mass-produce a variety of heroes, who will then fight all on their own. All you need to worry about is building the optimal factory to manufacture them.

games.name: AK-xolotl: Together
games.summary: The cutest, deadliest top-down roguelike shooter featuring AK-wielding Axolotls. Blast your way through the animal kingdom with an arsenal of kick-ass guns, mighty power-ups and even raise an army of trigger-happy baby axolotls. Double the firepower! Local co-op update now live!

games.name: Hyper Light Drifter: Special Edition
games.summary:
The wait is over, the worldwide acclaimed game Hyper Light Drifter is finally here with this impressive Special Edition!

Runs at 60fps, includes new exclusive content and all the previously released remastered for a perfectly inmersive gaming experience to play anywhere.

Explore a beautiful, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers and lost technologies. Echoes of a dark and violent past resonate throughout a savage land, steeped in treasure and blood. Hyper Light Drifter is an action adventure RPG in the vein of the best 16­bit classics, with modernized mechanics and designs on a much grander scale.

games.name: One Military Camp
games.summary: Build and manage your own military camp, enrol the best recruits, set the training courses and finally send them on dangerous missions to win the war. But becoming a Military Tycoon also means improving your financial skills, so don’t forget to make your academy a profitable business.

games.name: Citadelum
games.summary: Citadelum is a city builder set in legendary Ancient Rome. Build your own settlement, gather resources and evolve it into a magnificent city. Explore the world, trade and lead your mighty legions in epic tactical battles. Earn the favor of the Gods or challenge them, if you dare.

games.name: Anoxia Station
games.summary: After a supervolcano eruption, Earth has become uninhabitable and humanity is on the brink of extinction. We need to go underground. Anoxia Station is a dark strategy game in which you manage a mining station and fight for survival, extract resources and take life or death decisions over your crew.

games.name: Amnesia: The Bunker
games.summary: Amnesia: The Bunker is a first-person horror game set in a desolate WW1 Bunker. Face the oppressing terrors stalking the dark corridors. Search for and use the tools and weapons at your disposal, while keeping the lights on at all costs. Overcome fear, persevere, and make your way out alive.

games.name: Maldita Castilla EX: Collector's Edition
games.summary:
The tears of a young witch have been turned by a demon into a key that opens up a gateway for the evil in this world. The King Alfonso VI of León has gathered his loyal knights to get to Tolomera del Rey and finish the nightmare using the power of the Witch’s tears. Banish the zombies and demons that entered the Kingdom of Castile with Don Ramiro, the loyal King’s Knight, and his friends. For that, you will use a different range of weapons to defeat your enemies through the cursed lands of Tolomera, in a pure classic arcade action style.

The Cursed Castilla EX: Collector's Edition includes:
- Cursed Castilla physical game for the Nintendo Switch
- Reversible cover
- Full-color game manual
- Complete original soundtrack
- Arcade cut-out with 3D screen
- Revised "Making Of" book
- Keychain
- Sticker

games.name: A Farewell To AI
games.summary:
In a future where drawing is forbidden, your lines move the story.

A new experience awaits: an AI × drawing × visual novel adventure that brings your creativity to life.

games.name: Never Grave: The Witch and the Curse
games.summary: A Metroidvania x Roguelite, where you advance using a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Dead Take
games.summary: Find your missing friend. Uncover the secrets within. Brave a luxurious and haunting mansion in Dead Take, a first-person psychological horror crafted by Surgent Studios.

games.name: Vivid World
games.summary: A follow-up to the hit game Vivid Knight, Vivid World is a completely new party-building, roguelike strategy game! Our story takes place in the Netherworld, a land ruled by demons. Utilize and master our protagonist, Lemuria's new Jewel Magic to conquer strange dungeons.

games.name: Castle & Dragon
games.summary: Castle defense and variety of cute monsters to use. It has online multi-play function up to 3 players.

games.name: Kill The Shadow
games.summary: In an alternate post-war divided city, players take on the role of Detective Lucas. Use your eloquence, intelligence, the ability to rewind time (or even violence) to investigate and deduce various bizarre cases, unraveling a shocking secret behind them. Justice or love? The decision is yours.

games.name: BrokenLore: Low
games.summary: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

games.name: Hololive Treasure Mountain
games.summary: Stack the Love of Captain Marin! A Simple yet Exciting 3D Physics Puzzle Game!

games.name: Twilight Monk
games.summary: Explore the shattered world of Speria as the last remnant of ancient Kung Fu warriors in Twilight Monk! Destroy demons, or enslave them as you hunt down and obliterate the portals from whence they came. In Twilight Monk, you will explore Metroidvania dungeons connected by an open world.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Dreams of Another
games.summary: Dreams of Another is a third-person exploration-action game built around the philosophical theme, “No Creation Without Destruction.” Rather than destroying objects by shooting—as in traditional shooting games—here, your shots materialize and create the world. This unconventional mechanic offers a gameplay experience that challenges the norms of the genre and invites players into a whole new dimension.

games.name: Majogami
games.summary: The sword fighter Shiroha cleaves through a twisted world with her high-speed Setsuna, facing off against the powerful witches in her way, in 2D paper craft character action. Paper craft character action! Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.

games.name: BrokenLore: Unfollow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.

games.name: Kuukiyomi: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.
games.summary: Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Thailand! Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.

games.name: HoloReversi
games.summary: Experience a New Twist on Reversi with Hololive Members! Use original stacking mechanics and Hololive member skills to enjoy strategic battles! Take on intense CPU matches or online battles for the ultimate brain challenge!

games.name: Boku no Natsuyasumi
games.summary: The game revolves around Boku, a 9 year old boy sent to his aunt and uncle in Japan's wooded countryside and the daily adventures he encounters there. Boku is there because his Mother is in her final month of pregnancy. The player controls him for the 31 days of August 1975 (In Japan, a Summer Vacation, called natsuyasumi last for one month). You explore the game's area and can catch bugs and pit them against each other, collect bottle caps, fly a kite, or just relax.

games.name: Boku no Natsuyasumi 2: Umi no Bouken-hen
games.summary:
Boku no Natsuyasumi 2: Umi no Bouken-hen is the sequel to Boku no Natsuyasumi and has a similar concept. The nine-year-old city boy Boku once again spends his summer vacation in the countryside in 1975. It is a alternate universe sequel where the character spends his vacation with his family in a different location, but still meets many characters from the first game. The sequel is set in a Japanese southern coastal town on the tropical Izu Peninsula where his aunt and uncle have a bed and breakfast.

The game consists of fixed screen, pre-rendered environments with 3D models and a cinematic camera with a different viewpoint for each scene. Boku's vacation only lasts 31 days, but the player is free to choose how to spend his time as it is presented as a sandbox environment. It is possible to seek quests and help the people in town to solve their problems, but he can also choose to ride his bike anywhere, go bughunting, spend time fishing, dive into the ocean, launch a rocket, go on walk, play hide and seek, or play a mini-game of beetle wrestling. Many scenes offer interaction for the sake of exploration, with no further purpose. Time advances when a new scene is entered, so it is not possible to complete all content in a single playthrough.

games.name: Psychic 5
games.summary: A platform game that allows players to choose between five unique characters.

games.name: Esper Boukentai
games.summary: Esper Boukentai is a platform action game developed by Jaleco for the Famicom and published in 1987. It is an exploration game which uses Jaleco's arcade game Psychic 5 as the basis for the story and the cast of characters which you use throughout the game. Each character possesses different attributes, including their jumping ability, their ability to hover in mid-air, and their strength. As in the arcade, some characters must be rescued in order to make them playable. This game boasts over 50 household items which serve as animated enemies throughout each level.

games.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid
games.summary: Natsu-Mon! 20-seiki no Natsu-yasumi is an adventure game where you spend a summer as a boy. Catch insects, fish, swim in the sea, and interact with the towns people. You can also travel to neighboring towns by train and participate in festivals at night. By experiencing various things, the things you can do and the places you can go will expand.

games.name: Attack of the Friday Monsters! A Tokyo Tale
games.summary:
Step into the life of Sohta, the young son of a family that has just set up a dry cleaners shop in the idyllic town of Fuji no Hana. In his interactions with the town's unique residents, episodic mysteries are revealed that portend to the strange events surrounding the appearance of a giant monster every Friday. And finally, when Friday evening falls, the giant monster will appear right before your eyes!

Collect the "Monster Glims" scattered around town to form Monster Cards, and once you've collected five cards, Sohta can battle his friends for dominance. Winning at Monster Cards gives you the chance to collect useful information, more Monster Glims, and even to cast a secret spell on your friends that will make them fall down at your whim. Why? Because that's the rules!

A touching drama about family, friendship, and the innocence of being a child unfolds against hand-drawn backgrounds, charming music, and memorable characters.

games.name: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid Sunset Bundle
games.summary: Natsu-Mon: 20th Century Summer Kid DLC Bundle includes the main game and DLC.

games.name: Shin-chan: Shiro and the Coal Town
games.summary: Shin chan starts a mysterious daily routine, traveling between two worlds: the Village in Akita and Coal Town.

games.name: Shin-chan: Me and the Professor on Summer Vacation - The Endless Seven-Day Journey
games.summary: The Nohara family has decided to spend their summer vacation in Kumamoto. A week of life begins in the small town of Asso. Surrounded by abundant nature, you can catch rare insects, catch fish in nearby streams, and pick up wild plants. You can also record the fun events in a picture diary every day.

games.name: Henry Halfhead
games.summary: Meet Henry, merely half a head, but with the peculiar ability to possess and control any object within their reach. Discover every object's unique properties and abilities and cleverly combine them to progress through Henry’s not-so-ordinary everyday life.

games.name: Digital Exorcist
games.summary:
While everyone is celebrating the coming of the new year 1999, retired Digital Exorcist Sawyer and his computerized partner Tomodachi run into a grisly scene that will make this jaded investigator remember all the old techniques he learned at the agency.

Travel into a world where cyberdemons live all around us in this Adventure Game/Visual Novel inspired by Snatcher and The Silver Case. Do you have what it takes to become a Digital Exorcist?

games.name: Fantasketch
games.summary: "Fantasketch" is a new kind of puzzle action game where the characters you draw come to life and move! Control your character and aim for the goal!

games.name: Monster Create
games.summary:
With our uniquely developed character editor, you can freely attach various parts such as face parts and body parts!
You can easily create your own monster!
Finally, give it a nice name and you're done! “Life” dwells and begins to move!

games.name: Super Nodage Game Maker
games.summary: In this game, you can easily create your own original "Noda game" just by answering questions from Noda AI!

games.name: Momo Crash
games.summary: This game is a rhythm action game in which the player purifies souls by pinching them with girls' thighs! The player controls the thighs and pinches the flowing souls in rhythm. Let's purify souls by pinching them with thighs in rhythm! Let's Paradise!

games.name: GilGul
games.summary: Why Do People Want to Die? Why Don't People Want to Die? This is a story about a group of girls in a world that exists in limbo between life and death. Embark on a dramatic real-time tactical adventure.

games.name: Twin Soul
games.summary: Dive into Twin Soul, a music action game set in a world inspired by ancient myths. You'll journey through different areas, facing off against powerful gods to clear stages. You will experience the story from two perspectives as you uncover the contrasting paths of our two heroes.

games.name: Lumines Arise
games.summary: A mind-blowing, fiendishly addictive reinvention of the puzzle classic Lumines from the creators of Tetris Effect: Connected, where sound pulses through your body, mind, and every block you place, triggering dazzling visuals synched to the driving beat of an infectious, eclectic soundtrack.

games.name: Lumines
games.summary:
Lumines is a block-dropping game, that may seem at first to be similar to Columns and Tetris. A 2 x 2 square (an O tetromino) made of four smaller block pieces is dropped into the playing field, which may appear different as the player advances through levels or skins. The small blocks that comprise the larger blocks will be one of two different colors. The objective is to rotate and align the blocks in such a way as to create 2x2 squares of the same color, which may span multiple blocks and, indeed, share blocks. For example, if one should get a 2x3 area of matching blocks, the middle portion will "share" itself with both the left and right halves and create two 2x2 squares. After the "timeline", which is synchronized to the music, sweeps over the matching blocks, they disappear. When too many unmatched blocks pile up to the point where no more blocks may be dropped in the playing field, the game ends.
When part of a falling block hits an obstruction, the unobstructed portion of the block will split off and continue to fall. More points are scored by creating the largest number of squares during one "timeline" sweep. Increasing score multipliers are earned by repeatedly clearing squares on consecutive timeline sweeps. Bonuses are also awarded by reducing all remaining tiles to one single color or for removing all non-active tiles from the screen altogether.
Occasionally, a block falls with a special square of one of the two colors with a "jewel" in the center. This square, when cleared as part of a matched 2x2 square, will cause all individual blocks of the same color that are horizontally or vertically adjacent to the matched 2x2 square, or to an adjacent square, to be cleared without score. These can be used for both generating large bonuses, since generally several blocks of the other color will be formed once these are removed, as well as to help the player recover if the field becomes too cluttered.

games.name: Lumines II
games.summary:
The gameplay in Lumines II is very similar to its predecessor, Lumines. The object is still to move blocks of four different colored squares across the board; while trying to create a single square of the same color. This all must be done before a "timeline" crosses the screen deleting the squares that you make. Deleting four or more squares will add a bonus multiplier to your score. (Refer to the Gameplay section of Lumines for more details).
There is no Infrastructure gameplay in Lumines II. The game is visually similar to Lumines Live! and the PC port of Lumines during both gameplay and in the menus.

games.name: Lumines Supernova
games.summary: In January 2009 Lumines Supernova was released on the PlayStation Network. It has all the features of Lumines Live! (with the exception of online multiplayer) as well as the sequencer from Lumines II and a new mode, DigDown Mode. DigDown Mode is a timed mode where the player has to clear two vertical lines within a time limit to move "down" to the next stage.

games.name: Lumines Electronic Symphony
games.summary:
Lumines Electronic Symphony uses the new features of the PlayStation Vita such as the touch pad on the back, while keeping classic controls already known in the first Lumines on the front.
Lumines Electronic Symphony now uses animated 3D blocks instead of 2D sprites. The game will use the front touch screen controls to move and rotate blocks but will also support analog and D-pad controls.
In previous Lumines titles, a player unlocked skins based on their ability to successfully reach that skin. However, in Lumines Electronic Symphony, an experience point system has been integrated. Now all the points that a player receives in a session are converted into XP, so as the player levels up, additional skins and avatars will be unlocked.
Each avatar has a single player and multiplayer ability mapped to them. Players unlock more avatars and find the abilities that best suit their style of play.
Q Entertainment enlisted the design firm, BUILD (which was founded by former Designers Republic and Psygnosis members), to create much of the game's marketing materials, such as the new logo, in-game font, and graphic elements for the package design.

games.name: Hirogami
games.summary: Explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. Embark on a mystical journey to save your fragile home from deadly digital invaders. Take on animal forms to traverse the landscape, solve puzzles, overcome enemies, and save the realm.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

games.name: Cold Abyss
games.summary: COLD ABYSS is a relaxing and atmospheric exploration game where you repair internet cables on the bottom of the ocean.There are no enemies or other forms of danger down there. Just you.

games.name: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek
games.summary:
"It's time to take on those monsters!"
Can you escape? Or will you hunt humans as a monster?

games.name: Sky the Scraper
games.summary: This is a building cleaning Roguelike action game, about a young man named Sky, who chases uncertain dreams as a building cleaner. Conquer thrilling randomly changing high-rise stages, upgrade skills and gear with your money and will, and find your path within a two-month limit.

games.name: Poppy Playtime Triple Pack
games.summary: ﻿THREE GAMES IN 1 PACK! Embark on an epic journey filled with mystery, puzzles, eerie environments and the most terrifying toy characters to ever come to life. Over a decade ago, all the employees of Playtime Co. mysteriously vanished, except for you. You must return and discover what really happened at the now abandoned factory of the most popular toy company in history. But beware the toys are now alive, and they may not be as friendly as they seem. Take your first steps into Playtime Co. with the first 3 chapters in the Poppy Playtime saga! Chapter 1: A Tight Squeeze - Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility...and don't get caught. Chapter 2: Fly in a Web - Descend deeper into the toy factory where mind-numbing puzzles and horrific toys await. Grapple and swing your way to safety. Try to escape - and don't let Mommy find you. Chapter 3: Deep Sleep - A decrepit orphanage known as Playcare sits beneath the once magical toy factory. You must make your way through this frightening place, solving new puzzles and avoiding the nightmares that lurk within the dark. Answers lie between the puzzles, characters and clues you encounter...If you can survive.

games.name: No Door Can Not be Opened with a Non-black Key
games.summary: A world constructed with sentences. 2D action puzzle game where you get keys, open doors and clear stages by rewriting sentences and altering rules by adding and subtracting the word ‘Nai(no/non/not)’.

games.name: Starbites
games.summary: The story of a girl's growth and adventure on a vast desert planet, "Bitter."

games.name: Phantom Squad
games.summary: As a team of 2-4 players, communicate, plan, execute and improvise to succeed in this online coop, fast-paced, brutal top-down shooter where tactics are as crucial as skill.

games.name: Nano Neighbors
games.summary: An online idle game that brings life to the bottom of your screen with friendly androids called NANOs. Customise your NANOs, choose their occupation, build and design their perfect home, and invite your friends' NANOs over to hang out, join mini-activities, and interact.

games.name: Greedland
games.summary: Welcome to Greedland, an exhilarating top-down shooter where you play as an interstellar mercenary. Battle through ever-changing environments and annihilate waves of enemies. If you enjoy the action-packed gameplay of Crimsonland and Vampire Survivors, Greedland is the perfect game for you!

games.name: I Am Legion: Stand Survivors
games.summary: Summon your stands and brawl it out! Dive into the thrill of mowing down enemies, synthesizing and upgrading, mining, forging gear, unlocking new characters and equipment. Discover unique stands combos and craft your own battle style to break through the chaos!

games.name: Townseek
games.summary:
Townseek is a relaxing exploration-trading game where you embark on a journey across the world of Explora and discover the lost legacy of Sir Reginald Sharkingston! Discover exotic landmarks, trade with faraway towns, fish, mine, and farm as you complete your journal and make a name for yourself!

The whole world is your sea now, so be sure to see all that it has to offer!

games.name: I Hate this Place
games.summary: A craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality. Scavenge and build to survive terrifying days and nights while using stealth and noise to fight enemies that stalk by sound. All styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe.

games.name: Fischer's Fishing Journey
games.summary: Put Fischer on your desktop as your ultimate study and work buddy. He'll fish quietly in the corner, taking care of it all—you just drop in occasionally to collect your rewards, unlock new fish, upgrade your rod, while enjoying that calming, healing atmosphere.

games.name: High on Life 2
games.summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: Let Them Trade
games.summary: Build a network of cities that produce and trade resources, upgrade your castle, and protect the cities from cheeky bandits.Tinker with the economy at your own pace, and watch the charming wooden world grow into a lively and thriving kingdom.

games.name: Gecko Gods
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island as a tiny lizard. Complete ancient puzzles, effortlessly climb cliffs, and eat bugs as you make your way across an island civilization lost to time.

games.name: Vivid Knight
games.summary: Vivid Knight is a roguelike adventure game in which you save your friends from being turned into jewels and combine their abilities to form the ultimate party! Explore an ever-changing dungeon and harness the jewels you collect to defeat the Black Witch!

games.name: HoloParade
games.summary: Collect your favorite characters, nurture them, and have fun just watching in this hololive fan game! It's a 2D tower defense game that offers depth for dedicated players, strategic elements, and easy enjoyment for casual players.

games.name: Flare Nuinui Quest
games.summary: Nuinui quest is a Mega Man style platformer featuring Shiranui Flare and various other Hololive characters.

games.name: Blindfold
games.summary: A first-person horror game that uses a webcam to recognize your face. The goal is to escape from the monsters by using a system that closes your eyelids in the game when you close your eyes in real life.

games.name: Yoshimi-kun wa Game Bakkari
games.summary: A romance simulation game where you connect with a classmate you're interested in and build a relationship through online gaming. You can use your PC camera to video call Yoshimi-kun.

games.name: Yaoyoro Zoo
games.summary:
Remote-control bats, toolbox hippos, clock owls... familiar items have transformed into adorable yet strange animals called ""Fanimals,"" living freely and happily!

Your mission as a caretaker is to deliver food to these Fanimals.

Navigate through 2D stages created within rooms, solve puzzles, and reach the food box.

games.name: Super Hydorah: Collector's Edition
games.summary:
An evil force has launched an invasion over the Omios star! Fly with the space fleet in a campaign to liberate planets, destroy enemy bases and discover the mysterious force behind the attack. Biomechanical enemies, space creatures, exotic planets and climatic threats are waiting for you, so select a route, equip your ship and prepare to die!

The Collector's Edition includes:
- Physical copy of Super Hydorah for Switch with reversible cover
- Super Hydorah Game Manual
- Super Hydorah Complete Original Soundtrack
- Arcade Cut-Out
- Super Hydorah "Making Of" Book
- Super Hydorah Keychain
- Omios Star and the Juggernaut Mother Ship Sticker

games.name: Dream Mayday
games.summary: You are "Dream Supporters" — protectors of dreams. Working together from two perspectives — dream and reality — you must ensure the peaceful sleep of residents through cooperative gameplay. Don’t miss any signs of disturbance, and team up to deliver a perfect night's rest by 9:00 AM!

games.name: Wa-shoi! Kamiokoshi
games.summary: A 2D action game in which you use the two sticks on your controller to send the mikoshi into the sky in order to wake up the lazy god inside the mikoshi. Send the mikoshi flying, add up your score, and reach the target line to reach the goal!

games.name: Tobenai Koi ha Tada no Koi
games.summary: Control the carp and send it flying high into the sky! Control the Koi that swims automatically with one-button operation. Use fish in the water and birds in the air to reach higher!

events.name: The Secret Sauce Showcase 2025
events.description: Welcome to the SECRET SAUCE SHOWCASE! Expect 40+ brand new trailers for some of the coolest, cutest, weirdest, and [redacted] games ever. Plus, tune in to see exclusive behind-the-scenes dev diaries sharing some extra info on the talented devs behind some of the featured games.

games.name: Alabaster Dawn
games.summary: Break Nyx’s curse and guide humanity's rebirth in this top-down 2.5D Action RPG from the creators of CrossCode. Battle enemies with stylish combos, wield multiple divine weapons, solve intriguing puzzles and explore a changing world.

games.name: Neon Inferno
games.summary: NYC 2055: a city beyond salvation. Blast your way through this dense cyberpunk jungle in NEON INFERNO, an explosive fusion of 2D run-and-gun and gallery-shooter, and help the Family dominate its streets!

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Explore the open seas and uncover the kingdom's dark secrets as you expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear every step of the way!

games.name: Berserk B.I.T.S
games.summary:
Train and level up your B.I.T.S (Battle.Intelligent.Teammate.System). Team up with your digital buddy collect battle chips and take on the internet. Battle viruses explore new biomes and defeat powerful bosses!

Berserk B.I.T.S is an idle-rpg, auto-battler, chip-collecting game that runs on your desktop alongside your other applications. Re-position the game so you can comfortably work and monitor the progress of your B.I.T or minimize it completely and let it go in the background!

Collect and craft a plethora of battle chips to be used in real-time during battle. Each battle chip is placed in an ever growing library that you can strive to fill out. Get medals for completing tasks or kick back and spend time decorating your perfect HOME NET.

Level up your B.I.T by dropping them on a mission and taking on the internet, exploring different biomes! Be involved and monitor their battles and use battle chips you've collected in real time and help your B.I.T succeed - or sit back and relax, work on other tasks while you send your B.I.T to handle business!

games.name: GigaSword
games.summary: An action-puzzle metroidvania in which you wield a huge, heavy sword

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: MycoRelic
games.summary: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on an island inhabited by tribal robots. Raid derelict foundries and ancient temples to upgrade your body, gaining forgotten powers. Wield elemental magic to trigger powerful reactions or fight with melee and ranged weapons in dynamic combat.

games.name: Band of Crusaders
games.summary: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Angeline Era
games.summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

games.name: The Lacerator
games.summary: A mix of classic survival horror and trash movies, play as an 80's porn actor and beware of every corner because you can get Lacerator and lose a limb in real time... But you can still adapt and survive.

games.name: Verho: Curse of Faces
games.summary: Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude, where masks have become the only protection against the Curse of Faces. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: White Knuckle
games.summary: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Arsonate
games.summary: Outwit the HOST in a death game where fire spreads with each flip of a card. Be the last to burn. Do you fear death?

games.name: Gangstalk
games.summary: GANGSTALK is a psychological horror game from the POV of your stalkers.

games.name: DarkwebStreamer
games.summary: You? An occult streamer on an alternate 90s internet. Your goal? Become #1. The problem? The supernatural is REAL. Manage your stream, do weird rituals, make weird friends and experience a different story every time in this procedurally-generated psycho-horror RPG streaming sim.

games.name: Exark
games.summary: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Future Vibe Check
games.summary: Future Vibe Check is a musical automation game where your factories don’t just produce goods—they make music. Summoned by Infinity, you must rebuild reality. The call of endless optimization will be sublimated into sound. Automate the Vibe. Defend the Vibe. Become the Vibe.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Lost Twins 2
games.summary: A cute puzzle-platformer with a unique mechanic of moving the world itself to create new paths. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op mode to help Ben & Abi navigate this mysterious world. Engage in clever puzzles & overcome obstacles to help them re-unite & find their way back home

games.name: Curiosmos
games.summary: Curiosmos is a whimsical cosmic sandbox game where you build your own solar system by hand, crafting planets, moons, gravity, atmosphere, and even life! Embark on a quest to discover the secrets of the universe!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.summary: Discover the stories of kids growing up in the midst of armed conflicts over the last three decades. Inspired by real testimonies, this narrative adventure follows the lives of children from Bosnia, Syria, and Ukraine.

games.name: Gemporium
games.summary: Mine, Refine and Sell Gemstones of various rarities to eagerly awaiting customers in Gemporium, a casual mining simulation management game. Keep your finances in check as you juggle a growing gem emporium while simultaneously paying off a generational debt. There's only so much time in the day!

games.name: The Royal Writ
games.summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

games.name: Montabi
games.summary: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: My Card Is Better Than Your Card!
games.summary: Become the coolest kid of the playground in this playful roguelike deckbuilder. Craft every card yourself with adorable stickers and wow your rivals in tug-of-war card battles full of wonder!

games.name: Mars Attracts
games.summary: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

games.name: Bytebond
games.summary: Bond with your friend and become a part of the Antivirus Special Forces as you head to the heart of the PC. Solve electrifying puzzles to regain control over the infected CPU.

games.name: The Art of Reflection
games.summary: The Art of Reflection is a first-person puzzle game where you traverse mirrors as if they were natural extensions of space. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and perform gravity-shifting acrobatics through a sprawling environment as you learn to navigate this world with mastery.

games.name: Rivals of Aether II
games.summary: Rivals of Aether II is the sequel to the hit indie fighting game, Rivals of Aether. Play as both new and returning elemental fighters in the next generation of platform fighters.

games.name: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime
games.summary: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.

games.name: Aethermancer
games.summary: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins. Plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles utilizing the four elements of Aether. Watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

games.name: Sledding Game
games.summary: Sledding Game is a cozy, online multiplayer game about sledding, relaxing, and hanging out with your friends.

games.name: Voyagers of Nera
games.summary: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative seafaring survival-crafting game for up to 10 players. Sail across a magical ocean world, skim along the waves, and protect lost nature spirits from monsters emerging from the depths.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Battle Suit Aces
games.summary: Lead a plucky crew against a star-consuming threat in this charming character-driven, card battling RPG. Brought to you by the creators of the award-winning Battle Chef Brigade, recruit ace pilots, upgrade their mecha Battle Suits, grow meaningful friendships and captain your personalized adventure.

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Stretchmancer
games.summary: STRETCH THE WORLD, SAVE THE GALAXY! In this smartly funny First Person Puzzler, you are THE STRETCHMANCER. Squash and stretch your environment to solve fiendish puzzles and defeat the Claustro Empire... in an epic voice-acted adventure inspired by 90s Saturday Morning Cartoons!

events.name: New Super Mario Bros. Modding Direct 2025
events.description: Welcome to the 2025 Modding Direct! A presentation of brand new trailers and previews for mods of New Super Mario Bros. Wii.

games.name: New Super Mario Bros.: Burning Ice
Super Mario and the Starry Skies
NSMBW Superstar Mode
games.summary: NSMBW Superstar Mode is a mod that aims to make NSMBW more challenging while offering a creative and new feel to the game. This mod is in development and only a demo has been released so far.

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii: New Horizons
Mayro's Heart Throbbing Adventure Wii Ultimate
Super Mario and the SkyStar Dreams
Pokémon Go
games.summary: Pokémon Go is an augmented reality mobile game that uses GPS to let players locate, capture, train, and battle Pokémon in real-world locations. Players explore their physical surroundings to find PokéStops for items, battle at Gyms for team control, participate in Raid Battles cooperatively, and compete in the Go Battle League's player-versus-player format. The game is free-to-play with in-app purchases and features Pokémon from across multiple generations of the franchise.

games.name: Pokémon Masters EX
games.summary: Pokémon Masters EX (originally named Pokémon Masters) is a free-to-play mobile game for Android and iOS developed and published by DeNA. It is based on the Pokémon media franchise. Set on the artificial island of Pasio, the game allows players to battle and recruit various prominent Pokémon Trainers from the main series games. Originally named Pokémon Masters and released in August 2019, it was renamed Pokémon Masters EX in August 2020 on the 1st anniversary of the game.

games.name: Pokémon Café ReMix
games.summary:
Link together Pokémon icons to clear puzzles as you work to build up your very own café in Pokémon Café ReMix, a free-to-start game for Nintendo Switch systems! Recruit Pokémon to help out at the café (in their stylish uniforms) by building friendships while expanding your café and menu offerings by completing puzzles. Each Pokémon staff member has a Café Skill that will come in handy solving puzzles!

Complete touch-based challenges in this free-to-start puzzle game

Strategize the best way to clear Pokémon icons within the turn limit in adorable-yet-challenging puzzles. Use your puzzle skills to complete the objective and employ the help of every Pokémon’s Café Skills for some extra oomph! In addition to Café Skills, each Pokémon staff member has a specialty and specialty gimmicks they can destroy with ease—Eevee can make quick work of sugar cubes, for example. Match a Pokémon’s specialty with the drink or dish you’re making to get bonuses in puzzles.

Remixed fun for everyone

Pokémon Café ReMix is a revamped version of the original Pokémon Café Mix game. Puzzles have been refreshed and there are even more Pokémon to discover and recruit. Your Pokémon may outfit themselves in café chic with newly added dress-up options and can improve their abilities through training puzzles! If you’ve played the original, your golden acorns will all transfer over to Pokémon Café ReMix.

games.name: Pokémon Sleep
games.summary: A sleep-tracking game that allows you to attract Pokémon that match your sleeping style.

games.name: Pokémon Unite
games.summary:
Team up and take down the opposition in Pokémon’s first 5-on-5 strategic team battle game!

Join Trainers from around the world as they head for Aeos Island to compete in Unite Battles! In Unite Battles, Trainers face off in 5-on-5 team battles to see who can score the most points within the allotted time. Teamwork is key as you and your teammates defeat wild Pokémon, level up, evolve your own Pokémon, and work to prevent the opposing team from scoring points. Put your teamwork to the test, and take home the win!

games.name: Pokémon Friends
games.summary: Solve brainteasing puzzles and make in-game Pokémon plush with Pokémon Friends, available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and iOS and Android devices.

games.name: Pokémon Scarlet
games.summary:
The Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet games, the newest chapters in the Pokémon series, are coming to Nintendo Switch later this year. With these new titles, the Pokémon series takes a new evolutionary step, allowing you to explore freely in a richly expressed open world.

Various towns blend seamlessly into the wilderness with no borders. You’ll be able to see the Pokémon of this region in the skies, in the seas, in the forests, on the streets—all over! You’ll be able to experience the true joy of the Pokémon series—battling against wild Pokémon in order to catch them—now in an open-world game that players of any age can enjoy.​

games.name: Pokémon Violet
games.summary: Catch, battle, and train Pokémon in the Paldea Region, a vast land filled with lakes, towering peaks, wastelands, small towns, and sprawling cities. Explore a wide-open world at your own pace and traverse land, water, and air by riding on a form-shifting Legendary Pokémon. Choose either Sprigatito, Fuecoco, or Quaxly, to be your first partner Pokémon before setting off on your journey through Paldea.

games.name: Pokémon Champions
games.summary: Get ready to experience everything you love about Pokémon battles all in one place—in Pokémon Champions. This new, battle-focused game will feature familiar mechanics such as Pokémon types, Abilities, and moves, creating an environment conducive to rich and varied strategies for new and experienced Trainers alike. It’s not just familiar mechanics—you’ll be able to bring in classic Pokémon from Pokémon HOME, too! Look forward to cross-platform battles alongside your favorite Pokémon on Nintendo Switch and mobile, with a variety of different modes available for your desired experience.

games.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
games.summary: A new adventure awaits within Lumiose City, where an urban redevelopment plan is underway to shape the city into a place that belongs to both people and Pokémon. Please look forward to seeing it for yourself.​​

events.name: BitSummit MIX Showcase 2025
events.description: Tune in for some exclusive interviews with some of the talented developers attending the largest indie showcase in Japan!

games.name: Die Deep
games.summary: Die Deep delivers a pure and focused combat experience - it’s all about reading your foes and mastering your timing to strike back. Nothing stands in your way but combat! Dive into a constantly changing abyss, take down every enemy in your way, and enjoy the ultimate head-to-head battle experience.

games.name: Steel Knight's Armis
games.summary: "Steel Knight's ARMIS" is a roguelike robot game. Lead the rebellion through five chapters, fighting against the Imperial Army and Earth Federation. Customize and upgrade your robot to survive the intense battles ahead.

games.name: Gogh: Focus with Your Avatar
games.summary: A cozy multiplayer co-working sandbox with character customization, room building, and productivity tools. Focus, study, work, and relax together with friends and players around the world.

games.name: No Players Online
games.summary: you find an abandoned fps game on an old computer. you decide to play it.

games.name: Tempopo
games.summary: A psychedelic soundscape in the sky. Puzzle through the seasons by conducting chaotic Tempopo to rescue musical flowers. Design and populate your melodic garden, then let the music play!

games.name: Demon Raiders: Bloody Gems of Blood
games.summary: A vulgar, cute & competitive party game! Stab your friends (2~4 players) and splatter their blood across loads of levels! Pools of blood will spawn rotten-blood monsters and power-up chests! Get stabbed! Get eaten! Never die! Even if you become poop! Single player co-op campaign also in development!

games.name: Electrogical
games.summary: "Jigsaw Puzzle + Arithmetic" is a casual yet engaging game that appeals to puzzle gamers who enjoy immersive experiences. Customize your gameplay by rearranging "piece placement," "number manipulation," and "score selection" to aim for a high score in each stage.

games.name: Never's End
games.summary: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

games.name: 10 Seconds Dash!
games.summary: Ten-Second Takeover! is a 2D jumping action game with an extremely short time limit of 10 seconds to enjoy a new sense of tension and achievement. Enjoy the ultimate time limit combined with cute character graphics and fast-paced music.

games.name: One More Plate
games.summary: One More Plate is a physics-based quirky funny game. Here, you'll serve food on ANYTHING but proper plates! Keep your balance, aim carefully, and then you will be rewarded with…… One More Plate!

games.name: Bits & Bops
games.summary: Bits & Bops is a collection of original rhythm mini-games. Featuring over 20 mini-games filled with catchy music, snappy gameplay and gorgeous, hand-drawn animation, Bits & Bops is sure to brighten your day.

games.name: Sonic Valkyria: Kanon
games.summary: "Every time you shoot an enemy, music is born." The heartbeat of rock becomes your aim. An impulse shooting game with anime song rock and lock-on! "Sonic Valkyria: KANON"

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
games.summary: “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe” is a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, peruses antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him for fear of losing your head.

games.name: Sonokuni
games.summary: Sonokuni is a hardcore high-speed action game. In a world of bio-science fiction and Japanese mythology, manipulate time and space to protect your dying country from the forces of a superpower. This experience is truly HIPHOP as you continue to struggle for a solution other than violence.

games.name: MeloMisterio: Play Your Melody
games.summary: The melody you play moves the world — experience a brand-new kind of musical 3D platforming action.

games.name: Cloudheim
games.summary: Ragnarok shattered the world, the gods have chosen you to shape the next one. Cloudheim is a cooperative action RPG blending crafting with chaotic physics-based combat. Gather your allies, craft your weapons, and upgrade your shop in the sky to bring harmony to a broken realm.

games.name: Jelly Troops
games.summary: An online action RTS where the tide can turn in a flash! Fight exciting battles where you recruit golems to battle your opponent’s slimes, cleverly redirect their slimes with walls, or sneakily steal their flag to make a dramatic comeback.

games.name: Serial World
games.summary: "SerialWorld" is a comedic yet serious RPG. Whether you've played deck-building games before or not, everyone can enjoy this adventurous tale. Embark on a journey into the mysterious world to solve the city's disturbances!

games.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
games.summary:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

games.name: Hotel Barcelona
games.summary:
"Hotel Barcelona," where serial killers from all over the United States are said to have gathered. You must defeat them and check out before all the blood is spilled.

Japanese game creators SWERY65 and SUDA51 have teamed up to create this ambitious work. Don't miss it.

games.name: Haunted Streamer
games.summary: Live-stream Japan’s most haunted ruins. Capture ghosts, grow your channel… and survive.

games.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
games.summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: Fragile Hero and the Immortal Frog
games.summary: This is a 2D action game where a high-powered but fragile protagonist teams up with an invincible frog who follows behind.

games.name: Earth Atlantis 2
games.summary: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

games.name: Sausage Legend: Arena
games.summary: Sausage Legend is a 3D physics-based fighting game where players clash their sausages in battle. You take on the role of a medieval slave, forced to fight in the "Sausage Duel," a pastime of the nobility. To gain your freedom, you must emerge victorious in this mad contest.

games.name: Robo Oh vs. Uchu Mega Fight
games.summary: With simple 2-button controls,anyone can jump in and enjoy the thrills of tag-team fighting action. This game is developed using the 8-bit fantasy console PICO-8.Experience the dynamic animations that push the limits of this tiny engine!

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: BrokenLore: Unfollow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.

games.name: Hauntii
games.summary: A beguiling adventure in which you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world - haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

games.name: Berserk or Die
games.summary: This is an action game in which players attempt to survive by defeating a number of enemies which appear from the left and right sides of the screen. Use a unique keyboard-banging control scheme for maximum dopamine! Go Berserk, or Die!

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

games.name: Awaysis
games.summary: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

games.name: Crazy Sonic
games.summary:
The ultra-fast vehicle you control, CRAZY SONIC, accelerates the more you crank.
Your goal is to reach the finish line within the time limit by dodging obstacles that appear across highway lanes—using lane changes and speed control to your advantage.

events.name: Free Fangame Festival 2025
events.description: Enjoy around an hour of announcements/releases of fangames and mods!

games.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
games.summary: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

games.name: Banjo-Kazooie: Nostalgia 64
games.summary: Banjo-Kazooie: Nostalgia 64 is a ROM hack/mod of Banjo-Kazooie developed by Kurko Mods. It is an expanded and enhanced version of Banjo-Kazooie: Stay At Home, being a love letter to retro games of the Nintendo 64 era such as Super Mario 64, Diddy Kong Racing, Bomberman 64 and many others. Banjo and Kazooie go on an adventure through worlds taken or based on retro games from their era.

games.name: Mushroom Kingdom Fusion
games.summary: Mushroom Kingdom Fusion is an unofficial fan game crossover with many different series and characters, such as Mario, Zelda, Mega Man, Metal Slug, and many others. It is a side-scroller platformer with a dark tone.

games.name: All Hell Unleashed
games.summary: Amidst a realm where darkness reigns and evil lurks in every shadow, a sinister cult has unleashed chaos upon our world. Introducing 'All Hell Unleashed,' the NES game that pits YOU against the most infamous horror icons of all time.. Jason, Michael, Freddy, Candyman, Ghostface, Leatherface, Chucky, Pennywise, Pinhead and the Killer Klowns. As the world teeters on the brink of eternal fear, you must embark on a perilous journey to confront these iconic villains. But beware, time is of the essence, for the shattered fragments of a cursed amulet hold the key to sealing the dimensional rift and saving our world from eternal darkness. Can you rise to the challenge, gather the fragments, and stop the cult before it's too late? The fate of humanity rests in your hands. 'All Hell Unleashed' Confront the terror… or let it claim your soul.

games.name: EarthBound Beginnings Remake
games.summary: A rom hack by Gabbi that remakes EarthBound Beginnings within the original EarthBound, mimicking what the actual developers would have done if it was remade on the SNES.

games.name: Animal Crossing: City Folk Deluxe
games.summary: Animal Crossing: City Folk Deluxe is an unofficial enhancement patch for Animal Crossing: City Folk / Let's Go to the City that introduces new content and gameplay changes.

games.name: Mario Builder 64
games.summary: Mario Builder 64 is a toolbox letting you fulfill all of your SM64 dreams. Play one of the numerous user-made levels, or create a course pushing your imagination (and hardware) to its limits!

games.name: Kirby Air Ride Deluxe
games.summary: Kirby Air Ride Deluxe is a modpack with an emphasis on customization and familiar aesthetics. All features are toggleable via in-game menus and their settings save to the memory card!

games.name: Dr. Mario Mania
games.summary: Dr. Mario Mania is an unofficial fan-game based of the Dr. Mario series, bringing new features and improvements to the classic formula!

games.name: Pokémon Stadium Club
games.summary: PSC acts as a "hub" to select the minigame to play. All the minigames were made from scratch in Unity Engine supporting PvP (1 vs 1, 2, or 3 players), PvE (player against AI) and EvE (AI vs AI). There are 4 difficulties available: Easy, Normal, Hard and Hyper Hard. Every playthrough ends winning either 1 coin if the player loses, or 1 * difficulty coins if the player wins. These coins can be spent in the Gachapon machine to obtain a Pokémon-toy. There are +700 collectible Pokémon toys available in PSC in regular and shiny forms, so filling the Toy-Dex won't be easy. There are more than 1500 collectibles! If you are only interest in throwing to the gacha machine, you can use the code "I WANT GACHA" to gain 2 throws for free. In addition, you get 10 coins every day!

games.name: Paper Mario: TTYD - Tower of Trials
games.summary:
Tower of Trials is a mod of Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door created by jdaster64 which pits Mario and his partners against a Rogue-like series of random battles, with a choice of different rewards after clearing each floor.

The mod also reworks a number of existing moves and badges, adds multiple new moves to each partner's moveset, and has an expanded Journal menu with logs for achievements completed, and moves, items and badges encountered.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom Online
Super Mario Odyssey: A Galaxy Story
games.summary: A mod for Super Mario Odyssey that adds levels from Super Mario Galaxy 1 and 2.

games.name: FNaF: Wii U Edition
games.summary: FNaF: Wii U Edition is a remake of Five Nights at Freddy's for Wii U made by Source Macchiato. You have been recruited as a night guard at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza restaurant and must monitor animatronics while avoiding getting killed. Select the camera on your gamepad and watch on your TV screen if anything strange happened. This remake includes translation into French, Spanish, Italian, German and Arabic languages and different layouts.

games.name: Shadow the Plumber
games.summary: Shadow the Plumber will be a small, story-focused hack.

games.name: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door Encore
Animal Crossing Deluxe
games.summary: Animal Crossing Deluxe is a mod for the GameCube version of Animal Crossing powered by the Animal Crossing Decompilation project. It adds tons of quality of life features, regional content, content from future games, and custom content!

games.name: Tanks Rebirth
games.summary: Tanks Rebirth is a faithful recreation of the Tanks gamemode from Wii Play. This game is entirely free and there is no monetary benefit from the game itself.

games.name: Angry Birds Refresh
games.summary: Angry Birds Refresh is a fan-made revival of the Adobe Flash version of Angry Birds Friends.

games.name: Ultimate Trial
games.summary: Deep inside the Lost Woods lies a mysterious Stronghold, inhabited by lost travellers. As Link enters this place, he is greeted by Shiba, the protector of the fortress. He places the task of conquering the 3 Trials upon Link. He needs to meet new people and explore each corner of the Stronghold to be prepared, but will he be able to conquer them all and eventually reach the Ultimate Trial ?

games.name: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
games.summary: Super Mario Bros. Remastered is an unofficial PC remake of the 1985 NES classic. It features enhanced graphics, widescreen support, smoother gameplay, custom resource packs, a level editor, and bonus content like The Lost Levels.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe
FNAFMIN
games.summary: This mod is a recreation of Five Nights at Freddy's built into the Pikmin 2 engine using the Pikmin 2 Decomp.

games.name: Lethalmon
games.summary:
Lethalmon is a roguelike Pokémon fangame inspired by Lethal Company. Each playthrough is designed to feel unique, ensuring a fresh experience every time.

Explore planets to catch Pokémon and collect valuable items. Earn money by selling your catches at The Ship, the game’s central hub.

Fight your way to freedom by defeating the Gym Leaders!

games.name: Paper Mario: Star Nova
games.summary:
Paper Mario: Star Nova is a full-scale story-based Paper Mario 64 mod made by NicTube. Mario somehow ends up at Stellaria, a sacred kingdom of many mysteries...
Get ready for a brand-new world featuring multiple new chapters, an entirely new story, and more!

games.name: Boxguy Adventure 2
games.summary: A Rom Hack of the 8-bit version of Sonic the Hedgehog for the Sega Master System that adds new levels and lets you play as Boxguy, features custom levels, graphical changes among other things.

games.name: Wega & The Lost Media
games.summary:
Wega And The Lost Media is an in development shitpost 2D Platformer that follows the iconic Luigi and Mario recolors Wega and Urio, and their quest to stop the evil Maltigi from making their world LOST MEDIA!

The game will contain 8 worlds of content, 4 weapons for you to break out of bounds with, a soundtrack that's probably better than this game deserves, and shoe bench.

games.name: Sonic Essence
games.summary: Sonic Essence is an original 2D Modern Sonic adventure built with the Retro Engine V4 Decompilation. It features completely original sprites, levels, badniks, and an all-new soundtrack featuring remixes and original compositions! This project aims to push the potential of Retro Engine (V4) modding to show the fresh and new experiences the decompilation can offer!

games.name: Mario Kart 64: Amped Up - Version 3
games.summary:
Mario Kart 64: Amped Up is a ROM hack/mod of Mario Kart 64 developed by Litronom.

The mod includes:
-16 brand new courses
-5 additional game modes,
-fully animated 3D racers
-modern visuals
-groovy music
-customization settings
-unlockables
and much, much more!

It can be played on any modern emulator and even on original hardware.

games.name: NSMB: Mario vs. Luigi Online
games.summary:
A Unity-standalone 2-10 player remake of the Mario vs. Luigi gamemode from the New Super Mario Bros. DS download game.

Includes the 5 default levels (Grassland, Bricks, Castle, Pipes, and Ice), along with a handful of custom levels to battle on! All power-ups are included and remain faithful to their original counterparts, along with the new addition of the Propeller Suit, Ice Flower, and Hammer Suit!

games.name: Paper Mario: TTYD - Tower of Trials v3.0
Boxguy Adventure
games.summary: A mod of Kirby's Adventure that adds new levels and lets the player play as Boxguy the Box.

games.name: FNaF 2: Wii U Edition
games.summary: Your new job: survive five nights at the new Freddy Fazbear's Pizza. Thought you'd be safe behind two flimsy doors? Think again. No doors, no security—just a Freddy mask to protect you. And hiding behind the monitor won't help; they're smarter than you think.

events.name: Stream for a Cause's IGN Showcase
events.description: Tune in on July 29th at 9am PT for an event 5 years in the making. Stream for a Cause celebrates gamers doing good while playing games. There are going to be some amazing publishers and developers showing off their newest titles so don’t miss a minute of it.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Furi
games.summary: Fight your way free in our frenzied all-boss fighter, and discover what’s waiting behind the last gate. Furi is all about the tension of one-on-one fights against deadly adversaries. It’s an intense, ultra-responsive hack-and-slash with a unique mix of fast-paced sword fighting and dual-stick shooting.
