games.summary: Rebuild the city of Pompeii and climb the social ladder. Roman society is full of intrigues that you have to solve in order to become a powerful ruler.

games.name: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
games.summary: Pirates Outlaws 2 is a swashbuckling roguelike deckbuilder. Collect & fuse cards, gather powerful relics and adapt your strategy during each run. Become a reputed pirate, loot the Sea Masters, challenge giant creatures and triumph in the great Arena!

games.name: Plus Ultra: Legado
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a Mesoamerican metroidvania adventure, featuring vivid ligne-claire comic visuals set in the 16th century. Explore the intersection of two worlds in this spellbinding tale base on historical background with rich lore, dynamic combat, and a captivating soundtrack.

games.name: Decktamer
games.summary: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

games.name: Lustra: Lachea’s Tale
games.summary:
LUSTRA: Lachea’s Tale is a story-rich RPG that combines real-time spellcasting, exploration, and settlement building, set in a fractured floating island realm where ancient magic and mystery intertwine.

Play as Lachea, a young mage shaped by the world around her, learning to lead, grow, and take control of her path in a land suspended between ruin and renewal.

Lustra invites players to see the world through multiple perspectives, to reflect on morality, empathy, and responsibility, and to shape not just the outcome of a magical world, but the kind of person Lachea becomes along the way.

games.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
games.summary: Tiny paper - Big adventure! Soar, sail, and roll to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and imagination

games.name: Drill Bird
games.summary: Drill Bird is a cozy-yet-tense digging platformer where every trip underground counts. Fallen from the sky, you search for powerful ores to hatch your egg. Bring them home, upgrade abilities, grow stronger, and unravel a story about survival, care, and purpose. Exploring, returning, and growing.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

games.name: O3: Hollow Descent
games.summary: 03 is a bullet-hell rogue-like shooter. Set in a surreal world inspired by the art of H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Word to Angel
games.summary: Play as five heroes in this musical pacifist RPG taking place in a 2D alternative version of the world where some friendly angels and a very shy god conduct balance and harmony together.

games.name: Grey Wake
games.summary: In an intimate narrative-driven exploration game, wake up on a forgotten island between life and death equipped with only a compass, a telescope, and a weathered sailboat. Chart the haunted archipelago, relive faded memories, and uncover the truth about what, and who, you came here to find.

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

events.name: State of Play: 007 First Light
events.description: Prepare for a deep dive on 007 First Light! During this special State of Play, the development team at IO Interactive declassifies new gameplay on James Bond’s upcoming espionage action-adventure thrill ride.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

events.name: The ANZ Indie Showcase 2025
events.description: Welcome to The ANZ Indie Showcase 2025 - a curated showcase featuring Australian and New Zealand made games.

games.name: Aussie Bogan Hero
games.summary: G’day mates! In this crackin’ 2D metroidvania, Aussie Bogan Hero sees Davo, a mullet-wearing, beer-loving legend, battle corporate goons and freaky creatures to reopen his pub and save Dusty Springs. 'Cause sometimes, it takes a legend in a singlet to save the day.

games.name: Call of the Golden Valley
games.summary: Become a detective and delve into the depths of desire and motivation to solve the mystery of vanishing hikers in the Australian bush. Follow clues, solve puzzles, dive into conspiracy theories, and find your missing friend. This thrilling story is an immersive escape into a true crime-like mystery.

games.name: Cast n Chill
games.summary: Cast n Chill is a cozy idle (and active) fishing game where you explore serene lakes, rivers, and oceans. Catch rare fish, upgrade your gear and reel in legendary catches - all with your loyal companion by your side.

games.name: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
games.summary: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

games.name: Choo Choo Survivor 2
games.summary: Drive your train through the zombie apocalypse, gather resources, rescue survivors, and upgrade your train strategically into a powerhouse of destruction. Defeat the boss and get to the end to win, or complete the survival challenge!

games.name: Pie in the Sky
games.summary: Pluck them. Pluck them all. You are an Australian Magpie on a mission. That mission: Spread havoc, cause mayhem, and grab the occasional unattended piece of food. Menace, rob, and terrify humans, enjoying old-school action arcade gameplay rendered in glorious retro PS2 graphics.

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Bones: Wandering Soul
games.summary: Sneak past the living. Speak for the dead. Solve your way through a strange city, limb by limb, as a skeleton with no memory in a story-rich puzzle adventure full of mystery and meaning.

games.name: Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair
games.summary: Bulb Boy defeated the evil that had overtaken the Bulbhouse and his beloved family. But it seems that this is only the beginning of his dark adventures! And this time, it all starts with an empty jam jar...

games.name: Infernal Cleaner
games.summary: Hell's walls don't clean themselves. Blast away every speck of blood and grime with your powerwasher, shotgun, and toothbrush. Enjoy the twisted satisfaction of scrubbing Hell spotless. Remember, you’re not here to have fun, you’re here to wash.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Trash
games.summary: Discover a post-human earth in Trash, a beautifully crafted open-world action adventure game where strange and wondrous trash-based life thrives. Explore your surroundings with friends, solve puzzles, craft unique attachments and emerge from the heap.

games.name: Teeto
games.summary: Teeto is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a tiny blob and bunny duo on an extraordinary journey. Absorb objects from the world, harnessing their powers to fight the shadow corruption and help out a cast of crazy characters in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Wylde Society
games.summary: Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

games.name: How Was Your Day?
games.summary:
Caught in a strange time loop and with her beloved dog, Beans, missing, 13-year-old Diya discovers that building meaningful connections is key to solving the sinister mystery in this beautifully illustrated 80s-themed narrative adventure. Can Diya break free from the endless cycle and find Beans?

Video game enthusiast and moody 13-year-old Diya’s day starts out rough. It’s the late 80s, and on top of the usual teenage angst—school, bullies, cliques, and annoying adults—Diya’s just moved to a new country, has no friends, and her once-close relationship with her brother is souring. Ugh! But when the only light in her life, her beloved dog Beans, vanishes without a trace, and she finds herself trapped in a mysterious time loop, Diya’s day goes from bad to worse.

Groundhog Day meets Stranger Things in this narrative-driven, point-and-click adventure that brings a supernatural twist to an ordinary teen’s life. Journey through Diya's repeating day, where every interaction could hold the key to breaking the loop and unlocking the truth about Beans' disappearance.

games.name: Rita
games.summary: Rita is a cozy adventure where a little chicklet solves word-based puzzles to transform the world around her. Follow her story across generations, meet her grandchicklet, and be a part of her legacy.

games.name: Roadside Egg Stand
games.summary: Bring the residents of Reine the freshest, finest eggs! Raise cute chickens, collect their eggs, and sell them at roadside egg stands scattered throughout the village. Decorate your egg stand, collect your daily earnings, restock with fresh eggs, and read the heartfelt letters from the villagers.

games.name: Dungeons & Dining Tables
games.summary: Dungeons and Dining Tables is a Cosy-RPG where you delve dungeons to collect rare furniture to decorate your house! The comfier your house. The better your stats!

games.name: Poly Bricks
games.summary: A brick-building puzzle game. Assemble sets of increasing complexity, design your own, share with the community.

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: Design & Conjure
games.summary: Join Dalia, a young witch, in her cozy adventure to fix her hometown. Reconnect with nature and bring beauty back as you clean, decorate, solve light puzzles, and help magical creatures affected by the mysterious corruption.

games.name: Letters to Arralla
games.summary: Deliver letters, parcels, and packages to the residents of Arralla, a small fictional island off the coast of Australia populated by big booty cutie fruits! In this relaxing RPG, you play as a mail delivery turnip covering the holiday of the previous mailman. It’s your job to get the mail where it needs to go by solving visual puzzles and exploring.

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: Innkeep
games.summary: Innkeep is an immersive job sim with an RPG core and a dark twist. Run your own fantasy world inn. Serve ale. Share rumors. Tell jokes. Rob your guests…?? Well, maybe just a little.

games.name: Black Raven
games.summary: Black Raven is a dark 2.5D action-adventure rooted in Slavic Folklore set in 14th-century Eastern-Europe. Play as Ivan, a man consumed by vengeance after a brutal raid shatters his family. Journey through grim landscapes and fight brutal enemies in this dark tale of loss, rage, and resilience.

games.name: Castle Cab
games.summary: Castle Cab is a hilariously chaotic action sandbox game that puts you in the horseshoes of a majestic, yet slightly unhinged, steed. Hitched to your trusty cart, you’ll gallop, drift, and crash your way through a bustling medieval world where rules are more of a suggestion.

games.name: King's Guard
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

games.name: Finely Diced
games.summary: Chefs are mercurial at the best of times, and catastrophically explosive at their worst. In this hospitality roguelite, your family's restaurant is balanced on a knifes edge. You have the ingredients, the stove is on, now you just need to cook.

games.name: Malys
games.summary: Expose, endure and expel evil from innocents on your hunt through a corrupted city. As Noah, former priest turned demon-hunter, you'll perform exorcisms, forge precarious alliances and strengthen your deck of arcane tricks in this unholy roguelite deckbuilder.

games.name: Dolven
games.summary:
Dolven is a fantasy turn-based strategy RPG with a deep card-based battle system. Following the events of The Necromancer’s scourge upon the northern townsfolk, guide a band of mercenaries through the Decaying Isles in order to rid the land of evil. Use the Pillars to create a variety of combos to earn mana and gain advantage over the recent evil plaguing the land of Dolven.

Card battles include hand-to-hand combat, where the cards provide characters with additional skills. The Pillars allow you to create various hand combinations that range from matching cards and suits, playing a pivotal role in your quest to accumulate more Mana, Gear, Cards, Skills and even exerting influence over the game's environment. Strategic planning is of utmost importance.

games.name: Trading Card Inspector
games.summary: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

games.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
games.summary: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant is a story-driven merchant adventure that will test your sense of strategy and empathy as you make tough decisions for a fox merchant girl aiming to save the life of a loved one.

games.name: Wanderer: The Fragments of Fate
games.summary: Step into the unknown and embark on an epic, time travel adventure, completely re-imagined. Introducing Wanderer: The Fragments of Fate, a remake of the critically acclaimed VR adventure game - Wanderer. There’s no telling where you’ll go and who you’ll become as you unravel the mysteries of time.

games.name: Castillon
games.summary:
Defend your Kingdom

As a renoun wizard you lay claim to a new land and build your castle! But beware, for demon invaders roam the wilds. Grow your kingdom during the day then fight off waves of enemies at night!

Castillon is a bite sized strategy game about building and defending your growing castle realm.

games.name: Tavern Keeper
games.summary: In Tavern Keeper you manage a tavern, building, bartering, cooking and cleaning your way to success in a humorous fantasy world. Starting out with a shell of a tavern in the backwaters of the kingdom, you build rooms, place items, stock the larder and hire staff to satisfy the demands of the oddball locals and misfit heroes that stumble through your door. Run your business well and you'll progress to larger taverns with more demanding patrons where you'll need to expand your offerings to include new meals, drinks, rooms and services.

games.name: Go-Go Town!
games.summary: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Huedini
games.summary: Huedini is a top-down action roguelike game. Play as Huedini, a powerful wizard with the ability to change his colour. By matching your colour, to that of the enemies you can absorb their colour essence. By combining these colour essences into the correct combination, you can cast custom spells.

games.name: Winnie's Hole
games.summary:
Join Winnie on a new adventure, from within!
Play as a virus in his body and mind. Capture cells to mutate and build a deck of actions to unleash in combo-driven combat.

A genre-blending roguelite with a dark yet charming story. Embrace discomfort - Sometimes we can't help being seen as a monster...

games.name: Video Nightz
games.summary: It’s 1999 and Y2K is upon us. You are the owner of an independent video store that a corporation is eyeing off to purchase. Help your customers find the perfect video by listening to their stories and decide what the future is for your video store.

games.name: Oil Town
games.summary: OIL TOWN is a worker-sim RPG about scooping and hauling oil. Earn money during the work day, and interact with the town after your shift. But don't let the Oil Barons find out about your secret before you can afford to buy the land it hides on.

games.name: Adaptory
games.summary: Deep in uncharted space, your expedition took a challenging turn when your ship crash-landed. Master complex simulations to keep your outspoken explorers alive, face unpredictable challenges, and figure out a way back home.

games.name: Untethered
games.summary: Stranded in deep space, you must survive against all odds. Scavenge from wreckage, process resources, and build your own space station - a refuge in the most hostile of environments.

games.name: Kuu
games.summary: Trapped in the fading light of a broken moonhouse, you have 30 nights to balance scarce resources. Grow meager rations in the weak earthlight. Navigate the emotional sanity of a fragile sisterhood. Decode ancient documents in search of secrets. Your only choices will be impossible ones.

games.name: Nullstar: Solus
games.summary: Be. Faster. You are a corporate scavenger drone, sent to rip through the decaying corpse of a dying world to salvage its nullstar. Master flight, thrusters, and face ancient guardians and hazards in 80 precision platformer levels set in the ruins of a civilization where all is not as it might seem.

games.name: Foodomina
games.summary: Play as two personified food girls- Takoyaki & Tempura- in their cosmic battle against mold people! Explore a food-themed galaxy, rich in flavour, make friends, & engage in absurd pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from infection! But mold people used to be food people- Maybe there's another way?

games.name: Memory's Reach
games.summary: Memory’s Reach is a first person puzzle-adventure metroidvania. Explore labyrinthian megastructures, solve mind-bending puzzles, and wield fantastic alien technology in a quest to reveal the legacy of a doomed civilization.

events.name: Monster Taming Direct 09.07.2025
events.description: Get ready for Monster Taming Direct 2025 featuring a wide array of Monster Taming / Creature Collecting Indie games all with their own unique twist on the genre, including turn based RPGs, real time action combat games, roguelikes, etc.

games.name: Sphirit
games.summary: Tactical RPG with grid-based battles where masters summon mystical creatures, use skill cards, and control the battlefield in strategic duels.

games.name: V-Monsters Forgotten Link
games.summary:
V-Monsters Forgotten Link is a turn-based monster RPG with strategic 3v3 battles and evolutions that occur mid-combat, in a digital world on the brink of collapse.

Immerse yourself in Folklora, a system created to simulate a perfect life—until an experiment went wrong.

games.name: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman
games.summary: Myth Caller: The Nightmare Shaman is a 3D collectathon platformer fused with a monster-catching RPG! Catch monsters, collect permanent upgrades, and unlock even more of this huge 90's-inspired world.

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Critterrupters
games.summary: Choose your new buddy and set off on a Critter adventure on Holon Island! Capture Critters by fulfilling their conditions and master time based battles by interrupting your opponent's turns. Assemble your team to challenge the Islands Clubs and gain new abilities for your buddy to help you explore.

games.name: Monster Crown: Sin Eater
games.summary: Explore the beautiful and detailed environments of Crown Nation, breed endless monsters with the most robust and polished true crossbreeding system devised in a video game.

games.name: Astra Bestiary
games.summary: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Oni Hunters
games.summary: Journey through Gironia's lands, where monsters roam and secrets await. Battle, fuse creatures, and decide your fate in the grand Monster Jubilee. Ready for the adventure?

games.name: Stories of Somnia
games.summary: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: Tuscany has been obliterated by Thunder Goober for his own entertainment! Play as Lambypoo and adventure through the broken land of Tuscany, either making friends and having them join your team or defeating enemies for their EXP in your efforts to save your cousins and reunite Tuscany.

games.name: Bean Beasts
games.summary: Defeat monster hordes alongside your Bean Beasts in this cute, challenging Tower Defense Game! Evolve your companions, explore upgrade paths for traps and take on epic boss battles!

games.name: Insectile
games.summary: Insectile is a creature collector RPG where you piece bugs together to form your attacks! Assemble your party of cute bugs and synergize their puzzling shapes with their unique effects!

games.name: Tiny Monster Haven
games.summary: A cozy idle creature collector that sits on your desktop as you go about your day. Grow crops, care for and level-up your companions and put them to the test in wild monster battles!

games.name: Goobie Garden
games.summary: Goobie Garden is a free-to-play creature collector, where the world changes and grows alongside you each and every day.

games.name: Legacy of Pandora
games.summary: Legacy of Pandora is a monster-taming roguelike inspired by Greek mythology. Play as Pyrrha, daughter of Pandora, on a journey to recapture the escaped evils, confront legendary heroes, and reshape your cursed family legacy.

games.name: Anvilium
games.summary: Forge a living army in this monster-crafting strategy RPG. Discover species, synthesize your army, min-max stats and gear, and command real-time battles on handcrafted worlds.

games.name: Trinity 64
games.summary: A Souls-like Monster Tamer inspired by 90's Retro Adventure games. Fight and form bonds with powerful creatures, explore a ruined world, and uncover secrets within dungeons and the bosses that lurk in them.

games.name: TurnBreak
games.summary: Enter the ultimate roguelite elemental creature-card battler! Collect and evolve powerful teams to build your perfect battle deck. Outwit your opponents with turn-breaking action! Exploit elemental weaknesses to draw cards to become a member of the Turn Breaker League!

games.name: Dino Citadel
games.summary: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Tamer Town
games.summary: Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

games.name: Path to Tamer Town
games.summary: Travel from city to city collecting badges in these procedurally generated roguelite adventures. Catch and evolve your team of Mokitons, make tough choices, and fight using a unique real-time meets turn-based battle system – all leading up to the ultimate Stadium Showdown!

games.name: Aethermancer
games.summary: Monster Taming meets Roguelite. Become the Aethermancer and fight alongside mythical creatures. Explore the ever-changing Fractured Ruins. Plan your moves in challenging turn-based battles utilizing the four elements of Aether. Watch your Monsters grow stronger from previous lives and defy death!

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: Botworld Odyssey
games.summary: Venture out into a huge and diverse open world to discover new bots, collect rare scrap to build them, and deploy them in tactical real-time battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

games.name: Anode Heart 2
games.summary: A dungeon crawler creature collector RPG, set in a digital, futuristic environment, with fast-paced combat and 150+ Tama creatures to befriend and raise into lovable monstrosities.

games.name: Astral Arena
games.summary: Create & Combat mystical creatures known as Astrals in this Monster Tamer Roguelike with unique Real Time Combat!

games.name: Montabi
games.summary: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: Monster Care Simulator
games.summary: Become the manager of a care center for adorable little monsters in Monster Care Simulator. Earn money by meeting their needs, improve your facilities, and customize the environment to provide the best care and see the creatures thrive.

games.name: Eidolon Awakened
games.summary: Eidolon Awakened is a turn-based creature collector RPG set in a post-apocalyptic world overtaken by creatures known as Eidolons. Take your place among the Summoners, able to capture and control the Eidolon to determine the fate of mankind.

games.name: Shard Squad
games.summary: In Shard Squad, join elemental creatures to save their lands in intense battles against challenging hordes and bosses. Strengthen yourself with unique allies, gather valuable items, face epic calamities, and unlock new members to create unique strategies on your path to victory!

games.name: Abomi Nation: Monster Rifts
games.summary: Battle teams of Abomis in this turn-based roguelike monster-tamer where the matchups change every run! Recruit creatures from several different indie universes to help close the rifts destroying Abomi Nation. Create your own Abomis or download others from Steam Workshop for infinite possibilities

games.name: Pipkin
games.summary: Explore a magical and spooky world, capture wild Pipkin, and fight alongside them, as you uncover a series of mysterious events happening around New Haven...

games.name: Tomomon: Legacy of Light
games.summary: Experience the best of both worlds with our monster taming game - relive the nostalgia of classic role-play games, while enjoying fresh and immersive gameplay. Capture and train unique monsters in stunning environments, and put your skills to the test in challenging 3v3 battles.

games.name: Idle Critter Adventure
games.summary: Pick your first Critter and head off on an adventure, even if that's away from your PC! Choose an area in the Dorma region and leave Alfa to battle trainers and capture new Critters. Unlock areas filled with new Critters and defeat Clubs on the way to becoming a Critter Champion!

games.name: WinMon
games.summary: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

games.name: GladiEaters
games.summary: Cook and command teams of living food in this narrative creature battler. GladiEATers blends seven chef stories in top-down JRPG adventures and roguelike gauntlets, featuring 6v6 battles, spicy cooking minigames and online multiplayer.

games.name: 9th Dawn Remake
games.summary: Rediscover the magic of the 9th Dawn series with this complete re-imagining of the original game. Venture into a massive 2.5D open world. Explore 45 new dungeons in top-down or first-person view, craft weapons, raise pets, play a deck-building card game, and take down the Castle of Maltyr!

games.name: Bagdex
games.summary: The journey begins! Collect over 160 creatures inspired by Brazilian culture, manage and customize your base, conquer challenging battles, and unravel the mystery behind this fantastic world!

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

games.name: Coromon: Rogue Planet
games.summary: Choose your starter Coromon, upgrade your gear, then battle your way across the wilderness of Velua in a modern-day Monster Tamer with a Roguelite twist! Tame monsters, battle Crimsonite bosses, and uncover the secrets of the galaxy!

games.name: Kindred Fates
games.summary: Kindred Fates is an open world monster battling RPG, and a love letter to the monster battle genre. Our goal is to evolve the genre, and finally bring fans what they've been asking for.

events.name: Games Against Living Miserably
events.description:
Games are great. We all know that. But did you know they can also be great for your head?

Running from 8–15 September, to mark World Suicide Prevention Day, this event celebrates how games can help us unwind, connect, and escape. It’s presented by Curve Games and us - the suicide prevention charity, Campaign Against Living Miserably (CALM).

Every developer and publisher taking part has pledged a donation to our life-saving work.

games.name: The Wandering Village
games.summary: The Wandering Village is a city-building simulation game with survival and rogue-like elements. Build a village on the back of a giant, wandering creature, farm crops and forage resources to keep your villagers alive and form a symbiotic relationship with your giant host to survive together in a hostile, yet beautiful post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Ultimate Chicken Horse
games.summary:
Ever wish you were a wall-jumping, arrow-dodging, trap-setting horse, besting your animal pals in a race through a peril-laden obstacle course that you all built together?

Wish granted!

Ultimate Chicken Horse is a party platformer where you and your friends build the level as you play, placing deadly traps before trying to reach the end of the level. If you can make it but your friends can't, you score points! Play online or locally with your animal buddies and experiment with a wide variety of platforms in all sorts of strange locations to find new ways to mess with your friends.

Key Features:
- Online and local play for up to 4 players
- Cross-platform play between PC, PS4, and Switch
- Unique game flow, from strategic block placement to twitch control platforming
- 15 levels with different features
- Build and share custom levels
- Compete for global best times on Challenge levels across all platforms
- Huge library of blocks to create an infinite variety of levels
- Customizable rule sets and game modes
- Shared controller mode to play multiplayer with one controller or keyboard
- Play as a chicken, horse, sheep, raccoon and other wonderful animals
- Fun, cartoony art style
- Sweet funky soundtrack

Please note: this is primarily a multiplayer game. Challenge levels can be created and played alone, but unlocking characters and levels requires playing one of the main game modes (like Party Mode) which are only multiplayer.

games.name: A Space for the Unbound
games.summary: A coming-of-age adventure where you follow two high school sweethearts on a journey of self-discovery at the end of their high school years while facing the end of the world. Explore 90s Indonesian town, uncover its secrets, use supernatural powers to dive into people's hearts, and pet cats.

games.name: Train Simulator Classic
games.summary: Welcome to the ultimate railway hobby! Master complex operations on the DB BR 411 ICE T, BR Class 390 Pendolino, Union Pacific AC4400CW, and more as you explore authentic routes. Whatever you love about trains, Train Simulator Classic lets you take your hobby to the next level.

games.name: Patch Quest
games.summary:
Patch Quest is an action roguelike with metroidvania elements, set on a deserted tropical island.

Your lasso allows you to mount and ride all of the enemy types in the game, letting you use their powers in combat.

games.name: Super Loco World
games.summary: Effortlessly build and automate intricate railroads and deliver goods to meet the demands of a dynamic world! Make clever use of signals and signposts to avoid traffic jams, and watch your villages blossom into bustling towns in this cozy take on the train tycoon genre.

games.name: Biped
games.summary:
Biped is a coop action game with physics. Take Aku and Sila on a fun and bonding adventure, overcoming original challenges and saving Earth from going dark.

- 30 exotic stages to explore, many secrets to uncover
- supports both local 2 player coop and solo play
- collect treasures and customize your bipeds

games.name: Lost Ember
games.summary: Explore the remains of a fallen world from fascinating perspectives! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights, dig underground as a mole or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around.

events.name: #PlayAcclaim Showcase: September 10th, 2025
events.description:
Tune into the #PlayAcclaim showcase on September 10th, where we will begin this exciting new chapter for #Acclaim.
Join us on YouTube as we showcase the titles that will mark the beginning of a bold new era.

games.name: GridBeat!
games.summary: Dungeons! Danger! Rhythm Action! You just hacked into the biggest corporation in the world and stole an unfeasibly valuable amount of data, but getting in was the easy part. To get back out you’ll need to explore the Mainframe, solve puzzles, battle security programs… and do it all on the beat!

games.name: Basketball Classics
games.summary:
5 on 5 Pro Basketball born from the golden era of sports games. This spiritual successor to the 8-bit ballers bridges the gap between retro and today’s simulation games.

Side-scrolling, sweaty arcade action with simplified 3-button gameplay and retro vibes galore. Explore decades of rosters featuring 160+ teams and 800+ players – all with individualized attributes. Introducing the first seamless play calling system of its kind, along with sensational cut scenes. Single player Story Mode unlocks secret teams or engage in endless scream-inducing local multiplayer.

Lace up those hi-tops, hot shot. It's time to show us what you got.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Talaka
games.summary: Welcome to Talaka! A fast-paced, combat-driven roguelite that brings Afro-Brazilian mythology to life in a vivid, hand-painted world.

games.name: Tossdown
games.summary: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

games.name: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
games.summary: After a visit to the psychologist that went horribly wrong you’re trapped in the mind of a game developer on the brink of physical and emotional burnout during the last stages of an intense project. Experience a metroidvania drenched in anxiety based on a very true story.

games.name: Katanaut
games.summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

games.name: HyperYuki: Snowboard Syndicate
games.summary: Welcome to the Snowboard Syndicate! Race, Compete, and Explore the slopes as a colorful cast of unique characters! But what’s snowboarding without a little bit of drip? Through exploring and racing, you can unlock cosmetics such as designs for your snowboard and clothes to make sure you shine the brightest while shredding.

events.name: devINITIVE Showcase 2025
events.description: A digital event featuring Spanish and Latin American indie games!

games.name: MineGeon: Renegades
games.summary: Descend into Planet Paimo in MineGeon: Renegades, a chaotic multiplayer roguelite where you choose your renegade, delve into the minegeons, and battle unique enemies across diverse biomes. Fight, gather, improve, and die to uncover the secrets of Paimo and New Olympia.

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Weefager
games.summary: Guide this pink being with the power of the ether in a metroidvania where nothing is as it seems. Infuse souls into objects, create minions to help you, and explore vibrant landscapes with a great soundtrack. Shape your destiny on this captivating journey.

games.name: Littlelands
games.summary: The Littlelands region is brimming with strange characters and magical landscapes to discover if you know where to look, for a big-headed little youngster like you every moment exploring, growing berries, searching for buried treasures or walking through these lands can be an epic adventure.

games.name: Animas
games.summary: Animas is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into the dark secrets of the Blanco family. Explore a cursed house in the Venezuelan mountains, where time unravels to reveal decades of sectarian rituals and familial tragedies.

games.name: Parkour Labs
games.summary: Are you good at parkour video games? Are you number 1 in surfing mode? This is your game, welcome to Parkour Labs, an experience that will test your skills.

games.name: Tiny Lands 2
games.summary: Take your perception into a new dimension with the relaxing sense of photorealistic miniature scenes in Tiny Lands 2. Find the differences and stories by exploring handcrafted 3D dioramas. Can you find them all?

games.name: Teeko
games.summary: Platformer meets tower defense in this story-rich game inspired by the Costa Rican Día de Las Mascaradas festival. One day, grandma Tita's kids get possessed by the spirits of the gigantes and begin to wreak havoc upon the land. It's now up to her pet sloth, Teeko, to save their town.

games.name: FrostFire: Battle Frenzy
games.summary: This is FrostFire -Battle Frenzy-, a 2D anime fighting game perfect for new and experienced players of the genre.

games.name: Below, Rusted Gods
games.summary: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: The Sinking Forest
games.summary: A Japanese survival horror game full of tension, drama, and violence. If you like psychological horror games with exploration, puzzles, and limited resources, you'll enjoy an intense experience where every decision can mean the difference between finding Sayuri or getting lost in the forest forever.

games.name: The Visitor Effect
games.summary: What if your world was a lie? Outsmart inventive puzzles to escape the glitching simulation that holds you captive. Question reality and uncover a dark conspiracy while evading rogue security systems in this innovative puzzle-adventure.

games.name: Everdark: Undead Apocalypse
games.summary: Inspired by horror and B-movies from the '80s, Everdark takes us to a city infested with vampires. Armed with stakes, garlic, crosses, holy water, and an arsenal of firearms and melee weapons, we'll fight our way through this shooter that blends classic survival horror with an oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: Smile Thief
games.summary: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

games.name: Hack and Climb
games.summary:
"Hack And Climb" is a physics-based 2D Foddian platformer where every swing matters!
Play as a cursed axe on a grueling ascent in search of revenge
Hard, fair, and addictively fun!

games.name: Red Rogue Sea
games.summary: Red Rogue Sea is a roguelike strategy game that puts you in the shoes of a pirate captain and their crew. Manage your vessel as you sail through the treacherous waters of the archipelago, interact with the scum that inhabit it, and engage in battle using a tactical deck-building system.

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Anura
games.summary: Join Don Rano in his adventure! A platformer in which you will have to use the bubbles of the stage, and the ones you create, in order to reach the most difficult platforms. Will you try to go as fast as possible? Or will you take it at your own pace? You decide!

games.name: Ethra
games.summary: EthrA is an RPG/Adventure and open world game that revolves around the misadventures of two characters: Bob and Veil. Both will explore the land of EthrA and uncover a thousand year lie the world already forgot about.

games.name: The Dark Rites of Arkham
games.summary: A macabre ritual murder puts Arkham PD detectives Jack Foster and Harvey Whitman to the test. As the investigation progresses, they will unveil a disturbing connection between the Salem witch trials of the 17th century and the end of humankind.

games.name: Netherworld
games.summary: A weird jellyfish handles marriage crisis with alcohol, drugs, sex, blows and lots of odd characters.

games.name: Dark Atlas: Infernum
games.summary: If Hell is a state of the soul, this story is the descent to the inner abyss. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story , where the end of the world is combined with psychological terror in a survival horror experience with a strong narrative component.

games.name: Nordic Ashes: The Complete Saga
games.summary: Nordic Ashes is a challenging Norse inspired roguelite-survivor game, where you’ll have to survive hordes of creatures that come your way.

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: Call of the Elder Gods
games.summary: Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea.

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Looppip is a magical seed that carries an ancient hourglass with the power to turn back time. Your mission is to save the bee hives, essential for the survival of life on Earth, and reverse the environmental collapse threatening nature.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Red Moon Kingdom
games.summary: When a group of outcasts is sent to retrieve a wondrous artifact, a fatal mistake brings chaos upon the world. Explore, solve puzzles and card battle your way through a unique medieval fantasy setting full of magic with 3 controllable characters and in stunning 4K hand-drawn visuals.

games.name: Bloodseed: The Last Helsing
games.summary: Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

games.name: Uppercute
games.summary: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.name: Effulgence RPG
games.summary: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

games.name: LAN Party Adventures
games.summary: Okay, Pedro is AWOL, and you have to get this LAN Party set up at the Game Store for the session later. Connect cables, install software, and solve puzzles all while you and the gang uncover the mystery of your missing friend.

games.name: Umami
games.summary: Umami is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

games.name: Cosmic Horror Tales: Roots Below
games.summary:
Cosmic Horror Tales is a pixel art top-down action RPG that follows a young farmer searching for his missing chicken, Petunia. What begins as a simple errand soon turns into a descent into a nightmarish village where reality unravels, and forgotten gods whisper from the shadows.

Explore hand-crafted environments, solve light environmental puzzles, and fight to retain your sanity as you face grotesque creatures and surreal encounters.

With a strong narrative focus and atmospheric world-building, the game offers a compact but impactful experience lasting around 1-2 hours for its first act.

games.name: The Last Case of John Morley
games.summary: Step into the mind of John Morley, a 1940s detective on his final case. Explore shadowed places long forgotten by time, and piece together crime scenes in a narrative adventure steeped in mystery, unexpected twists, and a truth buried for decades.

games.name: Evil Inside VR
games.summary:
Evil Inside VR is not just a simple adaptation to Virtual Reality. It’s a complete reimagining of the original story, rebuilt to deliver a new, deeper, and more terrifying psychological horror experience. With significant changes in gameplay, lighting, sound, and puzzle design, this version completely transforms the way you experience Mark’s nightmare.

This is not the same Evil Inside you remember. It’s a new nightmare.

games.name: Plus Ultra: Legado
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a Mesoamerican metroidvania adventure, featuring vivid ligne-claire comic visuals set in the 16th century. Explore the intersection of two worlds in this spellbinding tale base on historical background with rich lore, dynamic combat, and a captivating soundtrack.

games.name: Cat-Astrophy
games.summary: Guide Polo, a brave abducted cat, through a vast universe of exotic planets. Face challenging combats, customize your abilities, and choose your own path in this epic space odyssey to uncover Polo’s lost memories.

games.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
games.summary: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

games.name: Together: Moon Escape
games.summary: Trapped on the Moon, two astronauts must work together to escape! Solve clever co-op puzzles, share laughs, and survive a hilarious lunar adventure with your partner.

games.name: Oniria
games.summary: Oniria is a first-person psychological horror game with a retro aesthetic. Explore the village by solving puzzles and evading the strange presence that haunts it. Experience Angy's present in 3D, and uncover her hidden memories in 2D.

games.name: Blightstone
games.summary: Blightstone is a challenging, dark fantasy turn-based roguelike that brings unique twists to combat through freedom of character placement, interactive environments and hardcore resource management. Dying, learning, and meta-progression will be key in your mission to destroy the Blightstone itself

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Shadows of the Afterland
games.summary:
Madrid, 1960. The old city zoo is rocked by a mysterious death, catapulting a soul to the threshold between the world of the living and the afterlife. But when the transition goes awry, the soul arrives with the memories of Carolina, one of the pioneers in Madrid's police force, who has yet to be born.

Step into Carolina’s shoes and plunge into a riveting adventure to unravel the enigma shrouding these ominous events. Explore the wacky realm of the afterlife, teeming with unique characters and with its own set of rules.

games.name: Dracamar
games.summary: Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight to free the Okis. Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

games.name: Forgotten Fragments
games.summary:
Help Enid, Ryder and Dayen recover the Forgotten Fragments in this beautiful pixel art adventure, where your puzzle-platformer skills will be put to the test!

Uncover all the mysteries in this Forgotten realm.

games.name: Echoes of Night: The Exodus of the Stars
games.summary: In this world consumed by darkness, where aberrant creatures lurk in the shadows... Prometheus is the only hope. In this action-platformer, you must find lost star fragments and rebuild the constellations to restore light to the universe.

games.name: Mira and the Legend of the Djinns
games.summary: An epic 2D pixel art style Metroidvania, inspired by Moroccan culture and spiritual traditions. Wield powerful ancient weapons and forge your way through unrelenting deserts, crumbling necropoli, floating islands and dangerous mountains as you try to uncover the secret of the last Djinn.

games.name: Adepts Arena
games.summary: Adepts Arena is a first-person adventure for both flat-screen and VR, featuring advanced physics-based effects. Master the power of the earth element, learn new abilities from ancient spirits, and aid them in their war against the sinister Golem Army!

games.name: Bogdan's Cross
games.summary: Embark on a journey of redemption as Bogdan, a fallen Templar seeking to make amends for his past sins. Explore a stunning world filled with ancient mysteries, uncover hidden secrets, and battle fierce enemies in this immersive action-adventure game.

games.name: Leafblade
games.summary: The coziest mix of ARPG and monster tamer. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

games.name: Teios' Journey
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling adventure through a vibrant world teeming with challenges and mysteries. Traverse diverse landscapes, solve intricate puzzles, and engage in epic battles as you unravel the secrets hidden within the land.

games.name: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
games.summary: Cute 2D Point-n-Click of the adorable comic book characters Jordi and Oslo the dragon.

games.name: Ties: Soul Link
games.summary:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

games.name: BrokenLore: Dark Dawn
games.summary: BrokenLore: DARK DAWN is a first-person psychological horror where you face the horrors of abduction and fight to escape a warped reality. Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Akaku Forest
games.summary: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

games.name: Tormented Souls II
games.summary: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: Mojito Woody's Rescue
games.summary: MOJITO Woody's Rescue puts you on a journey to find your best dog friend Woody, who has been kidnapped by an evil Cucumber, in a cute 3d adventure with sandbox levels, platforming challenges and exploration zones. Inspired by Super Mario 64 - Odyssey / Banjo Kazooie / Celeste

games.name: Super Woden: Rally Edge
games.summary: The spin-off of the acclaimed Super Woden saga, blending classic arcade essence with great depth and a genuine love for car culture. With a unique personality, Rally Edge takes you back to an era where fun goes beyond realism.

games.name: The Occultist
games.summary: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

games.name: The Next Stop
games.summary:
The Next Stop is a narrative adventure about a murder full of contradictions, where the clues don't add up and everything hides something darker. It blends point & click mechanics with the depth of a visual novel, all set in a haunting subway filled with secrets.

Eight people are on board. Eight stories. Eight hidden truths. Each stop on the train reveals a new chapter. Each carriage is a different experience. Every decision you make has consequences.

games.name: Souls Alive: Origins
games.summary: Souls Alive: Origins is a Lovecraftian survival horror game set in a dark sci-fi future. Explore a world where reality bends, ancient cults return, and Cthulhu stirs once more. With a strong focus on story, atmosphere, and visual detail.

games.name: Eko And The Bewitched Lands
games.summary: "Eko and the Bewitched Lands" is a roguelite action RPG game. Help Eko on his mission to save the bewitched lands filled with enemies. Acquire and upgrade weapons of all kinds to combat and discover all the secrets that awaits for you.

games.name: Empire in Decay
games.summary:
Empire in Decay is a roguelike deckbuilding turn-based tactical game, loosely based on chess. Its gameplay has been broadened with the use of cards and the progression of units. In the game, you'll proceed through procedurally generated routes across the districts of Daandria, the capital of the Empire.
In your journey to the Throne Hall to face the King, you will have to fight turn-based combats through different locations, collect cards and upgrade them, recruit units to support your cause and enhance them, find relics and forge artifacts to boost your powers, and use all your cunning and skill to make your way through waves of enemies.

games.name: Idolz
games.summary: The most badass online multiplayer fighting game, where you can kick your friend's or your favorite idol's ass. It's not just about throwing punches, but also insults and trash talk. The war is on!

games.name: Luto
games.summary:
This is a story about death.

Luto is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.

games.name: Sopa: Tale of the Stolen Potato
games.summary: Emotional narrative adventure about the things we pass along. Inspired by Miyazaki, Coco, and The Little Prince.

games.name: Peregrino
games.summary: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

games.name: Antro
games.summary: ANTRO. The underground revolution.An introspective journey to an underground world where music will be your ally.

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

games.name: Inanima
games.summary: Inanima Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Ink of Fate
games.summary: Explore the world of books, discover its secrets and collect every page in Ink of Fate. A narrative 3D puzzle game in which you will help Helena, a half elf who embarks on a journey to rewrite her destiny and avoid the tragic end imposed on her by her author.

games.name: Malvinas: La Ultima Carta
games.summary: The last survivor of a battalion (a teenage soldier) must protect the last letter of his fallen comrades. Undergo the hunger, cold and violence the Argentinean soldiers had to endure during the war on the islands.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Off-Score: A Game of Songs
games.summary: A surreal game that tells the stories of 3 songs. Play the music until the end by solving the puzzles and secrets along the way.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Terrible Life Expectancy
games.summary: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements, where you fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience. You only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing… or at least twitching.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: The Shadowed Rune
games.summary: 'The Shadowed Rune' is a challenging roguelike game that you can play solo or in two-player co-op. Combine the power of runes to discover new spells and ascend the tower to break the curse.

games.name: Tiny Shop
games.summary: Leave the hustle and bustle behind and bring your dream of a cozy little shop to life! Create, decorate, and watch visitors fall in love. Let your imagination run wild and craft a beautiful, inviting space they'll want to return to again and again.

games.name: The Scarlet Harvest
games.summary: A 90’s-inspired slasher survival horror. A Halloween party at a remote farm turns into a nightmare as you explore macabre farms, dark cornfields, and dangerous settings where you'll have to run, fight, and survive.

games.name: Oxide Room 208
games.summary: Eight people trapped in an old laboratory will try to survive their last moments of life in this frenetic body-horror full of action, blood and guts. Oxide Room 208 challenges you to face your fears in a dark and twisted environment where flesh and madness merge.

games.name: 9 Years of Shadows
games.summary: 9 Years of Shadows is an emotionally-driven Metroidvania, enhanced by healing music that tells the story of Europa, a young woman of noble birth tasked with ending the curse that plagues her people and restoring color to all lands.

games.name: Operation Highjump: The Fall of Berlin
games.summary: In the last days of World War II, lead a suicide mission to hunt down the enemy leaders, steal their experimental technology and recover the art pieces and relics. A combination of frenetic action, tactical missions and an explosive run & gun platforming adventure.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Hellfire Poncho
games.summary: Hellfire Poncho is a western rogue-lite isometric shooter. Shoot little demons with your upgraded weapons, die, and try again stronger. Bet your upgrades against the creatures you meet in the saloon, and develop your best build. Don't push your luck....

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: AlcheMice
games.summary: Explore 16th-century Granada, steeped in tarot and alchemy. Face Gusparda, the cursed witch, and fight for your freedom. Build your deck, choose every move across 3D boards, and use strategy and tactics to break the curse and craft the Philosopher’s Stone.

games.name: Rogue Mansion
games.summary:
Rogue Mansion is a survival horror game combined with the best of the roguelike genre! Explore a procedurally generated mansion that changes every time you play, and becomes more dangerous and unpredictable according to your level of fear.

Experience the game in different ways, by choosing from multiple unique characters, each with their own equipment, specialist perks, and motivations.

events.name: Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
events.description: Join us on Sept 12 at 6am PT for a Nintendo Direct! Tune in for roughly 60 minutes of information on upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch games.

games.name: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2
games.summary: Travel the stars with Mario in enhanced versions of these beloved adventures.

games.name: Mario Tennis Fever
games.summary:
Hit the court for explosive action in the latest Mario Tennis game!

Join Mario and friends for over-the-top tennis mayhem! Use topspins, slices, lobs, and other familiar shots—along with other fancy footwork and new defensive maneuvers—to outpace your opponents on the court. Keep a rally going, build up your Fever Gauge, and unleash powerful Fever Shots that can be augmented with special effects by equipping Fever Rackets!

games.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Meetup in Bellabel Park
games.summary: More experiences are coming to the Flower Kingdom! Enjoy a variety of attractions in the Bellabel Park plaza that lets you team up with (or work against) friends and family. Collect the most coins, run and hide in Phanto Tag, work together to pass a Bob-omb to the goal and more! This Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds even more content and enhancements as well.

games.name: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book
games.summary:
Join Yoshi for a new adventure in Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, launching on Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2026.

One day, on the island where Yoshi and his friends live, a peculiar talking book named Mr. E suddenly falls from the sky. This peculiar book’s pages contain information about unusual creatures, so Yoshi decides to jump in and help investigate!

As Yoshi wanders through the book, you'll make all sorts of discoveries about the creatures you find and those discoveries will be written down. You'll find lots of unusual creatures residing within the book – a page-turning adventure awaits!

games.name: Storm Lancers
games.summary:
You and your friend just crash-landed on an alien planet harboring a secret source of powerful magic. All of reality is on the verge of collapse, and two magical creatures have chosen you as their heroes. To save the planet, you’ll fight, die, and bond with the Stormhearts to rise again — stronger, fiercer, and unstoppable.

Designed for couch co-op, Storm Lancers is a fast-paced rogue-like, where every run means dodging death, overcoming enemies, and mastering powerful skills. The battle is on, so team up for survival.

games.name: Dinkum
games.summary: G’Day! Get ready to start a new fair Dinkum life and build your new home out in the bush. Explore tropical eucalyptus forests, scorching deserts and cool billabongs on an Island inspired by the wild Australian outback. Take care of giant wombats, play with friends and get ready for a ripper time!

games.name: Popucom
games.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

games.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
games.summary: Create Mii characters based on family and friends, someone you admire, or something completely original—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

games.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection
games.summary:
Step into the arena and choose your fighter! Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection includes all the essential games from Mortal Kombat's early years. Experience the legendary origins of the franchise with the iconic arcade classics that started it all—alongside a curated selection of most-loved home versions for the Super NES and Sega Genesis. Dive deeper with rare and fan-favorite releases across the Game Boy, Game Gear, Sega 32X, Game Boy Advance, and more—a celebration of the franchise’s groundbreaking legacy.

Digital Eclipse's interactive documentary format explores how Mortal Kombat changed the way society perceived video games. By using digitized humans as player sprites in an over-the-top, martial-arts fighter, the game thrilled players, shocked critics, and laid the foundation for a franchise that has thrived for more than 30 years. Hear firsthand from the original dev team of Ed Boon, John Tobias, John Vogel, and Dan Forden, along with other exclusive interviews, rare concept art, vintage marketing materials, and archival video footage.

Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection also lets players explore Mortal Kombat lore, with a timeline of the original series' storyline and comprehensive character histories that offer stories, secrets, and glimpses behind the scenes at their creation.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.summary: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade is an enhanced and expanded version of Final Fantasy VII Remake that features a new episode starring Yuffie and introduces an exhilarating new story arc with numerous gameplay additions for players to enjoy.

games.name: Lynked: Banner of the Spark
games.summary: Team-up, brawl and build in this co-op action game that blends hack and slash combat with roguelite-inspired missions and town-building progression that goes beyond the run! Unlock and upgrade gear, rescue robot allies, and lead the resistance against the world-dominating Combots!

games.name: Hades II
games.summary: Battle beyond the Underworld using dark sorcery to take on the Titan of Time in this bewitching sequel to the award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.

games.name: Kirby Air Riders
games.summary:
Kirby Air Riders is the long-awaited sequel to Kirby Air Ride on the Gamecube.

Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

games.name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
games.summary:
Fight the war for ancient Hyrule! Step on to the battlefield as Princess Zelda, King Rauru, and other legendary heroes as you fight to reclaim your homeland— and live the story of Demon King Ganondorf's invasion that was only briefly alluded to in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom game.

Princess Zelda is not alone in this war! Join Mineru, the Sages, and even some brand-new heroes in battles against Ganondorf's forces. Combine powerful Zonai Devices with your heroes' signature abilities to take down powerful bosses and their legions of minions.

games.name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
games.summary: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

games.name: Mario's Tennis
games.summary: Mario's Tennis is a tennis game that was released as a launch title for the Virtual Boy. It is the first tennis-related Mario game, and would later be followed by the Mario Tennis series. You get to choose from seven different characters, all with different ability levels, to play against each other in either singles or doubles matches. You can also play in an exhibition or tournament mode.

games.name: Galactic Pinball
games.summary:
Prepare to enter the vast expanse of the Milky Way. Put your pinball skills to an interstellar test with four incredible space tables.

Blast your pinball at rotating planets and turn them into dust in the Cosmic world. Send your puck flying through galactic formations in the deep-space Colony. Defeat an evil skeleton and hit the ultimate UFO jackpot! Knock down multiple rings and destroy wicked assailants in an Alien place. Defy arduous obstacles and save the world from impending devastation!

games.name: Teleroboxer
games.summary:
In a savage display of pounding moves and lightning action, robotic boxers from around the globe step into a futuristic ring. Mirroring the movements of the humans in control, each Teleroboxer is capable of surviving defense matches unbearable to mankind.

Slug it out to the staggering end to determine the true world champion. Created with specialized Techtronic powers and unique personalities, these responsive machines show no mercy on their way to the brutal top.

games.name: Red Alarm
games.summary:
Bursting through incredible dimensions of Virtual space the final mission is clear. Obliterate all enemies and obstacles created by KAOS and terminate this menacing battle system from within.

Employing an impressive arsenal of high-tech weapons and evasive maneuvers the Tech-Wing Fighter speeds on. Spinning deaths, spy pods and mosquito mechs appear from everywhere! The fate of humanity will soon be defined. Red Alarm! Red Alarm! Alarm Condition Red!!

games.name: Virtual Boy Wario Land
games.summary: Yikes!!! Get ready for a devious treasure hunt with the infamous scheming Wario. Capture the shining gold and vast treasures locked deep inside a hidden cave. But, beware of poison ponds, perilous prisons, endless walls and creepy woods! Make a quick change into Sea Dragon Wario, Eagle Wario or Bull Wario and utilize their mighty strengths. Blow away enemy cave defenders with body attacks and power actions. Succeed in this greedy plot to seize the riches of this underground world and find this key to freedom!

games.name: Jack Bros.
games.summary: The portal between Earth and another mysterious dimension has opened, and the intrepid Jack Brothers have come through for an adventure in our world.
