You are the Dark Queen—the most powerful being of your entire universe. Your lair is breached by an aspiring hero—a pitiful thing, easily crushed.

Except they keep coming back.

A 20 minute anti-game about an unconventional relationship and the capacity for change.

games.name: The Girl from Arkanya
games.summary: Arkanya is a 2D adventure RPG about an aspiring young treasure hunter named Marisa and her capybara companion! Explore deep within the jungles of Amazonia, discover a deep alternate world history, and amass your fortune as you strive to become the world's greatest treasure hunter!

games.name: Blippo+
games.summary: Blippo+ is a live-action, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don't touch that remote—everything's about to get bent.

games.name: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi
games.summary: Altheia: The Wrath of Aferi is a fantasy adventure game where a sword–wielding Guardian and an arcane Monk must learn to work together to defeat the Void corrupting their home. Explore ruined temples, solve environmental puzzles, rescue spirits, and defeat giant Void monsters!

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: Oku
games.summary: Become a zen monk and embark on a journey towards spiritual growth. Ride the wind across artistic Japanese landscapes as you write Haiku-like poems to capture the beauty of nature and unlock forgotten paths.

events.name: Convergence Games Showcase 2025
events.description: Convergence is upgrading in 2025! Bigger, better and working hand-in-hand with the most important gaming creators to celebrate the best new indie games.

games.name: Escape the Backrooms
games.summary: Explore the seemingly infinite expanse of eerily familiar levels in the backrooms based on the popular creepypasta lore. Each level features different ways to escape with danger along the way.

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: Oneway.exe
games.summary:
oneway.exe is a first-person, single player horror game, with a heavy focus on story and internet culture. Explore, survive and solve puzzles to find out what happened to UNTITLED.EXE, its developers, and understand why you're in the middle of it.

Face the internet horrors that haunt your past. The one's you've never heard of. They don't exist.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Zwaard
games.summary: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Lootbound
games.summary: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

games.name: Dimhaven: The Lost Source
games.summary: After several years, the team behind Quern - Undying Thoughts is back with new mysteries to unfold. Explore Dimhaven, solve mind-bending puzzles and uncover the truth behind the Ravenwood legacy in this first-person adventure.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
games.summary: A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

games.name: High Times
games.summary: Sit back and relax as you play the role of a donut therapist in this cozy dating/cooking sim. Feeling nervous? Need some happiness in your life? Here at High Times, there's a donut for every mood.

games.name: Winter Survival
games.summary: Winter Survival is a story-driven survival game where trauma turns reality into a reflection of your breaking mind. Battle cold, hunger, hallucinations, and adapt to the wilderness as it adapts to you.

games.name: Desktop Explorer
games.summary:
Desktop Explorer is an eerie point-n-click mystery game through the abandoned profiles of an old PC.

Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them?

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Jupiter Junkworks
games.summary: Fast paced arcade puzzle action awaits you in Jupiter Junkworks! Complete arcade puzzle contracts to earn resources while rebuilding and upgrading a ruined spaceship junkyard. All set in a sci-fi narrative campaign mode where you'll join an unlikely trio of travellers as they overcome challenges.

games.name: Pao Pao
games.summary: Pao Pao is a wild mix of culinary diving and animal madness—where you become the ultimate restaurant boss and management guru! Gather ingredients, go fishing, and expand your spot solo or with friends. Every order turns into an epic adventure… Jump in and experience it for yourself!

games.name: Everything Is Crab
games.summary: The Animal Evolution roguelite. Hunt, Flee, Scavenge & Thrive in a living ecosystem. Choose from over 100 mutations to evolve your creature in countless ways with every run. Adapt to survive the natural curve in order to beat carcinisation... or get Darwin'd trying!

games.name: Stuck Together
games.summary: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner. Failure is always one slip away.

games.name: Oneway.exe
games.summary:
oneway.exe is a first-person, single player horror game, with a heavy focus on story and internet culture. Explore, survive and solve puzzles to find out what happened to UNTITLED.EXE, its developers, and understand why you're in the middle of it.

Face the internet horrors that haunt your past. The one's you've never heard of. They don't exist.

games.name: Everspace 2: Wrath of the Ancients
games.summary: The Ancients have awakened! Their wrath has laid waste to human settlements in Cluster 34, and the path of destruction leads to the Okkar Homeworlds. Take flight in this massive expansion DLC as the Cluster readies for war once again in EVERSPACE 2: Wrath of the Ancients.

games.name: Iter-8
games.summary: Welcome to the surface, ITER employee #8. Mine the Pillar, upgrade your tools, defend your base, reach the top... or die miserably. Each expendable worker pushes the mission forward - one glorious, replaceable iteration at a time.

games.name: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis
games.summary: The Signal: Stranded on Sirenis is a single-player survival craft game set on a captivating alien planet that has ensnared you. Scavenge, build, extract, and survive your way through a complex world as you reveal the true intentions of this sentient planet - and why it has brought you here.

games.name: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef
games.summary: An action roguelike co-op dungeon crawler set in a lovecraftian universe.

games.name: Angel
games.summary: Angel is a rhythm-racing adventure in which digital climate change threatens the eCho network with extinction. Players can propel through digital landscapes, crafting new break beats to infuse a stagnating network with the spark of renewal. Angel imbues the flow state of racing with the complexity of breakbeat music, redefining arcade and combo-based gameplay and enhancing it with a soundtrack from MyraTV and many other breakbeat enthusiasts.

games.name: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars
games.summary: Through Blood and Dragons: Dragon Wars is a third-person, fantasy-themed, on-rails shooter for a single player; players take the role of an archer on the back of a dragon AND the dragon itself through short first-person dragon-breath segments.

games.name: Mars Attracts
games.summary: Mars Attracts is a park management sim set in the iconic universe of Mars Attacks. Build rides, hire staff, manage guest needs, and abduct humans to serve as the star attractions. You'll face demanding visitors, environmental hazards, and the ever-looming threat of human escapes!

games.name: A Storied Life: Tabitha
games.summary: A wholesome narrative puzzle game about the objects we leave behind and the stories they tell. Complete a loved one's damaged memoirs by exploring their home and packing away their things.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

games.name: Stario: Haven Tower
games.summary: Build a vertical city in a world of a tower. Lead the dwellers to gather resources from the sky and build upwards. Make vertical transport and climbs up. Explore the creatures and sceneries in higher skies.

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Gas Station Simulator: RV Camp
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a campground manager in the brand-new RV Camp DLC for Gas Station Simulator. Rent out spots to travelers and complete diverse minigames to help them while away the hours. Expand your campsite, tackle various challenges, and help Ruby create the best resort the world has ever seen.

games.name: Eclipsium
games.summary: Eclipsium is a trippy and surreal horror game that will take you on a journey through darkness and confusion. In this haunting and immersive experience, you'll need to traverse a dark and twisted world to reach a tower that's looming in the distance.

games.name: Shadows of Doubt
games.summary:
Shadows of Doubt is a detective stealth game set in a fully-simulated neo-noir metropolis.

An open world stealth game with a whole city of secrets at your fingertips!

Set in an alternate reality hyper-industrialized 1980s where the government outsources police work to private corporations and contractors. You play the role of a private intelligence investigator, making money by finding and selling information. Capture of the rampant serial killer carries a hefty bounty, but who knows what secrets you’ll find along the way. In this world of secrets & lies, information is power, and the cards you hold are determined by how far you’ll go to acquire it…

Break into apartments, rifle through secret documents and hack security systems. The entire world is fully simulated. Each citizen has an apartment, a job, a daily routine, favorite things to do, places to go, and people to interact with. Uncover this knowledge and use it to your advantage!

games.name: Nutmeg!
games.summary: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Emotionless: The Last Ticket
games.summary: Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth, but beware, some things should stay buried.

games.name: Dicealot
games.summary: A roguelike dice roller with deckbuilding elements

games.name: Revelation of Decay
games.summary: Zombies have taken over our homes! Pick up guns, organize a brave team, and fuck up those monsters! Farm land, scavenge a large apocalyptic world, and fight various of zombies! Modify your weapons, defeat scaring bosses, and finally uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak and save our home!

games.name: Towa and the Guardians of the Sacred Tree
games.summary: In this Roguelite set in a far-off mystic realm, ancient forces stir, and untold dangers await. As Towa, lead the guardians of the sacred tree in forging strong relationships and powerful swords to fight Magatsu’s forces and determine the future of Shinju Village.

games.name: Identifile
games.summary:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

games.name: Fogpiercer
games.summary: Build your train to build your deck. Fight off bandits in a post apocalyptic world. Progress and unlock new train combinations with synergies. Get drivers to their final destinations.

events.name: SAGE 2025
events.description: A yearly online event for Sonic the Hedgehog fangame developers to chat online and to demonstrate finished and unfinished games they are developing.

games.summary: An upcoming platformer inspired by NiGHTS into Dreams and Freedom Dive.

games.name: A2C: Ayry Seems to be Playtesting a 2D Runner Shooter from Cci
games.summary: A 2D runner shmup(shoot-em up) where you may or may not save a nation by beating a game. Shoot and dodge bullets while you keep running and jumping! Enjoy a story where you play the game made by Cci while Ayry and Cci banter with each other(and talk about the world of Nosolute and game development)!

games.name: Acroflow
games.summary: Dive through dimensions with style in this 3D expressive platformer! Join Acro and Flora on their cosmic quest to reunite and return home. Use their acrobatic abilities to jump, dive and spin through bite-sized arcade platforming challenges set across multiple dream-like realms!

games.name: Advent Neon
games.summary: Hyperactive 2D action platformer with wicked fast attacks, omnidirectional dashing, and time-freezing! Play well enough to transform and unleash 100% power!

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

games.name: Astropods: Starside Glaze
games.summary:
Astropods: Starside Glaze is a 2D Fighting Platformer with endless mobility and combat potential! Starring as Hemi and Acro, swap between them at any time to utilize their unique attacks and physics within various environments.

Astropods combines platform fighter combat with platformer styled levels, alongside nonlinear progression and perk customization, to create a dynamic combat-platforming experience unlike anything else!

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Bombun
games.summary: High above the clouds, Bombun, a bomb-throwing rabbit, defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe, Robombun.

games.name: Buster's Big Score
games.summary: Pull off heists in this jazzy fast-paced 2D platformer as legendary(-ish) thief Buster Speedway! Smoothly combine your acrobatic abilities and novelty gadgets to sneak past guards. Slide into the vault to the jewels and hoist your score before making a quick getaway back to your hideout!

games.name: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
games.summary:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

games.name: Candy Rangers
games.summary: Go on a single player, On-Rails Shooter Adventure in Candy Rangers and match 4 colors with 4 rangers! Each ranger can take down enemies that match their color, and it's up to you to use each one accordingly! Can you match them all?

games.name: Canvas Intruder
games.summary: Canvas Intruder is a game about an artist named Pix who got sucked into the canvas world unfortunately thanks to her apprentice's black magic. goofy. But now its up to Pix to navigate through these canvas levels!

games.name: Cosmo Vulpes
games.summary: Inspired by 90's and 2000's 3D platformers, Cosmo Vulpes is a sci-fi adventure where your main tool is the jetpack. Play as bounty hunter fox called Klaus, with his jetpack and others gadgets developed by his friend Safira, a brilliant and skilled mechanic, you will help him to pass through challenges and missions on this adventure, earning money and collecting Vultechs, which are a big source of energy, but he is not the only one looking for them!

games.name: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend
games.summary: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend is a story-driven indie RPG where you play as Michael, a nerdy kangaroo inventor from the Tech District. They have a lifelong goal of making monsters less of a threat to society. And their research takes them to the abandoned offices of the Mall District to test a theory regarding how monsters relate to the memories of the deceased. Things go well, but then they get caught up in a corporate nightmare. Slowly breaking them down and leaving them desperately searching for a way to escape.

games.name: David Get Keen
games.summary: Get Keen for fast-paced 3D platforming built around momentum. Run, dash, and spin through abstract levels, smash up robots, and improve your best times.

games.name: Disaster Arms: Impact Project B.A.H.N.
games.summary: Disaster Arms is a 2D run-and-gun boss rush game. Shoot and punch your way through a ceaseless gauntlet of giant alien and robotic lifeforms.

games.name: Dono's Tale
games.summary: Relive the glory days of the 16 and 32-bit era in Dono's Tale. A super cute and colorful platformer about a hungry little dragon! Jump, dash, climb, and shoot your way through detailed and colorful worlds in order to get back your precious fruit!

games.name: Dream Enkoure
games.summary: A not so simple platformer where you go from left to right.

games.name: Dungeon Gals
games.summary: A small polycule-turned-crisis control team been summoned to help a civilization in the sky escape impending doom! Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and find lots of treasure to help prepare yourself for incredible challenges!

games.name: Honey Bunny
games.summary: Honey Bunny is a bartender at Lucky Rabbit's Foot Casino, the cutest casino in all of Starlight City! She's busy at work when the no-good gang, The Cool Cats, steals away the casino and the entire city's supply of cocktail cherries. Chase them down as Honey Bunny using your ears to headbutt enemies, grab items, and platform around the city as you recover as many cherries as possible!

games.name: KilaFlow
games.summary: Play as the mascot of a blazing fast (for it's time) antivirus software to clear out corruptions and viruses from various devices around a town.

games.name: Knight George
games.summary: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.summary: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: Lylia's Deadline: Clearance
games.summary: A sequel to the original Lylia's Deadline which features high-speed 2.5D gameplay, low-poly 3D graphics, Rocking music, and more heat-based combat mechanics.

games.name: Lyrestruck
games.summary: This game follows Irina, who's been wandering through an endless forest, in search of an exit. Will she discover the roots of this curse and break out?

games.name: Pomeraider
games.summary: Pomeraider's an arcade game heavily inspired by the classic Mario Bros!

games.name: Potatostrike
games.summary: A space shmup featuring the ultimate potato-based space fighter.

games.name: Rad Venture
games.summary: Taking inspiration from 2000s 3D platformers and Shounen anime, Rad Venture is an edgy and stylized approach to the indie 3D platformer resurgence. Take control of Rad, an ex-magician's apprentice, on his journey to finish his community service while exploring a huge and magical world.

games.name: Rebellion Stryker
games.summary: Gun your way through this cyberpunk Run-n-Gun with never-before-seen hand-drawn graphics! Pick between two characters and even play co-op in this arcade title!

games.name: Rollin' Rascal
games.summary: Rollin’ Rascal is a high-speed action platformer that will test your reflexes and creativity as you zoom through a whimsical world in search of adventure! Strap in for a thrilling ride filled with speed, excitement, and a cast of endearing characters—an experience that will delight classic speedster fans while also introducing newcomers to the genre!

games.name: Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut
games.summary: Rolling Ball Game returns with Rolling Ball Game DX: Director's Cut! Traverse through obstacles and avoid the capsule-bots trying to knock you off the stage. Featuring all new and remastered levels, alongside extra content.

games.name: Smitty 2
games.summary: Smitty 2 brings back the adorable platforming adventure into a brand new level! Walk, hop and sprint through the interconnected areas around Dripsdale and search for Dropple Capsules and Energy Pellets scattered throughout.

games.name: Soda-Powered Penguin
games.summary: Control a soda-propelled penguin in this fast-paced precision platformer!

games.name: Super Freaks Side Story: Scruffy Minus - The Rise of the Anti-Freaks
games.summary: A new Classic Super Freaks game, Scruffy Minus is a new platforming adventure (with some freaky surprises!) Run, jump, and activate your different superpowered Suits, to kick butt!

games.name: Toree Saturn
games.summary: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!

games.name: Warrior Spirit
games.summary: A 3D adventure video game for all ages. Use Warrior Spirit's many tools and abilities such as the Four Arms, Bracelets of Good, and Clay for platforming, combat, exploring, and solving puzzles. Travel through various lands and defeat Evil by serving the will and power of Perfect Good.

games.name: Witchfall: Secrets of Emotica
games.summary: Welcome to the world of Witchfall, a magical land filled with adventure! Play as five adorable critters: Koemi, Rez, Maya, Sloberg or Envel as they embark on a perilous journey to stop the evil Professor Flitz from stealing the mysterious Emotica Shards.

games.name: Zafe's Adventures
games.summary: Zafe's Adventures is a new and simplified 2D platformer game with a simple run and gun elements and gameplay. Inspired by abandonware platformer, Sonic the Hedgehog series and its fangame, Spark the Electric Jester, Jazz Jackrabbit and Freedom Planet and as well with other simple 2D game that was made using GameMaker or Scratch in the past. This has been considered as a small solo indie game project only. The game follows a young and heroic pyrokinetic cartoon humanoid who tries to fight back against evil entities around the hillside wilderness. While he ends up on a long journey through another different world via the mysterious dimension portal.

games.name: Geno 2 the Generals' Orders
games.summary: Take out demonic generals that have taken over the planet! Destroy giga robots, save the cities, give the citizens their homes back, and stop the reign of terror from the 6 masterminds. Collect power orbs to unlock new areas and explore the open world of each location.

games.name: Chapter Zero: The Angel Island Saga
games.summary: The world is a chaotic, terrifying place, rife with all manner of monsters, warlords and hostile architecture. Even for the mighty Pachacamac clan, just the act of survival is a day to day struggle, and everybody seems to know that they can't keep it up forever. In pursuit of a safe home, a lone shaman named Ichima happens apon the Special Stage - and with it, a means of realizing their dreams of safety and peace...

games.name: EvilBritishGuy's Sonic and The Hedgehogs
games.summary: Sonic and The Hedgehogs reimagines how an Open-World Sonic game should play, Open-World in this context meaning that Sonic is free to go anywhere and do anything that Sonic can and would do. Rather than only rapidly progressing through mostly linear stages to reach a goal miles away from where you start, Sonic makes whatever world he finds himself in his playground.

games.name: Knuckles Quest
games.summary: Knuckles Quest is a continuation of the treasure hunting gameplay style that was present in Sonic Adventure and Sonic Adventure 2, now with a custom framework and levels. Using a radar, search the area for all the emerald pieces, but be careful: the locations are randomly selected!

games.name: Kura5: Bonds of the Undying
games.summary:
Kura5 is a non-canonical fan game for the Boktai series and its successor, Lunar Knights. It's neither a full remake nor a sequel, but a remix of both familiar Boktai staples and new elements that seek to recreate the magic that we all loved from the series.

Kura5's weather system knows where you are in the real world, so there's no need for a solar sensor. In-game events may even play out differently depending on if you play in darkness or in light... And that's just the start!

games.name: Mega Met
games.summary: A Mega Man fan game which features Metalls (Mets) as the entire cast of characters, enemies and bosses.

games.name: Nights: Moonlight Dreams...
games.summary: Nights: Moonlight Dreams... is a fan game of Nights into Dreams, developed by Marco Medina.

games.name: Project Reignition
games.summary: Project Reignition is an on-rails platformer developed by KumaPauZ. This unofficial remake of Sonic and the Secret Rings, originally developed by Sonic Team and published by SEGA in 2007 for the Wii, aims to bring the classic game to modern systems. Built using the Godot engine, this free and open-source project features enhanced graphics, refined controls, and a smoother frame rate, offering a fresh experience while staying true to the original.

games.name: Sonic Battle R
games.summary: Gather your friends and see who is truly the fastest in this no hold barred fast track. Featuring many different stages through the Sonic series enhancing the stages with new features for multiplayer. Explore the world and work together to complete missions.

games.name: Sonic Battle Rush
games.summary:
Based on the original on the Gameboy Advance, Sonic and the gang are back to duke it out with each other once more! Only this time as a 2D traditional fighter!

Fight as Sonic the Hedgehog and Shadow the Hedgehog in the Sage demo and learn the ins and outs of their expanded moveset!

Old mechanics from the original are making a return here as well!

games.name: Sonic Colors Demastered
games.summary:
Sonic Colors Demastered is a 2D reimagining of Sonic Colors for the Nintendo Wii and Nintendo DS. The game features gameplay inspired by the Sonic Rush series and a fully original level design and soundtrack.

Join Sonic, Tails, and a colorful cast of aliens to put a stop to Eggman’s plans for interstellar domination! Use Sonic’s signature suite of abilities, including the boost, grind, and homing attack, to make your way through exhilarating, high-speed 2D platforming challenges!

games.name: Sonic CD's Scrapped Rounds
games.summary: This mod returns the scrapped levels of the Sonic CD: Dubious Depths, Baneful Badland (reimagined Desert Dazzle) and Final Fever. Levels become part of the main game, not additional levels. They are made according to existing information and concepts about them, but at the same time, the mod does not try to authentically and accurately recreate the levels, but is a free interpretation of the author. All level's assets and objects are custom. The mod has a little customization of names and level music; some of the music was written specifically for the levels, while others were borrowed from other authors, most of whom are part of the team.

games.name: Sonic Eternal
games.summary: Sonic Eternal is a fan game inspired by Sonic 3 and Knuckles Chaotix.

games.name: Sonic Rush Rerun
games.summary:
Sonic Rush Rerun is a full fan reimagining of the Nintendo DS game “SONIC RUSH”. The idea behind this remake is to take the greatest strengths of the Sonic Rush trilogy (Rush, Rush Adventure, and Colors DS), crank them up to 11, and combine those strengths into the ultimate remake of Sonic Rush!

Boost through familiar zones with refined, low-poly, 2.5D visuals with newly implemented moves and tricks to really kick things into high gear! With the retuning Advance 2 launcher system and the Stomp and Air Boost from Colors DS, Sonic and Blaze can rush through these revamped stages faster than ever before!

games.name: Sonic Tameshi
games.summary:
Sonic Tameshi is a Classic Sonic Fan Game created on the Sonic Worlds engine.

The game's story follows Sonic after he finds out about Dr Eggman's new plan to extract all the natural resources from an Mystical island. Face Metal Sonic and save the island, stop Eggman from building the Pleasure Island Theme Park and save the beautiful paradise hidden on the other side of the sea. Sonic will feature the Drop Dash, Insta-Shield, Peel Out and a Wall jump!

games.name: Sonic: Lock & Load
games.summary:
Sonic: Lock & Load is a hyper-fast stylish action first-person shooter based on the Sonic the Hedgehog series of games and built on GZDoom.

It's heavily inspired by the high-speed platforming of Sonic Robo Blast 2, the heavily movement-based FPS gameplay of ULTRAKILL and the stylish action of Devil May Cry.

games.name: Triku
games.summary: Meet Triku, a platform-adventure game that's made for fans of Monster World IV and Shantae in which you take control of Triku who must travel across various areas filled with enemies to avoid and dungeons to enter.

games.name: Scouter
games.summary: Welcome to Scouter! A fast-paced action platformer oozing to the brim with 90's anime goodness! This is a really fast-paced action game where your goal is to get to the end and fight as many enemies (and be as stylish) as you possibly can!

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Arca
games.summary: News of the Great Flood has reached the South Pole, and rumor has it there's an Ark ready to help... but only one spot per species! Jump, slide, and sabotage your rivals as you race against time to secure your place. It's every penguin for itself and the world against them all!

games.name: Archa
games.summary:
As Archa, fight enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and get the Interdimensional Pumpkins or Carrots in this upcoming Bullet-Hell Platformer!

Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

games.name: Art Strikers
games.summary: Draw your path to victory in Art Strikers! A unique art themed bullet hell shoot-em-up that looks and plays like a beautiful work of art.

games.name: Hexachampions
games.summary: Hexachampions is a TCG-tabletop RPG hybrid: every Champion has its unique die and abilities. Your strategy is key, but it will be up to the roll of the dice to dictate what your tools will be. So you always know what to blame in case you lose.

games.name: Hot Job 94'
games.summary: Hot Job 94 is a 3D action platformer inspired by the early 2000's GameCube games such as Sonic Adventure and Super Mario Sunshine. Control 5 different characters with unique attributes like speed, flight, shooting, and combat.

games.name: Stardust the Unicorn
games.summary: A small platformer inspired by old-school speed games. Help Stardust rescue his friends from the Kelpie Kingdom using his speed, horn, and magic dusts that grant him different abilities. Jump around, run, and use your abilities to advance through the levels. Watch out for obstacles and use different dusts to help you progress. Different dusts grant you different powers, which you can use to your advantage. Try them all and use your favorite one.

games.name: Beavis And Butt-Head In Quest To Score
games.summary: Beavis and Butt-head can't afford tickets to a concert that they want to go to as the tickets are 20bucks and unfortunately they only had 20 cents. With a goal in mind to score and to do things that don't suck Beavis and Butt-Head set off to get $20 to pay for the tickets and to acquire the delicacy known as Nachos as the venue didn't sell it.

games.name: Abstract Tales: Techno-World
games.summary: Abstract Tales: Techno-World is a beat 'em up with cute cartoony characters and some action! Join Adrian, Elliott, Cindy, Canaan, and Clover and help them to reach Techno-World and save their parents before it's too late! Play with 5 different characters, use different special moves, go through 11 stages, and unleash your power!

games.name: Captain Commander's Conquest
games.summary: Players take on the role of the titular Captain Commander, piloting a spaceship to combat hordes of enemy ships in SHMUP mode. When boarding or being boarded, the gameplay shifts to FPS mode, where players must defend against or take over enemy vessels.

games.name: Demon Tides
games.summary: Explore the open seas and uncover the kingdom's dark secrets as you expressively platform your way across dozens of locales, upgrading your gear every step of the way!

games.name: Dynamite Flare
games.summary: Join Flare, the grooviest bounty hunter, as she hunts down dangerous criminals for fame and fortune in this stylish 2D beat 'em up. Inspired by the 'golden age' with a twist, brace yourself for a neon-soaked underworld where every fiery move propels Flare toward her dream palace in the stars!

games.name: Dystopia Derby
games.summary: Dystopia Derby is a grappling hook racing game where the speed limit is your skill limit. Combine different movement abilities together to create your own movement system and surpass speed itself.

games.name: JeliWave
games.summary: JeliWave is a linear 3D platformer with the visual appearance of retro games from the 90s. Swing your way through various worlds, unlock new abilities and master the art of Jeli's grapple!

games.name: MDF: Magical Defense Force
games.summary: MDF: Magical Defense Force is a unique story focused Magical Girl Visual Novel, featuring a cast of strange and entertaining character, monster of the week action, comedy, a rocking soundtrack and artistically rendered fight scenes.

games.name: Moussacre
games.summary: Imprisoned for nearly a century, MouseTrap finally breaks out and goes on a rampage to steal color... by any means necessary. Experience fast-paced 2D platforming mayhem while slashing apart legions of victims who stand in your way.

games.name: My Slime Garden
games.summary: Raise, nurture, and breed adorable slimes in a relaxing adventure where each slime is unique! Mix traits to create new slime companions and explore endless islands filled with secrets and surprises. Your perfect slime squad is waiting for you. How far can you take them?

games.name: Star Garden
games.summary: Dive into an electrifying single-player story or take on thrilling multiplayer battles with up to four players locally or six online. Star Garden brings creature collection, exploration, and fast-paced action to life in stunning, dynamic worlds. Your interstellar adventure awaits!

games.name: Techpack Collection
games.summary: Techpack Collection is a remake of the 1980s-styled arcade game released in 2020 on Steam, Techpack. In this new version, you will find a whole brand-new menu, redone gameplay, and even more selectable arcade games! If you're a fan of old arcade games and the challenges they bring, this game may give you a kick!

games.name: Bowser Gets Clever: Insert Subtitle Here
games.summary: This game is half-parody of a Super Mario Bros. game, a reimagining of a really old game made in 2009 by Adrien Dittrick.

games.name: Super Sonic Battle
games.summary: Full fledged Sonic Fighting game - Super Sonic Battle. Developed to celebrate the 20th Anniversary of the GBA title Sonic Battle!

games.name: Sonic Islands
games.summary: Sonic Islands is an open zone fan-game inspired by the Sonic Frontiers game. Sonic and his friends need to help the Guardian of the Aurora Islands defeat a greater evil being that has been taking over the now destroyed civilization of Aurora for years.

games.name: Catatattack!
games.summary: A High Octane Side Scrolling Beat-Em-Up in Development! By Cats, For Cats!

games.name: The Spirit Engine DX
games.summary: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

games.name: Black Cat Bundle
games.summary: Black Cat Bundle is a 2D arcade platformer that consists of two games: Black Cat Blitz and Black Cat Brawl. Avoid obstacles and reach a high score either alone or with a buddy in Black Cat Blitz. Either that or grab seven of your friends and duke it out in the team-based showdown Black Cat Brawl!

games.name: Psycutlery
games.summary:
It's a spoon. And yet, it's also a fork. Or is it either? It's a video game-type thing currently in development here at Eyes in Everything, by Luke Tarlowe.

Take control of Lillian the Alien and her mind-controlled spork. Bring down an incomprehensible abomination of evil with a single piece of silverware, and witness copious craziness unfold across the planet!

games.name: Electigirl: High Tension Beauty
games.summary: A retro and free-scrolling shoot 'em up. The plot follows a city being drained of electric supply by otherworldly invaders.

games.name: Galactic Blasters BR: Artist's Faith
games.summary: It's a horizontally scrolling boss rush shooter game that takes place on Light Island, where a member of the H.D.E. finds a bunch of enemy spacecraft in the Northern Mountains.

games.name: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
games.summary: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

games.name: Solitaire Battle
games.summary: Slay your enemies by playing solitaire, synergize your card-powered attacks and abilities, then break the game and become the best to ever Solitaire Battle in this roguelike deckbuilding autobattler!

games.name: Polyroll Pocket
games.summary: An all new, Pocket-Sized adventure starring Polyroll! Kaiser Kiwi has landed on the moon with a diabolical plan to wipe out the Polyrolls. You'll need to uncover secrets, reclaim the stolen batteries from Kiwi's goons, and power up your rocket ship to blast off for the final confrontation!

games.name: Sonic Speedfreshed
games.summary: Sonic Speedfreshed is a 3D side scrolling Sonic fan-game. This fan-game aims to improve apon the flawed aspects of the original classic games, like the bosses for example.

games.name: Puke the Pirate: Rebarfed
games.summary:
The grossest pirate is back with a brand new remake of Puke the Pirate!
Revisit Spatter Island and collect as much of Black Barf's treasure as you can!

games.name: Ectorider
games.summary: Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ektos evil plan.

games.name: Catto Chateau
games.summary: An exploration based platformer where you can explore a Chateau full of a variety of unique levels. Find upgrades, spells and save your new friends who have become twisted by The Dutchess's curse!

games.name: Loonicycle
games.summary: Craig is a delivery boy trying to save up tons of Dosh, despite what the forecast says! Deliver passengers to their destinations to earn money & stay on the clock. Don't get caught in inclement weather or your luck might just spin out!

games.name: Astral Court DX
games.summary:
Astral Court DX is an arcade bullet hell platformer! Taking place in Heaven, you play as "The Prisoner" - an infamous criminal who's been to prison one too many times and is sent to death-row! Heaven's one and only court, the Astral Court, is an... odd one... and decides to grant The Prisoner with a series of deadly trials that, if completed, will allow them to get out of prison scot-free!

In these trials, you platform on top of the Scales Of Justice, well several of them, collecting little stars named "Shinies" that spawn around the arena. You must collect a certain amount of Shinies all whilst avoiding whatever foes or obstacles have set up to stop you. Movement is made to give you as much control as possible to avoid hazards efficiently, you have a jump that can be performed even whilst falling and a double jump to get as much height as possible. There are a variety of other characters whom add extra challenge to the trials, accessible in the endless mode only however.

games.name: Thrive
games.summary:
Thrive is a free, open-source game about the evolution of life.
From the lowly tidepools of your home planet, you will rise to cosmic dominance. At every step, powerful creation tools and deep simulation mechanics will aid your species' development.

games.name: Operius DX
games.summary: Blast off into Operius DX, a high-speed arcade shooter where you navigate twisting polygonal tunnels, battle waves of enemies, and confront formidable bosses in an endless amount of procedurally-generated levels. How far can you get?

games.name: Rayman Lum'o'Grams
games.summary:
Rayman Lum'o'Grams is a puzzle fan game for PCs running Microsoft Windows currently in development by Rayman Universe, or RUNI.

The game belongs to the Picross/Nonograms genre and uses both its own and assets of most 2D projects from Rayman series, with the exception of UbiArt games. The game was first announced at Rayman Alive 2022 as part of the RUNI Showcase segment presenting Rayman Universe projects, which featured a concept trailer. The project's World Premiere took place at Rayman Alive 2023, revealing most of the details of the game.

The first public demo version has been announced for early 2024, but its released has been postponed, and was instead released for Rayman Alive 2025, celebrating the 30th anniversary of Rayman.

games.name: Blinky's Adventure
games.summary: Blinky's Adventure is a pixel platformer about beating up the biggest trouble of the grand year of 20XX, the British. After Blinky's cousin-brother-in-eighth-degree-law, Clemorot, mysteriously goes missing overnight, Blinky has to go across the entirety of Memlia island, connecting with its incredibly strange inhabitants, powering over its stranger gimmicks, and one overarching flower-based infection, all in vain, to find out where the heck he went.

games.name: Strato Freaks DX
games.summary: Take flight in your Grand Gyro and shoot down every robot in your path to save the Powerful Monkey Council!

games.name: Aztec Mayhem!
games.summary: Aztec Mayhem is a fast-paced 2D top-down shooter with the difference being that this one is about a... slime with a gun?!!?!??!??

games.name: Kyubu Kyubu Dice
games.summary: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an Action Puzzle Game that challenges you to think about dice in different spatially oriented ways! By rolling the magical "Kyubu" the player must clear the panels that appear on the stage in this new, exciting and fast-paced puzzle experience!

games.name: XGA
games.summary: This is a Metroidvania aiming to continue Metroid Fusion's focus on horror and the SA-X. Explore a huge, interconnected space station, fighting various monsters, upgrades and boss battles. Avoid XGA as getting caught means certain death....

games.name: Rog & Roll
games.summary: Rog & Roll is a fast-paced, fluid 2.5D platformer from a new perspective. Control a tiny enemy monster named Rog on a quest to save his fellow minions! Rocket through levels using Rog's roll ability, or hunt for secrets and unlock hidden paths!

games.name: Ultimate Street Fighter: Fist of Fate
games.summary: This fangame is a tribute a to the SF franchise that consists of being the balanced SF with the largest number of mechanics possible plus with the sprites in 32 bits as in the Capcom vs Snk.

games.name: Soul Calibur: Swords of Destiny
games.summary: The gameplay attempts to resemble that of the traditional Soul Calibur games, but in 2D.

games.name: Metal Crisis
games.summary: Pushed to their limits by the Earth government, the space colonies began a rebellion. With the resources of an entire planet, the war is becoming more widespread and there is no end in sight.

games.name: Prototype Chaos
games.summary: Prototype chaos is about our main characters Prototype Guy getting their ice cream stolen by a ghost girl and they are mad so they go get it back.

games.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
games.summary: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

games.name: SyS KillMirror
games.summary: An exploration FPS set on a fake planet called SyS, ruled by the cat named Emperor, will you be able to escape this cursed realm?

games.name: Tails Adventure Remake
games.summary: Tails Adventure Remake is a fan-made remake of the Game Gear game for modern platforms, adding 16:9 widescreen, high refresh rate support, improved physics, controls, and enemies' behavior.

games.name: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Ring
games.summary: Sonic Fighting Heroes: King of The Rings (SFH: KOTR) is a MUGEN-based 2D Fighting Game, which has been in development since 2017.

games.name: Sonic Colors VN
games.summary: Sonic Colors VN is a remake of Sonic Colors DS in a Visual Novel format using the Ren'Py game engine. This project bridges the gap between all versions of the tale, stringing their plot threads together.

games.name: RoboGal: Gaga Delta Lady
games.summary: Rei-Bo was living peacefully on the island of Plutobell, until a giant spaceship crashed into the place! This is a fun and humorous saga to solve this incident full of obstacles and traps! Choose the levels in the order you want, defeat the ship's members and get their weapons in RoboGal!

games.name: Project X-treme
games.summary: Project X-Treme is a remake of the cancelled "Sonic X-Treme" made by STI (Sega Technical Institute), which was cancelled in 1996

games.name: Hyper's Quest 2: High Voltage
games.summary: The evolution of the Volt Orbs is here!

games.name: Hotel Hysteria!
games.summary: The evil Dr. Von Gordo has kidnapped Madame Moon! you, Vince Vinchi and your...sidekick Kaizo have to find clues to her location by searching through Dr. Von Gordo's Kooky Hotels!

games.name: Cube Crusaders
games.summary: Mow down all who stand in the way of your Crusade. Become a benevolent conqueror, or a brutal oppressor to those you achieve victory over. Your actions decide the fate of the planet.

games.name: Yoshi Tanks Kawaii
games.summary: In Yoshi Tanks Kawaii, play as up to six different Yoshi Tank Girls and use a variety of different powerups as you fire away at your opponents in this multiplayer turn-based artillery game, whether they be your friends, or AI controlled!

games.name: Time Foray
games.summary: Time Foray is a puzzle platformer where you control Macky Bürg in a mission to infiltrate into a mysterious complex by using her ability to travel back in time. With it, she's capable of creating time paradoxes that allow her to cooperate with her future selves in order to advance through the complex.

games.name: Transylmania: Retro Edition
games.summary: The classic online game you know and love, now in nostalgic 8-bit form!

games.name: BoltHead
games.summary: Take control of a scavenger robot, venture amidst the wreckage of an ancient man-made structure, and attempt to find and gather power cells! BoltHead is a speedy 3D platformer with an expressive moveset, where only mastery of your servomotors will ensure your success!

games.name: Bad Rat Tax
games.summary: A singleplayer open-zoned rat-like taxi game where you must talk to your client while driving.

games.name: Another Layer Down
games.summary: Another Layer Down is a fast-paced 3d-platformer focused on fluid, snappy movement that enables you to move exactly as you want. Play through open level's with varied different objectives, shortcuts, and secrets to uncover. Test yourself by crushing the gold and diamond times on each stage!

games.name: Brew!
games.summary: Brew! is a game in which you run a potion stand and must make potions as per request.

games.name: Cereal O's
games.summary: Cereal O's is a breakfast themed 2D indie platformer inspired by titles like Wario Land: Shake It, Wario Land 4, Pizza Tower, and Antonblast. developed by Yiannu duckis!

games.name: Codestar Cromo Land
games.summary: Codestar Cromo Land is a 2D platformer inspired by games such as Rayman, Wario Land 3 & 4, Super Mario Bros, and arcade games. Play as you go through three unique levels: Rocky Beach, Waterfall Highway, and Goldenize Towers. But be careful, although Codestar might seem to be a walk in the park, it might maybe, and I mean just maybe, might kick your ass out of nowhere.

games.name: Collision System Test
games.summary: In Collision System Test, words are a scarce resource, exploration is confusing, battles are annoying, and the storm around the castle of Finisterre is waiting to be tamed.

games.name: Comet Tail: Polygon Panic
games.summary:
"A super-fast mouse accidentally stumbles into a testing ground where something is wrong... Will he be able to escape before disaster strikes?"

This game is just a rough draft of what the original "Comet Tail" could have been.

games.name: Deep West
games.summary: Deep West is a platformer shooter inspired by pixel's Cave Story and Kero Blaster. You play as Brine, a framed sheriff trying to clear his name. Follow him through his quest to find the gang leader who put a price on his head! You can also play as Flint or make your own custom character!

games.name: Delivery Issues
games.summary: Delivery Issues is a side-scrolling package-throwing time-attack action-platformer that tests your package delivery skills against a zany world of characters and events that just happen to make an easy job... difficult.

games.name: Dragon March
games.summary: Dragon March is a modern and challenging spin on the classic game of Snake. Guide Cereal, The Metal Dragon, through levels full of obstacles while rescuing other Metal Dragons along your path. As your line increases, so does the danger. Bumping into almost anything causes a game over. Reach the exit and you win the level!

games.name: DuoZuplixo
games.summary: DuoZuplixo is a 2D platforming collect-a-thon with some RPG elements. You'll be taking control of two characters, Dr. Zuplow & Nora. You'll be able to switch between these two on the fly, and will need to make use of both of their abilities to collect all the Zuplonium Orbs and proceed through the areas. Alongside the Zuplonium Orbs you'll also find other secrets hidden throughout, such as Health & Attack Upgrades & tokens that allow you to access 3D bonus levels.​

games.name: Empronix Game
games.summary:
The villain from the Bluky and Phen series now has his own game! He's just a head in this one so don't get your hopes up.

Speed through levels with a new moveset! Increase your gear to get even faster! Each level has new mechanics, as well as an increase in size! New "masking" mechanic where you can transform into enemies! Try out even more movesets! Escape sequences! We sure need more of that in this genre.

games.name: Entropic Fracture
games.summary: Entropic Fracture is a speed and combat-focused platformer in which you play as Doctor Chaos, a green doctor hellbent on destroying his brother's plans for total world annihilation.

games.name: Baku Maru
games.summary: A fast-paced 3D unique action platformer where you'll be rolling and munching all your nightmares away.

games.name: Flow Skate
games.summary: Introducing Flow Skate, a fast-paced 3D platformer with gameplay inspired by Sonic R and Kirby Air Ride, with a sharp cel-shaded aesthetic.

games.name: Fork of the Crimson Soul
games.summary: Fork of the Crimson Soul is a stylish character action game featuring food characters in absurd and badass life or death battles. You take control of Furter, a hot-headed fork wielding hotdog who slashes his way through heaps of enemies he's fairly quick and has a wide range of moves.

games.name: Flipping Frogs 64
games.summary: Flipping Frogs is a fast-paced platformer built around one mechanic: a grappling-hook tongue. Whether you’re snagging flies, launching across gaps, or chaining together perfect swings, the tongue is your main tool for movement, combat, and speed.

games.name: Tricky and the Dream Caster
games.summary:
Tricky O'Possum has been hit with a sleep curse, trapping him in Caster's dream domain!
With the help of his new pal Volt, he's gotta collect the keys to Caster's Castle and beat him up to break the curse.
Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

games.name: Rubato
games.summary: A collect-a-thon about a frog fixing the solar system after it explodes for some reason.

games.name: Speedy the Rollerskater: SMS Edition
games.summary: Speedy the Rollerskater SMS Edition is a demake of Speedy the Rollerskater using the Open Surge Engine. Besides fixing some issues of the original version, Speedy SMS Edition offers a 'What If' scenario...

games.name: BrazSonic 20XX
games.summary: BrazSonic 20XX is a reboot of the BrazSonic series set in 20XX's Brazil, where the congressman Dr. Corruptnik, who dreams of being President of the country, seeks the Corruption Emeralds to make it true. However, his ambition implies chaos and destruction to the lands and citizens. Then the hero BrazSonic will come into the scene to stop him!

games.name: Penn Guiny
games.summary: After being sucked into a sack full of dreams Penn Guiny lands into an area of the dream realm called "Sunny Shores". With the help of an unnamed cloud lady Penn Guiny learns how to traverse the dream realm.

games.name: Sonic ERaZor
games.summary: Sonic ERaZor is a hack of Sonic the Hedgehog created by Selbi. This hack is unlike many other hacks, featuring a heavy in-game story line, unique challenges, and never seen before gameplay mechanics. These elements are often somehow related to explosions, which is why this hack is sometimes called, "What if Michael Bay directed Sonic 1?"

games.name: Sonic Riders Plus
games.summary:
"Sonic Riders Plus" is a mod of the original Sonic Riders for the Gamecube that focuses on enhancing the competitive potential of the game while still remaining true to the game's nature.
Changing, Adding and Removing multiple aspects of the game like Characters, Gears, Stage elements, Visuals and a lot more.

games.name: Sonic Riders Tournament Edition 2.4.6
games.summary: Sonic Riders Tournament Edition (SRTE) is a mod that gears towards competitive play while pushing the limits of what's possible.This mod is being built on the belief that Sonic Riders was a sorely misunderstood game, and that it's in-depth mechanics and skill ceiling actually have competitive potential as an esport.

games.name: Untitled Sonic Fangame
games.summary: Untitled Sonic Fangame is a game inspired by Eggman Hates Furries as well as Sonic Boom (the rom hack) and Super Meat Boy

games.name: Leap Galaxy
games.summary: Leap Galaxy is a 2D platformer with a minimalistic aesthetic and gameplay that puts speed and flow first. Take advantage of momentum and master the recoil of your shots to reach insane speeds and beat each level as fast as posible!

games.name: Geometry Breakers
games.summary: An arcade shoot 'em up retro-style game starring Captain Spike while destroying anti-matter geometric figures chimeras and their evil organization lead by General Complox.

games.name: Greeny the Blox
games.summary: Speed on through the adventurous world of Greeny the Blox! The fast-platforming cube with a burst of energy!

games.name: Guild of Monsters
games.summary: Guild of Monsters is a lane-based tower defense game inspired by the Plants vs. Zombies series, and similar titles. Play as Cassidy, an estranged princess who ran away from her deadbeat father, and a ragtag group of monsters who have been beaten down by the human kingdom. Make elaborate plans, fight against armies of soldiers, and enact vengeance on the vicious King. Recruit unique and crazy monsters to battle against equally crazy enemies. With the help of in-level upgrades and the mystical Power Cards, you can make your monster squad even stronger than you can ever imagine.

games.name: Hyperboard Extreme
games.summary: Hyperboard Extreme revives PS2-era arcade-style racing with cool girls, crazy powerups, and intense, speedy action.

games.name: Jenny
games.summary: Smash demons, salarymen and the bureaucratic system in this chaotic hat-and-bat twin-stick shooter.

games.name: Kick-Bell
games.summary: Kick-Bell is a 4-player, 3D-action arcade styled game where you must defeat every enemy to proceed to the next stage!

games.name: Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage
games.summary:
Kira-Kira Catgirl Rampage is a difficult exploration-based platformer where pretty much every background object is destructible!

Taiki has had enough of those meddling rats.
Take control of Taiki, and her drunken fairy friend Ivy, as you rip and tear through various buildings, plots of land, whatever needs "cleaning!"

games.name: Lloyd the Monkey 3 Expansion: The Warrior Once Called Prince
games.summary: Told over the course of five stages, the campaign details Grecian prince Octavius's efforts in protecting his younger sister and his kingdom from Scholz's initial efforts for conquest, culminating in the explosive battle teased in Lloyd the Monkey 2's cold open.

games.name: Lusa the Cathead
games.summary: Lusa the Cathead is an action platformer game where you get to play as a cute cat-head-looking creature named Lusa! Jump your way through the stages, collect orbs and break capsules while avoiding obstacles... and from now on, gathering polymers and megamers to gain score! This game is very customizable, with possibility for not only custom stages, but custom characters with unique mechanics, powered by Lua scripting, free for any modifications!

games.name: MechaWing!
games.summary: Is this a 2D platformer, or a 3D platformer? It's both! Flip from 2D to 3D at your leisure to explore and platform your way across a multitude of levels, some of which include mind-bending puzzles. With unique powerups and a geometric artstyle, this adventure is sure to be super!

games.name: Paloo Spiral
games.summary: Classic run n' gun gameplay mixed with fast paced melee combat! Rack up your combo to unleash even more powerful attacks!

games.name: Solar Dreamer Nikko
games.summary: BOOST YOUR DREAMS ! Play as Nikko, a young squirrel girl on a journey through visions of her future ! Explore levels at brisk speed using you BOOST! and collect every sun in this retro-styled adventure paying hommage to the greatest late-90's classics !

games.name: Windweaver
games.summary:
You are a Windweaver — once a guardian of the skies, now stripped of your full power. Cast from the heights, you must begin the long journey back to the Isle of Wind, relying only on the faint power that remains within you. Every step matters. Every jump demands precision. By bending the wind still at your command, you’ll run faster, leap farther, and cling to walls as you scale your way through a world of environments, obstacles, and pathways.

This high-speed action platformer has a direct emphasis on fluid movement and slope physics, where players will chain their abilities with environmental elements to build up incredible speed and execute spectacular combos to blitz through levels. Experience the thrill of windsurfing down mountain slopes, wall-running through ancient ruins, and soaring through the air as keep running to restore your lost flight - and maybe even discover the truth of your world as you meet new friends along the way!

games.name: World Hockey '88
games.summary: Turn back the clock! Take a shot! Face-off against friends and family side-by-side or over the (inter)net in this modernized celebration of video games of hockey past!

games.name: Beyond Golden Coins: Wario's Conquest + SML2 Reclaimed
games.summary:
Super Mario Land 2 is back!
Relive the golden days in this remake of a classic- spiced up with lots of new features!

games.name: Kirby: Soft & Wet
games.summary:
Welcome to Kirby ~ Soft & Wet! This is a game where you catch as many fish as you can!
Simply throw your bobber and click the right keys!
You can also come back in other times of day to get unique catches!
Can you collect them all and fill your Fishbook?

games.name: Megaman X Omega Blaster - Ultimate Edition
games.summary: This is the game's latest update, now featuring four selectable characters: X, Zero, and two X Armors called Moolight Armor and Jotun Armon. It also features four different endings, new bosses, stages, and music. This is definitely the final version of Omega Blaster!

games.name: Super Phantasy Fighters
games.summary: Super Phantasy Fighters is a "Phantasy Star Online 2" fan game, with Smashlike fighting game elements, featuring a unique cast of monster fighters.

games.name: Meander Forth
games.summary: Meander Forth is a platform game about an otter named Garret Rapids, who discovers that a curse has caused all of his friends to disappear! To find them, Garret must learn to master a magic known as Dark Cadence, which gives him the power to shoot bubbles, skate on ice, climb walls, and more! Not everything is as it seems, however, as Garret's search uncovers the web of secrets that cursed his friends in the first place.

games.name: Aeropunx
games.summary: Forget gravity, ignore the limits, and prepare for a tournament where flow is your only law and style is your greatest weapon. Choose your side and fight against the system!

games.name: Jinx
games.summary: Jinx is a 3D action platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure, NiGHTs Into Dreams, and Super Mario Sunshine.

games.name: Lo-Friction
games.summary: Lo-Friction is a speedrunning platformer about being in the zone, finding new ways to gain speed and getting better and better times.

games.name: Meeri Bliss
games.summary: A pixel platformer featuring Meeri and her friends!

games.name: Metal Surge
games.summary: Metal Surge is a 2d platformer shooter with multi-phase boss fights and multiple upgrades that change how you play and are required for beating its challenges.

games.name: MHZ
games.summary: MHZ is a multiplayer action real time strategy game (action RTS) greatly inspired by the early original pioneers of the genre. Instead of controlling an omniscient being who gives orders to units on the ground, you yourself play as one. Playing as a carrier aircraft, you must manage the construction, placement and support of your units directly on the ground. With your aircraft's pulse cannon, you have a direct impact on the battlefield. Your goal is simple: capture as much territory as you can and destroy your opponent's base.​

games.name: Milk Quest: Repasteurized
games.summary: Explore the depths of the Void to reclaim your milk! Milk Quest: Repasteurized is a reimagining of the original Milk Quest. Join Fezhead and a variety of friends and foes alike as you try to get home after a milk run gone bad! Use your abilities and whatever junk you pick up along the way to platform through and escape the confusing land of the Void.

games.name: Glow
games.summary:
Glow is a 2D Jump'n'Run inspired by Lunistice. Play as an alien glow-blob as it finds itself trapped in cyberspace and must find it's way out.

Move, jump, and attack your way to the end of the level.

games.name: Sonic Mushroom Blast Legacy
games.summary: An enhanced recreation of the 2023 beta of Sonic Mushroom Blast (back when it was just the vanilla SM64 levels). 117 stars should be collectable.

games.name: Hightail
games.summary: Hightail is a fast-paced 2D platformer for the Game Boy Color. The game stars Chili, a plucky mouse with a knack for treasure hunting. If there's any chance of encountering treasure, Chili will run, dash, swim, crouch, and twirl their way through any challenge. Hightail takes inspiration from the platforming greats of Wario Land, Sonic, Pizza Tower, Celeste, and more.

games.name: Kubby Big Adventure
games.summary: Kubby is a serious red cube who goes on a dangerous adventure to get his stolen artifacts back — gloves and boots that give him superpowers!

games.name: Milenay
games.summary: A small 2D platformer developed in GBStudio for the Gameboy Color, featuring external music with CD quality and Chiptune style.

games.name: Mr. Golden Revenge Machine
games.summary: The game is a reference to Puyo Puyo games, inspired by Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine/Dr. Fetus' Mean Meat Machine, it's mostly Tetris.

games.name: Neon Nexus
games.summary: Neon Nexus is a beat em' up game where you ride a skateboard and attack with your yoyo that takes place in a world with infected people, one day our protagonist MAX! wakes up by a loud noise coming from the backyard, when he goes to check he sees that... SOMEONE IS STEALING HIS FAVORITE SKATEBOARD! When Max finds out about this, he gets ready to go in search of his favorite skateboard! but there is one issue... he is going to have to use his 2nd favorite skateboard, which let's just say... is not the best of all

games.name: Onirical
games.summary: Aid Wimsy and its critters into the Oniric space to purify each world from the darkness!

games.name: Potato Game. Trilogy
games.summary: It's the Screaming Potato Head against other-worldly creatures in the loudest adventure ever conceived!

games.name: Riley The Roadrunner
games.summary: A speed demon who loves nothing more than to race. One morning, he and his partner in crime, Ollie the Armadillo, have a rude awakening when an Unidentified Flying Object plows through their tree. Next thing they know, weird alien tech is spreading all over their canyon home. Will Riley be fast enough to stop this other worldly menace?

games.name: Rocket!!
games.summary: You are Rocket, a Fox-Rabbit from out of this world! Strange monsters have begun to appear & are causing chaos wherever they go, it's up to Rocket to put a stop to that!

games.name: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby
games.summary: RPGMP: Retrieving the Ruby is an RPG Maker VX game with ACTUAL RPG mechanics, some cool dialogue and a retrievable ruby!

games.name: Slashbang
games.summary:
Slashbang aims to be the fastest paced FPS around. Inspired by the likes of Jet Set Radio and Sonic Adventure, there's a distinct 50/50 split between movement and combat.

There's lots of movement abilities and lots of tech, including dodging, drifting, and the ability to run up walls. Props are also fully destructible and can be sliced to pieces with Flynn's claws, as well are enemies! There's also a focus on story - the full game will be akin to a mix of Scott Pilgrim and Metal Gear.

games.name: Slice Night 3: Slicer of the 7 Dreams
games.summary: Slice Night 3 is a graceful yet challenging melee platformer about the beauty of dreams and processing of repressed emotion; a power fantasy with some truth sprinkled in.

games.name: Sliding Blaster 2
games.summary: A top-down shooter game for SNES, with mouse controls.

games.name: Slug Fling
games.summary: Slug Fling is an action platformer inspired by the retro classics of the run-and-gun genre with modern enhancements. Help Team STAR to victory by carrying Slug across the solar system, and stop the threat to the Astropod!

games.name: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition Turbo
games.summary: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition is back, and turbocharged! Build up crazy speeds with the new sprinting feature, and perform death defying time trials in turbo mode!

games.name: Personal Best
games.summary: Personal Best is a Momentum Platformer. The player must navigate through the various paths that make up each level on their way to the Stopwatch at the end. However, they have a limited amount of time to progress, and when that timer runs out, their score (gained via collecting Charms throughout the level, as well as just making their way to the end) are tallied up and converted into EXP and Points. They're then sent to the Upgrade Menu where those points can be used to purchase upgrades, allowing the player to better navigate and further progress in the level.

games.name: Phase Nexus
games.summary: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

games.name: Smart-Attack!
games.summary:
Smart-Attack is a wacky brain-teaser bullet hell.
Help Jack the donkey survive a deranged, rejected educational game!
You'll need your smarts and your reflexes for this one.

games.name: Snoutbreakers
games.summary: Do you have what it takes to become the champion of the Snoutbreakers, an underground fighting circuit? Fight your way through gauntlets of furry fighters armed with their fists, weapons, and more as you try to beat down everyone in your path.

games.name: Stadium Shift
games.summary: Stadium Shift is an indie game inspired by Mr. Needlemouse and a Deranged Italian Chef where you stand between the fate of the world itself by doing smooth, fun and chainable moves all the way to the end of stages.

games.name: Street Rider
games.summary: Street Rider is a hectic endless runner taking place on a never ending road trip. Weave through cars, tire spikes, and many other obstacles to see how far you can get!

games.name: Sufferix Six: Attack of X
games.summary: Stop a robotic uprising at the hands of a 14-year-old mad scientist!

games.name: Symbiote
games.summary: A high-speed action platformer where combat intertwines with movement. Swing off your enemies or slam them into the ground!

games.name: Telegeddon
games.summary: Telegeddon is a TV-trashing, genre-busting action RPG with a battle system made up of microgames - think "Paper Mario meets WarioWare," but with an original touch and its own sense of identity.

games.name: The Boy and his Story
games.summary: A fast-action platformer inspired by the Sonic Rush trilogy with decently animated pixel art and music inspired by many artists.

games.name: The DeviantArt Grind
games.summary: Congratulations! You got yourself a shrew to raise! Now's your chance to become an ARTIST! Feed your shrew, draw him, and put him on DeviantArt!

games.name: Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey
games.summary:
Trunkey's Amazing Odyssey is an unorthodox 3D physics platformer about stealing shiny objects while dealing with dangerous monsters!

Experience the privilege of living through the compound eyes of Trunkey, a weak, unintelligent, and easily distracted critter as he endeavors to steal shiny objects. He knows how to run, jump, slide, and throw things. Go nuts!

Featuring unique point-and-click styled mouse controls for precisely throwing objects, the gameplay focuses on your ability to bring as many objects back to the extraction point as possible while facing hostile wildlife at every turn!

games.name: Thunder Edge
games.summary: A high-voltage action platformer set in the distant future of 1989, where the supervillain group New Age Pantheon threatens the world. Strike like lightning, and become the hero that will shock the world!

games.name: Fadin's Vacation
games.summary: The is a remake of a game already released on Steam, and the final version will be available as a free update for all current owners.

games.name: Aishi & Reimu
games.summary: Aishi & Reimu is a 2D Sonic-inspired Touhou fan game inspired by the likes of Sonic CD and Sonic 3 & Knuckles. It is a similar formula to "Super Marisa Land" and "MegaMari - Marisa no Yabou", but instead of, let's say Mario or Mega Man, it's Sonic instead.

games.name: Sonic.exe: Dark Souls Remake
games.summary:
While on vacation, Sonic The Hedgehog, making a discovery on Angel Island, calls his friend Miles “Tails” Prower so they could investigate it together, not realizing that he has gotten himself possessed.

The self proclaimed demon, Exezar, using Sonic’s body, goes on a mission alongside his only demon friend, Oxiel, to revive the physical body of himself and his ally, Avares… but, do the both of them have the same goal in mind?

Waking up from the commotion caused by Exezar on Angel Island, Knuckles The Echidna rushes to the rescue of the Master Emerald.

His badniks have made the same discovery as Sonic, and with Metal Sonic sent away to collect the Chaos Emeralds, Dr. Ivo “Eggman” Robotnik, travels to Angel Island to confirm his badniks’ discovery with his own eyes, only to find himself tangling with the Heroes on the way and, later, Exezar's companion, Oxiel.

games.name: Syobon No Action Special
games.summary:
Did you play the original Syobon Action, and thought it was fun?...

No?

Well, this is a very SPECIAL edition of the game! No more trolling, 13 new levels, and many, many new features!

A completely new almost troll-free platformer based on the original Super Mario Bros and Syobon Action.

games.name: Shinka Tales
games.summary: Super Mario 64, but with masks, magic and machinery!

games.name: Cliff Hanger PC
games.summary: This is a PC conversion of the 1983 arcade game Cliff Hanger. This is an FMV game that uses footage from the Lupin the 3rd series. Quick reflexes are necessary to beat the game.

games.name: Comet Catastrophe
games.summary:
Comet Catastrophe is a Sonic fangame inspired by Classic Sonic games with its own somewhat strange twists.
Throughout your journey, you'll get to meet some quirky characters that may or may not help you. No, Sonic isn't one of them...

games.name: Cone’Z Broken Bonez
games.summary: Completely bored, babol decides to drive around and see if there's anything interesting to do. luckily, he remembers about the SAGE event, but shows up at the wrong SAGE. a very original concept. seeing as this expo also had a few games, decides to play the games.

games.name: Isekai Emblem
games.summary: Isekai Emblem is an unofficial freeware Fire Emblem fan game available on Windows and Android featuring over a hundred characters from a wide variety of different isekai anime franchises.

games.name: Kirby's Dream Land PIC18F45K22 Edition
games.summary: Ever wondered how the original Kirby would look like on a microprocessor made for dishwashers? No? Ok...

games.name: Mario VS The Noise
games.summary: A Pizza Tower fangame starring Mario!

games.name: Mario's Challenge Gala
games.summary: From the creator of the "infamous" Super Mario Bros. Friends, a.k.a "Dorkly" Mario Adventures (by others), now returns with a brand new game! Join the team as they compete in a mysterious contest happening at the mall!

games.name: Mario's Picross Deluxe
games.summary: Chisel your way in this PC Remake of the Game Boy classic!

games.name: Mega Man X Demake
games.summary:
How would Mega Man X be if it had come out on an 8-bit console?

8-bit, NES-style recreation of Mega Man X, inspired by Mega Man 7 and 8 Famicom.

games.name: Megaman Zero: VS The Universe
