games.summary: Megaman Zero: VS The Universe is a Megaman Zero fangame where you fight bosses from several different franchises, such as Sonic and Dragonball.

games.name: Mighty Morphin Power Rangers: Power Nexus
games.summary: MMPR Power Nexus is a REMIX of the Game Geam (and now Sega Genesis!) MMPR games! Battle it out as one of 35 characters in the intense semi-survival arcade 1P mode. Duke it out with a friend in VS matches. Change between 8-bit/16-bit music on the fly!

games.name: Project Forestation
games.summary: "Project Forestation" is a 3D Sonic Fan Game developed in Unreal Engine with an emphasis on Adventure's style gameplay. The game is being created with the aim of gamifying the 3rd season of anime "Sonic X".

games.name: Puyo Puyo Fever RPG
games.summary: Primp Town's finest in an RPG setting!

games.name: Rescue Rose
games.summary: When Sonic is captured and replaced by fake versions of yours truly, it's up to Amy Rose to defend the locals and clear her lover's name.

games.name: Sonic Advance: Unnamed
games.summary: Unnamed Sonic Advance game tries to bring mechanics from Advance games for a new-ish adventure

games.name: Sonic Adventure Advanced
games.summary: Sonic Adventure Advanced is a 2D recreation of Sonic Adventure, aimed to translate the original game into 2D, while also including custom touches to bring it closer to modern day.

games.name: Sonic Astral Generations
games.summary: Sonic Astral Generations is a fangame that seeks to give the opportunity to new levels that were absent in the 3 versions of Sonic Generation, with brand new Friends to save.

games.name: Sonic Breaking Point
games.summary: A 2D single-player focused fighting game inspired by Flash animations such as Super Mario Bros. Z.

games.name: Sonic Daybreak
games.summary: Explore all-new, original levels with the help of Sonic's core physics-based gameplay, with moves such as the Trick, Spindash, Dropdash, Rail Surge, Wall-Run, and so much more!

games.name: Sonic Definitive
games.summary:
This is a 2D Sonic fangame based on the Boost formula, using the Modern Sonic Worlds engine, created in Click Team Fusion .
A platformer with exciting additions: quick-time events and animated in-level cinematics to immerse you in this adventure.

games.name: Sonic Escape
games.summary: An expressive 2D Sonic Game inspired by the Sonic Advance Trilogy and Sonic Rush.

games.name: Sonic Forces Untold: Darkest of Days
games.summary: Three years have passed since Sonic vanished. Eggman rules the world, and the Resistance is on the brink of collapse.

games.name: Sonic Minus
games.summary: The game takes place on Eastshore island, Eggman discovered that the center of the island holds a ton of Negative Energy so he wants to use that to make the Chaos Emeralds into Negative Emeralds.

games.name: Sonic Mystic Land
games.summary: Sonic The Hedgehog comes back to a new exciting and somewhat strange adventure in Sonic Mystic Land! What will he find on this foreign land that he finds himself on?

games.name: Sonic of the Ring Tutorials Room
games.summary:
This game is about virtual training game which you can explore with Running and Fighting segments like Sonic Unleashed.
Sonic of the Ring will return to the era of 2006 to 2010 because this game tells the story of a blue ring that can awaken past memories.

games.name: Sonic Can Go Only Up
games.summary:
This is a 2D Sonic platformer, where your goal indeed is to go up. The game is one single huge level for you to clear, with areas of said level split into different zones. Rings are sparce (you can hold only a single ring), there are no checkpoints, and you will most likely fall down a good few times. Oh, but don't worry, the game autosaves.

If you're familiar with Getting Over It, Jump King, Only Up, Get to Work, all those sorta games, you know what to expect. If not; expect to get frustrated and annoyed.

games.name: Sonic Quickshot
games.summary: A 2D Sonic fan game with an emphasis on quick and focused level design.

games.name: Sonic Recharged
games.summary: Join Sonic on a solo mission to defeat Doctor Robotnik as he tries to exploit the resources and populace of Jade Island in his bid for world domination! Stop Robotnik and find the chaos emeralds.

games.name: Sonic Saga: The Mystery of South Island
games.summary: A reimagination of Sonic 1 into a game boy color RPG

games.name: Sonic Scramble
games.summary: Sonic Scramble is a 2D Platform Fighter featuring the cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series. Using mechanics familiar to other Platform Fighters as well as mechanics inspired by Traditional 2D Fighting Games like a meter, special cancels, and super moves, Sonic Scramble aims to be a Sonic Fighting Game like no other.

games.name: Super Mario Star Scramble Jam
games.summary:
Super Mario Star Scramble Jam is an unofficial remastered collection of all four games in the Super Mario Star Scramble series.
Not only does it improve the visuals and run at 60 FPS, but it also adds content and improves the gameplay for the ultimate classic experience.

games.name: Super Mario Buys Bread
games.summary: Mario wants to buy bread, but there isn't any! And now he's on a rampage against the bread thieves!!!

games.name: Sonic Seasons
games.summary: Stop Eggman's Control over the seasons on Eastside Island in Sonic Seasons!

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Past, Present, & Future
games.summary: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Past, Present & Future is the fifth episode of the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG (e.g. SatAM RPG) series.

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog XA
games.summary:
Sonic the Hedgehog XA is an open-source fan-game inspired by classic Sonic games from the Sega Genesis. It was built from scratch by a single person using the C language and PSn00bSDK and a lot of tools and scripts created for the sole purpose of building this game.

Sonic XA is a game that runs on the PlayStation 1, so to play it, you will need to use an emulator or burn the game to a proper CD-ROM so you can play it on your home console.

games.name: Sonic The Hedgehog: EVO
games.summary: The game aims to combine multiple mechanics from various Sonic games to offer a fresh and unique gameplay experience!

games.name: Sonic Unleashed 3DS
games.summary:
Here a new way to enjoy Sonic Unleashed !
On Playstation ? Xbox ? No !
On Nintendo 3DS ? Yes

games.name: Super Duper Amy Freaking Rose
games.summary:
Witchcart has stolen Amy's birthday cake :o

Help her get it back before the night is over!

games.name: Tales' Epic Gang
games.summary: Tales' Epic Gang is a 2D Sonic the Hedgehog Fan Game with cartoony graphics and wacky characters.

games.name: Sonic Before the Sequel '26
games.summary: Sonic Before the Sequel '26 is a remake of the original Sonic Before the Sequel (2011), with improved physics, visuals and controls!

games.name: SMB RMX: Shattered Realms
games.summary: SMB RMX: Shattered Realms is the 7th entry in Glitchworm Games's Mario fan game series where Glitchworm has to get all the Time Crystals to repair the Shattered Realms. With Wario Land inspired gameplay, you make your way through the Shattered Realms and go a journey to take back the Time Crystals from each Realm's Bosses, and look cool while doing so.

games.name: YTP All-Stars
games.summary: YTP All-Stars is a parody of the Super Smash Bros. series of platform fighters, featuring characters and stages inspired by early internet culture and memes.

games.name: Mr. Triangle The Pizza Delivery Guy Mania Simulator 2k17 Turbo HD Remix GOTY 2024 Edition: Coked Up + 1.5 Collection DX Directors Cut & Knuckles
games.summary:
The first game in the Mr. Triangle Mania series (a sequel to some games I made as a child, of which the 6th entry was never finished), ported to the second's engine.
Including the extra story Mr. Triangle Mania 1.5, originally an SRB2 mod, now with its original intended ending.

games.name: The Deal
games.summary: A Doom II WAD.

games.name: Sonic Paradigm
games.summary: The Ultimate 2D Sonic Adventure!

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Curse Warrior
games.summary:
Curse Warrior is a dungeon crawler RPG where you explore and conquer the underground labyrinth “Eclipse,” filled with curses.

In the dungeon, your party members may become cursed through various actions.

Since curses alter the abilities and actions of your party members, players must constantly monitor the state of their party and make crucial decisions on how to proceed. Build stronger characters while managing and adjusting the effects of curses to successfully clear the dungeon.

games.name: Daisenryaku SSB2
games.summary: Wield over 300 modern weapons, from jets to tanks, and outmaneuver rival forces with your strategy. From small islands to massive total-war maps, turn-based battles let both newcomers and veterans play at their own pace.

games.name: Disgaea Mayhem
games.summary:
Disgaea Mayhem is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention—unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.

games.name: Gobble
games.summary: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Xicatrice
games.summary: Around 100 years since superpowers awakened in society, the Anti-Abnormal Unusual Talent Team (AUT) was created to prevent incidents caused by those wrongly using their powers. However, as these efforts became strained, the Reserve Anti-Unusual Talent Team (RAUT) was then formed to assist in tackling such conflict. This group is made up of the aforementioned students. Now, in 2023, the protagonist is a former member of the AUT who lost their powers after an unknown incident.

events.name: Southeast Asia RPG Maker Showcase 2025
events.description:
Southeast Asia RPG Maker Showcase is back—now using its full name!
Discover 27 RPG Maker-style games by Southeast Asian developers on September 21, 2025!

games.name: Something Left
games.summary:
After years of isolation caused by a haunting past, a reclusive girl receives an unexpected message—her mother appears in a dream and urges her to seek out the ex-boyfriend she left behind long ago.

Driven by curiosity, unresolved feelings, and a flicker of hope, she sets out from her remote home into the vast city, facing unfamiliar streets, fading memories, and the weight of her own emotions.

Will she find closure... or uncover something she never expected?

games.name: A Sun-Kissed Fantasy
games.summary: A Sun-Kissed Fantasy is a short RPG featuring Harold on a tropical adventure.

games.name: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy
games.summary: Gorgonia: A Gorgon's Tragedy is an RPG Maker horror game that reimagines the Gorgons’ origin story, offering a fresh perspective on the ancient myth. Step into the role of Medyuu, a beautiful lamia with unsettling secrets. Her sisters seem to glimpse something different in her—a haunting gaze that pulls her into a path of strange encounters and eerie discoveries.

games.name: Shepherd’s Plan
games.summary: An office point-and-click puzzle game mixed with visual novel-style storytelling set in a noir-fabled world. As you are fired from the job, to save yourself from a collapsing dream, it’s time to investigate, discover the black company’s secrets, and take sweet revenge for the money you deserve.

games.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
games.summary: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

games.name: Luna Has Gone
games.summary: Luna Has Gone is an RPG inspired by PS1-era pre-rendered backgrounds, delivering a unique visual style for an RPG Maker game. The gameplay features turn-based battles with limited resources. You play as Misha, the daughter of a world-class corporation, whose goal is to find her missing friend, Luna.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Not My Part
games.summary: This is story about 'Grace' who is on her way to the Sunday Lake camp, but something happens that makes her meet a famous serial killer at a motel along the way. In this horror movie-like scenario, what role will she play?

games.name: Tale of Ren: Searching for Heart Droplets
games.summary: Me...Mizu Ren Nanami… As a REN people, it's time to go on a mission to conquer the hearts of people in other realms. Then, the Rostania is the town where I was chosen to come here. to the pursuit of secrets that were never known before.

games.name: Whispers in the Bitter Frost
games.summary: A Cold Horror RPG about fragmented memories.

games.name: Sirensia: A Date Beneath
games.summary: A burnout man's story, leading him into a tale of tragedy.

games.name: Rave Heart+
games.summary: Experience the definitive edition of this classic RPG, now available on the Epic Games Store. Rediscover the adventure, enhanced and reimagined, and relive the thrilling story on a whole new platform!

games.name: Artisan Acre
games.summary: Master cheeses, wines, and various delicacies in your own culinary atelier. Craft refined artisanal food products through careful manipulation of temperature and fermentation from living cultures. Expand your operations as you progress through an immersive culinary adventure.

games.name: Our Last Conversation
games.summary: Our Last Conversation is an RPG Maker Horror 2D side-scrolling game. The main character has two friends who have gone to an abandoned school. And this place isn't safe enough to let us think about that it has many things that don't like that we are alive.

games.name: Arsenic & Absinthe
games.summary: Arsenic & Absinthe is a blend of a chill bartender simulation with narrative-driven story. The player takes on the role of "Sylene", a bartender who recently began a new life; making drinks, serving unusual recipes of art, and listening to the stories of working-class customers. A simple life, however, is merely a dream for her as her haunted past returns. The player has to explore the night city and solve the pre-midlife crisis while getting caught in the notorious "Snow White" murder case once more.

games.name: In a Bit of Tales
games.summary: In a Bit of Tales is a unique horror anthology game featuring seven spine-chilling stories delivered in an omakase-style experience. Explore haunting dreams, mysterious cults, ghostly schools, and more!

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: Delvin: Origins
games.summary: A horror turn-based RPG in hell.

games.name: Bathhouse Creatures
games.summary: Ready, set, bath! Build and manage your bathhouse for animals in this casual and cozy management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard-earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!

games.name: Lily Adventuresses! Episode 1: She Who Lost Everything but Her Name
Lily Adventuresses! Episode 2: Rise of the Arcritters
Lily Adventuresses! Episode 3: The Explorer Sisters and the Deepest Depths
Twilight Memoria: Freedom
games.summary: Twilight Memoria: Freedom is a turn-based JRPG about two women from different worlds. Customize every character’s class and unleash devastating combos in a battle system where strategy meets emotion. Two lives. Two fates. One chance to break free.

games.name: Restoring Falmay
games.summary: An RPG about saving a fairy's homeland.

games.name: 77Survival Part I
games.summary: 77Survival is a survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Players will control four characters who accidentally find themselves stranded on the rooftop of a 77-story building. Their mission is to survive as long as possible or venture down to the first floor to uncover the mysterious events happening in the building. Each character has unique abilities, allowing them to solve puzzles and complete missions. If all four characters die, the game is over.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name
games.summary: Hazuki Dies: She Has No Name is a tactical rhythm RPG featuring a frail doctor in training named Hazuki who struggles with her new life of being part of a criminal organization disguised as a local restaurant.

games.name: WiThu, It's Time To Go
games.summary: WiThu, It's Time To Go is an RPG Maker Horror puzzle game. You wake up in a familiar place. Something that everyone has is called a name, but you don't. Searching for who we are and the truth of these things. The adventures in mysterious lands are waiting for you.

games.name: The Last Bloom
games.summary: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

games.name: Eternal Ex Machina: Hawz Krarace
games.summary: The legend said at the Hawz Krarace ruin have legendary weapon and the chosen one can pull it out!! You and your party member take the task and find them and become millenarians in no time!! But... Something... Not right...

events.name: eastasiasoft Fall 2025 Showcase
events.description: Join us for a look the latest projects we're working on for Fall 2025 and beyond. This showcase covers 18 titles across Nintendo Switch, PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S and PC for release in the months ahead. No matter your platform of choice, you won't want to miss this special presentation!

games.name: Incantation
games.summary: "Incantation" is a first-person horror mystery game adapted from a movie of the same name. The game reveals the chilling story behind "Chen Village" from the movie. A mother searching for her missing daughter accidentally stumbles into a village filled with mysterious cults. Beyond the palpable madness and fear in the village, there's a sinister force that drives one to despair. What happens when one crosses the forbidden line of this evil deity?

games.name: Hakuoki SSL: Sweet School Life for Nintendo Switch
games.summary:
Spring, a season of blessing for new encounters. Yukimura Chizuru knocks on the gates of a private academy, which has since been a boys' school. However, as of this year, Hakuou Academy opens its gates to co-education and Chizuru is the only female student enrolled. Thus, begins her first year.

This edition comes with cards and some other extras.

games.name: The Tag-along Obsession
games.summary: The Tag-along Obsession is adapted from the movie "The Tag-along", based on the Urban Legend. It is a first-person horror puzzle adventure game, Players will play Hui-Ting and go into the situation to understand a series of supernatural phenomenon, and immerse themselves in the story, looking for the answers to everything.

games.name: Birdcage
games.summary:
BIRDCAGE is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shoot’em up inspired by genre classics, blending gritty pixel art sprites with 2.5D backdrops and a pumping retro soundtrack! Blast through 6 unique stages of bullet hell mayhem, facing off against enemy swarms using multiple shot types and rechargeable specials.

Chase high scores by maintaining chains and kill rate. Strategically activate Hyperblade mode in tense situations, and take down screen-filling bosses! Can you break free of your cage and redeem humanity?

games.name: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
games.summary: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

games.name: Super Mining Mechs
games.summary: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

games.name: Söldner-X: Himmelsstürmer
games.summary: The celestial planet Conceyta orbits with its moon in a dust- and gas-covered solar system. Within lurks an evil unknown to man that bears a danger so much greater than any threat yet witnessed. A dark, mysterious power has manifested itself in the depths of the gas giant, absorbing life and technology, and assimilating all in its wake. Spacecraft, pilots, androids, and computers: Nothing is safe. No one can escape the virus that infects all life forms, turning once brave heroes and peaceful colonists alike into ravaging, chaotic forces, fighting each other and infecting more in the process. Soulless technology and hate-driven humanoids are all that's left of Earth's once-proud fleet. The galaxy as we know it is threatening to fall apart. War, death, and bedlam have taken hold of civilisation. Humankind is at the brink of extinction. Those who aren't yet infected--the resistance, a band of mercenaries, soldiers and civilians--are Earth's final hope, and they have one goal in common: To stop the deadly infection and destroy the core of all evil, hidden in the depths of Conceyta. Scouts have undertaken a merciless mission to bring detailed plans and data on the location of the power and its defence line in a last attempt to save humankind. So it has come to be that the last remaining pilot, a mercenary and bounty hunter, is the only chance of survival, ironically driven by the desire for wealth and fame. Left with little choice, the resistance has developed a star fighter capable of intercepting the evil force, equipped with a deadly weapon system and of utmost agility. With no time to lose, the 10th and final prototype of the ship is handed to the pilot. Its name: "Sldner-X". Should the pilot succeed, his name shall live on in the memories of man forever to come. And so the battle begins.

games.name: Montezuma's Revenge: The 40th Anniversary Edition
games.summary: The 1983 classic multi-room platformer Montezuma’s Revenge returns in 2.5D glory, and now Pedro’s adventure is bigger than ever with 100 tricky rooms to explore! For its 40th anniversary, what was once an unfinished game is now resurrected to match the full vision of creator Robert Jaeger. This time you can choose between male and female explorers, Pedro or his sister Rosita, to delve deep into the dangerous ruins and hunt for treasures untold!

games.name: Schildmaid MX
games.summary: Schildmaid MX is a fresh and frenetic side-scrolling 2D shoot 'em up in which you pick 1 of 3 ferocious fighter spacecraft to wreak havoc on the invasion fleet that threatens your planet. Embark on multiple attack runs and strike fear into the hearts of your enemy. The best pilots are immortalized on the online leaderboards!

games.name: Halloween 1985
games.summary:
Step into the arcade-era thrill of Halloween 1985!

When monsters steal Pumpkman’s pumpkins on Halloween night, it’s up to you to get them back! Dash through 5 vibrant, quirky levels, outsmarting classic foes like Dracula, The Mummy, and The Witch. Jump, dodge, and battle your way to their lairs, then take on the big boss in a final showdown!

With 3 game modes, a retro chiptune soundtrack, and high-score chasing just like the golden age, this pixel-art platformer delivers fast-paced, nostalgic fun.

Can you reclaim all the pumpkins and become a legend?

games.name: Baradroid: A Gay Visual Novel
games.summary: A choice-driven, high-tech, gay visual novel with elements of dating-sim! Choose your baradroid, Live with him, and... Can you teach a robot the meaning of human love?

games.name: Dimensional Animals
games.summary: Five animal friends unite for one glorious purpose: recover the dog's... play ball? Explore beautiful dimensions in this metroidvania action platformer adventure!

games.name: Doll Defenders
games.summary: You were teleported to Male Doll's multiverse with one goal: to save the heroes of our games. However, you may fall in love with them along the way and get the happy final ending you deserve. Are you looking to save the world, or the love of one hot man that’s everything you ever wanted? Don't lie!

games.name: Electronics Puzzle Lab 2
games.summary: Learn circuitry and electronics engineering in a fun way with concepts simple enough for beginners but engaging for enthusiasts!

games.name: Love Chemistry: Sibella's Formula
games.summary:
A SFW release of "Lustful Chemistry" for consoles.

Take the role of an unhinged lady chemist in raucous side-scrolling platformer Love Chemistry - Sibella’s Formula! Shoot syringes of your special mind-control formula at weird enemies, from robots and carnivorous plants to roving bookworms, and make your way through tricky corridors in old-school pixel art style!

games.name: Magnetic Bonds
games.summary: Magnetic Bonds is a fusion of the visual novel and turn-based RPG genres inspired by shonen manga where players explore a vast galaxy, befriending characters and building relationships as they progress through the story and take down enemies and bosses.

games.name: Winterlight: Where Silence Says It All
games.summary: As Elias returns to the coastal town that once sheltered him, he’s pulled into a slow winter of connection, memory and quiet decisions. Take the role of this young man and guide the choices he makes, surrounded by the warmth of townspeople young and old, often holding conversations in a bookstore over shared coffee.

games.name: Twilight Parade: Moonlit Mononoke
games.summary: Beautiful oni-girls battle hordes of yokai in this side-view bullet hell SHMUP. Every year yokai takes to the streets to celebrate at Hyakki Yagyou, the night parade of the hundred yokai. But this year they didn't invite the oni twins, so they're going to ruin the party!

events.name: Beyond the Strand
events.description: Hosted by Hideo Kojima, Beyond the Strand, celebrating the 10th anniversary of Kojima Productions, will include special guest appearances as well as offer a glimpse into future projects. Beyond The Strand will take place at TOHO Cinemas Roppongi Hills, Tokyo, Japan, on Tuesday, 23rd September 2025.

games.name: OD: Knock
games.summary: OD explores the concept of testing your fear threshold, and what it means to OD on fear – while blurring the boundaries of gaming and film.

games.name: Physint
games.summary: This new action-espionage game will use cutting-edge technology and a stellar cast to deliver an experience like no other. Blurring the boundaries between film and games, offering near life-like graphics and a new take on interactive entertainment.

events.name: Boomstock 2025 Showcase
events.description: A celebration of booming & shooting with launch updates and new announcements from Fulqrum Publishing, as well as news from partners including Apogee Entertainment, Byte Barrel, Devolver Digital, Hyperstrange, New Blood Interactive, and many more.

games.name: Blood West: Scavengers
games.summary: Endless West brings a long awaited endless randomizer mode to Blood West! See how long you can survive as you meet familiar friends and old foes in the never ending weird wild west!

games.name: Night Jackal: Blood Debt
games.summary: A masked vigilante seeks revenge, unravels a conspiracy, and teeters on the edge of sanity in this retro-inspired boomer shooter.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Captain Wayne: Vacation Desperation
games.summary: Captain Wayne is an intense, fast-action Retro Shooter about a sailor with a Shotgun for an arm!! With a cartoony, hand-drawn art style and gory gameplay, you'll have to mow down enemies through 8 action-packed levels to take back what's yours.

games.name: It Consumes
games.summary: It Consumes is a roguelite arena-FPS in the dark. See by beating your heart and kill demons shrouded in shadows. Upgrade your abilities, unlock new weapons, and conquer what lurks in the darkness.

games.name: Bloodmatch
games.summary: The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…

games.name: Kvlt
games.summary: Fight your way through armies of Nazi occultists, religious zealots, and unspeakable cosmic horrors to unveil the Eldritch secrets behind the war theatre in this 2000s-era-inspired grimdark singleplayer FPS where WW2 meets Cthulhu Mythos.

games.name: HyperViolent
games.summary: An ancient evil has awoken in the depths of a remote mining asteroid, stirred from its slumber by man's lust for power. Unaware, you answer a distress call and become stranded, surrounded by monstrous foes. Unravel the mystery of this madness and stop its spread in this violent retro shooter!

games.name: Bloodthief
games.summary: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

games.name: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3: I Opened a Portal to Hell in the Favela Trying To Revive Mit Aia I Need to Close It
games.summary: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3 is a fast-paced ultraviolent Brazilian old-school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). made as a tribute to the Brazilian mods of the 2000s, the Brazilian bootleg games of the 2000s, Brazilian music, and the King of Brazilian music, Mit Aia!

games.name: Mechanical Fury
games.summary: Your arm has been replaced with a grappling hook, courtesy of the Machine Army. Return the favor with total annihilation. Grapple. Kick, and DESTROY everything that stands in your way!

games.name: Forgive Me Father 2
games.summary: Embark on a journey into the darkest nightmares to restore your sanity. Blast your way through hordes of possessed enemies, unlock an arsenal of deadly weapons and get ready to face even more Lovecraftian madness in this action-packed FPS sequel.

games.name: Wizordum
games.summary: Wizordum is a retro-inspired FPS with a focus on action and light puzzles. It blends the best features of classic fantasy shooters from the 90s with some modern aspects making it a unique experience. Take the role of a Cleric and fight against Chaos that roams the land - smash, burn and loot!

games.name: Fida Puti Samurai
games.summary: Fida Puti Samurai is a retro-FPS "virtual happy place" set inside a virtual simulated world, the simulation is jeopardized with a naughty bug. Traverse this action-oriented roguelite blasting waifus on procedural generated cities to uncover dirty secrets on someone's computer!

games.name: Ion Fury: Aftershock
games.summary: Ion Fury, the old-school first-person shooter, keeps the bullets and cybernetic body parts flying with Aftershock, a new expansion. Like classic expansions, “Aftershock” offers a brand new Arrange mode. Whether playing for the first time or revisiting Ion Fury, choose Arrange mode to experience the original game but now enhanced with new enemies, weapons and more.

games.name: Viscerafest
games.summary: Viscerafest is a Sci-Fi Fantasy Singleplayer Arena FPS with minor Collectathon elements. Fight through hordes of aliens and eldritch monstrosities wielding a slew of powerful weapons, juggling your resources, and exploring over 26 intricately designed hand crafted levels.

games.name: Unbroken
games.summary:
Brave the hostile lands in search of your goal. Forge your own path and discover the many secrets of the realm and the looming Township of Westfall. Unlock new abilities, perks and weapons. Soak in the atmosphere and head forth against all odds.

A mood heavy action-adventure, Unbroken takes players on a grindhouse journey to Crests Edge in search of the traitor Nielsen. With multiple routes to achieve your goal (or even abandon it), the ascent to one of the multiple endings will be a memorable one.

With a unique lore structure and one of a kind audio visual composition, Unbroken will take players on a trip.

games.name: Sulfur
games.summary: Sulfur is a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

games.name: Brutal John 2
games.summary: Brutal John is a fast-paced ultraviolent old school FPS combining crazy storyline about saving the world from the mining technlogies, with inspired gameplay from the best shooters of the '90s. Rip apart alien enemies, destroy mining technologies, save the world.

games.name: Hellbreak
games.summary: Fight to save your soul from damnation in a brutal arena where only the strongest survive. Entertain the Lords of Hell and earn their favor to unlock new weapons, spells, and blessings. Dive into this fast-paced roguelite arena shooter and achieve the highest score. Can you reclaim your soul?

games.name: Texnoplazm
games.summary: Gun fu action centered on three intertwined movesets for punches, ranged weapons and firearms. Fight your enemies through the gothic metropolis while using their weapons against them, in the most acrobatic way possible.

games.name: Voltage High Society
games.summary: Punch, evolve, escape! This cyberpunk FPS Metroidvania pits you against horrific cyber-monstrosities as you master deadly abilities to break free from the derelict prison island of Nemo Ultra.

games.name: Zero Protocol
games.summary: In this Sci-Fi survival horror game, you must uncover the secrets of the IAS Antarctic Research Complex and try to survive. You will find various endings, puzzles, battles with monsters, and an intriguing plot.

games.name: Postal: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze
games.summary: POSTAL: Brain Damaged - These Sunny Daze isn’t “just a DLC” - it’s a tropical serotonin collapse packed with juicy carnage, alleged jokes, overbaked new levels, even less appropriate enemies and unhinged guns. This is another mag of SPF-free mockery fired point-blank at modern life.

games.name: Tempo Punk
games.summary: Can you survive in an addicting fusion of rhythm-driven FPS action and captivating dystopian action-packed storytelling? Fight for your life through cutting-edge graphics while the pulsating beats of electronic music get your brain synapses firing at highspeed.

games.name: Beneath
games.summary: Plunge into a treacherous and enigmatic underwater world and brace yourself to confront the heart-stopping horrors that await as you fight against all odds.

games.name: Project Warlock: Lost Chapters
games.summary: Next Chapter of Project Warlock is here. A retro fps shooter that honors the legacy of classic shooters like Doom, Wolfenstein and Hexen picks up the story of Warlock mixing frantic gunplay, with powerful magic spells and perks and skills based character customisation.

games.name: Berserker's Domain
games.summary: BERSERKER'S DOMAIN is a fast-paced, unhinged retro FPS freakshow with a roguelike loop, inspired by classics like Blood, Quake 1-3, and Doom, as well as modern shooters like Dusk, ULTRAKILL, and Doom Eternal.

games.name: Spyrit Walker
games.summary: A Weird Western world trapped in a perpetual night. You must fight to survive, rescue strange characters, unlock powerful weapons and abilities in hopes of ridding this land of EVIL. Explore the open world and complete objectives in any order you like alone or in CO-OP as a SPYRIT WALKER!

games.name: Reclaim
games.summary: Skate, dash, and rail-grind your way around the city while blasting through enemies with your vast arsenal of weapons, abilities, and gadgets. Keep your score multiplier up by eliminating enemies with both style and ruthless efficiency. The higher your multiplier, the more powerful you are.

games.name: Sydless
games.summary: Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

games.name: Warag
games.summary: Old-school boomer shooter in a world where Slavic myths have merged with technocult. Cut, shoot and survive among cultists, cyber-mutants and traitors in armor. Restore the glory of the Varangian Guard - through blood, steel and ancient wrath.

games.name: Sportal
games.summary: Retro fps where you use sport equipment - baseball bats, hockey sticks, golf clubs, bowling balls and pigskins to launch projectiles into monsters straight from classic creature features. Collect upgrades, find gear and hit fastballs to get back home in this stylish action game set in 50’s America.

games.name: Supplice
games.summary: Supplice is a stylish throwback shooter inspired by the mid-90s FPS glory days and the legendary Doom modding community. Mixing the retro stylings of 90s era shooters with colorful graphics and frantic gameplay, it creates an experience that's ever so familiar but also exciting and fresh.

games.name: Wrack: Reclamation
games.summary: Inspired by classics like DOOM and Quake, Wrack is an arcade-style FPS. Mow down enemies one after another, and become more powerful the more you kill. Amass a deadly arsenal, discover secret powers... and save your world!

games.name: Blocks for Babies
games.summary: Blocks for Babies is the puzzle-shooter mashup of your dreams. Clear falling blocks by forming complete lines, or go in guns blazing to clean up the board the messy way. Hard and soft drops aren't your only tools anymore—now you have a shotgun.

games.name: Gunstoppable
games.summary: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

games.name: Into the Fold: Nala Junction
games.summary: A fast-paced boomer shooter set in a strange mountain town. Blast through enemies, explore deadly levels, and fight to survive. Inspired by classic '90s games.

games.name: Agent 64: Spies Never Die
games.summary: Relive the golden era of gaming with a retro FPS that captures the essence of 90s console shooters. Embark on a thrilling journey of espionage and action, tackling various objectives while battling cutting-edge 64bit powered enemy AI. Enter a world where bullets and secrets collide!

games.name: HMUR
games.summary: HMUR is a fast-paced retro-FPS, in the original setting, that merges Soviet aesthetics with whacky madness and frantic dynamics of iconic 90s shooters. Survive a disaster at a classified Soviet facility as you blast your way through crowds of enemies. Speed is your key to survival.

games.name: Don't Stop, Girlypop!
games.summary: Spread the love! Don’t Stop, Girlypop! is a Y2K arena movement shooter where standing still is not an option.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

games.name: Blow-Up: Avenge Humanity
games.summary: BLOW-UP: AVENGE HUMANITY is a single-player fast paced first person shooter campaign where you take control of an industrial robot rewired by the last human being to violently dispatch the alien race accountable for Earth’s destruction. Are you ready to become the ultimate avenger?

games.name: Kook
games.summary: In this fast-paced, retro FPS game with a Quake-like feel, players will battle Lovecraftian monsters in a Victorian-era steampunk world using crazy weapons and navigating mind-bending gravity.

games.name: Lonely Space
games.summary: Lonely space is an old-fashioned sci-fi immersive sim game. You find yourself awakened from hibernetic sleep in the docking bay of the Cassiopeia space station. All your crew gone long time ago. You have to resque them and find out what's going on on the station.

games.name: Project: Amica
games.summary: Project: AMICA is a first person shooter built in the GZDoom engine. You play the role of SID, an android set out to defeat General Genant Kekaha in order to prevent further military conflict. Explore a colorful 90's inspired world of robots, cool power ups and weapons! Collect power ups that change the way you tackle combat scenarios and exploration. Revisit areas you've already been to and explore new paths and secrets that'll help you throughout your journey!

games.name: Baionlenja
games.summary: Baionlenja is a first-person metroidvania with an extreme movement focus. Explore the vast and interconnected research facility, where a mysterious fossil grants you unimaginable power and mobility. B-hop, rocket jump and air strafe to uncover the secrets of the Baionlenja corporation.

games.name: Hemohound
games.summary: HEMOHOUND is a fast-paced western shooter with roguelike elements in a world where vampires stand under the sun. Consume your foes' blood to gain their skills and weapons as you cut a bloody trail through the west seeking to become worthy of immortality.

games.name: Call of Dookie
games.summary: Imagine you went to the crapper, and emerged an hour later to a monster apocalypse! Retro first-person shooter action inspired by 90's classics! Old-school local deathmatch & co-op for up to 4 players!

games.name: Battle for Ercaton: Robot Uprising
games.summary: Battle for Ercaton: Robot Uprising is a first-person shooter where the player takes on the role of an earthling who crashed a spaceship and ended up on the planet Ercaton, which is inhabited by dangerous robots.

games.name: Biomeat Huskworld
games.summary: This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.

games.name: Fracture Point
games.summary: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

games.name: RetroBlazer
games.summary: Take on the mantle of the Pyramid Guard, go up against the cybernetic Ark Legion, and rid the kingdom of a spectral blight. Combining the charm of Saturday Morning Cartoons and the bombastic action of late 90s shooters, RetroBlazer recaptures a golden era of frantic, fast-paced, first-person action.

games.name: Incision
games.summary: Slaughter your way through nightmarish industrial mazes, transformed cityscapes and surreal alien structures to cut down the Growth in this ultraviolent, fast-paced, and merciless retro-styled first person shooter.

games.name: Project Warlock II
games.summary: Adrenaline-pumping gore retro funhouse that’s full of guns, magic, demons, vertical arenas, 3D visuals, 2D sprites, and heavy metal music.

events.name: Annapurna Interactive Direct From Tokyo 2025
events.description:
Three new games from Yarn Owl, Iridium Studios and Marumittu Games.

Tune in Tuesday, September 23, 2025 at 5PM PT / 8PM ET / 9AM JST to see more.

games.name: Wanderstop
games.summary: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

games.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim
games.summary: An exploration/photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

games.name: Skin Deep
games.summary: Skin Deep is an immersive first-person shooter. We got sneezing. We got things getting stuck in your feet. Stalk through a vast non-linear starship and sneak, subvert, and sabotage to survive in this stellar sandbox. You're outnumbered, outgunned, and have no shoes. Welcome to Skin Deep!

games.name: To a T
games.summary: to a T is a 3D narrative adventure game developed by Keita Takahashi and the uvula team, with a strong focus on character, interaction, story and exploration. Play as a teenager (Teen), with a unique posture just trying to live a normal life in a small coastal town. Explore the town along with the help of Teen’s loyal dog and loving mother. While going to school and contending with bullies, Teen discovers a new ability granted to them by their extraordinary posture, and they start to uncover more about their mysterious lineage.

games.name: Wheel World
games.summary: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

games.name: Bounty Star
games.summary: Bounty Star is an over-the-shoulder 3D action game that marries mech combat and customization with farming and base building. The player takes on the role of a broken but powerful ex-soldier named Clem, a war veteran, talented fighter and expert mech pilot.

games.name: Morsels
games.summary: Morsels is a fast-paced creature collecting roguelite with a rotating roster of characters to switch between at will. Overcome a clique of killer cats as you fight your way out of the sewers in this unique, action-packed journey.

games.name: D-topia
games.summary: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, its up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: People of Note
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

games.name: LEGO Voyagers
games.summary: From the makers of LEGO Builder's Journey comes a new 2-player co-op adventure about friendship and play. When two friends make it their mission to rescue an abandoned spaceship, they embark on a journey beyond their wildest dreams.

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

events.name: RGG SUMMIT 2025 + RGG DIRECT 2025
events.description:
RGG SUMMIT 2025 will go live September 24, bringing you the latest info directly from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio.
RGG DIRECT will immediately follow the SUMMIT, giving you a closer look at some of the studio's latest announcements.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3
games.summary: Continue the story of ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu as he fights to protect those he loves in an extreme remake of Yakuza 3 that evolves every aspect of the beloved game. The bustling streets of Okinawa and Tokyo come to life in stunning detail with reimagined combat taking brutal brawling action to the next level. Added scenes deliver more depth and emotion to the beloved story with new and enhanced side experiences that immerse you in the world like never before, and more.

games.name: Dark Ties
games.summary: Experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 in an included separate game. Having once led a succesful startup company, he plunged himself into the dark world of the yakuza by choice after losing everything. Left with an empty heart, the pursuit to find true bonds drives him forward once again in a dramatic journey colored by exhilarating boxing-based combat, and a variety of engaging side experiences.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
games.summary: YAKUZA KIWAMI 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves. DARK TIES is a brand-new game featuring Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 included as a separate action-packed experience.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami
games.summary: Yakuza: Kiwami is an enhanced remake of the original Yakuza game for PlayStation 2, not just an HD port. While the original PS2 release also had English voice-acting for western release, this PS4 remake only retains Japanese voice-acting for authenticity with available subtitles for other countries.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 2
games.summary: Yakuza Kiwami 2 is a remake of Yakuza 2, and is an action-adventure game set in an open world environment and played from a third-person perspective. Combat is based on that previously seen in Yakuza 6. A new "Majima Saga" story scenario features recurring series anti-hero Goro Majima as a playable character.

games.name: Yakuza 0: Director's Cut
games.summary:
Yakuza 0: Director's Cut is the definitive edition of the critically acclaimed prequel to the Yakuza series.

Director's Cut content gives deeper insight into key incidents and character backstories with never-before-seen cutscenes and enhanced features like English and Chinese voiceovers, and multi-language text support. Plus, the Red Light Raid online multiplayer mode lets you join forces with friends and choose from 60 playable characters to take down hordes of enemies.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

events.name: TGS2025 Capcom Online Program
events.description: Get all the latest Capcom news in our pre-recorded stream as part of TGS Online!

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Mega Man Star Force: Legacy Collection
games.summary: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - Sagat
games.summary: Sagat is the first DLC character in the Street Fighter 6: Year 3 Character/Ultimate Pass. The Emperor of Muay Thai. He was once one of the highest ranking members of Shadaloo, but has since left the criminal organization. He currently lives deep in the mountains, focusing only on his training.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Year 3 - C. Viper
games.summary: An operative belonging to a certain intelligence organization. A cold, hard realist. She complements her fighting abilities using a number of gadgets hidden in her outfit.

games.name: Street Fighter 6
games.summary:
The evolution of fighting games starts with our traditional Fighting Ground, and then we're turning the genre on its head with World Tour and Battle Hub for a total of three modes where anyone can play to their liking.

No one starts off as a champion. You get there step by step, punch by punch.
Take up the challenge and bring your game to the next level.

games.name: Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy
games.summary:
Defend the innocent and save the day! Courtroom hero Phoenix Wright lays down the law this Winter in the digital release of Phoenix Wright: Ace Attorney Trilogy. Experience the original trilogy like never before in clear, high-resolution re-drawn graphics and immersive 3D visuals optimized for the Nintendo 3DS system.

Join rookie lawyer Phoenix Wright through the early years of his career in his quest to find the truth behind all of the classic cases! Prepare for intense courtroom showdowns by investigating crime scenes, collecting evidence, and questioning witnesses. Use evidence and the testimonies of witnesses to your advantage as you battle for the innocence of your client. Nothing less of a full acquittal will do in this court of law. Find the contradictions in witnesses' testimonies to expose the truth!

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Resident Evil Village: Gold Edition
Resident Evil 7: Biohazard - Gold Edition
games.summary:
Set in modern day rural America and taking place after the dramatic events of Resident Evil 6, players experience the terror directly from the first person perspective. Resident Evil 7 embodies the series' signature gameplay elements of exploration and tense atmosphere that first coined "survival horror" some twenty years ago; meanwhile, a complete refresh of gameplay systems simultaneously propels the survival horror experience to the next level.

The Gold Edition contains the full game plus DLC: the Banned Footage Vol. 1 and 2, and the End of Zoe epilogue episode.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Onimusha 1+2 Pack
games.summary:
Experience the origins of the classic samurai series remastered in high-definition! The first two Onimusha games are now available in 16:9 widescreen format with additional gameplay enhancements such as modernised controls.

Onimusha: Warlords
The first game in the series features popular actor Takeshi Kaneshiro as both the voice and face model of main character Samanosuke Akechi. Play as Samanosuke as he battles the Demons armed with the Oni Gauntlet bestowed to him by the Oni clan.

Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny
Jubei Yagyu returns in this sequel. Voiced by Yusaku Matsuda, Jubei will forge new alliances as he sets out on a quest of revenge with awakened powers of the Oni.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 3
games.summary:
A special collaboration with FINAL FANTASY XIV Online, the hit MMORPG, is coming in Title Update 3!
Experience a fanciful story featuring characters who have wandered from the faraway realm of Eorzea—the world of FINAL FANTASY XIV Online.
Get ready for a surge of awesome collaboration content!

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 4
games.summary: Title Update 4 (TU4) for Monster Hunter Wilds releasing December 16, 2025 which includes Gogmazios, expanded endgame content, and more.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

events.name: Indie Fan Fest: Fall 2025
events.description: A curated showcase from The MIX and Digital Bandidos, spotlighting unreleased indie games launching demos in the October 2025 Steam Next Fest, designed to help standout games drive maximum wishlist growth, reach new fans, and build buzz with press, creators, and players — when it matters most.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
games.summary: Explore a rich and unique open world in this Adventure RPG. Uncover lost dwarven ruins, build a new society and re-establish dwarven kind.

games.name: Froggy Hates Snow
games.summary: A survival roguelike where a frog digs through freezing snow, uncovers treasures, unlocks upgrades, and battles mystical creatures. Find the escape door or defeat the final boss to survive.

games.name: Nullspace
games.summary: Experience epic space battles in NULLSPACE, a story driven real-time strategy set in a retrofuturistic universe. Command massive fleets across the battlefield or jump in and take direct control of individual squadrons. Lead your forces to victory in visceral space combat.

games.name: Psychofinger
games.summary: Survive hordes of ghosts in this FPS-roguelite. Become an agent at the Department of Metaphysical Investigations and unveil the mystery of an old church. Choose Aberrant Items that will upgrade your character, fight bosses and unlock new hand gestures.

games.name: Let Them Come: Onslaught
games.summary: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde in Let Them Come: Onslaught, a sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

games.name: Gloom Punks
games.summary: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Beneath
games.summary: Plunge into a treacherous and enigmatic underwater world and brace yourself to confront the heart-stopping horrors that await as you fight against all odds.

games.name: Fish Stick Protocol
games.summary: Gather up to 8 players and dive into chaotic procedural dimensions to collect artifacts for the Owner's peculiar galleries.

games.name: Escape from Duckov
games.summary: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

games.name: Stars of Icarus
games.summary: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

games.name: Strange Brew
games.summary: Escape zombies and chase coffees! Run to survive the horrific launch of a new pumpkin spice latte. Play as Joe the Duck, a mascot, who must outmaneuver and outwit the brainless mobs. Destroy the company town to win some peace with your morning cup.

games.name: Curse of Pirates
games.summary: Ahoy, matey! How about slicing up some sea beasts and sending a couple of rivals to feed the kraken? Curse of Pirates be a true action roguelike, inspired by Vampire Survivors and Hades! Set sail upon the high seas, gather ye brave crew, and stand firm against the relentless tides of foes!

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Beatdown City Survivors
games.summary: Punch a car so hard it EXPLODES! Dash through flaming gas to create a fire trail burning everything. Destroy a hydrant to douse out the fire. Beatdown City Survivors is an immersive sandbox meets survive-em-up with dynamic environments & outrageous lite weapon crafting & team building.

games.name: Storebound
games.summary: A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

games.name: I Hate this Place
games.summary: A craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality. Scavenge and build to survive terrifying days and nights while using stealth and noise to fight enemies that stalk by sound. All styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe.

games.name: Oceaneers
games.summary: A survival-crafting colony sim set in a flooded world of unstable islands. Build a colony, craft gear, design rafts, fend off sharks, manage your survivors, and explore island bunkers to uncover lost Float-Tech from an old-world corporation.

games.name: Under Par Golf Architect
games.summary: Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

games.name: Bladesong
games.summary: Crafting/management game Bladesong is set on taking swordmaking mechanics to a new level, featuring unparalleled customization of the sword's every detail and deep analysis of the sword's physical properties. Take the role of a swordsmith in the city of Eren Keep, one of mankind’s last standing cities after the gods have banished themselves in an act of desperation. Run your forge, fulfill customer commissions and perfect your craft and tools. Find your way in a city governed by an idolized ruler with an iron grip and build a loyal team of those you deem trustworthy.

games.name: Hotel Architect
games.summary:
Step into the chaotic 24/7 lifestyle of a hotel owner as you design and build grand hotels across the globe. Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in Hotel Architect, the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.

Advance in a career campaign mode, with a variety of objectives to complete, in order to unlock the sandbox mode across each location.

Create your own hotel from scratch or transform a dilapidated plot into a thriving business. Design the layout and hire construction workers to lay the foundations and build different facilities across multiple floors. Building requires careful planning, as it plays out in real-time, so be careful annoy, disturb or remove items your guests are using – or else they might leave a bad review!

games.name: Little Corners
games.summary: Peel, place, and arrange stickers across tiny windows into different worlds. Relax and unwind to lofi beats, collect unique stickers and share your cozy creations with the world.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Umami
games.summary: Umami is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

games.name: Spooky Express
games.summary: Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

games.name: Gunny Ascend
games.summary: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure — Stack, Adapt, Escape! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

games.name: Dunebound Tactics
games.summary: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Frontier Paladin
games.summary: Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with weighty, stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves in tactical action-tower defense battles. Can you rebuild a shattered Order?

games.name: Anthem#9
games.summary: Combine Gems to unleash Skills in ANTHEM#9, a deck-building rogue-lite puzzle-battler! Customize your Recipes for a wide variety of deck ideas, and explore the thrilling story of secret agents fighting for world order.

games.name: Toy Smash Kaboom!
games.summary: Toy Warfare, Physics Collisions, Auto Chess, Space Management, Item Crafting, Trap Setting, Countless Playstyles—Every Combo is a Brand-New Adventure!​

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.summary: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.name: Liminal Skies
games.summary: Welcome to Liminal: Skies, the opening chapter of a new creative universe. More than just town building, here you can design your own characters, bring them to life with dialogue, and craft entire worlds through play. With Liminal, creation is the game.

games.name: Below the Crown
games.summary: Explore the dungeons Below the Crown, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Voron: Raven's Story
games.summary: In this story-driven adventure, you are the raven from the pages of Norse legends. Fly, explore an open world, uncover its secrets, solve puzzles, save souls, and help your family. Caw!

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

games.name: Astrobotanica
games.summary: Discover Earth 300 thousand years ago as an alien biologist. Utilize your expertise in botany to survive, grow plants, harvest crops, compose and brew tonics. Reveal hidden powers of unknown plants. Engage with primal humans, leaving your mark on the future of civilization.

games.name: Origament: A Paper Adventure
games.summary: Tiny paper - Big adventure! Soar, sail, and roll to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and travel through time and imagination

games.name: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
games.summary: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

games.name: Blind Descent
games.summary: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

games.name: Revelation of Decay
games.summary: Zombies have taken over our homes! Pick up guns, organize a brave team, and fuck up those monsters! Farm land, scavenge a large apocalyptic world, and fight various of zombies! Modify your weapons, defeat scaring bosses, and finally uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak and save our home!

games.name: Trash
games.summary: Discover a post-human earth in Trash, a beautifully crafted open-world action adventure game where strange and wondrous trash-based life thrives. Explore your surroundings with friends, solve puzzles, craft unique attachments and emerge from the heap.

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.summary: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

events.name: State of Play | September 24, 2025
events.description: Tune in live this Wednesday for more than 35 minutes of reveals and news from developers around the world. We’ll share new looks at anticipated third-party and indie titles, plus updates from some of our teams at PlayStation Studios - including an extended look at Saros, Housemarque’s mysterious new title arriving next year. Look forward to nearly five minutes of gameplay captured on PS5.

games.name: Saros
games.summary: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

games.name: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies
games.summary: From ZA/UM comes ZERO PARADES: For Dead Spies – a story-rich espionage RPG. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on a desperate assignment. Pick up the pieces of your broken network, untangle a bloody web of intrigue at the End of History, and prove yourself on the big stage or blow it all up – again.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.summary: Pursue your dream of an aviation career with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This brand-new simulator is designed to take advantage of the latest technologies in simulation, cloud, machine learning, graphics and gaming to create the most sophisticated, immersive and awe-inspiring flight simulator of all time. To achieve this unprecedented level of accuracy, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is powered by the significantly evolved Asobo Studio engine.

games.name: Battlefield 6
games.summary: The ultimate all-out warfare experience. In a war of tanks, fighter jets, and massive combat arsenals, your squad is the deadliest weapon.

games.name: Deus Ex Remastered
games.summary: This is Deus Ex Remastered the definitive version of Ion Storms legendary cyberpunk immersive sim, modernized with visual upgrades, modern enhancements, and quality-of-life improvements for a new generation of operatives.

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.summary: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Last Epoch
games.summary:
Uncover the Past, Reforge the Future.

Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred transformative skill trees. Last Epoch is being developed by a team of passionate Action RPG enthusiasts.

games.name: Last Epoch: Orobyss
games.summary:
Ascend into one of 15 mastery classes and explore dangerous dungeons, hunt epic loot, craft legendary weapons, and wield the power of over a hundred and thirty transformative skill trees.

Last Epoch combines time travel, exciting dungeon crawling, engrossing character customization, and endless replayability to create an Action RPG for veterans and newcomers alike. Travel through the world of Eterra’s past and face dark empires, wrathful gods, and untouched wilds – to find a way to save time itself from The Void.

games.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
games.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG set in the universe of The Seven Deadly Sins. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Mega Man Pack
games.summary:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Mega Man Pack includes:
• Mega Man and Proto Man Playable Characters
• Rush Roadstar Vehicle
• Wily Castle track
• 6 Emotes per Character
• 8 Additional Sounds

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds
games.summary: Race across land, sea, air, space, and time in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.

games.name: Nioh 3
games.summary: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: Code Vein II
games.summary:
Code Vein II is an action role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world where Revenants are being transformed into hostile "Horrors." A Revenant Hunter must partner with a time-manipulating companion named Lou.
Gameplay features third-person action combat and deep RPG progression, emphasizing specialized Blood-based mechanics and character customization. An evolved Partner System enhances tactical cooperation with AI companions during exploration and high-difficulty boss encounters. Success depends on mastering diverse weaponry and temporal abilities to survive a world defined by memory and ruin.

games.name: Final Fantasy Tactics: The Ivalice Chronicles
games.summary: This dramatic tale of ambition, betrayal, and honor comes to life again with an updated and enriched script with fully voiced dialogue, alongside improved graphics that bring a new level of immersion and playability to the battlefield. Additionally, the enhanced version brings quality-of-life updates like new difficulties, a revamped UI, auto save, and more that make the game more accessible to newcomers.

games.name: Let It Die: Inferno
games.summary:
LET IT DIE: INFERNO is a roguelite survival action game where you can engage in chaotic battles with grotesque monsters, enemy factions, and even other players.

Humanity had just recovered from the unprecedented cataclysm known as “Earth Rage,” when suddenly, a massive chasm appeared—large enough to swallow an entire city whole.​ Someone began calling the hole “Hell Gate,” and lying at its depths is the “Eye of the Reaper,” a powerful crystal containing the energy to rule the world. Explore, survive, and extract from the Inferno, where stage layouts and item placements differ every match.

In this game, on top of player-versus-environment-versus-player—where players and enemies collide within Hell Gate—there is also a mode for battling exclusively with other players. We hope you enjoy this powered-up version of the LET IT DIE world!

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
