games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

games.name: SoulCalibur III
games.summary:
A port of SoulCalibur III, originally released on the PlayStation 2 console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Soulcalibur III is a fighting game, the sequel to Soulcalibur II, and the fourth installment in the Soul series. Compared to its predecessor, it introduces three new modes and a larger character roster, with 24 characters playable in Tales of Souls mode and an additional 18 playable in all other modes.

games.name: Gran Turismo 7: Spec III
games.summary: The free Spec III Update 1.65* brings an exciting mix of high-performance machines, classic icons, and cutting-edge technology to Gran Turismo. From Ferrari’s latest track-bred GT3 to Polestar’s electric powerhouse, plus new circuits, events, and features, there’s something for every racing enthusiast.**

games.name: Crimson Desert
games.summary: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.

games.name: Alan Wake II
games.summary: Alan Wake 2 marks Remedy Entertainment’s first foray into the survival horror genre. Ritualistic murders in a small town. A writer trapped in a nightmare. An FBI agent looking for answers. Two realities. Two hero characters. One horror story that wants them dead.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3
games.summary: Pilgor’s baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; a totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage together, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends.

games.name: Cocoon
games.summary: Cocoon is a puzzle adventure game developed by Geometric Interactive and published by Annapurna Interactive. Players control a small insect-like creature navigating interconnected worlds contained within orbs, solving environmental puzzles by carrying and using these orbs to manipulate space and progression.

games.name: The Last of Us Part II Remastered
games.summary: Experience the winner of over 300 Game of the Year awards now with an array of technical enhancements that make The Last of Us Part Il Remastered the definitive way to play Ellie and Abby's critically acclaimed story.

games.name: The Last of Us Part II
games.summary: The Last of Us Part II is an action-adventure game set five years after the events of The Last of Us. The player traverses post-apocalyptic environments such as buildings and forests to advance the story. They can use firearms, improvised weapons, and stealth to defend against hostile humans and cannibalistic creatures infected by a mutated strain of the Cordyceps fungus. The game intermittently switches control between Ellie and Abby, and also briefly Joel in the opening sequence. The nimble nature of the player character introduces platforming elements, allowing the player to jump and climb to traverse environments and gain advantages during combat.

games.name: Tekken 3
games.summary:
A port of Tekken 3, originally released on the PlayStation console, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Nineteen years following the previous King of Iron Fist tournament, fighters from all over the world have mysteriously begun to disappear at the hands of the enigmatic being known only as Toshin. Heihachi, hoping the promise of strong opponents will lure out this so-called "God of Fighting," begins his preparations for The King of Iron Fist Tournament 3.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Anniversary
games.summary:
This is an emulation of the classic PS2 action-adventure title, Tomb Raider: Anniversary, playable on PS4 and PS5 for the first time and enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Tomb Raider: Anniversary is a third-person action-adventure game that revisits Lara Croft’s original journey to recover the Scion artifact. It reimagines the 1996 title with updated environments, refined controls, and expanded narrative elements while maintaining the exploration, platforming, and combat of the original game.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine
games.summary: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology. It is planned as the first installment in a trilogy of games focused on the X-Men.

events.name: TGS2025: Annapurna Interactive
events.description: Indie game publisher Annapurna Interactive - known for titles such as Stray and Outer Wilds - will make its debut appearance at Tokyo Game Show. Will be held on the official TGS stage, delivering the latest updates a new title slated for release in 2026.

games.name: D-topia
games.summary: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, its up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: Project Evilbane
games.summary: Project Evilbane is a dynamic and action-packed strategy-based experience that you can tackle solo or with friends. Switch freely between ranged and melee weapons, and customize your skills for every situation to create your own unique warrior. Your choices and teamwork will determine your victory!

games.name: Ninja Gaiden 4
games.summary: The definitive ninja action-adventure franchise returns with Ninja Gaiden 4! Embark on a cutting-edge adventure where legacy meets innovation in a high-octane blend of style and no-holds-barred combat.

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

games.name: Terminull Brigade
games.summary: Rise in the virtual rebellion to free the Nullverse in this action-packed roguelike game together with other players, or alone. Master your Rogueteers with distinct playstyles and customizable builds and break out from the binaric destiny with the Terminull Brigade.

games.name: Winter Burrow
games.summary: Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game about a mouse returning home to restore their childhood burrow. Explore, gather resources, craft, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.summary: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

games.name: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Blood Heat
games.summary: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Blood Heat is a third-person action game that reworks Gungrave G.O.R.E with updated visuals, revised combat systems, and redesigned encounters. Players control Grave, a resurrected gunslinger who battles hordes of enemies using a combination of gunplay, close-range attacks, and combo-driven combat. The game emphasizes fast-paced action, large-scale battles, and the series' signature "bullet ballet" style.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Rhythm Doctor
games.summary: Save patients with your rhythm mastery! Rhythm Doctor is a rhythm game where you heal patients by defibrillating in time to their heartbeats. Learn each patient's unique heartbeat and defeat boss viruses trying to sabotage your rhythm, all set to heart-pumping, soul-soothing music.

games.name: Double Dragon Revive
games.summary: Double Dragon Revive faithfully reproduces the thrill of old school side-scrolling action games, with updated controls and difficulty settings for the modern era, and utilizing Arc System Works’ fighting game development experience. Jimmy Lee, Billy Lee, Roper, Abobo, and more will appear in stylish 3D.

games.name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
games.summary: The full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly. This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters lost in an abandoned village haunted by evil spirits. Using the Camera Obscura, they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Sudden Strike 5
games.summary: Sudden Strike 5 delivers real-time tactics in epic WWII battles. A host of tactical options and more than 300 playable units open-up multiple approaches to reach your objectives in a 25 mission campaign on historical battlefields in Europe and North Africa.

games.name: Fallout 76
games.summary: Fallout 76 is an online action role-playing game and the first multiplayer entry in the Fallout series. Set in 2102 in Appalachia, West Virginia, players control a resident of Vault 76 who ventures into the open world 25 years after a nuclear war. The game features exploration, questing, base building, and combat against mutated creatures and hostile factions. It can be played solo or cooperatively, with players sharing servers and engaging in trade or PvP combat.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear
games.summary: Unleash 12 new gods in a mythic Japanese campaign and multiplayer. Command powerful samurai, shadowy ninjas and creatures from Japanese mythology in this epic expansion.

games.name: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7
games.summary: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 is a first-person shooter set in 2035, co-developed by Treyarch and Raven Software. The game features three main modes: a cooperative campaign playable with up to four players or solo, multiplayer with 6v6 and 20v20 modes, and the round-based Zombies mode. Multiplayer features a perk system split into combat specialties, weapon prestige progression, and scorestreak rewards.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories
games.summary: The first installment of the Monster Hunter Stories series is back and coming to Nintendo Switch, PC, and PlayStation 4! Become a Monster Rider and hatch, raise, and battle with your favorite Monsties in this epic RPG adventure.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
games.summary: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin offers both RPG and Monster Hunter fans a unique new experience with a rich storyline featuring charming characters, challenging quests and friendly encounters with familiar monsters from the Monster Hunter series. Assuming the role of a young Monster Rider who can use a Kinship Stone to form strong bonds with monsters, players can gain experience and improve their skills to form deeper connections with these wonderful creatures. When ready, players can embark on memorable adventures filled with dramatic events and heartwarming friendships as the epic tale unfolds.

games.name: Hitman World of Assassination: Bruce Lee
games.summary: Unlock a series of cosmetics inspired by The Infiltrator Elusive Target mission and gain permanent access to The Dragon - A Two-level Arcade contract featuring The Infiltrator Elusive Target.

games.name: Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven
games.summary:
Romancing SaGa 2: Revenge of the Seven is a full remake of the groundbreaking non-linear RPG Romancing SaGa 2, which originally launched in Japan in 1993.

Embark on an adventure featuring both new and classic SaGa franchise features, complete with Japanese and English voiceovers, original and rearranged compositions, and much more! This is an ideal entry point for new players and provides an amped-up experience for longtime fans.

games.name: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake
games.summary: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: World Update 20 - Japan
games.summary:
This massive, exciting update brings Japan to life like never before in Microsoft Flight Simulator!

Japan is a nation of beauty and intrigue, filled with breathtaking vistas of towering mountains, iconic architecture, and renowned cities. The country beholds some of the world’s most alluring and famous sights, including Mount Fuji, Japan’s highest mountain, Osaka Castle, a revered historical monument, and soaring skylines throughout Tokyo, Kyoto, Sapporo, and other metropolises. World Update 20 reveals Japan in stunning, vibrant detail—and the release comes with a great selection of missions throughout this storied country to immerse Microsoft Flight Simulator aviators in its beauty and history.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

events.name: TGS2025: LEVEL5 Special Match: Exclusive Gameplay Reveal!
events.description: Starting at 9:00 PM on Thursday, September 25, 2025, we'll be livestreaming the "LEVEL5 Special Match: Exclusive Gameplay Reveal!"as part of the TOKYO GAME SHOW 2025 Official Program! Our guests include Lisa Hanabusa from VSPO! and voice actors Yuki Kaji and Sho Komura, with Mayu Yoshioka serving as host. The program will feature intense head-to-head battles from our showcased titles, as well as the latest update information. A special giveaway campaign to celebrate the livestream, where you can win exclusive original gifts, is also being planned. We look forward to your participation!

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary:
Professor Layton and the New World of Steam depicts the world one year after the events of "Professor Layton and the Unwound Future".

Due to a mysterious incident in Steam Bison, a new adventure for Layton and Luke begins!

games.name: Inazuma Eleven: Victory Road
games.summary: The latest entry in the character collection and football simulation RPG series, "Inazuma Eleven!" With an original story featuring new main characters, over 4,500 players from across the series' history to collect and train, as well as exciting online tournaments, you can play the game your way!

games.name: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time is an RPG life-sim game and the long-awaited sequel to the 3DS classic Fantasy Life. This game will expand on what the original did, blending simulation with traditional action RPG combat mechanics.

events.name: Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival Showcase 2025
events.description: Hosted by Lirie and Ran, the Fall in Love Visual Novel Festival Showcase will feature 20 different romance-filled game trailers from the Steam sale.

games.name: Lock & Key: A Magical Girl Mystery
games.summary: Lock and Key: A Magical Girl Mystery is a romantic thriller starring a married couple of former Magical Girls. Along with and old friend and a new protégé, they'll undertake one last journey to free Chicago from the terrifying grip of a mysterious serial killer.

games.name: Mirage Noir
games.summary: Play as a detective, solve cases, and try to catch an elusive serial killer in this mystery visual novel focused on found family

games.name: Fledgling Manor
games.summary: A supernatural horror visual novel where vampires compete to save their eternal unlives in a high-stakes reality show.

games.name: Saintess of the Golden Bow
games.summary:
Celine thought her life as an American office worker was mundane, but after a fatal accident, she wakes up as an extra character in her favorite web novel a BL tragedy fantasy. Expected to die early as part of the protagonist's backstory, Celine defies fate and survives her death event, causing a butterfly effect that catapults her into the role of the Saintess of the Golden Bow.

Joined by an unforgettable cast of characters including the valiant knight Levi, the enigmatic Mad Prince Noah, and the devout High Priest Elijah you must lead a quest to defeat the Demon Queen and bring peace to the realm. Each choice you make weaves a complex web of romance, friendship, and sacrifice, offering a deeply personal and replayable journey.

games.name: Of Sense and Soul
games.summary: A queer Victorian romance visual novel in which a gentleman running from the past and a poet hiding from the future collide through a lonely hearts ad. Suddenly, their lives can blossom—if you choose to change them.

games.name: Adult Life Yuri Bundle by Team ANPIM
games.summary: Collection of 4 yuri stories by Team ANPIM, featuring women who are 23 years and older! No longer students, they are finding romance while balancing the responsibilities of working, rent, and adulting.

games.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
games.summary:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

games.name: In Ashes
games.summary: An unexpected quest has reached your sleepy town. Once again, you must raise your weapon and step into the boots of a weary, burnt out adventurer. When faced with a choice, what kind of hero will you be? In Ashes is a choice-driven fantasy visual novel about adventurers, monsters, and the forgotten.

games.name: Draculesti
games.summary: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

games.name: Starbright Agency
games.summary:
In the neon-lit streets of Neo Seattle, being a hero isn’t just a calling — it’s a high-stakes industry. Unranked and overlooked, Star Scout Wishbright would do anything to get her big break until her agency proposes a bold plan: Fake a high-profile romance with one of the city’s top-ranked Scouts to skyrocket her to success.

Staged dates, exciting twists and turns. It’s all for show — until the spotlight reveals truths Wishbright could never expect.

Neo Seattle’s finest, not unlike the city itself, are full of secrets. Secrets hidden in their civilian lives — where the masks come off and identities are not just for show. Can Wishbright navigate the act and the actual without losing herself?

In the end, will she choose fame, love, or something gray in between? Set against a glittering City-Pop inspired backdrop this queer friendly visual novel puts you in control of Wishbright’s journey through love and heartbreak, fame and failure.

Will you rise to the top? Or will you realize that some dreams aren’t worth losing yourself over.

games.name: Bustafellows: Season 2
games.summary:
Bustafellows Season 2 is an otome visual novel developed and published by eXtend.

Everyone wants answers. Who is to blame? What went wrong? And what must the punishment be? To preserve the state of the world, everything is either black or white. Those who focus on the in-between will only continue to suffer.

games.name: Snow White Ashes
games.summary: Lose your heart in this dark fairy-tale romance! Once upon a winter night, you enter the woods in search of a beast. But the hunter you find is so charming and sweet–is he truly the monster you seek?

games.name: Taisho Romance Theater
games.summary: This is a dark and diverse romance visual novel set in 1920s Taishō-era Japan, where amnesiac actor Kotori Sakuma is pulled into long-buried secrets after a friend's mysterious death. As he becomes entangled in magic, conspiracy, and haunting blood ties, his search leads him toward a darker truth.

games.name: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
games.summary: Sensei! I Like You So Much! is a fangirl simulator. Step into the shoes of a passionate fan girl and embark on a journey through the vibrant world of fan culture in this immersive simulation management game.

games.name: Upwards, Rain! The Post Office of Farewells
games.summary: On the outskirts of a small village stands a massive tree whose canopy disappears far above the clouds. While grandiose on the outside, its interior houses the humble Mortem Post, which receives and delivers letters from those who have passed on. Deciding to break protocol to lend a helping wing, Rain, a flighty little courier takes a skittish girl by the name of Mila on an adventure through the inner workings of the post office. Together, they search for a letter containing the last words of someone who seemingly never existed.

games.name: A Date with Death
games.summary: Fight against and romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a chat simulator visual novel where you date the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through fully voiced video calls.

games.name: The Mysterious Thief: Forget Me Not
games.summary: A story-rich, girl's love visual novel about phantom thieves.

games.name: Fearbonding
games.summary: Fearbonding is a Yandere x Demon BL Horror Visual Novel. Play as Hinata, a demon, and try to tame the deranged Kosuke. Will you get to satisfy your hunger for fear through your new hunting dog or will you be the one to get devoured?

games.name: Alaris
games.summary:
A global crisis that only continues to escalate. A dangerous run-in with a shadowy stranger. And a mysterious word that won't stop gnawing at you. How does everything tie together? And what role could you possibly play in all of this?

Enter a world of magic—of Fae and Dragon.

games.name: Imperial Grace
games.summary: Imperial Grace is a unique mix of romance, medieval intrigue, and strategy. Play as the new Empress of Calidya through a visual novel rife with ambition and deceit. Make choices that will change your fate and that of your nation, rule wisely to make your Empire prosper, and find love along the way!

games.name: Borderlands 4
games.summary: See if you have what it takes to go down in history as a legendary Vault Hunter as you search for secret alien treasure, blasting everything in sight.

games.name: Borderlands 4: Vault Hunter Pack
games.summary: Explore all-new regions of Kairos with two new Vault Hunters with the Borderlands 4 Vault Hunter Pack. Experience all new story and side missions, and take on new challenges and fearsome foes!

events.name: PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct 2025
events.description: The PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct will spotlight some of the best upcoming games on PC, with publishers such as SEGA, Devolver Digital and Nightdive Studios already confirmed to appear," a press release says. "Expect exclusive trailers, news from the showfloor, must-see developer interviews and world exclusive announcements.

games.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply
games.summary: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.

games.name: Earth Must Die
games.summary: These moronic Terranoids think they can just roll in here and take over my beautiful Tyrythian kingdom? The kingdom that I built from the ground up with my bare hands, and only sort of inherited from my dear, sweet, extremely dead father? This is complete bullsh*t, and I'm going to make them dead.

games.name: Minos
games.summary: Minos is a maze-building roguelite where you, the fabled Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: Awaysis
games.summary: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

games.name: Billie Bust Up
games.summary:
Billie Bust Up is a musical 3D platformer inspired by Disney musicals, with memorable unique villains and singing bosses that entwines gameplay with music.

Each main character has their own song that sells their personality, motives, and charm, written by Daniel Ingram from My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic.

games.name: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties
games.summary: YAKUZA KIWAMI 3 is an extreme remake of the action-adventure beat 'em up Yakuza 3 featuring ex-yakuza Kazuma Kiryu's fight to protect those he loves. DARK TIES is a brand-new game featuring Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 included as a separate action-packed experience.

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Gravebound
games.summary: Gravebound is a post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in a world where crumbling cities and ancient magic collide. Fight, loot, and survive against deadly creatures and rival players as you explore the Shatterlands.

games.name: Kaiju Cleanup
games.summary: Relax and unwind by cleaning up the world’s biggest corpses. In a Cleaning Sim like no other, your job is to slice up and tidy away Kaiju carcasses, leaving the city clean and serene. Until the next Kaiju attack, obviously.

games.name: Hotel Barcelona
games.summary:
"Hotel Barcelona," where serial killers from all over the United States are said to have gathered. You must defeat them and check out before all the blood is spilled.

Japanese game creators SWERY65 and SUDA51 have teamed up to create this ambitious work. Don't miss it.

games.name: Mars Tactics
games.summary: Classic turn-based tactical combat with some modern twists. Use stress to manage RNG. Master advanced suppression mechanics. Grow troops who develop abilities, personalities & relationships based on what happens in battle. Procedural, destructible maps. Realistic bullet physics.

games.name: Clawpunk
games.summary: Clawpunk is a challenging, fast-paced, melee 2D action game with roguelite elements and multiple characters, where the player can run rampant in a destructible environment that rewards a reactive and aggressive play style.

games.name: Soulmask
games.summary: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

games.name: Soulmask: Shifting Sands
games.summary:
The Scorching Land: A New World Born from Ancient Egypt

This was once a land blessed by the Solar Deity, a pearl in the desert, but now, all its glory has scattered to the winds...

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Doomspire
games.summary: Doomspire is a roguelike card game where you play a hero and venture deeper into the Doomspire, a dark and ancient structure. Face terrifying bosses, gather treasures, and strategically build your deck as you descend into the abyss, where doom awaits.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.summary: "Guardian, gather the pieces of the great relic and seal the void of darkness." In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void.

games.name: Motionrec
games.summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

games.name: Mind Diver
games.summary: Restore a broken mind to solve a twisted case. Investigate a couple's most intimate moments and piece together the events of a fateful night. Pick what to investigate, deduce awful truths, and solve a dark mystery. But most of all, Mind Diver: find the lost love. Before it's too late.

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Turnbound
games.summary: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them?

games.name: Join Us
games.summary: Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

games.name: Threads of Time
games.summary: Threads of Time is an era-spanning, turn-based RPG inspired by the timeless classics. Embark on a journey through time, gather a party of charismatic heroes from across ages, and uncover a plot that threatens to unravel the past, present and future.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Reach
games.summary:
The ground-breaking cinematic action-adventure from nDreams Elevation – the VR immersion expert’s pioneering new studio.

Embody a reluctant hero, wield extraordinary abilities, and journey into a perilous world of crossed realities. Make every move matter to shape your destiny. Are you ready to make the leap?

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: House Flipper 2: Pets
games.summary: House Flipper 2 is getting rowdy! With dozens of pets to choose from, you can now adopt your new best friend. Let them accompany you during the pet-centered jobs or relax by petting them with your friends in the Co-op!

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

games.name: People of Note
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

games.name: D-topia
games.summary: Step into the world of D-topia in this gentle-paced puzzle adventure. In D-topia, life is curated by artificial intelligence to maximize happiness. As the newest Facilitator, its up to you to solve puzzles to keep the D-topia residents happy and the facility running.

games.name: Oku
games.summary: Become a zen monk and embark on a journey towards spiritual growth. Ride the wind across artistic Japanese landscapes as you write Haiku-like poems to capture the beauty of nature and unlock forgotten paths.

games.name: Morbid Metal
games.summary: Morbid Metal is a stylish fast-paced hack’n’slash action rogue-lite. Shapeshift into powerful characters in real time, chain impactful combos, and tear through waves of deadly machines and brutal bosses.

games.name: Huntsman
games.summary: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

games.name: Raev: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
games.summary: Build an empire, founding its villages and cities. Every kingdom started with a single bonfire, and RAEV allows you to create your own thriving civilization across a sprawling continent. Craft interwoven cityscapes, inspire your people, and build a kingdom to forge your path to greatness.

games.name: Absolum
games.summary: Crafted with passion by the dream team that redefined side-scrolling beat 'em ups, Absolum mixes top-of-the-class combat action with modern roguelite elements, bringing all the vibes of the fantasy arcade hits of the past into an immersive adventure set in the original world of Talamh.

games.name: Task Time
games.summary: Task Time is a Gameshow inspired competitive party game where 8 friends dive headfirst into 6 rounds of unpredictable tasks and physics-fuelled chaos, to finish top of the leaderboard. From (some of) the people who worked on Gang Beasts and Fall Guys, this is your new favourite friendslop.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Farmbotic
games.summary: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

events.name: The Horror Game Awards: Halloween Showcase 2025
events.description: Get ready for a spine-chilling time at The Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase!

games.name: Macabre
games.summary: A four-player co-op nightmare where you must outsmart a monster that adapts to your every move. Enter a volatile time rift, craft and upgrade gear to survive, and face shifting objectives on procedural maps. Will you band together, or betray your friends for the lion’s share of the loot?

games.name: BioCrisis: Return 2 the Lab
games.summary: The alert has been given, the virus is on the loose, you've escaped the lab, the city will be nuked!

games.name: Dead Format
games.summary: Dead Format is a survival horror game set in iconic film eras. It's 1990s Scotland, and your brother has gone missing after becoming obsessed with a mysterious new VHS format. Follow his trail through the tapes and uncover why the government wants to ban "Video Ghastlies".

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

games.name: Backrooms Level X
games.summary: Enter the disturbing world of Backrooms Level X, a first-person narrative survival horror game that immerses you in an endless labyrinth of desolate and liminal spaces. 13 levels and giant enemies await you in this unique experience.

games.name: A.A.U. Black Site
games.summary: The consequence of a mission gone wrong leaves you trapped in an endless cycle of nihilistic, man-made hell on earth, with your only option for survival being to trust a stranger’s voice that guides you through the darkest depths of the forgotten, shut-down Yugoslav town of Uzovnica.

games.name: N.O.X.
games.summary: N.O.X. is a co-op horror game where up to four players take on the roles of paranormal investigators. Players must find clues, identify the type of spirit, and banish it using their tools, either alone or together with their crew.

games.name: Death In Abyss
games.summary: Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep sea hostilities.

games.name: Sacrificio
games.summary: An intense and fast-paced survival horror shooter in a dark fantasy world. Face overwhelming odds in a brutal struggle against evil.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: Besmirch
games.summary: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.

games.name: Shock
games.summary: In SHOCK, you play as a disabled war veteran, hunted by a cybernetic creature. With only a wheelchair for mobility, use stealth, solve puzzles, and crawl into tight spaces to escape. Survive the horror and uncover the truth behind this nightmare.

games.name: Scary Cargo
games.summary: A co-op survival horror for 14 players deliver cargo, stay alive, and trust no one for too long.

games.name: Descendant of Night
games.summary: Descendant of Night is a love letter to the 00s era of survival horror. Play as Blake Cage, a sharp-tongued operative of Vector Six - humanity’s last hope against the darkness. Unravel a gripping, lore-rich mystery of ancient immortals, bloodthirsty vampires, and the desperate struggle of mankind.

games.name: Shark Dentist
games.summary: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.

games.name: Dark Atlas: Infernum
games.summary: If Hell is a state of the soul, this story is the descent to the inner abyss. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story , where the end of the world is combined with psychological terror in a survival horror experience with a strong narrative component.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Testimonium
games.summary: Testimonium is a bite-sized, experimental analog horror game designed to push your psychological limits. PLAY THE TAPE.

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: The Bagman
games.summary: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

games.name: Blood Reaver
games.summary: A Dark-fantasy, Round-based FPS. Become the Blood Reaver in solo or 4-player co-op. Harness forbidden magic and weaponry to shoot, blast and slice your way through endless hordes of demons. Upgrade your arsenal and survive long enough to discover the ancient secrets of the gods of hell.

games.name: Dark Hours
games.summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

games.name: Ground Zero
games.summary: Fight through post-apocalyptic South Korea in this retro survival horror. Uncover the truth behind the devastating meteor impact that left the country in ruins and turned every living organism into a terrifying monstrosity. Fight. Solve puzzles. Upgrade gear. Make every bullet count.

games.name: Iris Dissolution
games.summary: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

games.name: Quite a Ride
games.summary: Pedal through the fog, but never look back.Trapped in a constantly shifting horror, you must ride, conserve your phone's battery, and decode cryptic messages to escape. Explore, survive, uncover the truth.

games.name: Painkiller
games.summary: The classic Painkiller series is back! Battle through Purgatory in fast-paced co-op action, wielding infernal weapons against relentless demonic hordes. Condemned for your sins, the Voice of the Creator offers you a chance at redemption. Will you seize it or be lost to darkness?

games.name: Who Are You!?
games.summary: Who Are You!? is a sci-fi psychological horror experience based on real UFO research. The story centers on Ray Roswell and his internal fight to understand the disappearance of his wife, which may involve an alien abduction.

games.name: Fear FA 98
games.summary: FEAR FA 98: Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98. Use your enemies' heads as the ball, use knives, and summon demons! the very first survival horror soccer simulator!. Play against the computer, or the classic local mode to enjoy with your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: Tormentor
games.summary: Take on the role of a merciless torturer. Earn money from video transmissions of your torments and then buy new victims and torture tools to expand your prison.

games.name: The Cave Diver
games.summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

games.name: Cosmic Fear
games.summary: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

games.name: Dark Fracture
games.summary: Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.

games.name: After Lights Out
games.summary: After Lights Out is a first person psychological horror game. Players will explore a terrifying house that keeps changing in the dark. Use the lights to solve the puzzles and uncover the hidden truth in the room.

games.name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
games.summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

games.name: Faith: The Unholy Trinity
games.summary: What you are about to do has not been approved by the Vatican. As a young priest, struggle against demons, insane cultists, and your own weakening faith in this pixel horror game inspired by the era of classic 8-bit gaming and the "Satanic Scare" of the 1980s.

games.name: Crisol: Theater of Idols
games.summary: What would you do if your blood were your only weapon? How much would you sacrifice your life? Experience the unholy island of Tormentosa in this twisted first-person adventure full of horror and action where only your blood can be used to defeat the impious creatures that roam therein.

games.name: BrokenLore: Dark Dawn
games.summary: BrokenLore: DARK DAWN is a first-person psychological horror where you face the horrors of abduction and fight to escape a warped reality. Do you have what it takes?

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Watch
games.summary: In BrokenLore: DON'T WATCH, immerse yourself in the haunting world of Shinji, a young hikikomori trapped in his Tokyo apartment. As his mind unravels, confront a malevolent entity watching from the shadows. Will you uncover the truth before it's too late?

games.name: BrokenLore: Low
games.summary: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

games.name: Cold Abyss
games.summary: COLD ABYSS is a relaxing and atmospheric exploration game where you repair internet cables on the bottom of the ocean.There are no enemies or other forms of danger down there. Just you.

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: DreadOut 3
games.summary: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as Keepers of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

games.name: The Fractured Shimmer
games.summary: The Fractured Shimmer is a 2.5D pixel-art survival horror adventure where you follow Eddy, a journalist investigating a string of unsettling murder cases.

games.name: Midnight Dreams
games.summary: In Midnight Dreams, embark on a psychological horror adventure, playing as Felipe, a boy with a unique perspective. Trapped in a space station on the brink of destruction, overcome dark obstacles, unravel secrets, and join Felipe's quest for truth, freedom, and forgiveness.

games.name: Animal Use Protocol
games.summary: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: BrokenLore: Unfollow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Heart of the Forest
games.summary: An ill-fated hiking trip into the Black Forest spirals into a chilling fight for survival in this interactive horror adventure.

games.name: Maid of Sker VR
games.summary: Maid of Sker VR is a first-person survival horror, set in a remote hotel with a gory and macabre history from Welsh folklore. Brave the nightmares of the Quiet Ones. Do not panic…don’t even breathe!

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: Becrowned
games.summary: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

games.name: Rogue Mansion
games.summary:
Rogue Mansion is a survival horror game combined with the best of the roguelike genre! Explore a procedurally generated mansion that changes every time you play, and becomes more dangerous and unpredictable according to your level of fear.

Experience the game in different ways, by choosing from multiple unique characters, each with their own equipment, specialist perks, and motivations.

games.name: Silly Polly Beast
games.summary: This story is about a girl who, by the will of fate, faced the beast, and in order to become free she was forced to study its nature. A story-driven roguelike with aggressive gunfights and terrifying monsters awaits you. How far can you go in the fight for your freedom?

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Demon King
games.summary: Venture through the Labyrinth Of The Demon King, solving puzzles and fighting fearsome monsters in an epic quest to track down the demon who betrayed your lord and end it’s life.

games.name: Dead Reset
games.summary: Trapped in a terrifying death-loop, surgeon Cole Mason is kidnapped and brought to an underwater facility, forced to operate on a patient to extract an evolving parasitic horror. Dead Reset is a blood-soaked interactive horror, where each death brings you closer to the truth.

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary: The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders. Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Flesh Made Fear
games.summary: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.

games.name: Projekt Z: Beyond Order
games.summary: Projekt Z: Beyond Order is an atmospheric First-Person Zombie Co-Op-Shooter set in WW2. In this game, you get to play different characters, who have very different abilities, to find out more about the secrets of the german island you all crashed on.

games.name: Bye Sweet Carole
games.summary: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

games.name: Echograph
games.summary: Photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

games.name: Midnight Special
games.summary: Welcome to 'Midnight Special,' a gripping point-and-click survival horror game that pays homage to 70s and 80s cinema. The game's story draws inspiration from giallo, slashers, and sci-fi classics, while the presentation is inspired by 90s 16-bit aesthetics.

games.name: Niraya of
games.summary: "Niraya of " is a Japanese horror game inspired by the Buddhist beliefs. The game focuses on a unique system where players "avoid" the attacks of various monsters. This, combined with the fear of exploring eerie environments and solving puzzles, is a major draw of the game.

games.name: Trenches VR
games.summary: Trenches VR is a psychological horror game where your microphone becomes part of the terror - enemies can hear your real-life breathing, whispers, or cries for help. Stay quiet, stay hidden… or they’ll come for you.

games.name: Cult Vacui
games.summary: Cult Vacui is a horror point-and-click adventure with survival and time management elements where your choices could keep you alive... or not.

games.name: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun
games.summary: Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night? LET THE HUNT BEGIN!

games.name: The 18th Attic
games.summary: The 18th Attic is a psychological horror game where you play as a man trapped in a loop, armed with an instant picture camera. Hunt down paranormal anomalies lurking around by taking their pictures and detecting their presence to unravel secrets of your past. Each photo unlocks a new memory.

games.name: The Dark Delivers
games.summary: Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.

games.name: Contaminant
games.summary: CONTAMINANT is a third-person action horror set in an alternate post-Soviet reality. As Maria, trapped in her grandfather’s grim factory, you’ll uncover secrets of your family through brutal combat, twisted puzzles, and surreal realms of abominations.

games.name: Lily's World XD
games.summary: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… A fourth wall-breaking psychological horror experience featuring LilyPichu.

games.name: Last Chance Market
games.summary: When a grocery list becomes a struggle to survive against cosmic horrors, will you make it through the door? Stay alive, solve the mystery and make your offerings - or end up on a missing person poster in this first-person, non-linear nightmare. But you'd better hurry, the store's closing soon.

games.name: Pulsebreaker
games.summary: Pulsebreaker is a classic survival horror game. Explore environments, collect resources, and fight zombies. Manage your inventory, solve light puzzles, and survive with limited supplies. Includes melee and ranged combat. Single-player only.

games.name: Parasensor
games.summary: When Marisol starts a new life as a telecom technician, she finds herself out of her depth in a mutating city. Connect with strangers, confront grotesque creatures, and unravel a conspiracy at the heart of the metamorphosis.

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Ultrasound
games.summary: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

games.name: Shutter Story
games.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: A.I.L.A
games.summary: A.I.L.A. is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

games.name: Eternal Haunt
games.summary: Eternal Haunt is a first-person atmospheric survival horror game. Explore the claustrophobic labyrinth of Yuki-Onna's home. Solve dynamic puzzles, scavenge for items, experience haunting scares that shift and evolve. Can you endure the relentless cold and escape the chilling embrace of death?

games.name: Inanima
games.summary: Inanima Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

events.name: Out of Bounds Indie Showcase 2025
events.description: Spanish independent game publisher Entalto Publishing and independent Spanish developer GGTech are happy to present Out of Bounds, the new hybrid game showcase dedicated to bringing you the newest, freshest, and boldest titles from out of this world.

games.name: Project Blur
games.summary: Project BLUR (code name) is the second game from Maboroshi Artworks.

games.name: TPK
games.summary: A chaotic co-op dungeon crawler for up to 6 “heroes” dumb enough to explore a sadistic demiplane full of traps built by a bored Lich. Solve puzzles, fight monsters, make highly questionable decisions “for the good of the group”, and die in dungeons. Don’t cry, this is just another Total Party Kill.

games.name: Detour
games.summary: DETOUR is a single-player driving adventure through a mysterious sci-fi landscape. Upgrade your truck, manage your resources, and chart your own path across quiet rural backroads. Scavenge materials, adapt to the unknown and uncover the secrets of a world quietly ruled by an artificial intelligence.

games.name: Hyperwired
games.summary: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

games.name: Empire in Decay
games.summary:
Empire in Decay is a roguelike deckbuilding turn-based tactical game, loosely based on chess. Its gameplay has been broadened with the use of cards and the progression of units. In the game, you'll proceed through procedurally generated routes across the districts of Daandria, the capital of the Empire.
In your journey to the Throne Hall to face the King, you will have to fight turn-based combats through different locations, collect cards and upgrade them, recruit units to support your cause and enhance them, find relics and forge artifacts to boost your powers, and use all your cunning and skill to make your way through waves of enemies.

games.name: Broken Race
games.summary: Broken Race is a roguelike racing game set in an eternal night where your exhaustion distorts reality. Run, upgrade your car, and clear levels as fast as possible while facing enemies born from your own madness.

games.name: Crimanimals
games.summary: Become an animal thief, solo or with friends, and take on the ultimate heist: stealing the legendary Golden Can of Tuna. Dangerous puzzles, absurd traps, and crazy physics await in this roguelike escape room. Will you survive the chaos and pull off the heist?

games.name: Spyyn
games.summary:
Try to stay on the vinyl and shoot at the center!

Destroy each Boss to add their song to your collection!

games.name: Two Strikes: Baki Hanma
games.summary: Baki Hanma enters the world of Two Strikes. The world's strongest teenager brings unmatched technique, lightning-fast reflexes, and an unbreakable fighting spirit. Crush opponents with raw power and relentless precision!

events.name: No More Robots 8th Anniversary Showcase
events.description: We're celebrating 8 years here at No More Robots, so of course we had to party hard this year! Welcome to the No More Robots 8th Anniversary showcase, where we'll be revealing brand new games, updates on your favourites & more!

games.name: Cruise Control
games.summary: It's time to set sail! Manage a cruise liner fleet, build entertainment and relaxation facilities, and tend to your guests needs at every turn. Work fast to solve problems, earn rewards, and ensure smooth sailing! Are you ready to turn on Cruise Control?

games.name: Thank You For Your Application
games.summary: Thank You for Your Application is an interview game. You play as a recent graduate who joins the Aeropolis Group as a recruitment officer.

games.name: Descenders
games.summary: "Descenders is extreme downhill freeriding for the modern era, with procedurally generated worlds, and where mistakes have real consequences. Will you lead your team to glory and become the next legendary Descender?"

games.name: Descenders Next
games.summary: Grab your board and master the mountain! Descenders Next is the ultimate extreme sports game, with sprawling snowy peaks, winding dirt tracks, and tons of parks to conquer. Will you and your friends become the Next Ultimate Descenders?

games.name: Little Rocket Lab
games.summary: Transform your childhood home as you build brilliant factories and forge lifelong friendships, then reach for the skies and finally finish your family's dream - your mother's precious rocket ship. Roll up your sleeves, it turns out that saving this town really IS rocket science!

events.name: ZNT Horizon 2025
events.description: ZNT Horizon brings together the best and most wholesome games made by the ZNT Indie Talents devs and special guests from Brazil and around the world.

games.name: Coralina
games.summary: An investigation through space and time in a retro RPG that blends different art styles.

games.name: Coralina: Illacrimo
games.summary: Lost in nostalgia, surrounded by ghosts, Coralina goes through the Elysian Fields to find a long lost alchemy artifact, all before the world ends. The girl that can enter memories travels through these Posthumous Lands once again, in her own Psychedelic Odissey.

games.name: Sophie: Starlight Whispers
games.summary: Sophie: Starlight Whispers is an adventure game with metroidvania elements, featuring pixelated graphics, a deep narrative, and fully dubbed in Portuguese. Explore a vast map and put an end to the dark creatures that terrorize the kingdom of Sharan.

games.name: Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
games.summary:
Lost Sanity: Cthulhu is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.

A group of teenagers get together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity."
Starting with the tale of "Cthulhu," a cosmic entity that lies dormant in their city submerged in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You play as Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a prison-like place. Your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!

games.name: Tuned Turtle
games.summary: Tuned Turtle is a wacky 2D platformer inspired by the Tortoise x Hare fable. Tune up your shell with mighty power-ups and cross the finish line before "Loko Rabbit". You are the only hope to save a village in ruins from the hands of the greedy "Dirty Duke".

games.name: Dear Poe
games.summary:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

games.name: MechaBlade Hero
games.summary: MechaBlade Hero is an indie action adventure game where you control a robot fighting your way through an army of robots to get out of a giant tower. Face enemies and gain new weapons, solve puzzles and platform challenges in this challenging hack and slash.

games.name: Joe Adventure
games.summary: Keep moving or explode! Control multiple Joes to solve puzzles in order to save your siblings and Joe Mama from the grasps of the food factory!

games.name: GluMe
games.summary: “GluMe” is a cute Sokoban-style puzzle game. Team up with your slime friends to collect all the spectacular gems.

games.name: Bellochia: Love Powered by Gears
games.summary: Find your first love in the kingdom of Bellochia, use your skills to talk with our 4 main protagonists, invite them to dates and live a school life in a day-by-day gameplay.

games.name: Robot-LE
games.summary: A point-and-click adventure game based on a story where humanity is about to die soon, because of the sun exploding and taking everything with it. Humanities attempt to save their species, working with the most talented scientists in the world to build a sophisticated AI robot to enter space, find habitual planets, and then return with data to prove the existence of another exoplanet. So, they come up with Robot-LE.

games.name: Alien Strike: Blasting the Intruders
games.summary: The earth has been invaded by aliens, and even though they are still in training, a group of soldiers are trying to save their city while trying to understand why it happened so quickly.

games.name: B.O.D.E.
games.summary: From the creators of Devil's Drizzle, B.O.D.E. is a pixel art metroidvania lite shooter with a satanic theme (and a healthy dose of blasphemy). Use your shotgun to move around and annihilate everything in your path. Destroy hell in search of revenge!

games.name: The Never Ending Flower Shop
games.summary: The Never Ending Flower Shop is a game focused on exploration, you will fight your way through the lost Floricultura Consuelo, a place that once thrived in the ownership of your mother, now forgotten, exactly as she left it.

games.name: Lembre-se em Cedida
games.summary: Emerge in the lives of three different inhabitants of a small town as they are caught between self discovery, destruction and rebirth of themselves and where they step on.

games.name: Mailbound
games.summary: The dead linger in the CRT glow, their wails rippling through the screen like disembodied echoes. And now… you’re drifting with them...

games.name: Dig Out
games.summary: With a dark and minimalist aesthetic, the title blends action and elements of "puzzle combat," pitting the protagonist, an abstract representation of human emotion, against enemies that personify their own inner "demons."

games.name: Capote
games.summary:
Capote is an online card game for 2 to 6 players that mixes classic trick-taking rules with bold bets and chaotic special cards. Each match is set around a casual card table full of colorful characters—and in Capote, no win is guaranteed, and any card can flip the game.

Players bet how many tricks they think they’ll win, then play their cards round by round to hit that number exactly. If you win more or fewer tricks than you bet, you’ll take a virtual shot for each one off. Hit four shots and… you’re out. Capotado!

If the cards aren’t in your favor, don’t worry—messing with your friends is also a valid strategy. Play your special cards at the right time to twist the odds, sabotage their bets, or turn a sure win into chaos.

games.name: Talentos Indie ZNT
games.summary: A bundle featuring all games of Talentos Indie ZNT, from ZNT Productions.

games.name: Miller's Fantasy: Party - Deluxe Update
games.summary: An upcoming major update to Miller's Fantasy: Party, which revamps the gameplay, visuals and a new storyline.

games.name: Lost Patient
games.summary: The game is a surreal horror RPG, containing puzzles and enemy battles, it features a mix between pixel art and 3D low poly art!

games.name: Muse
games.summary: A narrative-driven visual novel where you help Clara, a struggling artist, overcome her creative block through painting mini-games and emotional choices in a surreal dream world.

games.name: Protocol: Umbra
games.summary: Protocol: Umbra is an unsettling, observation-driven psychological horror game inspired by I’m on Observation Duty and FNaF, built in Python with Pygame-CE and powered by my own UI framework, Tessella.

games.name: Toada Brava
games.summary: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

games.name: Le Fol
games.summary: Le Fol is a point-and-click narrative game with multiple endings, puzzles, and poetry, featuring neo-impressionist 2D isometric art. Inspired by The Fool’s Journey from the Tarot de Marseille and the city of São Paulo, it follows an unconventional protagonist, exploring the fragility of human connections across eight branching storylines.

games.name: Small Claims
games.summary: Step into the shoes of an employee at North River, one of today's largest artificial intelligence startups, in this narrative choice-based game. But be careful: your choices can have small consequences.

events.name: Kirby Air Riders Direct #2
events.description: Join us on Oct. 23 at 6 a.m. PT for a second Kirby Air Riders Direct with director Mr. Sakurai. The livestreamed presentation will last roughly 60 minutes and feature more info on the upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 game.

games.name: Kirby Air Riders
games.summary:
Kirby Air Riders is the long-awaited sequel to Kirby Air Ride on the Gamecube.

Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

events.name: The Indie Horror Showcase 2025
events.description: The Indie Horror Showcase, presented by DreadXP and The MIX, and co-hosted by John Wolfe and BigGaming64, premieres on October 23rd at 10:00 a.m. PDT / 1:00 p.m. EST.

games.name: The Cave Diver
games.summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

games.name: Demon Spore
games.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

games.name: Butler Guillotine
games.summary: Flesh filled puppets in a mishapen hotel. No windows, no exterior. Follow different characters' intertiwining paths and unearth forgotten events from a time long gone. Bring the ceremony to a halt.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Grindworm
games.summary: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine.

games.name: White Knuckle
games.summary: White Knuckle is a first person speed climbing game. Ascend through the guts of SUB-STRUCTURE 17 using precision movement mechanics. Sharp reflexes and resource management will take you to the highest peaks under ten thousand meters of concrete and decay.

games.name: Total Chaos
games.summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

games.name: Death In Abyss
games.summary: Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep sea hostilities.

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: God Help Us All
games.summary: God Help Us All is a fixed-camera survival horror game that merges the suffocating dread of classic horror with the brutal grit of the Wild West.

games.name: Indoors: The Alston Manor
games.summary: All kind of unsolved horrors from all around the world are just a door away. INDOORS is a single-player horror anthology game developed by Snova where your puzzle solving abilities will take you through 7 paranormal escape rooms.

games.name: Fear the Spotlight
games.summary: Fear the Spotlight is an atmospheric third-person horror adventure with a disturbing mystery to unravel. Sneak into school after hours with Vivian and Amy, survive a séance gone wrong, solve tactile puzzles, and, whatever you do, stay out of the spotlight…

games.name: System Shock
games.summary: After 22 years, cyberpunk cult classic System Shock is getting an update. A "reimagined" version of the 1994 Windows PC game is in the works at Night Dive Studios for PC and Xbox One, and it's a project that company founder Stephen Kick says he can hardly believe is really happening.

games.name: The Secret of Weepstone
