games.summary: STRETCH THE WORLD, SAVE THE GALAXY! In this smartly funny First Person Puzzler, you are THE STRETCHMANCER. Squash and stretch your environment to solve fiendish puzzles and defeat the Claustro Empire... in an epic voice-acted adventure inspired by 90s Saturday Morning Cartoons!

events.name: Chao Direct 2025
events.description: Join us for over 16 minutes of fan game trailers and announcements at the Chao Games Showcase!

games.name: Sonic ERaZor
games.summary: Sonic ERaZor is a hack of Sonic the Hedgehog created by Selbi. This hack is unlike many other hacks, featuring a heavy in-game story line, unique challenges, and never seen before gameplay mechanics. These elements are often somehow related to explosions, which is why this hack is sometimes called, "What if Michael Bay directed Sonic 1?"

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Past, Present, & Future
games.summary: Sonic the Hedgehog RPG: Past, Present & Future is the fifth episode of the Sonic the Hedgehog RPG (e.g. SatAM RPG) series.

games.name: Project Forestation
games.summary: "Project Forestation" is a 3D Sonic Fan Game developed in Unreal Engine with an emphasis on Adventure's style gameplay. The game is being created with the aim of gamifying the 3rd season of anime "Sonic X".

games.name: Beyond Golden Coins: Wario's Conquest + SML2 Reclaimed
games.summary:
Super Mario Land 2 is back!
Relive the golden days in this remake of a classic- spiced up with lots of new features!

games.name: Sonic the Hedgehog 2: Gear Shift
games.summary: Save Tails from the clutches of Dr. Robotnik in this complete re-imagining of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 for the Master System and Game Gear!

games.name: Super Mario Buys Bread
games.summary: Mario wants to buy bread, but there isn't any! And now he's on a rampage against the bread thieves!!!

games.name: Mega Man: Starburst
games.summary: A new adventure starring Mega Man!

games.name: Freedom Planet Plus
games.summary: Freedom Planet Plus is a mod that restores cut features and DLC content, notably the ability to play as Torque and Spade.

games.name: StarFox: Game&Watch
games.summary: StarFox: Game&Watch aims to preserve and update the original LCD title released by Nelsonic Software and Nintendo from 1993! This version not only comes with the benefit of being able to be played on modern hardware but is also packed with many quality of life improvements; from achievements to a new balanced mode, you’re sure to sink many hours in this polished gem from the past!

games.name: Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems
games.summary: We all know Sonic got reinvented for the Dreamcast era. Have you ever wondered what Alex Kidd might have been like if it had been reinvented for the Sonic era? Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems explores this "what if" with a Genesis-styled Alex Kidd fangame with all the speed and action of Sonic. Alex Kidd and the Miracle Gems is a loose sequel to Alex Kidd in Miracle World and Alex Kidd: The Lost Stars, with other nods to the Alex Kidd series and classic SEGA throughout.

events.name: Playdate Update #8: 11/06/25
events.description: Take a break from putting away Halloween decorations and raking leaves, because we have some exciting news from the team and game developers about what's new and next in Playdate Land!

games.name: Ratcheteer DX
games.summary: Explore the interconnected caverns below the frozen surface and a vast Snowcean above as you set out to rescue friend, foe, and stranger alike in this lo-fi action-adventure!

games.name: Fauna
games.summary:
Guide the hacker duo Jun and Polly through the world of Fauna as they unravel hidden conspiracies and fight for what’s right.

In the near future, LLM technology has advanced to the point where humans can use it to communicate with animals. Rival factions fight for control of this powerful technology, and animals—now that they have a voice—seek equal rights.

This branching, choose-your-own-adventure comic takes about 15–20 minutes to complete. With dozens of unique story paths, each playthrough reveals new choices, secrets, and perspectives—inviting you to return again and again to experience the full world of Fauna.

games.name: Diora
games.summary:
After a strange accident, you’ll travel across the world to uncover a mysterious force that is manipulating structures and the people around them.

As you explore, you’ll find new ways to solve puzzles, and free each island from the signals controlling it.

games.name: Under the Tree 2: Hedgerows
games.summary: The sequel to Under The Tree! A first-person grid-based dungeon crawler inspired by the original Wizardry first released on the Apple ][, simplified to suit the screen and controls of the Playdate. Featuring an all-new 3D graphics engine, with dungeon and outdoor areas, quests, puzzles and more!

games.name: Trackminia
games.summary: Are you a master of the drifting arts? If not...would you like to be? Trackminia is a precision-racer inspired by a legendary series of French games.

games.name: Oquonie
games.summary: A textless adventure/puzzle game in which the player, a disgruntled rabbit, must exit a superstructure that houses other disgruntled animals in an effort to discover how, what, and why you are.

games.name: Mission LunaTrix
games.summary: Skateboarding tricks on the moon.

games.name: PizzaMaker
games.summary: Cats are customers too, and they want pizza. But for them, ordinary pizza is an insult for nine lifetimes. Make the perfect pizza by combining fish, ham, and delicacies for four-legged gourmets.

games.name: Fissh
games.summary: Set sail on a grand adventure to acquire your fortune on the high seas. Will you earn enough croins to retire or sink your crab-catching boat and be back where you started?

games.name: Crank Up
games.summary: An infinite stacking game for the playdate.

games.name: Cascada
games.summary: Cascade marbles and watch them plink and plonk down serene waterfall scenes in this relaxing Pachinko game for Playdate.

games.name: Inspector Waffles: Early Days
games.summary: A top-down detective adventure with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by classic Game Boy games. Follow Waffles in his first days as an inspector who wants to prove to everyone that he is more than just a rookie. But beware… Your future worst enemy is hiding in the shadows.

games.name: Little House
games.summary: Waking up from an unknown dream you enter your house, only to find that everything is not as it should be. Now you must explore, solve surreal and challenging puzzles and encounter strange beings as you search for your house... inside your house!

games.name: Devils on the Moon Pinball
games.summary: Themed on the astrologically Occult, Devils on the Moon is a Single board VG-Pinball Heavily inspired by all the great Pinball games of the past and some modern ones as well.

games.name: A Fool's Errand
games.summary: Crank to ascend the infinitely-spiralling tower, dodging its many devious traps and creepy denizens.

games.name: Outside Parties
games.summary: Outside Parties is a “hidden picture”/“hidden object”-style horror scavenger hunt, coming to Playdate.

events.name: State of Play Japan: November 11, 2025
events.description:
This Tuesday, we’re bringing you a special episode of State of Play running for more than 40 minutes, focusing on games created in Japan and across Asia, alongside a few other exciting updates.

From beloved series to distinctive indie creations, the show, hosted by voice actor Yuki Kaji, will be packed with great games, interviews, and new looks at anticipated titles.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
games.summary: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: BrokenLore: Ascend
games.summary: BrokenLore: Ascend is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors: Origins - Visions of Four Heroes
games.summary: This DLC adds new stories featuring the Four Heroes, new allies, weapons, and more. The immersive battlefields and exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action return!

games.name: Gran Turismo 7: Power Pack
games.summary:
What’s Included in the Gran Turismo 7 Power Pack DLC:
- 50 new races across 20 themed categories, inspired by global automotive and motorsport traditions.
- 24-hour endurance racing for players who crave the ultimate test of skill and stamina.
- Full race weekends: Practice, qualify, and compete in the main event for a true racing simulation.
- Gran Turismo Sophy 3.0 AI for intense, tail-to-nose battles that push your limits.
Includes 5,000,000 in-game Credits

games.name: No Sleep for Kaname Date: From AI - The Somnium Files
games.summary:
Kaname Date and the AI-Ball, Aiba tackle a mysterious case and rescue Iris, an internet idol who has been forced to take part in a dangerous escape game.
Examine crime scenes and listen to testimonies in "Investigation". Enter the dream worlds of suspects and key witnesses in "Somnium". Solve puzzles to break out of locked rooms in the new "Escape" sections.
By moving between these three sections, obtain the necessary clues to solve the case.

games.name: Pac-Man World 2 Re-Pac x Sonic the Hedgehog
games.summary:
Grants the Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set for PAC-MAN WORLD 2 Re-PAC!

Sonic the Hedgehog Collaboration Set includes:
- 3 Collab Stages
- 1 Collab Costume
- 20 Collab Figures
• Collaboration Set Bonus: Legendary PAC-LAND Costume

games.name: Digimon Story: Time Stranger - Episode Pack 1: Alternate Dimension
games.summary: In this Digimon Story Time Stranger DLC, five new digivolution paths for Mega Digimon are unlocked, granting players a special story woven from encounters that transcend time and space separately from the main storyline.

games.name: Never Grave: The Witch and the Curse
games.summary: A Metroidvania x Roguelite, where you advance using a cursed hat. Use a variety of magic or possess your enemies to reach the lowest levels! Bring back loot, build new facilities in your village, make a living and strengthen yourself for the next battle! Supports up to 4-player multiplayer.

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Octopath Traveler 0
games.summary:
All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!

Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Elden Ring Nightreign - The Forsaken Hollows
games.summary:
The DLC will feature two new nightfaring warriors as playable characters:

- Scholar: An academic who walks the Lands Between. Boasting impressive arcane levels, he gains incredible advantages through battlefield observation.

- Undertaker: An abbess who was mandated to slay the Nightlord. Boasting impressive strength and faith, she sends enemies to the afterlife with ruthless efficiency.

It also features the new Limveld enemy type, and a new area: Shifting Earth: The Great Hollow, a great cavity in the depths of Limveld. The hollow is strewn with exotic ruins and temples; sacred towers denoting the remains of an ancient people; and crystals that exude a cursed, life-draining miasma.

games.name: BrokenLore: Unfollow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.

games.name: Fatal Frame II: Crimson Butterfly Remake
games.summary: The full remake of FATAL FRAME / PROJECT ZERO II: Crimson Butterfly. This Japanese-style horror adventure game follows twin sisters lost in an abandoned village haunted by evil spirits. Using the Camera Obscura, they fight ghosts as the story unfolds.

games.name: Motionrec
games.summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

games.name: Wandering Sword
games.summary:
The hit pixel-art RPG set in the world of Chinese martial arts is finally coming to PlayStation!
Play as a young swordsman gravely injured after being caught in a violent conflict.
Having narrowly escaped death, you set out on a journey to master the martial arts and fulfill your destiny as a true hero in a vast wuxia world.
Includes Original DLC
All DLC released on other platforms is included:
“Immortal Trails Across the Blue Sea”
“Mount Pack: The Supreme Steed”

games.name: Tokyo Xtreme Racer
games.summary:
Countless souls wander the ring road at night.
The title of “fastest” never fades, no matter how times change.

The stage of battle is a sealed future Tokyo.
Race through the night highways weaving through the city in your customized machine.
Defeat the countless rivals and aim to become the fastest on the Shuto Expressway.

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Dance Dance Remixes
games.summary:
Includes:
- 5 dazzling remixes featuring songs from the collaborative EP "Denonbu Katamarespect" by DENONBU
- 10 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari: Katamari Damacy Series Neo Remixes
games.summary:
- 5 additional BGM tracks celebrating the legacy of Katamari with remixes from previous Katamari titles
- 10 costume pieces from previous Katamari series titles

Track List:
Baby Universe - Hiroshi Okubo Remix
Guru Guru Gravity - Sho Okada Remix
Alien - Kanaya Oki Remix
Walking on a Star! - Junichi Nakatsuru Remix
Family Damacy - Yoshihito Yano Remix

games.name: Super Robot Wars Y: DLC 1 - Contract from the Darkness
games.summary:
Super Robot Wars Y features a number of units and pilots from a variety of robot anime, and the first DLC introduces three exciting crossover titles:

- Galaxy Cyclone Braiger
- The Big O
- Fuuto PI: The Portrait of Kamen Rider Skull

Players will gain access to new area missions and additional playable units inspired by these series, expanding the strategic depth and fan-favorite roster of the game.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds: Title Update 4
games.summary: Title Update 4 (TU4) for Monster Hunter Wilds releasing December 16, 2025 which includes Gogmazios, expanded endgame content, and more.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - SpongeBob SquarePants Pack
games.summary:
The Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - SpongeBob SquarePants Pack includes:

• SpongeBob SquarePants and Patrick Star playable characters
• Patty Wagon vehicle
• Bikini Bottom track
• New original music
• 6 Emotes per character
• Additional sounds

games.name: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X
games.summary: In BlazBlue Entropy Effect X, you’ll face off against surging hordes across ever-shifting dimensions in an action-focused roguelike platform adventure. The Sea of Possibility is envisioned as a descent through multiple levels, each filled with threats you’ll need to suppress while harvesting Shards of Possibility. Along the way, you’ll uncover a completely new, original story that expands the BlazBlue Entropy Effect X universe in unexpected ways. Read the swarm, weave through danger, and strike back with combos and strings that never let up.

games.name: Disgaea Mayhem
games.summary:
Disgaea Mayhem is a brand-new 3D action RPG from an all-star team consisting of director Shunsuke Minowa, character designer Takehito Harada, and composer Tenpei Sato.

In this game, players will be able to experience the exhilaration of defeating enemies with overwhelming power that defies convention—unleashing flashy techniques with simple controls, completionist elements like leveling characters up to 9,999 and “reincarnating” them to grow even stronger, and developing overpowered stats that let them deal over a billion damage.

games.name: Fate Trigger
games.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by Unreal Engine 5. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, craft your own strategies, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

events.name: VR Games Showcase: November 13th, 2025
events.description:
The VR Games Showcase is back for one last show of 2025!

Join us on November 13 at 9am PT for, 5+ new game announcements, 20+ trailers and fresh looks, Meta Quest, PC VR, PlayStation VR2 + beyond with roughly 30 minutes of curated announcements.

games.name: Star Trek: Infection
games.summary:
A VR full-body narrative survival experience set in the Star Trek universe.

You’re a Vulcan Starfleet officer, sent on a special mission aboard the U.S.S. Lumen, but something has gone horribly wrong.

There’s no crew in sight, and an unknown entity has infested the ship. Now it’s inside your body, physically mutating you, unlocking dangerous new abilities at the cost of your sanity.

games.name: Arken Age
games.summary: Arken Age is a VR action-adventure game set in the Bio-Chasm—a terraformed fantasy world created by the Grand Arborist. Engage in full physics combat using Arkenite infused swords & guns—and freely explore the densely filled environments under siege by Hyperion's neural corruption.

games.name: Forefront
games.summary: Forefront is an intense VR shooter featuring 32-player large-scale battles, land, sea, and air vehicles, and immersive, tactical combat. You are the tip of the spear in the war between a global energy giant and resistance forces. Which side will you take?

games.name: Escaping Wonderland
games.summary:
Escaping Wonderland is a new chapter in the Down the Rabbit Hole saga, and an all new story from the same developers who brought you the original, Cortopia Studios

Puzzle your way through perplexing challenges and lose yourself in an enchanting landscape where up is down, left is right, and nothing is quite as it seems (except when it is, and even then, it might not be).

Prepare for hours of gameplay, brimming with brain-teasers, enchantment, and just the right dash of delightful nonsense. Will Molly navigate her way out, or will she unearth the curious truth that sometimes the best way out is further in? Step into this whimsical whirlwind and discover what Molly is really escaping from and help her recover her memory—if you dare!

games.name: Moss
games.summary: In Moss, players can reach out, touch, and interact with the environment while guiding Quill through her journey. As a character within the world, players will work together with Quill to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and conquer any danger that comes their way,” said Danny Bulla, co-founder and design director of Polyarc. “As gamers, we’ve been conditioned for years to hold a gamepad in our laps when playing games, letting our thumbs and fingers do the controlling. It has been a great experience to create an immersive game that encourages players to reach into and interact with a tactile world.

games.name: Moss: Book II
games.summary: Quill is back! And she's journeying deep into the hexed castle of the Arcane in Moss: Book II, the highly anticipated follow-up to the smash hit VR game Moss. Having rescued her uncle Argus, Quill’s adventure continues with the revelation that a winged tyrant is hunting her within the hexed castle where her uncle was held captive. Moss: Book II is lined with dangerous terrain, challenging puzzles, and enemies twisted in fire and steel.

games.name: Trombone Champ: Unflattened!
games.summary: Trombone Champ: Unflattened will take the charming and quirky gameplay of the original Trombone Champ and bring it to life in a fully immersive virtual reality environment. In this reimagined version, players will honk, blow, and toot their way through over 50 unique songs, all within a vibrant and dynamic 3D space.

games.name: Surviving Mars: Pioneer
games.summary: The Red Planet is vast, desolate, and utterly indifferent to your survival. Surviving Mars: Pioneer is the first made-for-VR entry in the Surviving Mars universe, challenging you to carve out an existence in one of the most hostile environments imaginable.

games.name: Gorn 2
games.summary: GORN 2 is a ludicrous sequel to the hit VR gladiator simulator from Free Lives. It's bigger, wilder, and stronger than ever before, with mighty new weapons to wield, treacherous new traps to avoid, and new power-ups to imbue you with supernatural strength. Enjoy GORN 2's improved VR combat as you battle the five sons of the God of the Afterlife across an array of heavenly realms, with in-your-face combat so irresponsibly violent you'll check your headset for blood spatters when you're done.

games.name: Down the Rabbit Hole
games.summary:
Down the Rabbit Hole is a VR adventure that takes place in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. You will discover a girl in search of her lost pet, Patches, that has wandered into Wonderland. Guide her as she moves through the mysterious world. But which way should she go?

You control the girl’s fate by plotting her journey through an immersive diorama that wraps around you. Through the game’s many twists and turns, you will find yourself exploring the most wondrous corners of Wonderland, solving puzzles, uncovering secrets and making choices about the story along the way.

games.name: Postal 2 VR
games.summary: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

games.name: By Grit Alone
games.summary:
Stranded. Tormented. Alone.
By Grit Alone is an action horror shooter combining frantic combat, bosses and challenges with a harrowing sci-fi anthology story.

You’re marooned in a bizarre unknown dimension of space, filled with ancient derelicts and ravenous aliens. Uncover the mysteries of the dead as you move ship to ship, slaughtering your way through hordes of brain starved horrors.

Fight. Discover. Survive.
Experience twisted stories from our incredible writers, with credits including Dead Space, Resident Evil and Dr Who. There's no loading screens, no inventory and unlimited ammo; you’ll need skill and focus to rip through the ferocious swarms and get out of this corrupted hellhole in one piece.

By Grit Alone, you will survive.

games.name: V-Racer Hoverbike
games.summary: V-RACER HOVERBIKE is a fast-paced futuristic racing game in VR.

games.name: Out of Sight VR
games.summary: Out of Sight VR pulls you into a chilling nightmare where you see through the eyes of a child’s only comfort—her teddy bear. Guide Sophie through a sinister mansion and evade the lurking horrors that stalk her every move. The shadows are watching. And Sophie is depending on you.

games.name: Gunman Contracts: Stand Alone
games.summary: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an action-movie inspired shooter playable both in VR and in Non-VR (First Person). As a professional hitman, the player takes on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld, bringing justice and order in the world beyond the reach of law - one contract at a time.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City
games.summary: A brotherhood in the shadows. A city on the brink. In the vacuum left by Shredder's demise, the Foot Clan's grip tightens on the streets you once called home. In the first-ever TMNT first-person action adventure VR game - forge your own chapter, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Coming 2026

games.name: The Lightkeepers
games.summary: Grab your weapons and face an unequal battle against the nightmares of the deep! The Lightkeepers is a cooperative action game where you’ll fight for your life until every dawn!

games.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim VR
games.summary: Use native PCVR support to experience a hightened sense of spatial freedom and immersion in Lushfoil's 10 detailed environments.

games.name: Glassbreakers: Champions of Moss
games.summary: Lead your squad of Champions into an immersive arena in this exciting game of tactics, magic, and power! This 1v1 real-time battler puts you face to face with your opponent and their squad for action-packed gameplay that will keep you coming back for more.

games.name: Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok
games.summary:
The first book in the Shadowgate Saga, Shadowgate VR: The Mines of Mythrok brings the hit adventure series to virtual reality! Step into the fantasy world of Kal Torlin like never before and immerse yourself in this exciting action/adventure game made exclusively for the Oculus Quest!

With Odin the raven as your guide, and three difficulty levels to fit your play style, it's time to discover what secrets await within the Mines of Mythrok!

games.name: Audio Trip
games.summary: Dance to your favorite music (and workout in “Cardio”) as you catch gems, ride ribbons, smash drums, & dodge barriers. With tracks by Zedd, Lady Gaga, Skrillex, deadmau5, Tiësto, express yourself & get creative with the in-VR editor--with support for your own songs!

games.name: Rager
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the adrenaline-fueled excitement of this melee combat rhythm game! Master weapon of your choice – sword, mace, claws, hammer, axe, your own fists and many more! Stunning visuals and spatial audio technology puts you right in heart of the action.

games.name: Roboquest VR
games.summary: A VR port of Roboquest being developed by Flat2VR Studios for Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2 and SteamVR.

games.name: Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR - Brutal Edition
games.summary: Hunt the corrupted Guardians and purge a dying world in Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR, a brutal old-school FPS built in the legendary Quake engine and reimagined for virtual reality. With dual-wielding combat, physical reloading, and deadly artifacts at your command, the darkness doesn’t stand a chance.

games.name: Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

games.name: Project Freefall
games.summary: Grab your squad and dive into a frantic chase for the lone parachute as you play the ultimate game of tag at 10,000 feet! Toss a grenade, spray a fire extinguisher, or dodge the shark as you skydive with your friends and try to survive the fall. Will you go on to victory or go splat? Free to play.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.summary: Stranded in the 17th century after a brutal shipwreck, you awaken alone on a deadly tropical island. To survive, you’ll need to learn fast - facing wild beasts, nature’s wrath, and uncovering secrets hidden deep in the jungle. Every step is a fight for your life.

games.name: Deadly Delivery
games.summary: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 3 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans.

games.name: Penguin Festival
games.summary: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

games.name: Orcs Must Die! By the Blade
games.summary:
The orcs are back—louder, dumber, and smellier than ever. And this time… they’re in your face. Literally!

Orcs Must Die: By The Blade brings the legendary trap-slaughter franchise into fully immersive VR. Become a War Mage and defend Stormwreck Island in an all-new story as rotten rifts unleash corrupted orcs. Swing swords, trigger trinkets, punch orcs in the snout, and set ingenious trap chains that rocket screaming orcs across the room, pop off limbs, and spray gooey carnage everywhere.

Explore epic fortresses, channel powerful magic, and experience the most up-close (and up-nose) orc-smashing action ever. Fight solo or team up in 2-player co-op to build traps, heal rifts, and doom the greenskin hordes with style.

Mix brutal melee with comedic chaos. Build deadly defenses. Become a legend.

Stormwreck Island won’t save itself… and the orcs aren’t going to punch themselves… Well, some might—but you should help!

games.name: Knights of Fiona
games.summary: Fierce dragons have emerged in the land of Gallia. Join Fiona and her sworn knights to protect the kingdom! Embark on quests solo or with friends as you fight against the darkness.

games.name: Banners & Bastions
games.summary: Banners & Bastions is a 3D tabletop real-time strategy game in mixed reality. Command your troops and fortify your kingdom to defeat the enemy in dynamic and epic battles!

games.name: VR Giants
games.summary: VR Giants is a local multiplayer coop VR game that makes use of one player’s body to extend the level for the other player to explore. One player is huge (Goliath) and his avatar is controlled with a VR set. David is the tiny character which is controlled with a gamepad. Goliath must use his body as a bridge for David to cross abysses or reach higher platforms. David is tiny and is highly vulnerable to fire, spikes, and other dangers. Goliath must protect David so that he can collect coins and keys that lead both players to freedom.

games.name: Kartoffl
games.summary: Kartoffl is a ridiculously cute but challenging VR puzzle game with Lemmings-like vibes.

games.name: Fixer Undercover
games.summary: Welcome to DIY Espionage - a VR puzzle adventure where everyday tools and found objects become your problem-solving kit. Go undercover as a repair worker inside a prison, investigate a mysterious rehabilitation program through various challenges, and make your escape with the truth.

games.name: Full Steam Undead
games.summary: VR STEAM TRAIN + ZOMBIE ACTION. Zombies infest Necropolis island and Queen Victoria is not best pleased. Grab your shotgun, ride the rune train and slay the undead. It's time to roll: all aboard for undead destruction!

events.name: arcINDIE CURRENT 2025
events.description: Join us for over 15 minutes of exciting independent game trailers and announcements for the arcINDIE expo !

games.name: Apricity
games.summary: Fight, farm and bake your way through ancient canals and the crumbling castles of APRICITY. Gather strength by fishing waterways, harvesting ingredients and slaying ancient beasts. Rekindle the lost light and push back the hungering darkness.

games.name: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
games.summary:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

games.name: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend
games.summary: Cubenen Gardens: Befriend is a story-driven indie RPG where you play as Michael, a nerdy kangaroo inventor from the Tech District. They have a lifelong goal of making monsters less of a threat to society. And their research takes them to the abandoned offices of the Mall District to test a theory regarding how monsters relate to the memories of the deceased. Things go well, but then they get caught up in a corporate nightmare. Slowly breaking them down and leaving them desperately searching for a way to escape.

games.name: Riley The Roadrunner
games.summary: A speed demon who loves nothing more than to race. One morning, he and his partner in crime, Ollie the Armadillo, have a rude awakening when an Unidentified Flying Object plows through their tree. Next thing they know, weird alien tech is spreading all over their canyon home. Will Riley be fast enough to stop this other worldly menace?

games.name: Lorenzo PC Adventure DX Director's Cut Ultimate New Funky Mode Edition
games.summary: The Galactic Poultry Army has taken over a small town of Emerel and Amongst the captives are 8 orphans and a young woman named Sarah, who is the Mayor's daughter. It's up to Lorenzo and his friend Ivan to put a stop to it.

games.name: Renegade Hero: Termination of Salvation
games.summary: You are Arnold and your goal is to terminate a machine by the name of: SALVATION and rescue professor Linda.

games.name: Catto Chateau
games.summary: An exploration based platformer where you can explore a Chateau full of a variety of unique levels. Find upgrades, spells and save your new friends who have become twisted by The Dutchess's curse!

games.name: Zafe's Adventures
games.summary: Zafe's Adventures is a new and simplified 2D platformer game with a simple run and gun elements and gameplay. Inspired by abandonware platformer, Sonic the Hedgehog series and its fangame, Spark the Electric Jester, Jazz Jackrabbit and Freedom Planet and as well with other simple 2D game that was made using GameMaker or Scratch in the past. This has been considered as a small solo indie game project only. The game follows a young and heroic pyrokinetic cartoon humanoid who tries to fight back against evil entities around the hillside wilderness. While he ends up on a long journey through another different world via the mysterious dimension portal.

games.name: Dogs of the Dark
games.summary: Dogs of the Dark is a role-playing game that pulls inspiration from retro RPGs from the 90s and the quirky ones from the 2000s. It features a full 5+ chapter campaign filled with dumb jokes, strange characters, and retro pixel art graphics akin to 8-bit or 16-bit games.

games.name: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition Turbo
games.summary: Super Freaks 1: Ultimate Edition is back, and turbocharged! Build up crazy speeds with the new sprinting feature, and perform death defying time trials in turbo mode!

games.name: Strato Freaks DX
games.summary: Take flight in your Grand Gyro and shoot down every robot in your path to save the Powerful Monkey Council!

games.name: Super Freaks Side Story: Scruffy Minus - The Rise of the Anti-Freaks
games.summary: A new Classic Super Freaks game, Scruffy Minus is a new platforming adventure (with some freaky surprises!) Run, jump, and activate your different superpowered Suits, to kick butt!

games.name: Collision System Test
games.summary: In Collision System Test, words are a scarce resource, exploration is confusing, battles are annoying, and the storm around the castle of Finisterre is waiting to be tamed.

games.name: Ectorider
games.summary: Ectorider is a fast-paced 3D platformer combining Extreme Sports and Third Person Shooter. Fight a robot army with your super magnet or use them to do insane tricks with your rollerblades. Save the Ectomorphs and stop Professor Ektos evil plan.

games.name: Void Grapplers
games.summary: Void Grapplers is a super fast platforming roguelike with the crazy movement of games like Sonic Mania, Pizza Tower, and Grapple Dog, along with the funky style of Antonblast, Sonic Rush, and Garbanzo Quest. Join Jac, Giromo, and their friends as they dash, swing, and zip through several procedurally generated levels.

events.name: Xbox Partner Preview November 2025
events.description: As always, Xbox Partner Preview is all about sharing exciting game news from our talented partners across the globe. During Xbox Partner Preview, you’ll get multiple world premieres, first looks at gameplay, and updates on other great titles coming to Xbox. Every game you see will be Xbox Play Anywhere, so you can buy once and play on Xbox console, PC and supported handhelds. And many will also be coming to Xbox Game Pass Ultimate on day one.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Dave the Diver
games.summary: Dave the Diver is an action-adventure and management simulation game developed by Mintrocket. In the game, players control Dave, who spends his days diving into underwater environments to catch fish and gather resources, and his nights managing a sushi restaurant. The gameplay combines real-time underwater exploration and combat with restaurant management mechanics.

games.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
games.summary: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

games.name: Crowsworn
games.summary: Explore a dark world inhabited by men and monsters in this action packed platformer. Lay waste to the monsters that stand in your way with a wide array of stylish combat maneuvers, as you attempt to unravel the truth behind the curse of Fearanndal.

games.name: Echo Generation 2
games.summary: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

games.name: Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors
games.summary: Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turnbased deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Master the Turboturn with your own hand of cards!

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Roadside Research
games.summary: Roadside Research is a 1 to 4 player co-op gas station simulator. Except you’re aliens. And undercover. Do very human things like restocking shelves while preparing for the invasion. Just don’t get caught.

games.name: Total Chaos
games.summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

games.name: Reanimal
games.summary: The creators of Little Nightmares I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: Erosion
games.summary: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

games.name: Zoopunk
games.summary: Zoopunk is a team-based co-op PVE game that blends diesel-punk with Eastern aesthetic.

games.name: Cloverpit
games.summary:
You wake up in a rusty, narrow cell, standing over a dangerously unstable grate.

Someone has kidnapped you, demanding payment, and your only way out is to play the Slot Machine and pay off your debt.

Don’t let yourself fall —literally— into ruin!

games.name: Cloverpit: Unholy Fusion
games.summary: Unholy Fusion introduces the Surgery Machine to CloverPit! The grotesque new device lets you fuse charms together into a single, more powerful trinket. Combine effects, discover new synergies, and break the machine all over again.

games.name: Hitman World of Assassination
games.summary:
Become Agent 47 in the ultimate spy-thriller adventure across more than 20 locations.

Hitman World of Assassination brings together the best of Hitman, Hitman 2 and Hitman 3 including the main campaign, contracts mode, escalations, elusive target arcades and Hitman: Freelancer.

games.name: Tides of Annihilation
games.summary: Tides of Annihilation is a fantasy action-adventure inspired by Arthurian legend. Uncover the mystery of an otherworldly invasion in a shattered modern London, unleashing hordes of enemies. As Gwendolyn, fight alongside spectral knights to save your family and piece a broken world back together.

games.name: Raji: Kaliyuga
games.summary: Six years after the great war, destiny bleeds into prophecy as gods and mortals blur. Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasuras wrath as he tears open heavens gates, unleashing Kaliyuga-an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

events.name: Winter OTK Games Expo 2025
events.description: Discover the Next Big Indie Hit!

games.name: Night Swarm
games.summary: Rise as a young vampire, earn your name, and gather powerful allies. In this survivor-like auto-shooter, battle relentless werewolf hordes, grow your strength, build your pack, and dominate the night.

games.name: Cursemark
games.summary: Cursemark is an action-exploration roguelike where you forge unique equipment to pierce the depths of the Unknown Lands. Unlock hundreds of items and spells, then discover powerful rune synergies every run in this place beyond the edges of the world.

games.name: Palworld
games.summary: Palworld is a multiplayer open-world survival game that combines creature-collecting with crafting, base-building, and combat. Set on the Palpagos Islands, players capture and tame animal-like creatures called Pals, which can be used as mounts, combat partners, or workers at player-built bases. The game incorporates firearms and darker satirical elements into the monster-taming formula.

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Ferocious
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Anime Shop Simulator
games.summary: Manage your own anime shop. Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-op mode to grow your business. Stock shelves with manga, figures, and collectible cards in this immersive first-person game.

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: Copa City
games.summary: Organize high-stakes football events in the first football tycoon! Get the urban space and the stadium ready, ensure safety, and provide fans with an amazing football fiesta! But stay alert: Your decisions will not only influence the city but also the emotional rollercoaster for football fans!

games.name: Gravebound
games.summary: Gravebound is a post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in a world where crumbling cities and ancient magic collide. Fight, loot, and survive against deadly creatures and rival players as you explore the Shatterlands.

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

games.name: Airport Contraband
games.summary: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation game where every suitcase could be a risk. Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

games.name: Paddle Paddle Paddle
games.summary: A fun physics-based coop game where you (and a friend) have to paddle through a loooong parcour! Get ready to fall a lot and Paddle Paddle Paddle!

games.name: Rune Dice
games.summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! Hark the Ghoul offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Super Adventure
games.summary: SUPER ADVENTURE is a Shmup turned 2D-Platformer with great emphasis on bullet dodging, expressive boss fights and a wacky story.

games.name: I Won’t Let You Level up in My Goblin Town
games.summary: Interfere in a turn based fight! When adventurers come to your goblin town to level up, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle. Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any adventurer party.

games.name: Australia Did It
games.summary: Join our mercenary team: high-risk, low-benefit positions available! Defend cargo trains in this innovative Turn-Based Tower Defense meets Reverse Bullet Hell. Deploy units, merge them to create powerful new types and variations, withstand relentless waves, deliver the goods.

games.name: Anomaly President
games.summary: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

games.name: Golftacular!
games.summary: Mini-golf turned upside down! Abuse wild items on a variety of challenging golf tours. Shoot, fly, explode, and whatever else you can to get in the hole! It’s golf… barely.

games.name: Crathos Deep
games.summary: Descend down the arctic depths in Crathos Deep, a cosmic horror narrative adventure. Explore the vast abyss with your submarine and utilize your expeditionary drone to reach the dark corners of the ocean. Investigate a lost research institute to unravel the unsettling mystery of its downfall.

games.name: Rogue Point
games.summary: From the creators of Black Mesa: Welcome to Rogue Point! A 4-player co-op shooter where teamwork is everything. Join forces on intense missions with evolving objectives and powerful upgrades. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome. Your squad’s survival depends on it.

games.name: Slyders
games.summary: Fight against insane hordes of demons to prevent an evil overlord from conquering Sky World in this first-person survival roguelike shooter. With an arsenal of weapons, perks, and items, the battlefield quickly transforms into a fast-paced bullet hell.

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Pigeon's Mission
games.summary: Enjoy a whimsical pixel-art adventure crafted from a 6-year-old's art & vision. Navigate Pepper Pines as Archie, a pigeon with clever attacks & CRAZY power-ups, on a dangerous quest to save his parents. Experience a blend of nostalgia & fresh, fun gameplay in a world ruled by imagination & wonder.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Critterville Goes Bankrupt
games.summary: Inherit a royal title, preside over a cast woodland critters, and survive an industrial revolution together in Critterville goes Bankrupt, a town life RPG that combines farming, village management, home building, and high-society intrigue into an unforgettable adventure!

games.name: Nether Spirits: Beyond the Gate
games.summary: Mend your shattered soul in Nether Spirits, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder set in a dark, fantastical afterlife corrupted by sin. Choose from seven distinct classes, explore a vast world, and fight your way to salvation - alone, with friends, or in real-time PvP!

games.name: Dungeons & Dining Tables
games.summary: Dungeons and Dining Tables is a Cosy-RPG where you delve dungeons to collect rare furniture to decorate your house! The comfier your house. The better your stats!

games.name: Feign
games.summary: Feign is a role-playing game with maximum 12 players that takes place in a small town where innocents, imposters and neutrals together. You use your role at night to win and send a person from the village in the morning.

games.name: The Coin Game
games.summary: A virtual ticket redemption arcade with realistic physics, silly prizes and a bunch of goofy robots. The Coin Game is made by a solo developer. Be sure to add us to your wishlist for new announcements.

games.name: Brass Rain
games.summary: Fight iconic battles of World War II in Brass Rain. Choose your side and take part in crew-based combats as infantry, tank crews, bomber gunners, or naval teams. Support your Brothers and shape the course of history.

games.name: Vaulting Over It
games.summary: Physics based climbing game. You use a tall tree branch to climb and vault over obstacles. Inspired by Getting Over İt.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Dumpster Divers
games.summary: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Chess Arena
games.summary: 40-player real-time chess battle royale on a massive chessboard. Outplay enemies with chess tactics and game-changing ability kits. Master the chaos as the storm closes in to be the last King standing!

games.name: Escape from Ever After
games.summary: When a greedy megacorp with the power to enter storybooks takes over Flynt Buckler’s fairytale world, he must get a job to sabotage them from within! Climb the corporate ladder, fight in stylish, snappy combat, and dive into storybook worlds from Lovecraft to sci-fi in this genre-bending RPG!

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.summary: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

games.name: Besmirch
games.summary: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.

games.name: Vision Quench
games.summary: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

games.name: Talespinner
games.summary: Enter a captivating realm steeped in the exotic and bizarre tapestry of Japanese mythology with Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

games.name: Grime II
games.summary: Become the stealer of forms in GRIME II, a surreal action-adventure metroidvania. launch tendrils made of hands to absorb foes and summon molds in their shape, as you explore a bizarre lived-in-world obsessed with art.

games.name: Bandit Knight
games.summary: Step into the boots of a master thief in Bandit Knight! Outsmart enemies, steal legendary treasures, and navigate a vibrant 2.5D pixel world. Customize your tools, unlock upgrades, and rise to become the ultimate King of Thieves!

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: Hell Clock
games.summary: Forge powerful builds with endless loot in this relentless combination of Roguelike and ARPG. Blast through dungeons and unleash inhuman powers in a dark fantasy twist on Brazil’s War of Canudos.

games.name: Conquest Dark
games.summary: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.

games.name: To Kill a God
games.summary: An immersive action roguelite experience with a groundbreaking skill system that allows you to craft your own skill tree. unlock the true potential of your character, delivering an ever-evolving experience.

games.name: Crimson Desert
games.summary: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.

events.name: INDIE Live Expo 2025.11.29
events.description: In this program, we will be introducing the hottest news of more than 100 indie games!

games.name: Yunyun Syndrome!?: Rhythm Psychosis
games.summary: “Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis” is a rhythm adventure game about a psychotic hikikomori girl - also an avid anonymous poster - who corrupts the world with her severe brain rot from listening to too many denpa songs. Yunyun all over this world with your degen otaku-posting.

games.name: Core Keeper: Void & Voltage
games.summary: Awaken as an explorer in a long-forgotten cavern teeming with treasures and secrets. Harvest relics and resources, craft advanced tools, build your base, and explore over 10 unique biomes in a dynamically evolving world just waiting to be unearthed. Cultivate crops, fish in mysterious waters, master recipes, hatch pets, raise cattle, drive vehicles, fight enemies, level up your skills, automate your bases, and defeat legendary Titans to unveil the power of the Core.

games.name: Resequence: The Orchard
games.summary: Resequence: The Orchard is an occult-horror adventure game in which school counselor Saito approaches an inexplicable phenomena through his counseling sessions with students.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a multi-ending sci-fi mystery adventure game, featuring headless corpses, a sealed laboratory, a limbless android suspect/heroine, and an amnesiac protagonist. The game design and gradually UI change in reflection of your actions.

games.name: Öoo
games.summary: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

games.name: No, I'm Not A Human
games.summary: An intimate story about a disaster and guests from underground. People are breaking into your home, but not all of them are true people.

games.name: Demonic Mahjong
games.summary: Demonic Mahjong is a Roguelike deckbuilding game inspired by the timeless mechanics of Mahjong. Masterfully use the tiles in your hand to craft powerful combinations, reach staggering high scores, and develop strategies that are uniquely your own!

games.name: Promise Mascot Agency
games.summary: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

games.name: Ball x Pit
games.summary: BALL x PIT is a brick-breaking, ball-fusing, base-building survival roguelite where you battle hordes of monstrous enemies with your arsenal of ricocheting balls.

games.name: The Noexistencen of You and Me
games.summary: Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

games.name: Escape from Duckov
games.summary: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

games.name: Word Game
games.summary: Word game is literally a game of words. Player controls "I" to find clues between lines, delete words to change the meaning of sentences, or shift words to rewrite facts. “I” must be wise and brave enough complete the mission of words. May the best "I” win!

games.name: Sultan's Game
games.summary: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

games.name: As Long As You're Here
games.summary: A first-person emotional family drama seen through the eyes of a woman with Alzheimer's disease. When Annie is forced to move from her long-time home, her children try to cope with reversed caretaking roles. As they clash over how to care for her, Annie's life slowly unravels, and memories of her long-dead brother start bleeding into the present.

games.name: Slot & Dungeons
games.summary: "Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots. While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

games.name: All About Chopsticks
games.summary:
This is a game where you can naturally learn about chopsticks while challenging physics-based puzzles inspired by chopstick handling.

There is no known correlation between performing well in the game and improving actual chopstick skills.

This game is inspired by the game below:
Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy

games.name: Blind Descent
games.summary: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

games.name: Lucky Coin Pusher
games.summary: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

games.name: AutoMaker
games.summary: AutoMaker is an automotive business simulator. Start at the dawn of the automotive history, build your factory, research technologies and design cars as you progress through the ages to the current era and beyond.

games.name: Wiped Clean PC
games.summary: Wiped Clean PC is a psychological horror game where you are an undercover agent tasked with cleaning crime scenes while secretly gathering evidence to expose a ruthless hitman.

games.name: Mirage: Ignis Fatuus
games.summary: As the world turns short of Mana, Mirage, the city of illusions, is in danger of collapsing! Help Kyuboy’d make his way through mind-boggling puzzles to save his hometown!

games.name: Over the Radio
games.summary: Local co-op game about flying a plane. One player is the pilot, the other the navigator. The pilot has no map. The navigator guides the pilot using only words. Work together to reach your goal in a remixable national park map.

games.name: Slaughterhouse
games.summary: A 90s style point and click game. Blizzard. Stranded. Eight days. Enemies — kill them all.

games.name: Compress(Space)
games.summary: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.summary: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: Living Dead House
games.summary: Living Dead House delivers a pulse pounding, classic arcade experience. Battle through waves of the undead solo or team up with a friend. Use an arsenal of weapons and survival items to outlast the night. Will you escape alive and claim your top spot on the leaderboard?

games.name: Kindling Hour
games.summary: A brief, atmospheric text adventure of flickering candlelight, forgotten memories, and a quiet search through the dark.

games.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action
games.summary: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action is a top-down bump combat action game where you control Tess, a bunny girl who uses her huge hammer to send enemies flying into other enemies!

games.name: Taste of the Wind
games.summary: A simulation and RPG game with multiple endings, set in a Chinese restaurant. Play as the owner, and manage the restaurant, form bonds with characters, and explore the lively town. Uncover the secrets behind the restaurant’s mysterious downfall.

games.name: Robot Recycler Ryn
games.summary: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

games.name: DeckWrecking Pirates
games.summary: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you roll dice, command your pirate crew, and even control your enemies. Build your deck… and wreck theirs!

games.name: Hips N Noses
games.summary: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

games.name: In Silico
games.summary: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

games.name: Generic Fighter Maybe
games.summary: Generic Fighter Maybe is a traditional-style, 4-button, side-view fighting game for 2 players. Featuring all the classic fundamental fighting game mechanics, complete with big combos, multiple defensive mechanics, and meter management.

games.name: All Our Broken Parts
games.summary:
Experience a story-driven adventure/VN game as a robot doctor.

In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories.

Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

games.name: Railborn
games.summary: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Flotsam
games.summary: The premiere floating garbage town survival game! Scavenge whatever debris you can from the ocean's surface and grow your city while doing your best to survive in this colorful post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Wabisabi SushiDerby
games.summary: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!

games.name: 1999Tokoyo Building
games.summary: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... Did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.

games.name: Children's Garden
games.summary: Welcome to a puzzle game where your goal is to guide young souls to peace. Set in Sai no Kawara, a hell for children, you’ll stack the divine toy "Gift" bestowed by the gods. Discover their memories and the stories they left behind.

games.name: 4Dead
games.summary:
The only way to live is to eat!

Control the strongest invincible creature, "No. 42," who dies in 4 seconds, defeat the alien invaders, and survive!

games.name: S.E.M.I.: Side Effects May Include...
games.summary: S.E.M.I. is a cooperative online game about escaping from a special clinic. Here you and up to 3 of your feeble-minded loyal friends in the role of patients fight with the staff and other patients and find yourself in unexpected situations. Teamwork is essential, as randomized events and experimental drugs will lead your party into unpredictable mayhem. Pop pills with your friends as you cooperate to gain your freedom.

games.name: Machine Child
games.summary: Machine Child - a nurturing simulation lovingly crafted by renowned illustrator Ooyari Ashito! "Raise a daughter in a charming town! Nurture her through heartwarming moments & adventures. Her future is in your hands – will you guide her to happiness?

games.name: Treasure 'n Trio
games.summary: Team up with a brute-force warrior, a nimble and wily thief, and a cowardly wizard with teleportation magic. Use all three characters with different abilities at the right time to solve puzzles and collect treasures.

games.name: Wave Leads You...
games.summary: A simple 2D action puzzle game that conveys waves to lead you to the goal. Make full use of scaffolding blocks that can be shaken like waves to reach the goal.

games.name: Magic Boutique of Royal Blue
games.summary: Help Philosia the Spider Witch in debt to run a magical boutique! You can craft special clothing by exploring the world and collecting mysterious ingredients. Earn money by completing missions and decorate the boutique!

games.name: XOL: Space Mech Wars
games.summary: Mech FPS game in Space Fight in all directions of space, follow the story and contribute to the space wars of your homeland! Survive as an up-and-coming soldier with the toughest warriors around!

games.name: DaemonClaw: Origins of Nnar
games.summary: Defend humanity from a surprise attack by the mystical creatures of the world of Nnar in this high speed arcade/console style action game coming to modern and classic retro platforms.

games.name: Mimesis
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, 'Mimesis' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.

games.name: The Farmer Was Replaced
games.summary: Program and optimize a drone to automate a farm and watch it do the work for you. Collect resources to unlock better technology and become the most efficient farmer in the world. Improve your problem solving and coding skills.

games.name: Gnosia
games.summary:
Gnosia is a Sci-Fi Social Deduction RPG in which you will engage in discussion with a variety of unique characters, with the aim of identifying the Gnosia among the group. Players will have to use what information they can gather during the discussions to ascertain whom they think is Gnosia and then vote to put them into cold sleep. As you progress, your abilities will improve - but so will those of the crew.

As the numbers of crew members, Gnosia, and various “roles” increase, it will become increasingly difficult to determine who is telling the truth. Work in collaboration with or against other crew members to ensure your survival until the end.

games.name: Touhou Danmaku Kagura: Phantasia Lost
games.summary: A rhythm game in which players can play popular arrangements of Touhou Project songs. A rebuild of "Touhou Danmaku Kagura" as a stand-alone version with a completely new storyline.

games.name: Staffer Case: A Supernatural Mystery Adventure
games.summary:
Staffer Case is a new sort of mystery game, asking players to find clues, arrange them into documents, and point out the contradictions between them to solve a series of murders.

The game is set in a fictional version of London in the 1960s where 10% of all residents have some sort of supernatural ability. In this city, incidents involving staffers, the people who have these abilities, are constantly occurring.

Players take the role of the Mana Affairs Division's newest detective, Notrick, in order to make sense of these incidents. Since the tricks buried within these staffer cases, at their core, revolve around the supernatural abilities of these criminals, conventional investigative methods won't be enough to solve them. Instead, players will have to rely on the documents that explain what their suspects' abilities entail in order to make sense of everything.

games.name: Chill with You: Lo-Fi Story
games.summary: "Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story" is a sound novel game where you work alongside Satone, a girl who loves writing stories. Customize lo-fi music, ambient sounds, and landscapes to create a focused environment. As you deepen your bond with Satone, you may discover a special connection with her.

games.name: Meg's Monster
games.summary: Take control of the Underworld’s grumpiest ghoul to help a lost little girl find her way home in this creepy-cute indie adventure. Just be warned: if she cries, the whole world dies.

games.name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
games.summary: 'Marisa of Liartop Mountain' is an adventure-roleplaying game, where you, the player, will play as Reimu and explore a mountain of books filled with mysteries and lies in search of the whereabouts of the missing Marisa.

games.name: Super Farming Boy
games.summary: Your farm is under attack! Fly, harvest, grow crops & whack enemies with your shape-shifting one-button superpowers as you seek revenge from your evil nemesis, Korpo, who has captured your mom & friends! An action-puzzle farming sim featuring chain reactions and combos.

games.name: Hyke: Northern Light(s)
games.summary: The young witch Hyke's adventure begins! A thrilling 2D top-down action pixel RPG. Relax and camp with your companions!

games.name: Omega Crafter
games.summary: Adventure in a vast open-world survival craft game with your programmable sidekick Grammi! Program the Grammi to collect materials, build your town, craft weapons and armor to challenge strong enemies! Play alone or with friends online!

games.name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
games.summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Llamalandia
games.summary: In Llamalandia you play as a cute Llama that got lost in the mountains, prepare yourself to explore a new world that you have never seen before, while you embark on a magical journey across the Bolivian altiplano, facing many challenges in order to find your family and save the rest of your species.

games.name: Dosmic
games.summary: In a world consumed by darkness, a boy embarks on a perilous journey to rescue a lost girl. Navigate through cosmic horrors and unravel ancient mysteries in this cinematic puzzle-adventure. Experience a hauntingly beautiful tale of despair and hope.​

games.name: Dialoop
games.summary: This is a roguelike puzzle game where quick thinking determines your survival. Every run offers a fresh experience based on your choices—deck-building, puzzle-solving, and exploration all shape your journey. Master the mysterious stone tablets and uncover the secrets hidden within ancient ruins!

games.name: 14: Overmind
games.summary: 14: Overmind is an immersive first-person survival-adventure in an anomalous sci-fi space, where reality is torn apart by mysterious zones that alter the laws of physics. Waking up among ship wreckage with amnesia, you are a lone survivor with your AI companion S.A.M. Use high-tech exosuit and vehicles to gather resources, study all lost blueprints, and battle fractals from other dimensions.
