games.summary: Automate highly unstable and unreliable robots using microprograms installed along their paths. Design an automated system that is prepared to handle the challenges of a super weird environment, full of automated hazards left here long before your arrival.

games.name: MineGeon: Renegades
games.summary: Descend into Planet Paimo in MineGeon: Renegades, a chaotic multiplayer roguelite where you choose your renegade, delve into the minegeons, and battle unique enemies across diverse biomes. Fight, gather, improve, and die to uncover the secrets of Paimo and New Olympia.

games.name: Scaling Up
games.summary: Become the owner of a snake ranch! As a small dragon, raise your ranch from the ground up. Gather and manage resources, build various facilities to house your snakes, make sure they are cared for to keep them happy, and collect their beautiful scales, to forge stronger equipment and scale up!

games.name: Scourge of the Reptiles
games.summary: Scourge of the Reptiles is a party-based tactical RPG set in a prehistoric fantasy world. When a meteor strikes the Earth, humans, elves and dinosaurs alike are gifted with magical abilities—abilities that result in war, devastation and forces that stretch far beyond the hero’s quiet home village.

games.name: Barty's Adventure
games.summary: Discover the world of Barty's Adventure: a cozy, time-loop metroidvania set in the world of children's toys. Make new friends, explore unique biomes, and master the three-day cycle to stop the Colic from returning once and for all!

games.name: Solnox: Grimoire of Seasons
games.summary: Become the master of seasons in this tactical turn-based deckbuilder. Dominate the ever-changing battlefield by unleashing the four seasons and utilizing their terrain-altering effects. Learn to create perfect synergies & guide your three sorcerers to victory against unholy creatures.

games.name: Sunny Trails
games.summary: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

games.name: Synth Beasts
games.summary: Capture and harness powerful beasts to do combat and traverse the world in this monster taming action-adventure. Unravel the mystery of your existence by exploring a sinister island laboratory and putting an end to the creation of the Synth Beasts.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

games.name: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
games.summary: Grow from a tiny tadpole to cosmic menace in Toadled: Eating Frenzy, the frantic single-stick roguelike. Test your reflexes and make smart choices as you upgrade through hundreds of new mutation combos, fight bosses, and become the universe!

games.name: Wild City
games.summary: Shape your urban ecosystem in Wild City, a unique roguelike deckbuilder! Rule a harmonious society or indulge in the citizens' primal instincts, as you shape your own concrete jungle!

games.name: Wild Tactics
games.summary: The Wildest character-driven tactical strategy game you've ever seen! Build your team and maintain their relationships in the war against organized crime. Uncover the conspiracy in the animal-populated city of Clawville, and find the mastermind behind its downfall!

games.name: Firearms Factory
games.summary: In 1909, your workshop that produced sweet candies for children was hastily turned into a firearms workshop, according to an order from the government. Are you ready to make them win the war?

games.name: Paper Castle
games.summary: Paper Castle is a minimalist strategy game where you build, paint, and defend your kingdom of paper. Harness the power of water to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Paper Castle survive the next wave?

games.name: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
games.summary: A mini action city-builder in a post-post-apocalyptic world. Grow your settlement. Fend off waves of enemies. Restore nature.

games.name: Lost in the Roots
games.summary: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

games.name: Saveseeker
games.summary:
Saveseeker is a turn-based RPG adventure that follows a tenacious time-traveling girl who must save the world from her father.

Play as Emmer Edette, a cheerful and carefree child who discovers she inherited her famous father's ability to 'save' moments in time at specific points worldwide. Alongside her grumpy dragon toy sidekick, Tippleton, she embarks on a journey to overwrite all of the world’s save points (“Save Stops”) and confront her father, a once-great Hero using his power for nefarious means.

Explore six vibrant lands, recruit the Hero’s former foes, and save the world from an untimely end!

games.name: Ghost Gunners
games.summary: This party FPS is made to CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS, up to 6 people! Everyone is invisible, but you have various tools to track and reveal enemies. Play different game modes and customize your lobbies.

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: HMUR
games.summary: HMUR is a fast-paced retro-FPS, in the original setting, that merges Soviet aesthetics with whacky madness and frantic dynamics of iconic 90s shooters. Survive a disaster at a classified Soviet facility as you blast your way through crowds of enemies. Speed is your key to survival.

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: The Good Overlord
games.summary: You're the guardian of the realm's most feared dungeon, now aiding heroes. 'The Good Overlord' is a Roguelike Bag-Builder with monsters, traps, and secrets. Defeat enemies, collect relics, and uncover the reason behind the Overlord's benevolence.

games.name: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
games.summary: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

games.name: We, Junk Artists
games.summary: A "collage-and-guess" multiplayer game for up to 6 players. Enjoy collaging ordinary items into outside-the-box "masterpieces," guess each other's creations, and unleash your wild imagination around the campfire. Here, everyone is an artist!

games.name: Pakinpaks
games.summary: A cozy puzzle game where you go on a journey all around the world packing and organizing all sorts of travel gear. Fulfill your client's request in any way you wish and — as long as everything fits — prepare the neatest bags that you can!

games.name: Nova Patria
games.summary: Nova Patria is a Roman Steampunk Colony Sim. In this alternate history, the empire never fell and lived on to discover the New World and steam power. Manage intricate supply chains, expanding cities, and innovations in a hopeful, procedurally generated, isometric simulation of industrial antiquity.

games.name: Color Lim
games.summary: ‘Color Lim’ is a platformer adventure game set in the post-apocalypse. In a world where color is everything, Lim, a little slime who was not born with color, embarks on a journey to find color. Can the little slime find his true color?

games.name: Peregrino
games.summary: Peregrino is a dark isometric survival adventure where you explore a cursed forest by day and manage your caravan by night. Gather resources, hunt deadly creatures, upgrade your caravan, care for your companions, and lead them through the vast wilderness in search of New Eden.

games.name: Sector Zero
games.summary: SECTOR ZERO is a reverse horror physics-based puzzle platformer where you play as a monster! You are part of The Corruption - an Alien Hive Mind Entity hunting down survivors inside the Mining Colony of Asteroid 2031 XT.

games.name: Space Scum
games.summary: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

games.name: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
games.summary: Gold makes god. Embrace city-building chaos. Pet giant monsters! Watch puny adventurers! Bend nature to your will with powerful spells and the greatest of all forces of nature - GOLD. Colony sim / reverse RPG

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu
games.summary: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

events.name: AWS re:Invent Keynote Racer
events.description: Have you ever watched a keynote while driving a racecar? Watch all five live keynotes from AWS re:Invent 2025 while driving through this Las Vegas-inspired track, or in the trackside lounge. Developed in collaboration with EPAM, this experience shows how Amazon Web Services (AWS) powers seamless live streaming, while providing players with information on how game developers work with AWS, Amazon, Amazon Ads, Amazon Luna, Twitch, The Internet Game Database (IGDB), as well as EPAM.

games.name: Fortnite
games.summary: Fortnite is a free-to-play online game where you and your friends fight to be the last one standing in Battle Royale, join forces to make your own Creative games, or catch a live show at Party Royale.

events.name: DOSMan Direct: December 3, 2025
events.description: The world's first DOSMan Direct is here! Here to bring you fresh trailers, reveals, sales and so much more!

games.name: Blue Wyrm
games.summary: Blue Wyrm is a first-person skill-based action game, where you take upon a role of the Red Knight Gabriel, armed only with her trusty sword to fight off a tight, but varied roster of enemies in a nonsensical surreal dungeon. Learn the ways to use your movement and position, directional attack variety and timing to perfect your battle technique and succeed in your quest to save her.

games.name: Dead Trash: Operation - Yellow Snow
games.summary: Operation Yellow Snow is a short, grindhouse-style holiday mini-campaign set in the Dead Trash universe. This standalone DLC brings the retro horror shooter to the season of gibbing.

games.name: Satan II
games.summary: The daughter of Satan has seized control of Hell and destroyed Heaven itself. You are hiding among the last survivors on Earth.—but not for long. An insane journey awaits you: a journey into Hell itself, to slaughter every demon, undead and cultist you encounter.

games.name: Blood Mall: Part II
games.summary: Blood Mall: Part II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where Blood Mall left off. Are you prepared to put an end to the Hastovenator Crisis, or have you bitten off more than you can chew?

games.name: Reverend: Surf 'n Sin
games.summary: Reverend: Surf 'n Sin is the follow-up you didn't expect. A spin-off to the cult game Reverend, this first-person shooter builds upon the gameplay and mechanics of the original, whilst throwing the story off the deep end. Have we jumped the shark? Water puns.

games.name: Bloodmatch
games.summary: The arena beckons. Sharpen your steel. Slash, stab, and spear your way through the ranks of Rome’s toughest warriors, taking yourself from a lowly pit slave to the land's most glorified gladiator. Your audience awaits…

games.name: The Henchmen
games.summary: The Henchmen is a pulp-inspired, 90s fueled top-down, action retro open-world game set in the fictional city of New Queens during 1979 and 1991.

games.name: Biomeat Huskworld
games.summary: This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.

games.name: Gravelord
games.summary: Gravelord is a fast-paced boomer shooter voiced by a badass protagonist featuring hand-crafted levels filled with secrets and hordes of enemies to kill. Dish out some brutal carnage with powerful guns and collect Tarot Cards to gain even more killing power. Let's put the fun back in funeral!

events.name: Total War 25th Anniversary Showcase
events.description:
Join us on December 4th, 4pm GMT for the Total War 25th Anniversary Showcase – a special video presentation celebrating exciting new projects across historical and fantasy Total war.

This showcase will be your front seat to see what we’ve been eagerly building behind the scenes. Across the franchise, we’re working on a variety of projects that span different settings and stages of development and now we finally get to share some of them with you.

games.name: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Total War: Medieval III
games.summary:
We’ve been waiting a long time to say this: Total War is going back to the medieval era ⚔️ Total War: MEDIEVAL III is now in early development!

This isn’t just a sequel; it’s the rebirth of historical Total War. And we're bringing you on the journey with us.

events.name: PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2025
events.description: The PC Gaming Show: Most Wanted 2025 is coming right up, broadcasting Thursday, December 4 at 12pm PST, 3pm EST, and 8pm GMT, showing off all the most hotly anticipated titles that will be coming out in the final weeks of December, next year, and beyond.

games.name: Tamer Town
games.summary: Collect Mokitons in this city management game, where tamers and their monsters unite in battle, evolve and bond together in their unique town. Design neighborhoods, unlock stories and grow a feel-good world where every connection matters.

games.name: Wardrum
games.summary: Lead a tribal warband and time your attacks to the beat of the Wardrum in this tactical turn-based roguelite! Forge a path across a harsh fantasy world full of rhythm magic, face death and strengthen your warriors until you have the power to destroy the dark sorcery infecting the lands.

games.name: Crimson Desert
games.summary: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.

games.name: Spellcasters Chronicles
games.summary: CAST. FLY. FIGHT. COOPERATE. In intense 3V3 action-strategy battles, summon hundreds of creatures, cast devastating spells, and call upon the might of Titans to rise as the most powerful member of the community of Spellcasters – and shape the fate of the world. Together.

games.name: When Sirens Fall Silent
games.summary: When Sirens Fall Silent is a dark psychological thriller set in 1990s Italy. Players play as Mila, a troubled policewoman drawn into a high-profile case of kidnappings and murders. As the case unravels, players must not only save her from herself but from being swallowed by a vortex of violence and confusion.

games.name: Guild Wars: Reforged
games.summary: Step into Guild Wars Reforged, the award-winning online roleplaying game enjoyed by millions, now re-energized with system enhancements. Experience the complete saga—from the fall of Ascalon to the desperate stand against Nightfall. Your adventure is just getting started!

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Last Man Sitting
games.summary: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

games.name: Springs, Eternal
games.summary: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

games.name: Rhell: Warped Worlds & Troubled Times
games.summary: Create unique spells by combining magical runes to solve puzzles your way. Transform objects, manipulate time, and discover the mysteries of a world where everyone has vanished, leaving only 12 people behind. Every puzzle has multiple solutions - if you can imagine it, you can probably do it.

games.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
games.summary: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in a brutal afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, Story Mode or Co-Op PvE to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

games.name: Be My Horde
games.summary: Be My Horde is a roguelite survivor where your minions fight for you. Become a formidable necromancer and turn your enemies into a resource! Raise fallen foes, build massive undead hordes, enhance your skills with devoured souls, and conquer the world – you’re the villain in this story.

games.name: Starsand Island
games.summary: Leave the hustle of the city behind and embrace life on Starsand Island. Fish, farm, raise animals, and befriend or fall in love with locals to learn their secrets. Customize your world with our DIY system, and invite friends to help build your dream paradise!

games.name: Brightfall
games.summary: Lived through the Plague, did you? Now try surviving till morning on an island erased from the maps. Gather, build, and fight to keep your light alive in Brightfall - a co-op open world survival-craft roguelite where the darkness wants to swallow you whole.

games.name: Star Wars Zero Company
games.summary: Command an elite squad through a gritty and authentic story in Star Wars Zero Company, a single-player turn-based tactics game.

games.name: Remnant Protocol
games.summary: The assassination of the Blessed Mother has plunged the galaxy in darkness. Usurpers rule with absolute authority, and blood flows in rivers of red across the stars. Only the Protocol can restore Her light.

games.name: Let It Die: Inferno
games.summary:
LET IT DIE: INFERNO is a roguelite survival action game where you can engage in chaotic battles with grotesque monsters, enemy factions, and even other players.

Humanity had just recovered from the unprecedented cataclysm known as “Earth Rage,” when suddenly, a massive chasm appeared—large enough to swallow an entire city whole.​ Someone began calling the hole “Hell Gate,” and lying at its depths is the “Eye of the Reaper,” a powerful crystal containing the energy to rule the world. Explore, survive, and extract from the Inferno, where stage layouts and item placements differ every match.

In this game, on top of player-versus-environment-versus-player—where players and enemies collide within Hell Gate—there is also a mode for battling exclusively with other players. We hope you enjoy this powered-up version of the LET IT DIE world!

games.name: Halloween: The Game
games.summary: On Halloween night, 1978, no one is safe from Michael Myers. Become the Boogeyman or fight back against the face of evil itself in Halloween.

games.name: Streets of Fortuna
games.summary: Use your wits to survive the generated chaos that is living in the Streets of Fortuna. A free-roaming sandbox game about growing from street rat to a tradesman, a priest, a smuggler, an alchemist, a spy, or perhaps someday a leader to rival the Overlord.

games.name: Rivage
games.summary: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Night Swarm
games.summary: Rise as a young vampire, earn your name, and gather powerful allies. In this survivor-like auto-shooter, battle relentless werewolf hordes, grow your strength, build your pack, and dominate the night.

games.name: Luna Abyss
games.summary: Luna Abyss is a single player story driven action-adventure with fluid platforming and bullet hell combat. Follow the journey of Fawkes, a prisoner of Luna caught between a cryptic prophecy and their prison sentence.

games.name: Blood: Refreshed Supply
games.summary: Things are about to get… bloody! Soak up 42 pulse-pounding levels dripping with Lovecraftian atmosphere as you battle your way through armies of sycophantic cultists, zombies, gargoyles, hell hounds, and other insatiable horrors, in your quest to defeat the loathsome Tchernobog.

games.name: Light No Fire
games.summary: A game about adventure, building, survival and exploration together. Set on a fantasy planet the size of Earth.

games.name: The House of Hikmah
games.summary: The House of Hikmah is a narrative-driven 3D adventure game exploring grief, legacy and the search for answers after profound loss. Solve puzzles, encounter historical scholars of the Islamic Golden Age, and uncover timeless lessons in a beautifully imagined House of Wisdom.

games.name: Sol: Shogunate
games.summary: Paint the stars with the blood of your enemies in this Space-Samurai Action RPG set in an alt-future solar system ruled by the sword. A pulse-pounding soundtrack drives your gravity-defying, blood-soaked path of revenge as Yuzuki the “Shattered Heir” to a massacred clan who becomes an outlaw ronin.

games.name: Nioh 3
games.summary: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

games.name: Substructure
games.summary: Harness the power of automation in this factory game set on a rogue planet in the far reaches of the solar system. Dig down and explore the depths of an alien world, exploit its resources across complex production chains, and travel towards the core to uncover its deepest secrets.

games.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
games.summary: Explore a rich and unique open world in this Adventure RPG. Uncover lost dwarven ruins, build a new society and re-establish dwarven kind.

games.name: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
games.summary: Carmageddon smashes back with brutal roguelite vehicular‑combat mayhem. Adapt, upgrade, and unleash destruction on post‑apocalyptic zombie hordes. The legacy lives on, reinvented and unforgiving.

games.name: Esoteric Ebb
games.summary: ESOTERIC EBB is a single-player CRPG inspired by the freedom of tabletop adventures. Unravel a political conspiracy with your goblin sidekick. Roll dice in tense encounters. Become a cleric of legends or completely ruin the campaign.

games.name: Reanimal
games.summary: The creators of Little Nightmares I & II have returned to take you on a darker, more terrifying journey than ever before. In this horror adventure game, a brother & sister go through hell to rescue their missing friends and escape the island that they used to call home.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Splitgate: Arena Reloaded
games.summary: Portal into the action as an elite Ace in Splitgate 2, the only free-to-play shooter where you can teleport across the map to outsmart your opponents. Team up, customize weapons, and master portaling skills as you compete for glory in epic showdowns.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: Stranger Than Heaven is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio and published by Sega. The game follows a multi-decade story across five eras and five cities, centered on men searching for a place to belong. It combines close-quarters action with narrative elements, historical urban settings, and activities connected to music and performance.

games.name: Rogue Point
games.summary: From the creators of Black Mesa: Welcome to Rogue Point! A 4-player co-op shooter where teamwork is everything. Join forces on intense missions with evolving objectives and powerful upgrades. Plan, Adapt, and Overcome. Your squad’s survival depends on it.

games.name: Dungeons of Dusk
games.summary: Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS. Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Nutmeg!
games.summary: NUTMEG! is a nostalgic football manager game with a deckbuilding twist, set in the '80s and '90s. Relive the days when the tackles were as hard as the mullets were long and football was about football.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Away From Home
games.summary: A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!

games.name: Mio: Memories in Orbit
games.summary: MIO: Memories in Orbit is a 2.5D side-scrolling metroidvania platformer. Players control a robot named Mio who explores a vast spaceship called the Vessel, gaining new abilities such as wall climbing, dodging, grappling, and gliding while fighting machines that have gone rogue. Combat emphasizes aerial fighting, and players can equip modifiers that adjust their abilities at the cost of modifier slots. Currency called Nacre is used to purchase upgrades and is lost on death, and fast-travel devices serve as save points across the ship.

games.name: Samson
games.summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI heads to the state of Leonida, home to the neon-soaked streets of Vice City and beyond in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the Grand Theft Auto series yet.

games.name: Ferocious
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a survival FPS adventure. Stranded on a dangerous island, face mercenaries, dinosaurs, and a vibrant yet hostile ecosystem. Explore breathtaking environments and survive the onslaught of intense, fast-paced encounters.

games.name: The Relic: First Guardian
games.summary: "Guardian, gather the pieces of the great relic and seal the void of darkness." In this action RPG, you embark on a heroic adventure to save the world in the dark as the last guardian. Start your journey as a guardian, gather pieces of great relic and close the void.

games.name: Windrose
games.summary: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Inkblood
games.summary: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

games.name: Animalkind
games.summary: Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Use your powerful mech to establish your ideal town and recruit a variety of characters to join you. It's the paw-fect game to play with up to 3 friends!

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: ConcernedApe's Haunted Chocolatier
games.summary: An RPG/simulation game following a chocolatier living in a haunted castle. In order to thrive in your new role, you will have to gather rare ingredients, make delicious chocolates, and sell them in a chocolate shop.

games.name: Neath
games.summary: Manipulate the turns of friend and foe alike in this Eldritch roguelike tactical RPG by the makers of Rogue Legacy. Ascend the inverted tower. Kill an indolent god. Control every "moment".

games.name: Slay the Spire II
games.summary:
The iconic roguelike deckbuilder returns!

Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, and discover relics of immense power in Slay the Spire 2 - featuring new characters, cards, events, alternate acts, and more!

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Dogpile
games.summary: Dogpile is a roguelike deck builder about merging cute dogs into bigger dogs. Play dogs, get money, customize your dogs with special Traits, refine your deck, PLAY MORE DOGS! DOGS!

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: About Fishing
games.summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Lunar Strike
games.summary: Lunar Strike blends speculative fiction with a game world grounded in hard science. The game focuses on compelling survival and character-driven storytelling over combat. A race against time to preserve the evidence of humanity’s presence on the Moon before its inevitable collapse and destruction.

games.name: Killing Floor III: Operation Breakout
games.summary: Welcome to Season 2 Operation: Breakout. This massive seasonal update expands gameplay with new content, features, and balance improvements. Players can wield the KV Recluse, a new Medic SMG, face the return of the new stealthy Stalker Zed, and explore the new Prison survival map deep in the Costa Rican jungle. The update reintroduces DJ Scully as a new Specialist alongside a new ten-mission narrative campaign, fresh weekly modes, wave mutators, and Zed execution animations. A new Collections store taband100-tier Supply Pass overhaul progression and customization. Extensive balance tuning, optimizations, and hundreds bug fixes round out the most ambitious update yet within Killing Floor 3's Year 1 Roadmap.

games.name: Space Warlord Baby Trading Simulator
games.summary: Buy low, sell high, and short an entire universe of babies in this arcade stock market sim set in the world of Space Warlord Organ Trading Simulator.

games.name: Big Walk
games.summary: Hang out and get lost with close friends in a big world. A cooperative online walker-talker from the creators of Untitled Goose Game.

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

games.name: Last Flag
games.summary: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

games.name: Den of Wolves
games.summary: Den of Wolves is a co-op heist FPS from the creator of Payday: The Heist, Payday 2 and GTFO. In this techno-thriller you and your friends operate as criminals for hire in the conflicts between rival corporations in Midway City. Gather your crew, design the plan, gear up and execute the heist.

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Down with the Ship
games.summary: Strategic auto battler where you design a heavily-armed spaceship. Draft 200+ items, outfit your hull, and unleash it in async PvP. Blend captains and factions for absurd combos and galactic domination. Roll, buy, place, pray.

games.name: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes
games.summary: In Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes, take command of a fleet escaping the annihilation of the Twelve Colonies. Manage crises on board as you prepare for the next encounter with the Cylon Fleet. Times are dire, and hard choices must be made. Your only hope: rejoin the Battlestar Galactica.

games.name: Recur
games.summary: A time-bending journey to the end of the world and back. Run, jump, and manipulate time to solve puzzles as the apocalypse unfolds. Can you stop the clock on disaster?

games.name: Soulmask
games.summary: Soulmask is a sandbox game that prioritizes an authentic survival experience. As the "last one" blessed with the mysterious mask, players will grapple for survival in a primitive land steeped in mysterious faiths, carving out a path to ascendance. Start from nothing, explore, build, recruit tribesmen to fortify your clan, and ultimately unravel the mysterious truths hidden behind the civilizations of this world.

games.name: Soulmask: Shifting Sands
games.summary:
The Scorching Land: A New World Born from Ancient Egypt

This was once a land blessed by the Solar Deity, a pearl in the desert, but now, all its glory has scattered to the winds...

games.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
games.summary: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

games.name: Epoch Reset
games.summary: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

games.name: Starship Troopers: Ultimate Bug War!
games.summary: Lock and load into the Starship Troopers universe and join the Mobile Infantry in the most realistic depiction of war ever made ! Experience an original story in this action-packed, first-person retro shooter. Would you like to know more?

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

games.name: DarkSwitch
games.summary: DarkSwitch is a vertical survival city builder. Build a city on a great tree and defend it against the Fog. Face the challenges of limited real estate, scarce resources, and tough moral choices as you seek to uncover the mystery of the Veil. The Tree Provides! The Tree Protects! The Tree Prevails!

games.name: Hello Sunshine
games.summary: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

games.name: High on Life 2
games.summary: An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through the exotic locales to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)!

games.name: Thick as Thieves
games.summary:
Enter the shadows in this introduction to Thick as Thieves. In the shadow-draped streets of Kilcairn, fortune favours the bold. As a member of the Thieves' Guild, you'll undertake daring heists to claim precious heirlooms and uncover arcane secrets hidden within this alternate-history 1910s Scottish city, where magic and early technology have begun to collide.

Whether working alone or playing online co-op, only the most cunning will seize their fortune in Thick as Thieves!

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Witchspire
games.summary: A survival-crafting adventure in a world brimming with magic and peril. Befriend and battle creatures, and conjure up a sanctuary alongside other witches in co-op or single-player.

events.name: Grasshopper Direct: 5 Minutes feat. ROMEO IS A DEAD MAN
events.description: A short showcase to show more of the studio’s upcoming science-fiction action game ROMEO IS A DEAD MAN, including a behind-the-scenes look at the game’s development and never-before-seen gameplay.

games.name: Romeo is a Dead Man
games.summary:
Latest ultra-violent sci-fi action title from Grasshopper Manufacture and Suda51.

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Romeo Stargazer, a man pulled back from the brink of death by a time paradox gone wrong. Now reborn as Agent Dead Man of the FBI Space-Time Division, and armed with the mysterious Dead Gear mask, Romeo must chase the universe’s most dangerous fugitives across alternate realities.

Blending high-octane gunplay, brutal sword combat, and over-the-top sci-fi insanity, Romeo Is a Dead Man is GhM’s bloodiest action game yet. Players can expect mind-bending twists, outrageous gimmicks, and a deeply cathartic combat system that turns enemies’ powers against them in universe-shattering battles.

As Romeo tears through the multiverse, he’s also on a desperate quest to find Juliet, his mysteriously vanished girlfriend. With a narrative that fuses love, loss, and metaphysical chaos, Romeo Is a Dead Man offers a stylish and unpredictable journey through the very fabric of time itself.

Can you survive the bleeding edge of space-time? Or will you become just another ghost in the paradox?

games.name: Banners & Bastions
games.summary: Banners & Bastions is a 3D tabletop real-time strategy game in mixed reality. Command your troops and fortify your kingdom to defeat the enemy in dynamic and epic battles!

games.name: Catana: Red Flowers
games.summary:
Step into the paws of a nimble ninja cat!

By day, run your chaotic Restaurant, cook dishes, serve quirky guests, and stir up playful mischief.

By night, dash through enemies, deflect bullets, gather resources to grow your Restaurant, and showcase your skills with precision, speed, and style.

games.name: Crossings
games.summary: Explore and Fight your way through an ever-changing world in a quest for vengeance and survival in an epic Adventure through the Norse afterlife. Meet fellow lost souls in seamless and wordless VR Co-op as you Block, Dodge, Strike and Power your way through Trolls, Draugr and other dark beings.

games.name: Xploit.Zero
games.summary: Xploit.Zero is an Augmented Reality experience that transforms your space into a virtual battlefield. You are a human firewall — place turrets to slow down swarms of DDoS viruses and use your own body to destroy airborne Malworms. Your NeuroGate has been hacked, and a digital breach has opened inside your room. Defend it at all costs, or you’ll lose connection with reality and be trapped in the Matrix forever.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: CyberDrifter
games.summary:
A virus has been unleashed that threatens global communications!
Military tech specialists who enter systems in Virtual Reality are called in to battle the virus in a simulated world.
They are the CyberDrifters.
Enter Cyberspace in Virtual Reality and battle your way through a virtualized world armed with your Data-Disc and Cyber-Cycle!

games.name: Deadly Delivery
games.summary: An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! Team up with up to 3 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans.

games.name: Cues: Creator Update
games.summary: Creator mode lets you build anything you want with cubes. From tiny models… to living-room fortresses.

games.name: The Great Flood
games.summary: "A War you can grasp." An upcoming strategy game, featuring the ability to engage in duels in VR/MR Dual Modes.

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Hide The Corpse: Gusimir Mansion
games.summary:
Welcome to Gusimir Mansion, a frightening but hilarious new level where Gus’s bizarre ancestors left behind their legacy of chaos.

Explore a creepy manor packed with strange inventions, taxidermy experiments, and questionable family secrets.
This DLC adds 8 hiding spots — two more than usual — scattered through mysterious rooms filled with animal sculptures, flickering machines, and vampire-disco vibes.

Your goal: find every hiding place to reach the best score. Watch out for the mansion’s weird physics and unpredictable contraptions — in Gusimir Mansion, even the furniture might have a pulse.

Scary? Maybe. Fun? Definitely.

games.name: Les Mills XR Bodycombat: Ultimate Fitness Pack
games.summary: Get the most complete BODYCOMBAT collection ever. Train at home with award-winning workouts. More content, more intensity, and more motivation—one pack, no subscriptions, endless fitness.

games.name: Stellar Cafe
games.summary:
The first VR game built entirely around your voice. No menus, no controllers, just real-time conversations and interactions.

Welcome to Stellar Cafe, a coffee shop at the edge of the galaxy filled with quirky robots with bizarre ambitions and a lot to say. Pull up a seat, order whatever you can imagine, and meet a rotating cast of unforgettable characters. You might end up helping a robot quit their job, be a guest on their podcast, or chase their dreams. Your voice steers the story.

games.name: Street Gods
games.summary: Street Gods is a physical VR action rogue-lite set in a shattered New York City where the Nine Realms of Norse myth have crashed into the modern world. Ancient power floods the streets. Reality is breaking. And Mjolnir has chosen you.

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Heroes Together VR
games.summary: Gather your friends and dive into a world of magic and adventure in Heroes Together VR, a roguelite VR dungeon crawler. Choose your hero, explore ever-changing biomes, battle magical monsters, and master your skills together as a team in this epic co-op quest.

games.name: Virtual Skate: Winter Update
games.summary: The Winter Update comes with a new mini mega map, carve corners and pump transition, customize your clothes and gear with gear mod support, and more!

games.name: Alliance Peacefighter
games.summary: A linear, story-driven space sim in the style of 90s classics like X-Wing and Wing Commander. As a newly qualified Alliance pilot, you find yourself caught up in a plot to break the fragile peace between two galactic super powers.

games.name: Alliance Tales: Battle for the Frontier
games.summary: Alliance Tales is a linear, story-driven space combat sim inspired by 90s classics like Wing Commander and Tie Fighter. Take part in fast-paced space battles in a campaign takes you on the search for a missing friend while foiling a plot to take over the Frontier Colonies.

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Fresh Tracks VR
games.summary: The critically acclaimed rhythm roguelite, Fresh Tracks, is now in VR! Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

games.name: Men in Black: Most Wanted
games.summary:
New York, 1995.
You are Agent I of the Men In Black. A race of shapeshifting aliens has infiltrated every corner of the city, wiped your memory and made an attempt on your life.
Frankly, it’s embarrassing.
Partnered with the enigmatic Agent L, you are charged with repelling this new threat while confronting the most dangerous aliens on the planet: MIB’s Most Wanted.

games.name: Fixer Undercover
games.summary: Welcome to DIY Espionage - a VR puzzle adventure where everyday tools and found objects become your problem-solving kit. Go undercover as a repair worker inside a prison, investigate a mysterious rehabilitation program through various challenges, and make your escape with the truth.

games.name: Skytail
games.summary:
Living among the clouds with your legendary birdlike companion, your idyllic life is shattered when corrupted fiends steal your Skytail’s offspring. Now you must harness the telekinetic powers of the ancients and take to the skies in a daring rescue.

Wield a wide range of telekinetic abilities using elegant gesture controls. Crush foes, tear them apart, or charge them up and hurl them around for devastating impact.

games.name: Little Planet: Holiday Update
games.summary: Little Planet is inviting everybody home for the holidays, bringing plenty of winter joy to everybody's favorite social life sim. Whether it's a hot cup of cocoa shared with friends, a visit from Santa, or the thrill of exchanging gifts after a laugh filled snowball fight, there's plenty of new fun to be had.

games.name: How to God
games.summary:
Are you a wise and benevolent leader, or a vengeful deity? Will you assist your villagers, or throw them into the sun?
In How to God, a sandbox God Simulation game, you alone choose how to shape your world. Command your followers, experiment with alchemy, build up your villages, and make the choice between good and evil. No judgement from us, of course - only you can choose How to God.

games.name: Hero Bootcamp
games.summary: Congratulations, recruit — you’ve been accepted into Hero Bootcamp, the galaxy’s least predictable (and most eye-powered) superhero training program. Your goal? Survive the SHAT — the Super Hero Acumen Test — a whirlwind of ridiculous missions that somehow determine whether you're “hero material.”

games.name: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger
games.summary: Pirates VR Jolly Roger is a game alluding to old stories of the all-time most famous Pirates. The journey into the pirate world begins on a deserted island. Despite its extraordinary charm, the land hides a number of secrets and mysteries to be solved as well as obstacles and traps.

games.name: Aerosurfer
games.summary: Glide and surf through handcrafted tracks at breakneck speed. The closer you fly to the ground, the faster you go! Chase your best times, race against your ghost, and climb the leaderboards in a high speed journey of control and flow.

games.name: Voxel Playground
games.summary: Voxel Playground is a physics-based voxel sandbox VR game

games.name: Unseen Diplomacy 2
games.summary: You're a Secret Agent during a dangerous time, Evil-doers are plotting to destroy the world. Complete missions, manage your agents & use Intel to narrow down the plot & save the Earth. Play a real-life VR obstacle course using every inch of your room - you will run, roll, sneak & hack to victory!

games.name: Jolly Match 3 MR
games.summary:
Get ready to step into a whole new dimension of puzzle-solving with Jolly Match 3 MR!
Interact with dazzling puzzles in your own space. Swap, match, hit awesome combos, and rediscover the fun of classic match-3 mechanics like never before!

games.name: VR Giants
games.summary: VR Giants is a local multiplayer coop VR game that makes use of one player’s body to extend the level for the other player to explore. One player is huge (Goliath) and his avatar is controlled with a VR set. David is the tiny character which is controlled with a gamepad. Goliath must use his body as a bridge for David to cross abysses or reach higher platforms. David is tiny and is highly vulnerable to fire, spikes, and other dangers. Goliath must protect David so that he can collect coins and keys that lead both players to freedom.

games.name: EXD: Extra Dimensional
games.summary: A delivery guy. A dimensional rift. A quest across another world. Master telekinesis and elemental magic in Erath, where everyday objects become legendary weapons. Battle mythical creatures. Solve ancient puzzles. Uncover dark truths. Advanced VR physics meet epic fantasy adventure.

games.name: Walkabout Mini Golf: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
games.summary: Follow the white rabbit and dive down into the curiouser and curiouser world of one of the most fantastical stories of all time. Lewis Carroll's everlasting tales of Alice's adventures are brought to life in this fantastical mini-golf course, where you'll be greeted by iconic characters and a new mechanic that will change everything. Shrink your worries, grow your imagination and explore the whimsical world of Wonderland to your heart’s content! After all, every adventure requires a first step.

games.name: Pencil! x Walkabout Mini Golf: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland - Lesson Pack
Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a cooperative sci-fi PvE shooter that redefines VR combat with intense firefights, squad tactics, and dynamic battlefields.

games.name: Dread Meridian
games.summary: Dread Meridian is a survival horror adventure for VR. Play as Daniela on a desperate search for her lost sister on an frozen island spiraling into madness. Scavenge for resources, solve cryptic puzzles and battle unimaginable creatures while unraveling the mystery of her disappearance.

games.name: Scared by Squares
games.summary: A creepy VR exploration game where you navigate liminal spaces, avoid roaming cubes, and uncover hidden anomalies in eerie block-filled mazes.

games.name: Color-A-Cube
games.summary: Dive into a relaxing, color-filled escape with Color A Cube. This immersive coloring experience lets you explore and bring voxel worlds to life, one cube at a time. Unwind and tap into your creative flow as each brushstroke reveals vibrant, voxel-based environments and characters.

games.name: Birdseed VR
games.summary: Snap pics of the chunkiest, cutest birds in VR! Relax in lush forests, complete quirky daily quests, and fill your Journal. Whether you’re birding alone or together with friends, get cozy and escape to nature.

games.name: The Amusement
games.summary: An abandoned amusement park, a tangled memory, a family shattered by the Great War… Discover an intense story in this redirected-walking VR adventure in which every step counts.

games.name: UnLoop
games.summary: The ultimate VR puzzle where playing with yourself is strictly required Infiltrate a retro-futuristic space station, get trapped in a time loop, and team up with your past-copies to solve puzzles. Forget tutorials. Prove you're a genius, figure it out, or literally screw yourself over.

games.name: Transmission: Shortwave
games.summary: Transmission: Shortwave is a 3D casual driving delivery simulator set in a retro-futuristic 1990s Great Britain.

games.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim VR
games.summary: Use native PCVR support to experience a hightened sense of spatial freedom and immersion in Lushfoil's 10 detailed environments.

games.name: Guardians Planetfall
games.summary: From the creators of Guardians Frontline, Guardians Planetfall drops you into a galaxy-wide war for the fate of humanity. Fight assembled into squads of up to 4 soldiers in fast, tactical VR combat across space and dangerous planets filled with aliens, Void soldiers, and massive war machines.

games.name: I Am Bird
games.summary:
I Am Bird puts you in the wings of a true bird hero. Fly freely through
a large city full of quests, activities, and exploration. Experience the
life of a super-bird from above as you glide through streets, rooftops,
and open skies.

events.name: 11 bit studios Digital Showcase 2025
events.description:
Join us for the first-ever 11 bit studios Digital Showcase!

We’re bringing you a closer look at what’s coming across our worlds, from the frozen streets of #Frostpunk 2 to the distant planet in #TheAlters, the spirit-torn realms of #DeathHowl, the endless runs of #Moonlighter 2, and more surprises along the way.

games.name: Frostpunk: 1886
games.summary: The original Frostpunk experience is being reimagined and expanded with new events, mechanics, and laws within a new Purpose Path. Return to your role as the ruler of Earth's last city, manage its citizens, weigh up your choices and ensure your society's survival.

games.name: The Alters
games.summary: Explore an emotional sci-fi game with a unique blend of survival, adventure, and base-building elements. Help Jan Dolski, the sole survivor of an ill-fated space expedition, create alternative versions of himself to escape a hostile planet and tackle personal turmoils with this unconventional crew.

games.name: Death Howl
games.summary: Journey through the sorrowful spirit world in a soulslike deck builder. Craft cards and claim powerful totems to defeat the woeful spirits lurking in the mystical lands. Unravel the tale of a grieving mother in her desperate attempt to defy death and bring back her son.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Frostpunk 2: Fractured Utopias
games.summary: The first Frostpunk 2 DLC expands Utopia Builder mode by adding structured Utopia Trees for each faction, powered by affinities. As factions’ trust grows you unlock faction-specific laws, buildings, and abilities that push their ideological goals. Completing a faction’s Utopia Tree enacts a single societal vision for the city and permanently resolves Tension, but pursuing utopia carries significant costs.

events.name: Choose Wisely Festival Showcase 2025
events.description: A showcase of 50 choices matter games, accompanying the week-long digital event dedicated to celebrating branching narrative in games.

games.name: Dispatch
games.summary: Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

games.name: Scarlet Hollow
games.summary: You've finally made it to the dead-end mining town of Scarlet Hollow, North Carolina, where your aunt is dead, your cousin hates you, and something otherworldly stalks you from the shadows. You won't be able to save everyone. You might not even be able to save yourself. Welcome home.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Mandrake
games.summary: You are the last of the Mandrakes, a sorcerous line of gardeners. At long last, you’ve returned to your family's abandoned home. Make friends, tend your gardens, and put down roots. Fish, gather and delve in the wilds. Make a place for yourself, and uncover the mysteries your family left behind.

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: In Ashes
games.summary: An unexpected quest has reached your sleepy town. Once again, you must raise your weapon and step into the boots of a weary, burnt out adventurer. When faced with a choice, what kind of hero will you be? In Ashes is a choice-driven fantasy visual novel about adventurers, monsters, and the forgotten.

games.name: The Wolf of Derevnya
games.summary: When the villagers of Derevnya begin turning up maimed, suspicion falls on you. Track down the beast to clear your name and save the village—but to unravel the mystery, you will need to confront your own past. A survival-horror choose your own adventure set in Kievan Rus'.

games.name: My Wife is a Spy?!
games.summary: In this otome isekai visual novel you're thrown into an arranged marriage with the cold Duke of the North. Explore political tension, shifting loyalties, and two routes: romance or rebellion. Support your husband or betray him like a true villainess and take control of your fate.

games.name: A Story of Questions
games.summary: You are trapped, unable to walk, only a desk in front of you. The voice you hear is that of a woman on a speaker. Solve puzzles, interact with your surroundings, and make weighty decisions as you uncover a strange and disturbing story in this supernatural single-player horror mystery.

games.name: No, I'm Not A Human
games.summary: An intimate story about a disaster and guests from underground. People are breaking into your home, but not all of them are true people.

games.name: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
games.summary: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Dating and Dragons: A Love Quest
games.summary: Dating & Dragons – A Love Quest is a narrative RPG dating sim packed with every fantasy trope you love. Sneak out with the thief, wreak havoc with the warrior, or flirt with the bard. Explore branching adventures with multiple endings and hidden secrets. Roll those dice and watch out for dragons!

games.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
games.summary:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

games.name: Ambition: A Minuet in Power
games.summary: A young woman finds herself alone in the streets of Paris, far from home and abandoned by the love of her life. In that moment, she decides to live for herself and seek her own passions, as France marches towards a violent uprising that will change history forever. Navigate the twisting social politics of pre-revolutionary Paris in a game world that’s different every time you play. Court, snub and seduce your way to the top of society. Extend your influence, uncover the intrigue of the coming revolution, and ensure that you end up on the winning side of history.

games.name: A Year of Springs
games.summary: Experience the stories of Haru, Erika, and Manami, a trio of friends navigating their feelings of love, connection, and just wanting to belong.

games.name: Asbury Pines
games.summary: A grisly murder in a small town unfolds across centuries. Incremental-style interactions with the people, places, and events of Asbury Pines grow resources and build rewarding production engines that unlock a sprawling mystery embedded in the flow of time.

games.name: Band of Crusaders
games.summary: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.summary: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

games.name: Ministry of Order
games.summary: You’ve been assigned to the Maternity Ward in a totalitarian 1920s state. Reunite newborns with their rightful parents using a simplified genetics puzzle - no mistakes allowed. Obey the regime, join a secret conspiracy, or forge your own path.

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Letter Lost
games.summary: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

games.name: The Wide Open Sky Is Running Out of Catfish
games.summary: A story-driven photography game... on the back of a giant, flying catfish. Transform clouds into sea creatures and bring abundance back to an empty sky.

games.name: Gap Year
games.summary: Gap Year is a story-focused point & click adventure played through comic book panels that reconfigure as you explore Vera Novak’s one-bedroom apartment. Vera is a bright young scientist, but the arrival of an unexpected guest and a strange fixation with a cosmonaut may derail her academic pursuits.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Fearbonding
games.summary: Fearbonding is a Yandere x Demon BL Horror Visual Novel. Play as Hinata, a demon, and try to tame the deranged Kosuke. Will you get to satisfy your hunger for fear through your new hunting dog or will you be the one to get devoured?

games.name: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game
games.summary: Welcome to Red Hives, a lovely Midwestern town infested with demons. You're a little spirit stuck in a time loop, your only way to interact with the world is by possessing people and whispering into their ears. Explore timelines, solve mysteries, and please, try to keep your hosts alive...

games.name: Lake
games.summary: It's 1986 - Meredith Weiss takes a break from her career in the big city to deliver mail in her hometown. How will she experience two weeks in beautiful Providence Oaks, with its iconic lake and quirky community? And what will she do next? It's up to you.

games.name: Teller's Duty
games.summary: Teller’s Duty is a simulation game where players take on the role of a bank teller in a dystopian world. They must process transactions, verify documents, and detect fraud while navigating complex moral dilemmas that shape the story. Featuring a vintage paper-inspired aesthetic and a choice-driven narrative, the game challenges players to balance their duties with ethical decisions that impact their future

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Of Sense and Soul
games.summary: A queer Victorian romance visual novel in which a gentleman running from the past and a poet hiding from the future collide through a lonely hearts ad. Suddenly, their lives can blossom—if you choose to change them.

games.name: Militsioner
games.summary: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.summary: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

games.name: Peppered: An Existential Platformer
games.summary:
A light hearted 2D platformer about the meaningless of existence. Dark humour. Big focus on narrative-driven gameplay. Regret. Currently being developed for PC and Mac.
You play as a nameless civilian of an immortal world an hour before a return of the God of death. Life presents you with an opportunity to take this matter into your own hands. And then presents you with countless ways to fail spectacularly.

games.name: Contra Spem Spero
games.summary: Contra Spem Spero is a non-linear horror visual novel. You are lost deep in a twisted place — a forest one can only hope to escape.

games.name: Truth Scrapper
games.summary: You have a case to solve, your memories reset each day, and two mysterious guides are vying for your attention– who will you decide to remember, and who will you decide to push aside…?

games.name: Opona
games.summary: The reality TV show Popworld is a one-way ticket to pop stardom, and Mia and Noah came here to win! Fight your way through turn-based dance battles (and a whole lot of drama) in this hand-drawn idol adventure game.

games.name: All Our Broken Parts
games.summary:
Experience a story-driven adventure/VN game as a robot doctor.

In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories.

Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

games.name: Sister Ray
games.summary: 2D RPG about the brutal daily life of a drug addicted artist called Ray, who takes care of her little sister. Look after your condition, so no one finds out about the addiction. Improve your drawing and social skills. Do everything to get cash for another fix. Survive and look for a way out.

games.name: Midnight Special
games.summary: Welcome to 'Midnight Special,' a gripping point-and-click survival horror game that pays homage to 70s and 80s cinema. The game's story draws inspiration from giallo, slashers, and sci-fi classics, while the presentation is inspired by 90s 16-bit aesthetics.

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: Glasshouse
games.summary: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

games.name: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors
games.summary: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

games.name: This Bed We Made
games.summary: This Bed We Made is a third-person mystery game in which you play as a maid in a 1950s hotel and snoop around strangers' rooms to uncover their deadly secrets. Discover what links the clients together in this tale of love, heartbreak and murder!

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Inhuman Resources: A Literary Machination
games.summary: A literary machination about corporations, conspiracies, and the unspeakable horrors you’ll commit for minimum wage.

games.name: Celestial Return
games.summary: Celestial Return is a story-driven RPG where dice are your bullets, your bribes, and your last breath. Loot, gamble, and survive a reality-crumbling city. Uncover cosmic horrors, outwit corrupted megacorps, and pray your next roll isn't your last.

games.name: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall
games.summary: In this new reality, where monsters seem closer, enemies stronger and your petitioners struggling more than ever, your duties as a King must continue. It will be your responsibility to rebuild the trust of your kingdom, protect your family and survive the upcoming winter.

games.name: Tavern Talk Stories: Dreamwalker
games.summary: Welcome Tavernkeep! In this D&D-inspired visual novel you will run a cozy seaside tavern, meet adventurers, gather rumours and mix fate-altering drinks to stop dreams from twisting into nightmares.

events.name: Slitherine Next 2025
events.description: Our biggest annual showcase returns to bring you exclusive news, gameplay reveals, and updates from some of our most anticipated titles. Whether you’re a long-time commander or new to the battlefield, this is your chance to see what’s next in the world of strategy gaming.

games.name: Panzer Corps 2: Allied Operations - Italy: Vol.1
games.summary: Lead the Allied invasion of Sicily in the opening chapter of a grand trilogy. Command British and American forces across two converging campaigns, carry your veteran core army forward, and relive the historic push that broke open Fortress Europe.

games.name: Nightmare Frontier
games.summary: Behold the first-ever Tactical Extraction Looter where you pit your courage and leadership against fears made manifest: the Dreadweavers. Lead a band of scavenger roughnecks into a devastated boom town of the alternative 1900s. Get in, face the monsters, grab what you can carry and get out. Alive.

games.name: Bolt Action
games.summary: Step into the boots of a battlefield commander in Bolt Action, a turn-based WWII strategy inspired by Warlord Games tabletop classic.

games.name: Radio Commander: Pacific '41
games.summary: Command operations in the Pacific War by analyzing reports, issuing radio orders, and making strategic decisions. This new title in the Radio Commander series enhances realism, focusing on situational awareness built through radio communications.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Space Station Designer is a construction and management game that puts you in charge of creating and expanding a network of orbital outposts in Earth and Lunar orbits.

games.name: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Evolution
games.summary: Evolution is the next major story expansion for Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance, the gritty real-time strategy experience set in the dark future of Dark Fate.

games.name: Scramble: Battle of Britain
games.summary:
Scramble: Battle of Britain is a simultaneous turn-based dogfighting game. Set in a 3D airspace, the game features fast-paced, tactical combat with dynamic flight physics.
Luftwaffe and RAF fighter squadrons go head to head over The English Channel. Competing players simultaneously issue control inputs for multiple aircraft while time is paused.
The planned orders are then played out simultaneously: shots are fired, loops are looped, colliding planes collide.
