games.summary: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

games.name: Shellbound
games.summary: Shellbound is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where life can only exist on a gigantic snail. Explore a vibrant world, fight bizarre flora and fauna and discover civilizations fueled by the powerful snail mucus. It is the key to your natural role: Devour everything so life itself continues to exist.

games.name: Super Adventure
games.summary: SUPER ADVENTURE is a Shmup turned 2D-Platformer with great emphasis on bullet dodging, expressive boss fights and a wacky story.

events.name: The Game Awards 2025
events.description: Live from Peacock Theater in Los Angeles, join Geoff Keighley and the video game industry for a celebration of the year's best -- and a look at what's next.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: Highguard
games.summary: From the creators of Apex Legends and Titanfall, comes Highguard: a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

games.name: Solo Leveling: Arise Overdrive
games.summary:
The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

games.name: Nioh 3
games.summary: In the latest game in the dark samurai action RPG series "Nioh," you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open world.

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: Arknights: Endfield
games.summary: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG developed by HYPERGRYPH. You will take on the role of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, set out across Talos-II to uncover its secrets, and defend and expand the frontiers of human civilization.

games.name: Duet Night Abyss
games.summary: Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features "multiple weapon loadouts & 3D combat" at its core, and tells the story of "Demons" from dual perspectives.

games.name: Out of Words
games.summary: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer is a runs-based, high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Total War: Warhammer 40,000
games.summary: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

games.name: Hitman 3: Patient Zero Requiem
games.summary: In this new mission, Agent 47 is tasked with the elimination of Lilith Devereux, the ambitious prospective CEO of Ether Corporation. A relative newcomer in the world of the high and mighty, Devereux’s rapid ascent has followed the mysterious deaths of her predecessor Neleis De Waal and chief scientists Silvio Caruso and Francesca De Santis. Her meteoric rise has been generously supported by Gregory Carlisle. For this mission, Agent 47 will visit the Carlisle Estate, based in the Dartmoor location, where tensions will reach a breaking point.

games.name: Hitman 3: The Eminem vs. Slim Shady Pack
games.summary:
Unlock a series of cosmetics inspired by The Reflection Elusive Target mission and gain permanent access to The Antithesis - A two-level Arcade contract featuring The Reflection Elusive Target.

The pack includes:
• The MC Fit
• The Prank Pistol
• Jar of Mom's Spaghetti Sauce
• Mr. Chainsaw Jr.
• The Antithesis - A two-level Arcade contract featuring The Reflection Elusive Target

And a set of cosmetics for the Freelancer Safehouse inspired by the iconic Elusive Target mission.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: Where Winds Meet: The Imperial Palace
No Law
games.summary: Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

games.name: Saros
games.summary: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

games.name: Lords of the Fallen II
games.summary: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

games.name: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin
games.summary: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin is an open-world action RPG set in the universe of The Seven Deadly Sins. Step into the role of Prince Tristan of Liones and explore an open-world Britannia, as you embark on a journey to restore order to a world thrown into chaos by the collision of time and space.

games.name: Warframe: The Old Peace
games.summary: Those glory days, long since reduced to ashes, are now preserved in the purest of resins. This exhibit commemorates our glorious landing on Tau: that deep and wonderful coast, that grand orokin project, now obscured by the vile sabotage of its solar rail.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Marvel Rivals: Season 6 - Night at Museum
Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred
games.summary: Sanctuary reaches its breaking point. In Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred, Mephisto’s dark crusade threatens the heart of Sanctuary. Rise as new heroes, uncover the fate of old allies, and forge your legend in the next chapter of the critically acclaimed action-RPG.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
games.summary:
Deadly sharpshooter Sylux has finally caught up with renowned bounty hunter Samus Aran! After an unexpected accident in the wake of their clash, Samus finds herself transported to Viewros— a mysterious planet once inhabited by an ancient race. Now she must explore this planet, all while battling the strange creatures that inhabit it, to find her way home.

Scan your surroundings for clues, make the most of your equipment and weapons, and use Samus's newfound psychic abilities— and her technologically advanced bike, the Vi-O-La— to traverse and explore the environment. Operate mechanisms, control your charge beam, and more— you'll need every tool at your disposal to survive and escape Viewros!

games.name: Wuthering Waves: We Who See the Stars
games.summary:
Version 3.0 of Wuthering Waves is the game's second major post-release update, and it includes:
• New characters: Lynae and Mornye
• New region: Lahai-Roi, with several new areas
• New story quests
• New exploration systems
• New echoes, events and more!

games.name: Orbitals
games.summary:
Team up as Maki and Omura, two inseparable explorers with a whole lot more determination than experience. You’ll brave the perils of space in search of help for their crumbling station home, now trapped within a supernatural cosmic storm.

Orbitals captures the warmth and style of classic Japanese anime, brought to life with hand-crafted cinematic cutscenes from Studio Massket, full Japanese and English voice acting, and an original soundtrack that channels the magic of the era.

Built from the ground up for asymmetric 2-player co-op, either in local split-screen or online, Orbitals rewards smart teamwork and clear communication. Use each character’s unique tools to open the path forward, overcome danger, and meet out-of-this-world creatures and characters on a bombastic adventure.

games.name: Invincible Vs.
games.summary: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Rust Mobile
games.summary: Rust Mobile brings the core DNA of the Rust experience to mobile players: open-world survival, brutal PvP, base building, and sandbox gameplay.

games.name: Marvel Cosmic Invasion
games.summary: Marvel Cosmic Invasion is a side-scrolling beat 'em up featuring 15 playable Marvel heroes. Designed in the style of classic 1990s arcade brawlers, the game allows players to switch between two characters mid-battle using the Cosmic Swap mechanic. Each hero brings unique abilities and team-up attacks, with additional upgrades and rewards becoming available as players progress.

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Gang of Dragon
games.summary: A new action-adventure game from game creator Toshihiro Nagoshi, set in the streets of Shinjuku, Tokyo. Starring Ma Dong-seok as Shin Ji-seong, the story unfolds with heated and intense human drama across Shinjuku, including Kabukicho — one of Japan’s largest entertainment districts.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Screamer
games.summary: High-octane action and anime aesthetics collide in this arcade racing game, featuring fighting mechanics and a storyline that hits hard. In this world, some race for glory while others seek power or revenge. Every race is a fight and every battle is personal.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus is an epic new sci-fi action-adventure RPG franchise developed by the team at Archetype Entertainment. The story is fueled by the consequences of player choices due to the impact of Time Dilation and how they change the lives of those we love most.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: South of Midnight
games.summary: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Explore the mythos and confront mysterious creatures of the Deep South in this modern folktale while learning to weave an ancient power to surmount obstacles and face the pain haunting your hometown.

games.name: 2XKO
games.summary: 2XKO is a 2v2 fighting game featuring the iconic characters from Arcane and League of Legends.

games.name: Zenless Zone Zero: Update 2.5 - To Be Fuel for the Night
games.summary:
Version 2.5 of Zenless Zone Zero, which includes:
• New Characters: Ye Shunguang and Zhao
• New Main Story Quest
• New events
• New skins for Jane and Ye Shunguang
• ...and more!

games.name: Ontos
games.summary: A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

games.name: Coven of the Chicken Foot
games.summary: After the dungeons have been plundered and the monsters all killed, an elderly witch quietly gets to work. In this emotionally-rich, stylized, single-player adventure - Gert will need to build a bond with a peculiar creature if she’s to fulfill a coven’s oath.

games.name: 4:Loop
games.summary: Created by Mike Booth and the interactive storytellers at Bad Robot Games, 4:LOOP is a tactical, four-player co-op shooter crafted for endless replayability and infinite ways to build the ultimate team. Together, if you can learn from your mistakes, you might just fail to save the world.

games.name: John Carpenter's Toxic Commando
games.summary: Take control of one of the commandos, team up with your friends and send the Sludge God and its horde of things-that-should-never-be back to the underworld. Choose the class that matches your playstyle, pile into your favorite ride, and unload an array of gunfire, grenades, special abilities, and freaking katanas as you save the planet.

games.name: Soulframe
games.summary:
This free-to-play open world adventure heavily influenced by themes of nature, restoration, and exploration.

Soulframe will deliver its own independent and uniquely immersive experience led by the creative and imaginative minds behind Warframe.

games.name: Battlefield REDSEC
games.summary: Now entering REDSEC, a free-to-play destination built on Battlefield’s iconic DNA. Drop into Fort Lyndon for a Battle Royale only Battlefield can deliver, featuring massive-scale destruction, fast-paced squad play, and the deadliest ring in BR. Survive and advance in Gauntlet: an all-new cutthroat, knockout-style elimination mode where squads race to complete missions. Then redraw the lines of battle with Portal.

games.name: Star Wars: Fate of the Old Republic
Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

games.name: Bradley the Badger
games.summary: Bradley, the beloved platforming icon, finds himself lost in strange new lands... and decides to fight back! Shape unfinished worlds with your game developer powers, explore a genre-bending story, and save your home in this unique action-adventure. Wishlist now and join Bradleys journey!

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Solasta II
games.summary: In a Mana-infused land, a dark force led by the enigmatic Shadwyn threatens Neokos. Bring your party of adventurers together across perilous realms in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5e ruleset. You make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Escape from Duckov
games.summary: A single-player top-down looter-shooter game. Loot, escape, build, and eventually become a mighty bird soldier. Beware! If you are knocked down, items in your inventory will be lost! But don't worry. With your infrastructure built nicely, you will rise again soon.

games.name: Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity
games.summary:
Tyria’s leaders are anxious about rumors of covert Inquest voyages launched in search of the island of Castora, an island so remote that it’s long been thought to be inaccessible—or even nonexistent. The risks involved prevent all but the most tenacious (and perhaps foolhardy) of pursuers from investigating the Inquest’s plan. Your race to discover the Inquest’s plot will lead you across two new open world regions at launch, each filled with magical energies and strange creatures. Two additional maps will open as the story continues over the course of a year.

During your travels, you’ll unlock three new Mastery tracks, including one for your Skimmer mount that will unlock new and updated abilities. The new region also brings new adventures, collections, and thematic rewards. Players who own both Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity and Guild Wars 2: Janthir Wilds will be able to unlock a new Castoran Homestead map.

A new elite specialization for each profession will unlock new traits, profession mechanics, and healing, utility, and elite skills. Further augment your build by acquiring new relics themed to your adventures in Castora. And work towards six legendary rewards: three new legendary weapons, plus a ring, accessory, and aquabreather.

The magically infused landscape of Castora is home to all manner of strange, warped wildlife. Two of the three major updates coming in 2026 will pit players against the most powerful of the island’s denizens in Raid Encounters (including Challenge Modes and a Legendary Mode) and a new Convergence. Along with the first of the new Raid Encounters, new system updates will make raids easier to access. A Fractal with an accompanying Challenge Mode will also release with the last of the major expansion updates.

New emotes, armors, weapons, recipes, and other unique rewards await those who brave the dangers of Castora, and seasonal Wizard’s Vault refreshes throughout the expansion will bring additional options for unique aesthetic rewards.

To support the addition of a new Homestead map, we’re introducing two additional features. The first, the ability to freely swap between the Janthiri and Castoran maps, is helped by the second feature, Layouts. Layouts create a file you can use to save, load, share, and edit arrangements of decorations. We’ll share more about these and other features as we get nearer to the launch of Guild Wars 2: Visions of Eternity.

games.name: Audiomech: Your Music Transformed
games.summary: Your music paints the world, and controls the action. Each of the Mech’s three forms [Bass Knight, Vocal Gunship, and Treble Bomber] react to any audio, including streaming.

games.name: Decrepit
games.summary: Decrepit is a first-person action game with souls-like combat where every death drags you back into the depths. Learn the dungeon, master the combat, and find your way out of the forsaken castle.

games.name: The Free Shepherd
games.summary: Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Catalyst
games.summary: Set in the wake of a mythical cataclysm that has unleashed ancient secrets and awakened mysterious guardian forces, Tomb Raider: Catalyst follows Lara Croft on a new adventure across Northern India.

games.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
games.summary: Players control Kaatri, a veteran warrior who forms a pact with an otherworldly entity to wield dark magic against formidable foes. The game focuses on open-world exploration, visceral combat blending melee and spell-casting, and the thematic cost of power.

events.name: Premiação Sem Prêmios 2025
events.description: Much bigger, much better with exclusive trailers, free games, special guests, unimaginable surprises, and yet still no awards...

games.name: Arashi Gaiden
games.summary: Arashi Gaiden is a turn-based action game, with frantic combat, in the dash-and-slash style. Arashi is a Ronin from the Pocket Bravery universe, he was hired by his former master, Lobo, receiving the mission of defeating Ninjas and Matilha soldiers to recover 3 powerful relics from Japan.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: Machick 2
games.summary: The anti-magic toads are back, stronger than ever, and the magical chickens are unleashing ancient powers to fight them! With even more wands and powers to master, vanquish enemies, collect XP, and upgrade like never before in Machick 2! Get ready to out-magic the menace!

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: 85Top
games.summary: 85Top is an arcade racing game inspired by Crazy Taxi, with the fast pace of Need for Speed ​​and the heat of downtown Fortaleza! Pick up passengers, compete with other app drivers, earn money and get a 5-star rating — all this with passing through historic landmarks in the city.

games.name: Cordels & Spells
games.summary: Cordels & Spells is a thrilling cooperative twin-stick shooter action adventure based in the culture of cordel literature. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle gangs of bandits, and recover the Enchanted Cordels, magical artifacts that hold the history and essence of Northeast Brazil.

games.name: Drill Hero Legend
games.summary: 2D action-adventure platformer with a drill-head hero! Get ready to drill and blast everything in front of you in this challenging game made by fans of classic 90s platformers! Shoot, slide, enter tubes and be launched by cannons, drill everything in your path!

games.name: The Lightseeker
games.summary: The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Dig Out
games.summary: With a dark and minimalist aesthetic, the title blends action and elements of "puzzle combat," pitting the protagonist, an abstract representation of human emotion, against enemies that personify their own inner "demons."

games.name: Root
games.summary: In the deepest part of the forest lives a large tree, whose shade is so dense that even the most powerful light cannot dispel it.

games.name: Lendas da Amazônia
games.summary: Lendas da Amazônia is a game that depicts the enchanted creatures of the Brazilian Amazon. It's a 2.5D platform game in the style of Little Nightmares, carrying a bit of Pará culture in a brief story and 8 levels. To pass each level, you must find the muiraquitã. Compatible with XBOX controllers.

games.name: South Star River
games.summary:
Build a community and develop ecological agroforestry techniques in this cozy game set in the Amazon! Animals and local people are all part of an ecosystem where each has a role!

Join Lu as she returns from the big city, seeking a peaceful life in the place where she was born and raised!

games.name: Waldo: In the Heart of the City
games.summary: Join Waldo in a fast-paced 2D adventure! Fly across Mosquitópolis, battle enemies, and uncover the source of a mysterious virus in this fun and educational shoot ’em up.

games.name: Crisálida
games.summary: A short emotional journey through memory, grief, and healing. Help Íris piece together her fragmented memories and uncover hidden truths about herself and those she loves. Your choices shape the story — only by revisiting the past you will unlock new layers and reveal the true ending (and music).

games.name: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3: I Opened a Portal to Hell in the Favela Trying To Revive Mit Aia I Need to Close It
games.summary: Brazilian Drug Dealer 3 is a fast-paced ultraviolent Brazilian old-school FPS heavily inspired by the first Quake, using the same engine as the game (ID TECH2). made as a tribute to the Brazilian mods of the 2000s, the Brazilian bootleg games of the 2000s, Brazilian music, and the King of Brazilian music, Mit Aia!

games.name: Deathbound
games.summary: Deathbound is a one-of-a-kind party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. The forbidden city of Akratya is an unforgiving land that cannot be conquered alone. Bind with fallen warriors found throughout your crusade and dynamically transform between characters seamlessly in mid-combat with the unique 4-hero party system.

games.name: E-Lich: Corporate Souls
games.summary: There’s no R.I.P at E-Lich Corp! Explore the afterlife in this roguelite bullet heaven that is all about humor, insane power-levels, replayability and awful office jokes. Reap souls along your undead coworkers in a company that values your life. And death. Literally.

games.name: Brew & Dash
games.summary: Jump, duck, accelerate, and run to test your reflexes by dodging obstacles and enemies, collecting ingredients along the way to brew potions, gaining new powers, and going even further. Face challenges on randomly selected maps.

games.name: Meatballs Farm
games.summary: Meatballs Farm is a first-person surrealistic shooter and farming game where you have to plant living flesh-based organisms, when night falls, you must defend your farm from creatures that want to eat your plants.

games.name: Dear Poe
games.summary:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

games.name: Memoware
games.summary: Memoware! A small adventure, exploration and puzzle videogame.

games.name: V-Monsters Forgotten Link
games.summary:
V-Monsters Forgotten Link is a turn-based monster RPG with strategic 3v3 battles and evolutions that occur mid-combat, in a digital world on the brink of collapse.

Immerse yourself in Folklora, a system created to simulate a perfect life—until an experiment went wrong.

games.name: Firefighter Gaiden
games.summary: Firefighter Gaiden is a thrilling game set in a University that is being consumed by flames, where the fire gives life to the furniture. As a brave firefighter, your mission is to defeat the flaming objects with your powerful hose and sharp axe to save the university.

games.name: Au Revoir
games.summary: Use your investigative skills in this point-and-click adventure to retrieve human minds stored in synthetic brains in 2071. Immerse yourself in a retro-futuristic world with neon-noir graphics from the 90s, and uncover a conspiracy that will challenge everything you know.

games.name: Sweet Math
games.summary: Sweet Math is a puzzle game in which the player faces mathematical challenges stuffed with fun in a world made of candy. Controlling a gummy bear, the player will jump in candy blocks and avoid obstacles, traps, enemies as well as paths of no return while trying to complete equations. The game includes several levels based on addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and numerical sequence. As the player progresses, the difficulty of the puzzles and equations increases. Perfect for those who want to learn while having fun!

games.name: Enoah's Quest
games.summary: Enoah's Quest is a top-down adventure RPG, featuring captivating narrative, stunning three-dimensional visuals, and electrifying gameplay, providing a memorable adventure and action experience.

games.name: Limb.Inc
games.summary:
Limb.Inc is an investigative, narrative-focused game that addresses the theme of the afterlife with a bureaucratic twist. The main character is an employee of Limb.Inc whose job is to help souls trapped in purgatory make their passage to the afterlife.

You do this by reading descriptive files found in your drawer, containing personal data and a brief summary of what each spirit did in life. With this information, you must associate the corresponding item with the file so that the spirit can be released from its attachment to that earthly item that was part of its life.

games.name: Void's Rage
games.summary: Void's Rage is a fast-paced, ultra-responsive hack'n slash game inspired by arcade games. With each match, improve your combat reflexes, achieve the highest scores on the leaderboard, and defeat the evil creatures of the void once and for all.

games.name: Black Sailors
games.summary: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

games.name: Arida 2: Rise of the Brave
games.summary:
Arida 2: Rise of the Brave is the sequel to an adventure and exploration story in the Brazilian backlands.
Overcome a long trip on foot and discover the paths to the magical village of Canudos, the land where the dreams dwell.

games.name: A Cat in the Cangaço
games.summary: One way by day, another by night. Play with a cat that turns into a man at night and face a fantastic wilderness full of monsters and cordel literature. A roguelike, deckbuilder, and autobattle game.

games.name: Sigils of Nightfall
games.summary: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive at all costs — or be consumed by the horrors lurking in the darkness.

games.name: Tape Us Out
games.summary: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

games.name: Coralina: Illacrimo
games.summary: Lost in nostalgia, surrounded by ghosts, Coralina goes through the Elysian Fields to find a long lost alchemy artifact, all before the world ends. The girl that can enter memories travels through these Posthumous Lands once again, in her own Psychedelic Odissey.

games.name: Folia Felina
games.summary:
Gatosa is a distracted cat, raised in an apartment and easily lost on the street. When trouble arises, she always asks her best friend for help.

Her best friend, Miranja, is a more laid-back cat who likes to talk nonsense and was raised on the streets. She is fierce, there's no way around it!

This Carnival, the friends agreed to go to a street party together, but Miranja needs to send directions and routes via cell phone, since Gatosa has a long history of getting lost when she leaves home and, besides that, doesn't have a good internet plan.

games.name: Ruling Horsestown
games.summary: Be a horse mayor and survive your term (somehow)! Make ridiculous and wildly unexpected choices, and deal with chaotic new situations every run as you try to keep your government (and the city) from total disaster!

games.name: Val'ty
games.summary:
An retro first-person shooter about an "evil" alien mother and her daughter.
Inspired by Turok, MDK, Chasm: The Rift and ARG elements, Val'ty crosses the galaxy unlocking new powers, doing silly alien activities and asserting her dominance.
Nothing will stand between her and her kin.

games.name: Kundara: Art of Cards
games.summary: Kundara: Arts of Cards is a roguelite deck-building card game featuring strategic and dynamic battles inspired by the aesthetics of traditional Japanese Kabuki theater. By combining numbered cards with elemental suits, you create increasingly powerful combos to face your opponents. With every defeat comes a new lesson, as you explore an adventure filled with encounters with new enemies, spirits, and bosses.

games.name: [Afantasia]
games.summary: A boy bargained his memories for the ability to imagine. Now, his hometown of Tempo is a blur between reality and imagination. A voice called Intrusion guides him as he uncovers fragments of a past he traded away, before his identity fades completely.

games.name: Coralina
games.summary: An investigation through space and time in a retro RPG that blends different art styles.

games.name: Guará Guaraná
games.summary: An incremental tower defense game with farm mechanics, where you grow crops, defend your village, and make it prosper!

games.name: Starcatcher
games.summary: Wish upon the starry sky for the power to slay your enemies in this hack 'n' slash action roguelite.

games.name: Meatbound
games.summary: Two unlikely adventurers — a brute-force Dwarven Barbarian and an explosively creative Elf Artificer — must work together in co-op to survive a living dungeon made entirely of pulsating flesh. Grotesque creatures lurk around every corner, and the only way to make it out alive is by trusting your partner… and the Grumpy Merchant, of course. He’s got everything you need — weapons, gear, and even a way to bring fallen heroes back from the dead.

games.name: Fofumia
games.summary: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

games.name: Fallen Echoes
games.summary: Fallen Echoes is a hand-drawn 2D platform game in which Kael, a warrior frog, travels through ruins, forests, and frozen mountains in search of a hidden valley. With an introspective atmosphere, the game offers a challenging and emotional experience, guiding the player through a journey of overcoming adversity in a world fragmented by grief.

games.name: Mulheres na taverna
games.summary: An interactive game based on the book A Noite na Taverna by Álvares de Azevedo, where the main objective was to create a horror game in which most of the characters were women, either as villains or protagonists. Throughout the game, the player will encounter the stories of five characters, with the narrative being constructed based on the choices made by the player.

games.name: Kambulin
games.summary: Kambulin is a story focused game about love: be it about people, environments or even yourself. Enjoy your time meeting a lot of very different characters and explore a beautiful pixel-art world!

games.name: Gears Of Glory
games.summary:
Gears of Glory is a movement-based Tower Defense where you drive a van across the map to collect Gears, build powerful towers, and stop the robots from destroying your bases.

Developed for PC, Gears of Glory combines classic Tower Defense strategy with a unique twist: driving a stylish van through the chaos of a post-apocalyptic world.

Featuring a top-down pixel art look and fast-paced gameplay, the player takes on the role of a resistance pilot tasked with protecting the last human bases from hordes of robots that have taken over the planet and isolated humanity. To succeed, you’ll need skill behind the wheel, dodging obstacles or running enemies over. All while building towers with strategic synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.

Speed, strategy and survival collide in this game where every turn can mean the difference between extinction and the salvation of humanity.

The game’s inspiration comes from the desire to complement the Tower Defense genre and eliminate those idle moments where players would simply speed up the game after placing towers and wait. In Gears of Glory you are in constant motion driving the van to upgrade towers, collect Gears, and run enemies over.

The gameplay and art are influenced by titles such as Gemcraft, Kingdom Rush, Thronefall, Rock and Roll Racing, Biker Mice from Mars, GTA2.

games.name: Magical Blush
games.summary: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

games.name: Toada Brava
games.summary: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

games.name: The Last Haven
games.summary:
After getting himself into a bunch of messes, gambling, betrayals, bad choices, Tom decides to flee into the woods and start his life over from scratch. But he didn't expect nature to have a surprise in store for him: bringing back all his “nightmares”, people with whom he still has scores to settle.

Use your Master of Gambits skills to collect resources in Brazilian biomes and defend yourself from the shadows that want to drive you away.

games.name: Jampa Buggys
games.summary: Jampa Buggys is a fast-paced local multiplayer racing game set on the breathtaking beaches of Paraíba, Brazil. Race through thrilling tracks, face exciting challenges, and immerse yourself in the vibrant local culture! Perfect for friends and family, with simple controls and endless fun!

games.name: Aboxcalipse
games.summary: Aboxcalipse is a 3D top‑down cooperative game for up to 2 players where you play as a stock clerk in a zombie‑infested warehouse. Gather materials, assemble boxes and load them onto the truck, using them as weapons and traps to face clumsy zombies in each level.

games.name: Cosmic Maid Café
games.summary:
Welcome, dear customer, to Cosmic Maid Café! My name is Clara, and I will be accompanying you on this incredible journey, and... well... the truth is, I'm afraid I can't get more coffee by myself, so could you help me?

My boss is such a powerful cosmic being that his mere presence is enough to distort the space in the kitchen, and to avoid the risk of being thrown who knows where, my only movement is pressing space.
But fear not! As a high-tech artificial intelligence maid, I am equipped with the best central light in this galaxy, which recharges slightly as I perform my tasks! Just don't waste my time, because I'd rather not know what happens if that light goes out...

games.name: Malleus Maleficarum
games.summary: A Metroidvania inspired by the mechanics and style of classic games in the genre. Help Mirabel find different ways to explore a haunted mansion and hunt terrifying witches while gaining new weapons and discovering more about the macabre experiments carried out by demonic beings.

games.name: Maiden Cops
games.summary: Maiden Cops is a Beat'm Up full of classic, arcade-style action and ass kicking. Choose among the gorgeous Maiden Cops policewomen, tackle crime in Maiden City and enjoy premium-level pixel art and a breathtaking soundtrack.

games.name: Eco City Planner
games.summary: Eco City Planner is a card-based city-building and strategy game focusing on sustainability, urban planning, and resource management.

games.name: Quacolé Tennis
games.summary: Face the most unexpected opponents in completely crazy tennis matches. Win tournaments, overcome obstacles, and defeat giant monsters using the power of your racket! Embark on a solo adventure or invite a friend to explore the world of Quacolé Tennis in doubles matches.

games.name: Mind Defender
games.summary: A fast-paced, futuristic tower defense game in which Anderson, a hacker, is trapped inside a digitized mind. With the Codex collapsing, he must defend the mental core against waves of corrupted and buggy memories to restore his consciousness and return to the real world.

games.name: Project.Tasker
games.summary: In a world where physical death is no longer possible, artificial intelligence is created to free people from mental death. However, would it be right to do such a thing? Wouldn't erasing someone's memories to replace them be the same as erasing them?

games.name: Acre: Last Stand
games.summary: In a world consumed by a deadly virus, you are one of the last survivors. As night falls, waves of increasingly stronger and faster zombies close in. Your only goal: survive as long as possible. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons, and fortify your defenses — each round is tougher than the last. There’s no happy ending, only one question: how long can you last before you’re torn apart?

games.name: UnoDos
games.summary: Take control of Uno and Dos using just one controller to solve puzzles with minimalist graphics. The characters have unique abilities: one can jump, while the other can dash forward. The characters must use these abilities to solve the stages and progress through the levels.

games.name: Fire Combat
games.summary:
The Earth is under threat from a massive heatwave. The city of Spark is overwhelmed by outbreaks of fire, but a team of heroes will rise to fight the flames and rescue the victims. Immerse yourself in this action-packed and strategic adventure: extinguish the fires, save the items, survive, and become a legendary firefighter in Fire Combat!

A platform action game where you control firefighters who shoot water jets to extinguish flames scattered across the levels. You must jump on platforms, avoid traps and pitfalls, and rescue victims along with their precious items, taking them to a safe zone. But be very careful—if you don't complete the rescue in time, the flames will consume everything.

games.name: Myths & Rites
games.summary:
Take on the role of a legendary guardian and face mythical creatures in strategic turn-based battles. Build your deck, combine attack, defense, and ritual skill cards to purify the corrupted forces and restore balance between man and nature.

Each card is a fragment of ancient power.
Each battle, a rite of redemption.

games.name: Hemp Paradise
games.summary: Raise the hemp resort of your dreams in this unique city building and weed-growing game! In "Hemp Paradise," experience the thrill of farming simulator dynamics as you cultivate various marijuana strains. Explore and revel the beauty of paradisiac beaches, construct dope buildings to boost your farm and business. Join a cast of misfits characters in this exciting weed farming game, seeking their share of green happiness in your weed plant based game.

games.name: Sery: Into the World of Myths
games.summary: Dive into the mythical dream world of Sery for an epic adventure. In this precision 2D platformer, Sery must restore balance between the real world and the dream world, battling malevolent figures that invade her dreams.

games.name: CatAway
games.summary: CatAway is a 2D endless runner where, after suffering a shipwreck, the player controls a raft and goes looking for dry land. While navigating, he has to dodge various obstacles and aquatic creatures, collect coins and power-ups.

games.name: Eleanor
games.summary: A game telling the story of the brave warrior Eleanor.

games.name: Sphirit
games.summary: Tactical RPG with grid-based battles where masters summon mystical creatures, use skill cards, and control the battlefield in strategic duels.

games.name: UniDuni
games.summary: Inspired by the classics, UniDuni is a lighthearted puzzle platformer adventure which celebrates the bonds of friendship. Invite a friend to work together across hand-crafted levels or challenge yourself and prove your skills!

games.name: Marionetes
games.summary:
Marionetes is a narrative-driven 3D platform adventure game about a discarded marionette.

Painful and sad performances of a brilliant marionette. Trown in the furnace by her creator the poor ballerina has to learn how to live without the strings.

games.name: Cage: Along With Us
games.summary: Cage: Alone With You is a psychological horror game with an isometric view and retro pixel art style that combines strategic exploration, escape, and constant tension.

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: The Sintonia Chronicles
games.summary: Join Maria on an unforgettable journey through the world of Sintonia to rescue her beloved pups. Forge unlikely alliances, face epic bosses, and outsmart every challenge in a universe brimming with magic and adventure.

games.name: Infinitevania
games.summary: Explore different worlds, defeat enemies and challenging bosses, in search of power to destroy the core of infinitevania.

games.name: Goldilock One: The Mists of Jakaira
games.summary: Action RPG with survival elements. Manage resources and bond with NPCs to unlock crafting and gain allies who may become playable. Use them to solve puzzles and battle together. Survive the frozen wilds and uncover the truth behind your exile.

events.name: The Horror Game Awards 2025
events.description: The Horror Game Awards is back for its fourth year running, and this year will mark its first live, in-person awards ceremony! Thanks to the partnership with Lost in Cult, the Kensington Conference and Events Centre in London will play host to an evening in celebration of the best, darkest, and most macabre in the past year of horror gaming.

games.name: Touko in Underland
games.summary:
Touko In Underland is an exploratory horror game with a focus on beautiful and atmospheric environments.

Break the loop in a seemingly endless labyrinth that has trapped Touko with her unhinged stalker.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Pulsebreaker
games.summary: Pulsebreaker is a classic survival horror game. Explore environments, collect resources, and fight zombies. Manage your inventory, solve light puzzles, and survive with limited supplies. Includes melee and ranged combat. Single-player only.

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: The Florist
games.summary: A classic survival horror experience, set in a town overgrown with deadly yet beautiful flowers.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: The Boba Teashop
games.summary: A cozy horror game where you own and manage a boba tea shop. Prepare boba teas, serve customers, and expand your menu to grow your business.

games.name: Conscript
games.summary: During the First World War, a lone French soldier must navigate twisted trenches, scavenge for limited supplies and solve complex puzzles - all whilst fighting for survival in the midst of mankind’s most brutal and horrifying conflict. CONSCRIPT is a new take on classic survival horror.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: DreadOut 3
games.summary: DreadOut 3 is a third-person horror adventure inspired by Asian - Indonesian urban legend. Follow Linda’s journey as Keepers of the Dark into an interdimensional rabbit hole to find the source of unseen power threatening the balance of light and darkness.

games.name: The Bagman
games.summary: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

games.name: Blood Mall: Part II
games.summary: Blood Mall: Part II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where Blood Mall left off. Are you prepared to put an end to the Hastovenator Crisis, or have you bitten off more than you can chew?

games.name: The 9th Charnel
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game, The 9th Charnel is filled with a rich and frightening atmosphere. While exploring the many mysteries of this world, you must survive- whether you do it through stealth or by using weapons.

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

games.name: A.I.L.A
games.summary: A.I.L.A. is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

games.name: Hell of Fear: Mind Breach
games.summary: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: BrokenLore: Ascend
games.summary: BrokenLore: Ascend is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.name: BrokenLore: Unfollow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Unfollow is a surreal horror game where you play as a victim of bullying, fighting terrifying monsters as you uncover a dark mystery in a thrilling journey of terror. It pushes you to the edge of your seat as you explore the dark impact of social media on mental health.

games.name: Graft
games.summary: GRAFT splices together tense survival horror with a dark RPG experience in a thrilling new adventure from the developers of BATTLETECH and the Shadowrun Trilogy. Explore a dying world haunted by darkly fascinating characters and nightmarish monsters as you delve into the mysteries of the Arc. Tear pieces from your enemies to transform yourself into something new—something capable of surviving the horrors that prowl around you. Every Graft brings with it some piece of its previous owner’s identity, changing more than just your physical body.

games.name: Mourning Tide
games.summary: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

games.name: Horripilant
games.summary: Horripilant is a chilling incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld. Combining idler, puzzle and autobattler elements, you'll fight, mine, and think your way through the depths of a forsaken dungeon.

games.name: Becrowned
games.summary: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
games.summary: A 2D side-scrolling platformer with cute and dreamlike aesthetics. The ever growing colossal tree known as "the witch's hand" is growing out of control. Froggo sets foot on a journey to investigate the tree in hopes of finding a solution to save his home.

games.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
games.summary: Become a water balloon champion in Don Pepe y sus globos, a projectile based arena fighter for up to 4 players!

games.name: Drift Boom Boom
games.summary: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

games.name: Stunted Gravity
games.summary: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

games.name: That Damn Fox
games.summary: That Damn Fox is a Quake engine based third person platformer with some high-octane gunplay action! Join Cam the Fox on her adventure to save her city from the evil Dr. Henney Penny and his plan to 'Taxerminate' the world with his reanimated-cybernetic animal army!

games.name: Alpine Lake
games.summary: Kick back in the fresh mountain air and craft your ideal haven on the shores of Alpine Lake! Build, and decorate your inn to bring joy and prosperity to the community. Welcome guests to your cozy escape in the woods. Farm, cook, and entertain them in your own unique way!

games.name: Alliance Peacefighter
games.summary: A linear, story-driven space sim in the style of 90s classics like X-Wing and Wing Commander. As a newly qualified Alliance pilot, you find yourself caught up in a plot to break the fragile peace between two galactic super powers.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: LumenTale: Memories of Trey
games.summary: LumenTale: Memories of Trey is a Monster Collector RPG set in the wonderful land of Talea. Trey, who has mysteriously lost his memories, decides to set on a journey after a particular event. His only guiding light will be a mysterious desire... but will that be true?

games.name: Skinwalker: First Blood
games.summary: Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Flooded Burials
games.summary: Flooded Burials is a top-down action adventure game about exploring a tower buried in the sea. Play trough stages where you have to face combat and platforming challenges, as well as meet and talk to strange creatures.

games.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
games.summary: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

games.name: Sparrow Warfare
games.summary: Lead a feathered rebellion in the bird-filled deckbuilder SPARROW WARFARE! Combine your tiles to free birds. Unlock wildtiles to craft riotous combos. Take down the fiendish Storyteller for the liberation of all!

games.name: Scraps of the Machine
games.summary: FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay. Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

games.name: Starless Umbra
games.summary: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

games.name: Death By Misstep
games.summary: Death By Misstep is an upcoming First-Person Rhythm, Stealth and Horror game set on a party cruise where a massive massacre by robots is happening.

games.name: Morbid Mailroom
games.summary: In a claymation prison for occult offenders, you are the package inspector. Search packages for hidden contraband, coded letters, and cursed objects. Balance duty, compassion, and survival as you decide what reaches the inmates and what burns in the incinerator. Your choices cannot be undone.

games.name: Ratocalypse
games.summary: A classic "Boomer Shooter" trying to capture that feeling of pure, fast-paced retro action

games.name: Hypno Halo
games.summary: Hypno Halo is a minimalist score attack game.

games.name: Shooty Seas
games.summary: Shooty Seas is an open world Pirate Exploration game where you take on the role of a pirate and plunder the seas picking fights and looking for treasure.

games.name: #Drive Rally
games.summary: Drive Rally lets you relive the 90s in the most exciting era in motorsport history, where dust, mud, and snow are badges of honor. Unleash the raw power of legendary rally beasts, admire every second of the stunning landscapes, and remember: the faster you go, the better!

games.name: Torso Tennis
games.summary: A sports-like roguelike. DRAFT & GRAFT cursed limbs. Get horrible tattoos. Become a Tennis God.

games.name: Scopecreep
games.summary: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Everdream Village
games.summary:
Set sail and explore a collection of enchanted islands, each with their own ecosystems, treasures, and resources to help you grow and expand your village. Whether you're gathering rare flora, collecting new creatures or discovering secrets, there's always a journey to enjoy too!

Your village isn’t just the buildings you construct, it’s a thriving community that reacts to your choices. Befriend NPCs, manage their moods, and even possibly find romance. The village you build and maintain affects how everyone feels and behaves from a variety of factors. Add decorations, care for your animals, remove pests, and so much more to make this a happy place to be.

Interact with a massive variety of wild and domestic animals that each bring something different to the ecosystem. Breed and cross-breed animals to create unique variations of inherited traits, with hundreds of possible variations and combinations. And when the islands' magic takes hold, transform into different animals to see the world through their eyes and maybe even cause a little mischief along the way.

Turn your little village into a thriving farm! Grow crops, care for animals, and build relationships with your fellow villagers. Each has their own routines, personality, and needs. The more they like you, the more they’ll help around the place - harvesting crops, chopping wood, and even feeding your animals.

Shape the world to match your vision! Raise hills, carve out rivers, or dig deep underground to uncover hidden secrets, lost treasures, and rare resources.

Beyond farming and building, Everdream Village is packed with activities! Cook delicious meals, fish in scenic waters, collect rare creatures, or help villagers with unique quests. Every day offers something to make your time here feel like a never-ending adventure.

games.name: I Hate this Place
games.summary: A craft-based, isometric survival horror game with twisted monsters and warped reality. Scavenge and build to survive terrifying days and nights while using stealth and noise to fight enemies that stalk by sound. All styled with bold comic art and an '80s horror vibe.

games.name: Megabat
games.summary: While in search of food, a fruit bat stumbles its way through the ventilation system of a secret facility finding unique fruit that give special abilities. While in search of more fruit the bat must avoid traps and enemies. Will the bat be able to satiate it's hunger and escape with its life?

games.name: Forever Skies
games.summary: Forever Skies is a first-person action survival game. Return to Earth destroyed by an ecological disaster, fly a high-tech airship, expand, rebuild and repair it. Scavenge resources to survive, face the dangers of the surface as you will hunt for viral pathogens to cure a mysterious illness.

games.name: Leafy Corner
games.summary: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

games.name: Deadbeat
games.summary: Make your voice heard in this isometric Action-RPG where quick thinking and patience guide the way to victory. In a hazy Hereafter that's not heaven or hell, fight bizarre demons, call your friends, and explore the deepest reaches of death.

games.name: Witchy Tower
games.summary: A witchy arcade platformer about climbing an infinite tower and avoiding the consequences of your actions.

games.name: Heradonia
games.summary: Despair seizes a mother's heart when she finds her daughter gone.

games.name: Super Shapeshooter
games.summary: SUPER SHAPESHOOTER is a fast-paced, top-down, stylized action game. Take on relentless waves of enemy shapes as you fight for survival. Save up your credits, make risky choices, and construct the perfect build to make your way through to the end and defeat the final boss.

games.name: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
games.summary: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

games.name: Dice 'n Goblins
games.summary: Explore a mysterious dungeon in this dungeon-crawler RPG. Fight with dice in turn based combat. Use your skills to make combos and beat bad luck. Loot, buy and upgrade your equipment to build a dice pool able to fend your foes, monsters and humans alike!

games.name: Game Settings
games.summary:
A journalist receives a mysterious package. A console. And a game. No combat, no score, no objectives, only movement, and a menu full of cryptic settings you’re meant to adjust.
What are you really configuring? The more the mystery unfolds the more you wonder who’s really in control.

games.name: Raccoons to Riches
games.summary:
Strike it rich in this non-combat Roguelike Deckbuilder. Run an item shop as a raccoon shopkeeper. Sell items, manage your time, and customize your shop to stay in business for a whole month!

Raccoons to Riches is a small solo-developed Roguelike Deck Builder about managing an item shop as a little raccoon trying to stay in business! Your goal is to keep up with weekly payments on your shop for a whole month while you make as much gold as possible. Supply townsfolk and adventurers alike as you customize your shop and manage your time for maximum profit!

games.name: Champion of Lore
games.summary: The Guardians have failed. Myths crumble into chaos. Become the Champion of Lore the world needs. Battle through corrupted myths and lost worlds in this turn-based, card-driven tactical adventure forged on hexes and ancient lore.

games.name: Fist of the Forgotten
games.summary: Jump, punch, and slide through the remnants of civilizations using forgotten artifacts to augment your movement and combat abilities on a journey to find the last human holdouts where your brother might be.

games.name: Resurrection Gate
games.summary: Resurrection Gate is an interactive novella about loss, liches, and what lingers at the edge of existence.

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit
games.summary: Retro Arcade-style Rally Racing in repurposed Parking Garages in big cities across North America with tight arcade racing controls. A hybrid of Rally and circuit racing, from rally it draws the jumps and “one racer at a time against the clock” time-trial format. However, the tracks are similar to circuit racing, with each race consisting of multiple laps around the same track.

games.name: Why Did The Chicken Cross The Road?
games.summary: A pixel-art shooter roguelike with almost infinity of options to upgrade your weapons. Will you be able to fly the coop and find the answers that your people have been searching for years?

games.name: Find This Pixel Anomaly
games.summary:
In Find This Pixel Anomaly your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors.

Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game.

games.name: Zombies & Bullets
games.summary: Zombies & Bullets is a 3D top-down action shooter game where you must help the soldier Jacob face armies of zombies in varied scenarios full of challenges. Prove your skills and reflexes and become the warrior of the zombie apocalypse!

games.name: BioMenace Remastered
games.summary: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay. Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!

games.name: Berserker's Domain
games.summary: BERSERKER'S DOMAIN is a fast-paced, unhinged retro FPS freakshow with a roguelike loop, inspired by classics like Blood, Quake 1-3, and Doom, as well as modern shooters like Dusk, ULTRAKILL, and Doom Eternal.

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Val'ty
games.summary:
An retro first-person shooter about an "evil" alien mother and her daughter.
Inspired by Turok, MDK, Chasm: The Rift and ARG elements, Val'ty crosses the galaxy unlocking new powers, doing silly alien activities and asserting her dominance.
Nothing will stand between her and her kin.

games.name: Dragon Dinner
games.summary: Cute but chaotic restaurant simulator where you play as a dragon waiter in a fast-paced dining rush. Set tables, serve hungry dragons, deliver the right dishes, and keep the place clean! After each day, customize the layout of the restaurant and learn new abilities to improve.

games.name: Balla Machina
games.summary: A Pinball rogue-lite deckbuilder

games.name: Kauna
games.summary: KAUNA is a Finnish boomer shooter made with 90's retro style graphics.

games.name: Iron Village
games.summary: With the help of your railway, build houses, farms, warehouses, and more to create your village. Trade what your people make for other resources and gold to grow your village into a prospering town, and grow the railway into a powerhouse.

games.name: Anima Gate of Memories: I & II Remaster
games.summary: A third-person action RPG that brings to life the world of Gaia from the Anima: Beyond Fantasy RPG table-top books. Explore a deep and multifaceted story where your choices and actions directly impact the journey and decide the fate of the characters.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Neon Rain
games.summary: Neon Rain is a hybrid between a Metroidvania and a Boomershooter.

games.name: Midnight Billiards
games.summary: Midnight Billiards is a turn-based roguelite game inspired by Peglin and billiards. Choose from a variety of characters and collect items to build your unique strategy. Aim carefully and make the perfect shot to defeat your opponents!

games.name: SurfsUp
games.summary: SurfsUp is a high-speed, acrobatic platformer where you master surfing mechanics to glide through unique environments. Navigate ramps and obstacles with precision working towards achieving your personal best clear time. Can you claim a world record?!

games.name: Goldstained
games.summary: Explore a dangerous, fantastical world and slay the divine being that corrupted it. Goldstained is a top-down 2D action-adventure where unlocking new weapons with new movesets is your way forward through boss fights, puzzles, and combat!

games.name: Zombies Hate to Die
games.summary: A roguelite wasteland escape. Experience the satisfying knockback of physics-based combat, manage your scarce resources, and wield an array of absurd items found along the way. Every run is a unique journey through a darkly humorous apocalypse.

games.name: Touhou: The Unreachable Oneiroborder
games.summary: “The Unreachable Oneiroborder” is a beginner-friendly Touhou-styled Bullet Hell shmup. Indulge in a uniquely Touhou experience with intricate patterns and stylish effects.

games.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life
games.summary: Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.

games.name: Bryce Tiles
games.summary: A Manhattan/taxicab-geometric tile-based isometric puzzle strategy game featuring everyone's favorite 90's anti-hero, Bryce! You'll push boxes across tiles, sands, still waters, rapids, moving floors, ice and coals to move into position! Don't forget to redirect the lasers and evade those enemies!

games.name: Kook
games.summary: In this fast-paced, retro FPS game with a Quake-like feel, players will battle Lovecraftian monsters in a Victorian-era steampunk world using crazy weapons and navigating mind-bending gravity.

games.name: Anticitizen: Red
games.summary: Use bullet time, a variety of movement mechanics and an improvised arsenal to outwit and outgun biker gangs and corporate police in an American-occupied cyberpunk Australia. Meet a unique cast of Aussie battlers, delve into the lore of the new American empire, and stay for the larrikin charm.

games.name: Echoes of the Cove
games.summary: Uncover your father's fate in a 2D story-rich action adventure RPG set in a forgotten coastal town. Follow his diary, explore the Cove, battle strange creatures and rebuild a community on the edge of the sea.

games.name: Keaton's Adventure
games.summary: Traverse the newly formed Milkdromeda Galaxy to restore balance and stomp out the Ultralite invasion!

games.name: Eyes of the Sky
games.summary: A stylish Hack-and-Slash! Combine sword techniques and powerful spells as you switch between forms, each with a unique set of moves. Traverse the inner world of Toshiro, the master mage, as he struggles to regain his lost memories before the forces of the Abyss claim his world

games.name: Abyss Veil
games.summary: Abyss Veil is a narrative FPS where you play as Ivy and Mel. One seeks her brother, the other revenge. Meet strange folks, fight like hell, unravel strange mysteries, and most importantly, enjoy your stay!

games.name: Sugar Overdrive
games.summary: Slash and combo your way through hordes of sugar monsters in this first person melee game set in a candy city! Inspired by fast-paced FPS and Character Action games, swap weapons on the fly to extend your combos and heal from those combos. in Sugar OVERDRIVE, you combo or you DIE.

games.name: Foldy's OS Quest
games.summary: Foldy’s OS Quest invites players into a colorful computerized world for an action-packed 3D platforming adventure like no other! Run, jump, zip, surf and stomp your way through the magical world of personal computing, and take down the virus before it can break through the Firewall!

games.name: Null State
games.summary:
Null State is a moddable CRPG built on classic gameplay styles and themes found in cyberpunk games from the late 80s and early 90s.

Inspired by classic cyberpunk stories (& other, older tales of downtrodden folk heroes), you will be tasked with helping the people in your community until you discover that your world is barely holding together — and about to be pushed over the brink.

games.name: Another Round
games.summary:
