Another Round is a deckbuilder / slots-style game. Your goal is to stay in business and make your cyberpunk cafe into a social hub which everyone in the community enjoys.

There is no timer or countdown clock putting pressure on you to make decisions quickly; you will not need to do a lot of math or rely on perfect play to have a good time.

games.name: One Last Job
games.summary: One Last Job is a moddable team management game, where you work to build your reputation as a fixer by successfully completing jobs with your crew.

games.name: Saint of Chains
games.summary:
Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.

Retro Horror - Reborn: A love letter to Silent Hill 3, Lost in Vivo, Condemned: Criminal Origins, and Cry of Fear.

Built in the haunting visual style of the PS2 / Xbox360 era — when every shadow felt alive, and every step sounded like a confession.

games.name: Mr. Sleepy Man
games.summary: In Mr. Sleepy Man, you play as a sleepy guy who's up way past his bedtime and out of control! Make a mess of everything you find and turn Bedtime Town against you! This sandbox adventure is filled with comical hijinks, outrageous characters, and platforming action!

games.name: Penguin Festival
games.summary: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

games.name: Delve
games.summary: Delve is a multiplayer puzzle-platformer where players control adorable creatures as they dig through underground caverns in search of treasure.

games.name: Ephemeral Frame
games.summary: Step inside picture frames, films, and other imagery that connect a variety of dreamscapes in this surreal first-person exploration game.

games.name: Prophecy
games.summary: A cozy, narrative-driven, first person horror based on the true events of the Mothman back in the 1960's.

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
games.summary: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Binary Golf
games.summary: Mini-golf with a chaotic twist! Chain abilities, curve shots, and eliminate targets until the last one becomes the cup. Customize your ball, master wild power-ups, and compete in the madness of Battle Mode or uncover the secrets of Story Mode and fight bosses!

games.name: Zooika
games.summary: Zooika is a casual puzzle game where you match animals in order to create a larger animal. It's a Suika style game with animals, leaderboards, challenges and achievements.

games.name: Rogue Blight
games.summary: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

games.name: Twisted Grove
games.summary: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

games.name: Crave
games.summary: Ceaseless hunger draws you yet a bit closer to the gates of Foghorn. Devour men and beasts alike to acquire a wide array of combat abilities. Through shadows and mold, track down the paling memories of this bygone kingdom, all in a classic hand-drawn action platformer.

games.name: Pirate Survivors
games.summary: Pirate Survivors is a fast-paced Roguelite where you battle endless waves of sea monsters, unlock powerful upgrades, and take on deadly Sea Legends. Choose your ship, conquer countless enemies, and face escalating challenges in this high-stakes Bullet Heaven adventure!

games.name: Hypogea
games.summary: Escape from a mysterious underground megastructure in this short atmospheric 3d-platformer.

games.name: Dungeon Bodega Simulator
games.summary: Dungeon Bodega Simulator is a retro styled fantasy shop game where you can grow crops, brew potions, sell items and raise slimes as pets! Can you build up your bodega into a one stop adventuring shop while solving the mysteries of the dungeon beneath you?

games.name: Biathlon Challenge
games.summary: Master precision shooting while performing stunts to boost your score and beat the clock. Customize your loadout for speed, control, or style. Explore the courses to uncover secrets, gear, and meet the locals.

games.name: Corpse Carnival
games.summary: A top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

games.name: The Knightling
games.summary: The Knightling is a platforming action adventure where you play as an aspiring knight in search of their missing mentor, Sir Lionstone. Equipped with only a legendary shield, you’ll brave your way through the lands of Clesseia to become the unlikely hero.

games.name: Torment Hexus
games.summary: Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place.

games.name: Kinetic
games.summary: A first-person platform game with smooth and responsive movements designed for speedrunning. In Kinetic you will jump, surf and bounce through 50 levels, switch dimensions with portals and challenge yourself on the online leaderboards!

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.summary: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

games.name: Kyubu Kyubu Dice
games.summary: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an Action Puzzle Game that challenges you to think about dice in different spatially oriented ways! By rolling the magical "Kyubu" the player must clear the panels that appear on the stage in this new, exciting and fast-paced puzzle experience!

games.name: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
games.summary: Welcome to Occult Office, a cozy and mysterious productivity game! Decorate your workspace, conquer to-do lists, and explore dungeons on your coffee breaks. Master daily rituals, collect strange pets, and climb the corporate ladder - all in cozy pixel art with a Lovecraftian twist.

games.name: Five Biggest Accomplishments
games.summary: Five Biggest Accomplishments is a short Visual Novel where you play as someone who has held the same job for 30 years: push a button every 8 hours or the world will end. Suddenly, you get an email asking you to list your five biggest accomplishments for the week, or risk being fired.

games.name: Alice's Current Draft
games.summary: Fly around and explore floating islands, interact with townsfolk and cryptids, and discover secrets.

games.name: Crude Survivor TD
games.summary: Shoot, build, upgrade and defend, in this gruesome shooter meets tower defense. Carefully balance between economy and upgrading your weapon or towers. How many waves can you survive?

games.name: Love is a Demon
games.summary: Love is a Demon is an adventure game packed with romance, chaos, and supernatural surprises. Confess your crush, dodge demons, and embrace the mess; love has never been this complicated. Your choices shape Ash’s love life in this heartfelt, hilarious story-driven experience.

games.name: Beandejo
games.summary: BEANDEJO is an action-packed spin-gun roguelite. Enter the Old West, where the cattle roam, and drunken vegetables terrorize the local saloons. Spin your gun, time your draws, and gun them down to become the toughest sheriff in town!

games.name: SwitchTrack
games.summary: SwitchTrack is a coordination puzzle game about switches, levers and minecarts. Time your inputs correctly to guide as many minecarts through each level as possible.

games.name: Pandamonium Puzzle
games.summary: Collect sets of gems, coins, and pandas.

games.name: D.A.D.S.
games.summary: Use your special ops units to construct base facilities and towers to protect them from the ever-increasing threat of alien invaders in this Tower Defense game with a city-building element! Research their weaknesses and develop defenses before mankind runs out of time.

games.name: Project Timbre
games.summary: Control the squishy hero, Timbre, as you jump, dash, and dive onto enemies and gather power gems in this bite-sized 3D platformer!

games.name: Kristala
games.summary:
Kristala is a dark fantasy ARPG featuring Sekiro-inspired combat, acrobatic parkour, and exploration to uncover a detailed story. Embark on a journey to join ranks with Ailur’s most elite warriors as you battle to master the ancient magic of the Sacred Six and uncover the source of a dark curse.

Play as a catlike warrior from one of six clans, each with its own unique magic specialty. Choose your own style of combat: avoid damage by blocking, dashing/rolling, and deflecting attacks; combo light and heavy attacks; utilize multiple weapon abilities; and cast numerous spells.

Your catlike character will be fully customizable via various Talent Trees, including an innovative Feline Skill tree that allows you to unlock and level a multitude of feline-related skills.

games.name: Texnoplazm
games.summary: Gun fu action centered on three intertwined movesets for punches, ranged weapons and firearms. Fight your enemies through the gothic metropolis while using their weapons against them, in the most acrobatic way possible.

games.name: Shrouded Suns
games.summary: In the midst of a seemingly hopeless war among the stars, take control of highly customizable spacefighters to experience classic space combat action throughout a story-driven campaign.

games.name: Bone Fire Effigy
games.summary: The horror of relationships passed. Collect old discarded things from the woods and burn them. Avoid the Effigy's fiery embrace.

games.name: Huntsman
games.summary: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

games.name: Tactus
games.summary: A rhythm-based dungeon crawler with authentic retro charm. Explore mysterious ruins, find powerful weapons, and slay to the beat. Designed and built for the original NES, playable on Steam with modern enhancements.

games.name: Fluffy Memories
games.summary: Fluffy Memories is a cozy tile-matching memory game featuring a variety of cute and kinky furry characters who'd love to show off for you when you win a match!

games.name: Dungeon Pizza
games.summary: A cooking game with a fantasy twist! Knead the dough, spread the sauce, and prepare… the rat chunks?! Open your own pizzeria deep inside a dungeon, serving weary adventurers who come to rest and refuel between their quests and bounties.

games.name: Idosra: The Electric Renaissance
games.summary: Explore the distant future in Idosra, an action-adventure RPG set in a world on the verge of rediscovering electricity. Follow Marika's quest to uncover the motives of the Vallas Empire. Learn dozens of new skills, meet a wide cast of characters, and discover the secrets of the lost city Idosra.

games.name: Nemiza's Verdict
games.summary: Nemiza's Verdict is a cooperative roguelite dungeon crawler where your soul takes over various monstrosities. Hunt down Nemiza and challenge their verdict in the twisted labyrinth of Lovence by evolving your monstrous abilities and remember skills from your past life.

games.name: Thirsty Princess
games.summary: Thirsty Princess is a fast-paced, top-down party game for 2–4 local players where you and your friends compete to drink beer with an impatient and unreasonable princess. Get drunk and slowly lose control while you brawl, steal from and sabotage your friends to win the favour of your princess.

games.name: Anxiety Arcade
games.summary: Anxiety Arcade is a short, surreal narrative game about living with anxiety — and how it feels when your own thoughts turn into puzzles.

games.name: Compress(Space)
games.summary: A mind and space-bending puzzle game where you fold space to cheat your way through puzzles. Master space manipulation and reach beyond the stars to uncover the mystery at the end of the universe.

games.name: UvsU: You vs. You
games.summary: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

games.name: Cosmic Run
games.summary: Cosmic Run is a single player space roguelite game. Take on hordes of galactial enemies, build your ship strategically to overcome the hurdles, improve your stats to stand longer and flee the Zogark family from the galaxy. Fight, Build, Survive, Escape!

games.name: Deep Fog Signals
games.summary: Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

games.name: Wirelight
games.summary: A tiny turn-based tactical... soulslike! Explore a twisty, interconnected world, battle enemies using a unique spin on a 'posture' system, and employ different combinations of upgrades to your advantage.

games.name: May and the Amazing Bouquet
games.summary: Help May to obtain the Eight Prized Flowers in this cozy pixelated top-down action adventure! Explore her island home, meet new people, avoid shadowy creatures, solve puzzles, and collect whatever useful objects you can find!

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Crownbreakers
games.summary: Insatiable, hyper-charged capitalism has the magical city in a chokehold. Crash into the tyrants' districts and build your deck as you push forward. Use your heroes and your cards to fight back against criminal syndicates and demonic billionaires in this turn-based card-game brawler.

games.name: Cannon Keep
games.summary: Build your city block by block and defeat waves of mechs in this tower defense roguelike! Combine powerful cannons with unique effects to survive the unforgiving wasteland and explore the underground to gather resources and find powerful relics.

games.name: Knight George
games.summary: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.summary: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity to satisfy the gods. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a thinky city-building puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

games.name: Boeckham's Football Manager
games.summary: An old-school football manager in the style of the management games of the 90s. Lead your team through the seasons, shaped by dynamic story events. Develop your club and yourself to gain reputation and conquer your league and the world.

games.name: Fading Skies
games.summary: Explore a vivid fantasy world full of mystery, memorable characters, and heartfelt narrative. Unlock the powerful abilities of Ryn and her dragon companion, as you join her quest to stop the planet’s collapse. Only by confronting the shadows of her forgotten past can the future be saved.

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: The Greenening
games.summary: The Greenening is a short and wholesome incremental journey about exploring and reawakening a forgotten world. Wash away the ashes to discover the secrets hidden beneath, upgrade your versatile watering abilities, and grow your own cozy space garden.

games.name: Tabula
games.summary: A mind-bending, level-based puzzler about overlapping computer windows to create traversable, top-down landscapes. Delve into the heart of an unusual operating system, one folder at a time!

games.name: Nine Rounds Rapid
games.summary: A fast paced, super stylized, roguelike, twin stick shooter. Nine levels of designed, hand painted and procedurally generated, punchy and punky fast mayhem in a uniquely stunning attitude filled world.

games.name: Tow Game
games.summary: Your beloved old car has broken down and needs to be towed! Hooked and hauled - time for the garage! But will you get there in one piece? The tow truck is in a hurry!

games.name: Bear Brigade: Ocean Attack!
games.summary: A twist on the tower-defense genre, play as a bear tribe chief defending their home against the forces of the ocean as they attack you in anger and retaliation due to overfishing. Place towers, command minions, and defend the camp from the enemy.

games.name: DX Legends
games.summary: Fast-paced online battle arena with thrilling modes, deep customization, and chaotic battles. Will you rise as a legend?

games.name: CryptidCam
games.summary: Head out into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Bigfoot, and more in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

games.name: Space Scavenger 2
games.summary: Space Scavenger 2 is an Action-Roguelike where you scavenge for modules to build a hodgepodge spaceship. Upgrade and customize your ship on-the-fly to make the best of a terrible situation. Playful and colorful - who said you can't smack aliens with a huge hammer in space?

games.name: Hyper Tanks
games.summary: Choose your tank and fight in neon-lit arenas where shots ricochet off walls! Beat challenging campaigns solo or in co-op, or battle your friends and bots in action-packed multiplayer modes. Use powerups, special weapons and tank abilities to survive the mayhem of Hyper Tanks!

games.name: Flowerdrops
games.summary: Grow flowers with bouncy drops of water!

games.name: Frame of Mind: A Game of Thoughts
games.summary: Frame of Mind is a brief and cozy narrative game that lets you discover a character trough thoughts and mementos they find while moving out of their parents home. It's an introspective game, meant to share some experiences a peer-group of neurodivergent queers, including the developer, had growing up.

games.name: Shell of a King
games.summary: Test your strength in Shell of a King! A precision bullet-hell adventure that will push your dodging skills to the limit. Challenge tough bosses, uncover secrets, and explore a world left to ruin in this top-down RPG.

games.name: Berry Bury Berry
games.summary: A juicy first-person incremental game about growing berries and tossing them down an ominous hole. Earn money and upgrades. Make new friends with sentient berry pals. Grow and control the hole as you unearth why nobody leaves this accursed garden. Bury it all, Berry everything.

games.name: Nomad
games.summary: Weave and slide under waves of projectile hazards in this energetic movement shooter. Dispatch hordes of lost and otherworldly foes as you avenge the planet's demise. Creatively utilize flexible movement mechanics to navigate the environment for fluid movement and displacing enemies.

games.name: Dribble Bounces Back!
games.summary: A mobile game about a super ball bashing business bots to bits!

games.name: Robot Recycler Ryn
games.summary: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

games.name: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
games.summary: Grow from a tiny tadpole to cosmic menace in Toadled: Eating Frenzy, the frantic single-stick roguelike. Test your reflexes and make smart choices as you upgrade through hundreds of new mutation combos, fight bosses, and become the universe!

games.name: Legends of Castile
games.summary: Legends of Castile is a comic fantasy point-and-click adventure set in the historic Castile region of Spain in the 19th century. It tells the story of a village girl who must investigate the myths and legends of Castile to fulfill her dream of becoming a nun. Advance the story by solving puzzles and riddles, meeting all kinds of characters, defeating fantastic creatures with your wit, and exploring places all around Castile.

games.name: Mythic Kart Maker
games.summary: Mythic Kart Maker is fantasy kart racing level editor, with vehicular combat, whimsical characters, & a vibrant 3D prerendered art-style, with gameplay akin to classic "kart racers".

games.name: Biomeat Huskworld
games.summary: This is the future, Meat is currency. Nobody is giving you time to think about it. QUICK, CONSUME, MAKE CONNECTIONS AND SHOOT MONSTERS.

games.name: Moki: The Escape
games.summary: Moki wakes up in a strange environment. The only memory: the own name. A peaceful world... or is it?! Join Moki in a challenging 2.5D jump & run platformer with many puzzles. Meet lovable and sometimes oddball characters and experience a occasionally emotional story.

games.name: Foreverthorn
games.summary: Explore the dungeons of Rose Chapel, blast enemies with your shotgun, avoid deadly traps and collect roses for your wife's grave.

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: When the Embers Wake
games.summary: When the Embers Wake is a third person narrative adventure with a cause to create awareness about the very current and real threats on wildlife. You play as a red panda that needs to survive amidst environmental challenges, threats and also grief.

games.name: Jelly Bubble
games.summary:
Stick together, bounce apart.
Grab soap, mess with your friends.A cute but chaotic multiplayer party game where jelly creatures compete, collide, and betray each other. Play with up to 6 players online or 4 players locally, and jump into wild matches—or build your own with the map editor.

games.name: Lou's Lagoon
games.summary: A cozy exploration-and-crafting adventure: fly your seaplane between tropical islands, collect resources with the Swirler 2000, rebuild storm damaged communities, and unravel the mystery surrounding Uncle Lou’s disappearance.

games.name: Deck of Memories
games.summary: Deck of Memories is a deckbuilding roguelite where you delve into the life of the last lighthouse keeper through immersive card dioramas. Customize your deck with a unique card crafting mechanic, explore fragmented memories, and uncover the secrets of the lighthouse.

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Superbug
games.summary: A blindingly-fast arcade shooter. Become the deadliest virus, and destroy everything in your path.

games.name: Pirates Outlaws 2: Heritage
games.summary: Pirates Outlaws 2 is a swashbuckling roguelike deckbuilder. Collect & fuse cards, gather powerful relics and adapt your strategy during each run. Become a reputed pirate, loot the Sea Masters, challenge giant creatures and triumph in the great Arena!

games.name: Dyadem
games.summary: Become the greatest tactician in this love letter to classic handheld SRPGs. It falls to you to forge the bonds of your Prince's followers, develop their skills, and shape their strategies as you fight to reclaim your homeland and save the world.

games.name: Dave's Word Game
games.summary: Dave's Word Game (known as DWG by fans) is an important new daily word game, where you must strategically use your best words to maximise your score every day.

games.name: Go Slimey Go!
games.summary: Go Slimey Go! is an easy-to-pick-up game for players of all ages! Help Slimey, our tiny slippery protagonist, visit his friends for some well deserved teatime after some thrilling platforming challenges! Just make sure not to get caught in the middle of the ultimate showdown between good and evil!

games.name: Dart Racer
games.summary: Dart Racer is an immersive VR arcade racing game set in a futuristic galaxy obsessed with speed. Master the intuitive controls, fine-tune your dart, and compete in thrilling races across a variety of strange environments.

games.name: Mything
games.summary: Gather your monsters and fight against the Gods of Greek mythology in this idle battler. Collect and upgrade your units.

games.name: Keep The Beat
games.summary: The party is on, don't let the neighbors stop it!

games.name: Little Shadow
games.summary: Go and try free your friends scattered across the city of lights, up to the ultimate beacon. But careful, stay hidden in the shadows, our dark little creature doesn't do well under the light...

games.name: Chicken Scratch
games.summary: Chicken Scratch is a quirky multiplayer drawing game set in a bird office, where you pass on a telephone chain featuring unusual prompts, muddling doodles and wacky captions.

games.name: Robot Rhapsody
games.summary: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

games.name: Infinite Alliance
games.summary: Heroes and villains from 13+ Indie JRPGs collide, in this story rich Crossover Event! Chained Echoes, Jack Move, 8-Bit Adventures 2, Beloved Rapture, Quartet, and more unite for a totally FREE adventure!

games.name: A Magical Tale: Revoke DX
games.summary: Venture to a new island and find locals in horror, it's your task to return their sacred gems that have been scattered by evils bestowed upon the land. Step into caverns, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles as Hero...

games.name: Muri: Wildwoods
games.summary: Explore the mysterious creature-filled Wildwoods as a Muri. Find secrets, solve puzzles, befriend creatures, and clean away the corruption. Restore the world's beauty in this cozy adventure!

games.name: Brok the Investigator: The Brawl Bar
games.summary: All-action additional content for BROK the InvestiGator. Fight your way through new enemies, tackle crazy challenges, and make new friends!

games.name: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna
games.summary: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna is a narrative sumo RPG that blends first person combat, life simulation, and story rich exploration. Train, cook, bond with stablemates, and fight to rise to the pinnacle of sumo.

games.name: False Hope
games.summary: False Hope is a survival horror game where you play as Stanley and Harriet, a couple trapped in an abandoned mall. As they navigate dark corridors, mannequins come to life, turning their escape into a fight for survival. Solve puzzles, uncover the mall's dark secrets, and evade relentless threats.

games.name: Highway Noir
games.summary: You are an underground driver for hire, fired from the Major Crimes Agency. Rush through a busy city at night as you take on high speed getaways, dangerous street races, white knuckle pursuits and more. Don't stop until you reveal the truth about who wanted you gone

games.name: Amelorn
games.summary: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

games.name: SeeYou
games.summary: A dark, medieval horror experience filled with lore, focused on exploration and puzzle-solving. There is no combat — only survival. Single player gameplay with challenging mechanics. Try to unravel the mystery behind the cursed world and maybe find a way to return it.

games.name: Illusive Domain
games.summary: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

games.name: Benjumpin Hopkins
games.summary: A challenging high-stakes physics based precision platformer. You take a role of Benji The Frog, who likes to jump, has a goal to climb up to the top of this infamous magical well, where a princess might be waiting. A single missed jump can lead to a long fall back down, but Benji never gives up.

games.name: Close to Light
games.summary: Follow the music and stay close to the lights in this rhythm game! Avoid hazards and do not let the darkness absorb you.

games.name: Hyperslice
games.summary: Fast paced action arena roguelike where you defeat waves of enemies using your dash. Slice through enemies or push them to survive. Upgrade and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.

games.name: Little Nemo and the Guardians of Slumberland
games.summary: Explore a dream world as Little Nemo, armed with toys, candy, and stuffed animals in this colorful platforming metroidvania adventure.

games.name: Clown House: Lunacy
games.summary: Unravel the mystery of an abandoned mansion and a commune of lunatic clowns. Clown House: Lunacy is a horror game with focus on the uncanniness and unpredictability of clowns. Observe the clowns, solve puzzles and survive. Never forget: Every clown you kill brings you closer to becoming one.

games.name: Luminaya
games.summary: Prepare for an enchanting journey as you dive into the mystical realm of Luminaya. You are braving a mysterious forest teeming with terryfing shadows. Use magical runes strategically to create enchanted orbs of light to drive away the shadows. Be vigilant and escape the ominous darkness!

games.name: Abglantz
games.summary: Enter a realm of nightmares and claw and shoot your way through hordes of bloodthirsty vermin and things that are much, much worse in this retro FPS

games.name: Soulfused
games.summary: Soulfused is a modern take on the classic text adventures from the early days of computer gaming. Dive into a dystopian future ruled by an empire focused on conquest and control. Take on the role of a newly converted Soulfused; a part human/part robot soldier in service to the Empire.

games.name: Casa De Diamantes
games.summary: Accompany agent Steph, right hand of the revered forbidden flower, on the hunt for their final rival residing in the beautiful and glamorous casino, the Casa De Diamantes.

games.name: Rift Fishing
games.summary: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

games.name: Forklift Flowerpot: Botanical Investigator
games.summary: Change between three seasons on a strange archipelago to solve puzzles, quiet-quit your forklift job, and dismantle the potato-dominated shipping industry. When you're done exploring, kick back and play a deckbuilding card game in a wild attempt to dethrone your local Gods.

games.name: Mancy
games.summary: An old-school card game where every deck is a kitchen table deck. No card limit. No net decks. Just duelists and their shoebox collection.

games.name: The Hilltop Funeral
games.summary: Yet another night at Cherry Hill, a casket arrives. The phone rings—two pallbearers are sent. One hand for one man, navigate through the cemetery and deliver the dead to their destination… at The Hilltop Funeral.

games.name: Biolune
games.summary: An artificial life simulation about a robot cultivating ecosystems on the moons of a ruined planet. Grow fantastical plants and animals, facilitate their evolution, and gather resources while discovering the secrets of this strange world.

games.name: Something Meaningful
games.summary: An open-world RPG where you decide how to live after your death. Work, study, train, explore the city, customize your appearance, meet cartoonish characters and unlock interesting locations as you try to do something meaningful with this new opportunity.

games.name: Red Season
games.summary: Red Season is a brutal third-person stealth-action game set in the storm-soaked countryside of 1998. Hunt the cult that kidnapped your daughter with violent takedowns, savage melee and intense gunfights. Face the horrors as you walk the fine line between justice and becoming a monster.

games.name: Pollinate or Die
games.summary: Pollinate or Die is a fast-paced action roguelite set in the hazardous wastelands left behind by humanity. As one of the last surviving bumblebees, you alone can revive Earth's flora. Fight through swarms of enemies as you search for flowers to pollinate and bring life back to the planet.

games.name: Scramble Heart City
games.summary: From the team behind Tough Love Arena comes Scramble Heart City, an exciting, 3v3 tag team fighting game that's playable in browser — no installation required!

games.name: Quantum Quartz
games.summary: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

games.name: Radiant Sky
games.summary: You and a group of adventurers must travel the world and unite the factions of weather spirits to stop constant natural disasters and stop an inevitable world ending catastrophe once the sky turns "radiant".

games.name: Dream Hollow
games.summary: A cozy-horror adventure game where choices matter. Manage your resources each day to delve deeper into an eerie storybook forest. Gather items, aid the frightened denizens, and make it back to your cottage before your RESOLVE runs out.

games.name: Bad Delivery: Pizza Your Heart
games.summary: You're the new girl at your local pizza place. Make pizzas, go on delivery runs, and collect tips to save enough money to pay your rent (and maybe find love along the way)!

games.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
games.summary: This is an action game where you explore ruins buried in the forest with Ethnic BGM. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), goes on a journey around the ISEKIZIMA (Ruins Island of dreams and romance : as it was written in the tourist brochure).

games.name: Match Morphosis
games.summary: Match Morphosis is a Roguelike Match-3 Deckbuilder. Match tiles to defeat enemies, gain artifacts, build synergies and unleash powerful combos. Master your way in this unique turn-based RPG. Kill, death, unlock, repeat. No two runs are the same, no timers, no grinding, no mercy.

games.name: Rollick N' Roll
games.summary: Marvelous marble runs, with a modern twist. Rollick N' Roll combines fun physics with intuitive controls to deliver a joyful puzzle experience for all ages. Expand your collection by unlocking fun vehicles and playsets, but be prepared for things to get a bit chaotic.

games.name: The Boo Croo
games.summary: 4-player cooperative and competitive party game with various minigames where everyone can win... and everyone can lose!

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: Dino Citadel
games.summary: Command a castle-on-a-dino through a corrupted world. Rescue fallen allies, lead them in battle, and build your deck. Manage your economy to draw cards and confront the Voidrift in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Wrecking Wave
games.summary: Wrecking Wave is an explosive action game with physics-based destruction focused on Challenge and Speedrun. Unleash a wave of chaos and smash cities, chase high scores and stop a mad scientist from polluting your ocean with toxic waste.

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Ballistic.exe
games.summary: Ballistic.exe is an advanced weapon simulator, with challenging true-to-life aiming mechanics, full weapon manipulation and customization, and highly accurate ballistic calculations.

games.name: Moose Diver
games.summary: You’re a moose on a diving adventure. Swim into the ocean and vacuum coins from the seabed. Sell the coins and earn money to upgrade and buy new gear. Swim deeper and find treasure chests to collect power boosting artefacts, but don’t forget to keep an eye on your oxygen level.

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Order Automatica
games.summary: A dark tactical roguelite where positioning, synergies, and automated battles collide on a tiny 3x3 ritual grid. Like chess with demons.

games.name: Goblin Dice and Cleave
games.summary: Hey, stranger! Welcome to the Black Maw, a tavern where the sessions are every bit as dangerous as its patrons! Take a seat at a table for four and experience a turn-based tactical tabletop RPG that blends dice-building, strategy, bluffing, and real-time action mechanics. Ready to play… or to bleed?

games.name: Humbug Tales: Keeper of the Swarm
games.summary: Experience the world of bugs through the eyes of the humbug ant herder Eacus and his peculiar flock. Together you'll meet a quirky cast of tiny friends on a larger-than-life adventure. Explore lush wetlands and use your wits to outsmart predators and enemy humbugs. Your colony is depending on you!

games.name: Hedon Bloodrite
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a crystalpunk underworld where the visceral combat of the 90s' FPS games blends with the exploration and puzzle solving of classic dungeon crawlers and adventure games.

games.name: Bloodspill
games.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

games.name: Mothership
games.summary: Mothrership is about PURE EXPLORATION in awe-inspiring zero-G and mind-blowing exoplanets. Your goal, to retrieve the fuel cores of huge space wrecks, to keep searching deeper into space for the last humans in the galaxy. This is the first game of a solo dev, delivering a very personal experince inspired by his own trekking experiences and aerospace insights.

games.name: Stranded Survivors
games.summary: Survive swarms of monsters, rescue stranded animals, and build a base where they can be safe in this unique bullet heaven. Turn your rescues into upgrades and build a safe town to create new weapons and recruit powerful heroes that unlock new ways to survive til dawn.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Tossdown
games.summary: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Void Dungeon brings you a 2D Action RPG with intense hack & slash combat, deep character options, and unyielding enemies, which you can face solo or with up to 4 friends. Oh, and quirky costumes. Because it’s better to look good when the void consumes you.

games.name: Towers of Scale
games.summary: A resource management optimization puzzle game with metaprogression under a guise of an RPG. Explore the towers, get high scores, obtain gems and push the scores even further beyond!

games.name: Little Tree Kingdom
games.summary: Build a gnome kingdom among the branches of a giant tree in this relaxing mix of city-building and roguelike deckbuilding. Grow the tree, build structures, earn cards and blessings, and survive monsters and disasters. Each run spans seasons and unfolds differently. Can your tree kingdom thrive?

games.name: RoboFarm
games.summary: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

games.name: Roombattle
games.summary:
Roombattle is a party fighting game where players will control robotic vacuum cleaners and will fight equipped with sharp objects and balloons. The main objective is to be the last to be equipped balloons in the game. In addition to the battles, the game contains a large crowd of minigames.

Meet up with your friends, customize your vacuum, and get ready to battle in different rooms to claim victory!

games.name: Living Dead House
games.summary: Living Dead House delivers a pulse pounding, classic arcade experience. Battle through waves of the undead solo or team up with a friend. Use an arsenal of weapons and survival items to outlast the night. Will you escape alive and claim your top spot on the leaderboard?

games.name: Crimson Furnace
games.summary: Manage a clandestine tavern where gangs, poachers, and Council spies cross paths. In this cozy horror simulator, cook cursed dishes, manipulate your patrons, and build your reputation to expand your cult's influence.

games.name: Super Pinball Adventure
games.summary: A colorful casual pinball game for all ages and skill levels. Delight in knocking out enemies, collecting coins and solving the puzzle of each level! A fun and quirky reimagining of a beloved arcade classic with all the dopamine-hits of those games from your childhood.

games.name: Hard Drive
games.summary: Explore the cyberpunk world of Hard Drive as you work as a driver and hacker in order to pay down your debts and uncover the secrets of the city.

games.name: Before the Silence
games.summary: In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

games.name: Elite Beasts
games.summary: From out of the shadows comes a new breed of beast! Put these cute characters through their paces to discover which ones have what it takes to become a true ELITE BEAST. Reach the goal without dying. Kill enemies or collect fruit if that's your jam.

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Family Reunion
games.summary: Family Reunion is a game about speedrunning a childhood family dinner. Use imagination, conversation, and exploration to make time go faster and finally escape the table.

games.name: Olga: Episode 1
games.summary: Relive Olga's childhood memories as she visits her grandparents' home in Belovodica, a secluded mountain village where some discoveries last a lifetime.

games.name: Wolf With Inn
games.summary: Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern simulator. Become a werewolf, discover new recipes, cook hearty meals, and grow your inn! Welcome noble white knights and adventurers—and send them into the clutches of the forest "monsters."

games.name: Grinding Guilds
games.summary: Grinding Guilds mixes Auto Battler and ARPG elements. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

games.name: Surfers Code
games.summary: 3D open world tropical adventure and surfing simulation. Immerse yourself in this chill environment with quirky characters and challenging surfing. Unveil the mysteries tucked away in every corner of the islands.

games.name: Bear Defence Situation
games.summary: A hybrid card game and tower defence where the hands you play become the towers you build. Defeat the enemies approaching the bear's den and find modifiers that support the elements of your defensive strategy.

games.name: Dukkido
games.summary: Recruit an army of minions and overwhelm the enemy! Dukkido is a physics-based Action-RTS, featuring large handcrafted levels and dungeons. You've been Zorped in from your edge of reality, and command your Dogs of War to riches, glory, and a good meal. Supports up to 5-player online co-op.

games.name: Tower Lab
games.summary: Roguelite tower defense where enemies can’t be killed, knock them off with physics instead! Build devastating contraptions that push, pull, and launch enemies. Unlock towers, discover broken synergies, and dominate through creative combinations.

games.name: Lady Dracula
games.summary: An evolution of the Classicvania genre and a return to the glory days of precision platforming, retro challenge and gothic atmosphere. Transform yourself into a wraith, a spider and a bat to fly, climb and blast your way across Transylvania to do battle with Lady Dracula at her castle keep.

games.name: Echo Punk
games.summary: Echo Punk is a roguelite top-down looter shooter with fast-paced combat, tactical upgrades, and endless replayability. Blast through waves of enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your build -- or die trying.

games.name: Miroh Jr.
games.summary: A co-op arcade puzzle mash-up.

games.name: CleanFall
games.summary: CleanFall is a survival rogue-lite that prizes player freedom and creativity. Build mobile death machines to fight off ravenous hordes, craft and alchemize gun turrets, and tunnel through subterranean ecosystems crawling with nameless horrors.

games.name: Lost Host
games.summary:
Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.

games.name: Stop the Press!
games.summary: You run a newspaper in a nation on the brink of revolution. Twist headlines to suit your agenda, upgrade your printing press, mastermind a distribution strategy to grow your readership and evade being censored—or worse—by the Secret Police. With enough influence you can change the course of history.

games.name: Loco: Rails & Tails
games.summary: Chaotic co-op for 1-4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

games.name: Zitifono
games.summary: After a storm, your boat breaks down, but relax! The quirky inhabitants of Zitifono will help you to repair it. Embark on an adventure, swim, sail and discover all the secrets of the mysterious and colorful islands.

games.name: Rushcremental
games.summary: Rushcremental is an active incremental journey about searching the wasteland for scrap resources and building a racecar to rule over all the territories.

games.name: Must Be Feng Shui
games.summary: Must be Feng Shui is a relaxing puzzle game where you arrange furniture to follow Feng Shui rules. Recreate your own home in sandbox mode, or decorate existing cozy apartments to restore their balance.

games.name: Silent Road
games.summary: Drive through Japan’s suicide ring in your night-shift taxi. Pick up strange passengers, fulfill their unsettling requests and follow the silent road as their stories make each ride darker than the last.

games.name: ACUVAC: A Suck And Blow Adventure
games.summary: ACUVAC is a vacuum physics simulator with action-adventure elements! Suck! Blow! Swing your hose around! Perform various ridiculous challenges! Clean your way to victory!

games.name: Obsidian Moon
games.summary: Investigate your way in this branching noir horror detective game. Discover dark secrets through genre-bending clue mechanics while navigating a world where Lovecraftian horrors blend with ancient Minoan and Kawirian mysteries. Uncover a sinister plot and face an ultimate choice.

games.name: Magic Inn
games.summary: Reclaim glory in Magic Inn, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: Through the Nightmares
games.summary: The atmospheric hardcore action platformer about the Sandman wandering the world of children's nightmares. You will have to find and rescue the children from the trap of the almighty Morpheus, by overcoming of all their fears.

games.name: Dungeon Tourists
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

games.name: Bit Esc
games.summary: Break free from the system in Bit Esc, an action/adventure platformer where Bit sets out to escape from the tyrannic OS. Explore the digital world, overcome frantic challenges, meet new friends and make tough decisions that’ll determine the fate of Bit and the world around them.

games.name: Tales of Kathay
games.summary: Tales of Kathay is a tactical turn-based RPG where every world is born from centuries of simulated history. Explore ruined kingdoms, join faction wars, craft your path through a living sandbox, and return generations later to see the mark your choices left behind.

games.name: Once Glorious Artahk
games.summary: Explore the ruins of an ancient city. Solve puzzles to unlock new paths, abilities, and forgotten lore. Read the lost stories you uncover to gain insight into a tangled web of mysteries. Using only your wits and your trusty torch to guide you, you must find a way to return light to a starless sky.

games.name: Star Spark
games.summary: Master combos, unleash powerful attacks, and survive dangerous encounters to win the Star Spark Tournament! Plan your moves and outwit your opponents in this roguelite, turn-based fighting game.

games.name: Piczle World of Puzzles
games.summary: All your favourite logic-puzzles in one feature-rich package, Piczle World of Puzzles is the ultimate in picture logic-puzzling!

games.name: Gentoo Rescue
games.summary: A puzzler about sliding penguins and walruses. Pickup items to push, pull, bounce, swap, stop, steal, or explode. Solve tightly-designed challenges in a world of puzzles inside puzzles inside puzzles.

games.name: Emblems: Sunless Vow
games.summary: Can they stop arguing long enough to escape the void?! A Roguelike Visual Novel with QUICK turn-based combat and flexible difficulty. Calculate, power-up, and stack favors to The Heart's content... Or take on a narrative campaign filled with Mystery + Drama + Shenanigans.

games.name: Alruna: End of History
games.summary: Alruna; now in wide-screen! A different kind of Metroidvania, a tour-de-force of game design, with world-class temples and dungeons. Dead men yearn for Heaven, but Elysium remains out of their grasp.

games.name: Phobos Down
games.summary: A sci-fi twin stick shooter stripped down to the bare essentials with focus on smooth controls and satisfying action.

games.name: Harmony Havoc
games.summary: A roguelike shooter where you create music to power up your battles and experience what it's like to be part of a heavy metal band.

games.name: Greenhouse: Schism
games.summary: Greenhouse: Schism is a sidescrolling platformer focusing on Gameplay, Magic based combat and Boss Battles. Explore and fight through the Acri forest and discover the secret to it's high concentration of magic! Learn new spells and find secrets while adventuring deeper towards the truth.

games.name: Yesterdreamt
games.summary: Deliberate movement, limited ammo and precious sanity. Yesterdreamt is a twin-stick horrorvania where the odds are stacked against you, Gunslinger. Unlock arcanicks to tip the scales and keep close to your dog, and you might just win this fight. And if you were to fall, well… Blessed be the Dreamweavers.

games.name: Ash & Adam's Existential Treads
games.summary: A mini action city-builder in a post-post-apocalyptic world. Grow your settlement. Fend off waves of enemies. Restore nature.

games.name: Mass of Consumption
games.summary: The church is impatient. The church is hungry. The church is willing to do anything to get you back.

games.name: Netherworld
games.summary: A weird jellyfish handles marriage crisis with alcohol, drugs, sex, blows and lots of odd characters.

games.name: Drink Human Beans
games.summary: You will pay $99.99 to be psychologically tortured by a sentient job application. You will learn to live, laugh, love until the walls bleed. You will become a succulent beverage.

games.name: The Henchmen
games.summary: The Henchmen is a pulp-inspired, 90s fueled top-down, action retro open-world game set in the fictional city of New Queens during 1979 and 1991.

games.name: Begraved
games.summary: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

games.name: Hemomancer
games.summary: Hemomancer is a story set in a surreal world. It's also a roguelite game with RPG, visual novel and musical/rhythm elements. Gameplay and narrative is designed to challenge you, so prepare to struggle.

games.name: Skeleseller
games.summary: Skeleseller is a laid-back idle game set in a vibrant fantasy world. You're a skeleton shopkeep who hires adventurers to collect loot for you after your untimely demise. Send adventurers into battle, sell what they find, and build up your town!

games.name: Maddmadd
games.summary: Maddmadd is a third-person run-and-gun boomer shooter with fast-paced movement, beautiful giblets and a comedic tone. Blow stuff up in your tank and then get up-close-and-personal with your boomstick!

games.name: The Regreening
games.summary: In our cozy nature-restoration management game, you are the last human on Earth, but your task isn’t survival—it’s renewal. Regreen habitats by planting seeds, restore habitats to welcome back folklore animals, and nurture ecosystems to life. Trade resource extraction for purposeful healing.

games.name: Block Block Block
games.summary: Design your dream space! In this tiny cozy building game, stack and arrange uniquely shaped wooden blocks to craft charming dioramas. Design cozy bakeries, elegant living rooms or quirkiy studios, create beautiful spaces filled with warm and personality.

games.name: All Quiet in the Trenches
games.summary: All Quiet in the Trenches is a narrative turn-based strategy game set in the Great War. Get to know your soldiers, take care of their needs and lead them in battle, trying to strike a precarious balance between the ambitions of your superiors and the survival of your men.

games.name: Chaos Coin
games.summary: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Plan your turns to shove, evade, and attack your foes in tactical lane-based combat. Upgrade coins with new faces unique to every character to build complex combos. The forces of Chaos are coming…so use your heads (and tails)!

games.name: City of Dolorosa
games.summary: You've just died—and your trial for the ultimate sin begins. City of Dolorosa is an interactive fiction and first-person exploration game with handmade india ink graphics. Meet the Five Great Powers and uncover all the secrets that lie within Dolorosa, the cruelest city in Hell.

games.name: RadCity: a post-apocalyptic adventure
games.summary: Scavenge for food and escape a dead city in a broken, post apocalyptic world. Gather enough food for 40 days and prepare for a train journey to a place of refuge. Featuring a top-down perspective and a finely crafted 3D world.

games.name: Thumblemania
games.summary: Thumb up and fight! Thumblemania is an action-packed wrestling game where you smack down your opponents to become the “Strongest Thumb of the Univeeeeerse”!

games.name: Little Retreat
games.summary: Little Retreat is your personal cozy productivity game. Set timers for real-life tasks and unlock items to decorate wholesome rooms inspired by places and legends from Southern Germany. Little Retreat blends entertainment with self-motivation, rewarding you for making the most of your time!

games.name: Charon's Obol
games.summary: Play a high stake game of head or tails against a mysterious opponent, trapped under the ocean in a claustrophobic, eldritch & Lovecraftian horror atmosphere.

games.name: Lexispell
games.summary: Strategy meets physics, in this roguelike word game, where you combine spelling with cool upgrades to score high.

games.name: The Purple Peacock
games.summary: The Purple Peacock is a 2D point-and-click adventure game where players guide Virgil Russ, in a mysterious quest to find a rare and elusive stamp, the “Purple Peacock”.

games.name: Maid Cafe Coop
games.summary: Become a cute maid in a maid cafe! Prepare to harness your inner moe energy by preparing and serving customers many different drinks and foods with proper Moe Moe Kyun hospitality, and unlock new ways to make them happier. Play singleplayer or with your friends!

games.name: Rogue Climber
games.summary: You've only got a short time to climb. An army of enemies and traps are waiting to stop you. Manage your equipment, hone your build, and master your platforming techniques to climb higher than anyone before you.You think you've got what it takes? I don't think so.

games.name: Asthenia
games.summary: Trapped in a decaying world ruled by cosmic entities, wield the primordial gauntlet to fight distorted foes. Explore, uncover secrets, and use tainted artifacts. Survive or be consumed by Asthenia.

games.name: Mirai #167
games.summary: MIRAI #167 is a 2D pixel-art runner where you control two characters at once, rewinding time and jumping through portals. Embark on a frantic adventure to save humanity in a world where AI surpasses human control - upgrade your characters, break records and rewrite history before it’s too late!

games.name: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown
games.summary: BoobyRogue: Tumor Takedown is a fast-paced 2D roguelike where you choose your hero and fight through waves of enemies in a symbolic battle against breast cancer. Collect weapons and items, create unique builds, and survive until the final Tumor.

games.name: A Simple Expurriment
games.summary: A cartoony, combat-free metroidvania with puzzles, stealth and genetically modified kittens. Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

games.name: All will Rise
games.summary: The river is a god, and they killed it. It’s time for ordinary people to hold them to account. Manage your team. Mix with ecoterrorists and godmen. Build your deck, follow leads and find allies. Make your case, and win the battle for the future.

games.name: Joe Adventure
games.summary: Keep moving or explode! Control multiple Joes to solve puzzles in order to save your siblings and Joe Mama from the grasps of the food factory!

games.name: Metahorror Therapy Session
games.summary: Take control of a therapist in a mysterious, never-ending therapy session. Can you unravel the truth behind your patient's lies, and live to tell the tale? A psychological mystery developed by a psychologist.

games.name: Devil's Drizzle
games.summary: An enchanting 2D pixel art platformer with an engaging story, starring a brave kid, their trusty umbrella, and Sumerian demons. It features a diverse range of mechanics and level designs, including action, adventure, horror, puzzle, and drama.

games.name: Ekorella Vol 1
games.summary: A turn-based RPG set in a fantastic society of plants and animals. Fight against monsters and visit exotic places that have their unique culture and history. Beware of what lurks in the darkness...

games.name: DeckWrecking Pirates
games.summary: A tactical roguelike deckbuilder where you roll dice, command your pirate crew, and even control your enemies. Build your deck… and wreck theirs!

games.name: Mutate! Fight! Purr!
games.summary: A roguelike deck-builder set in a twisted biblical world, where a lone cat mutates to survive the trials of heaven and the pit.

games.name: AnimaCircus
games.summary: Join the troupe of an circus exclusively for cats. Pick your visuals and show your talent as a feline artist.

games.name: Band of Crusaders
games.summary: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

games.name: Inner Voice
games.summary: Step into the world of "Inner Voice", where the silence is louder than screams. In this atmospheric horror experience you will uncover long-buried secrets as the story unfolds. Every creak and every whisper holds a part of this story. Are you ready to face this nightmare?

games.name: ChainStaff
games.summary: ChainStaff is a brutal action-platformer with a transforming spear and grappling hook, blazing weapon upgrades, and a rocking soundtrack. Aliens have taken over the Earth! Swing, shoot, and spear your way through hordes of mutating monstrosities and bone-shaking boss fights.

games.name: Your Holy & Virtuous Heretic
games.summary: A first-person, turn-based journey into the occult. Who will stand with Aleister at the end of days?

games.name: Cult Of Blood
games.summary: Cult of Blood is a survival horror adventure that combines cinematic storytelling with modernized classic gameplay. Fixed camera angles, dramatic cutscenes and refined tank-style controls create a tense, atmospheric experience where survival hinges on every decision. Fans of classic survival horror will feel right at home.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Haunted Bloodlines
games.summary: Haunted Bloodlines is a first person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

games.name: Godshard Chronicles
games.summary: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the world of the Godshard novels with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles, explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

games.name: Sub-Species
games.summary: At first the alien outbreak spreading throughout the oceans was confined. We delayed our extinction rather than avert it. As part of a salvage crew, you search the hellish containment zones, where a treasure trove of lost tech can help you and your crew eke out a living in a slowly dying world.

games.name: Lunr.Rdio.Taxi
games.summary: lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'Drifthm' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.

games.name: In Print
games.summary: In Print is a chaotic font-themed rogue-lite shooter where each round’s loser picks a new power-up to build their wild, broken combos. Rain fire with the power of Hellvetica or fly through the skies with Wingdings. Are you ready to destroy your friends—all while sporting your finest office attire?

games.name: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y.
games.summary: Terror Type: A.L.C.H.E.M.Y. is a stealth-action immersive sim about resistance, redemption, and the explosive power of chemistry. As a skilled alchemist turned freedom fighter, you’ll craft potions for the resistance, engineer devastating bombs, and dismantle tyranny from the shadows.

games.name: Whatta Frogs?
games.summary: Persuade your friends by lying or telling the truth in this social deduction game, all in the pursuit of scoring as many points as possible! Does your box have a fruit? Yes or no, it doesn’t matter—just convince them to pick you!

games.name: Nice Day for Fishing
games.summary: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

games.name: Cralon
games.summary: Cralon is an authentic 3D dungeon crawler with RPG and adventure elements, inspired by the ultimate dungeon classics. Hunting a demon, you fell into the abyss of an old mine. Equip yourself, fight creatures, solve quests, uncover secrets and find a way out.

games.name: Cascade
games.summary: CASCADE is a stylish first-person roguelite with a focus on blazingly fast movement. Slide from surface to surface, unlock and upgrade abilities and face otherworldly enemies and bosses, all while exploring a corrupted digital space. But don't forget: Always keep on moving!

events.name: Mundo Gamer Showcase 2025
events.description:
The Mundo Gamer Showcase 2025 is the official Mundo Gamer Network event dedicated to revealing and promoting the best independent games from Brazil and around the world.

During the Showcase, studios present their trailers and exclusive highlights to a global audience — including players, media, influencers, publishers, and industry professionals.

games.name: Rogue Climber
games.summary: You've only got a short time to climb. An army of enemies and traps are waiting to stop you. Manage your equipment, hone your build, and master your platforming techniques to climb higher than anyone before you.You think you've got what it takes? I don't think so.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Rune Dice
games.summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Strawberry Quest
games.summary: Music RPG platformer about friendship, memory, and emotional journey, with a striking sound identity.

games.name: Master Lemon: The Quest for Iceland
games.summary: MASTER LEMON is a narrative adventure game inspired by a true story. Players solve puzzles and face challenges on a journey where freedom and dreams clash with tough choices. Join Lemon as he seeks to save a distant land from a memory-eating plague threatening world history and languages.

games.name: Changer Seven
games.summary: Fast-Paced Lane-Based Action Brawler. The legendary Changers 7 heroes must fight a new threat that changes the citizens of Sunny Point into terrifying beings! But as they investigate and defeat "villain of the week" like enemies, they suspect that someone from their own group may be behind it all.

games.name: Hotel Galactic
games.summary: Hotel Galactic is a cozy management game inspired by Studio Ghibli's classic pictures. Build the tourist destination of your dreams, oversee and unite your staff to forge a quirky family, and make new friends as you explore this wholesomely nostalgic world.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Ghost Gunners
games.summary: This party FPS is made to CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS, up to 6 people! Everyone is invisible, but you have various tools to track and reveal enemies. Play different game modes and customize your lobbies.

games.name: Bearly Awesome
games.summary: Transform into a furry Bearlie and explore a mysterious, daunting world full of endless surprises and quests. Use your bear skills wisely to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles and team up with other players to advance through the enchanted world.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Devive
games.summary: Devive is an action-adventure game where your life is constantly decreasing. Run into a race against death to bring your child back to life, drain the energy of your enemies to survive, forge your fighting style, and solve a variety of puzzles to harvest the power of a fallen entity.

games.name: The Perfect Pencil
games.summary: Help John on his journey of personal growth. Unravel the nuances of human reactions to fear. Surprising exploration, fast paced combat, complex choices and allegorical characters, all intertwined with a psychological narrative in this hand-drawn 2D action-platformer.

games.name: Gig Crawler
games.summary: GigCrawler is a co-op roguelite where Freelancers swap abilities, prepare builds, and tackle procedurally generated, biome-coded dungeons. Adapt, grind, and survive the gig chaos!

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

games.name: Black Jacket
games.summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: The Bunker Notes
games.summary: "The Bunker Notes" is a visual novel about a concrete trap where the past whispers through the cracks of rusted doors. In this world, survival is everything; meeting another person might be your last mistake.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Ultra Maze
games.summary: This is the ultimate Maze Game. The mazes are procedurally generated, and so are always unique. There are plenty of options to create an experience to your likings.

games.name: X4: Foundations
games.summary: X4: FOUNDATIONS, the long awaited sequel in the successful X series, brings our most sophisticated universe SIMULATION ever. Fly every ship, EXPLORE space or manage an empire; TRADE, FIGHT, BUILD and THINK carefully, while you embark on an epic journey.

games.name: Total Reload
games.summary:
Ever had something turn out so disastrously that you wished you could just reset and start all over again? In this game you may just have the chance to reboot the grandest experiment ever gone wrong. That experiment? The Universe itself.

You will find yourself inside an amazing single mechanism, impressive in its scale. Taking control of its silent resident Artificial Intelligence named HAWKING, you will be able to visit many locations filled with a variety of technical devices.

Solve spatial puzzles, change the fundamental laws of physics to activate all systems of this incredible mechanism and launch a process called TOTAL RELOAD!

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Summona Realm: The Secret Flame
games.summary: Summona Realm is a simple visual novel that uses a map-based system to navigate the story. The game gives the feel of black and white Japanese manga.

games.name: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
games.summary: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

games.name: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles
games.summary: Hivaneph: The Legend of Elles is an action-adventure game where every character holds a unique perspective, revealing a world that is distinct to their own eyes.

games.name: Worldseekers
games.summary:
Worldseekers is a GPS exploration RPG. Discover rare cards, events, and unique characters as you delve into the expansive lands and deceptive dungeons of this world.

To help encourage mental and physical health, Worldseekers uses GPS mechanics and links to a phone app to help you get outside and walking. Of course, the Steam version allows you to play from your PC for hours while still rewarding you for taking an extra stroll. For all you streamers out there, we adjust / hide location by default.

games.name: Haunted Bloodlines
games.summary: Haunted Bloodlines is a first person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

games.name: Cursed Blood
games.summary: Play as vengeful Samurai Apes fueled by blood in a lightning-fast mix of stealth and action. Spill blood, cut limbs and claim vengeance.

games.name: Rabbit's Tale
games.summary: Rabbit’s Tale, a hand-drawn metroidvania roguelike. Play as a Rabbit in search of his kidnapped family, but along the way something mysterious happens: you get lost in a purple Void, a procedural world where dying is permanent. A Venom-like creature tags along. You bound by survival.

events.name: Southeast Asia Games Onward 2025
events.description: Southeast Asia Games Onward (SEAGO) is an annual online community event that celebrates the growth and development of Southeast Asia gaming industry. Tune in for Southeast Asia Games Onward - Presentation on 28th December 2025 and SEA GO Steam Sale & Itch.io collection on 8th December until 31st December 2025.

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Not My Part
games.summary: This is story about 'Grace' who is on her way to the Sunday Lake camp, but something happens that makes her meet a famous serial killer at a motel along the way. In this horror movie-like scenario, what role will she play?

games.name: Don't Freeze: A Winter Card Survival
games.summary: Don't Freeze is a winter card survival game set in a winter wasteland. Explore, gather resources, craft, hunt, die, repeat. Something sinister lurks in the cold darkness. Will you make it out in time?

games.name: Riftstorm
