games.summary: Storms are coming, and there are rules you must follow. RIFTSTORM is co-op looter-shooter set in a world of myth and secret societies where you can play solo or co-op in a party of three.

games.name: Roguematch: The Extraplanar Invasion
games.summary: Roguematch is a Fantasy Turn based Rogue-like fused into a Match-3 layout, giving players many more ways to get out of challenging situations! With so much raw elemental magic at your command, theres even more to do than just smack and bash your way through creatures from the extraplanar realms!

games.name: Troublemaker 2: Beyond Dream
games.summary: Teenagers, Dreams, and Drugs. Unveil the secrets of South Jayakarta city, set two years after the ending of the original Troublemaker. The journey of the “Parakacuk” gang continues alongside the “Beyond Dream” band in South Jayakarta city in this fun open-world action-comedy beat-'em-up game.

games.name: Asbak
games.summary: Asbak is a fast-paced hack-and-slash platformer where you chase down and slay demons born from humanity’s darkest fears. Move fast, hit hard, and keep the nightmares at bay!

games.name: Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD - The First Expansion
games.summary: This free expansion brings new game modes and content to celebrate the 10K units sold milestone of the base game Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD.

games.name: Verde
games.summary: Build a small town of seedlets, mysterious seed like creatures in this cozy city builder. Build facilities, put up decorations, and help the seedlets thrive!

games.name: Potion Promise
games.summary: In a medieval fantasy world, a young witch finds herself inheriting a massive debt from her parents. With only 30 days to repay it, she must rely on her potion-making skills and cunning to gather rare ingredients and fulfill the demands of her customers, while uncovering shocking truths behind.

games.name: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Love at Furst Bite
games.summary: Olive is trapped in school in the midst of the apocalypse! With demons slaughtering every dog in sight there's only so many left to spend time with! Will their special someone be Brownie the snack-loving corgi, Sparky the sporty husky or Patches the dalmatian bookworm? You decide!

games.name: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Patches' Infurno
games.summary: Patches is dragged to school for the first ever cat-and-dog school day! All he needs to do is get this damn collar off and wreck some havoc! Will he prove cats and dogs can get along, or will he make this the Purrfect Apawcalypse?

games.name: Purrfect Apawcalypse: Purrgatory Furever
games.summary: One thousand zombies from the massacre of Hachiko High are crashing Olive's birthday party! Trapped in the Grimalkin Estate they'll have to unravel the mystery behind the zombies, all while making sure their friends are having the Purrfect Apawcalypse!

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Roll, jump, and dash around as a house on a date in this silly adventure game. Meet eccentric structures, romance eligible bachelorx pads, and uncover the meaning of life... or you could go fishing instead (though we replaced the fish with cars to make more sense).

games.name: Fossilpunk
games.summary: Lead space dino settlers to rebuild your civilization and rise again! Start cities, expand borders, grow your economy, and master tactical battles. Unleash epic dino combos in this turn-based strategy game with 4X and Roguelite elements. Rawr!

games.name: Garden of Wandering Souls
games.summary: Garden of Wandering Souls is a Tower Defense game with a roguelite twist, featuring two unique mechanics: path building and tower attack range patterns that resemble puzzles, with narrative and visuals inspired by Indonesia’s Borobudur Temple, the world's largest Buddhist temple.

games.name: Talents
games.summary: Write your way to success with your talented yet rowdy co-founders in this game development-themed romance visual novel! Do you have what it takes?

games.name: Plushie from the Sky
games.summary: A charming souls-like hack & slash. Play as a little fallen angel, explore dreamy landscapes, shoot down corrupted monsters and fight challenging bosses with a plushie.

games.name: Whisper Mountain Outbreak
games.summary: An isometric co-op PvE multiplayer survival horror game. It's 1998, and an ancient curse has been unleashed, trapping everyone on Mt. Bisik. When a mysterious fog appeared, people started hearing whispers and seeing monsters. Fight, explore, solve puzzles, and figure out a way to escape... together!

games.name: Magic Caster
games.summary: Dive into a fast-paced wizard world where drawing gestures becomes your power! Defeat monsters, unleash potent spells, and expertly navigate the bullet hell to experience a new level of gaming excitement.

games.name: Of Frost and Flowers
games.summary: An otome-fantasy visual novel. Play as Alto, a fearless knight, and enter a world of magic and myths with secrets waiting for you to unveil.

games.name: Bail Force: Cyberpunk Bounty Hunters
games.summary: Hunt cybercriminals in a brutal action roguelite where enemies adapt to your fighting style. Play as Angel or Lea and choose your path through revenge and redemption in a dystopian society.

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: The Hell: City Builder of the Dead
games.summary: Welcome to the city-building game set in the depths of Hell. Assume the role of the Hell Governor and embrace the challenge of welcoming souls who perished in major, historically accurate human catastrophes. Are you ready to build and govern your own infernal city?

games.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.summary: Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

games.name: Mirth Island
games.summary: You're about to embark on an epic adventure with a young duck who's tired of feeling sad all the time. He's packed his bags, set sail on a rickety boat, and is headed straight for Mirth Island - a place where happiness is said to grow wild like daisies!

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.summary: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: Not Monday Cafe
games.summary:
Build and manage your cute cozy cafe while working studying or streaming.
Farming and serving delicious dishes to adorable animal customer in your cafe on the bottom of your screen, all while you're working on other tasks and enjoying your day.

games.name: Mala Petaka
games.summary: 2D Pixel Art Shooter inspired Sci-fi FPS runs on GZDoom. You play as 'Petaka', an angry amnesiac that just wants to kill every ugly green aliens and annoying drones he encounters while trying to restore his memories by exploring various universes through warp portals.

games.name: Robo Frenzy
games.summary: Build and battle in Robo Frenzy! Create dozens of weapons and construct inventions to crush gigantic gadgets in a sandbox action game that blends crafting with combat.

games.name: Axeras
games.summary: As a young captain in the army, command Acorns Company in this turn-based tactical SRPG as you fight through the Evestrian Civil War. Use different units and combine abilities to secure battlefield superiority. The decisions you make on the battlefield will eventually catch up to you…

games.name: Parasomnia
games.summary: What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

games.name: Zhen: Shattered Legacy
games.summary: Zhen: Shattered Legacy is a Twin-Stick, Action-Adventure where you play as a Robot Warrior Monk sent to investigate a decrepit realm in order to restore the righteous way of Kung Fu.

games.name: Escape from the Cursed Convent
games.summary: Escape from the Cursed Convent is a narrative-driven adventure game set in a medieval girls' convent, offering a rich storytelling experience, and several gameplay styles including QTE, hunting, cooking, and puzzle-solving.

games.name: Bathhouse Creatures
games.summary: Ready, set, bath! Build and manage your bathhouse for animals in this casual and cozy management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard-earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!

games.name: Kopi
games.summary: Welcome to KOPI, a family-friendly cooking game that can be enjoyed solo or with friends in co-op mode. In KOPI, you'll craft increasingly elaborate drinks and dishes for ever-demanding customers. Whether you're brewing, cooking, frying, cleaning, or serving, remember: it’s not over until the customer leaves happy.

games.name: Froggy Brews
games.summary: Froggy Brews is a cozy narrative adventure, where every cup of tea tells a story. Play as a tea-loving frog returning to your old neighborhood that has changed over time. Brew tea for villagers, uncover heartfelt stories, and rediscover your place in this world.

games.name: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight
games.summary: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight is a heartwarming cosy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant.

games.name: No Straight Roads 2
games.summary: Metronomik and Shueisha Games are thrilled to announce NSR2 – the explosive sequel to the hit action-music adventure NO STRAIGHT ROADS – coming to Steam in 2026.

games.name: Office Crush Dating Simulator
games.summary: A dating simulator where you romance your handsome co-workers and nothing goes wrong.

games.name: Turnbound
games.summary: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them?

games.name: Eat the Rich
games.summary: Be a billionaire, team up and betray your friends all at once in EAT THE RICH! A social party game for 6-10 players where you play mini games, vote out the competition, conspire to get ahead, all in a bid to be the richest!

games.name: Lily Adventuresses! Episode 1: She Who Lost Everything but Her Name
Lily Adventuresses! Episode 2: Rise of the Arcritters
Lily Adventuresses! Episode 3: The Explorer Sisters and the Deepest Depths
At What Cost
games.summary: Always fight for what is right. But are you on the right side?

games.name: Stuck in the Present
games.summary: Stuck in the Present is a 3D side-scrolling psychological horror title where two friends relive painful memories within the uncanny depths of twisting subway stations in a large, unfamiliar city.

games.name: Super Ledgehop: Double Laser
games.summary: Cutie anime girl realizes her cool big bro is missing?? Cheese it up with Chizuru and SHOOT TO THE BEAT OF THE SONG in this top down bullet hell shooter! Absorb enemy bullets using your waveshines to utilize their bullets as your own! Show those cheeseheads that you're better!!

games.name: Relic Abyss
games.summary: Experience a unique hand-crafted Bullet Heaven Roguelite RPG set in a Fantasy x Sci-fi world filled with might, magic, and lost technology! A mysterious tale centered around a world-devouring Abyss awaits...

games.name: Crimson Horn
games.summary: Forge an unstoppable army in this thrilling auto battler experience! Strategically recruit and command diverse warriors, each with unique abilities, to form the ultimate force. Customize your squad with powerful weapons, crafted gear, and inspiring banners to turn the tide of battle!

games.name: Shell Soldier
games.summary: Shell Soldier is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

games.name: Luxman Moonlit Market
games.summary: A strategic spatial set-collection roguelike featuring Balatro-inspired power-up management. Under the flamboyant Uncle Luxman, build the ultimate Moonlit Market while using exotic charms to trigger game-changing combos and adapting to the crowd’s ever-changing trends!

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: Pictective
games.summary: Think you're good at spotting images and solving captchas? Join Doma, a curious little cat who's just started training to become a detective! Help Doma take on picture-matching challenges to prove your skills!

games.name: Afterglow Bytes: Reverie by the Shore
games.summary: Run a cozy izakaya in futuristic Bali. Grill skewers, serve patrons, help wandering spirits, and manage supplies to keep your evening haven alive. Every night tells a new story.

games.name: Spell Trigger
games.summary: Unleash modern spell-craft in this third-person multiplayer shooter RPG. Wield the Spell Trigger, a weapon that fuses arcane power with firearms, and confront an otherworldly force behind a mysterious wave of slumber and mortality threatening humanity.

games.name: Acts of Blood
games.summary: Acts of Blood is a Beat ‘em up, Action, 3rd person game which focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in dystopian city of Bandung, Indonesia.

games.name: Eschalism
games.summary: Survival horror game set in a dystopian Indonesia, where the V.O.K. regime has maintained a stranglehold on the nation. As Sane, a Paramita's officer, investigates a cosmic worshipping cult, navigates a non-euclidian world, and fights against monstrous creatures.

games.name: Bounce95
games.summary: Incremental game where you bounce balls on stages you create

games.name: Comanomaly
games.summary: COMANOMALY is a mix between a whodunnit mystery game & horror game, with different randomly selected culprit each playthrough. 🩺 It's 1985. You are Susi, a nurse working for Sudaritra Hospital, you have to protect your patient: a wealthy and powerful man with weird symptoms and peculiar conditions.

games.name: Project: Jurit
games.summary: A zombie survival horror game set in a haunting Indonesian school. Combining atmospheric tension with a deeply engaging narrative, Project: JURIT explores the horrors of survival, friendship, and human nature in the face of a supernatural outbreak.

games.name: Broomstick Exorcist
games.summary: Play as Vikka, a street sweeper who hunts demons at night while keeping the street clean. Devour the darkness in a night filled with demons in this unique 2D, hand-drawn, Manga-inspired beat 'em-up horror adventure.

games.name: Gambit Maestro
games.summary: Gambit Maestro is a 3D tactical roguelite inspired by the strategic depth of the chessboard, infused with atmospheric mystery and narrative twists.

games.name: The Meek Mirtho
games.summary:
The Meek Mirtho is a top-down strategic roguelite. In the demon world, power is everything — and power is earned through fear. You play as Mirtho, a small, harmless demon who has been bullied and cast aside for being “unscary.” But weakness is a matter of perception.

Using your unique talent for manipulation, you escape into the human world to find anxious souls and twist their fears into loyalty. These frightened humans become your army — not through terror, but through wit.

The game blends maze-running and deck-building mechanics. In each wave, you’ll have limited time to explore a grid-based maze, gather followers, and collect scattered equipment (weapons and armor). Equip your human allies to evolve them into new character classes, unlocking them permanently in your collection.

Guide your followers through the gateway to challenge the boss of the wave. Battles unfold as automatic, turn-based card fights, where your preparation determines the outcome. Fail, and your dark little revenge story resets… but your legacy grows stronger with each run.

games.name: Linework
games.summary: Work as a forensic artist in China during the 90s era. Engage with witnesses, uncover mysteries, and solve crime in Linework.

games.name: Irradiant Skies
games.summary: Irradiant Skies is an arcade roguelite blending brick-breaking and bullet-parrying combat. Reflect enemy attacks, chain powerful upgrades, and master unique ships as you ascend through waves of enemies.

games.name: Neaten Up!
games.summary: Neaten Up! is a game where you vacuum up clutter, finding new furniture, and uncover hidden messes in maze-like rooms that unfold as you go.

games.name: Duck Shoot
games.summary: Duck Shoot is an arcade-simulation game where you play as Ashley, an aspiring photographer and a tourist on a mission to capture the perfect duck shot and win the golden duck award from the tropical sanctuary's photography competition. Guiding her is Momo, a cheeky, yet adorable monkey as her mentor.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: Waktunya Kerja!
games.summary: A life (work) simulation game made in RPG Maker 2003 (+ Maniac's Patch). Based on a game made for RaiPGMaker 2025 gamejam, and proudly made by surabayans(??) with a help from friends at Manusia Pagi.

games.name: Neko Michi
games.summary: Build and manage a cozy Meiji-era street for cats. customize buildings, balance tradition and modernity, and create a peaceful cat community

games.name: Handy Farm: Roguelike
games.summary: Welcome to Handy Farm, a cozy farming game with a twist. You are given a small piece of land, a few seeds, and one big goal: survive and thrive while paying your weekly rent. Plant crops, harvest produce, sell goods, and manage resources carefully to keep your farm growing and your landlord happy.

games.name: Match Morphosis
games.summary: Match Morphosis is a Roguelike Match-3 Deckbuilder. Match tiles to defeat enemies, gain artifacts, build synergies and unleash powerful combos. Master your way in this unique turn-based RPG. Kill, death, unlock, repeat. No two runs are the same, no timers, no grinding, no mercy.

games.name: Where Is My Cat?
games.summary: Where is My Cat s a purr-fectly delightful casual game with charming graphics and relaxing gameplay where you help a cute little kitty escape from various obstacles and challenges. Navigate through different levels and use your problem-solving skills to find a way out.

games.name: Grieving: Berduka
games.summary: Mourning Ritual for a Haunted Boarding Room. Uncover the mystery behind the ghost through exploration, puzzles, and a psychological horror narrative.

games.name: Funguys Swarm
games.summary: Funguys Swarm is a cartoony survivor bullet hell where the forest is on fire—and it’s very much not fine. Become a Funguy, arm yourself with forest-crafted weapons, and unleash some bonkers powers on the Fireking’s army. And maybe—just maybe—save the day if you’re skilled (or lucky) enough.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

games.name: Mirth Melody
games.summary: Play as Dodo the duck exploring a beautiful little forest. Strum your favorite guitar and watch as the forest creatures happily vibe along to your music.

games.name: Blades of Mirage
games.summary: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

games.name: War Angels
games.summary: War Angels puts you in charge of a hospital in the middle of a war. With scarce food, limited medicine, and waves of critically injured patients, every decision becomes a moral struggle. Who will you save when you can’t save them all?

games.name: Rated.
games.summary:
In the near future, society has reduced human worth to a simple rating system. Every smile, every gesture, every outfit is judged—and every star determines your place in the world.

You are Echo, an ordinary person living under the constant gaze of others. From the moment you wake up to the time you return home, your choices are weighed: be authentic and risk rejection, or perform for approval and climb the star ladder.

Through short chapters in a single day, you’ll experience life in a world where connection has been replaced with evaluation. With no dialogue—only actions and ratings—Rated tells a story of identity, conformity, and the quiet cost of chasing perfection.

Will you stay true to yourself, or become the flawless mask they want to see?

games.name: Ookami Okami
games.summary: You're dead. But your love life is just beginning! Reborn in the Spirit Realm, take over a crumbling hot spring inn and partner with a brooding masked god who hides more than his face. Explore secrets, rebuild the inn, and flirt through simmering tension in this point-and-click romance visual novel.

games.name: Garuda Emblem
games.summary:
Garuda Emblem is a beat ‘em up game with a taste of RPG content, where you can roam freely in the game’s beautifully hand-drawn world, get immersed in the story, and be the good journalist you are.

Play as Garuda Emblem members, a journalistic student activity unit that uncovers the truth behind the shady part of UNION. As the story unfolds, you’ll encounter various figures that’ll help you along in the journey. You can also upgrade your characters with different skills and abilities using your accumulated experience by beating your enemies to pulp!

Got bored of the main story? Refresh yourself with various side quests and mini games you can discover around the game’s world! Who knows, there might be secrets lying right in front of you all along!

games.name: Lost Eclipse
games.summary: After the city was shrouded with nightmares, you’ve been assigned to dive into this psychological survival-horror adventure to uncover its strange phenomenons that are affiliated to a certain science-tech corporation and bring them to justice.

games.name: Our Monsoon Balcony
games.summary:
Our Monsoon Balcony is a short, atmospheric narrative game crafted with a RPG Maker MV engine and presented in monochrome pixel art.

You play as Arka, an office worker living through the rainy season, one quiet evening, a new encounter on the balcony changes everything. As daily routines unfold and the rain keeps falling, fragments of memory, emotion, and mystery begin to intertwine.

games.name: Once Upon a Kingdom
games.summary: Rebuild civilizations across storybook worlds shaped by ancient legends and myths. Once Upon A Kingdom is a card-based city builder where strategy and tower defense collide. Build your city, defend your realm, and turn the page on a new kingdom.

games.name: Onigashima
games.summary: Onigashima is a psychological horror visual novel with romantic tragedy, supernatural loop mechanics, and dual-layered narration. Play as a nameable protagonist and uncover the truth behind the Red Moon and the devouring of your villagers.

games.name: Smith's Chronicles
games.summary: Forge your legacy as a blacksmith, transforming a humble village into a sanctuary where humans and fantastical races find home and harmony.

games.name: Port of Jumanah
games.summary: From a humble port, you set out to clean the ocean of troublemakers. Hack and harpoon through absurd foes, shady allies, and your own bad calls. The world wants a hero… your friends want you to punch an orca. Both valid. Choose wisely—or don’t. The sea remembers everything.

games.name: Night Shippers
games.summary: You signed up to deliver food in the underworld, alone or with up to 8 friends. Take orders, dodge monsters, and survive the night - or be trapped in hell forever.

games.name: Trianga's Project: Battle Splash 2.0
games.summary: Trianga's Project: Battle Splash 2.0 is a Friendly, Competitive, Team-based Third-Person Shooter inspired from Fast Paced Arena Shooter and modern Class Based Shooter. Using only Water as the main mechanic, Blast away your opponents in various colorful worlds that everyone can enjoy!

games.name: Red Rebellion
games.summary: A sapphic fairy tale mashup as Robin Hood teams up with Red Riding Hood to save their town set in a historically accurate medieval England.

games.name: Whispers of the Luminaries
games.summary:
Whispers of the Luminaries is an idol-themed murder mystery visual novel where you balance social life with detective work.

Investigate, obtain clues and deduce the killer.

games.name: Mizuchi
games.summary: Mizuchi is a fantasy romance visual novel inspired by the Legend of the White Serpent, a famous Asian love story. This yuri version includes other multicultural folklores mixed in.

games.name: Cool Kid Cody
games.summary: In a world of Losers, Cool Kids and Gods, where Losers wish they were Cool Kids, Cool Kids wish they were Gods and Gods rule over all, Cool Kid Cody embarks on his quest for Godhood! All he's gotta do is achieve the impossible: transform the biggest Loser in school into a Cool Kid.

games.name: WinMon
games.summary: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

games.name: Rock Crusher
games.summary: Crush, upgrade, explore! This incremental clicker puts you in control of a little rock crusher on a mysterious planet. Uncover its secrets and your destiny as you complete the skill tree.

games.name: Galleria
games.summary: A compact art gallery simulator that runs quietly on your desktop while you work or study. Perfect for quick breaks, you'll hire artists, create paintings, and grow your gallery business without disturbing your workflow. Ideal for office workers and students.

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Lac Viet Journey
games.summary: Explore Vietnam’s rich flavors and culture as you soar with a little Lạc bird, typing dish names, unlocking upgrades, and journeying across the country.

games.name: Blackblade Revenant
games.summary: Blackblade Revenant is a Sekiro-like action RPG with parry-focused combat set during the fall of an ancient dynasty. Rise from the dead as Revenants and return to the mortal realm with one mission: Kill the King who cheated death.

games.name: Last Seen Online
games.summary: “last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.

games.name: Peaceful Days
games.summary: Peaceful Days is a farming RPG heavily inspired by Harvest Moon series. In this game, you can build your dream from scratch, raise animals, interact with town folks, take part in interesting festivals, discover many secrets and more!

games.name: Ham-Spin
games.summary: Hamster against cats. Can you beat all the cats?

games.name: Tikus Tales
games.summary: Tikus Tales is a colorful 3D platformer featuring Suki and Tuki—two daring mice on a quest to defeat rebellious creatures and free the imprisoned Zodiac guardians. Face off in multi-phase boss battles filled with combat, platforming twists, and charm!

games.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
games.summary: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

games.name: Slap 'em Up!
games.summary:
Slap ’em UP! is a fast-paced competitive game where players enter intense slap battles using skill, timing, and pure nerve.
No weapons. No mercy. Just one hand… and one chance.

Get in on the casual party card game where every hand is a chance to roast your friends! Slap them down with the higher cards, blast them with mocking stickers, or drop emotes they won’t forget. Dress to impress and make your way to the crown. Who’s the real king now?

games.name: Cozy Dive
games.summary: Watch a tiny diver explore the ocean in the corner of your screen. Collect sea creatures, upgrade equipment, and unlock new diving spots.

games.name: Guardian Tactics: Deck of the Chosen
games.summary: Command a squad of guardians in a thrilling deckbuilding, roguelike card battle to save the world from an Android army invasion. Fight, fall, learn, rise again!

games.name: Rogue's Odyssey
games.summary: Explore, Grind, Loot, Die—and repeat! Face hordes of monsters and challenging bosses in a 2.5D pixel roguelike RPG where you can mix and match skills across classes. Be a potion-brewing Warrior or a Firebolt-casting Cat, the choice is yours!

games.name: Aquatia
games.summary: Dive into Aquatia, a third-person anime-action RPG game, where you'll become the master of water magic. Experience the graceful aqua ballet, using water magic to defeat monsters with finesse.

games.name: LightSup!
games.summary: LightSup! is a couch-action co-op game for 1-4 players with rogue-lite elements where you play as adventurers encounter ferocious monsters crawling from the Eclipse Dungeons. Prepare your weapons and protect the Altar of Light at any cost, or the world will be doomed into darkness forever.

games.name: Black OX
games.summary: Black OX is a roguelike deckbuilder where Blackjack meets Tic-Tac-Toe in a wild, tactical clash of cunning combos. Stack cards, twist values, and unleash powerful Oxchips to outsmart your opponent—and flip the game on its head. This isn’t just Blackjack. This is Black OX.

games.name: Kuukiyomi: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.
games.summary: Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Thailand! Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.

games.name: Puni the Florist
games.summary: Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions. Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.

games.name: Artisan Acre
games.summary: Master cheeses, wines, and various delicacies in your own culinary atelier. Craft refined artisanal food products through careful manipulation of temperature and fermentation from living cultures. Expand your operations as you progress through an immersive culinary adventure.

games.name: Hometown Store
games.summary: Experience Simulation Management, the charm of running a retro Thai convenience store from the 1990s! Build trust, unlock nostalgic products, and expand your business to the community.

games.name: In a Bit of Tales
games.summary: In a Bit of Tales is a unique horror anthology game featuring seven spine-chilling stories delivered in an omakase-style experience. Explore haunting dreams, mysterious cults, ghostly schools, and more!

games.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
games.summary: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

games.name: Beloved Bound
games.summary: An adventure game about a boy trapped in a mysterious virtual sanctuary. Explore, solve puzzles, and discover the secrets hidden in a world that never lets you go.

games.name: Neko Station
games.summary: Sit back and relax with Neko Station, a cozy 2D Pixel Art Desktop Idle Game! Manage your very own 'cat train,' decorating it with the perfect furniture to attract a diverse cast of feline customers. Pick them up at various stations and build friendships in this heartwarming adventure.

games.name: Twilight Horizon
games.summary: A surreal sci-fi horror RPG. Play as two protagonists, trapped in two doomed realities. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and survive industrial nightmares in a haunting journey through the Twilight Zone.

games.name: Sous Raccoon
games.summary: Play as a raccoon sous chef managing restaurants while defending customers from monsters in this action-packed roguelike that blends cooking with combat!

games.name: The Last Bloom
games.summary: Margarete receives a letter from Veronika, her kind neighbor, saying she’s ill. Concerned, Margarete decides to visit, but the journey is challenging due to her blindness. Now it’s time for you, her trusty four-legged friend, to guide her and help her reach Veronika’s house.

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is an action-adventure game where the player takes on the role of a Puppeteer trapped in the Nightmare Realm. Set out on a journey to find his friends and escape the nightmare!

games.name: False Princess Iruruu
games.summary: Iruruu, daughter of a nomadic khan, is summoned by the Imperial court to become consort to the divine emperor. However, she soon finds herself targeted by various factions, and it seems that this summons may be more than a simple political move...

games.name: Eternity Breaker
games.summary: Build your class, break the cycle. A 2.5D turn-based roguelike where the skills you gain become your class.

games.name: Escape from Irene: Parasite
games.summary: In Escape from Irene: Parasite, a psychological horror prequel, you play as an examiner in Duskwood. Investigate sickness, anomalies, and strange events as you search for the truth behind Irene.

games.name: Northwind
games.summary: Northwind is a monster-hunting roguelite deckbuilder with a tug-of-war combat twist, card crafting, and a mana management system inspired by Magic: The Gathering.

games.name: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin
games.summary: Conquest Tactics: Realm of Sin is a dark fantasy roguelite with hex-based, turn-based tactical combat. Command your forces, make impactful choices, and navigate a realm consumed by sin—will you restore order or surrender to darkness?

games.name: Cyber Sensation: MicroLife
games.summary: A quirky microgame collection with a 2.5D RPG twist, follow an indie team as they scramble to meet their final deadline in this charming, fast-paced adventure!

games.name: Re:Curse
games.summary: A time-travel mystery visual novel about found-family, connections, and hope in dark times.

games.name: Unyielder
games.summary: Unyielder is an intense Boss-Rush Movement-Shooter with a flexible and exploitable Roguelite-Looter sandbox. Carve your way through the war-torn lands of Antarctica, Hunt down war machines and Assemble your arsenal of destruction.

games.name: Stack to Ascension
games.summary: The beasts have ravaged your ancestral sect, leaving you as the sole survivor. With your cultivation regressed to Qi Condensation stage, you must start anew. Rebuild strength, recruit disciples, and uncover the dark truth behind the disaster.

games.name: Siegeturtle
games.summary: Upgrade your turtle, recruit cute animals, and blast through waves in an idle roguelite RPG. Swim farther each run, unlock new skills, and edge closer to home with every upgrade.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: Stormbridge
games.summary: Build a bridge settlement while outrunning an impending storm in this roguelite city builder. Unlock upgrades and pets between runs as you unravel the storm's origin. Can you survive and build the longest self-sufficient bridge?

games.name: Detective Hindsight
games.summary: Solve a variety of perplexing cases in the sleuthing shoes of Detective Hindsight - who gets help from Phoebe: a young orphaned girl with dreams of being a storyteller and powers to look into the past. Uncover the truth with her sketches done in crayon. The catch? She can't draw very well.

games.name: Arcana Academy
games.summary: Build your magic academy in this card realm, recruit students, manage their tasks or classes, perform rituals, and explore a perilous magical world. Faced with the encroachment of the Abyss, can you live up to people's expectations and save the empire from crisis?

games.name: Research Story
games.summary: Set out to discover and record plants and creatures for the Violet Archive. Grow crops, tame animals, and build the perfect farm! Forge friendships along the way as you begin your life as a researcher!

games.name: Compensation Not Guaranteed
games.summary: Peek into Southeast Asian politics through a lens darkly. Check ownership for authenticity, listen to stories, decide who should give up their land in the name of PROGRESS!

games.name: Tails & Talons
games.summary: Tails & Talons is a roguelite deckbuilder where spell-casting cards and card-matching combos intertwine to create a addicting and strategic experience! Join a colorful cast of furry adventurers, unleash powerful spells, and chain devastating combos as you descend down a mysterious tower..

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Illusive Domain
games.summary: Deflect, parry, and defeat your opponents through intense boss rush action. Fight for you and your allies’ freedom, lest you remain entombed forever more.

games.name: Our Bad Ending
games.summary: A girl’s dark, romantic desire for her best friend and the spiral of pursuing a doomed love.

games.name: Identifile
games.summary:
Navigate your operating system and battle viruses in this bullethell roguelike where folders act as treacherous dungeon rooms!

Your computer has been infected by an unknown virus, and with your antivirus down, it’s up to you—the cursor—to save it from being overrun. This action-packed roguelike plunges you into the depths of your file explorer, where every folder is a dungeon teeming with threats, and every file holds secrets, treasures, and dangers.

Navigate through procedurally generated levels filled with relentless viruses. Utilize unique circling combat mechanics to eliminate threats, all while collecting powerful EXE files that radically change the gameplay. Inspired by Pokemon Ranger and The Binding of Isaac, Identifile seamlessly blends bullet hell action with deep exploration. Uncover hidden paths, discover game-altering power-ups, and reclaim your system, one dungeon at a time.

games.name: Kissaten Dream
games.summary: From hand-grinding beans to designing the perfect layout, every detail is in your hands. In Kissaten Dream, you serve a cast of unique customers, manage your business, and transform your humble coffee shop into a beloved local gem.

games.name: Yellow Trouble
games.summary: 8-way water gun blasting horizontal 2D arcade co-op shoot ‘em up, with ducks?!

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: A Witch's Stop
games.summary:
A Witch’s Stop is a rhythm game where you play as members of a band full of teen witches. It consists of a gameplay fusion of music and magic where you cast spells along with the rhythm.

Take a peek into the cozy seaside village where there’s magic, witches, and… high school. In this coming-of-age story, follow three witches through a journey of self-discovery as they try to find their way through the pressure of an unchanging magic society. How do they balance the duality of a normal life and a constant magical action?

games.name: Repeat After Death
games.summary: The task is simple, defeat enemies using various Characters. But, your past move will consume you the more you continue down the path. Discover the dungeon mysteries while engaging with the other dungeon dwellers

events.name: New Game+ Showcase 01.08.2026
events.description: Introducing a new type of games showcase, the New Game+ Showcase! Putting authentic excitement back at the center of game reveals.

games.name: Blind Descent
games.summary: Blind Descent is a multiplayer open-world survival adventure game with up to 4 players set in the Martian underground.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.name: Prologue: Go Wayback!
games.summary: Prologue: Go Wayback! is a single-player open-world emergent survival roguelike where every journey is unique. Traverse a new wilderness that is generated for you every time you play. Chart your path, overcome the elements, and write your own story of exploration.

games.name: Beautiful Light
games.summary: Beautiful Light is a PvPvP(vE) tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

games.name: Project Shadowglass
games.summary: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: Distant Shore: Bretagne
games.summary: Explore the ruins of a former research site, devastated by climate collapse. Wield magnetic gauntlets to move, bend, or break metal as you recover lost BIO2 data and uncover your brother’s trail — all while evading the Cloud, a sentient weather entity that watches your every move.

games.name: Avowed
games.summary:
Welcome to the Living Lands, a mysterious island filled with adventure and danger.

Set in the fictional world of Eora that was first introduced to players in the Pillars of Eternity franchise, Avowed is a first-person fantasy action RPG from the award-winning team at Obsidian Entertainment.

The Living Lands is a place that feels foreign yet somewhat intrinsic to you as it feels the island itself is calling out to you for help. Explore an island home to many different environments and landscapes, each with their own unique ecosystem.

Mix and match swords, spells, guns, and shields to fight your way. Dig into your grimoire for spells to trap, freeze or burn enemies, bash them with your shield, or use range bows to attack from a distance.

Companions from a spread of species will fight alongside you, with their own unique set of abilities. From a former mercenary to an eccentric wizard, they will be part of your journey with your choices shaping them as you help them with their quests.

games.name: Grounded 2
games.summary: Shrunk again, but the world is much larger. In this open-world, single-player or co-op survival adventure, craft weapons and armor, build your base, and traverse the playground on your buggy. But something else is out there—and it hasn’t forgotten you.

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Forsaken Realms: Vahrin's Call
games.summary: Adventure awaits in this narrative driven fantasy action-RPG. The war-torn city of Vahrin stands before you on the brink of collapse and in desperate need of aid. As a mercenary in search of your next…opportunity, will you answer Vahrin’s Call?

games.name: Dragontwin
games.summary: Dragontwin is an upcoming open-world RPG/Strategy game in which the player shapes their own destiny as a Dragontwin, a legendary mortal soulbound to a powerful dragon.

games.name: The Cube
games.summary: The Cube is an MMO RPG shooter. A giant, levitating Cube with rotating rows and edges. Hidden within is an unknown equation capable of altering the laws of reality. Can you survive another turn?

games.name: Atomic Heart
games.summary: Atomic Heart is an adventure first-person shooter, events of which unfolds in an alternate universe during the high noon of the Soviet Union. The principal character of the game is a special agent P-3, who after an unsuccessful landing on enterprise "3826" is trying to figure out what went wrong.

games.name: Immortal: Gates of Pyre
games.summary: Immortal: Gates of Pyre is an action-packed Battle Strategy game that strips out the chores and focuses on the fun for everyone. Immortal lets the player assume the form of a god-like commander that forges alliances, commands armies, and conquers their enemies from on high.

games.name: ExeKiller
games.summary: Retro futuristic, single player, action adventure game with western vibes. You are a bounty hunter trying to survive in dystopian, post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Far Far West
games.summary: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Erosion
games.summary: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

games.name: Tom Clancy's The Division 2
games.summary: The Division 2 is an action-shooter RPG set in an open-world. Play in co-op and PvP modes that offer more variety in missions and challenges, new progression systems with unique twists and surprises, and fresh gaming innovations to engage players for years to come.

games.name: Alpha Response
games.summary: From Gooseman, creator of the original Counter-Strike mod - Alpha Response delivers intense police action in dynamic, real-world environments. Fight solo or with friends against diverse enemies in high-stakes missions that demand tactical precision and split-second decisions.

games.name: Sand: Raiders Of Sophie
games.summary: In an alternate 1910, scavenge the sands of Sophie in towering Tramplers. Build your highly customizable walking base. Squad up or go solo. Gather loot, weapons, precious artifacts. Clash with other players in a brutal procedurally generated desert forged by history and chaos.

games.name: Old School RuneScape
games.summary: Relive the challenging levelling system and risk-it-all PvP of the biggest retro styled MMO. Play with millions of other players in this piece of online gaming heritage where the community controls the development so the game is truly what you want it to be!

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: RuneScape
games.summary: RuneScape is a high fantasy open world MMORPG. Explore an ever changing and evolving living world where new challenges, skills, and quests await. Featuring unprecedented player freedom, you choose how to play, adventure, and grow.

games.name: Dark Light: Survivor
games.summary: In a dying multiverse, the Phantom Train is your last hope. Traverse a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world of nightmarish creatures. Experience dynamic shifts between top-down and third-person views, deep customization, and epic battles across universes in this action roguelike survival game.

games.name: Nested Lands
games.summary: A ruthless settlement-survival RPG in a post-plague medieval world full of cruelty and despair. Gather survivors, build a settlement, craft, master your skills, survive, and endure alone or in online co-op.

games.name: Tape 101
games.summary: A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler-Ross model - the five stages of grief: denial, anger, bargaining, depression, and acceptance - where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real

games.name: Unawake
games.summary: Unawakens is a melee first person action adventure game in a surreal realm which combines ancient history and fantasy together. Live your journey beyond the battlefields of the Fallen Angels and the giant Unawakens. The Eternal War continues!

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
games.summary: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader
games.summary: You will take on the role of a Rogue Trader, a scion of an ancient dynasty of daring privateers, that reign over their own merchant empire and explore the fringes of Imperial space with the blessing of the Emperor Himself. Thanks to their Warrant of Trade - the Rogue Trader is endowed with privileges and power beyond imagination as well as the task of expanding the borders of the Imperium. At their disposal is a gargantuan voidship of immense power and innumerable servants and personnel ready to do the bidding of their lord. Their adventures begin in the vast Koronus Expanse - a treacherous region of unexplored space at the edge of Humanity’s domain.

games.name: Towerborne
games.summary: The Belfry stands as a beacon of hope and safety amongst the ruins of humanity and the City of Numbers, with monsters lurking right outside the tower’s walls. You are an Ace, born anew from the spirit realm with the skills, the grit, and the determination to protect the people of the Belfry.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Sprint City
games.summary: Sprint City is a shared-world competitive 2D platformer from the original creators of SpeedRunners, where tight controls, explosive speed, and hidden shortcuts fuel high-intensity racing.

games.name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.summary: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

games.name: Core Keeper
games.summary: Explore an endless cavern of creatures, relics and resources in a mining sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Mine, build, fight, craft and farm to unravel the mystery of the ancient Core.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Starfinder: Afterlight
games.summary:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

games.name: Gallipoli
games.summary: Land on the battlefields of the Middle Eastern Front of World War 1! Gallipoli brings the most authentic WW1 FPS battles yet, with desert warfare, beach landings, historical classes and realistic weaponry.

games.name: Where Winds Meet
games.summary: Where Winds Meet is a free-to-play wuxia action-adventure RPG set in China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. Players take on the role of a wandering adventurer known as a youxia, wielding a variety of weapons including swords, spears, fans, and umbrellas, each paired with distinct martial arts styles. The open world spans multiple regions and supports both single-player and multiplayer modes, with cooperative dungeons, PvP arenas, and a range of casual activities. Combat combines light and heavy attacks, martial art skills, mystic arts, and defensive maneuvers like dodges, blocks, and deflects.

games.name: Dinoblade
games.summary: Dinoblade is an action RPG game that takes place right after a major event that changed what we know about Dinosaurs. You shall set out on a journey as a young Spinosaurus that can use a Great Sword fighting against other Dinosaurs that uses weapons as well to stop an extinction.

games.name: Crimson Desert
games.summary: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure game set in the beautiful yet brutal continent of Pywel. Embark on a journey as the Greymane Kliff and restore what has been lost. Explore uncharted lands, fight against threats that stand in your way, and discover the wonders the world has in store.

games.name: Last Man Sitting
games.summary: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

games.name: Resident Evil 7: Biohazard - Gold Edition
games.summary:
Set in modern day rural America and taking place after the dramatic events of Resident Evil 6, players experience the terror directly from the first person perspective. Resident Evil 7 embodies the series' signature gameplay elements of exploration and tense atmosphere that first coined "survival horror" some twenty years ago; meanwhile, a complete refresh of gameplay systems simultaneously propels the survival horror experience to the next level.

The Gold Edition contains the full game plus DLC: the Banned Footage Vol. 1 and 2, and the End of Zoe epilogue episode.

games.name: Resident Evil Village: Gold Edition
Resident Evil Requiem: Deluxe Edition
games.summary:
Resident Evil Requiem Deluxe Edition. Includes the full game and the Deluxe Kit. A must have for true survivors.

The Deluxe Kit contains the following content:
- Grace's Costume: Dimitrescu & Film Noir
- Leon's Costume: RE4, Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Screen Filter: Apocalypse & Film Noir
- Four weapon skins including S&S M232 Weapon Skin: Apocalypse
- Charms: Mr. Raccoon & DSO Emblem
- Audio Pack: Raccoon City Classic
- Files: Letters from 1998

Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Forza Horizon 6
games.summary: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend at the Horizon Festival. Start your journey as a tourist and explore a world full of hit music and Japanese culture. Build a Valley Estate, acquire awe-inspiring homes, and display your prized car collection in fully Customizable Garages. Cruise the roads with your friends and join Car Meets around Japan, unleash your imagination with EventLab and build together in Horizon CoLab.

games.name: Beast of Reincarnation
games.summary: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

games.name: Kiln
games.summary: An online, multiplayer, pottery party brawler from Double Fine Productions. Grab your friends to assemble a team of colorful spirits, then sculpt ceramic battle armor on a pottery wheel. The size and shape of your pots determine their play-style and abilities—work together to douse the enemy's kiln!

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

events.name: Taipei Game Show 2026
events.description: Organized by the Taipei Computer Association, Taipei Game Show (TGS) evolved from a modest event of just a few thousand attendees in 2003 into one of Asia’s leading gaming events, drawing hundreds of thousands of visitors from around the world.

games.name: Kirby Air Riders
games.summary:
Kirby Air Riders is the long-awaited sequel to Kirby Air Ride on the Gamecube.

Pick your rider, pick your machine, and mount up for competition! Take on your rivals in frantic arena battles or fast-paced races on the ground and in the air. Use the Boost Charge button to brake and control your turns as your machine automatically fights for top speed. Fill your Boost Charge Gauge as you drift around the bend and release it to trigger an explosive dash!

games.name: Animal Crossing: New Horizons - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary:
A carefree new life is just beyond the horizon! Step off the plane and onto your very own deserted island where new friends, discoveries and opportunities are waiting for you.

Escape to a deserted island and create your own paradise as you explore, create, and customize in Animal Crossing: New Horizons. Your island getaway has a wealth of natural resources that can be used to craft everything from tools to creature comforts. You can hunt down insects at the crack of dawn, decorate your paradise throughout the day, or enjoy the sunset on the beach while fishing in the ocean. The time of day and season match real life, so each day on your island is a chance to check in and find new surprises all year round.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Animal Crossing: New Horizons uses the unique features of the console to offer even more ways to enjoy your island paradise!

games.name: Mario Kart World
games.summary: Mario Kart World is a kart racing game for the Nintendo Switch 2, featuring characters from the Mario franchise. It introduces an open-world design to the series, allowing players to drive freely between courses rather than selecting them from a menu. Races support up to 24 players and include new mechanics such as off-roading, boat racing, rail grinding, and wall riding. The game features a Knockout Tour elimination mode where racers compete across connected courses with periodic eliminations at checkpoints, as well as a Free Roam mode for open exploration and collectible-finding.

games.name: Dragon Quest VII Reimagined
games.summary: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is a modern remake of DRAGON QUEST VII, which originally launched on PlayStation in 2000. In this new reimagined version of the game, the core concept of the original title remains, but the battle mechanics, graphics and story have all been updated and improved, providing players with a more streamlined and focused experience. In particular, the graphics in the game were completely overhauled from the original, using real-life doll figures for the characters and monsters that were scanned into the game to create stunning hand-crafted visuals. This definitive version of the game is perfect for fans who want to revisit the beloved story or newcomers who are diving into the world for the first time.

games.name: Vampir
games.summary: The MMORPG for vampires. Vampir: Heir of Blood!

games.name: Rainbow Six Siege
games.summary: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege is a tactical first-person shooter focused on close-quarters combat between teams of five. Players select from a roster of operators drawn from counter-terrorism units around the world, each with unique gadgets and abilities. One team attacks objectives such as defusing bombs or rescuing hostages, while the other team fortifies and defends. The game emphasizes destructible environments, with players able to breach walls, ceilings, and floors to create new lines of sight. There is no respawning within rounds, making each player's survival critical. The title has no single-player campaign but includes training modes and cooperative scenarios against AI opponents.

games.name: SD Gundam G Generation Eternal
games.summary: Dive into the world of Gundam and enjoy the game's unique system to upgrade, develop, and form squads with your favorite Mobile Suits and characters.

games.name: Quit Today
games.summary:
"Quit Today" is a side-scrolling action game around the workplace theme.

One usual day, when you step into the company, all the colleagues attack you because they think you want to resign!

To figure out what happened, you start a fighting trip with your briefcase, and realize the company darkness which you ever ignored is so hateful. You can't keep enduring the high-level's behavior, determined to send the resignation challenge to this company formally!

games.name: Falling with Ice Phoenix!: Cozy Version
games.summary: Falling with Ice Phoenix! combining the classic gravity fall platformer, sprited and high-octane action game, you and the cutie monster girls venture downwards to find the lost orb, facing traps and sexy monster lords ahead, an exciting adventure to the unknown lays ahead...

games.name: XXL Woofia
games.summary:
Power! Laughter! Energy!

Welcome to WOOFIA, a land where humans, Beastfolks, and Hominians of all kinds thrive in vibrant harmony.

From vast grasslands to an ever-buzzing city that never sleeps, to primal volcanic islands, dazzling futuristic metropolises, and of course, a gym brimming with raw masculinity...

Join our protagonist, Ying Hugeeu, in this diverse world as he embarks on an adventurous journey, meeting all kinds of unique men and igniting fiery passions along the way!

games.name: Orisries
games.summary:
Orisries is an adult simulation game designed to immerse you into a fantasy world with its captivating plot and distinctive gameplay.
Recruit new heroes, including celestial beings, sect members, or elves; train the heroes and unlock new skills to help you conquer the world.

games.name: Capoo Stack
games.summary: Capoo Stack is a fun and casual stacking game that's perfect for killing time! This time, our adorable Capoo needs your help to reach new heights. Simply stack each Capoo as it jumps up—easy to play, hard to master! Test your limits and see how many layers you can build!

games.name: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33
games.summary: Lead the members of Expedition 33 on their quest to destroy the Paintress so that she can never paint death again. Explore a world of wonders inspired by Belle Époque France and battle unique enemies in this turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics.

games.name: Infinity Nikki
games.summary: Infinity Nikki, the fifth installment in the Nikki series by Infold Games. Step into a UE5-powered open-world styling fantasy filled with exploration, platforming, puzzles, and more. Travel across Miraland with Nikki and Momo, uncover hidden secrets, and use outfit abilities to overcome challenges and shape your style.

games.name: Arknights: Endfield
games.summary: Arknights: Endfield is a 3D real-time strategy RPG developed by HYPERGRYPH. You will take on the role of the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, set out across Talos-II to uncover its secrets, and defend and expand the frontiers of human civilization.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors: Origins
games.summary: Experience an unrivaled sense of realism on the battlefield, fueled by exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action and the rush of massive armies! A nameless hero conquers the turbulent and chaotic Three Kingdoms in this latest DYNASTY WARRIORS series entry.

games.name: Zenless Zone Zero
games.summary: Zenless Zone Zero is an all-new 3D action game from HoYoverse, here to provide a thrilling combat experience. Build a squad of up to three and begin your assault with Basic and Special Attacks. Dodge and Parry to neutralize your opponents' counterattacks, and when they're Stunned, unleash a powerful combo of Chain Attacks to finish them off! Remember, different opponents have different traits, and it would be prudent to use their weaknesses to your advantage.

games.name: Genshin Impact
games.summary: Genshin Impact is an open-world action RPG, where you embark on a journey across Teyvat to find your lost sibling and seek answers from The Seven, the gods of each element. Explore this wondrous world, join forces with a diverse range of characters, and unravel the countless mysteries that Teyvat holds...

games.name: Honkai: Star Rail
games.summary: Honkai: Star Rail is an all-new strategy-RPG title in the Honkai series that takes players on a cosmic adventure across the stars. Hop aboard the Astral Express and experience the galaxy's infinite wonders on this journey filled with adventure and thrill.

games.name: Wuthering Waves
games.summary:
Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and surmount the Lament.

The game features fast-paced combat with a variety of mechanics such as Extreme Evasion and Dodge Counter. You can also absorb the remaining of the monsters you've defeated and use their power in battles.

games.name: Mr Love: Queen's Choice
games.summary:
Who will be your soul mate? Mr Love: Queen's Choice is a romance simulation game that gives you the opportunity to text, chat and even call the main characters while developing your own career as a media producer.

In a world filled with superpowers, fantasy, and surprise, you will experience a girl’s whole life and get deeply involved with 4 male characters, feeling their romance, love, mystery and conflict in a deep story spanning dozens of episodes.

games.name: Arknights
games.summary: Take on the role of a key member of Rhodes Island, a pharmaceutical company that fights both a deadly infection and the unrest it leaves in its wake. Together with your leader Amiya, you’ll recruit Operators, train them, then assign them to various operations to protect the innocent and resist those who would thrust the world into turmoil.

games.name: Arena of Valor
games.summary:
Experience Arena of Valor, an epic new 5v5 multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) designed by Tencent Games!

Call on your teammates to join you in the jungle! Crush your enemies in classic 5v5 combat in real time! Draw first blood, carry your team, and become legendary in the arena!

games.name: Love and Deepspace
games.summary: As the brand new installment of the popular Mr. Love series, Love and Deepspace allows you to step into a sci-fi world where love knows no bounds. With immersive cutscenes, 3D storylines and interactions, love is truly within reach!

games.name: Valorant
games.summary: Valorant is a character-based 5v5 tactical shooter set on the global stage. Outwit, outplay, and outshine your competition with tactical abilities, precise gunplay, and adaptive teamwork.

games.name: League of Legends
games.summary: League of Legends is a fast-paced, competitive online game that blends the speed and intensity of an RTS with RPG elements. Two teams of powerful champions, each with a unique design and playstyle, battle head-to-head across multiple battlefields and game modes. With an ever-expanding roster of champions, frequent updates and a thriving tournament scene, League of Legends offers endless replayability for players of every skill level.

games.name: Delta Force
games.summary: Delta Force is a free-to-play tactical first-person shooter developed by Team Jade and published by TiMi Studio Group. A reboot of the classic series originally created by NovaLogic, the game features large-scale multiplayer modes including a Warfare mode for massive PvP battles and Hazard Operations, an extraction-style mode. Players choose from a roster of operators with unique abilities fitting into Assault, Support, Engineer, or Recon archetypes. The game also includes a single-player and cooperative campaign inspired by the film Black Hawk Down, recreating Operation Gothic Serpent.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.summary: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade is an enhanced and expanded version of Final Fantasy VII Remake that features a new episode starring Yuffie and introduces an exhilarating new story arc with numerous gameplay additions for players to enjoy.

games.name: Octopath Traveler 0
games.summary:
All the definitive elements of the Octopath Traveler series return in this exciting prequel set in the realm of Orsterra. Embark on a brand new adventure of your own creation in this stunning HD-2D RPG, Octopath Traveler 0!

Brand-new features to the series include a character creation system where you get to become the hero, and town building mechanics as you seek to restore your devastated home.

games.name: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.summary:
The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

games.name: Killer Inn
games.summary: A corpse has been found... and everyone is a suspect. You have been chosen to participate in a one-night-only game of death, deceit, and deduction. Will you be a wolf? Or perhaps a lamb with the means to fight back... In deception we trust.

games.name: Bravely Default: Flying Fairy - HD Remaster
games.summary:
Bravely Default, the first title in the Bravely series, remastered in high definition for a single screen. Discover the origins of the classic Brave and Default battle system alongside new and enhanced features. The story of light and shadow that never fades is reborn!

This version includes two new minigames: Luxencheer Rhythm Catch and Ringabel’s Panic Cruise.

games.name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Imprisonment
games.summary:
Fight the war for ancient Hyrule! Step on to the battlefield as Princess Zelda, King Rauru, and other legendary heroes as you fight to reclaim your homeland— and live the story of Demon King Ganondorf's invasion that was only briefly alluded to in The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom game.

Princess Zelda is not alone in this war! Join Mineru, the Sages, and even some brand-new heroes in battles against Ganondorf's forces. Combine powerful Zonai Devices with your heroes' signature abilities to take down powerful bosses and their legions of minions.

games.name: Metroid Prime 4: Beyond
games.summary:
Deadly sharpshooter Sylux has finally caught up with renowned bounty hunter Samus Aran! After an unexpected accident in the wake of their clash, Samus finds herself transported to Viewros— a mysterious planet once inhabited by an ancient race. Now she must explore this planet, all while battling the strange creatures that inhabit it, to find her way home.

Scan your surroundings for clues, make the most of your equipment and weapons, and use Samus's newfound psychic abilities— and her technologically advanced bike, the Vi-O-La— to traverse and explore the environment. Operate mechanisms, control your charge beam, and more— you'll need every tool at your disposal to survive and escape Viewros!

games.name: Super Mario Galaxy + Super Mario Galaxy 2
games.summary: Travel the stars with Mario in enhanced versions of these beloved adventures.

games.name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
games.summary: A new adventure awaits within Lumiose City, where an urban redevelopment plan is underway to shape the city into a place that belongs to both people and Pokémon. Please look forward to seeing it for yourself.​​

games.name: Donkey Kong Bananza
games.summary: Donkey Kong Bananza is exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2! Explore a vast underground world—by smashing your way through it! Bash, throw, and climb through just about anything in DK’s brand-new 3D platforming action-adventure game!

games.name: Super Mario Party Jamboree: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV
games.summary: Super Mario Party Jamboree is getting even more minigames and an upgrade on Nintendo Switch 2! The upgrade expands on the base game and adds Nintendo Switch 2 gameplay features, such as mouse controls, enhanced rumble, sound recognition, and modes that use a camera accessory (sold separately).

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Alex
games.summary: A DLC adding the character Alex to Street Fighter 6's roster.

events.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Direct 1.29.2026
events.description: Join us on Jan 29 at 6am PT for the Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream Direct! The presentation will last roughly 20 minutes and provide more info on the upcoming Nintendo Switch game.

games.name: Tomodachi Life: Living the Dream
games.summary: Create Mii characters based on family and friends, someone you admire, or something completely original—there are plenty of personality traits, little quirks, and physical traits to choose from—including some face customization options you haven’t seen before! Go deep into getting every detail just right, or create Miis quickly and easily by answering some simple questions, and then help them explore their likes and dislikes, find relationships, and get up to all sorts of fun. Your Miis are bound to surprise you as they take on a life of their own!

events.name: World of Warcraft: State of Azeroth 2026
events.description: Join Holly Longdale and Ion Hazzikostas and find out about World of Warcraft’s 2026 roadmap, plans, and content.

games.name: World of Warcraft
games.summary: World of Warcraft is a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game (MMORPG) set in the Warcraft universe. Players assume the roles of Warcraft heroes as they explore, adventure, and quest across a vast world. Being "Massively Multiplayer," World of Warcraft allows thousands of players to interact within the same world. Whether adventuring together or fighting against each other in epic battles, players will form friendships, forge alliances, and compete with enemies for power and glory.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Midnight
games.summary:
The second of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

Introducing Housing!
Before you put down roots in your own cozy corner of Azeroth later this year, jump into our virtual tour for an early glimpse at the customization options that await you.

Explore New and Reimagined Zones
The battle between the Light and the Void spans across four zones as you discover new allies and confront ancient enemies.
- Silvermoon City
- Eversong
- Zul'Aman
- Harandar
- Voidstorm

New Features and Improvements
As the Void invasion descends upon Quel'Thalas, an array of new features add more depth and improvements to our evolving world.
- Prey
- Devourer Demon Hunter
- Haranir
- Dungeons and Raids
- New and Returning Player Experience
- Transmog Updates

games.name: World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria Classic
games.summary:
