games.summary: In Ruffy and the Riverside, you wield the magic power of SWAP, using it to Copy & Paste textures within the game world. Turn ice into lava or waterfalls into vines as you ride hay bales, explore, fight, and solve puzzles throughout Riverside. Unleash your imagination in this quirky open-world action game that literally lets you change the world!

games.name: Grindworm
games.summary: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine.

games.name: Selini
games.summary: Collect the lost memories of the protagonist in a vast and ruined world, filled with ancient mysteries, minimal Cycladic islands and a forgotten metropolis that holds a dark secret.

games.name: Holy Shoot
games.summary: In Holy Shoot, the player embarks on a journey as a member of The Sanctum. The ultimate goal is to defeat the powerful demons that represent the Seven Deadly Sins. Each character, is granted unique abilities and traits that make them valuable assets in the fight against demonic forces.

games.name: Forgotten Eras
games.summary: Explore a Slavic folklore-inspired 2.5D Metroidvania. Guide Ivan and the Grey Wolf through a mythic kingdom, wield runes, solve puzzles, and face legends such as Domovoy and Baba Yaga reborn in a stylized, atmospheric world.

games.name: Thief's Shelter
games.summary: Uncover what happened at Highburn Mansion — before it unravels your mind. Investigate, solve intricate puzzles, document elusive evidence, and question every shadow. Thief’s Shelter is a first-person psychological mystery where the deeper you dig, the more reality slips away.

games.name: The Double
games.summary: Tarot meets Blackjack with psychological horror inspired by Dostoevsky. A gore card game based on one of the strangest novels. Gameplay with puzzles, dark themes, surreal horror, cards and black humor. Experimental gameplay blending multiple mechanics

games.name: Super Blowfish Castle
games.summary: Physics are your best frenemy in this cozy chaotic puzzle-solving platformer where you guide a small blowfish back to its castle just by pressing one button.

games.name: No Man's Home
games.summary: You wander into the dangerous Asran Exclusion Zone. You will have to survive hunger, thirst, dangerous factions, radioactive emissions and the wild life. Remember, this is no man's home and you are not the hero.

games.name: The Bunker Notes
games.summary: "The Bunker Notes" is a visual novel about a concrete trap where the past whispers through the cracks of rusted doors. In this world, survival is everything; meeting another person might be your last mistake.

games.name: Caromble!
games.summary: This is not just another brick breaker game. This is Caromble!, a fresh new take on the brick break game! Free the corrupted world and fight evil with physics-based destruction, puzzles, explosions, skill-levels, power-ups, mayhem, more explosions, further puzzles, speedruns, superscore medals, unlockable challenges and some surprises you would't expect in a brick breaker game. Brick break your way to glory and discover a world of nostalgic wonder. Let’s get ready to Caromble!

games.name: Hain
games.summary: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

games.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
games.summary: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

games.name: Frankenstein's Monster
games.summary: Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - In roguelite single-player, or social hangout multiplayer.

games.name: Blood Mall: Part II
games.summary: Blood Mall: Part II is a retro-style dinosaur horror game that picks up exactly where Blood Mall left off. Are you prepared to put an end to the Hastovenator Crisis, or have you bitten off more than you can chew?

games.name: No One Leaves the Field
games.summary: A first-person folk horror game set on a cursed farm where the wheat shifts each time you enter. Search for your car keys, uncover the family’s dark ritual, and beware—something ancient walks between the stalks.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Talystro
games.summary: Talystro is a rougelite-deckbuilder where you combine dice and cards to defeat your enemies. The catch? Instead of chipping away at their HP, you must macth their value. Collect, upgrade and enchant your cards. Discover game-breaking artifacts, power up your dice and defeat the Necrodicer!

games.name: Akatori
games.summary: A colorful action platformer with metroidvania elements and a staff that unlocks unique combat techniques and new ways to overcome obstacles. Explore beautiful worlds, fight monsters, and help Mako stop the amber storms that poison all living things.

games.name: Rogolf
games.summary:
ROGOLF is a minigolf roguelite, where each level has its own rules and each run is different.
Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top!

games.name: Rogue Climber
games.summary: You've only got a short time to climb. An army of enemies and traps are waiting to stop you. Manage your equipment, hone your build, and master your platforming techniques to climb higher than anyone before you.You think you've got what it takes? I don't think so.

games.name: Katanaut
games.summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

games.name: GridBeat!
games.summary: Dungeons! Danger! Rhythm Action! You just hacked into the biggest corporation in the world and stole an unfeasibly valuable amount of data, but getting in was the easy part. To get back out you’ll need to explore the Mainframe, solve puzzles, battle security programs… and do it all on the beat!

games.name: Zoo Wars
games.summary: Battle with cute animals and fruits! Build a deck of 6 cards and battle in this simple yet deep, real-time online PvP tower defense for two players!

games.name: Bulk
games.summary: Collect cards, mix them, watch them rise their rank, sell for gold, and invest in upgrades. Stack, mix, sell and repeat... The machines in this dark fantasy factory keep humming, and the profits are waiting for you...

games.name: Smashometry
games.summary: Smashometry is a neon-soaked, three-button reflex score-attack game. Hit matching shapes, survive escalating speed, stack insane combos, and climb global leaderboards as the screen erupts with colour and an electrifying original soundtrack.

games.name: Killing Momentum: Umbral Moon
games.summary: You are the commander, and your choices define your fate. Lead warriors on a perilous journey under the ghastly Umbral Moon. Defeat brutal enemies in tactical combat where momentum is everything. Brave deadly narrative encounters and manage the volatile bonds of your team of misfits to survive.

games.name: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
games.summary: After a visit to the psychologist that went horribly wrong you’re trapped in the mind of a game developer on the brink of physical and emotional burnout during the last stages of an intense project. Experience a metroidvania drenched in anxiety based on a very true story.

games.name: Nimillion: The Last Expedition
games.summary: Metroidvania Spaceship adventure with physics-based rocket ship controls. Retro-inspired Thruster-only flight, unlock and upgrade abilities, solve physics puzzles, battle tough bosses, conquer brutal terrain. Easy to learn, hard to master old-school thrills!

games.name: Shattered Chess
games.summary:
You only have 10 moves. Every capture counts for scoring.
Build huge combo chains, multiply your score, and push your run as far as possible.
Upgrade powerful passives, discover broken synergies, and survive bosses that completely twist the rules of the game.

games.name: Infinite Ruins
games.summary: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

games.name: Gravity's Edge
games.summary: Begin an epic space journey filled with strange worlds, engaging puzzles, and a dense Afro-punk theme. Another challenge also awaits you in 'Survival'. There you will face off against oncoming hordes while searching for the Ability Anvils. Are you ready to become a Kassler?

games.name: City Game Studio
games.summary: You are the founder of your video game company. The starting point belongs to you, in your garage, or think big instead of small by acquiring your first local. At the end of the day, your decisions will make your studio a success and will mark the Video Game History.

games.name: Mosaica: Arboreal
games.summary: If "Diablo" and "Cookie Clicker" had a cute goblincore baby. An enchanting RPG mosaic puzzle where every mouse click evokes the mysterious power of nature.

games.name: Fortune Avenue
games.summary: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?

games.name: Slots & Diapers
games.summary: Absurd incremental game where you turn even liquid assets into financial glory! Spin for jackpots and hire veteran gamblers to automate the madness. Use permanent upgrades and 'mishaps' to accelerate your progress! Simple. Messy. Addictive.

games.name: Sneak In
games.summary: Sneak In is a fun, challenging and addictive marble shooter game. Stop the evil and greedy snake Seth from eating all your beloved marbles that slowly sneak into the marvelous jungle of Chicahua. Seth, the fearless reptile who is living there for ages also wants to collect the precious marbles. Stop him by triggering chain reactions and combinations of three marbles and play through over 200 unique, colorful and challenging levels to reach the top spot on the scoreboard. Challenge your friends on the endless mode and beat their highscore. Sneak In is one of the most addictive marbles game you will ever play.

games.name: Infinicrypt
games.summary: Take control of one of 3 mighty heroes to vanquish an evil as old as time. Dodge attacks, slay monsters, and collect items in this bullet-hell dungeon-delving roguelike! Are you ready for the infinite depths?

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Prime Monster
games.summary: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Snacktorio
games.summary: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking simulator where you must satisfy the appetites of unspeakable horrors... with food! Build and manage sprawling networks of machines & pipes to mass produce delicious meals that can satiate the endless hunger of the beasts that are invading your home. Order Up!

games.name: Joey The Duck
games.summary:
Joey The Duck is a linear, open level type platformer game.

Join Joey as he explores different locations within one large, diverse level.

Don't be fooled by his cuteness - Joey is a materialistic, money-driven duck who embarks on a risky journey through the Forbidden Lands in search of a treasure that may not even exist.

There's no main menu, no world map, no hub world - Joey keeps moving forward without pause to get his feathers on that so-called mythical treasure.

The game features minimalist pixel-art style, with the option to switch between light and dark modes, as well as effects like CRT TV simulation and Black and White mode. These effects can even be combined for an extra retro vibe.

Collect coins, jump on enemies, interact with the environment, and get that legendary treasure!

Key Features:

One big level, zero interruptions - no main menu, no world map, just go!

Light Mode and Dark Mode - switch the style anytime!

Optional effects - play with CRT TV or Black and White effects, or even combine them!

Minimalist pixel art - cute and colorful!

Play as Joey - He's greedy, he's cute and he's cool!

games.name: Zombutcher
games.summary: ZOMBUTCHER – is a stealth action simulator in which you take on the role of a zombie butcher. Hiding in the shadows of a Louisiana town and avoiding night patrols, you will gather food and resources for other monsters.

games.name: Hidalgo
games.summary: Embark on the most iconic and cozy adventures from the classic novel "Don Quixote of La Mancha". In a handcrafted, colorful puppet world, you'll battle windmills, be knighted, will solve puzzles with Don Quijote and Sancho and fight for the love of your beloved Dulcinea.

events.name: Indie World Showcase 3.3.2026
events.description: Join us on March 3 at 6am PT for a new Indie World Showcase! Tune in for roughly 15 minutes of news and updates on indie games coming to Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Heave Ho 2
games.summary: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

games.name: My Little Puppy
games.summary: "There is a saying that when you depart from this world, the dog who went ahead will warmly welcome you." While spending time in dog heaven, Bong-gu the Welsh Corgi suddenly catches his dad's scent. Now, he embarks on a journey to meet his dad. Will Bong-gu be able to see his dad again?

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Live the double life of a fearless adventurer and a crafty merchant! Dive into vibrant dimensions brimming with shiny loot and pesky enemies. Grow your shop, tinker with weapons and gadgets, as well as make your mark among a ragtag community of castaways.

games.name: Minishoot' Adventures
games.summary: Minishoot' is a cute and unique adventure game that mixes up open exploration with crispy twin-stick shooter action. Fight your way from the shiny overworld to the deepest caves, improve your ship and overcome the dungeons' bosses to rescue your friends!

games.name: Rotwood
games.summary:
Hack and slash your way through the Rotwood in this rogue-like dungeon crawler developed by Klei Entertainment.

The world has been thrown into chaos, and it's up to you and your friends to battle the corrupted beasts of the Rotwood. Upgrade your gear, choose your preferred weapon, and hone your skills to defend your safe haven.

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: Blighted
games.summary: Battle your way through a psychedelic western nightmare to reclaim the memories of your people in this action RPG from the creators of Guacamelee! Harness the power of the deadly, reality-altering Blight and unravel the mysteries of a twisted world.

games.name: Mixtape
games.summary: Mixtape is a narrative adventure game developed by Beethoven & Dinosaur and published by Annapurna Interactive. Set during the last night of high school, it follows three friends as they revisit memories connected to music, youth and leaving home. The game combines story scenes with playable vignettes, including skating, parties, and other moments, all framed by a licensed soundtrack.

games.name: Deadzone: Rogue
games.summary: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite first-person shooter set in deep space. Slay hordes of enemies, loot powerful gear, and customize your loadout during each unique run. Uncover fragments of your past as you piece together the truth behind your mission. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Blue Prince
games.summary: Welcome to Mt. Holly, where every dawn unveils a new mystery. Navigate through shifting corridors and ever-changing chambers in this genre-defying strategy puzzle adventure. But will the unpredictable path you create lead you to the rumored Room 46?

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratata Arts and TVT have announced Ratatan, a new rhythm action game from the creator of Patapon previously teased as Project JabberWocky.

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

games.name: Unrailed 2: Back on Track
games.summary: Unrailed is back on track with more co-op railroad construction chaos! Choose your path in a new world packed with bold biomes and bosses. Permanently upgrade your character and engines, even create and share your own levels - just don‘t let your train derail!

games.name: Little Witch in the Woods
games.summary: Little Witch in the Woods tells the story of Ellie, an apprentice witch. Explore the mystical forest, help the charming residents, and experience the daily life of the witch.

games.name: Öoo
games.summary: A Bomb Caterpillar's Big Adventure! "Öoo" is a charming yet mysterious exploration puzzle platformer where you discover creative ways to use bombs!

games.name: Whisper of the House
games.summary: What's happening in this seemingly peaceful town? Strange residents, bizarre incidents, and unexpected storylines! Please be sure to let go of all your human lifestyle preferences and strive to meet the special requests of your otherworldly employers. Decorate this house with peculiar furniture!

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: Japanese Rural Life Adventure
games.summary: Experience countryside living in Japanese Rural Life Adventure. "View the cherry blossoms in the spring, attend the festival in the summer, eat roasted sweet potatoes in the fall, hear the temple bell ring in winter, and then it's time for the first shrine visit of the New Year."

games.name: Magical Girl Witch Trials
games.summary: Thirteen girls awaken, only to find themselves in a prison. What awaits them: a Witch Trial. Help them prepare for the trial by exploring the prison in order to find the witch hidden amongst them. Find the witch, learn what kind of magic she holds, dispel the lies, and prepare for the execution.

games.name: Homura Hime
games.summary: "Homura Hime" is a third person action game, featuring Japanese anime visuals and intense 3D bullet curtain gameplay. Alongside Homurahime, fight against Demon Girls possessed by deviant "emotions", and get closer to discovering the truth of not only the fallen, but also your own veiled legacy.

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary:
A gripping prison escape RPG woven with crime, corruption, and hidden agendas. Step into a maximum-security facility where every inmate has a past—and a plan. You'll have to fight to survive, investigate, and ultimately break free before the time runs out.

Uncover a scheme that threatens more than just your life—it could bring down the entire city. In this thrilling adventure, choices matter, and escape is your only salvation!

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Coffee Talk: Tokyo
games.summary: Coffee Talk: Tokyo is the newest instalment of the beloved coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator. It brings the warmth, heart, and delicious drinks from the previous games to an all-new café in Tokyo where humans and yokai alike share their stories.

events.name: Clemmy's Best Indie Games Spring Showcase 2026

games.name: God Save Birmingham
games.summary: Doom has come to Birmingham, and you are the last soul alive. Survive an undead plague in a painstakingly recreated medieval market town. Manage your needs, master physics-based mechanics, and evade the horde for as long as you can.

games.name: Kiborg: Descent
games.summary: Descend into the tower's forbidden depths. Unravel the Substance's secret, forge uneasy alliances, and escape Omega-201. New floors, bosses, weapons, and a chance to settle the score with Volkov.

games.name: Lunchbreak Tactics
games.summary: Lunchbreak Tactics is a strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, min-max your squad, build ridiculous synergies, then battle players asynchronously. Play your way to climb the ranks with quick runs, no timer, limitless combos, and endless replay.

games.name: Lunarium
games.summary: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

games.name: Kletka
games.summary: Kletka is a co-op horror game about going down in an elevator that is trying to eat you. Feed the elevator, explore deadly floors and descend deeper.

games.name: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
games.summary: Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you can battle unpredictable, dynamic mega-fires solo or in co-op, using ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support and more.

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent
games.summary:
Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent is the first video game based on the legendary tabletop IP Descent. It is a story-driven heroic fantasy Tactical RPG refreshing the formula of dungeon crawlers for all types of fantasy fans alike and expanding on the lore of the boardgames Descent: Legends of the Dark.
Lead a fearless company of heroes into the deep and dark corridors of Terrinoth, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing an unending darkness

games.name: Erenshor
games.summary: Erenshor is a single player nod to the MMORPGs of the past. Created specifically for the nostalgic gamer who no longer wants to commit to online or scheduled play times, it offers unrestricted exploration, strategic battles, and countless weapons, armors, and spells to discover.

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Faeland
games.summary: FAELAND is a 2D Platform Action Adventure Role Playing Indie Video Game currently in development for PC, inspired on the nostalgic 8-Bit classics with a modern charm for all generations.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Into the Fire
games.summary: Race an exploding volcano in this high-risk extraction survival. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you.

games.name: Symbiosis
games.summary: Online cooperative or solo survival and action RPG set in a procedural alien world. Explore, survive, battle bosses and gather resources to customize your equipment and defend your bases from creatures drawn by the electromagnetism of your technology.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Shark Dentist
games.summary: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.

games.name: Voidling Bound
games.summary: Hatch, evolve, and upgrade powerful space creatures in this action-packed sci-fi 3rd person shooter that reinvents the monster taming genre!

games.name: EverSiege: Untold Ages
games.summary: Liberate Bastion, humanity’s last refuge. Defend against evil hordes, reclaim lost powers, rebuild ancient ruins, and adapt your tactics to break the everSiege. A top-down action-strategy rogue-lite where choices shape every run, playable solo or up to 3 players in co-op.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Collector's Cove
games.summary: All aboard! Collector’s Cove is a cozy farming adventure on the high seas. Sail with your animal friend to uncharted waters, cultivate your floating farm, and discover new islands, crops and fish on your quest to become a Named Collector!

games.name: Don't Let It Starve
games.summary: A horror roguelike deckbuilder. You're trapped in a kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster that crawls through the vents. Don't let it starve.

games.name: Haunted Lands
games.summary: An homage to classic DOS games such as Dangerous Dave and Doom. Blast your way through the hordes of ghouls and demons, leaving nothing behind but their rotting corpses.

games.name: Voodoo Fishin'
games.summary: Voodoo Fishin is an online co-op horror game featuring fishing, proximity voice, and scary monsters. You and up to 3 friends can venture into the swamp to find the best fishing spots holding the rarest fish. BEWARE: Die along the way, and you will lose your catch!

games.name: Snacktorio
games.summary: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking simulator where you must satisfy the appetites of unspeakable horrors... with food! Build and manage sprawling networks of machines & pipes to mass produce delicious meals that can satiate the endless hunger of the beasts that are invading your home. Order Up!

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: Eona
games.summary: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: Fright Train
games.summary: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Frontier Paladin
games.summary: Begin your first quest as a Paladin in this isometric Action RPG with weighty, stamina driven combat. Delve into the depths of the Crater, then fortify your positions and survive relentless enemy waves in tactical action-tower defense battles. Can you rebuild a shattered Order?

games.name: Solateria
games.summary: In a world where the Litt have perished, a small pyron warrior embarks on a journey to find the King, the Primordial Flame, the last hope to save the world. Defeat mighty foes, unleash fiery attacks, and master parrying. Explore a beautifully hand-drawn world and uncover its secrets.

games.name: Stackmon
games.summary: Stack, train and collect 100+ powerful Stackmon in this creature-collector with a card-stacking twist! Build your camp, challenge rival Scouts in combat and face the mysterious corruption spreading throughout your land.

games.name: A.A.U. Black Site
games.summary: The consequence of a mission gone wrong leaves you trapped in an endless cycle of nihilistic, man-made hell on earth, with your only option for survival being to trust a stranger’s voice that guides you through the darkest depths of the forgotten, shut-down Yugoslav town of Uzovnica.

games.name: Forge the Fates
games.summary: This roguelike deckbuilder transforms your classic hand of cards into a grid of runes. Play a rune and the ones behind it shift forward, so every move shapes what’s next. Build a unique deck, trigger match-3 combos, and outplay your enemies.

games.name: Iter-8
games.summary: Welcome to the surface, ITER employee #8. Mine the Pillar, upgrade your tools, defend your base, reach the top... or die miserably. Each expendable worker pushes the mission forward - one glorious, replaceable iteration at a time.

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Butler Guillotine
games.summary: Flesh filled puppets in a mishapen hotel. No windows, no exterior. Follow different characters' intertiwining paths and unearth forgotten events from a time long gone. Bring the ceremony to a halt.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: Letter Lost
games.summary: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

games.name: RentPoly
games.summary: RentPoly is a roguelike city-builder board game. Build your own real estate empire, squeeze rent from tenants, and become a billionaire!

games.name: Rogolf
games.summary:
ROGOLF is a minigolf roguelite, where each level has its own rules and each run is different.
Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top!

games.name: Runeomicon
games.summary: Cast runes to summon the goddess of death, unleash eldritch horrors to fend off villagers, and wield dark magic in this unique tower defense. Balance your power between summoning and fortifying as waves of enemies close in. Can you complete the ritual before your defenses crumble?

games.name: Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes
games.summary: Have you ever heard of the damn Green Record? Or maybe the Black Sheet is trying to kill you at night? Have you ever seen a Blue Nail in a pie? The visual novel "Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes" is the first of five planned games in the entourage of Soviet children's horror stories, where everything happens for real. The story tells about a girl named Dasha from 4th grade, who disobeyed her mother and listened to a green record. Together with her, you will face a mysterious and terrible evil, and only you can decide what awaits her in the end ^___^

games.name: Suitcase Stories
games.summary: Suitcase Stories is a short, cozy puzzle game about packing life’s memories. Organize objects into suitcases across 7 chapters, from childhood to adulthood. No timers, no scores just the calm joy of finding the perfect fit for every cherished memento.

games.name: Sydless
games.summary: Sydless is an ultra-fast movement shooter where your weapon is a chaotic ball that grows deadlier the more you move.

games.name: Twisted Fate
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike with a deep ability-modification system. Lead a party of three heroes, adapt their skills using modifiers, collect artifacts, and craft unique builds to destroy the source of corruption… or die trying.

games.name: A Planet Full of Cats
games.summary: A Planet Full of Cats is a hidden object adventure with metroidvania-style exploration — in true Devcats fashion. Explore diverse biomes, unlock new powers and uncover ancient secrets!

games.name: Alaska Gold Fever
games.summary: Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests!

games.name: Becoming Pablo
games.summary: Becoming Pablo is a turn-based grand-strategy game where you build and lead a cartel empire. Conquer territories, manage your operation, and outsmart rivals in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade era. Every choice impacts your rise to power, or your downfall. Can you dominate the underworld?

games.name: Belle Citique
games.summary: Belle Citique is a cozy city builder and design game. Use the joyfully simple building system to make riverside hamlets, alpine castles, bustling cities, and everything in between. No major objectives or obstacles, just sit back and create something beautiful.

games.name: Black Jacket
games.summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: Bookbinding
games.summary: A quiet bookshop. A magical past. A murder and Tarot cards that can twist fate itself. Craft beautiful covers, read between the lines of your customers’ lives, and decide which secrets deserve to stay hidden… including your own.

games.name: Burden Street Station
games.summary:
Burden Street Station is a surreal narrative game set in a liminal train station about helping a cast of unusual creatures and spirits move on with their lives.

Collect personality traits through talking and exploration, and wear them to unlock dialogue options and advance their stories.

You will come to know these spirits very well. You will learn a lot about them.

games.name: Cosminers
games.summary: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

games.name: DarkBazaar
games.summary: A gambling roguelite where you trade illegal weapons on the dark web to pay off a debt... or die.

games.name: Dash'n'Drops
games.summary: Blast your way through Dash'n'Drops, a platform-fighting inspired roguelite. Build your own moveset, max your stats, and defeat the 7 Eternals!

games.name: Dig, Dig, Die
games.summary: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players. Board a cursed flying ship, raid haunted graveyards for loot, and survive monsters that hear every sound. Beware of UFO abductions, grab boosters from vending machines, gamble in the onboard casino, and embrace pure chaos with friends in voice chat.

games.name: Diggin
games.summary: Drill into the depths of a meteor crater in this incremental adventure. Mine ores, unlock upgrades and find the cosmic treasure that lies below! Can you uncover what happened to the Moles that came before you?

games.name: Dracamar
games.summary: Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight to free the Okis. Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

games.name: Drowned Lake
games.summary: Dredge up the secrets hidden beneath Drowned Lake in this horror fishing adventure. Investigate the dark waters to fish out the truth. Catch evidence. Do not get caught yourself.

games.name: Emptiness Sire
games.summary: Emptiness Sire is a turn-based puzzle adventure set in a world reborn in medieval times after a catastrophic meteor shower. Explore the ruins of humanity, face deadly cosmic horror creatures, and uncover secrets as you guide three heroes on a quest to survive the divine punishment.

games.name: Hamster Talk
games.summary: Hamster Talk is an idle social game that fits naturally into your day. Interact with lively hamsters on your screen, enjoy their cute reactions with a touch, visit friends’ towns, and have light chats with players around the world—all while your hamsters keep you company.

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery
games.summary: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Go! Go! Mister Chickums
games.summary: GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

games.name: Gunboat God
games.summary: Become the all-powerful Gunboat God in this fluid shoot 'em up. Carve the waves as you stylishly fight hordes of monsters in hundreds of quick-fire missions. Transform your Gunboat and upgrade your weapons, skills and abilities to take on giant, challenging, multi-stage bosses!

games.name: Here Comes the Swarm
games.summary: Here Comes the Swarm is a survival RTS with a pause button! Create your strategy, build, manage, and defend your settlements at your own pace. Take the fight to the hive mind and lead expeditions to deliver a deadly blow and eradicate your foes. Will you reclaim Ulora from the relentless Swarm?

games.name: Hocus Focus
games.summary: A cozy gamified focus tool to help you work, study, or relax to soothing tunes. Customize your space and summon your focus with productivity tools. You’re a student in a magic university - control time and weather, unlock new locations, collect cute Mitzkins, and level up in-game and in real life!

games.name: How Many Dudes?
games.summary: How many dudes does it take to beat up 1000 toddlers? A gorilla? Twelve bears and a horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter the Dude Ranch and find out.

games.name: Kiyo: Bunny Tyranny
games.summary: Control the body of Kiyo, a feline ex-predator trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. Discover their deepest secrets, and free everyone from their tyrannical grip in this stealthy platform adventure.

games.name: Maid Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Become the new manager of a run-down maid cafe. Rebuild it with unique kemonomimi maids, each with their own secrets and personalities. Manage ingredients, serve customers, expand your shop, and chase the ultimate dream: the legendary Maidchelin 3-Star!

games.name: Map Map: A Game About Maps
games.summary: Embark on a cozy treasure hunt as cartographer of an adventure crew. Use your sense of direction to make maps, help your companions and explore idyllic islands.

games.name: Midgardr
games.summary: You are a Duke sent to govern a village at the edge of the realm. Build, protect, and guide your people toward prosperity. But beware, hidden threats await... Choose your strategy wisely, forge alliances and face your fate. Will your village thrive… or be swallowed by chaos?

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: Over The Top: WWI
games.summary: Over The Top: WWI brings brutal real-time third-person and first-person combat set in the First World War. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal, including rifles, artillery, and even tanks, as you navigate the mud-soaked battlefields of the Great War.

games.name: Pigs and Wolf
games.summary: Little pigs fear becoming bacon, join the fight and survive from the wolf at night. Craft your home and travel to find the path back to the village in this fantasy world.

games.name: Pink Noise
games.summary: "Pink Noise" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, immersing you in the retro atmosphere of the '90s. It tells the tale of a group of teenagers who unknowingly set off a chain of terrifying events. What secrets lie within the mysterious VHS tape they should’ve never played?

games.name: Prime Monster
games.summary: A card-based political roguelike about surviving in a parliament of literal monsters. Fight for votes, break rules, weather scandals and force through absurd laws to keep the top job in this democratic dystopia of truly monstrous proportions.

games.name: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter
games.summary: Jump, dash, and brawl your way through beautifully animated 2D platforming levels, then shift perspectives into dynamic top-down 3D street zones to gather rare ingredients in chaotic, GTA2 - style street battles! Every fight feeds your menu. Every level is a recipe for madness.

games.name: Rova
games.summary: Rova is a cozy space-rover photography game. Help a new space colony conduct research on large spherical planets, by documenting elements of alien worlds through photography. ROVA is a game about discovery and exploration.

games.name: Signal Zone
games.summary: Defend your base against increasingly dangerous enemy waves each night in this minimalist survival strategy. Mine resources, build and repair defenses, and upgrade your structures, tools, and abilities to survive in this harsh world.

games.name: Stardust: Wish of Witch
games.summary: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

games.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
games.summary: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

games.name: Super Firefighter
games.summary: Run into hell and spray it down in this couch coop twin stick shooter. Team up with 1 to 3 friends and save victims, houses and trees from the flames and those who ignite them. Enhance your firepower waterpower with special upgrades designed to beat the heat from the unique fires you'll encounter.

games.name: The Hearth and Harbour
games.summary: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

games.name: Thrifty Business
games.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

games.name: Tombwater
games.summary: Explore the accursed Wild West town of Tombwater and lay bare the eldritch horrors that lie beneath. Survive blood-spilling combat in this gruesome 2D action-RPG that might just drive you to madness.

games.name: Trash
games.summary: Discover a post-human earth in Trash, a beautifully crafted open-world action adventure game where strange and wondrous trash-based life thrives. Explore your surroundings with friends, solve puzzles, craft unique attachments and emerge from the heap.

games.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe ️ No timers, No stress cook traditional dishes upgrade and customize just drink prosecco, relax and grow your dream cafe

games.name: Vortica
games.summary: Vortica is a 2D action roguelite set in a solar system overrun by hostile aliens. Suit up, loot up, and shoot up as you battle against enemy hordes, explore derelict outposts, and hunt giant bosses. Each mission gets you one step closer to reaching Earth and saving the human race.

games.name: Vultures: Scavengers of Death
games.summary: Face zombies and fearsome monsters in this turn-based survival-horror roguelike as you seek the path to recover a valuable artifact. Unravel the history of Salento Valley and its downfall after a bioterrorist attack led by a secret cult involved with the powerful corporation Eugenesys Tech.

games.name: Walk The Frog
games.summary: Guide Froggo through a world on sticky notes and relax while solving the puzzle of his journey home. Make new quirky friends, help each other out and overcome many obstacles. It’s a cozy and heartwarming point&click adventure with a unique and easy drag&drop puzzle style.

games.name: Wild Tactics
games.summary: The Wildest character-driven tactical strategy game you've ever seen! Build your team and maintain their relationships in the war against organized crime. Uncover the conspiracy in the animal-populated city of Clawville, and find the mastermind behind its downfall!

games.name: Zoominoes
games.summary: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

games.name: A Tale of Silent Depths
games.summary: A Tale of Silent Depths is a turn based tactical RPG set in a post-apocalyptic underwater setting. Explore a procedurally generated Ocean, command your submarine and fight beasts, pirates and creatures beyond your crew's comprehension.

games.name: Furniture Fu
games.summary: Furniture Fu is a home-makeover, demon-hunting, hoard-fighting roguelike. Lay out furniture strategically to make awesome synergies and cosy houses - all in a day’s work for America’s first suburban ninja.

games.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
games.summary: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

games.name: Maseylia: Echoes of the Past
games.summary: Maseylia : Echoes of the Past is a 3d metroidvania that aims to reproduce the experience of a 2d metroidvania in 3d. It features a labyrinthine world in which you'll need to collect upgrades to unlock new passages and make your way out of the labyrinth.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Slay All Bosses: Idle
games.summary: Slay All Bosses: Idle, is a short incremental RPG. Cut down waves of enemies, defeat powerful bosses, and rapidly grow stronger through character skill trees, weapon and skill upgrades, and equipped passive abilities, all on your path to becoming the ultimate hero.

games.name: Swan Song
games.summary: Swan Song is a cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. Use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief.

games.name: The Last Gas Station
games.summary: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

games.name: Muffles' Life Sentence: Episode 5
games.summary: EPISODE 5 of Muffles' journey. A darkly quirky RPG set in a prison where inmates are remade to match their crimes.

games.name: Pizza Bandit
games.summary: Pizza Bandit is a unique blend of "cooking" and "shooting," adding extra spice to the third-person shooter. In this mission-based 4-player co-op third-person shooter, you embody a wannabe chef utilizing his ex-mercenary skills to fund his dream pizza restaurant.

games.name: Pluralys
games.summary:
Pluralys is a solo narrative RPG set in an alternate world to our blue planet.
You can explore almost every place in the game, talk to everyone, and immerse yourself in a rich story full of mystery.
You’ve been contacted by someone, but who are they, and what do they want? You’ll have to find out.
This place is certainly hiding a lot of things...

games.name: 77p egg: Eggwife
games.summary: After a sexual mishap, our hero 77p egg finds itself on a quest to find a new wife while the world is overrun by sentient sewage and a milk-obsessed cult. A dumb and crass FPS inspired by the likes of Postal 2, Duke 3D, and Goat Simulator.

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: Astrobotanica
games.summary: Discover Earth 300 thousand years ago as an alien biologist. Utilize your expertise in botany to survive, grow plants, harvest crops, compose and brew tonics. Reveal hidden powers of unknown plants. Engage with primal humans, leaving your mark on the future of civilization.

games.name: Brave Escape
games.summary: Embark on a thrilling co-op adventure in 'Brave Escape,' a challenging platformer demanding teamwork to conquer perilous traps and treacherous terrain.

games.name: Caromble!
games.summary: This is not just another brick breaker game. This is Caromble!, a fresh new take on the brick break game! Free the corrupted world and fight evil with physics-based destruction, puzzles, explosions, skill-levels, power-ups, mayhem, more explosions, further puzzles, speedruns, superscore medals, unlockable challenges and some surprises you would't expect in a brick breaker game. Brick break your way to glory and discover a world of nostalgic wonder. Let’s get ready to Caromble!

games.name: Katanaut
games.summary: Descend into cosmic madness aboard a collapsing space station in Katanaut, a fast-paced action-roguelite. Unleash powerful abilities, master fluid combat, and confront eldritch horrors as reality unravels around you. Survive relentless battles and fight for your very existence.

games.name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
games.summary: From the world of "Lost Eidolons" comes an all-new turn-based strategy RPG. Stranded on a mysterious island with scattered memories, your only means of survival is to fight. Recruit allies, undertake a perilous journey, and battle to reclaim what you've lost... no matter how many deaths it takes.

games.name: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith
games.summary: Medieval Crafter: Blacksmith is a crafting simulation game where you Physically interact with your tools. Manage the complete process, resource acquisition, mining ore, gather resource to crafting weapons and armors for your customers. Craft items, forge and increase your blacksmith skills!

games.name: Tales of Seikyu
games.summary: "Tales of Seikyu" is a fantasy farming sim game set in a lost fae land called Seikyu, inhabited by legendary creatures. However, the town is frequently threatened by the old gods' forces. As a new arrival, can you successfully manage the old inn entrusted to you by God Inari?

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Twinkleby
games.summary: Twinkleby is a cozy decoration game where you map out an archipelago of floating islands and build dioramas for a society of spacefaring neighbours. Expand your collection, discover antique secrets, decorate, and when you change your mind – evict everyone and throw their furniture into space!

games.name: 1000 Deaths
games.summary: 1000 Deaths is a 3D adventure platformer about interpersonal conflicts and the effects of the media. Play fast-paced episodes and discover wildly different endings with each play through. Switch perspectives from a pool of eclectic characters, making decisions that you'll take with you to the grave.

games.name: Journey to the Void
games.summary: Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions in this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder. On your journey through varied grid-based biomes, battle unique foes and make tough moral choices to restore a corrupted land and decide the fate of your world.

games.name: Kaz
games.summary:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

games.name: Encryptid
games.summary: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

games.name: Lelu
games.summary:
Get your gears in motion for a captivating monochromatic adventure where you play as Lelu, a small but determined clockwork toy who has gained consciousness and found a taste for freedom!

Navigate your way through the toy factory, a labyrinthian tower filled with puzzles and traps set by the factory’s eccentric guardian. Use your wits and agility to overcome challenges, from conveyor belts and electrifying circuits to sentient toys and towering toy titans.
As you delve deeper into the world, uncover hidden abilities to aid you in your quest, alongside a variety of secrets and other toys sharing your desire for freedom.

Will you find your way to the elusive exit, or will you just be another toy on the shelf?

games.name: Poker Monsters
games.summary: A new take on Poker Roguelike. In Poker Monsters, you assemble poker hands on the table one card at a time, with one goal: hunting! Use your party’s abilities, take down huge beasts and power up to face even greater beasts. Become a true Poker Monster!

games.name: Duo Quest
games.summary: Dive into a fantasy world where your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?

games.name: March March!
games.summary: March! March! is a turn-based auto battler with puzzle-based mechanics, inspired by the classic puzzle game Tetris Each turn your army gets a regiment that varies in formation and size. Tell your units where to march! march! and they will do the rest.

games.name: Seasons of Solitude
games.summary: You are exiled. Seasons of Solitude is a turn-based strategy and resource management game where every move shapes a fragile landscape. Seasons shift, the land reacts to your choices, and balance is your way home in a hand-painted world inspired by Estonian myth.

games.name: Knight George
games.summary: Knight George is a top-down retro-style A-RPG. Travel across the Kingdom of Earlyne to meet friendly characters, explore numerous dungeons and fight terrifying monsters to save the kingdom!

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.summary: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

games.name: Ember & Blade
games.summary:
Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that
reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Frankenstein's Monster
games.summary: Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - In roguelite single-player, or social hangout multiplayer.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Lostade
games.summary: Lostade is a mysterious and unique Arcade-Stylised dungeon crawler with endless possibilities, combining Character building, Crafting, and Exploration with Endless endgame and Replayability !

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Shroomwood
games.summary: Top-down bullet hell with challenging roguelike progression. Unlock and upgrade your town as you fight through procedural levels.

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Talystro
games.summary: Talystro is a rougelite-deckbuilder where you combine dice and cards to defeat your enemies. The catch? Instead of chipping away at their HP, you must macth their value. Collect, upgrade and enchant your cards. Discover game-breaking artifacts, power up your dice and defeat the Necrodicer!

games.name: The Button Effect
games.summary: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

games.name: Awaysis
games.summary: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

games.name: City God Alice
games.summary: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

games.name: Contact Protocol
games.summary:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary:
Help Hoshino bring her hometown back together in a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in 2000s Japan! She'll face malevolent forces, uncover truths about her town, all while reconnecting with neighbors and her grandma living with dementia.

By gingham games - that's sandy powder, mogumu, and Melos Han-Tani (of Analgesic Productions)!

games.name: Deadly Rehearsal
games.summary: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

games.name: Desolus
games.summary: Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game.

games.name: Divinum
games.summary: Divinum is an action-adventure that blends stylish, expressive combat with rewarding exploration. Master devastating combos and craft unique builds to fight back mysterious invaders and uncover your island’s hidden truth.

games.name: Earthlings
games.summary:
Meet G - a space delivery guy who came for his dropped tablet but stayed for the scam. After seeing the amazing monuments humans built to worship him, he decided to exploit their creativity and sell their art as his own across the galaxy. You're his unwilling project manager, and when deadlines slip, his anxiety triggers disasters.

He's your boss, your burden, and ultimately your enemy.

Build weird monuments, meet crushing deadlines, and survive working for the universe's worst middle manager.

games.name: Fading Echo
games.summary: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: Gimmiko
games.summary: The world is frozen in an endless night, trapped under a shadowblighted moon. Demons from the collective subconcious are leaking into reality. Save the world from the curse of the Jabberwock in this wacky dicebuilding roguelite!

games.name: Gunstoppable
games.summary: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

games.name: Hearth and Hamlet
games.summary: Gather resources and grow your settlement from a humble camp into a vibrant, magic-filled kingdom! Hearth and Hamlet is an incremental citybuilder game in a cozy pixelart style. Assign workers, unlock new buildings, policies, and magic, trade with faraway lands, and construct your ideal settlement!

games.name: Hell Architect: Survivors
games.summary:
A darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin is power.
Play as a demon architect hell-bent on overthrowing Lucifer, rebuilding the underworld, and unleashing forbidden powers with an unholy arsenal.

games.name: Hidden Around the World
games.summary: Travel the world in this cozy hidden-object adventure with decoration and discover the charm of cities like Tokyo, Paris, New York, and many more!

games.name: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
games.summary: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Hyper Sentinel Fusion
games.summary: An intense shoot-em-up + roguelite fusion. Pilot your fighter to destroy the defences of procedurally-generated space titans, then land, infiltrate and plunder the depths with your droid. Spend your bounty on epic upgrades & explore the moon base hub to interact with characters & unlock secrets.

games.name: Junklands
games.summary: Embark on a journey to transform a polluted world shackled by its toxic overlords. Explore the lands, brave the environment, battle polluting foes and clean up a dying world in an epic 3D action-adventure metroidvania.

games.name: Monolith: Rogue TD
games.summary: You are the Monolith - an unbreakable force crashing from the sky, spreading corruption across countless worlds in this roguelike tower defense game with deckbuilding mechanics. Defend your core against those who resist and meet each world’s unique challenges.

games.name: Mossbound
games.summary: Mossbound is a small, atmospheric exploration game set in an overgrown miniature world. You follow Milo on a quiet journey through moss, roots, and forgotten spaces, searching for a way to save his sick brother.

games.name: Nimbit Frontier
games.summary: Embark on daring adventures into wild biomes to uncover fragments of long-lost creatures. Bring them back to life by hatching their young. Build them habitats, and release them into the wild. Become the star Nimbiteer you dream of surrounded by lovely folks in a small cozy town.

games.name: No Gods of Men
games.summary: Rebuild a towering citadel, manage your disciples, and slash through waves of enemies in a hand-drawn world that combines roguelike metroidvania gameplay with base-building & colony management.

games.name: One Less Choice
games.summary: A Russian Roulette duel twisted with Cards and Rock–Paper–Scissors.

games.name: Pain-to-win
games.summary:
A lot of crazy maniacs, bloody killers, violent freaks and murderers gathered in one experimental prison-hospital to make some noise.
And you are here too - cold-blooded gold-eager man-hunter. Maybe you are even worse than your opponents, maybe not... No one cares.
If you die – no one feels your pain.

games.name: Dungeon Baller
games.summary: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball, where every bounce is a battle.

games.name: Ruin: Beast City
games.summary: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

games.name: Sova
games.summary: Descend into a surreal sci-fantasy world in this narrative-driven action roguelite, where every run reshapes your story. Sova’s expressive combat meets deeply branching dialogue and world-shifting decisions. Compose your violence, rewrite your past, and bend a crumbling realm to your will.

games.name: Stories of Somnia
games.summary: Unravel a story-rich adventure blending a turn-based RPG with real-time mechanics. Use spells to grapple across gaps, uncover hidden routes, and combine abilities with powerful Dreamkin companions to overcome a world consumed by Gloam.

games.name: Sub-Species
games.summary: At first the alien outbreak spreading throughout the oceans was confined. We delayed our extinction rather than avert it. As part of a salvage crew, you search the hellish containment zones, where a treasure trove of lost tech can help you and your crew eke out a living in a slowly dying world.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

games.name: Vegelypse
games.summary: Vegelypse is a 2.5D hand-painted beat 'em up with roguelite grit. Take control of the Hard Rock Cacti Band - smash, crush, and chop your way through hordes of mutated, monstrous vegetables and fruits. The Vegelypse Has Begun!

games.name: Welcome to Harmony
games.summary: Build your timeline, execute your plan, and survive Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

games.name: Worlds Upon The Wind
games.summary: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

games.name: Cut the Grass: Farm Defense Survival
games.summary: Cutting grass is just the beginning. Explore, gather loot, upgrade your farm and survive night attacks. Fight monsters, defend your base, and last as long as you can in this day-night survival loop!

games.name: Dark Cards of Candlewood
games.summary: Candlewood is a solo collectible card game with the soul of a classic JRPG. Embark on replayable dungeon runs with deceptively deep, two-choice card combat. Draft items for your backpack, master chain attacks, and even crack a few card packs...then save the world from eternal darkness!

games.name: Grim Path
games.summary: A card-driven strategy roguelike where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, face various encounters, and collect powerful items in fast, easy-to-pick-up runs filled with meaningful decisions.

games.name: Manaftory
games.summary: Collect resources, build machines, and automate everything. Explore magical lands, face hostile creatures, and turn their loot into part of your factory system. This is your Manaftory — a magical factory powered by mana.

games.name: Moonsigil Atlas
games.summary: The deckbuilding roguelike with no energy – play cards using physical space! Slot cards together, manipulate the shape of your cards, and create overpowered combos to break the game!

games.name: Robot Recycler Ryn
games.summary: Build your own custom combat robots, piece by piece! Weld, saw, and shape metal to perfection. Lead your creations into battle as you follow Ryn in Story Mode, or craft freely in Construction Mode.

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.summary: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Gateworlds
games.summary: Gateworlds is a survival colony sim set in a wilderness shaped by five fickle gods. You begin with a small band of villagers, stranded on a hostile world. Lead your people as they survive, build, craft, hunt, explore, and vie for the favour of the gods. Journey across floating worlds connected by mystical portals, each world bearing the influence of a god’s power.

games.name: Devil Lift
games.summary: Demon hunting is a day job in Devil Lift, a tag battle roguelike deckbuilder. Play as the Lilith Society, a group of underpaid and overworked demon hunters as they protect humanity from the Archbeasts of the Underworld before their shift ends.

events.name: Capcom Spotlight: March 2026
events.description:
The Capcom Spotlight is a digital event that brings you the latest news from Capcom!
We will be presenting the latest news on highly anticipated upcoming Capcom titles.

games.name: Resident Evil Village: Gold Edition
Resident Evil 7: Biohazard - Gold Edition
games.summary:
Set in modern day rural America and taking place after the dramatic events of Resident Evil 6, players experience the terror directly from the first person perspective. Resident Evil 7 embodies the series' signature gameplay elements of exploration and tense atmosphere that first coined "survival horror" some twenty years ago; meanwhile, a complete refresh of gameplay systems simultaneously propels the survival horror experience to the next level.

The Gold Edition contains the full game plus DLC: the Banned Footage Vol. 1 and 2, and the End of Zoe epilogue episode.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin
games.summary: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin offers both RPG and Monster Hunter fans a unique new experience with a rich storyline featuring charming characters, challenging quests and friendly encounters with familiar monsters from the Monster Hunter series.
