Assuming the role of a young Monster Rider who can use a Kinship Stone to form strong bonds with monsters, players can gain experience and improve their skills to form deeper connections with these wonderful creatures. When ready, players can embark on memorable adventures filled with dramatic events and heartwarming friendships as the epic tale unfolds.

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories
games.summary: The first installment of the Monster Hunter Stories series is back and coming to Nintendo Switch, PC, and PlayStation 4! Become a Monster Rider and hatch, raise, and battle with your favorite Monsties in this epic RPG adventure.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Resident Evil Requiem
games.summary: Resident Evil Requiem is the ninth entry in the Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

games.name: Mega Man Star Force: Legacy Collection
games.summary: The Mega Man Star Force series, which expanded into an anime, is back in the Mega Man Star Force Legacy Collection! This collection includes seven games and additional features like a gallery of illustrations and music! Online play is also supported!

games.name: Pragmata
games.summary: Pragmata is a sci-fi action-adventure game set in the near future. The story follows Hugh and his android companion Diana as they navigate a Lunar research station. Gameplay incorporates action elements alongside mechanics involving interaction with systems within the environment.

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: Resident Evil Generation Pack
games.summary: Experience survival horror like never before in this bundle containing Resident Evil 7 Gold Edition, Resident Evil Village Gold Edition, and Resident Evil Requiem - the latest title in the mainline Resident Evil series.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Additional Character - Alex
games.summary: A DLC adding the character Alex to Street Fighter 6's roster.

events.name: Dames 4 Games Spring Showcase 2026
events.description: The Dames 4 Games Spring Showcase 2026 is a digital celebration of games led by women and femme creators, featuring fresh demos, new trailers, and developer spotlights. This year’s theme, “Seeds of Tomorrow,” highlights 33 games and is proudly partnered with Women-Led Games and WINGS to spotlight even more talent shaping the future of gaming.

games.name: Letter Lost
games.summary: You’re the sole employee at the Kharnym Isle post office, stamping, sorting, and delivering mail. But the job hides secrets, and the office itself holds mysteries you must uncover. This will be the only job you’ll ever need to work… unless you can escape.

games.name: Deep Fog Signals
games.summary: Stuck in an outpost deep in a sea of toxic fog, your crew has been decimated, you're cut off from the outside world, and oxygen is running out. Use limited bandwidth to coordinate unstable crewmates, conduct esoteric research that could change the world, and interpret strange signals from the deep.

games.name: TetherGeist
games.summary: TetherGeist is a 2D Precision Platformer about Mae, a young villager with a mysterious illness that has turned her right of passage into a treacherous journey. Join Mae in her struggle to prove herself as you make your way to a mystical temple using powers of astral projection.

games.name: Mitch
games.summary: Mitch just landed! Will you help her begin her new life?

games.name: Soup for Soul
games.summary: Run a quaint Japanese ramen shop, craft every bowl your way, and shape your guests’ heartfelt stories with your cooking choices.

games.name: Capote
games.summary:
Capote is an online card game for 2 to 6 players that mixes classic trick-taking rules with bold bets and chaotic special cards. Each match is set around a casual card table full of colorful characters—and in Capote, no win is guaranteed, and any card can flip the game.

Players bet how many tricks they think they’ll win, then play their cards round by round to hit that number exactly. If you win more or fewer tricks than you bet, you’ll take a virtual shot for each one off. Hit four shots and… you’re out. Capotado!

If the cards aren’t in your favor, don’t worry—messing with your friends is also a valid strategy. Play your special cards at the right time to twist the odds, sabotage their bets, or turn a sure win into chaos.

games.name: Foodomina
games.summary: Play as two personified food girls- Takoyaki & Tempura- in their cosmic battle against mold people! Explore a food-themed galaxy, rich in flavour, make friends, & engage in absurd pun-fueled combat to save the galaxy from infection! But mold people used to be food people- Maybe there's another way?

games.name: Socket
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game where you play as a social worker who obeys a wall socket. Follow its instructions, explore the city’s last inhabited apartment building, and pry secrets from its residents. All to fulfill the terms of the contract.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Pink Noise
games.summary: "Pink Noise" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, immersing you in the retro atmosphere of the '90s. It tells the tale of a group of teenagers who unknowingly set off a chain of terrifying events. What secrets lie within the mysterious VHS tape they should’ve never played?

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Kitty Haven
games.summary: A cute and cozy logic puzzle game about cats.

games.name: Provoron
games.summary: It's an adventure game about black&white crows.

games.name: Melted Time
games.summary: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

games.name: Odd Jobs: On The Lot
games.summary: A physics-powered, 1-4 player co-op set in a vibrant Australian carpark. Teammates race to complete a rotating roster of odd jobs avoiding hazards and losing wages. Manage chaos collecting stray trolleys, unloading delivery trucks, cleaning up trash, or delivering groceries directly to car boots.

games.name: Hill Agency: Purity / Decay
games.summary: Murdered sisters, mind altering drugs and flying cities, to a case that goes way further than the banks of this one detective's little neighbourhood in this Indigenous cybernoir detective narrative adventure set in a post-post-apocalyptic future.

games.name: Ghost Cam
games.summary: Ghost Cam is a spooky exploratory VR and PC game where you search for ghosts – at your own risk… Discover how good you are at finding ghosts, figuring out clues and uncovering the story - if you can survive the multiple endings.

games.name: Goblin Sushi
games.summary: In this rogue-like restaurant-action-sim, you play as a goblin that has the dream of becoming a sushi chef. Upgrade the restaurant, the menu and your ingredients to feed your fellow goblins the best and most expensive sushi any goblin can find in the cave!

games.name: The Whisker Watch
games.summary: Play as your cat(s) in a co-op roguelike of night prowls, day naps, and endless mischief! Claw at haunted appliances, fight chthonic horrors, and upgrade your cozy mansion! Customize your meow, accessories, and fur; Pet your human for perks!

games.name: Camera Anima
games.summary: The Artisan, one of one of Awyr's most infamous killers, is said to walk the cloudy streets looking for his next masterpiece. Pursue the Artisan, save your sister, and uncover the past, but remember what the stories say…Meet his face, and never wake again.

games.name: Irene: The Window
games.summary: Irene. The Window is a cozy narrative game. It combines a branching visual novel experience, campy minigames and imaginative real-life tasks that promote healthy habits as well as help with anxiety and internet addiction.

games.name: Cartomantic
games.summary: A tactical Tarot roguelite deckbuilder, where positioning matters just as much as the cards themselves. Craft decks of Minor and Major Arcana, create powerful combos, make your power reach the millions, and overcome the formidable Arcana Trials to see what lies within.

games.name: Thrifty Business
games.summary: Run your very own thrift shop in this laid-back management sim! Sort through boxes to find hidden treasures and arrange nostalgic displays of clothes, antiques, toys & more. Befriend the regulars, help with their requests and expand your store into a hub for the local community!

games.name: Crimson Tale
games.summary:
Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth takes one last action against the oppressing forces of the nobility. Avoid the sun, go back in time with blood magic and use your vampire abilities to find the golden guard, ending this tyrany once and for all.

You are Elizabeth, a vampire who returns to a decaying village where the nobility has fled and the guards control the people. With Christie’s death still fresh, Elizabeth uses her powers to travel to the past, discovering the hidden fates of those connected to the village’s downfall. While she uncovers the other's past lives to change the future, her determination sets out to avenge her love and bring an end to the last of the tyranny responsible for the remaining chaos.

games.name: Merry Crisis
games.summary: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed?

games.name: Glimvale: My Mini Overworld
games.summary: Manage and customize your little fantasy village, make your adventurers happy with cute and varied shops and decorate their environment as you please. After all, you are the master of the game !

games.name: Capy Castaway
games.summary: Embark on a whimsical adventure with a capybara pup and a clever crow as they set off to find their way home! Sniff, dig, and fly as you explore a vibrant world brimming with wonder, challenges, and heartwarming friendships at every turn.

games.name: Name of the Will
games.summary: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

games.name: Stika
games.summary: Stika is a single-player stealth horror game steeped in Ukrainian folklore. Navigate the Ukrainian forest, find clues, and solve puzzles to unravel the mysteries of night, all while evading folklore creatures. With multiple-endings, your choices matter — can you survive a night with the Rusalka?

games.name: Heidi's Legacy: Mountains Calling
games.summary: Heidi's Legacy is a cozy narrative sim where you care for goats, craft mountain goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Experience a peaceful pastoral life, inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, community, and self-discovery.

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.summary: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Pelikeeper
games.summary: Pelikeeper is a cozy tower defense & base building strategy game where you play as the last pelican in a world swallowed by a shadowy fog. Build up and defend the settlement around your lighthouse, rescue lost animal neighbors, and return constellations to the cosmos.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Hang out, fight monsters, and discover your town’s darkest secrets in Usual June, a third person action game about summer break and the end of the world.

events.name: The MIX + Kinda Funny Spring Game Showcase 2026
events.description: Kinda Funny and the MIX have teamed up once again to bring you a jam-packed showcase of brand new video games!

games.name: Cast Outs
games.summary: Urban fantasy collides with true co-op as you and your crew unleash visceral, physical magic, amplifying each other’s powers, and pushing back invaders in the fight to save your city. Cast Outs mixes the weight of a brawler with the speed of a shooter, built for quick-fix fun, high-intensity co-op, and memorable sessions with friends.

games.name: Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter
games.summary: Kill each other...for science! The class of '89 is trapped in an elite school killing game. Investigate, solve, and expose your classmates in Kumitantei: Old-School Slaughter, an episodic murder-mystery ADV card-battler inspired by retro anime.

games.name: The King is Watching: Crowns of History
games.summary: Play as Cleopatra, Taizong of Tang, and Xerxes, three legendary-inspired rulers with radically different playstyles. Master death and rebirth, dominate with devastating defenses, or risk everything for overwhelming power.

games.name: Demon Lord: Just a Block
games.summary: Reborn as a Demon Lord, seek revenge on the heroes! This fantasy roguelite game features grid-based combat controlled using four directional inputs. The world only moves when you do: you attack when you collide with enemies. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with dodges and parries!

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
games.summary:
Jump in the shoes of Lunch Box and Mr. Snoogans in a colorful Side-scrolling 2.5D over-the-top multiplayer brawler! Play as the dynamic duo alone or with a friend in a tag team combo fight fest. Destroy your enemies with fists, feet, and the magic of self-esteem destroying shit talk while you embark on a mission to find your long lost pot customers trapped in an Orwellian shopping center.

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch is a colorful side-scrolling tag-team beat-em-up where players swap back and forth between our heroes on the fly or perform special moves simultaneously with a friend. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from the humble corners where they ply their trade to the gates of hell itself.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: KuloNiku: Bowl Up!
games.summary: Run a meatball restaurant in this high energy comedic cooking game. Meet quirky locals and cook their wild orders, upgrade and customize your restaurant, win thrilling cooking battles, and become the town’s top eatery!

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary:
Lead a band of misfits on a roller-coaster ride to stardom in the age of MTV, rock anthems, and bad haircuts. ROCKBEASTS is a story-driven, role-playing management game that puts you in the shoes of a manager of an up-and-coming rock band.

Rock ‘n’ Roll Band Manager: This band has real potential, but they need your help to live up to it. Their tunes can revolutionize the music industry and redefine genres - but what good is a great song if no one hears it? It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
games.summary: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

games.name: Bloodgrounds
games.summary: Delve into roguelike arena combat and city management where core gameplay features strategic battles, town development, and character growth. Command Gladiator units and navigate various mechanics for a comprehensive gaming experience.

games.name: Rune Dice
games.summary: Throw dice, create explosive chain reactions, and defeat waves of enemies in Rune Dice! Collect ancient runes with diverse abilities, add synergies between relics, heroes, and special dice. All combined, this will give you an excellent experience in our roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: Surfpunk
games.summary: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

games.name: Awaysis
games.summary: The ultimate dungeon brawler. A revolutionary, physics-fueled throwdown where you’ll jump, slide, and collide on your adventure to restore peace to the Awaysis - an ancient floating relic under attack by forces of great darkness!

games.name: AfterQuest
games.summary: AfterQuest is a fast-paced roguelite RPG with tactical, turn-based combat. Build your party by choosing three heroes from a growing roster, experiment with endless build combinations, and experience a character-driven story where defeat only makes you stronger.

games.name: Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria
games.summary: Sacred returns as a party-based RPG set in a ruptured and battle-worn post-war Ancaria. Featuring hybrid real-time and turn-based combat, handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, and an open world from the original creators of Sacred. Build your party! Loot everything! Laugh at the rest!

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

games.name: Last Man Sitting
games.summary: A bunch of dudes sit in an office, all of them wearing black suits and white collared shirts. Everyone sits in the same lime green swivel chairs. For a video game, Last Man Sitting sounds really boring. Add shotguns and ragdoll physics, though, and you have a recipe for the only battle royale game left to make.

games.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
games.summary: Welcome to Hunter Haven! Bounty Brawl is a top-down action roguelite shooter for 1-4 players. Here, the hunt is fierce, and betrayal is inevitable. Will you form a fragile alliance with other hunters under the galaxy's most notorious bounties, or go it alone? Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

games.name: Super Basketball Classics
games.summary: Classic arcade basketball returns with a twist. Super Basketball Classics Featuring the World Famous Harlem Globetrotters combines retro-inspired gameplay, modern upgrades, and Globetrotter flair for the ultimate hoops showdown.

games.name: Monster Punk
games.summary: Dominate the ultimate motor-sport ritual. Smash, blast, and pull off wild stunts through extreme tournament challenges. Out-score rivals alone or co-op to survive elimination, win the 1v1 final showdown, and earn the cash to upgrade your ride. Rise from "nobody" to arena champion.

games.name: BPM: Bitcrushed
games.summary: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

games.name: The Player Who Can't Level Up
games.summary: The Player Who Can't Level Up is an action roguelite game based on web novels and webtoons of the same name. You can freely combine various combat styles and numerous growth factors to become stronger. Experience unexpected enhancement effects through various random elements.

games.name: GridBeat!
games.summary: Dungeons! Danger! Rhythm Action! You just hacked into the biggest corporation in the world and stole an unfeasibly valuable amount of data, but getting in was the easy part. To get back out you’ll need to explore the Mainframe, solve puzzles, battle security programs… and do it all on the beat!

games.name: Scramble Knights Online
games.summary: Welcome to Scramble Knights Online! Embark together with friends on bite-sized, Zelda-inspired quests in the shared online kingdom of Terracotta! Venture across an archipelago filled with dangerous enemies, quaint towns, puzzling dungeons, and challenges suited for a knight-in-training.

games.name: Descent Of Lunaris
games.summary: Investigate a signal emanating from deep within the moon and fight through a dark reflection of human nature. Are you being tested, or punished for the actions of humanity? Descent of Lunaris is a classic dungeon-crawling turn-based RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Echo Generation 2
games.summary: Embark on a sci-fi deckbuilding RPG odyssey. Gather your crew, craft powerful decks, and battle across the stars to find your way home. Deal the cards. Defy the cosmos. Embrace the adventure.

games.name: Montabi
games.summary: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

games.name: Wax Heads
games.summary: A cosy-punk slice-of-life narrative sim about managing a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues – all to restore the groove!

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: Retail Hell
games.summary: A horror job simulator set in a convenience store in purgatory. Serve non human customers, fight collapsing inventory, survive curses, and uncover why your shift never ends.

games.name: Sin: Reloaded
games.summary: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!

games.name: The Looter
games.summary: The Looter is 2D, action/adventure, pixel art, postapocalyptic indie game.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

games.name: Lunarium
games.summary: Lunarium is an atmospheric fantasy A-RPG. Play as Ave, a light-armored knight, who teams up with Lune, a mysterious Starfarer. Together, they journey to save a dying world, engaging in challenging battles to retrieve the lost glow of the stars and forsaken memories, unveiling cosmic secrets.

games.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
games.summary: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

games.name: SoulQuest
games.summary: Carve your path through hordes of enemies, defying the gods to seize the power of Morrigan, Goddess of Death, and retrieve the soul of your beloved! SoulQuest combines the evergreen Metroidvania gameplay with the unique Celtic mythology into one, action-packed mixture!

games.name: Netcode Warriors
games.summary: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: Pluto
games.summary:
A roguelike deckbuilder where you fight with your fingers, spill some blood, and try to make it to your niece’s birthday on time.

You’re a wizard. A not-so-heroic wizard imprisoned for wizard crime, awoken from your wizard slumber by an invitation from your niece. Escape from jail and traverse a hostile world crawling with danger. Every turn is a frenzy of spell sigils, cracking bones, and desperate gestures as you shred through monstrosities with raw elemental power.

You’re not the chosen one, you’re just trying to be a good uncle.

games.name: Octopinbs
games.summary: A multiplayer action game for 3-10 people. Firefighters (octopuses) must capture the artists (squid) who have infiltrated their ranks! These saboteurs may tell clever tales...but actions never lie.

games.name: Motorslice
games.summary: Parkour through the ruins of a megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure.

games.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate
games.summary: Explore a rich and unique open world in this Adventure RPG. Uncover lost dwarven ruins, build a new society and re-establish dwarven kind.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville
games.summary: A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express. Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

games.name: GodsTV
games.summary: Smash for Fame in This Madcap 90’s Killfest. Meet a vibrant cast of characters in this frantic action game with zero chill where Gods feed off of fame... And fame is a weapon.

games.name: No Wings Required
games.summary: Start your first day at work as an unqualified duck with a balloon and way too much confidence. Wander the Featherfall Islands, help quirky locals, and learn that “winging it” might actually be a real career strategy.

games.name: Find Your Words
games.summary: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.

games.name: Smalland: Survive the Wilds
games.summary: Experience a big adventure on a tiny scale! Enjoy multiplayer survival in a vast, hazardous world. Preparation is key when you're this small & at the bottom of the food chain. Craft weapons & armour, tame & ride creatures, build encampments & explore a strange new land.

games.name: Animalkind
games.summary: Animalkind is an inviting open-world town-building game where you play as an intelligent, aww-dorable animal who discovers an ancient mech. Use your powerful mech to establish your ideal town and recruit a variety of characters to join you. It's the paw-fect game to play with up to 3 friends!

events.name: Nippon Ichi Software UNTITLED// 2026.3.11
events.description: Introducing Nippon Ichi Software's upcoming titles!

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu
games.summary: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

games.name: Curse Warrior
games.summary:
Curse Warrior is a dungeon crawler RPG where you explore and conquer the underground labyrinth “Eclipse,” filled with curses.

In the dungeon, your party members may become cursed through various actions.

Since curses alter the abilities and actions of your party members, players must constantly monitor the state of their party and make crucial decisions on how to proceed. Build stronger characters while managing and adjusting the effects of curses to successfully clear the dungeon.

games.name: Gobble
games.summary: Gobble is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

games.name: The Witch and the Hundred Knight Mobile
games.summary: An upcoming mobile game based on The Witch and the Hundred Knight series.

games.name: The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince
games.summary: The Liar Princess and the Blind Prince follows the tale of two lonely hearts brought together through a mutal misunderstanding. In it, you control the wolf, disguised as a princess, who guides the blind prince through a perilous forest in search of the witch capable of restoring his sight. The forest is home to a number of hostile creatures intent on ending your journey prematurely, as well as hazardous traps that put the prince in danger.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Daisenryaku SSB2
games.summary: Wield over 300 modern weapons, from jets to tanks, and outmaneuver rival forces with your strategy. From small islands to massive total-war maps, turn-based battles let both newcomers and veterans play at their own pace.

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

events.name: Computer Worlds 2026
events.description: Hosted by Gil Lawson & Danny O'Dwyer

games.name: Queen's Domain
games.summary: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

games.name: Ultimate Drummer
games.summary: Ultimate Drummer is an action-platformer where you play as a lone drummer on a sacred quest to restore harmony to a fractured world. Use a fully playable step-sequencer drum kit to reshape reality, awaken lost musicians, and bring music back to life.

games.name: Metamorphosis
games.summary: Trapped in an endless megastructure of rust and reverence, a forsaken nun walks the path of absolution. Towering cathedrals rot beneath the everlasting machinery and the hymn of the lost whispers one plea: deliver our METAMORPHOSIS.

games.name: All Living Things
games.summary: Uncover the secrets of the philosopher’s stone by solving twelve intricately animated puzzles that reveal the mysterious hidden meanings within alchemical images.

games.name: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
games.summary: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

games.name: GoblinAmerica
games.summary: goblinAmerica is a squirmy, bouncy shooting game filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.

games.name: Arctic Eggs
games.summary: A Sci-Fi Cooking game where you take up the role of a Poultry Peddler stuck in Antarctica and longing for a way out. Sell your illegal eggs to those who look hungry.

games.name: Keep Driving
games.summary: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

games.name: FlyKnight
games.summary: Explore, fight, loot and fish! Solo or in co-op mode in this Old School First Person Dungeon Crawler. Earn your knighthood as you oppose the evil witch Lunamoth and stop her curse which prevents everyone from growing wings.

games.name: Brush Burial: Gutter World
games.summary: A murky first-person immersive sim with tightly-wound melee combat and tangled, vertical levels to explore. Use your forked tail to tie your enemies in knots and climb impossible heights. Kill your mark with quickness and cunning, using whatever tools you see fit.

games.name: Judero
games.summary: A handmade action/adventure game based on the rich folklore of the Scottish Borders. You play as Judero, a Celt who can establish a rapport with the nature around him. Travel with Judero through a handcrafted landscape as he discovers there is an evil at work manipulating the unguarded.

games.name: Dungeons of Blood and Dream
games.summary: Play as a mighty blood wizard on a quest to escape a death-loop of psychedelic dungeons. Slay disgusting creatures with a large array of bladed weapons and unnerving spells, harness the power of cursed rings, find mysterious treasures, and learn the secrets of the universe you are trapped in.

games.name: S.p.l.i.t
games.summary: A short psychological horror game, where you attempt to gain root access into an unethical superstructure.

games.name: Mama's Sleeping Angels
games.summary: Kiss and decapitate your friends in a Co-Op horror game about collecting cursed objects to feed to a deity called Mama, lest she hunger for you. Work together, and betray each other... Anything to keep Mama happy.

games.name: Eternity Egg
games.summary: Chaotic adventure-platformer with pilotable mechs, grotesque characters & high-energy trance music.

games.name: Metal Garden
games.summary: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

games.name: Skate Story
games.summary: Ollie, kickflip, and grind your way through the ash and smoke of the Underworld as you take on a seemingly impossible quest. Skate fast to destroy demons and save other tortured souls on your journey from a fragile beginner to a hardened skater.

games.name: How Fish Is Made
games.summary: Are sardines trustworthy? Are you? Do you want to be? How Fish is Made is a janky little jaunt through the world of surrealist storytelling.

games.name: Consume Me
games.summary: did you feel stupid, fat, lazy, and ugly in high school? well i did...but at least i made a life-simulation RPG about it!

games.name: Rogue Light Deck Builder
games.summary:
Rogue Light Deck Builder is a digital wooden board game.

Your house needs a deck. You have a hammer. You have wood and you have nails. The light outside is faulty. You work, you earn. Freedom is $1,000,000.

Build a deck. Use your hammer. Drive the nails in. Scrimp and save. Freedom is just around the corner.

games.name: Mouthwashing
games.summary: The five crew members of The Tulpar are stranded in the empty reaches of space, shrouded in perpetual sunset. God is not watching.

games.name: Fragrance Point
games.summary: What went wrong on Fragrance Point? Explore, hang out, and poke around where you're not supposed to.

games.name: 500 Caliber Contractz
games.summary: 500 Caliber Contractz is a momentum-based 3D-Platformer in which you play as a contract killer hired via crowdfunding to murder CEOs, Disgraced Sinister Ex-Doctors, Private-Prison-Owning DJs, etc. With your handy high caliber sniper rifle and a chest full of anxiety, you can and will propel yourself to where you need to be. Collect tokens that float around for a reason I haven't bothered coming up with and then murder your target. Do it. Please.

games.name: Loading...
games.summary: You are a 10-year-old Kiet. It is 2005, and your brother is dead. Nothing to do but play video games.

games.name: Dread Delusion
games.summary: Dread Delusion is an open world RPG brimming with strange places and dark perils. Carve your own path through the flying continents of a shattered land. Discover curious towns, unearth occult secrets, master powerful magic - and change the world through your choices.

games.name: World of Dogs
games.summary: WORLD OF DOGS is a high-velocity immersive sim where speed isn’t balanced—it’s weaponized. You are the first fully grafted human, stitched together from dead champions, dumped into a collapsing city where every faction is fighting for a future that hates you.

games.name: Vholume
games.summary: Vholume is a melancholic first-person parkour adventure set in a dystopian brutalist city where bureaucracy turns a simple task into an odyssey.

games.name: Titanium Court
games.summary: A surreal strategy game for clowns and criminals.

games.name: Soul Injector Commando
games.summary: FPS where you are tasked by God to give souls to the wealthiest people on Earth, helping them get normal jobs and be productive members of society.

games.name: Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander
games.summary: Set out on a grand adventure of exploration, strategy, and mystery in Erulean Angel: Fantasy Commander. Immerse yourself in a handmade world as you craft armies to outwit your opponents in fully simulated autobattler combat.

events.name: Future Games Show: Spring Showcase 2026
events.description:
The Future Games Show Spring Showcase returns on Thursday, March 12, 2026. Viewers can expect exclusive trailers and developer deep dives on coveted AAA blockbusters and trailblazing indie games, curated by in-house experts.

This year’s Spring Showcase will arrive during the GDC Festival of Gaming broadcast schedule and will be immediately followed by FGS Live From, where the FGS editorial team will regale viewers with the most exciting games on the GDC show floor, as well as debuting more world premiere trailers and insightful developer interviews.

Last year’s events provided updates on hotly-anticipated games like Resident Evil: Requiem, Phantom Blade Zero, and The Expanse: Osiris Reborn — so it’s worth setting a reminder to tune in so you can stay in the know and, hopefully, discover something new.

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary:
Set in a monster-ruled otherworldly dungeon, Stupid Never Dies puts you in control of Davy, a timid zombie living at the very bottom of monster society. Defeat enemies, level up, and collect strange items to grow stronger on your quest to bring Julia, a frozen human girl, back to life.

Steal enemy abilities, customize your undead body with bizarre upgrades, and experience fast-paced combat packed with innovation.

games.name: The 7th Guest Remake
games.summary: The iconic game The 7th Guest has been brought back to life with modern technology, delivering an atmospheric story like no other. Explore a foreboding mansion, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover its dark secrets. The 7th Guest is the ultimate mystery adventure, reimagined for modern platforms.

games.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
games.summary: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

games.name: Last Flag
games.summary: Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

games.name: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight
games.summary: Rise as the Dark Knight and experience the essential Batman story in a bold, action-packed adventure with hard-hitting combat, an open-world Gotham City, and the signature LEGO charm that fans know and love.

games.name: Project Shadowglass
games.summary: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.

games.name: Ready or Not: Boiling Point
games.summary: The relentlessly debased city of Los Sueños faces an existential crisis when a subversive terror attack severs any remaining faith in what's become an ineffective and overwhelmingly militarized city government.

games.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
games.summary: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned - enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

games.name: Unboxing Mr. Coo
games.summary: Mr Coo gets into a new conundrum, this time through the not-so-simple act of opening a gift box. A puzzle and narrative game without words, where you click your way through a mesmerizing toy.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
games.summary: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op FPS roguelite featuring 100% destructible environments and procedurally-generated caves. Join a team of dwarven Reclaimers tasked with reestablishing control over lost deep mining operations on Hoxxes IV.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Shadowstone
games.summary: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics game where players must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

games.name: 1348: Ex Voto
games.summary: Journey through a tumultuous Medieval Italy as Aeta, a young knight errant who sets off on a brutal quest to find and save her closest one. 1348 Ex Voto is a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales.

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.summary:
Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

games.name: Blight: Survival
games.summary: Blight: Survival is an upcoming medieval, co-operative, action horror game set in an alternate 14th century powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes
games.summary: Little Nightmares VR: Altered Echoes is a dark atmospheric adventurepuzzle game where you embody Dark Six, a mysterious figure with the shape of a little girl. Navigate in a disturbing world, solve intricate puzzles, and escape terrifying giant foes in a desperate search to become whole again.

games.name: AstroTechs
games.summary: You're an engineer with a gun and a wrench, and you're the only thing keeping this ship alive. AstroTechs is a tactical action game where you fight corrupted machines, weaponize ship systems, and repair the damage — all under fire.

games.name: Damon and Baby
games.summary: An exciting new style of action adventure fusing shooting action with exploration.

games.name: Anarchy Road
games.summary: Fast Speeds, Big Explosions, even Bigger Bosses and action throughout! Anarchy Road is a Post-Apocalyptic action driving game where our 4 heroes must race against the clock, battle bosses, while blasting enemies and dodging traps in order to survive to the explosive end!

games.name: ReVamp
games.summary: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: Demon Lord: Just a Block
games.summary: Reborn as a Demon Lord, seek revenge on the heroes! This fantasy roguelite game features grid-based combat controlled using four directional inputs. The world only moves when you do: you attack when you collide with enemies. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with dodges and parries!

games.name: Hello Sunshine
games.summary: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

games.name: We Gotta Go
games.summary:
We Gotta Go is a first person co-op horror game where you and your friends have to reach the only bathroom in a haunted mansion before your bowels betray you.

The mansion won’t make it easy: its many passages are blocked, locked, hidden, and haunted... can your team survive all the way to the porcelain promised land?

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Papa Needs a Headshot
games.summary: Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.

games.name: Will: Follow the Light
games.summary: Dive into a realistic, single-player, first-person journey through the harsh northern latitudes as you sail endless waters, searching for a way back to your loved ones. Will you follow the light?

games.name: Outbound
games.summary: Explore a colorful world and build your own cozy home on wheels. Craft workstations, and source energy from the sun, wind, or water. Upgrade and customize your vehicle, grow crops, and live sustainably off-grid with up to 4 players.

games.name: The Dungeon Experience
games.summary: Put your real world responsibilities on hold with a visit to The Dungeon Experience, a fantasy theme park phenomenon. Adventure awaits, for anyone and everyone! If you've already visited, please come back, we fixed that smell.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Heavy Duty
games.summary: The mines are about to get a whole lot louder.

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

games.name: Gate Guard Simulator
games.summary: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

games.name: Life is Strange: Reunion
games.summary: Life is Strange: Reunion is the thrilling finale to the Max and Chloe saga, a chapter that brings their book to a close. This is a full circle moment for both developers and fans—one that builds on everything that has come before. And even as the game delivers a reunion long-thought impossible, it also caps off our time at Caledon University in a literal blaze of glory.

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Shelf Heroes
games.summary: Blast rogue toys with wacky weapons in this fast-paced Roguelite FPS! Mix & match toy parts to assemble your Shelf Hero, discover powerful perk combos, and explore a giant House. Play solo or with friends in 3-player co-op!

games.name: Quite a Ride
games.summary: Pedal through the fog, but never look back.Trapped in a constantly shifting horror, you must ride, conserve your phone's battery, and decode cryptic messages to escape. Explore, survive, uncover the truth.

games.name: Herdles
games.summary:
In Herdles, you play a magical dog on a mission to restore balance to a fracturing world. Zoom through four regions of a vibrant landscape, using physics-based powers to venture further and creatively solve challenges, uncovering secrets using your superpowered bark.

Along the way, you’ll save corrupted creatures called ‘Herdles’. Each Herdle comes with new abilities – bounce, glide, break through walls, swim up waterfalls, and more. Playful experimentation is key! Herdles offers deep accessibility and customization options that you can tailor to suit your comfort, needs and playstyle.

games.name: Killing Floor III: Operation Deep Freeze
Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection
games.summary: Twin Rathalos, born in a twist of fate. Two centuries after a conflict that divided neighboring kingdoms, the drums of war are reignited as twin Rathalos—long thought extinct—hatch from a single egg: an omen of destruction. Is there hope beyond the northern border?

games.name: SlashZero
games.summary: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: The 9th Dragon
games.summary: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

games.name: Samson
games.summary: Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

games.name: Ritual Tides
games.summary: Ritual Tides is an first-person horror game set on a fictional British island, drenched with Lovecraftian terrors.

games.name: Anomaly President
games.summary: In this presidential rogue-like action game, gather votes and run for presidency by day, then transform into a warrior to take down your enemies by night! Master unique skills to become a swordmaster, a cyber mage, or anything in between, and overthrow the ruthless president!

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Yerba Buena
games.summary: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Void Hunters
games.summary: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

games.name: EverRail
games.summary: EverRail is a Single- and up to 4 Player Co-Op open world survival craft odyssey set in a frozen procedural world. Ride the rails! Glide through the air! Brave the cold on foot! Craft, upgrade, explore lost places, gather resources on expeditions, and build your train from the inside out.

games.name: Enginefall
games.summary: Enginefall is a player-driven crafting shooter set on colossal, post-apocalyptic megatrains. Start in the tail alone or with friends as you scavenge, craft, and build your way to First Class. Seize better gear car by car, and escape with high-value loot to upgrade your personal home on the rails.

games.name: The Occultist
games.summary: The Occultist is a first-person narrative thriller. You play as Alan Rebels, a paranormal investigator who travels to an abandoned British island after his father's disappearance. Explore GodStone island, face supernatural entities, and uncover long-buried occult rituals.

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Help the citizens of Emberville rebuild their town, as you rescue them from the clutches of wicked forces with the aid of a mysterious and loyal friend. Learn various crafting and combat skills as you explore the treacherous corridors of a massive, ever-changing dungeon.

games.name: Ex Sanguis
games.summary: From the creators of Othercide, Ex Sanguis delivers what the studio is known for: dynamic & epic turn-based combat in a visually striking world. Bleed the world to life; fight the agents of perfection and stillness through strategic blood baths in this evolved roguelite tactical RPG game!

games.name: Firearms Factory
games.summary: In 1909, your workshop that produced sweet candies for children was hastily turned into a firearms workshop, according to an order from the government. Are you ready to make them win the war?

games.name: Hyperwired
games.summary: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

games.name: Seed
games.summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: DeeSicks
games.summary: Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.

games.name: Distant Shore: Bretagne
games.summary: Explore the ruins of a former research site, devastated by climate collapse. Wield magnetic gauntlets to move, bend, or break metal as you recover lost BIO2 data and uncover your brother’s trail — all while evading the Cloud, a sentient weather entity that watches your every move.

games.name: Permafrost
games.summary: Embark on a brutal journey of survival in a perpetual winter. Hunt and gather resources for building and utilize deep survival mechanics to craft your way through a harsh, unforgiving landscape. Forge alliances or dominate the remnants of humanity in this chilling open world saga.

games.name: Romestead
games.summary: Rome has fallen! Rebuild civilization in this action-adventure survival game for 1-8 players. Fight, build towns and earn favor with the Roman gods! ...or just farm your crops.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is an action-packed mystery Metroidvania game. In Mariachi Legends, Join fantastical festivities at the Day of the Dead carnival alongside Detective Pablo Cruz, currently masquerading as a mariachi player to investigate an evil curse looming over the serene town of Santa Mascota.

games.name: Donut Panic
games.summary: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

events.name: Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026: Edition 01
events.description: Welcome to Edition 01 of 2026 of the Mundo Gamer Showcase! This is the second edition overall of our indie game showcase, and the first of this year. Get a first look at trailers, gameplay and announcements from 38 indie games available on Steam. Add your favorites to your wishlist and stay on top of the best in independent game development!

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

games.name: Galactic Economy
games.summary: Can you become a leader in the Galactic Economy? Buy spaceships and spacestations on you way to get some additional income. Roll the dice and see what you can achieve in this board game.

games.name: Hell Architect: Survivors
games.summary:
A darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin is power.
Play as a demon architect hell-bent on overthrowing Lucifer, rebuilding the underworld, and unleashing forbidden powers with an unholy arsenal.

games.name: Dixotomia
games.summary: Dixotomia is a roleplaying VR shooter in a world of a science-fiction dystopia. Dive into the daily life of a SpecOps contractor, who is forced to fight vampires while also trying to stay sane without giving in to infection himself. Can he return back unchanged?

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence
games.summary: Dive into Ayasa, a dark and mysterious platformer where light and shadow hold the key to survival. Journey through six haunting lands, solve challenging puzzles and restore balance to a world on the brink of collapse.

games.name: Mutant Football League 2
games.summary:
Mutant Football League 2 is an over-the-top, arcade-style football game packed with thrills, strategy, and unrelenting action. Created by the original designer of Mutant League Football and Mutant League Hockey, MFL2 takes brutal gridiron battles to the next level, delivering deep strategic 8-on-8 gameplay, bone-crunching hits, and outrageous mutants that parody your favorite players.

Prepare yourself for the most brutal football experience ever. Step into diabolical arenas filled with deadly traps, where victory isn’t just about scoring points – it’s about survival. Win the traditional way by outscoring your opponent or force a forfeit by racking up a body count that leaves the opposition in shambles. Outwit, cheat, and dominate your way to victory in the most chaotic, carnage-filled football game yet. Whether you're a die-hard sports fan or just looking for wild, unpredictable fun, MFL2 delivers an experience like no other.

games.name: Cup Or Die
games.summary: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

games.name: Detective of the Dead
games.summary: In this narrative noir adventure game you are a detective in the colorful Mexican underworld and must prevent a conspiracy to ruin the classic Día de los Muertos forever. Investigate & use your wit to solve many cases, puzzles, mini-games. Your trusted magic companion dog Xolo is there to help!

games.name: Squarena
games.summary: Squarena is a skill-based party game with an emphasis on physics combat. The game mechanics support ease of entry with a high skill ceiling. Have you ever wanted to prove to your friends who the best colorfully decorated square combatant is? If so, this is the game for you!

games.name: Dino Pet Walker
games.summary: Dino Pet Walker is a Fantasy Casual Game where you realize your childhood dream and play with your dinosaur pet. On this adventure, be ready for solve puzzles and have fun with your and another dino's in a voxel art enviroment, inspired by brazillians biomes.

games.name: Wildsite
games.summary: Crash-landed on an unknown planet filled with plasma and toxic weather. Your only hope? Bob, a sarcastic-genius AI who will question your every survival decision. Explore, build your mobile base and try to avoid death alongside up to 3 friends in Co-op.

games.name: Mafate
games.summary: In MAFATE, play as a mail carrier in the remote Cirque de Mafate in the Indian Ocean. Take photos and deliver letters while exploring this picturesque spot. Help Luna, sent back in time as a camera, touch the locals' lives and uncover the area's charm.

games.name: ShantyTown
games.summary: ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding beauty in everyday chaos. Bring new locations to life, stack your urban buildings high, and fill each little nook and cranny with your own touch. Even messiness has its own little charm.

games.name: Abathor
games.summary: Abathor is a 2D arcade action platformer for up to 4 players. You are the last hope in defense of Atlantis, you’ll face hordes of enemies and countless challenges. Enjoy its pixel art and epic music. A cooperative and competitive game to achieve glory or death.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: DeeSicks
games.summary: Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.

games.name: Reports from Vera Cruz
games.summary: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

games.name: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty
games.summary: Champions Stable: Equestrian Dynasty is the ultimate horse racing management experience. Train, breed, and race your champions across world-famous tracks, or ride freely in a breathtaking open world with stunning visuals.

games.name: Inky Blinky Bob
games.summary: Fly a weaponized hot air balloon across a chain of dangerous islands overrun by failed experiments. Scavenge resources, upgrade your flying machine, and dismantle the defenses of an occult biotech corporation before its greatest creation breaks free.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Hollow Mire: Shadow of Breken House
games.summary: A war hero returns to a shattered England, searching for his missing family while confronting nightmares that defy reality. A choice-driven, narrative thriller with 8 unique endings.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: Kaz
games.summary:
KAZ, your shot of dopamine wrapped in a minimalist roguelike. Execute lightning-fast moves with frame-perfect controls : easy to learn, hard to master. Immediate, Intense, Addictive. Every run makes you better, faster, hungrier, unlocking tons of unique items, skins and challenges.
4 keys, no excuses: Prove your skill and dominate the ranks.

games.name: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits
games.summary: Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

games.name: Gabby's Odyssey
games.summary: Embark on a journey through the fantastical world of Larion in this action-adventure inspired by timeless classics of the genre. Solve clever puzzles, overcome perilous dungeons, and unlock new abilities — while discovering that imagination is not a weakness, but a force that can change everything.

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: Co-op online multiplayer game where you must unite to survive the treacherous depths of a mysterious dungeon, navigate puzzling passageways and gather resources to improve your camping site. Encounter enemies with diverse behaviors, discover coveted treasures, and unravel enigmas within its depths.

games.name: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia
games.summary: Tupi: The Legend of Arariboia is a turn-based roguelite role-playing game based on the story of the Indigenous hero Araribóia and the set of myths that make up South American native mythology as a whole.

games.name: Shapez 2: Factory
games.summary: Dive into a factory-building game where the focus is on just that — building huge factories! Construct sprawling multi-level factories and min-max your layouts without limits. Shapez 2 is tailor-made for enthusiasts who crave the thrill of optimizing production lines and perfecting automation.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: Wizdom Academy
games.summary: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.summary:
Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

games.name: Andromis
games.summary: Play as two heroes a soldier and a doctor in a third-person action adventure packed with explosions, vehicles, and survival missions. Switch between characters, drive cars and tanks, rescue survivors, and fight deadly robots across 50 story missions in a post-apocalyptic world. Coming in January.

games.name: Earth Atlantis 2
games.summary: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

events.name: VR Games Showcase Spring 2026
events.description: See more than 30 VR game announcements and reveals, including Payday: Aces High, FlatOut 4, Compass, The Boys: Trigger Warning and Wrath: Aeon of Ruin VR.

games.name: Bloxer
games.summary: BLOXER mixes the classic match-4 formula with a physical fitness twist. Combine at least 4 blocks of the same colour either horizontally or vertically. The player who can manage their board better is sure to become the winner. You don’t simply move blocks with the controller, however—you have to physically punch your robot ‘’friend’’ to make them align! Uppercut, jab or punch depending on the current situation on the board.

games.name: How to God
games.summary:
Are you a wise and benevolent leader, or a vengeful deity? Will you assist your villagers, or throw them into the sun?
In How to God, a sandbox God Simulation game, you alone choose how to shape your world. Command your followers, experiment with alchemy, build up your villages, and make the choice between good and evil. No judgement from us, of course - only you can choose How to God.

games.name: Shop & Stuff: Supermarket Simulator
games.summary:
Step into the chaos of Shop & Stuff, the quirky VR supermarket simulator where running a store is anything but ordinary.

Start small in this roadside mini-market and hustle your way up by stocking shelves, satisfying bizarre customers, and surviving the wild world of retail. Chase off shoplifters, fix glitchy self-checkouts and clean up unexpected messes to make it through each day!

games.name: Peak Rhythm
games.summary: Ascend to the beat in Peak Rhythm! In this VR rhythm-climbing game, every grab and twist drives your robotic platform upward through a neon-soaked city.
