games.summary: “Compensated Girl” is a deck-building roguelike card battle adventure game.It aims to defeat monsters in card battles and try to escape from a nightmare world.However, the deck you use is the girl herself.Using cards affects the girl directly, changing elements like the UI, story, and more.

games.name: Conductus
games.summary: A rhythm game where you conduct the world with dynamic hand movements! Using a specialized controller and advanced tracking technology, you become the conductor of the world

games.name: Corebreaker
games.summary: Corebreaker is a fast-paced action-platformer game with rogue-like elements. Play as Nova, a robot designed to awaken when humanity is extinct by the machines. Unlock abilities, upgrades and powerful weapons as you fight your way through supreme robots to find out your purpose!

games.name: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown
games.summary: Get ready to blast into retro-racing madness with Cosmic Race! Our game reignites the arcade racing thrill, hurling you through mind-bending tracks, intense combat, and eye-popping visuals. It's like the 80s and 90s racing games on turbo steroids—strap in and relive the glory days!

games.name: Crabmeat
games.summary: A short first-person-point-and-click-survival-horror game set in a future Antarctic fisheries region where you are a prisoner tasked with crabbing for the priceless southern King Crab.

games.name: Culture House
games.summary: Culture House is a nurturing + adventure game based on biological cultivation experiments. Set in a building influenced by 20th-century modernist houses, the game portrays serene and strange days, unravels the mysteries hidden behind the experiments, and culminates in the arrival of the apocalypse.

games.name: Cyclia Journey
games.summary: This title, CYCLIA JOURNEY, is a 2D puzzle action game set in a geometric world where everything is governed by the “The Law of Replication & Re-creation”

games.name: Dancing with Ghosts
games.summary: A cozy wholesome narrative about a young teen girl who befriends a ghost that only she can see. Weighed down by the death of her parents, the girl finds healing through friendship, dance, and helping others. Created to share the message of joy and appreciation for the gift of life.

games.name: Dearend
games.summary: Dearend is a cinematic action-adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by AI. A former soldier haunted by his past and a humanoid girl with a human heart cross paths in a story of loss, connection, and redemption.

games.name: Death a Live
games.summary: Pack the house in 15 daysbefore your "Yandere Fan" stabs you. Survive a live stage swirling with love and madness in this rhythm-action RPG. Manipulate "Sound" and "Emotion" through rhythm inputs, where your performance and your choices dictate the "Girl Voltage"!

games.name: Delve Survivors
games.summary: An old-school roguelike game with modern survivors-like action! Delve into multiple retro pixelated dungeons where you control the pace with fast, reactive turn based movement and ever expanding skills which enable you to plow through hordes of enemies before escaping with the loot

games.name: Die Deep
games.summary: Die Deep delivers a pure and focused combat experience - it’s all about reading your foes and mastering your timing to strike back. Nothing stands in your way but combat! Dive into a constantly changing abyss, take down every enemy in your way, and enjoy the ultimate head-to-head battle experience.

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a Lovecraftian fishing adventure set in a post-nuclear apocalypse world. Sell your yield, upgrade your boat, build equipment and battle monsters lurking in water and on land. Explore forgotten lands and discover ancient secrets.

games.name: Dungeon Clawler
games.summary: Dungeon Clawler is a roguelike claw machine deckbuilder. Players can build their unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artifacts that help them on their quest to reclaim something they lost.

games.name: Dyping Escape
games.summary: Escape from a dying-typing game where the words you type become reality and turn against you.

games.name: Endless Samurai
games.summary: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

games.name: Enter the Chronosphere
games.summary: A psychedelic roguelike that blurs the line between real-time action and turn-based tactics. Play as misfit aliens, craft wild combinations between hundreds of weapons, items and abilities, and disable uncharted chronospheres: Colossal structures that consume time and distort reality.

games.name: Fear FA 98
games.summary: FEAR FA 98: Silent Hill mixed with FIFA 98. Use your enemies' heads as the ball, use knives, and summon demons! the very first survival horror soccer simulator!. Play against the computer, or the classic local mode to enjoy with your friends on a terrifying afternoon worthy of the '90s.

games.name: Finding Polka
games.summary: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!

games.name: Fishbowl
games.summary: Fishbowl is a slice of life, coming of age story told over a month. Video call loved ones, work from home, sort through puzzles to rediscover childhood memories, do care tasks and get to know yourself better, one day at a time.

games.name: Sheol no Mori: Tasogare no Majuuzukai
games.summary: Inspired by “Kodoku Poison,” an ancient Chinese sorcery, this game combines “Kodoku Poison, Beast Alchemy, and Match-3 Puzzles.” Select a few beasts from the herd to turn into familiars, pit your familiars against the beasts, and fuse familiars together to create giant beasts.

games.name: Gambonanza
games.summary: Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!

games.name: Ghost Vanguard
games.summary: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

games.name: Gutsy Grid
games.summary: An Action Deck-builder. Battle through enemy encounters with your trusty Gutsy Bit console. Collect abilities through Carts and Console Mods. Wield the power of the Gutsy-Bit to stop a sinister plot threatening two worlds and have the raddest summer vacation ever.

games.name: Handlime
games.summary:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

games.name: Heartreasure: Stellar Journey
games.summary: Solve puzzles and search for hearts in a pop-up book-like universe! Hand-drawn illustrations, cute animations, and gentle piano melodies create a soothing moment.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: HellPunk: Purgatorium
games.summary: HellPunk is a 2D action gore roguelite game. You play as the main character Asher Drake, who must help Leviathan conquer the Tower and solve the mystery of his family's vanishing.

games.name: Hermit Computer
games.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

games.name: High Fructose
games.summary: "High Fructose" is a first-person shooter roguelite. As a prophesied hero, wield up to five weapons against monstrous fruit. Use various traits and items to create builds and endure the relentless onslaught.

games.name: I Won’t Let You Level up in My Goblin Town
games.summary: Interfere in a turn based fight! When adventurers come to your goblin town to level up, your strongest warrior goblin meets them in Active Time Battle. Run around town gathering the equipment and potions he needs to defeat any adventurer party.

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Jinro Burger
games.summary: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

games.name: Jump into the New Year
games.summary: Jump into the New Year! But if you don't keep jumping for three seconds straight, you'll get swallowed up by another world!?

games.name: Kaguya
games.summary: High-School Heroines Take to the Skies!A fully-voiced bullet hell shoot-'em-up that's friendly to newcomers!Wipe out the AI robot army and save the day!

games.name: Karate Rogue
games.summary: A stance-driven, turn-based combo roguelike—turn defense into offense and fight your way out of the abyss.

games.name: Katuba's Poacher
games.summary: ''Wanted!!'' Chatch the Adoarble 'Sharp' for Reward! "Katuba's Poacher" is Boss-Battle action game with a cartoon and animation style.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Knights of Fiona
games.summary: Fierce dragons have emerged in the land of Gallia. Join Fiona and her sworn knights to protect the kingdom! Embark on quests solo or with friends as you fight against the darkness.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Line Forge BlackSmith
games.summary: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

games.name: Little Cheese Works
games.summary: This is a cooperative action game where you have to carry cheese to the goal without being found by cats. You can have a conversation with voice chat, but the slightest noise will wake up the cat. Let's carry the cheese quietly by breathing quietly so that the cat won't find it!

games.name: Lost and Found Co.
games.summary: Lost & Found Co. is a hidden object adventure in a cozy and immersive world. Join a cast of quirky characters on their epic journey across countless magical locations. Find lost items, solve puzzles, and help a tiny dragon regain her power!

games.name: Mad King Redemption
games.summary: Mad King Redemption is a unique blend of a traditional beat'em'up game with strong roguelite progression, mixed in a pixelated graphic style in a 2.5D world. Relieve the king from his madness while beating up corrupted enemies, in a fresh way at every run!

games.name: Magical Blush
games.summary: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and team up in local co-op as you battle the powerful Elemental Lords and explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

games.name: MAPS (My Apocalyptic Plan for Survival)
games.summary: Rendered in breathtaking cinematic pixel art, MAPS blends the intimate tension of classic survival games with the strategic depth of a sidescrolling colony builder. A deeply diegetic world keeping you immersed in every moment with its tragic beauty.

games.name: Max Gentlemen: Escape From Moriarty Mansion
games.summary: Join nine absurd Victorian characters invited to a mysterious and remote mansion. Solve devious puzzles, explore the mansion and try to keep everyone alive. Friends or Foes: it's up to all of you to discover Professor Moriarty's secrets and defy his murderous game.

games.name: Mekururi: Dizzying Witch
games.summary: A mysterious adventure game where you spin the witch's eyes round and round to unlock secrets. Escort her without hesitation through fantastical puzzles and action.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Moldwasher
games.summary: Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

games.name: Mop'n Spark
games.summary: "MOP'N SPARK" is a 2D puzzle platformer where a street cleaner and an electrician—an unlikely duo—team up to tackle challenging stages.

games.name: Mount Lomyst
games.summary: Mount Lomyst is a 2D action game about climbing to the summit of Mount Lomyst, using a grappling hook and wall climbing — without jumping.

games.name: Nexus Code
games.summary: NEXUS CODE is a 3D programming battle game that reimagines the excitement of the "hobby anime" and "competitive toys" that captivated many children in the 90s and 2000s, using modern programming elements. Build your own unique character and challenge rivals with logical thinking as your weapon.

games.name: Nightmare Operator
games.summary: NIGHTMARE OPERATOR is an action horror shooter about hunting Youkai in the haunted ruins of Tokyo. Combat fuses the tense, shooting gameplay of classic survival horror, with the skill-based mechanics and execution of fighting games and spectacle fighters.

games.name: Ninja or Die 2 Die
games.summary: In a nutshell, it's a high-speed game where you defeat enemies by jumping. The goal is to defeat as many enemies as possible while your soul inhabits another person's body for a limited time, during which the body gradually decays even if you do nothing.

games.name: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook
games.summary: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook is a pixel-art, dialogue-driven mystery game. You’re an AI in a taxi, teaming up with a talkative driver on late-night runs to hear bizarre passenger stories, solve cases in secret, and let him play the “great detective.”

games.name: Onikura
games.summary: A fast-paced and challenging boss-rush with options to customize your playstyle as you progress. Defeat all enemies in your path with unique attacks, specials, parries, and abilities.

games.name: Own Time Own Target
games.summary: Own Time Own Target drops two players into a divided battlefield in a pure 2D 1v1 where reading the environment is just as important as outgunning your opponent. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Friendships not guaranteed.

games.name: Pinball Garden
games.summary: Set in the charming world of “Garden,” where tiny creatures and playful spirits gather, this pinball game features two modes: CLASSIC, a single-player challenge for high scores, and VERSUS, a multiplayer race to fill the honey gauge first.

games.name: Pritto Prisoner
games.summary: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

games.name: Pro Jank Footy
games.summary: Pro Jank Footy is an over-the-top arcade comedy-sports game. Score goals to unleash game-changing power-ups, build a deck of absurd abilities, and tackle a season where no two matches are ever the same—solo or with your mates.

games.name: Project Solaris
games.summary: A rogue-lite RPG about the 100-day challenge of Solaris, a Less magic power witch, and her sidekick Homu, with beautifully animated combat, quick-time events, and charming characters to interact with!

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” You're a passenger on a transcontinental train. Looking for a room that's nowhere to find: Cabin 909.

games.name: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
games.summary: Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Room 502
games.summary: A cynical high schooler, Hae-eun's mundane life takes a colorful turn as she and her dorm roommates in Room 502 unravel mysterious incidents on campus. This game blends academy life, mystery, and youth in a captivating detective adventure.

games.name: Rope-Kun Adventure
games.summary: A very unique rope action game in which the main character "Rope-kun", who wields a rope, overcomes various gimmicks! The possibilities for ropes are endless, from carrying objects, to bouncing balls, to tying up and defeating enemies! Overcome with him the many difficulties that await you!

games.name: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
games.summary: Satoyama note Spring walk is a point-and-click visual novel in which you aim to reach your destination while identifying plants in a satoyama in spring. Listen to the animals, observe and identify the plants as you make your way through the forest, and have lunch under the cherry blossom trees!

games.name: Seraphine's Skyward Journey
games.summary: This game is an adventure game where you explore a steampunk-inspired world with 2.5D hand-drawn graphics aboard an airship. Manage resources like coal, food, and water while operating your airship, defeat sky pirates, engage in trade, and handle cargo transport as you venture into uncharted skies.

games.name: Servant of the Lake
games.summary: Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced, two-player local multiplayer painting game. Each player is given a mouse, a blank canvas, and a few simple paint tools. Each round, a famous painting from art history is revealed. Players race to copy the painting as quickly and accurately as possible.

games.name: Smile Muscle Trainer
games.summary:
Smile, and jump.

A game where your face becomes the controller.

games.name: Spellbrush’s Tactical Game
games.summary:
You are a fallen god.

Trapped as a jet-black crow, you wander through a stark diorama of white marble to uncover the lost colors of seasons past.

Walk through memory and time to rekindle the stone cold hearts of mortal heroes.

A tactical SRPG told through beautiful pixel art. Use the environment, combine the abilities of different vessels…

...and reclaim your Glory.

games.name: Starless Umbra
games.summary: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

games.name: StarVaders
games.summary: Defend the Earth from an alien invasion in the ULTIMATE fusion of deckbuilding and grid-based tactics. Pilot a mech, discover game-breaking combos, and protect the future of humanity in this endlessly replayable roguelike.

games.name: Sunset Game Shop Shayou
games.summary: Manage your dream game shop through gaming history starting from 1985. From the Famicom boom to digital distribution—can you survive this management simulation through Japan's biggest gaming shifts?

games.name: Surface Labyrinth Kurumabu
games.summary: Neo-2D Action Puzzle Game !

games.name: Surfpunk
games.summary: Become a wave-shredding Raider in this intense, PvE co-op extraction ARPG. Hop on your Rushboard, loot ancient artifacts, hack n’ slash through hordes of monsters and escape in style. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

games.name: Sushi Lick
games.summary: One lick away from a lifetime ban. Sushi Lick is a licking and chaos simulator about trading your dignity for viral views. Upset the customers and lick the sushi while dodging the chef’s sharp eyes. Be fast, because being caught means your fame ends in an instant.

games.name: Syndream
games.summary:
The game consists of an ADV section where you advance the story by choosing dialogue options, and an action section where you explore a dream world.

As the story progresses in the ADV segment, new dream worlds are unlocked.

By exploring the dream world and utilizing action mechanics, players uncover the truth behind the dreams, which reflect the inner lives of each chara

games.name: Tammuz: Blood & Sand
games.summary: A mythic VR puzzle-box adventure where ancient mechanisms come alive beneath your hands. Solve over 20 unique trials inside a divine cube prison and uncover Mesopotamian secrets that blur the line between reality and legend.

games.name: The 60 Second Syndrome
games.summary: You will die in 60 seconds. This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room. Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

games.name: The Little Tomb: The Maholova Club and the Search for a Dead Body
games.summary: "Is there a dead body who'd like to be buried in me?" This is a coming-of-age adventure of a young boy who believes he's an ancient tomb! As Kofun, interact with all sorts of characters and objects. Gain points and spend them on new skills and hints to show Kofun a world of new experiences!

games.name: The Posthumous Investigation
games.summary: Travel to a noir Rio de Janeiro in 1937 and investigate the mystery behind the murder of Bras Cubas, the famed character created by Machado de Assis. Until the truth is out, you'll be trapped in a time loop, amidst a plot full of conspiracy and treason.

games.name: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time
games.summary: The Remake of the End of the Greatest RPG of All Time is the last hour of a lost (nonexistent) JRPG, "remade” in 3D pixel art complete with director’s commentary, the digital manual, and archival footage.

games.name: The Void Between
games.summary: When one man's dream holiday turns into a nightmare, it's up to you save him from himself... VOID is an FMV style puzzle game that leads you through a labyrinth of mysterious challenges and puzzling obstacles. Can you uncover the keys that will unlock your freedom, or seal your fate...

games.name: Thumbylina
games.summary: Thumbylina is a fingertip-sized life simulation game device designed to be your daily companion. When you set a timer during study or exercise, your in-game character joins you in self-improvement—unlocking new outfits and hairstyles as you progress. Unlike smartphone or PC timer apps, Thumbylina is completely offline, allowing you to focus without any distracting notifications.

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard's castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle's dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don't.

games.name: Vikings on Trampolines
games.summary: It's all about trampolines! Stay on the trampolines and push your opponents off to win. Brawl against your friends or work together to save the kingdom. Big bosses, big minigames and evil balloons..? Play solo or local multiplayer for up to 4 players! Accessible controls: Only one hand needed.

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: Weatherium
games.summary:
You play as a little god who can control weather elements such as temperature and wind.
Warm the air, and convection will begin, eventually giving birth to clouds.
Carry rain clouds on the wind, and new water sources may spread across the land.

games.name: Yaoyoro Zoo
games.summary:
Remote-control bats, toolbox hippos, clock owls... familiar items have transformed into adorable yet strange animals called ""Fanimals,"" living freely and happily!

Your mission as a caretaker is to deliver food to these Fanimals.

Navigate through 2D stages created within rooms, solve puzzles, and reach the food box.

games.name: Zurarararush!!!
games.summary: Zurararush!!! is a twin-stick shooter that you can play easily! Wear a wig as a weapon and defeat the virus that mutated inside your body! Power up your character and wig and become stronger! Defeat a lot of enemies and feel good! It's an arcade-style casual game that you'll want to play every day.

games.name: Ninja Game
games.summary: Immersive stealth action ninja simulation! Act like a ninja. Sneak up on a ninja. Strangle a ninja. Dropkick a ninja off a cliff. Throw a ninja out the window. Kidnap a ninja. Make friends with a ninja in real life and play splitscreen coop together!

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
games.summary: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

games.name: One Song, One Life
games.summary: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

games.name: Threat: Scream and Escape
games.summary: THREAT -SCREAM AND ESCAPE- is a unique horror game where you must scream into your microphone to stun approaching creatures and make your escape. Use the power of your voice to clear the path and guide the protagonist, who wakes up in a mysterious research facility, to freedom.

games.name: Ultra Jet Girl
games.summary: A jetpack action rogue light game in which the main character, Roo, picks up a broken jetpack and heads to a faraway empty island in the sky in search of his mother.

games.name: Mononoke no Kuni
games.summary: Through free village building and boat trips, this 3D open-world action game adds the fun of discovering and exploring unknown islands, as well as the tension and strategy of roguelite dungeon crawling!

games.name: Liquid Abyss: The Melted Jelly
games.summary: An endless abyss... Is salvation waiting at its end? Ellie awakens in a submerged world resembling an aquarium. Seeing her reflection, she finds her body has turned to jelly. With no memory of how she got here, glowing jellyfish drift around her. Can she find salvation—or be consumed by the abyss?

games.name: Harold Halibut
games.summary:
Dive into this nautic adventure as curiosity will guide you through a space ship wreck on an unknown planet made up of water. When one of the lead scientists still on board tries to unriddle the possibility of a relaunch young Janitor Harold is around to assist her. Join Harold in his clumsy undertakings to stir up the ark-like ship’s stale day-to-day life and find the secrets that lie behind its doors.

Underwater atmosphere, self-reflective humor and contemporary adventure mechanics make up the foundation of this game created entirely out of craft supplies.

games.name: Animal Well
games.summary: What lurks beneath the surface of this deceptively minimalistic adventure? In Animal Well there is more than what you see. Explore a dense interconnected labyrinth, and unravel its many secrets. Collect items to manipulate your environment in surprising and meaningful ways. Encounter creatures both beautiful and unsettling, and try to survive what lurks in the dark.

games.name: Sword of the Sea
games.summary:
Sword of the Sea is an action-adventure game developed by Giant Squid, the studio behind Abzû and The Pathless.

Set in a vast desert landscape, players control a character known as the Wraith, exploring ruins and uncovering a lost world. Movement is centered on the "Hoversword," a tool that combines surfing, skateboarding, and snowboarding mechanics. The game emphasizes fluid traversal, atmospheric exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

games.name: Naiad
games.summary: A relaxing and colorful exploration adventure about flowing by a river. Immerse yourself in a relaxing, minimalist and colorful exploration adventure. Flow with Naiad across a mysterious river and interact with its fauna and flora to discover little secrets. A very personal and unique game created with love by a solo dev.

games.name: Ultros
games.summary: Ultros is a psychedelic metroidvania where you wake up stranded on The Sarcophagus — a cosmic uterus holding an ancient, demonic being. Trapped in the loop of a black hole, you will have to explore The Sarcophagus and meet its inhabitants to understand the part you play...

games.name: The Midnight Walk
games.summary:
Embark upon The Midnight Walk in this reverent dark fantasy adventure built in clay, from the minds behind Lost in Random and Fe.

Become The Burnt One, befriend a lost lantern creature named Potboy, and use his flame to light your way through a conflicting world of wonder and horror. Survive and outsmart the many monsters eager to devour your little friend’s flame as you experience five tales of fire and darkness, featuring an incredible cast of odd characters.

Marvel at every disturbing detail in a landscape painstakingly handcrafted with real life clay and animated in a stop motion style. Fully playable in both flatscreen and with a VR headset.

games.name: Windrose
games.summary: Embark on a PvE survival adventure in the Age of Piracy. Fight on land and sea, solo or with friends. Build, craft and explore vast open world filled with dark secrets. Master soulslite combat and take on challenging bosses, command your ship and plunder unspoken treasures!

games.name: Palworld: Palfarm
games.summary: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!

games.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
games.summary: Kotama and Academy Citadel is a 3D Metroidvania game. Players assume the role of an exchange student named Kotama as she explores through the mysterious Academy Citadel, aiming to become the esteemed [Carmel Star].

games.name: Sultan's Game
games.summary: Sultan's Game is a card-based simulation and narrative game, inspired by The One Thousand and One Nights. You are one of the ministers of the mighty Sultan, a fickle, cruel king that treats his subject like pawns of a deadly game for his own pleasure. Forced to make dreadful choices to save your own life, you will have to find a way to survive not just the Sultan’s Game, but its consequences too.

games.name: Omen Exitio: Hunger
games.summary: A Lovecraftian investigative gamebook. New York, 1927. A case pulled from real history, wrapped in cosmic horror. His name was Billy Gaffney. The man who took him was real. But his purpose was from another plane of existence. You play a journalist. You make choices. The story remembers all of them.

games.name: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
games.summary: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

games.name: Cohen 1939
games.summary: "Cohen 1939" is a top-down shooter set in Birmingham, England in 1939. Players take on the role of a woman seeking vengeance for her murdered gangster husband . You will be immersed in classic British gangland scenes of the 1930s.

games.name: Quack Quack Up
games.summary: A voice-controlled party game that will have you and your friends screaming until you pass out! Drop the controller and use your vocal cords to herd a flock of ducks to the finish line—or watch them all yeet off a cliff because someone yelled a bit too loud!

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

games.name: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
games.summary: At nightfall, the sieged city falls. Yaoguai came to massacre. You are nothing but a scholar on the brink of madness, trying to survive alongside a courtesan you met years ago. Experience two intertwined storylines in this sequel to the visual novel "The Hungry Lamb".

games.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced
games.summary:
This release contains the 3 classic side-scrolling 2D action games "Azure Striker Gunvolt" (2014), "Azure Striker Gunvolt 2" (2016), and "Azure Striker Gunvolt 3" (2022), including all available DLC.

Enjoy not just the action, but deep story that plays out without interrupting gameplay in "Live Novel" dialog that plays during missions. With full voiceover (Japanese only in Gunvolt 1 and 2) and a total of 37 vocal tracks sung by the "Muses", you'll be immersed in the near-future dystopian world.

In addition, the series director has renewed all three titles, polishing the action gameplay and updating the music. Previously separately available items such as voice drama CDs are now included in-game in Library Mode, making for the most complete "final version" of the trilogy.

games.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 3
games.summary: The speedy and stylish action of the Luminous Avenger series is back! Our hero Copen must use his new "Divide Edge" energy swords to protect his home from otherworldly invaders! His trusty partner Lola is there to support him with evolutionary new modes!

games.name: Gunvolt Chronicles: Luminous Avenger iX 1+2 Dual Collection
games.summary: The apeX of 2D action, the Luminous Avenger iX series, complete and refined. With all DLC and new balance updates, both games reach their peak. Plus an all-new "Endless Battle" mode. This special update is perfect for new and returning players alike.

games.name: Majogami
games.summary: The sword fighter Shiroha cleaves through a twisted world with her high-speed Setsuna, facing off against the powerful witches in her way, in 2D paper craft character action. Paper craft character action! Majogami - the story of one girl who cuts gods like paper.

games.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster
games.summary: A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy! Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

games.name: Shibuya Scramble Stories
games.summary:
Game designer and 428: Shibuya Scramble executive producer Jiro Ishii has announced the launch of a new “Shibuya Live-Action Adventure Game.” Led by general director Ishii and screenwriter Yukinori Kitajima, the project will be a live-action adventure game set in Shibuya.
The game itself will use an “ensemble drama” system—a synchronized story with multiple protagonists, in which players experience a multiple-perspective structure that shifts between each character’s viewpoint.

games.name: Depth Loop
games.summary: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

games.name: Archetype Blue
games.summary: Archetype Blue is a rogue-lite deck building game where you form your own adventure team and deck before facing the challenges this fantasy world has in store for you. With all the options in front of you and the circumstances surrounding your expedition, do you have any chance of succeeding?

games.name: Blackout: Zero Point
games.summary: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

games.name: Lone Chef
games.summary: Set off on a flavorful adventure in Lone Chef, an action Metroidvania where hunting, cooking, and exploration come together. Discover a vast world, meet unforgettable companions, and chase after the most mouthwatering dish imaginable.

games.name: Module:Berserk
games.summary: MODULE:BERSERK is a 2D pixel "hard-boiled" action game with steampunk-inspired world of endless desertification and corruption. Play as a butler-styled automaton. Track down the suspect that caused terrifying event to the family you serve. And protect the only survivor, 'lady' from upcoming dangers.

games.name: Monowave
games.summary: Monowave is a whimsical puzzle-adventure platformer about the transformative power of emotions. Explore beautiful landscapes and empathize with its quirky denizens to restore harmony in an emotionally turbulent universe.

games.name: Project Revenant
games.summary: Project Revenant is a side-scrolling shooter that requires "Precision Aiming" at hitboxes using the cursor.

games.name: Staffer Retro
games.summary: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

games.name: Thanks, Light.
games.summary: [Thanks, Light.] is a first-person 3D geometry puzzle game where you shine and absorb light to transform 2D and 3D states.Watch as one boy saves a world that has lost its light.

games.name: There is No Plan B
games.summary: Within a cyberpunk world in the year 2070, become Detective B to investigate crime scenes, discover hidden truths, and dismantle the perpetrators' lies. There's only one problem: you have to do all that "without" stepping foot outside your house.

games.name: Velaster
games.summary: Velaster is a gruesome 2.5D side-scrolling action combat game set in the Middle-earth called Malum. You will find yourself growing in battles against various monsters and bosses. Take revenge that remains in your fading memories.

games.name: Dark Scrolls
games.summary: Dark Scrolls is a fantasy-themed action platformer that fuses shmup-style chaos with roguelite progression and is packed with charm, challenge, and secrets.

games.name: Heave Ho
games.summary: Heave Ho tasks up to four players with a simple goal – don’t fall to your death! Players will use their own two hands and the outstretched grip of their friends to grapple across each level on their way to victory. Grab one another’s hands, climb across dangling bodies, and swing your pals to safety in a wobbly, dangly mass of limbs. Customize your character with all manner of stylish accessories and zany accouterment in a vain attempt to remember who you are and which of your hands is the only thing between you and the plummet of doom.

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: Unyielder
games.summary: Unyielder is an intense Boss-Rush Movement-Shooter with a flexible and exploitable Roguelite-Looter sandbox. Carve your way through the war-torn lands of Antarctica, Hunt down war machines and Assemble your arsenal of destruction.

games.name: Anthem#9
games.summary: Combine Gems to unleash Skills in ANTHEM#9, a deck-building rogue-lite puzzle-battler! Customize your Recipes for a wide variety of deck ideas, and explore the thrilling story of secret agents fighting for world order.

games.name: Atmosfar
games.summary: Atmosfar is a sky-high odyssey set on an alien planet of floating islands explored by flying crafts and a mobile airbase as you uncover the fate of your collapsed colony.

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Urban Myth Dissolution Center
games.summary: Join forces with the psychic Director of the Urban Myth Dissolution Center and solve a variety of cases involving cursed relics, rental properties with shady histories, and dimensional anomalies. Monstrous oddities and otherworldly planes abound in this occult mystery adventure game!

games.name: Underling Uprising
games.summary: Play as the Underlings, a group of experiments created by evil mad science, as you seek revenge on your previous captor, the maniacal Dr. Baldrick! On their journey, the Underlings will need to fight across the globe, overcome the demons of their pasts, and accept help from unexpected places.

games.name: Clue: Murder By Death
games.summary: A narrative adventure set in 1930s England. Immerse yourself in an adventure where knowing who, how and why will depend on your skills as a detective.

games.name: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
games.summary: Cute 2D Point-n-Click of the adorable comic book characters Jordi and Oslo the dragon.

games.name: Ariadne's Tale
games.summary: A game about the myth of the minotaur and escaping the labyrinth with the help of a magic thread

games.name: Zaya: Rise to the Gods
games.summary: A gore action and adventure game where you'll learn about the Mayan culture while you explore, obtain new abilities and defeat enemies to save Zaya's lands from the curse that ravages humankind and deities.

games.name: Angie Magica
games.summary: Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!

games.name: Never / Together
games.summary: A chaotic and exhilarating 2D co-op shooter where two friends in parallel universes must share a single weapon while a deadly split screen line is trying to take them out

games.name: Spark Of Nature
games.summary: Experience the adventure of a curious Aloe Vera in a magic and fun big world!

games.name: Kumari Samsara: The Living Goddess
games.summary: A narrative-driven 3D puzzle-adventure, set in a post-apocalyptic future of floating cities where climate change has erased history, the game breathes new life into the mystical cultural heritage of Nepal.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: Yodelee Golf
games.summary: Yodelee Golf is a cozy open world multi-player co-op game of the craziest golf ever, with motorbikes, boats, gondola, secret mountain caves, monsters, rubber duckies and a single golf ball. Ray-traced proximity chat adds to the fun and the chaos, climb a mountain and shout Yo-delee-oh!

games.name: 34Everlast
games.summary: This is a super-concentrated action entertainment for busy working adults. The game is an action puzzle game where your discoveries and actions unravel a complex and intertwined world of breathless action in a dying world.

games.name: Ruins Magus
games.summary: Ruins Magus is a VR action RPG developed for VR. Explore and cast your way in first-person through an immersive fantasy world. As a novice member of the RUINSMAGUS guild, work with the Enigma Research Institute to uncover the mysteries hidden beneath the gilded streets of Grand Amnis.

games.name: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle
games.summary: Once you open this book, you are no longer just a reader. A "reading-style" fantasy adventure in the spirit of The NeverEnding Story — handcrafted over six years by a 30-year veteran from Vanillaware. 100% handmade, from the first page to the last.

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Torima Headbang
games.summary: You are a badass bird thug with a sick crest. Strap on your HMD, throw your sanity away, and blast through the concrete jungle BACKWARDS on a mini-skateboard. The better you match the rhythm, the more wind you blast — and the faster you RIDE!

games.name: Tokyo Stories
games.summary: The city continues to tell her story, even after her disappearance.

games.name: Akiba Lost
games.summary: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “Akiba’s Spirited Away”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: HoloVillage: Our Cozy Days
games.summary: Farm, fish, mine, craft, and decorate your home in this cozy multiplayer life sim. Venture into dungeons and take on bosses outside the village for some added excitement. Share relaxing and thrilling moments alike with hololive talents as you shape your countryside life.

games.name: Calling
games.summary: A short sci-fi adventure where an astronaut struggles to decipher a "mysterious voice" through a broken communication device. Using only distorted visuals and flickering audio as clues, you must unravel the true feelings hidden behind the transmission. As the messages arrive in real-time... will you be able to hear them out until the very end?

games.name: 4Dead
games.summary:
The only way to live is to eat!

Control the strongest invincible creature, "No. 42," who dies in 4 seconds, defeat the alien invaders, and survive!

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: Buu must deliver a package through a deep forest. Despite many attempts to challenge the forest, he has not succeeded. Chat with passersby, explore, and take breaks at campsites, while searching for a way to get through the forest. Let's go on a small nighttime adventure with Buu!

games.name: Abyss Kitchen
games.summary: Abyss Kitchen is a survival action game in which you play the role of Lop a cook who accompanies a party of adventurers, and guides them with the power of food. Feed yourself in the dungeon and eat whatever you can to keep from starving and falling down. Eat up anything that stands in your way!

games.name: Addie Shen
games.summary: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit
games.summary:
"Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit" is a mystery adventure featuring a public security duo tackling supernatural cases.

Players take on the role of Tsujitsuma, a member of the "Angelic Agency" investigating "Ghosturbance Cases." The game progresses through three phases: (1) Conversation Part, (2) Deduction Part, and (3) Salvation Part.

Players navigate these phases to uncover the truth behind each incident.

games.name: Antonblast
games.summary: Antonblast is a fast-paced explosive action platformer that's all about destruction. Play as the enraged Dynamite Anton (or his cranked-out coworker Annie) and use your Mighty F’n Hammer to demolish bizarre worlds, tussle with screen-filling bosses, and steal your Spirits back from Satan!

games.name: Astromine
games.summary: Astromine is a co-op survival game about scavenging fully destructible voxel planets. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

games.name: Awaking Beauty
games.summary: Let’s save the world through dreaming—together! "Awaking Beauty" is a two-character roguelite action game that blends sci-fi and fantasy. You’ll play as selected high school girls piloting dream-diving mechas to rescue those trapped in the dream world.

games.name: Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter
games.summary:
From the makers of HANA, comes a life sim JRPG for Playdate and PC about living in an apartment complex that's infested with monsters.

Use your sick baseball skills to exterminate monsters from your neighbors' apartments as a part-time devil hunter!!

Save up money for convenience store runs, and to pay off your overdue rent!!

CRANK to use the elevator and baseball bat!!

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: BB Adventure
games.summary: “BB Adventure” is an immersive action game where you ride a real balance ball and clear athletic stages. Using a controller with an accelerometer, your balance ball’s movements control the in-game character, making you feel as if you’re inside the game.

games.name: Bento Blocks
games.summary: Craft delicious lunch boxes in this cozy-yet-challenging ingredient-cutting puzzle game.

games.name: BlueLine
games.summary: A visual narrative experience about a Bangkok millennial, Blue, balancing authenticity and social media pressures in a digital age. Engage in mindful activities, engaging conversations, as well as navigate the tension between authenticity and the need to impress.

games.name: Bytes and Knights Adventure
games.summary: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

events.name: BitSummit Punch Mixtape 2026: In Association with GamesRadar+
events.description: Hosted by Future Games Show fan favorite Jules Gill, alongside familiar BitSummit face and indie gaming personality J-mon, BitSummit Punch Mixtape Presented by GamesRadar+ will feature interviews, trailers and more from the ground at the BitSummit Punch 2026 festival.

games.name: Kopernicus: Extraction
games.summary: Incremental suffering. Experience the 2-bit terror of the sole SSC KOPERNICUS survivor. Expand your base, construct weapons and face nightmares while trying to EXTRACT forgotten memories. There is no escape from THE THINGS you love.

games.name: Saeko: Giantess Dating Sim
games.summary: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you. Experience the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story with avant-garde art.

games.name: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle
games.summary: Once you open this book, you are no longer just a reader. A "reading-style" fantasy adventure in the spirit of The NeverEnding Story — handcrafted over six years by a 30-year veteran from Vanillaware. 100% handmade, from the first page to the last.

games.name: Nightmare House: Reimagined
games.summary: No sleeping beyond this point. Escape a waking nightmare in this classic survival horror experience. She's waiting for you.

games.name: Zhen: Shattered Legacy
games.summary: Zhen: Shattered Legacy is a Twin-Stick, Action-Adventure where you play as a Robot Warrior Monk sent to investigate a decrepit realm in order to restore the righteous way of Kung Fu.

games.name: Annihilated
games.summary: Dungeon-crawling adventure where you must choose a single survivor from a hero's party that has been annihilated. The Hero can only say "Yes" or "No," the Mage cannot use magic, the Warrior has been turned into a cute doll, and the Cleric worships an evil god. The choice of who to save is yours.

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: BrokenLore: Ascend
games.summary: BrokenLore: Ascend is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness—and to the truth about themselves.

games.name: Yodelee Golf
games.summary: Yodelee Golf is a cozy open world multi-player co-op game of the craziest golf ever, with motorbikes, boats, gondola, secret mountain caves, monsters, rubber duckies and a single golf ball. Ray-traced proximity chat adds to the fun and the chaos, climb a mountain and shout Yo-delee-oh!

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Dungeons of Dusk
games.summary: Dungeons of DUSK is a classic turn based dungeon crawling RPG that takes place canonically between the episodes of the cult classic FPS. Are you... WORTHY?

games.name: Dr. Oops!
games.summary: Become an unlicensed doctor at a shady hospital, diagnose bizarre patients for fun, and struggle to pay off your debt in this medical adventure game!

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: In Falsus
games.summary:
"In Falsus" ties music gameplay to a tale of lies and truth, told through the eyes of 5 girls in a modern world both familiar and not.

An atmospheric soundscape awaits across 70+ songs—including more than 40 originals—arriving on release and produced by composers at the forefront of Japan's independent music scene.

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

games.name: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
games.summary: At nightfall, the sieged city falls. Yaoguai came to massacre. You are nothing but a scholar on the brink of madness, trying to survive alongside a courtesan you met years ago. Experience two intertwined storylines in this sequel to the visual novel "The Hungry Lamb".

games.name: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
games.summary: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

games.name: Cohen 1939
games.summary: "Cohen 1939" is a top-down shooter set in Birmingham, England in 1939. Players take on the role of a woman seeking vengeance for her murdered gangster husband . You will be immersed in classic British gangland scenes of the 1930s.

games.name: Unhomely
games.summary: Unhomely is a retro-inspired first person psychological indie horror game. You play a journalist who has 3 days alone in a reclusive tech CEO's cabin to get the exclusive on his new project and save your career.

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: End of Eden
games.summary: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

games.name: 7 Days To Think About It
games.summary: A short spot the difference psychological horror game. Your friends invite you to hang out tonight - you have 7 days to think about it.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

games.name: Opus: Prism Peak
games.summary: Opus: Prism Peak is a narrative adventure where your choices lead to divergent endings. Play as a photographer lost in an ethereal realm, and unveil its mysteries with your camera to find a way home.

games.name: Cataract: Autobattler Roguelite Deckbuilder
games.summary: Experience JRPG-inspired autobattles featuring unique combat mechanics. Recruit characters, level them up, choose their skills, loot monsters, and achieve perfect synergy to finally free the realm from the Allseeing's gaze.

games.name: The Traveller's Sight
games.summary: Vincent Dumas, an investigator with supernatural powers, is sent to a small town in France with a murky history to uncover the truth behind the death of Laurène Delgado. Using his ability to communicate with the dead, he sets out to find clues that will lead him to the killer.

games.name: Cartefact
games.summary: Cartefact is an automation card game. Craft, automate and manage resources all through cards Play as a young explorer who lands on a distant alien planet to uncover its mysteries and find a way to solve humanity's energy crisis.

games.name: Al'ulA
games.summary:
First-person narrative puzzle game made by a team of French students!
In Al’ulA you play as Mariam, a moroccan astronomer that just lost her mentor. One day while studying, she discovers a strange cube, a prototype created by a strange Entity.
You will manipulate the room around you using the alien Artefact : turn, rotate and twist the environment to your will and pierce the secrets of a strange and unknown dimension!

Think, Rotate, Escape

games.name: Project Louisiana: The Bounds VR
games.summary: Explore a cursed mansion from New Orleans, survive its horrors and find what happened to your daughter. Exploration, voodoo, puzzle solving, combat, strong narrative and multiple endings.

games.name: Crown of Hispania
games.summary: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Will you become a legendary ruler, or will you be rejected by those forgotten by History?

games.name: Tropical Resort Simulator
games.summary: Transform an abandoned island into a thriving business. Install fun activities, open your restaurant, maintain your equipment, manage your staff. It's time to open the beach, you're ready to welcome your first customers!

games.name: Glimvale: My Mini Overworld
games.summary: Manage and customize your little fantasy village, make your adventurers happy with cute and varied shops and decorate their environment as you please. After all, you are the master of the game !

games.name: Near Mint
games.summary: Create your own cards and combine them in a unique and everchanging deck. Explore and battle through hostile lands, encounter bizarre creatures and craft the perfect strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: BloomKeeper
games.summary: Spread nature and breathe life back into a world of ash by guiding the Pouics, naive and curious little creatures. They dream of reawakening the world, but they can’t do it alone. Guide them, calm them, protect them and help them restore life to a forgotten land.

games.name: Gobliiins Collection
games.summary:
A wave of nostalgia is in the air! One of the most memorable and delightfully zany point-and-click adventures of its time is back.
Discover – or rediscover – the origins of this legendary saga, from the creative genius of Pierre Gilhodes, in this exceptional collection. From its pixelated beginnings in the 1990s to today, this compilation brings together the first five iconic titles that captivated a whole generation.

games.name: Painted Kingdoms
games.summary: Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you paint, build, and defend your Kingdom of paper. Harness the power of paint to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The Corrosion, a plague of unparalleled proportions, has already ravaged the Astryan continent. On the other side of the world, the continent of Avaris and its nomadic peoples—so far spared from the horrors spawned by this abomination—now stand on the brink of extinction. Eline, an itinerant Soul Whisperer, relentlessly battles the force that turns the once-thriving fauna, flora and humans of this lush land into grotesque abominations. Following a mysterious encounter, a dark power awakens within her, one that may hold the key to ending this apocalypse: the ability to control the Corrosion within her own body.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: 1499. Paris is engulfed in flames as monstrous creatures suddenly emerge from the shadows. Trevor Belmont, the hero who defeated Dracula, ventures into the burning streets with his daughter, Rose Belmont. Armed with the legendary holy whip, the Vampire Killer, they hunt down the beasts bleeding from the looming castle.

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

games.name: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced
games.summary: The iconic solo pirate adventure returns with Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced, launching on July 9, 2026. Sail the Caribbean as Edward Kenway during the Golden Age of Piracy in this faithfully enhanced remake featuring stunning visuals, upgraded gameplay, and new content.

games.name: Out of Range
games.summary: Play as a dissident robot who tries to flee a spaceship as other robots thinks you're a menace. Gather new weapons and power-ups to travel through enemy-filled arenas in this 15 minutes action-packed twin-stick shooter adventure

games.name: Stickerino
games.summary: Go wild with stickers on your cards to break all the limits and hit totally sky-high scores! Collect snacks and Monstraks, flex your style, and crush the Sticker Wizard’s challenges!

games.name: Kalanoro
games.summary: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

games.name: Calame
games.summary: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

games.name: Feed the Giants
games.summary: You are a giant guiding a group of lost children through a hostile world. Help them… or sacrifice them to entertain your kind, who watch the spectacle from above. Some want to see them thrive, others crave their suffering. Every choice has its price.

games.name: Distant Shore: Bretagne
games.summary: Explore the ruins of a former research site, devastated by climate collapse. Wield magnetic gauntlets to move, bend, or break metal as you recover lost BIO2 data and uncover your brother’s trail — all while evading the Cloud, a sentient weather entity that watches your every move.

games.name: Cairn: On the Trail
games.summary: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Mirage: Miracle Quest
games.summary: Mirage: Miracle Quest is a modernized turn-based RPG, where strategy meets magical girl flair. Join Mirage on a thrilling journey to master her powers! Customize your playstyle, travel with a memorable team and explore a splendid hand-painted world!

games.name: Yerba Buena
games.summary: Dive into a surreal 1970s gameworld and save San Francisco from a sinister threat. Play as Barb, and use the Oscillator to capture and reapply the physical traits of objects to solve mind-bending environmental platforming puzzles.

games.name: Far Far West
games.summary: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Heave Ho 2
games.summary: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

games.name: Dive or Die: Children of Rain
games.summary: Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: Crushed in Time
games.summary: Embark on an adventure with Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson on this surprising and elastic point-and-click adventure. Grab, pull, and release to help them solve a bizarre investigation full of humor and meta-time travel!

games.name: Dash'n'Drops
games.summary: Blast your way through Dash'n'Drops, a platform-fighting inspired roguelite. Build your own moveset, max your stats, and defeat the 7 Eternals!

games.name: Craving Wisps
games.summary: Slide in the walls, possess your enemies, and discover a mysterious world threatened by wicked spirits! This short adventure, full of action and humour, will please platformer fans and players looking for an original experience!

games.name: Beware of the Cartographer!
games.summary:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

games.name: Emberfall
games.summary:
Emberfall is the first roguevania-survivor: a roguelite, metroidvania, and survivor-inspired action-platformer.
You must extract from the deadly catacombs of the fallen citadel "Lemia" in less than 10 minutes.
Emberfall puts you in control of Kali, who defeated the God of Greed and the Goddess of Light. Now, the gods have failed, and the citadel will collapse.
Tough and fast, with snappy controls and endless challenges.
Enjoy an idling-combat system and focus on finding your way out while dodging enemies.
The game offers a simple but enjoyable roguelite system.
Purchase upgrades across your runs to become more powerful from the start.

games.name: Free as Birds: Uazo
games.summary: Soar as a curious bird on a mysterious island filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and hidden wonders. Explore with your friends, gather resources, build, survive and uncover the island’s story in this serene adventure.

games.name: The Granny Detective Society
games.summary: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.name: Knuckle Paradise
games.summary: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

games.name: Last Moon
games.summary: The Moon is falling, malicious creatures appear, the world falls in chaos! Last Moon is an Action-RPG greatly inspired by the mythical titles from the 90s! Explore a mesmerizing, vast and ruined world riddled with dangers, face tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities in a classic hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
games.summary: Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Asobo Studio and published by Focus Entertainment. Set 15 years before A Plague Tale: Requiem, it follows Sophia, a young plunderer, as she travels to Minotaur’s Island and searches for answers about her past. The game is described as an original story set in the A Plague Tale universe, featuring combat, puzzles, and mythological elements tied to the series’ wider history.

games.name: Maseylia: Echoes of the Past
games.summary: Maseylia : Echoes of the Past is a 3d metroidvania that aims to reproduce the experience of a 2d metroidvania in 3d. It features a labyrinthine world in which you'll need to collect upgrades to unlock new passages and make your way out of the labyrinth.

games.name: LavaLoop
games.summary: LavaLoop is a music-driven shoot'em up, in a hand-drawn Steampunk universe. Face a mad queen and destroy the planet killing machine. Play as three musician fighters and jump from surprise to surprise in this unique fantasy universe.

games.name: Breach Signal
games.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Looking For Fael
games.summary:
Upon receiving a cryptic voicemail from your missing roommate, the ordinary confines of your apartment transform into a surreal labyrinth. Guided by his voice and a custom retro console in hand, embark on a journey to decipher the mysteries that have twisted your home into an enigmatic maze.

But beware. The further you venture into other realities, the harder it will be to find your way back.

games.name: Stardream
games.summary: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Factomancer
games.summary: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.summary: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

games.name: Goeland: Seagull Adventure
games.summary: Take off as a mischievous seagull, and soar into a captivating escapade! From playful pranks to selfless deeds, be the ultimate feathered troublemaker or a helpful hero. Solve puzzles, unravel secrets, and engage with an interactive world. Let your wings decide the fate of this charming adventure!

games.name: Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent
games.summary:
