games.summary: A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

games.name: My Familiar
games.summary: In this RPG, wake up as a fresh familiar on the mean streets of Wish City, where the denizens are dark and corruption is king. Fight, flee, and aggressively rap your way through a vibrant inner city gauntlet, chock full of dysfunctional demons, in flashy, over the top, turn-based battles.

games.name: Lie of Caelum: Spirit
games.summary: Bound by secrets and divided by class, a group of unlikely allies are swept into a global conspiracy. As they peel back the layers of history, they discover a reality that defies explanation: A Truth that challenges the very fabric of their existence.

games.name: RuneSmith
games.summary: Grab your beer and join Durgrim into his quest to get his money back from a summoner that is trying to end all creation. Runesmith is a humorous RPG where a grudge-holding dwarf runesmith engraves powerful runes, talks to other dwarves and kills everything else!

games.name: Starless Umbra
games.summary: Starless Umbra is a couch co-op action RPG. Join Amalia as she searches for her friend in a land afflicted by a noxious fog. The deeper she ventures, the further she unravels a force that threatens far more than just one life.

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: Wicked Night: Holy Knights
games.summary: Lead your army, shape their bonds, and watch those connections come alive on the battlefield as you fight to prevent the Wicked Night from spreading across Solance.

games.name: Sunny Trails
games.summary: It was supposed to be a great party, but when Amaterasu and her sisters arrive, they find everything abandoned and all guests turned into stone. Go on an adventure in this cozy turn-based RPG to solve this mystery and save your friends!

games.name: Ironwing Valiant: Record of Astera
games.summary: Ironwing Valiant is a fast-paced Mecha action-JRPG set in the fantasy world of Euridia! Taking the guise of a young mecha pilot named Reinhardt, you will battle through sleepy villages, imposing fortress cities, and war-scarred industrial centers!

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.summary: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: Seed of Nostalgia
games.summary: Seed of Nostalgia is a beautiful pixel art JRPG which follows the tale of Atilla and a cast of intriguing characters on a quest to save their dying world. Explore a mystical land, unravel dark secrets, and confront ancient forces in a tale of magic, sacrifice, and unexpected revelations.

games.name: Gravastar
games.summary: Gravastar is a sci-fi fantasy JRPG (Japanese-style Role Playing Game) for PC and consoles that combines a traditional JRPG aesthetic with a unique and fast-paced, turn-based battle system inspired by 2D arcade fighting games. The battle system in Gravastar is set apart from traditional turn-based JRPGs by its real-time button-combo input system. Alter the flow of battle, master your character's movesets, build enormous combos, and string together chains to dispatch your foes.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

events.name: The MIX Summer Game Showcase 2026
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Lifted
games.summary:
Step into the Anytime Elevator and get LIFTED — a cinematic single-player 2.5D puzzle-platform adventure from a former Disney ride designer.

Slacker Ari Buktu only pokes his head into Professor Raventhorpe’s lab for extra credit; seconds later he’s hurtling through history on a reckless mission to steal a legendary tiara and fix the professor’s love-life. Each stop opens a new era, a bigger puzzle, and the shadow of a rival tomb-raider who’s always one jump behind…

games.name: Entropy
games.summary: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

games.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
games.summary: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: R.override
games.summary: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

games.name: Ground Zero Hero
games.summary: Kill mutants. Absorb their remains. Mutate into something stronger every run. Stack insane power combos and survive overwhelming hordes in this fast, chaotic, highly replayable action roguelite bullet hell.

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in Lucid. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: Animal Game
games.summary: A 2-4 player rogue-lite party brawler where dying makes you evolve. Pick a cute animal. Grab a weapon. Wreck your friends. The catch? Last place gets the wildest upgrades. No lead is ever safe.

games.name: Sonzai
games.summary: Sonzai is a 2d, action-brawler platforming RPG. The town of Kumotoshi holds secrets. A new life, new people, new spirits. What are the threads that bind people together? What is the nature of magic? All presented in a beautiful, inky art style - with every single frame of animation hand drawn.

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer- a tiny bird armed with a matchstick- who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Ballgame
games.summary: Smash, bounce, and grind your way through Ballgame, a ballsy physics platformer where you are the ball. Compete in high-stakes tournaments, physics-bending parlor games, and pinball-inspired courses that are anything but golf!

games.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams
games.summary: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Neighborhoods
games.summary: Neighborhoods is a cozy city sim where you shape streets to help people thrive, gather, and develop strong opinions about a particular bench. We're reimagining the city builder as a city fixer.

games.name: Pale Tide
games.summary: A top-down zombie extraction survival game where you and your dog scavenge resources from deadly infected zones. Rescue survivors, and return to a hidden bunker to upgrade your gear, grow your crew, and prepare your escape before the largest horde ever witnessed floods the region, the Pale Tide.

games.name: Bracer
games.summary: Grab a buddy and brace for chaos in this 3D Fantasy Shoot Em Up (SHMUP). Face off against a twisted necromancer fueled by a cursed bracer and a bloodlust for destruction. Blast enemies, dodge projectiles, unlock upgrades, and customize your hero with unique weapons, skills, and skins.

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: MegaGum
games.summary: Play as Uja in this 3D bubble-punk platformer blending action and adventure. Jump, glide, fight, and walk on walls using your Gum-powered abilities. Outsmart the traps of the mysterious Mister Gum and climb floor by floor through a factory filled with secrets, puzzles, and surprises.

games.name: Wild Blue Skies
games.summary: Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

games.name: Raji: Kaliyuga
games.summary: Six years after the great war, destiny bleeds into prophecy as gods and mortals blur. Raji, the warrior of faith, and Darsh, the dreamwalker, face Mahabalasuras wrath as he tears open heavens gates, unleashing Kaliyuga-an age where every choice can unmake the universe.

games.name: Monsters Are Coming!
games.summary: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

games.name: Breathedge 2
games.summary: Sent on a reckless mission, you find yourself in outer space filled with numerous dangers and things to explore. Build, craft, manage your crew, look after the chicken, and defeat the evil space corporation in this new breathtaking survival game.

games.name: Theos: Cities of Myth
games.summary: A modern take on classic city-builders, Theos: Cities of Myth lets you develop a thriving metropolis dedicated to one of 7 Greek Deities. Raise an imposing sanctuary, meet your citizens needs, and found a city worthy of the Gods.

games.name: Twinkle’s Galactic Tour
games.summary: Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in this 90's anime styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure! Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries.

games.name: Isle Goblin
games.summary: Isle Goblin has been invaded by destructive humans, and complete annihilation of the delicate ecosystem is inevitable. Armed with only your monster friends and the resources available, do you have what it takes to revert the island to its former glory?

games.name: Meadgard
games.summary: Run your own viking pub in a chaotic co-op management adventure! Grab your friends, axes and tankards, and work together to both serve and fight your hot-headed customers. It’s time to show the world what viking hospitality looks like!

games.name: Chivalware
games.summary: Chivalware is a frantic tile-matching action roguelite. Challenge your reflexes and coordination in real-time on a grid battlefield: evade attacks, match tiles to charge your weapons, and find the right opportunity to strike.

games.name: Husk Protocol
games.summary: ATTENTION! HUSK PROTOCOL INITIATED! Prepare to engage in a challenging deck-driven mecha game. Synergise between powerful Husks, utilise a dynamic deck and avoid detection from the city’s mainframe as you infiltrate the machine-driven brutopolis of Aeterna.

games.name: Ornélia
games.summary: A cozy village-builder and benevolent god game where you build freely, guide the Kinous, and spread kindness to bring your valley back to life.

games.name: The Dark West
games.summary: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

games.name: Canyons
games.summary: Canyons is a third-person extraction shooter set in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Fight for your existence in 4 player co-op or solo, control massive Crawlers, build a settlement for survivors, and conquer this savage world!

games.name: Blades of Mirage
games.summary: Embark on an epic isometric action RPG set in a Southeast Asian-inspired world. As Mira, use your ability to create water-based weapons and explore ancient ruins scattered across unique islands. Confront corrupted, powerful creatures and solve intricate puzzles to secure the ancient relics.

games.name: Poly Fighter
games.summary: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with a choice of simple or motion inputs to master your moveset and claim your title!

games.name: Kirk Mephisto
games.summary: Follow Kirk on his quest to stop the ongoing battle between birds and wormkind in this sci-fantasy, hack n slash, action game. Fighting alongside Kirk are his childhood friends Halice the worm warrior princess and Carper the secret agent bee.

games.name: Infamous Keepers
games.summary: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

games.name: Exark
games.summary: Exark is an engine builder about building a city aboard a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, staff them with crew members, and maximise your ark's resource production by exploiting powerful synergies. Lead your Great House to safety at the rim of the world.

games.name: Pixel Washer
games.summary: Pixel Washer is a cozy, zen-like game where you play as a cute piggy power washing beautiful pixelated worlds. Wash sprites, upgrade your power washer, and find hidden secrets.

games.name: Greedy Greedy Gnomes
games.summary: A short incremental game set in a sleepy RPG town. Smash pots, recruit gnomes, raid mines, unlock upgrades, and optimize everything until you’re FILTHY STINKING RICH!

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.summary: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

games.name: Hands Over
games.summary: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

games.name: Feed It
games.summary: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, a determined investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary:
PAPERHEAD is a fast-paced FPS game set in a world where everything is made out of cardboard and paper but is infested with horror!
Use a pencil as a weapon and explore what exactly went wrong in the secret research facility and why suddenly papercut people were able to...bleed.
Paperhead's Main Features

- Cardboard cute style with a horror twist. Cute but horrifying!

- Brutal and fast-paced combat. Slide to throw enemies in the air, kick explosive barrels into them (or enemies themselves!), and jump onto them Mario-style.

- Use a Pencil as a weapon. Draw a bomb to explode enemies!

- Use a Pencil as a reality-warping puzzle-solving tool. Not sure how to get through? Try to draw a door on the wall!

WHY WOULD PAPER...BLEED?

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Embark on a quest to become the 13th Zodiac in this frantic hack-and-slash roguelike action adventure. Take on a celestial trial of grit, speed and power, and rise stronger after each fall as you upgrade your skills. Your trial awaits!

games.name: Erosion
games.summary: Your daughter's been kidnapped. Every death costs you a decade. Explore a roguelike open world where your actions reshape the timeline. Join a cult, steal a ride, gamble Cheddar. Collect 100+ weapons and abilities, demolish destructible voxel dungeons. Can you save her before time steals her away?

games.name: Reka
games.summary: Start your life as an apprentice witch to the legendary Baba Jaga and venture across a mysterious, natural landscape with your companion, chicken-legged cottage. Develop your magical powers, customise your home, craft potions, help or hinder villagers find your way in the world.

games.name: Sealbreakers
games.summary: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: "Eternal Palace Sakura" is a rogue-lite 3D action game where you power up your character and take on thrilling dungeon challenges packed with flashy combat. Step into the shoes of Retla, a brown-skinned, cat-eared dual-wielder, and explore the ever-shifting dream labyrinth!

games.name: Echograph
games.summary: Photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

games.name: UN:Me
games.summary: UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.

games.name: Out Fishing
games.summary: Out Fishing is a first-person horror fishing game set around a remote, decaying lake. Players take on the role of a lone angler trying to make a living while unsettling memories and supernatural events gradually surface. Combining slow-paced exploration, psychological horror, and a minimalist survival loop, the game blurs the line between peaceful solitude and creeping dread.

games.name: Kumarn: The Wandering Spirit
games.summary: A haunting Thai horror adventure. Play as Kumarn, a wandering spirit lost in a world of terrifying folklore and vengeful ghosts. With only his courage and loyal spirit steed, he must face his fears and search for a place called home.

games.name: My Otter Friends
games.summary: Explore a flooded island as a small otter. Meet stranded animals, restore nature, and bring warmth back to a world that has grown quiet.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: Dungeon Lurker
games.summary: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

games.name: Dioxide
games.summary: Dioxide is a high-stakes, tactical FPS with soulslike elements set in a dystopian world ravaged by industrial decay. Shatter neo-antique nightmares, scavenge the scraps of a gasping civilization, and forge the last sanctuary. You will die. You will be reprinted. Will you remain human?

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.summary: Wilderings is an open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-like progression that tells an emotionally impactful story about friendship, family, responsibility, and restoration.

events.name: MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: A Horror Game Awards Showcase 2026
events.description:
Discover some of the best games coming out in 2026 and beyond!

Your hosts Phil Dickens, Ash Millman and Will Penkeyman are ready to take you on another dark, scare-filled journey through deep caves filled with new titles, exclusive trailers and thrilling gameplay reveals. 100+ games will be covered, with 50+ world premiere trailers in over two hours of upcoming horrors, so there’s plenty to keep you busy and set your wishlists overflowing!

games.name: Baptiste
games.summary:
Submerge yourself in a first-hand experience that will make you feel each chill as if it were real. The line between the game and reality blurs further with each step you take.

Explore a mansion where horror awaits in every shadow. The masterful dubbing and sound track will drag you to the depths of a nightmare. Darkness will become your most feared enemy, putting your bravery to the test in each corner.

Play as Tom, a young man still suffering from the tragedy. After the loss of his father, he accompanies his mother Sara on what ought to be a new beginning. However, the ghosts of the past threaten to consume him. Can you keep control against the siege of his inner demons?

Disentangle the gruesome secrets that impregnate each floorboard and each crack on the walls. Each discovery will reveal a story of pain and horror that beggars belief.

Submerge yourself into a world where beauty and terror coexist in a macabre dance. The visual design will transport you to a kingdom where the grotesque is fascinating.

Each objective, each note and each whisper contribute towards weaving the plot. Your perseverance in the face of fear will be rewarded with chilling revelations that will keep you on edge until the very end.

games.name: End of Ember
games.summary: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

games.name: Forest Escape: Last Train
games.summary: Forest Escape: Last Train is a co-op horror exploration game for 1-4 players in the mysterious forest. Repair your locomotive, solve the insane Warden’s eerie puzzles, and outrun the stuff of nightmares as you try to escape this twisted realm.

games.name: Dreadline Express
games.summary:
Investigative odyssey into the minds of fading passengers facing the end of the world aboard the last human train.

An adventure game that doesn't set specific goals. It naturally encourages you to make your own decisions and draw your own conclusions, providing a highly immersive experience with a fair amount of story branching.

games.name: Sisters of Solitude
games.summary: Explore a haunted convent with your EMF detector, tape recorder, and camera. Uncover the fate of four ghostly sisters and the mystery behind the murder they commited. Every room hides a clue, every shadow a warning, and the truth waits for those who dare to seek it.

games.name: Silvanis
games.summary: A psychological thriller, story-driven experience. Venture into the mysterious forest to find your missing daughter; unsolved puzzles, a dark atmosphere filled with whispers, and unsettling sounds await you...

games.name: The Victor Initiative
games.summary: The Victor Initiative is an atmospheric horror game about exploring an abandoned government facility that lost contact with the rest of the world 60 years ago.

games.name: House of Saturn
games.summary: Exorcize the demonic in this psychological horror game set in 1920s England. Navigate a haunted university by solving puzzles and hiding from a demon that can phase through walls. The gates of hell shall not prevail.

games.name: Donut Panic
games.summary: Order up! Donut Panic is an anomaly horror game with a cooking sim twist. Take customer orders. Prepare and serve up delicious donuts. But when the hallucinations appear, run for your life. Your panic room is there for a reason...

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: Ultrasound
games.summary: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

games.name: Inherited Shadows
games.summary: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

games.name: Eternal Haunt
games.summary: Eternal Haunt is a first-person atmospheric survival horror game. Explore the claustrophobic labyrinth of Yuki-Onna's home. Solve dynamic puzzles, scavenge for items, experience haunting scares that shift and evolve. Can you endure the relentless cold and escape the chilling embrace of death?

games.name: Last Chance Market
games.summary: When a grocery list becomes a struggle to survive against cosmic horrors, will you make it through the door? Stay alive, solve the mystery and make your offerings - or end up on a missing person poster in this first-person, non-linear nightmare. But you'd better hurry, the store's closing soon.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Nowhere
games.summary:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

games.name: Livber: Smoke and Mirrors
games.summary: A short psychological horror interactive story. Five years after vanishing without a trace, the woman you once called your lover writes from beyond the silence: "I will give birth to your child.” In three acts, descend into a fractured mindscape where obsession, memory, and myth intertwine.

games.name: Lurking
games.summary: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

games.name: Verho: Curse of Faces
games.summary: Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude, where masks have become the only protection against the Curse of Faces. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.

games.name: The Skin Stapler
games.summary: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.

games.name: Fright Train
games.summary: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror game.

games.name: Out Fishing
games.summary: Out Fishing is a first-person horror fishing game set around a remote, decaying lake. Players take on the role of a lone angler trying to make a living while unsettling memories and supernatural events gradually surface. Combining slow-paced exploration, psychological horror, and a minimalist survival loop, the game blurs the line between peaceful solitude and creeping dread.

games.name: Caravana 2000
games.summary: Choose your almost-famous costume and face the dangers of Brazilian chaotic nights. In this action roguelike, survive hordes, farm aura, wield sinister gadgets, and create insane combinations while dancing in the face of danger.

games.name: Pulsebreaker
games.summary: Pulsebreaker is a classic survival horror game. Explore environments, collect resources, and fight zombies. Manage your inventory, solve light puzzles, and survive with limited supplies. Includes melee and ranged combat. Single-player only.

games.name: House 2
games.summary:
As a terrible storm approaches, two young girls spend a fateful night watching TV and playing games…

House 2 is the sequel to the hit indie horror game, House. In House 2, you play as Tabby & Melody, finally free from their cursed home, in the next chapter of the House saga.

games.name: Escape Protocol : Online
games.summary: In this co-op horror game, escape an unknown realm where reality is shattered and dimensions collide. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly entities, and uncover the hidden saboteur.

games.name: The Patient: Can You Escape?
games.summary: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

games.name: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun
games.summary: Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night? LET THE HUNT BEGIN!

games.name: Oniria
games.summary: Oniria is a first-person psychological horror game with a retro aesthetic. Explore the village by solving puzzles and evading the strange presence that haunts it. Experience Angy's present in 3D, and uncover her hidden memories in 2D.

games.name: Protocol Non-Human
games.summary: A realistic first-person horror deduction game. Identify Non-Human entities and navigate critical decisions within the Zone. Earn your survival, upgrade your booth, and-above all-don't let the Non-Humans in.

games.name: Solace Creek
games.summary: Solace Creek is a Horror game with a focus on suspense, exploration, stealth & puzzle solving. You wake up in a sinister place, haunted by a monstrous presence. Uncover the mystery of this dark place... or become its prey.

games.name: Parasomnia Verum 2
games.summary: Parasomnia Verum 2 is a psychological horror game about Maddy's repeating nightmares crawling into reality.

games.name: The Well Is Not Empty
games.summary: The well has gone dry. It's up to you to find out why. Traverse through abandoned tunnels. Discover remnants of a ritual never meant to be seen. Power dying machinery to bring light into darkness. Dig into broken earth and crawl your way out. Down here you’re not exploring... you're trespassing.

games.name: Remnants of R'lyeh
games.summary: Remnants of R'lyeh is a Classic Horror Survival game inspired by H.P.Lovecraft's Great Work. An ancient dark power is calling you and you need to find an exit... Face your greatest fear, fight, hide... you must escape before the underwater city rises...

games.name: Dive or Die: Children of Rain
games.summary: Every descent is a deadly gamble. DIVE or DIE in the cursed abyss, face Eldritch horrors to uncover the mystery of the black rain. Scavenge and upgrade, recruit and sacrifice. Save your camp... The Flood is coming.

games.name: Necrophosis: Full Consciousness
games.summary:
The complete experience comes alive in Necrophosis: Full Consciousness, a first-person psychological horror adventure with engrossing puzzles that plunges you into a surreal haunting world where only death endures.

Begin as Consciousness, trapped within an emaciated, decaying vessel devoid of memories. Explore grotesque environments cursed with eternal deterioration to unravel fragments of the truth and learn why you have awakened. Soon your journey descends into the darker realms of the subconscious as you become the guiding hand that navigates its shadowy depths while piecing together echoes of the past.

Long forsaken gods have been left to rot beyond eternity, yet something still calls. Prepare for a dark odyssey where every disturbing encounter and mind-expanding puzzle will draw you deeper into the macabre.

games.name: The Cave Diver
games.summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

games.name: Haunted Bloodlines
games.summary: Haunted Bloodlines is a first person survival, psychological horror game. In the dark rooms of an expanding mansion, a terrifying story unfolds. As the mansion breathes, hidden secrets lay within its walls. Survival depends on your own sanity. Always remember time can either be a friend or an enemy.

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: Iris Dissolution
games.summary: Iris Dissolution is a classic survival horror game where you explore increasingly surreal places, manage scarce resources, and fight for your life against horrid creatures as you struggle to come to terms with loss.

games.name: The Twilight Project
games.summary:
The Twilight Project is a third person survival horror game where you play as a tourist who gets lost in a forgotten village sealed off from the outside world. As night falls, strange and terrifying creatures begin to appear, and reality starts to shift into something far darker.

You’ll need to survive the night, search for clues, and uncover the dark history behind this cursed place. Some secrets should stay buried... but they might be your only way out.

games.name: Where Dolls Hang
games.summary: Where Dolls Hang is a survival psychological horror game where you investigate a place plagued by strange and unsettling events filled with hanging dolls. Explore dangerous locations, gather evidence, uncover hidden secrets, and use your boat to confront the unknown as you search for answers.

games.name: Parasomnia
games.summary: What begins as a simple funeral wake spirals into something far more sinister. As the Wan Siblings, explore their childhood home and uncover a dark plot, all the while surviving the malice of the tragic denizens trapped therein.

games.name: The Hambagu Shop
games.summary: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror narrative simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

games.name: Don't Fret
games.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.name: Name of the Will
games.summary: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

games.name: Fear of Sleep
games.summary: Fear of Sleep is a retro-inspired sci-fi horror that blends old-school survival horror tension with modern physics and analogue design. Wishlist now and solve puzzles, face grotesque monsters in visceral combat, and immerse yourself a subterranean world torn by war, hubris, and tragic mystery.

games.name: Deperson
games.summary: Are you ready to step into a dark and mysterious world with Aaron, who is afraid of his own shadow? A file that has been closed for years is opened again, the forgotten ones wake up from their sleep and the silence is broken by screams.

games.name: Abyss of Doom
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a hybrid of psychological horror and immersive adventure, where you will be plunged into a nightmare that drags you into the depths of the abyss. Journey through medieval dungeons and ancient Roman ruins on your path to the goal.

games.name: The Funskin Project
games.summary: A horrifying experience in a strange and timeless universe. Explore, solve puzzles, fight for your survival and try to escape this nightmare.

games.name: Blighten
games.summary: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

games.name: Feed It
games.summary: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Alchemortis
games.summary: Alchemortis is a roguelike inventory-management auto-battler about alchemy. Transmute and combine items to merge their stats, properties, and forms, then organize your inventory to unlock powerful synergies. Experiment, optimize, and craft the perfect build through the power of alchemy.

games.name: Dark Fracture
games.summary: Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.

games.name: Bad Cheese
games.summary: Bad Cheese is a psychological horror inspired by the eerie charm of 1920s animation. Step into the tiny paws of a mouse spending the weekend at home with a dysfunctional Dad while Mom's away. Be on your best behavior and KEEP DADDY HAPPY.

games.name: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss
games.summary: A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Paper Bleed
games.summary: Paper Bleed is a creepy and grotesque point-and-click adventure, made with a raw art style and disturbingly gory hand-drawn animations. You find yourself in a horrible yet familiar place, facing your deepest fears and darkest thoughts. Nothing really dies here and you are all alone...

games.name: Gretel & Hansel
games.summary: Gretel & Hansel is a delightfully twisted exploration-adventure crafted entirely by hand in watercolor. Abandoned in a cursed forest, you play as Gretel, guiding her brother home while outwitting deadly traps, unraveling sinister puzzles, and escaping the clutches of a ravenous witch.

games.name: Confined: Leaving OKB-134
games.summary: Confined: Leaving OKB-134 is a first-person horror game for PC and VR set in an abandoned soviet bunker. You got trapped! Seek safety by reactivating power, lights and machinery. Learn about long gone personnel, solve riddles and find a way to escape. But stay quiet! You’re not alone.

games.name: God Help Us All
games.summary: God Help Us All is a fixed-camera survival horror game that merges the suffocating dread of classic horror with the brutal grit of the Wild West.

games.name: Graft
games.summary: GRAFT splices together tense survival horror with a dark RPG experience in a thrilling new adventure from the developers of BATTLETECH and the Shadowrun Trilogy. Explore a dying world haunted by darkly fascinating characters and nightmarish monsters as you delve into the mysteries of the Arc. Tear pieces from your enemies to transform yourself into something new—something capable of surviving the horrors that prowl around you. Every Graft brings with it some piece of its previous owner’s identity, changing more than just your physical body.

games.name: Cosmic Fear
games.summary: Since the dawn of mankind, mysterious phenomena beyond human comprehension have occurred. Your studies suggest that everything is part of one big picture. What lies hidden in the depths of the cosmos? Explore, solve puzzles and survive in this disturbing Lovecraftian horror adventure.

games.name: Vermilion Arcade: Horror Collection
games.summary: Vermilion Arcade is a collection of 8+ horror games inside a surreal and mysterious arcade.

games.name: Those Who Dwell
games.summary: Those Who Dwell is a story-first psychological horror focused on isolation, atmosphere, and folklore. Light is your only hope as you explore deeper into a cursed cave system disturbed by those who dug too deep. Restore shrines, survive the dark, and uncover what became of Those Who Dwell.

games.name: Moonlight Motel
games.summary: A distant motel. A string of murders. Use your wits to investigate a series of unexplained deaths in this murder mystery job simulator. Welcome to the Moonlight Motel.

games.name: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu
games.summary: In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

games.name: Murder Meet Cute
games.summary: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

games.name: Follow Us
games.summary: A co-op horror game for 2 players, where you risk your life outside to entertain a world that never leaves home. On Follow Us, contestants work in pairs: one explores, the other guides. Trust is your lifeline.

games.name: Farsight
games.summary: Something is very wrong with your eyes. A routine eye exam pulls you into the house inside the machine. Beware. The figures in the image are closer than they appear.

games.name: Encryptid
games.summary: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

games.name: Echograph
games.summary: Photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

games.name: Exorcist Hotline
games.summary: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

games.name: Deadly Rehearsal
games.summary: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Becrowned
games.summary: Surreal survival horror in a world standing between reality and dreams. Unravel all the mysteries of the dark world, escape from your own fears, and explore the terrifying world where fire no longer burns.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers to your origin uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: BrokenLore: Follow
games.summary: BrokenLore: Follow is a captivating psychological first-person horror game that immerses players in the haunting narrative of Anne, as she grapples with issues of self-acceptance, bullying, and worthlessness while encountering metaphorical surreal creatures that heighten the terror of her journey.

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Mourning Tide
games.summary: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

games.name: Nightmare House
games.summary: You are trapped in a nightmare. Observe the house and try to escape from this nightmare house.

games.name: Unhomely
games.summary: Unhomely is a retro-inspired first person psychological indie horror game. You play a journalist who has 3 days alone in a reclusive tech CEO's cabin to get the exclusive on his new project and save your career.

games.name: Kopernicus: Extraction
games.summary: Incremental suffering. Experience the 2-bit terror of the sole SSC KOPERNICUS survivor. Expand your base, construct weapons and face nightmares while trying to EXTRACT forgotten memories. There is no escape from THE THINGS you love.

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: The Alighieri Circle: Dante’s Bloodline
games.summary: The world knows the Divine Comedy as a poem. For your family, it is a prison. As Gabriele Alighieri, you inherit a duty: reseal the gates of Hell. Burdened by fate, you descend into a psychological nightmare where the only escape is to uncover the dark secrets of your ancestors.

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing
games.summary: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!

games.name: It Reaches
games.summary: It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Lurks Within Walls
games.summary:
Lurks Within Walls is a tense survival horror game combining modern dungeon RPGs' exploration elements with fast-paced turn-based combat. Explore a series of cursed environments filled with terrifying creatures illustrated by the renowned artist Trevor Henderson.

A building under quarantine. Residents isolated. Those who failed to isolate themselves now stagger through the corridors, contaminated. But it's not just the infected residents—the darkness conceals other anomalies. It feels as if the building itself is alive.

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: Blok
games.summary: Blok is a psychological horror game set in 1990s Poland. You play as a former oppositionist who fled the country during the communist regime in the 1980s. After the system's collapse, a mysterious letter from your mother brings you back to your former home. But you sense something is wrong.

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk
games.summary: Black Omens: House of Crimson Silk is a first-person, single-player, escape room puzzle horror game set in a fictional Edo Japan. Assume the role of Idate Chiyo, a paranormal investigator, tasked with investigating an abandoned mansion and unveiling a family's dark and horrifying secret.

games.name: Project Songbird
games.summary: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest. Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block. Take caution, however. These woods were never empty...

games.name: Don't Let It Starve
games.summary: A horror roguelike deckbuilder. You're trapped in a kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster that crawls through the vents. Don't let it starve.

events.name: Black Voices in Gaming: Summer Game Fest Showcase 2026
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Ourlands
games.summary: Ourlands is a cozy island builder where you handcraft and play around in bespoke little lands and truly explore your creativity. No goals, no management, just vibes.

games.name: Bathory: Heritage of Blood
games.summary: Play as Ursula Bathory, the vampire Princess, awakened from a centuries long slumber to claim her throne of blood in this Vampire Soulsvania inspired by Castlevania, Nosferatu and gothic victorian literature classics.

games.name: Oh!Ware
games.summary: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

games.name: Alchemic Beasts
games.summary: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

games.name: Black Sailors
games.summary: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.

games.name: Netcode Warriors
games.summary: ⁤Dive into the datascape of 'Netcode Warriors', an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense 1-v-1 fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena. ⁤

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Scramble Star Crossing
games.summary: Embark on a stellar action-puzzle adventure! Engage in local multiplayer battles with 2-4 players. Hone your skills as a Star Clearer in our many single-player modes, clearing colorful stars in the night sky. Or unravel the mysteries of the world and its inhabitants with a huge cast of characters!

games.name: Truck-Kun Is Supporting Me From Another World?!
games.summary: Your truck is magic and you now owe a soul debt to the buff isekai elf girl living in your head. Run over pedestrians as Truck-kun, make deliveries, and defeat the Skeleton King across two worlds in this chaotic run-based anime driving game!

games.name: Saturday AM: Battle Manga
games.summary: For the first time ever, Saturday AM’s iconic manga heroes unite in a crossover fighter! Tag in Sano, Cast, and more fan favorites to battle it out in explosive 2.5D combat where worlds collide.

games.name: Duppy Detective Tashia
games.summary: Help Tashia unravel the case of a heinous murder and find her cell phone in this point & click, mystery adventure based on Caribbean folklore!

games.name: Diesel Knights
games.summary: Diesel Knights is a 6-v-6, Mech/Movement Shooter set in a pulp-inspired, dieselpunk world.

games.name: RollerGirl
games.summary: A narrative adventure about a summer spent rollerblading in the mid-2000s. Explore a quiet town as Naomi, a teenage girl looking for an escape. Your in-game MP3 player isn't just for music; its playlist shapes the world & story as you run errands for quirky neighbours / get entangled in local drama.

games.name: Carrier Cuties: Pets in Mechs!
games.summary: Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!

games.name: Go North
games.summary: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

games.name: Tossdown
games.summary: Run, jump and dash through chaos, dodging hazards and enemies as you deliver packages. Fight back with wacky power-ups and choose from a variety of perks to improve your chances of survival. It’s Crazy taxi meets Jet Set Radio!

games.name: Scrubbin' Trubble
games.summary: Scrubbin' Trubble is a cooperative roguelike where you go solo or team up with up to four players in local or online multiplayer to slash, smash, and scrub your way through dangerously dirty stages. Use strategy and teamwork to clean up Nasties, and take down the Four Filths of the Apocalypse.

games.name: Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch
games.summary:
Jump in the shoes of Lunch Box and Mr. Snoogans in a colorful Side-scrolling 2.5D over-the-top multiplayer brawler! Play as the dynamic duo alone or with a friend in a tag team combo fight fest. Destroy your enemies with fists, feet, and the magic of self-esteem destroying shit talk while you embark on a mission to find your long lost pot customers trapped in an Orwellian shopping center.

Jay and Silent Bob: Chronic Blunt Punch is a colorful side-scrolling tag-team beat-em-up where players swap back and forth between our heroes on the fly or perform special moves simultaneously with a friend. Our heroes embark on an epic adventure from the humble corners where they ply their trade to the gates of hell itself.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

events.name: State of Play | June 2, 2026
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls
games.summary:
Assemble your team of legendary Marvel characters in the ultimate 4v4 tag team fighter from PlayStation Studios, Arc System Works and Marvel Games.
Immerse yourself in the Marvel universe like never before with an iconic roster of heroes and villains, authentic stages, and intuitive gameplay mechanics. Experience the thrill of fast-paced over the top action with stunning anime-inspired visuals, where every battle is a unique and exciting team VS battle experience.

games.name: Marvel's Wolverine
games.summary: Marvel's Wolverine is a single-player action-adventure game and a standalone entry in the Marvel's Spider-Man series, sharing continuity with those titles while telling its own self-contained story. Players control Logan/Wolverine in close-quarters combat, using his adamantium claws against enemies drawn from the X-Men comic book mythology. It is planned as the first installment in a trilogy of games focused on the X-Men.

games.name: Bancho the Chef
games.summary: Bancho the Chef is a cooking simulation and adventure game that follows Bancho, a character from Dave the Diver, during his younger days as he travels the road to becoming a sushi master. Players can travel through cities across Asia and experience the joy of cooking firsthand as they follow Bancho’s journey and learn unique local cuisines.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: The Lost Wild
games.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Kemuri
games.summary: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

games.name: No Rest for the Wicked
games.summary: From Moon Studios, the award-winning developers of Ori and the Blind Forest and Ori and the Will of the Wisps comes No Rest for the Wicked, a visceral, precision Action RPG set to reinvent the genre.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.summary: Dune: Awakening is an open-world survival MMO set on the desert planet Arrakis. Players create a custom character and must manage thirst, maintain stillsuits, and contend with environmental hazards like sandstorms, extreme heat, and roaming sandworms. The game involves scavenging resources, crafting equipment, building shelters, and competing with other players to harvest and transport spice. As players progress, they advance through phases from basic survival to leading a guild, eventually participating in faction warfare between House Atreides and House Harkonnen. The game features both PvE and PvP zones, with a Deep Desert area that reshapes weekly through Coriolis storms.

games.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
games.summary:
Fight through bloodstained battlefields of intense swordplay action. Explore the historic Japanese capital of Edo-era Kyoto, twisted by malevolent clouds of Malice.
With every stage cloaked in mystery, danger and intrigue. Battle against monstrosities from the underworld known as Genma in a tale of dark fantasy.
Follow the tale of a samurai who wields the Oni Gauntlet, a mystical artifact that grants its bearer the power to slay Genma.
Through gritty, blood-soaked brawls, he searches for his reason to fight. What fate awaits at the end of his path?

games.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
games.summary: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

games.name: Stuntman: Hollywood
games.summary:
Become Hollywood's most sought-after stuntman. Perform explosive scenes inspired by blockbuster movies, defy danger, and drift your way to stardom.

Take on iconic stunts inspired by fan favorite Universal Pictures films and NBCUniversal TV shows like Fast & Furious, Back to the Future, Knight Rider, Miami Vice, and Death Race. Stuntman: Hollywood puts you behind the wheel to pull off death-defying stunts - always in style.

games.name: Ill
games.summary: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

games.name: Marathon: Season 2 - Nightfall
games.summary:
Season 2 of Marathon introduces tons of new content for players to discover, while in the dark corners of Tau Ceti IV, new mysteries emerge and the Anomaly stirs.

Shrouded in darkness and cloaked in danger, a new nighttime version of Dire Marsh, Night Marsh offers new challenges and opportunities. Turn the shadows to your advantage, use new tools to navigate the darkness, uncover hidden secrets, and become the monster in the night.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Gitaroo Man
games.summary: A port of Gitaroo Man, a rhythm video game featuring visual production by Mitsuru Nakamura and an original soundtrack by Japanese band COIL, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy
games.summary:
A port of Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Wield psychic powers as elite agent Nick Scryer and unravel a shadowy conspiracy within the Mindgate Project, battling rogue operatives and unleashing telekinesis, mind control, and pyrokinesis across mind-bending levels in Psi-Ops: The Mindgate Conspiracy. Face off against formidable foes like the enigmatic General Grienko and the deadly Six, each with their own unique psychic abilities and motivations. Explore iconic locations such as the secret Mindgate facility and war-torn strongholds, utilizing stealth, environmental manipulation, and a diverse arsenal of psychic powers to overcome challenging puzzles and intense combat scenarios.

games.name: Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams
games.summary: A port of Onimusha: Dawn of Dreams, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: God of War Laufey
games.summary: God of War: Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game developed by Santa Monica Studio for PlayStation 5. The game follows Laufey, also known as Faye, after she awakens in a strange afterlife realm following her death. To protect Kratos and Atreus, she travels through the Everywhen, an afterlife of the gods where deities from different mythologies compete for power. The game shifts the focus from Kratos to Faye and features sword-based combat, magic, and new supporting characters.

events.name: Clemmy's Best Indie Games Summer Showcase 2026

games.name: Guns 'n Goblins
games.summary: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

games.name: King's Well
games.summary:
King's Well is a steampunk-themed roguelite deckbuilder where players use high-stakes poker logic to power industrial machine combat.

After a kingdom falls into ruin due to a gambling plague, the King casts the most notorious gamblers into The Well; a deep, industrial pit filled with rusted machinery and failed experiments. To earn your freedom, you must salvage derelict weapons and "fuel" them using your gambling skills. This time, you aren't playing for money; you are playing for your life.

games.name: Don't Kill Them All
games.summary: Don't Kill Them All is a turn-based strategy game with base-building, where you play the Orcs, the most feared creatures of the land. In the midst of an economic crisis, your Warlord is prepared to do whatever it takes to bring glory to the clan. Something has to change, and fast!

games.name: Terra Traveler
games.summary: A top-down action-adventure RPG where you battle corrupted creatures, explore hand-crafted dungeons, solve puzzles, and customize your abilities with amulets. Uncover the truth behind a world ravaged by deadly storms.

games.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

TCG Card Shop Simulator is a trading card shop simulation where you sell card booster packs to earn money and build your card shop business.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary: It’s time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

games.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
games.summary:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges, and the most ambitious Kingdom Rush adventure yet.

Defend the past to change the future.

games.name: One Last Hand
games.summary: Poker meets Battle Royale in One Last Hand, a 2-6 players chaotic party game where poker gets deadly! Forget fair play: attack your rivals with powerful hands, fight for better cards in secret auctions, and bend the rules with powerful relics in thrilling online multiplayer matches.

games.name: Isle Goblin
games.summary: Isle Goblin has been invaded by destructive humans, and complete annihilation of the delicate ecosystem is inevitable. Armed with only your monster friends and the resources available, do you have what it takes to revert the island to its former glory?

games.name: Veil of the Soulstones
games.summary: Brave the Veil of the Soulstones alone or with your friends in this brutal, real-time auto battler adventure. Loot weapons and armor from every foe to build your strength, and through powerful synergies, slay the creatures that lurk unseen in the shadows.

games.name: Vacation Cafe Simulator
games.summary: Cozy Italian Vacation Cafe ️ No timers, No stress cook traditional dishes upgrade and customize just drink prosecco, relax and grow your dream cafe

games.name: Mythologous
games.summary: A persistent online text RPG with dungeon crawling, extraction, tactical combat, deep magic systems, and emergent radiant NPCs. Explore, prepare gear, clear dungeons, incant spells and rituals, interact and command companions naturally, craft and trade. Your avatar lives, with or without you.

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

games.name: Ball Buster Breakout
games.summary: Grab your balls and get ready to bust! A hyper-kinetic Idle incremental breakout game.

games.name: Void Crew
games.summary: Void Crew is a Chaotic, Co-op Roguelite game for 1 to 4 players: Outfit your spaceship and crew for thrilling quests, brave fierce enemies in Space Battles... and try not to panic!

games.name: All Our Broken Parts
games.summary:
Experience a story-driven adventure/VN game as a robot doctor.

In a city of robots, illness is looming. Crack open ports and units to trace causes. Diagnose, repair and cross paths with robots and stories.

Uncover secrets buried in the past and future, discover the truth that makes each robot unique.

games.name: Zoominoes
games.summary: Build the ultimate Zoo in this number-go-up roguelike deckbuilder. Find powerful mythical animals, boost them with snacks, and even manipulate the board itself. Break the game by scoring millions (and more) with insane combos.

games.name: Shadow Rush
games.summary: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

games.name: Jigrift
games.summary: Leap and swing around the lost tropical paradise of Jigrift as you assemble the island like a massive jigsaw puzzle.

games.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
games.summary: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

games.name: Croakwood
games.summary: Croakwood is a creative, relaxed town building simulation game about frogs and nature! Design and create structures, plan and decorate towns, and explore an ancient forest to guide the growth of a charming community of tiny amphibians as they settle into their new life in the lush and wild woods.

games.name: Clawsome
games.summary: Control a claw in a chaotic world where grabbing prizes is harder than it looks! Avoid moving platforms, disappearing objects, and unexpected twists while building your own diorama with the trophies you collect.

games.name: Dark Queen of Samobor
games.summary: Embark on a journey inspired by Slavic mythology and Croatian folklore in this 2.5D action-adventure game inspired by the likes of Song of Iron, Prince of Persia, Inside and Limbo.

games.name: Dig, Dig, Die
games.summary: Online co-op horror for 1–6 players. Board a cursed flying ship, raid haunted graveyards for loot, and survive monsters that hear every sound. Beware of UFO abductions, grab boosters from vending machines, gamble in the onboard casino, and embrace pure chaos with friends in voice chat.

games.name: Tombwater
games.summary: Explore the accursed Wild West town of Tombwater and lay bare the eldritch horrors that lie beneath. Survive blood-spilling combat in this gruesome 2D action-RPG that might just drive you to madness.

games.name: Focus Grove
games.summary: Build your cozy forest farm… while thriving in life. Focus Grove is a mindful game that improves your focus, well-being and work-life balance. Let your Woodlings grow your farm, while you grow in life.

games.name: Hyper Sentinel Fusion
games.summary: An intense shoot-em-up + roguelite fusion.
