Pilot your fighter to destroy the defences of procedurally-generated space titans, then land, infiltrate and plunder the depths with your droid. Spend your bounty on epic upgrades & explore the moon base hub to interact with characters & unlock secrets.

games.name: My Little Cafe Nightmare
games.summary: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

games.name: Echograph
games.summary: Photograph ghosts, crack environmental puzzles, manage limited resources, and unravel the mystery behind a generational family curse in this classic survival horror experience.

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Log Riders
games.summary: Join a fun adventure by rolling a log together! In this 2 player co-op platformer, become lumberjacks with your friend and keep your balance while moving forward on a log. Overcome obstacles by moving back and forth, reach the goal, and never give up. Knowing how to get back up matters.

games.name: Lost Legions
games.summary: Lost in the Teutoburg Forest after a historical catastrophic defeat, survive as a Roman soldier in a world filled with danger. Craft, build, explore and fight in this story-rich open-world adventure. Unearth secrets of a forgotten time, alone or with up to 3 friends, in a land where history lingers.

games.name: Engine of Sin
games.summary: Operate a titanic war machine from the perspective of its last surviving crew member in a desperate battle against the otherworldly Kaiju. Balance power levels, craft specialized ammunition, and feed your ever-hungry reactor, yet the greatest horror may already be sealed within your metal coffin.

games.name: Hellforged
games.summary: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

games.name: Snacktorio
games.summary: Snacktorio is a factory-cooking simulator where you must satisfy the appetites of unspeakable horrors... with food! Build and manage sprawling networks of machines & pipes to mass produce delicious meals that can satiate the endless hunger of the beasts that are invading your home. Order Up!

games.name: R.I.P.: Reincarnation Insurance Program
games.summary: In this virus-ravaged, post-apocalyptic world, you will wield the power of infinite resurrection to delve into perilous ruins, gather legendary gear, and draw strength from the gods—growing stronger through endless cycles, until you become a true savior legend.

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

games.name: Astral Lords
games.summary: Master the core "Combat × Base-Building" loop. Survive intense horde-clearing chaos with agile gunplay, then think like a strategist—build your economy and army in real-time. With diverse Commanders and endless builds, your choices shape each run.

games.name: Better Than Dead
games.summary: "Better Than Dead," is a FPS where brutal and realistic gunfight meets the haunting beauty of a photorealistic Hong Kong. Inspired by classic Asian bloodshed cinema

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.summary: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

games.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
games.summary: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in Cardaire: Eternal Aces, a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world, hunt down powerful cards, and build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

games.name: LouLan Kingdom
games.summary: Loulan Kingdom is a city-building survival and real-time strategy game. As the ruler of Loulan, you must build your city amid a perilous desert oasis, grow your power through the Silk Road, and fight to protect your kingdomuntil the very end.

games.name: Clerks & Quirks
games.summary: Run a magical shop where your appliances are alive, emotional, and doing their best to ruin your day. Win them over ♡♡♡ to unlock powerful bonuses while you craft items, serve demanding customers, and scramble through the weekly rush in this co-op roguelite, where every shift put you under pressure.

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Mechborn
games.summary: Protect Earth and her colonies in a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by ’90s mech anime and Greek mythology. In MECHBORN - YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK - Unlock mech parts and pilots, craft custom decks and unleash devastating combos as you fight to repel the Kaiju incursions!

games.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
games.summary: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique restaurant. The aroma of success is just a bowl away!

games.name: Heritage
games.summary: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

games.name: Lazy Witch's Factory
games.summary: A run-based rogue-lite factory builder where middle management meets lawless Hell. Optimize production, make questionable deals, and race against the debt deadline.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

games.name: Uncivilized
games.summary: The land of Ohurat is loaded with mysteries and precious resources, but also filled with great dangers. Take control of one of its most powerful factions and get ready to annihilate everyone in your path!

games.name: Derelikt
games.summary: Survive the dark corridors of a space station in Saturns orbit in this narrative retro FPS with faithful PS1 aesthetics. Meet over a dozen unique NPCs, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight against the eldritch abominations!

games.name: Hell Architect: Survivors
games.summary:
A darkly ironic action roguelite set in Dante’s Hell, where sin is power.
Play as a demon architect hell-bent on overthrowing Lucifer, rebuilding the underworld, and unleashing forbidden powers with an unholy arsenal.

games.name: PengPong
games.summary: PengPong is a survival roguelike shooter in a vintage cartoon world. Use a hockey stick to deflect pucks and weapons, stop swarms, and test your luck. Spend chips for safe upgrades or risk it at the roulette. New builds and quirky synergies challenge survival every run.

games.name: Space Revolver
games.summary: Space Revolver is a strategic puzzle game set in a space station. Use limited moves—such as map rotation, gravity control, and horizontal movement—to find the optimal path. Enjoy clever and deep puzzles with retro-style pixel art and a classic sci-fi atmosphere!

games.name: The Dark West
games.summary: The Dark West is a grim ARPG reimagining the genre with deep player agency, innovative systems, and and a fresh take on player progression. We're crafting an experience that blends cutting-edge gameplay within an engaging and immersive world.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Midnight Horde is a gothic horror casual action game with rogue-lite elements where you battle thousands of enemies and upgrade the castle. Discover the secrets of the castle and upgrade weapons and fortifications to keep darkness at bay.

games.name: Sorry, My King
games.summary: A 1-bit pixel roguelite where every step costs time and every coin feeds the system. Explore procedural maps, fight card battles, and gather 5000 gold in 7 days to pay your debt to the king. Or discover why the debt exists at all.

games.name: Uncanny Valley: Checkpoint
games.summary: Pass. Quarantine. Kill. Run a Soviet checkpoint together in co-op after a nuclear meltdown unleashes a viral mutagen. Inspect papers, spot lies, and judge twisted bodies while battling radiation, paranoia, and the deadly cost of every mistake.

games.name: Dystopicon
games.summary:
In Dystopicon the players will live in a dystopian society in which they receive money in exchange to watch TV. With that money they pay services to cover their basic needs. Throughout the game they will discover the details of this dystopia in which the government monitors your movements but gives you freedom of choice.

The story will be told through gameplay, texts and comics. Take your time to explore the different objects and the mechanics in your first day.

games.name: Hack Fate
games.summary: Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies. But if it's the heavens you're up against? Then you shall hack fate itself.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Five More Minutes
games.summary: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

games.name: Monk Took Book
games.summary: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks.

games.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods
games.summary: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods is a new kind of combo RPG where you and your pup piece together flashy combos to dismantle a plethora of enemies! Discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict amongst the gods.

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Craftiny
games.summary: Start your small business of handmade creations. Customize your items with different themes and pay attention to trends and your customers to help your business thrive. Upgrade your shop and workshop to create increasingly ambitious items and build a reputation!

games.name: Golden Swirl
games.summary: GOLDEN SWIRL is a Roguelike Deck Builder blending fast-paced action with strategic card play in a dark fantasy world. Journey through shifting dungeons, uncover swirl secrets, and adapt to challenges with unique cards, relics, and a depravity system.

games.name: Hyperwired
games.summary: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

games.name: Minikin
games.summary: A hidden-object party game for 1 to 4 players. Find the right Minikins before everyone else, challenge your friends or team up with them, and unlock stickers, characters, and more rewards along the way.

games.name: Monster Mercs
games.summary: Transform into the monsters you slay and unleash new spells and abilities. Team up with up to 3 friends, take on unique contracts to get paid, upgrade your character and gear, and unlock powerful transformations in this fast-paced co-op action RPG.

games.name: Security 51
games.summary: You're a security officer deep within Area 51. Scan the staff, verify clearances, and decide who can enter the elevator and who absolutely mustn't leave. The deeper you go, the less certain you are that anyone standing before you is still human.

games.name: Wonderfall
games.summary: A third-person adventure game in a dystopian 1920s Paris consumed by Entropy. As buildings crumble into sand, Léon, a young orphan with the ability to manipulate this sand embark on a quest for truth and confront the remains of a city collapsing beneath his feet.

games.name: I.T Never Ends
games.summary: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.

games.name: Meet the Master
games.summary: A turn-based tactical roguelike with deck-building elements on a grid. Create insane synergies, make use of enemies telegraphed attacks and line up your combos to dominate the area. Fight bosses and their backpacks, loot dungeons, complete quests, save the town and Meet the Master!

games.name: No Such Place
games.summary: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

games.name: Sojourn Past
games.summary: Embark on a transformative journey, where immersive visuals and stirring music breathe life into a captivating story. Traverse handcrafted landscapes, overcome intricate challenges, and unveil secrets in a one-of-a-kind adventure. Experience a deeply personal experience of self-discovery and growth.

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.summary: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost-hunting couch co-op game for up to four players. Team up with friends and family to locate and capture sneaky ghosts hiding in plain sight.

games.name: Would You Love Me If I Was a Snake?
games.summary: A puzzle game where you play as a snake. Push objects, block lasers, teleport, and bite your tail off to escape dreamy puzzle rooms.

games.name: Carpark Hero
games.summary: Every round is an intense race to claim a parking spot before your friends do. There's always one fewer spot than players, so if you don't park your car, you're eliminated. It all builds to a chaotic, high-stakes 1v1 final showdown where only one car can be crowned the winner.

games.name: Deadly Trick
games.summary: Survive the death game unfolding at school under the name "Special Class." You are not given any special role at the beginning. Depending on the situation or your own choices, you could become the White or the Shadow! Cooperate… or betray.

games.name: Gennady
games.summary: An old-school action platformer with rogue-lite elements. Imagine your grumpy neighbor blowing up the backside of an alien world with a blaster instead of resting after his shift. Blood, noir, and green slime.

games.name: Heir of the Dog
games.summary:
After a mysterious explosion over Victorian London, Cummerbund Bandersnatch (a likeable, if dim-witted twit) visits his uncle's laboratory and discovers an experimental new formula guaranteeing a "good time" for whoever drinks it. Seduced by the promises in his uncle's journal, Cummerbund decides that it is probably safe to drink and discovers his life will never be the same again.

What may seem like a curse at first, leads Bandersnatch on a thrilling, love-torn adventure through the back alleys of Old London Town as he uncovers a sinister plot involving a secret society, the royal family, copious amounts of dog hair and his uncle at the very centre.

games.name: Pigs and Wolf
games.summary: Little pigs fear becoming bacon, join the fight and survive from the wolf at night. Craft your home and travel to find the path back to the village in this fantasy world.

games.name: Rail Estate
games.summary: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, then build and upgrade tracks to dominate the rail economy. Players compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

games.name: Sting & Swing
games.summary: Explore a strange overgrown world as a bee with a golf ball. Master the skills of bee-golf to uncover the mysteries hidden in its furthest reaches and hiding in front of you. Discover uses for abilities you didn't know you had. There are always more secrets for those who seek them beneath the green.

games.name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
games.summary: They Are Here is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

games.name: Zodiac Mountain
games.summary: "Zodiac Mountain" is a roguelike deckbuilder following the journey of a Panda as they adventure to become a Chinese Zodiac. Utilise dual hands of Yin & Yang, encounter fierce mythical characters, outskill your enemies in battle, and climb Zodiac Mountain.

games.name: Invokyr
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play with up to 3 friends. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

games.name: Lone Chef
games.summary: Set off on a flavorful adventure in Lone Chef, an action Metroidvania where hunting, cooking, and exploration come together. Discover a vast world, meet unforgettable companions, and chase after the most mouthwatering dish imaginable.

games.name: Mexican Ninja
games.summary: A frantic fast-paced beat 'em up roguelike full of crass, brass and incredibly badass. Become THE Mexican Ninja as you slice your way through the streets of Nuevo Tokyo in this retro 2.5D arcade throwback. So what’chu waiting for? Show me your skills pinche ninja!

games.name: Nightwater
games.summary: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

games.name: Odd Town
games.summary: Explore, eat, drink, and investigate in Odd Town — a first-person adventure where a picturesque small town hides something sinister beneath its charm.

games.name: Survivors Guild
games.summary: Survivors Guild is a survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player online co-op. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

games.name: Wreck Runners
games.summary: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

games.name: Barfender
games.summary: Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar management game where you build your dream bar, serve wild customers, and desperately try to survive the nightly madness. Craft drinks, clean messes, stop bar fights, and keep your crew sanity intact. Do you have what it takes to run the messiest bar in town?

games.name: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
games.summary: Furyball is a fast paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

games.name: The Milgram Experiment
games.summary: A first person narrative game, based on one of the most controversial psychological experiments of all time. Step into the shoes of an unwilling subject faced with the toughest moral choice: who lives and who dies. You alone will decide who to kill and who to spare. Please wishlist!

games.name: Gunstoppable
games.summary: A momentum-fueled Roguelite FPS where speed is damage. Dual-wield overpowered weapon combos and bend time to obliterate robot hordes and overthrow billionaire bosses!

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.summary: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

games.name: Midnight Moments
games.summary: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

games.name: Cosmo Cargo
games.summary: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

games.name: Grim Axiom
games.summary: Enter a dark underground world in this soulslike adventure-horror game where undead monsters lurk around every corner, and uncover the mystery behind the ancient machines operating in its depths.

games.name: Voyage Router
games.summary: Voyage Router is a "navigation-based roguelike" where you explore procedurally generated terrain guided by your map. Adapt your route as the environment and conditions change, and visit as many target points as possible.

games.name: Lost & Found: A This Bed We Made Story
games.summary: Lost & Found is a standalone, short story game taking place aboard a 1960s transatlantic ship. Play as Sophie Roy in her new job as a stewardess, and help solve a curious series of thefts in this narrative-driven mystery set after the events of This Bed We Made.

games.name: Cloudbreaker
games.summary: Cloudbreaker is a roguelite, inventory management, bullet heaven. Explore a sky-world, finding relics and defeating hordes of enemies. Unlock and upgrade airships, each with its own unique layout, abilities, and strategies, to grow your power over time.

games.name: Ghoul Fright
games.summary: Ghoul Fright is a physics based FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves. ¿Ready to Fright?

games.name: Hubert
games.summary: Step into the paws of a loyal shepherd dog in this atmospheric third-person adventure. Track scents, herd sheep, and navigate the rugged northern wilderness. Face rough weather, natural predators and not so obedient sheeps.

games.name: One Coin Museum
games.summary: Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

games.name: Death at Fleming Manor
games.summary: "Your job is to write the death certificate." Investigate a mysterious death in a grand British manor, 1959. Explore eerie scenes and complete forensic documents like death certificates and medical reports. Stylish 1960s detective comic art. Perfect for fans of vintage whodunits.

games.name: HistoriCity: Florence
games.summary: A historical, mission-based, stylized 3D citybuilder set in Renaissance Florence. Use the strength of your economy, the power of religion, and the beauty of classical art and architecture to rebuild a city decimated by the Black Plague and civil unrest.

games.name: Pawsome Resort
games.summary: Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim with Co-op gameplay where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.

games.name: Slaughter Void
games.summary: Slaughter Void is a heavy metal dark fantasy slasher where hesitation is death. Chain kills, keep your momentum, shape your build, and slaughter your way into the Void.

games.name: Island of Winds
games.summary:
Island of Winds takes you to 17th century Iceland, plunging them into a magical world teeming with trolls, giant spiders, and mythical creatures. Experience all of this through the eyes of the magic-wielding Brynhild, a member of the Balance Keepers who draws her magical power from the natural world.

Brynhild's journey has her on a quest to find her mentor, Hrymja, that will take her through nine incredible landscapes that draw on Iceland's stunning natural beauty. These locations range from the fiery Lava of Skjól to the treacherous Jökla lagoon and gleaming Obsidian Shore. Brynhild will face legendary creatures on her journey, such as the powerful and majestic Bear King, Hafgúfa - Guardian of the Sea and the majestic elven lady Vör of the Oasis.

games.name: Never's End
games.summary: Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

games.name: The Last Mothership
games.summary: A short incremental game about harvesting planets to feed your mothership. Mine, manage resources, grow your fleet, and unlock upgrades to evolve your species. You are the devourer of worlds.

games.name: Boreal Tenebrae Act 0
games.summary: A surreal narrative adventure set on the night Tamarack Narrows collapses into static, fire, and aurora. Follow Sarah, Bree, and the townsfolk as an unknown visitor arrives promising salvation. A lo-fi, analog-horror

games.name: Fading Echo
games.summary: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

games.name: Bounty Fusion
games.summary: Suit up as a mecha bounty hunter in a gritty faraway galaxy! Fuse cards to unleash powerful combos, chase high-stakes bounties, and build the ultimate deck in this action-packed roguelike deckbuilder.

games.name: A Little Age
games.summary: Build and expand a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and watch a civilization emerge in this minimalist settlement builder.

games.name: Radiotext
games.summary: Radiotext is an interactive story set in the near future, where communication without intrusion requires radio-waves. Dive into a cryptographic radio-net in this text-based rpg, where you need to think carefully before typing your answers.

games.name: It's Fine
games.summary: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

games.name: Spooker
games.summary:
A roguelite pool-like game where you play for your freedom against your host and lightly cursed ventriloquist dummy, Ralphie. Steady your shots, build your combos and rack up enough points to make your escape.

This is pool, but… wrong. Enjoy tight, skill-driven shotmaking, high-risk scoring, and roguelite progression that changes every run and every table. The deeper you go, the more the speakeasy twists and changes. There is always another table, and it keeps getting darker. Will Ralphie ever let you leave?

games.name: Pegs X Stickers
games.summary: Pegs X Stickers is a pachinko-roguelite that combines Balatro with the cult-classic Peggle. Build your own boards and purchase stickers to create high-scoring synergies.

games.name: Card Homestead
games.summary: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: Astral Throne II: Age of the Phoenix
games.summary: How many times are you willing to die for revenge? Rise from the ashes to uncover a divine conspiracy in this Roguelite Strategy RPG inspired by the classics. Lead an ever-growing team on a continent-spanning quest, fight tactical turn-based battles, and synergize your skills for decisive victory.

games.name: Infinite Ruins
games.summary: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

games.name: Night Hike
games.summary: Night Hike is a single-player escape roguelite set in a never-ending wilderness loop. Navigate strange encounters, power your compass and uncover secret trails as you search for a way out of the endless night.

games.name: DekaDuck
games.summary: DekaDuck is a 2D action platformer, featuring fully hand-drawn art and animation. Fight enemies using their own abilities and quirks to solve puzzles and defeat bosses, in a sci-fi world full of conspiracies!

games.name: Becoming Pablo
games.summary: Becoming Pablo is a turn-based grand-strategy game where you build and lead a cartel empire. Conquer territories, manage your operation, and outsmart rivals in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade era. Every choice impacts your rise to power, or your downfall. Can you dominate the underworld?

games.name: Killing Things With Your Friends
games.summary: A chaotic first-person co-op game about surviving lethal experiments with your friends. Work together, dismember your enemies, steal their limbs and escape before time runs out.

games.name: From Basement with Love
games.summary: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the peak of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher encrypted communications to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, manipulate targets through social engineering, connect the dots, and escape before it's too late.

games.name: Lawnpocalypse
games.summary: Lawnmowing Roguelike! Hop on your mower and battle back the overgrowth, muck, and hordes of garden pests. Fight and upgrade as you complete oddly satisfying yardwork. Invent game-breaking builds, customize your Gnome, and uncover secrets of the Lawnpocalypse!

games.name: Pocket Racer Shop Sim
games.summary: Run a Pocket Racer hobby shop by day, then unleash custom built cars on handcrafted tracks during race nights with friends.

games.name: The Longest Tale
games.summary: Uncover a forgotten legend as you venture through mythical realms. Play as four heroes bound by a mysterious fate. Explore ancient ruins, outsmart deadly foes and solve arcane puzzles. Each path you take reveals a piece of The Longest Tale.

games.name: Loot List
games.summary: Loot List is a thief simulator and action game about robbery. There's one difference though — here, every heist has to have a list.

games.name: PinKeep
games.summary: PinKeep is a pinball deckbuilding roguelite – use the ball and flippers to collect resources and defeat your enemies! Place buildings from your deck on the playfield to defend your Keep. Create powerful synergies to eradicate the hordes of attacking Knights!

games.name: Valkyrie Saga
games.summary: Up high on a floating island, Roll the Valkyrie must ascend and subvert fate. Climb, dash, jump and glide up to the summit of the Island, and stop it from crashing to the earth below, in this PSX style 3D platformer.

games.name: Cardburners
games.summary: CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced solo or online versus card game. You must play you cards quickly before they burn in your hand! Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games,

games.name: Ereban: Shadow Legacy
games.summary: Ereban: Shadow Legacy is a fast-paced stealth platformer game where you become Ayana, the last descendant of a forgotten race. Harness mystical shadow powers, high-tech gadgets and avoid or kill to uncover the truth about your past and the key to saving a dying, morally grey universe.

games.name: Swan Song
games.summary: Swan Song is a cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. Use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief.

games.name: Dino-Ducks Mayhem
games.summary: Dino-Ducks Mayhem is a twin-stick shooter with bullet heaven vibes, wrapped around duck-builder system, set in a duck-tastic world and all about surviving as long as you can while everything explodes around you.

games.name: 4x4 in a Furniture Store
games.summary: 4x4 off-road physics-based precision driving in a mini open world mega furniture store

games.name: Grindworm
games.summary: A short horror game where you're buried alive in a collapsed underground mine, and your only hope for survival is an old mining machine.

games.name: Senatus
games.summary: Strategic card battles in the heart of the Roman Senate. Debate, persuade, and rise through the ranks to become Consul of Rome. Influence is power — and power decides everything.

games.name: RuneSmith
games.summary: Grab your beer and join Durgrim into his quest to get his money back from a summoner that is trying to end all creation. Runesmith is a humorous RPG where a grudge-holding dwarf runesmith engraves powerful runes, talks to other dwarves and kills everything else!

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: Connected Clue
games.summary: A detective adventure where you infiltrate the scene to solve the case. Use tools to secure evidence and testimonies.

games.name: Gear Up Einstein!
games.summary: Einstein becomes your soldier in this tactical multiplayer roguelite where strategy meets history. Lead a squad of legendary figures, craft insane item synergies, and fight through twisted historical timelines. Gear up your team, coordinate with your friends, and save the world in a new way every time!

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Sir, We Have an Orc Problem
games.summary: Incremental style tower-defense game where you face tens of thousands of orcs.

games.name: Torii: Beyond the Gates
games.summary: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Ministry of Order
games.summary: You’ve been assigned to the Maternity Ward in a totalitarian 1920s state. Reunite newborns with their rightful parents using a simplified genetics puzzle - no mistakes allowed. Obey the regime, join a secret conspiracy, or forge your own path.

games.name: Bobls
games.summary: Bobls is a precise and bouncy 2D retro platformer. Complete the story through the single player or unique two-player campaign, create and play levels made by the community through the level editor used by the developers themselves.

games.name: Grim Trials
games.summary: Prove your worth. Hack and blast your way through the Grim Trials. Explore the (after)life of the Academy – a training ground for aspiring Grim Reapers. Befriend fellow Reapers, learn from your mentors, and uncover the secrets of your life and love before your death.

games.name: Kalanoro
games.summary: Start a band with crazy lemurs and save your island from an evil witch in Kalanoro, an ode to Madagascar’s folklore and vibrant artistic scene! Hop on an action-adventure journey to discover the colorful world of Lemuria, rescue funky lemur artists, and defeat the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

games.name: T.W.I.R.L.
games.summary: It's 3am in your childhood home. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room to do what you always do - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Rhythm Rat Rampage
games.summary: Rhythm meets bullet heaven in a genre-smashing fusion. Strik-9 challenges you to dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style.

games.name: Quack Quack Up
games.summary: A voice-controlled party game that will have you and your friends screaming until you pass out! Drop the controller and use your vocal cords to herd a flock of ducks to the finish line—or watch them all yeet off a cliff because someone yelled a bit too loud!

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

games.name: Vquarium
games.summary: Vquarium is a relaxing incremental-idle game where you grow your own underwater world on your screen overlay with a virtual assistant. Collect rare fish, discover sparkling variants, and decorate your tank while taking care of an adorable assistant!

games.name: Loot Frog
games.summary: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

games.name: Revenge Crystal
games.summary: Revenge Crystal is an epic top-down action RPG. You explore a defeated world by unknown invaders as an amnesiac knight who must save the world and defeat the invaders by navigating through a world of interconnected challenges, fierce enemies, and intricate puzzles.

games.name: Curse Chapter: Dawnthief
games.summary: Plunder all the treasure worth taking from the exotic wilderness with your band of rogues. Jump, kick and sling your chain mace to smash and climb your way through any obstacle. Face off against beasts and hopeful heroes that rise up to stop you.

games.name: Hue Factory
games.summary:
Hue Factory is a minimalist automation game about color theory. It’s just you, some conveyor belts, and a stream of colorful boxes waiting to be sorted.

Find Your Flow. Start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations. As your factory grows, new colors appear, and your factory will need to evolve.

games.name: Wing Haven
games.summary: Wing Haven is a relaxing idle game about building cozy bird sanctuaries. Collect rare and exotic feathered friends, give them plant shelter, and watch them grow in real-time! Progress from a basic enclosure to a beautiful nature preserve in old-growth forest, desert oasis, or wetland climates!

games.name: Monst
games.summary: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

games.name: The Button Effect
games.summary: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

games.name: Project Roy
games.summary: Project Roy is a fast-paced FPS roguelike where you play as a rogue AI that survives by hijacking enemy robots. Combine abilities, adapt mid combat, and fight your way through a sci-fi facility to escape and defeat a powerful experimental war machine.

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Lost Castle 2
games.summary: "Lost Castle 2" is a 2D Beat'em up Rogue-Lite game. Explore abundant treasures and items to enhance yourself, master various weapons to showcase your skills, and challenge powerful monsters to demonstrate your strength. A new adventure is calling for treasure hunters!

games.name: Shark Dentist
games.summary: Shark Dentist is a unique horror roguelike where you play as a shark dentist. Your task is to treat the teeth of giant predators in a dark clinic while avoiding their deadly aggression. Balance tactics, luck, and limited resources to heal your patient without losing your own life.

games.name: Haunted Paws
games.summary: Haunted Paws is a Cozy Coop Horror game where you will play as two Puppies trying to rescue their human friend in a haunted mansion. Create your puppy, explore spooky environments and defeat evil creatures in an action packed adventure!

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Stip
games.summary: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.

games.name: Starfinder: Afterlight
games.summary:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

games.name: Aloft
games.summary: Soar the skies in Aloft, the co-op sandbox survival game set in a world of floating islands. Build any island into a skyship, your home in the clouds. Find lost knowledge, cure the fungal corruption, and brave the hurricane to restore the ecosystem.

games.name: Deadstick: Bush Flight Simulator
games.summary: Become a true stick and rudder pilot and master the backcountry in Deadstick Bush Flight Simulator. With no autopilot, no de-icing systems, little navigation aids and limited instruments, do you have what it takes to become the ultimate bush pilot?

games.name: Hell Maiden
games.summary: Traverse the depths of Hell and beat its toughest demons on your way to Heaven in this horde survival deck-building game inspired by Dante's Divine Comedy.

games.name: Railborn
games.summary: Railborn is a survival game where you build your train piece by piece. Navigate a world entangled by branching tracks. Find rare plants to cultivate on your farms. Upgrade your train - manage its power systems, direct resource flow, and distribute water. Designed for 1 to 4 players.

games.name: Toada Brava
games.summary: You’ve got busted! Save your mom and escape from Santacrúz Dungeon alongside a ragtag team of heroes in this hand-drawn JRPG.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: A high-difficulty action game combining parry mechanics and deck-building. Fight your way through and aim to become the champion of the tournament.

games.name: Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent
games.summary:
Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent is the first video game based on the legendary tabletop IP Descent. It is a story-driven heroic fantasy Tactical RPG refreshing the formula of dungeon crawlers for all types of fantasy fans alike and expanding on the lore of the boardgames Descent: Legends of the Dark.
Lead a fearless company of heroes into the deep and dark corridors of Terrinoth, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing an unending darkness

games.name: Hank Shaw: Animal Investigator
games.summary: When a pet goes missing, Hank Shaw's the detective to turn to. But when there's been a breakout at the zoo? You're going to need to do more than chat with low down dirty rats and stool pigeons. Call in every favor you got and get your hands dirty as you sniff out clues. It's up to you gumshoe!

games.name: Samurai Gunn 2
games.summary: Samurai GUNN 2 is a fighting game with Samurai and Gunns. Best your foes online or locally in this cutting edge sequel featuring Rollback Netcode and Ranked Matchmaking.

games.name: Feather's Edge
games.summary: Dash and slash through an innovative kinetic metroidvania. The Tower of Time awaits – a rich, handcrafted world fractured by the collapse of time. Slice through foes in tough-as-talons bite-sized battles, and master the way of the bird warrior.

games.name: Echoes of Mystralia
games.summary: Mages of Mystralia's award-winning spellcrafting system enters a new era. Free Mystralia from the Shadows of the Past in this action-RPG roguelite. Create an infinite variety of spells to save the Memory of the World.

games.name: Ballgame
games.summary: Smash, bounce, and grind your way through Ballgame, a ballsy physics platformer where you are the ball. Compete in high-stakes tournaments, physics-bending parlor games, and pinball-inspired courses that are anything but golf!

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: Fantasy Network
games.summary: Join Lyn in a colorful, cartoonish world of Holua where "Likes" are the ultimate power! Explore a non-linear world, master umbrella-based combat, and smash your way through talent-show boss battles. It’s a metroidvania with a social media soul- no subscription needed.

games.name: The Weeping Swan: Ten Days of the City's Fall
games.summary: At nightfall, the sieged city falls. Yaoguai came to massacre. You are nothing but a scholar on the brink of madness, trying to survive alongside a courtesan you met years ago. Experience two intertwined storylines in this sequel to the visual novel "The Hungry Lamb".

games.name: Sit-Back Attack
games.summary:
Sit-Back and Relax while the game grinds for you!
It is an Idle RPG WITHOUT any MTX!

Features 60+ different classes, 500+ different skills, unlimited amount of build options to help make the team of 4 heroes you control defeat over 300 monsters!

A very in-depth interface that allows you to see every facet of battle, stats, and more to help you decide how to make your team even stronger!

All classes have unique character art and their own skills, strengths, and weaknesses.

You can choose from 1 of 4 pets to help bolster your team and you control when it uses it's special attack.

An alchemy craft that allows you to use potions on your allies and enemies manually! This craft can be improved with a characters skills and gear.

So much more!

games.name: Gangs of Asia
games.summary:
Dominate rival gangs by seizing buildings, summoning unique fighters, and unleashing devastating special attacks. Whether you're battling alongside friends in co-op or unleashing chaos in PvP, the game offers shared split-screen, online multiplayer, and free-for-all modes to keep the action fresh.

Experience a fusion of skill-based 1v1 Kung Fu combat and real-time strategy. Command a diverse army—from mighty Sumo and agile Ninjas to legendary Kung Fu Masters—seize territory, manage resources, and unleash special attacks to crush your opponents and claim victory!

games.name: Lanesplit
games.summary: Push performance bikes to the absolute limit, and weave through traffic where one wrong move can spell disaster.

games.name: Clockwork Ambrosia
games.summary: Clockwork Ambrosia is a compelling steampunk fusion of metroidvania and a 2D shooter. Players pull on the boots of an airship pilot to combat an army of deadly robots and monsters. Experiment with a range of rule-breaking weapons modifications and armors to prevail through this wild adventure!

games.name: Fallen Tear: The Ascension
games.summary: Fallen Tear: The Ascension is an epic adventure set in a vast magical world where you’ll fight dangerous beasts, defy corrupt gods, and face many challenges, all in an attempt to bring balance back to your world.​Embark on this journey with Hira, a mysterious young boy who seeks the truth about his forgotten past. Along the way, bond with many fully-voiced characters to unlock new skills and abilities that will aid you in your battle through environments that constantly change and react to your choices - all in classic, hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Tailor Simulator
games.summary: Build your workshop and turn it into a fashion business. Interact with your customers and design unique collections to sell in your store. Upgrade your workshop until you rule the fashion industry.

games.name: Beyond the Grove
games.summary: Summon nature’s army in this charming RTS-inspired autobattler. With your troop of mushroom warriors and over 50 unique elemental Golems by your side, command your fun-guy forces to push back the corruption beyond your grove. Strategize, adapt, and overcome!

games.name: SpaceSlog
games.summary:
SpaceSlog is a challenging sci-fi spaceship simulator that focuses on shipbuilding, crew interaction, and exploration. Inspired by games such as Rimworld, Starship Theory, Dwarf Fortress and X-COM, as well as iconic media such as Firefly, Battlestar Galactica, Stargate Universe and The Expanse.

Your colony ship has been destroyed. Fortunately, a few survivors managed to escape on a small ship. Now alone, hungry, and lost in space, you must explore the cosmos and guide them to safety.

games.name: Stellar Wanderer DX
games.summary: Stellar Wanderer DX is an old-school space combat sim set in a vast open-world universe. Follow the story or choose your favorite side missions as a mercenary fighter pilot. Explore the galaxy, upgrade your ship and weapons, trade resources and fight outlaws.

games.name: Machine Gun Fury
games.summary: On a bold and potentially dangerous mission to revive the classic Arcade military shooter. Fully loaded with addictive top-down and side-scrolling run-and-gun gameplay, pixel-perfect 2D graphics, explosive SID soundtrack and massive destruction! Fight on foot and in heavily armed vehicles.

games.name: Remedium
games.summary: The fast-paced twin-stick shooter game in the grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance setting. It had been more than a hundred years since the terrible plague devoured the whole Europe and turned almost everyone there in the maddened mutants.

games.name: Choose Your Own Alternative
games.summary: A text-based adventure about exorcising your friend’s Inner Demon. Analyze objects filled with memories, uncover the reason for her possession, talk with her and figure out which object should be chosen for the sacrifice. Save your friend no matter the cost.

games.name: Back in the Swamp
games.summary: An immersive first-person point-and-click exploration game set in a post-apocalyptic wasteland overrun by giant insects and abandoned robots. Embark on a journey to uncover hidden mysteries, guided solely by hand-drawn sketches—no text or dialogue.

games.name: BattleJuice Alchemist
games.summary: BattleJuice Alchemist is a singleplayer RPG combining classic top-down combat with third person bullet time. Explore a dark procedural world, learn ritual magic, solve riddles, craft alchemical potions and combine them in deck-building-like fashion to fight the demons overrunning the lands.

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
In Pardon My French Toast, you play as a Toasty (a talking slice of brioche) who dreams of participating in the new edition of the bread wrestling competition. To be physically up to the challenge, he decides to follow a training program organized by the previous champion of the discipline, which will take him all over the world and make him meet a bunch of wacky weirdos.

Pardon My French Toast is an adventure / platform game in 2D top view in which the player explores different worlds, solves puzzles and meets a whole bunch of fun characters. Bread wrestling is a... special sport. We will introduce the discipline later.

games.name: Storebound
games.summary: A 1-3 co-op horror game. Play as ordinary shoppers trapped in an accursed megastore. Find the exit together at all costs before the employees catch you.

games.name: Packing Life
games.summary: A cozy and satisfying puzzle-simulation game where you step into the role of a warehouse worker with a knack for perfectly organizing and packing orders. With charming visuals, relaxing gameplay, and a lighthearted story, experience the joy of transforming everyday tasks into a fulfilling adventure.

games.name: Kotama and Academy Citadel
games.summary: Kotama and Academy Citadel is a 3D Metroidvania game. Players assume the role of an exchange student named Kotama as she explores through the mysterious Academy Citadel, aiming to become the esteemed [Carmel Star].

games.name: Serpent's Gaze
games.summary: Serpent’s Gaze is a punishing 1-4 player co-op third-person action game where you fight tough enemies and relentless bosses, all while uncovering the secrets of an ancient desert.

games.name: Arcane Merchant
games.summary: Open your own shop in the heart of a Medieval Fantasy realm! Stock your shelves with everything from potions and swords to mysterious crystals and legendary artifacts. Set your prices, earn your customers' trust and become the richest merchant in town!

games.name: Crimson Oath
games.summary: Long may the sun shine! Prepare to suffer! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change.

games.name: Barda
games.summary: The mesmerizing inventory management roguelite where keeping your bag tidy means the difference between life and death.

games.name: Cube Kingdoms
games.summary: You are the Lord of a small village in a medieval fantasy world. Build your kingdom by expanding your economy, defending yourself, recruiting troops, making your people happy (or not), all while your neighbors are breathing down your neck.

games.name: Kebab Chefs!: Restaurant Simulator
games.summary: Kebab Chefs! is a Co-Op, cooking and restaurant management game that can be played up to 4 players. Design your own restaurant. Cook delicious foods, fill your menu with various recipes, feed customers and become the biggest kebab restaurant in town!

games.name: 30XX
games.summary: Jump, shoot, and slash your way through 30XX, the roguelike action platformer you can play with a friend! Explore lush, ever-changing worlds that mix precise platforming with fevered combat. Destroy fearsome Guardians. Master unique Powers. Rediscover the thousand years we've lost.

games.name: The End of History
games.summary:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

games.name: Jupiter Hell Classic
games.summary: Jupiter Hell Classic is the demake of a remake of a roguelike unmake of a famous 1993 FPS shooter. Rip and Tear!

games.name: Extreme Forklifting 3
games.summary: Live the dream as a forklift operator! Experience the thrilling life of a warehouse giraffe! Use your trusty forklifts to solve problems and deliver pallets. Pick pallets up, put them down, the only limit is your imagination!

games.name: Smack Talk
games.summary: Smack Talk is a 1-4 player online pvp platform fighting game where you must say your moves out loud. Beat your opponents with one liners and finish them off with ultimate moves in this chaotic new fighter!

games.name: Lunchbreak Tactics
games.summary: Lunchbreak Tactics is a strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, min-max your squad, build ridiculous synergies, then battle players asynchronously. Play your way to climb the ranks with quick runs, no timer, limitless combos, and endless replay.

games.name: Burden Street Station
games.summary:
Burden Street Station is a surreal narrative game set in a liminal train station about helping a cast of unusual creatures and spirits move on with their lives.

Collect personality traits through talking and exploration, and wear them to unlock dialogue options and advance their stories.

You will come to know these spirits very well. You will learn a lot about them.

games.name: This is Fine: Maximum Cope
games.summary: The world famous meme debuts in his first video game. Play as Question Hound in a retro adventure platformer, traversing perilous pits and enraged enemies to overcome the manifestations of his anxieties!

games.name: Duck Side of the Moon
games.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

games.name: Hacked: The Streamer
games.summary: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

games.name: Fatal Claw
games.summary: FatalClaw is a high-quality 2D Metroidvania game. Explore the mysterious underworld in your own way with cat “Kisha” who rise from the dead, and find the key to the ground with other survivors through absorbing the power infected enemies.

games.name: Awaken: Astral Blade
games.summary: Weave your own story in this dark fairy tale. In the mysterious ancient ruins, Loretta, a girl who has parasitized by an alien beast, tries to break through the fog and uncover the truth about her fate. Is there any chance of survival in the darkest place?

games.name: Dark Pals
games.summary: In this singleplayer mascot horror game you're trapped in an abandoned children’s asylum. Solve twisted puzzles with your Ink Blaster, evade its disturbing mascots, and uncover secrets you had long forgotten about. Do you remember?

games.name: Pritto Prisoner
games.summary: Get ready for chaotic 4v2 party game action in Pritto Prisoner! Play as mischievous animal inmates using strategically messy peepee/poopie tactics to outwit highly customizable robot wardens. Break out, or get put to "deep sleep" in this asymmetrical escape game. Easy to learn, hilarious to master.

games.name: Trackastrophe!
games.summary: Trackastrophe! is a puzzle game where you guide an eccentric train through wacky worlds. Add tiles to the map layout, expand your train by collecting train cars, and pray you can get to the other side in one piece!

games.name: Schrott
games.summary: SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game: Pull off insane stunts, collect valuable loot, and customize your absurd vehicle.

games.name: Songs of Silence
games.summary: Songs of Silence is an Art Nouveau-inspired fantasy strategy game with a unique mix of turn-based kingdom management, hero development and real-time combat.

games.name: Bounty Brawl: Most Wanted
games.summary: Welcome to Hunter Haven! Bounty Brawl is a top-down action roguelite shooter for 1-4 players. Here, the hunt is fierce, and betrayal is inevitable. Will you form a fragile alliance with other hunters under the galaxy's most notorious bounties, or go it alone? Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

games.name: Earth Atlantis 2
games.summary: Earth Atlantis 2 is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic shoot 'em up set in a vast sunken world ruled by monstrous machine sea creatures. Pilot a heavily armed submarine through intense Bullet Hell battles, harnessing innovative drone systems to conquer over 20 colossal bosses. Explore stunning underwater ruins, uncover hidden secrets, and battle to save humanity. With a vibrant new pixel art style, expansive Metroidvania-style stages, and fresh gameplay mechanics, the game delivers intense SHMUP action, epic sea monster showdowns, breathtaking visuals, and unforgettable undersea journey.

games.name: Dark Engines
games.summary: Choose a juggernaut and tear through a dark fantasy campaign of brutal car combat, bosses, and unlocks. Then bring the carnage online in tight team-based multiplayer where explosives, magic, and heavy metal decide who survives.

games.name: Gnaw
games.summary: Something’s rotten in New Dino City, and it’s up to you to solve the mystery in GNAW. In this Metroidvania, explore a pre-apocalyptic saurian civilization hurtling toward self-annihilation. Meet strange characters, fight off twisted critters, and rescue your beloved city from extinction.

games.name: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
games.summary: Kodama is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure set in the world of Japanese folklore. Experience fast-paced platforming, fluid combat, and a mystical journey through a colorful, spirit-filled land.

games.name: Biofactory
games.summary: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. No enemies or pressure, the hive mind has only one instinct: The factory must grow.

games.name: FiresOut!
games.summary: FiresOut! is a chaotic couch co-op firefighting game for up to four players. You and your friends dive right into the burning neighborhood to extinguish fire, rescue trapped victims and overcome unpredictable environmental hazards all while dodging fiery projectiles from the fire monsters.

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: Manafinder II
games.summary: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

games.name: Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria
games.summary: Sacred returns as a party-based RPG set in a ruptured and battle-worn post-war Ancaria. Featuring hybrid real-time and turn-based combat, handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, and an open world from the original creators of Sacred. Build your party! Loot everything! Laugh at the rest!

games.name: Just A Shadow Game
games.summary: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game".

games.name: Hexborn
games.summary: An occult-fueled roguelite FPS inspired by Blood and Vampire Survivors — but instead of one arena, explore cursed labyrinths that reshape every run. Draft brutal perks, wield occult firepower, and survive escalating horrors with a retro shooter soul.

games.name: Scallywags
games.summary: Set sail with a ragtag group of Scallywags in a strategic pirate crewmanagement roguelike. Improve your ship, learn fantastical abilities, and hunt down the infamous Aces and their treasures. Every run is a fresh adventure and brings you closer to becoming a true Pirate Legend.

games.name: MIA: Memory Fragments
games.summary: MIA: Memory Fragments is a story-driven psychological horror adventure where you explore fractured memories, interact with the environment to progress, uncover the story through the world, and escape from MIA's darkest side. Survive the memories… or remain trapped forever in the past.

games.name: Twinkle’s Galactic Tour
games.summary: Travel the galaxy and bash enemies to the beat in this 90's anime styled, low-poly, musical platforming adventure! Jump from planet-to-planet, collect 'em all in classic platforming-style zones, and meet the locals in big, open city hubs full of activities, side-quests, and mysteries.

games.name: Cohen 1939
games.summary: "Cohen 1939" is a top-down shooter set in Birmingham, England in 1939. Players take on the role of a woman seeking vengeance for her murdered gangster husband . You will be immersed in classic British gangland scenes of the 1930s.

games.name: Inherited Shadows
games.summary: Inspired by the classics of the genre, Inherited Shadows weaves a gripping tale about Amanda, a young adult struggling to lead a normal life while haunted by the trauma of her mother's absence, but on an ordinary morning in 1999, everything will change for her forever.

games.name: Always in Mind
games.summary: A story-rich adventure set in the mind of a young boy named Teddy. Embark on a surreal journey across breathtaking mindscapes as you unlock unbelievable powers and forge an unlikely bond with an AI companion named "Proxy."

games.name: Impirical Evidence
games.summary:
A comedy adventure game featuring classic inventory based puzzles. Arthur is a skeptic who dedicated his life to denying the paranormal. Murray is the electric Imp he accidentally summoned. Now Arthur must solve mysteries while bound to the very evidence of the supernatural itself.

Arthur Marley is a professional Paranormal Debunker.

For twenty years he has used science, deductive logic, and a healthy dose of arrogance to prove that every ghost is just a projection and every monster is just a well-made costume. He is a man of facts in a world of frauds.

He was the best at denying the impossible… until he accidentally summoned it.

Enter Murray.

A chaotic, playful, electric Imp. He is bound to Arthur and subject to physics laws, yet he cannot directly interact with it and remains invisible to everyone else.

Now Arthur must continue his investigations while dragging around a supernatural partner he refuses to believe in.

Impirical Evidence is a comedy adventure that blends the inventory-based gameplay of 90s classics with a modern, gamepad-friendly presentation.

games.name: Zombuds
games.summary: The zombie apocalypse is here - time to make a profit. Loot, manufacture and distribute shady goods across a zombie-infested sandbox. Hire survivors, brainwash the undead, automate production, and grow your empire in this open-world co-op sim.

games.name: Husk Protocol
games.summary: ATTENTION! HUSK PROTOCOL INITIATED! Prepare to engage in a challenging deck-driven mecha game. Synergise between powerful Husks, utilise a dynamic deck and avoid detection from the city’s mainframe as you infiltrate the machine-driven brutopolis of Aeterna.

games.name: The Player Who Can't Level Up
games.summary: The Player Who Can't Level Up is an action roguelite game based on web novels and webtoons of the same name. You can freely combine various combat styles and numerous growth factors to become stronger. Experience unexpected enhancement effects through various random elements.

games.name: Glintseeker Island
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover exciting secrets, excavate countless treasures, and fight enemies and bosses. Save the island from a mysterious threat below!

games.name: Detour
games.summary: DETOUR is a single-player driving adventure through a mysterious sci-fi landscape. Upgrade your truck, manage your resources, and chart your own path across quiet rural backroads. Scavenge materials, adapt to the unknown and uncover the secrets of a world quietly ruled by an artificial intelligence.

games.name: Cosmic Race: Galactic Showdown
games.summary: Get ready to blast into retro-racing madness with Cosmic Race! Our game reignites the arcade racing thrill, hurling you through mind-bending tracks, intense combat, and eye-popping visuals. It's like the 80s and 90s racing games on turbo steroids—strap in and relive the glory days!

games.name: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok!
games.summary: Valhalla, Vikings, Ragnarok! It's a co-op game about a band of funny Vikings who must raid villages across all nine realms to pay off their debt to Hel and carve their path to Valhalla! Grab the treasure and carry it to the ship! Fight off the weak, hide from the strong, and do it all for the loot!

games.name: Reggie, His Cousin, Two Scientists and Most Likely the End of the World
games.summary: Control the direction of gravity as you run, jump and explore in an outrageous time-traveling adventure as Reggie, an unlikely hero from the 16,000th century on a mission to save science and ultimately the entire universe!

games.name: Goddess of Strategy
games.summary: Lead mortal heroes on grid-based tactical maps and restore the power of the Olympians. Forge bonds with gods, level up your team and combine the perfect skill synergies. Face limited resources, hard choices, and tactical challenges on your journey to defeat the seven deadly sins.

games.name: OrbiTower
games.summary: The hungry Gooper swarm threatens intergalactic peace. Stop them! Build towers around planets and take control over their orbits. Spin them with all youve attached! Collect new towers, powers and upgrades to beat the onslaught of goopers and save the galaxy in this colorful Tower Defense Roguelite!

games.name: A Story of Questions
games.summary: You are trapped, unable to walk, only a desk in front of you. The voice you hear is that of a woman on a speaker. Solve puzzles, interact with your surroundings, and make weighty decisions as you uncover a strange and disturbing story in this supernatural single-player horror mystery.

games.name: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness
games.summary: Eclipse 2: Invasion of Darkness – is an isometric, story-driven game in the Action RPG genre, combining the mechanics of metroidvania exploration and the dynamics of modern slashers. Lead the medieval resistance against the alien invasion on Earth!

games.name: Escape the Riddlerock Ruins
games.summary: Explore the ancient Riddlerock Ruins with your loyal dog in this first-person escape room game. Solve puzzles, decipher ancient inscriptions, uncover hidden passages, and master ancient mechanisms left by a lost civilization.

games.name: Stardream
games.summary: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

games.name: The Book of Prosperity
games.summary: A 2D Action RPG set in a surreal pixel-art world where ancient magic seeps through Hong Kong-inspired streets. Pulled into a parallel dimension ruled by the Circle, Cyrus must master rhythmic combat, rooftop parkour, and forbidden truths to uncover the cost of a world built on false prosperity.

games.name: Quiet Express: Cabin 909
games.summary: “Do you know anything about Cabin 909?” You're a passenger on a transcontinental train. Looking for a room that's nowhere to find: Cabin 909.

games.name: MMORPG NPC Simulator
games.summary: Play as an NPC in a living MMORPG world. Run your shop, trade with players, give quests, and send raid parties after rare loot. Build your reputation, unlock Game Master abilities, and take control of the server from within.

games.name: Thingamajigs
games.summary: A cozy hidden object game about helping the inhabitants of a vibrant hand-drawn world. From troubled bards to awkward first dates, follow along with their stories to discover new locations and more people in need of a helping hand!

games.name: Soundgrass
games.summary: You find yourself on a planet where plants emit sound. Sound and music are also your main gameplay mechanic. Experience the world of sound as never done before.

games.name: Devil Lift
games.summary: Demon hunting is a day job in Devil Lift, a tag battle roguelike deckbuilder. Play as the Lilith Society, a group of underpaid and overworked demon hunters as they protect humanity from the Archbeasts of the Underworld before their shift ends.

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Rinthine
games.summary: Brave the depths of an ever-changing labyrinth in search of secrets, treasures—or simply a place to call home.

games.name: RavenStar
games.summary: RavenStar is a mini-metroidvania where making friends unlocks new abilities! Discover hidden secrets, traverse an interconnected world, and cultivate friendships with a charming cast of characters in this heartfelt platformer.

games.name: Past Due: Midnight
games.summary: Venture through a twisted corporate office in this first-person psychological horror. An ordinary evening of overtime turns into a nightmare. You awaken at midnight, trapped in a place you no longer recognize. Follow clues, find the truth behind the dark. Can you survive the night and escape alive?

games.name: Bolt & Whalington
games.summary: Bolt & Whalington is a Metroidvania game where you play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring the floating ruins of Whalington. Reshape abilities and rewrite world rules with the "Setting Machine," switch mecha forms to craft weapons, battle enemies, and uncover the secret of Whalington.

games.name: Game is Full of Bugs
games.summary: Game is Full of Bugs is a game about a crafty programmer fighting an alien invasion of bugs by building a magazine of bullets like a deck of cards.

games.name: Kitaria Fables 2
games.summary: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary:
The Witch’s Bakery is a 2D Adventure Puzzle game where you play as a joyful witch who opens a bakery in modern Paris.

She has a special power: she can heal emotions with her bread.

games.name: The Scroll of Taiwu
games.summary: "The Scroll of Taiwu" is an indie game themed around Chinese mythology and wuxia. Players assume the role of the mysterious "heir of the Taiwu clan" in an alternate ancient China, working through generations of heirs to defeat a powerful hereditary enemy and shape the fate of the human world.

games.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
games.summary: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's clubs in the world!

games.name: Cloudbreaker
games.summary: Cloudbreaker is a roguelite, inventory management, bullet heaven. Explore a sky-world, finding relics and defeating hordes of enemies. Unlock and upgrade airships, each with its own unique layout, abilities, and strategies, to grow your power over time.

games.name: The Mermaid Mask
games.summary: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

games.name: Memoria Wake
games.summary: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

games.name: Gido Gido: Kaiju Battle Party
