games.summary: Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

games.name: They Will Come
games.summary: Survive a nightmare and save your family. They Will Come is a cinematic steampunk horror adventure set in an alternate 1897. You must avoid detection, solve puzzles, and fight back against mysterious enemies with the help of your powerful robot companion, Talus.

games.name: Holdfast: American Revolution
games.summary: Fight for freedom in Holdfast: American Revolution - A multiplayer first and third-person shooter set during the American Revolutionary War. Charge into chaotically elegant battles with over 200 players per server!

games.name: Vampire Survivors: Legacy of the Bloodmoon
games.summary: A cautionary tale, or a story better left untold? Legacy of the Bloodmoon is the darkest expansion to date for Vampire Survivors. Discover the path to ruin that this pack of villains is headed down. Unlock new weapons and characters to find new ways to snowball against relentless hordes of enemies.

games.name: Skatesterre
games.summary: Flip, grab and grind like it's 1999! Skatesterre is a fast-paced arcade skateboarding game inspired by the golden era of classic skate titles.

games.name: The Alters: Last Variable
games.summary: Continue Jan Scientist's story as he stays behind to unlock the planet's secrets. Build an underground base, assemble a crew of specialised Scientist alters, master Terraformation, invent new technologies, and conduct research that could define a legacy.

games.name: Impermanence
games.summary: A father. A condemned theatre. A son’s voice echoing from the beyond. Step into a narrative horror game about grief, obsession, and the act of holding on as a force older than grief pushes back.

games.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End
games.summary: Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

games.name: Cordura
games.summary: Cordura is a 4-player online co-op psychological horror where sanity is your most scarce resource. Venture together into shifting procedural Victorian labyrinths where the environment is never the same. Lose your sanity and the Night will mimic your team to feed your paranoia. Extract and survive.

games.name: Aniimo
games.summary: Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

games.name: The Road of Dust and Sorrow
games.summary: A story-driven, atmospheric thriller with pixel-art graphics and survival-horror elements. Short, intense, and unforgettable.

games.name: The Lift
games.summary: You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

games.name: My Cannibal Family
games.summary: You are the lurking terror in My Cannibal Family, a gloriously grotesque monster horror sim. Build a twisted theme park, then use traps and stealthy attacks to harvest guests within a deadly sandbox of your own creation!

games.name: Mistfall Hunter
games.summary: Mistfall Hunter is a third-person action PvPvE extraction RPG. Gear up for different classes, master combos and strategic skills, and face intense battles against monsters or players, solo or with teammates. Only a successful escape will secure your treasures.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: DeadRoot
games.summary: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus is an epic new sci-fi action-adventure RPG franchise developed by the team at Archetype Entertainment. The story is fueled by the consequences of player choices due to the impact of Time Dilation and how they change the lives of those we love most.

games.name: 1666: Amsterdam
games.summary: Every 333 years, something stirs. 1666: Amsterdam is a 3rd person Dark, Story-Led, Action-Adventure where Noa, the Collector, wields witchcraft to uncover demonic entities hiding behind human faces. Investigate by day. Face your demons at night.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Black Jacket
games.summary: Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

games.name: Hellcard II
games.summary: Hellcard II is a cooperative roguelike deckbuilder that can be played solo or with a team of up to four players. The game takes place in the paper dungeons known from Hellcard and Book of Demons, expanding into new biomes and storylines.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Witchspire
games.summary: A survival-crafting adventure in a world brimming with magic and peril. Befriend and battle creatures, and conjure up a sanctuary alongside other witches in co-op or single-player.

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
games.summary: A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending.

games.name: Grave Seasons
games.summary: Grave Seasons is a supernatural murder-mystery farming simulator. Play as the new farmer in Ashenridge as you harvest crops, fish and mine, meet and romance townsfolk, build up the community... and maybe stop the murders.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Alkahest
games.summary: Alkahest is an Action-Adventure RPG set in a murky medieval world. Where satisfying melee combat with highly interactive environments takes center stage. Explore realistic locations, learn alchemy and make a name for your family.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

games.name: Terminal War
games.summary: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

events.name: Frosty Games Fest: Summer Game Fest 2026 Edition
events.description: World premiere announcements and updates from 50+ of the coolest upcoming games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand, broadcasting live as part of Summer Game Fest on June 7 AEST and June 6 PT!

games.name: Cow Chess
games.summary: Cow Chess is a real-time artillery party game — think Super Smash Bros meets Worms. It features fluid, wall-sticking movement, punchy weapons, and fully destructible terrain. As the game progresses, you unlock upgrades that transform your abilities, pushing you to adjust your strategies on the fly.

games.name: Janet DeMornay is a Slumlord (and a witch)
games.summary: Live the anxieties and horrors of what it is to be a renter in a world run by landlords. …and your landlord is a witch.

games.name: Straycloud
games.summary: An island in the sky, the home of a once majestic people, has fallen to earth, its magic run dry. The youngest member of this line must venture to shore in an effort to restore power to the ancient magical technology that kept the island afloat.

games.name: Atlanta TD
games.summary: Atlanta TD is a roguelite tower defense game where the armies of the underworld descend onto the Four Spectacular Realms in waves as it falls unto the remaining Gods to protect the city of Atlanta!

games.name: Bashful Adoration
games.summary: Fight for your love with 2-4 friends locally or online in easy-to-learn, hard-to-master combat. Soar the skies on your broom, and dash and smash props and opponents until they're a twinkling dot on the horizon! Secure powerups, land devastating blows, and win the adoration of your crush!

games.name: Fishing Echoes
games.summary: Step into the cozy realms of Fishing Echoes, a game that beckons you to shorelines filled with rare fish and whispered legends. Ready yourself for the ultimate angling challenge as you embark on a journey to mastery.

games.name: Cooking For Ma!
games.summary: Go on an adventure through the spirit world to save your grandma from an evil sea serpent using the power of cooking! Cook dishes for different characters, exploring Korean cuisine in this story about identity, diaspora, and family.

games.name: Hyper Primate
games.summary: Speedrun as a Hyper Fast Ape in this parkour focused FPS. Dash, grapple, and blast through deadly obstacle courses using a massive arsenal of weapons. Master momentum, dodge death, and dominate the leaderboards.

games.name: Slayblade
games.summary: Build your ultimate Slayblade and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts for battle, and combine them for wicked power combos. Skate around the city in all its PS1 glory, making bank on your way to the top. And if you die in the game, you die in real life.

games.name: Freeline!
games.summary: Quick on your paws! Freeline is a frenetic, kinetic, expressive speedrunning platformer about taking down the surveillance state and reclaiming the rooftops.

games.name: Bravest Coconut
games.summary: Bravest Coconut is a silly game about solving story-driven puzzles, meeting a cast of quirky characters, and exploring a world littered with secrets... and you’re a cat.

games.name: Canvas City
games.summary: Canvas City is a turn-based tactics RPG of rebellion on rollerblades. Lead a crew of skaters and street artists rising up against an oppressive regime. Each map is a battleground and a canvas, where your actions shift control, leave your mark, and shape the city’s future.

games.name: Toya
games.summary: Toya is a minimalist cube-rolling game that is always bigger than you think...

games.name: Cloudlings
games.summary: Cloudlings is a cute colony sim set amongst the clouds. Guide a small tribe of curious creatures as they build a floating village, merge drifting islands, manage resources, unlock upgrades, and uncover the mysteries hiding beyond the clouds.

games.name: Verbal Void
games.summary: Three neurodiverse kids explore a forgotten island community. Develop connections, battle your fears and uncover the truth in this unique conversation-beat 'em up adventure game.

games.name: Acting Out
games.summary:
Don't be shy. Act with everything you've got!
The online co-op game where you are actors in a movie, but filming is one-take, do-or-die! Your bloopers won't get cut, so don't screw it up.
Whether you follow the script or ruin it with improv, you'll watch your masterpiece right away. Will be it great or will it be cringe? That's up to you!

games.name: L8r Sk8r
games.summary: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

games.name: N00b's Guide
games.summary: n00bs guide is a narrative walking sim told through a Youtube playlist. Funny, introspective and painfully earnest, play through a series of bizarre mods and community maps, trying to understand what was really important about the time spent with your friends.

games.name: Shape Sender Deluxe
games.summary: Solve physics puzzles with magnets, springs, portals, fans, and more while your new best friend Sendy helps you along the way! But maybe keep an eye on him, he's been acting a little … strange, lately.

games.name: Management in Space
games.summary: Management In Space is a gritty sci-fi strategy roguelite where you find yourself in debt. Build, mine, trade, and defend using stations across the galaxy, all while wars swells, aliens devastate sectors, and cults rip the galaxy apart & release interdimensional demons upon the universe.

games.name: Apathema
games.summary: Cursed to repair the inner organs of The Chasm, you fight to uncover the secrets of your existence and end a self-devouring cycle of Apathy. Apathema is a grunge fantasy turn-based RPG, inspired by God Husk, Baroque, and King's Field.

games.name: Apothecurse
games.summary: A mysterious letter compels Leon, an alchemist, to brave the seas and travel across the world to Port Gelour, a cast in shadow. Craft potent potions, befriend quirky locals, and uncover the dark secrets lurking beneath the waves in a quest for alchemy and discovery!

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Narrative adventure game based on H.P Lovecraft's At the Mountains of Madness. Swim, Slide and Explore open ended levels as multiple penguin types with different abilities and challenges.

games.name: Putrid/Sharp
games.summary: Slice your way through the stages of rot and search for someone lost in a world that is waiting to end.

games.name: Trading Card Inspector
games.summary: Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up! Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG! Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!

games.name: Edwin Earstwhile: Medical Examiner
games.summary: A medical detective game set in the late Victorian era. Uncover the perpetrators behind an assortment of grizzly murders by examining meticulously hand-animated cadavers.

games.name: The Troll & The Witch's House
games.summary: The Troll & The Witch’s House is a point-and-click adventure game set in a strange house filled with mysteries. Piece together fragments of the past, uncover secrets and find the key to your escape.

games.name: A Pocket Full of Slagford
games.summary: Slagford. Some call it The Backbone of the North, most call it proper sh*te. This silly misadventure will take you up monolithic megatowers, down dingy dung pits and beyond. Puzzle your way across the unravelling city by picking up pieces of the world and sticking them where they don't belong.

games.name: Dwarrf: A Pinball Roguelike
games.summary: Play as a Dwarven 'Pirate' and set sail on your modified minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.

games.name: Mingle
games.summary: Find your perfect match in the crowd. Match and merge minglers. Repeat until they're all joined together. 50 unique playable characters.

games.name: Echo Zero
games.summary: Descend into a dangerous, procedurally generated sci-fi underworld in this tower defense roguelike. Explore, gather resources, uncover powerful wargear and upgrades, build and defend your base, and battle a mysterious new species on the verge of breaching the surface.

games.name: Radio Decay
games.summary: A 1-6 player co-op survival horror set in a supernatural nuclear apocalypse. Drop-pod into an abandoned city to extract radioactive artifacts while being hunted by giant bug-like monsters. Rebuild your decaying body with prosthetic limbs, arm yourself, and radio your friends for help.

games.name: Attack of the Astrals
games.summary: Cosmic warriors invade! Command a champion trio in tight grid battles where every turn is a movement puzzle and every skill and spell is positionally targeted. Adapt your team to each realm's challenges and rewards to thwart the Attack of the Astrals!

games.name: Blighten
games.summary: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Chaos has descended upon the town of Gruesome Grove and its fate rests in Nora’s hands. Join her on an oftentimes gory journey through a beautifully hand-drawn world. Discover forgotten truths, make peculiar friends, encounter monsters and solve puzzles in this mysterious and macabre adventure.

games.name: Akashic Slingshot
games.summary: Fight your way through a diverse world in this action-adventure side scroller, where you are given one weapon and die in one hit. Can you earn the right to peer beyond the Zeroed Abyss?

games.name: Hawker
games.summary: Hawker is a Roguelite Action-RPG where you must pay or evade a debt to Death in a procedurally-generated grimdark world. Scavenge, barter and fight for ichor, life, and truth. Thirty days, an impossible debt. Pay, or Fall.

games.name: Night Shift: 1999
games.summary: Balance work, vampirism and socialising as you explore Kings Cross, Sydney during the last year of the millennium. Keep a lid on your darkest desires and be rewarded with a deeper understanding of what it means to live again. Or don’t — no one will stop you. You’re a vampire, after all.

games.name: Kuu
games.summary: Trapped in the fading light of a broken moonhouse, you have 30 nights to balance scarce resources. Grow meager rations in the weak earthlight. Navigate the emotional sanity of a fragile sisterhood. Decode ancient documents in search of secrets. Your only choices will be impossible ones.

games.name: Toil & Trubble
games.summary: Herbs locate, tonics make, So gas deflates, and aches abate. Brew up some mischief in a witchy life sim with a small but troublesome difference. To keep the people of The Nook happy and healthy, Mistress Toil needs to train a young, easily-distracted pig to find magical ingredients.

games.name: Lone Pine
games.summary: Lone Pine is a single-player, 2D adventure set in the fictional Lone Pine National Park. You play as Izzie, who has come to Lone Pine to try to photograph some of its mysterious, undiscovered 'cryptids'.

games.name: UnQuollified
games.summary: A charming Australian point & click detective mystery about a struggling artist investigating the mysterious death of his childhood best friend. Explore the small town of Bridgegully, interrogate quirky locals, & sketch clues to expose the truth. Are you ready to solve a crime years in the making?

games.name: Ghost Writer
games.summary: A whimsical desktop idle focus game. The perfect desktop work companion if you require a little tired ghost typing away at a typewriter.

games.name: Doomsday Diner
games.summary: Chaos! Cooking! Combat! In a post-apocalyptic world where hot dogs are cheap and life is cheaper, you manage the last functioning hot dog diner. Cook hot dogs, brew coffee and serve bizarre orders. Upgrade your diner and shoot down raiders who want your hard-earned cash.

games.name: Sludgineers
games.summary: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, and unlock new areas and perks.

games.name: The Isle of Lost Bees
games.summary: Welcome to the Isle of Lost Bees, a cozy idle game where you and your collection of Australian bees harvest pollen, research flowers, and uncover the island’s secrets. You're a bee-obsessed researcher on an island devoid of humans. You never seemed to need human contact anyway.

games.name: Rusthaven
games.summary: Rusthaven is a cosy management game about rebooting the world in the anti-apocalypse. Journey across an abandoned planet on a solar skyship, salvaging broken-down bots in need of rescue. Clean up the world, upcycle retro technology, and build a peaceful sanctuary where all can thrive and belong.

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.summary: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Sting & Swing
games.summary: Explore a strange overgrown world as a bee with a golf ball. Master the skills of bee-golf to uncover the mysteries hidden in its furthest reaches and hiding in front of you. Discover uses for abilities you didn't know you had. There are always more secrets for those who seek them beneath the green.

games.name: Wild N Chill
games.summary: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, its just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.

events.name: The v3Expo Gaming Showcase 2026
events.description: The v3Expo returns for the special 2026 edition of our showcase, presented by our host girls Squilchan and Shadchan! Come see what's next in indie vidya, have a laugh and cringe a bit. It all goes down Saturday June 6th, 7pm EST!

games.name: Nanima
games.summary: Nanima is a physics-based nanomachine builder where creativity drives combat. Loot and add gear to your ship as you go, with full control over how you dish out damage and move through the harsh microbial world that is the human appendix.

games.name: Putt Down
games.summary: Putt down is a first person mini-golf horror game, where you use a shotgun as a putter. Keep your shotgun in good condition and your stress levels in check while battling both randomized golf courses and horrific monsters. Will you survive or will you be putt down.

games.name: (A)woken
games.summary:
Alpha prototype of a mecha first person shooter made in godot.
It features hand drawn anime style character sprites, an endless arcade mode and a single player story mode.

games.name: O.M.S
games.summary: O.M.S is a casual story-driven 2D Sci-Fi Platformer where you control LIO as his world is threatened by SIMPHONY the very AI that powers his planet. LIO will be avoiding dangerous obstacles and enemies as he hopes to repair SIMPHONY and save his world.

games.name: Action Janken
games.summary: Ever heard how Every Game is just Rock, Paper, Scissors? This one takes it literally.

games.name: Darkodai
games.summary: The land was absolved, it fell to an ancient darkness, a spell cast by a mysterious force. Two beings from a pure realm of light are the only hope for this consumed land. Many adventures against the darkness await you in this small, RPG adventure known as Darkodai!

games.name: Buckshot Battlemage
games.summary: Blast, cleave, and telefrag your way through hordes of felonious fellas with shotgun magic in this arcade twin stick shooter. Upgrade your spells to ludicrous levels and ascend to bullet nirvana, unlocking more weapons and stages as you play.

games.name: Hirdrih Technologic
games.summary: Two robot brothers in an adventure!

games.name: 6 Ways To 7
games.summary: 6 ways to 7 is a high-stakes roguelike twist on the classic dice game Craps! It combines the hard choices of a roguelike, with the push your luck gameplay of craps!

games.name: Boing Boing Bros
games.summary: Boing Boing Bros is a chaotic pinball-like action roguelike where you blast and boing your way through increasingly larger amounts of enemies. Use powerups, stat upgrades, and your boing skills to fight bosses, clear waves of enemies, and boing with your friends.

games.name: Hydrofoil Surfing
games.summary: THPS style wingfoil surfing game with intuitive controls and realistic ocean physics. Pump to generate speed, ride waves and boost airs, land spins, flips, grabs, while maintaining speed or you will sink. Unlocking all locations & boards requires exploration and strategy to complete all 54 goals and achievements throughout 6 unique levels.

games.name: Kyubu Kyubu Dice
games.summary: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an Action Puzzle Game that challenges you to think about dice in different spatially oriented ways! By rolling the magical "Kyubu" the player must clear the panels that appear on the stage in this new, exciting and fast-paced puzzle experience!

games.name: Lettuce Fish
games.summary: Fish for vegetables by controlling the hook itself, while trying to get as deep as possible for greater rewards.

games.name: Polycity
games.summary: Polycity is a classic arcade tube shooter. Move your ship to avoid obstacles. Collect powerups and shoot enemies to try and get the highest score.

games.name: Convento
games.summary: A story about growing up online and dealing with IRL updates.A look back at the past 2 decades of gaming that will make you think about the good, the bad, and the ones left behind.

games.name: Photon Blade
games.summary: Photon Blade is an extremely challenging, fast-paced 2D character action game that combines elements from fighting games, arcade beat 'em ups, and mid-2000s action games.

games.name: Mirrored Soul
games.summary: A turn-based RPG detective story with focus on monster-collecting, exploration, and humor. Negotiate with enemies to recruit them to your party, and fuse your monsters to create new ones.

games.name: Bio-Submariner DX
games.summary: You're the captain of a Bio-Submarine! A living submarine that gains power from flesh! Cruise through the Deep Sea and devour your enemies!

games.name: Dungeon Drops
games.summary: Jump, fight and climb your way out of the ever-changing depths of the Snake Castle in Dungeon Drops!

games.name: Cambrian Crawl
games.summary: A dungeon crawler set in the cambrian period.

games.name: Jenny
games.summary: Smash demons, salarymen and the bureaucratic system in this chaotic hat-and-bat twin-stick shooter.

games.name: APE
games.summary: Deep within a secret laboratory hidden from the world, scientists are creating artificial life. Trapped inside the facility, you must solve puzzles and evade the creations that roam the halls.

games.name: Mouseman: Point-and-Click RPG Adventure - Chapter 1
games.summary: A Dark Comedy Noir Point-and-Click RPG Adventure - Discover the secrets of New Cat City and Rumble with foes! Do crime and make that cheddah!

games.name: Destructor2D
games.summary: 2D racing sim with soft-body physics, car deformations, highway driving, demolition derby, professional racing, crash racing, drifting, truck racing, open wheel racing, advanced AI with up to 50 cars on track, and more.

games.name: Project Heartbeat
games.summary: Project Heartbeat is a cute community-driven rhythm game inspired by titles such as Clone Hero and Project Diva, featuring music from top artists of the Eurobeat genre made popular by the Initial D anime and manga. You can also create your own charts and share them with your friends!

games.name: Project Goblin
games.summary: Project Goblin is a 3D action adventure game. Inspired by classics such as The Legend of Zelda or Dragon's Dogma, Project Goblin will take you on an adventure through a fantasy world full of dungeons to explore, puzzles to solve and enemies to fight.

games.name: Kasha vs. Kritters
games.summary: A retro-style arcade action game where you're a lone catgirl defending her house from a relentless onslaught of pests!

games.name: Ctesiphon
games.summary: A retrowave/mecha-inspired sci-fi first-person shooter featuring fast-paced combat in old-school style open-plan levels packed with pickups, keys, and secrets.

games.name: Maid Cafe Coop
games.summary: Become a cute maid in a maid cafe! Prepare to harness your inner moe energy by preparing and serving customers many different drinks and foods with proper Moe Moe Kyun hospitality, and unlock new ways to make them happier. Play singleplayer or with your friends!

games.name: Peace Incarnate
games.summary: Stop the enigmatic crisis of the disappearing city. Fight or troubleshoot your way across warring factions.

games.name: Radical Zomboarding
games.summary: Radical Zomboarding is a roguelike snowboarding game that's all about shredding powder and shooting zombies. Do tricks, buy perks, and soak the slopes with blood!

games.name: Ninja Game
games.summary: Immersive stealth action ninja simulation! Act like a ninja. Sneak up on a ninja. Strangle a ninja. Dropkick a ninja off a cliff. Throw a ninja out the window. Kidnap a ninja. Make friends with a ninja in real life and play splitscreen coop together!

games.name: Scirocco Thugs
games.summary: Roundhouse Kicks, Six shooters and rusty Lead Pipes become your vehicles for revenge against the Don.... Grab some scrap and engage in brutal, breakneck melee combat in this FPS Beat 'Em Up!

games.name: Genome Guardian 2
games.summary: COMBINE WEAPONS in the microscopic shooter with macroscopic depth. BUILD YOUR NANOBOT from hundreds of parts. SURVIVE the microbial onslaught once more in this psychedelic dive to the Abyss, full of mutations, minerals, anomalies and powerup polyps. SHMUP mode turns it into a vertical shoot 'em up!

games.name: Desk Space: Idle Spacefleet clicker
games.summary: Grow your fleet of space ships in this incremental space game. Extract wealth from the asteroids and stations, unlock upgrades to find synergies, defend against pirates, and unlock [REDACTED]. Pin to your desktop and watch your empire grow while you do "more important" things.

games.name: Your Party Died Again
games.summary: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

games.name: Mamzer Corp
games.summary: Lead a squadron of pilots in combat, working for a ruthlessly efficient mercenary company. Satisfy management's quotas while fighting against under-supply, an onslaught of monsters, and rival mercenaries; optionally keep your subordinates alive in the process.

games.name: The Rewind Hero Returns
games.summary: A visual novel, action, puzzle game. The enemies are always much stronger than you, and your goal is to figure out how to beat them by using elements of the environment to your advantage.

games.name: Bokube
games.summary: A nostalgic and comfy 3D puzzle game! Play as a bunny cube through 3D diorama-like puzzle levels filled with charm!

games.name: Conviction Chronicles
games.summary: 15 prisoners are trapped in a deadly game of murder and deception. Investigate or create twisted cases, clash in ruthless trials, and expose lies with razor‑sharp manipulation. Roles shift, alliances fracture, and a hidden mole works against the group. Adapt fast.... or be eliminated.

games.name: Arm of the Prince
games.summary: Arm of the Prince is a turn-based tactical RPG with a strong narrative focus. Enjoy strategic combat unconstrained by grids, and experience a character-driven story filled with intrigue, oneiric revelations, and morally dubious paramilitary operations. The negotiations must fail.

games.name: CyberCook
games.summary: A cyberpunk PS1-style cooking game, serve up more than just food. Slice through enemies, decide their fates, and uncover dark secrets hidden within your dystopian kitchen.

games.name: Spy/Cell
games.summary: An upcoming stealth 2.5D pixelart-ish looking game.

games.name: Paloo Spiral
games.summary: Classic run n' gun gameplay mixed with fast paced melee combat! Rack up your combo to unleash even more powerful attacks!

games.name: Remote Aphrodite
games.summary: Jump, Run and Gun your way through a series of brutally challenging 2D linear platforming challenges while guiding a discarded homunculus on a journey to find their creator across an entire country, brought to life with expressive, frame-by-frame hand-drawn animation.

games.name: Light Up the Dark
games.summary: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

games.name: Touhou Gaiden
games.summary: Touhou Gaiden is an action platformer heavily inspired by the aesthetics and gameplay of classic NES games like Ninja Gaiden and Castlevania, while adding to the mix the beautiful and overwhelming danmaku that Touhou Project is known for in high-octane boss fights.

games.name: Convent Of Magical Chambers
games.summary: 3D adventure Immersive sim inspired by the early 2000s level design, explore an abandoned convent filled with ghosts and magical chambers and try to solve the mystery behind the creation of the chambers.

games.name: Dice'n'Go
games.summary: Dice’n’Go is a turn-based tactical board game where every roll can change the outcome. Choose your hero, move across a tile-based arena, and use unique abilities to outplay your opponents. Master positioning, timing, and cooldowns to win with both strategy and a bit of luck.

games.name: Aculto
games.summary: Welcome to Aculto, a sandbox adventure game. Jump into a living world and explore an island with hidden secrets, artifacts to discover, and monsters to slay.

games.name: Goblins Can Conquer
games.summary: From a small pack of goblins to a mighty horde: conquer the lands turn by turn! Strategize your expansion, build your village, and collect powerful spells to empower your army. Recruit new goblins and crush your foes: the age of the goblin has begun!

games.name: Occult: Scarlet Elegy
games.summary: An upcoming horror themed RPG in the molds of Strange Journey and Etrian Odyssey.

games.name: Tristan: Curse of The Frog
games.summary: Tristan: Curse of The Frog is an action adventure game currently in development!

games.name: The Mysterious Cat Tower
games.summary: A turn-based J/W/GRPG. Find spells to add to your arsenal, pick impactful talents, tune your attributes, acquire powerful allies, freely reset your build and try something new. Find your own way to play as you experience the harsh life of the strongest pussy in Brazil.

games.name: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
games.summary: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

games.name: Necrofugitive
games.summary: Necrofugitive is a brutal 2D action platformer about the prison escape of an evil shapeshifter and his attempts to evade the realm's justice. Experience fast paced combat and intense fight or flight decisions as you are pursued by lawmen and merciless bounty hunters.

games.name: Wagie Run
games.summary: Wagie Run is a runner game where you play as an employee, running from his neighborhood towards his office. Don't be late for work! Dodge obstacles and keep on the caffeine intakes! Make sure you'll arrive on time!

games.name: Plinkomancy
games.summary: PLINKOMANCY is a roguelite that turns a simple ball drop into explosive chaos. Hit pegs, rack up massive numbers, and unlock upgrades as you push the arcade cabinet to its limits. How far can you go before the machine pushes back?

games.name: Oblivium
games.summary: Oblivium is a fast-paced, violent spellcasting action roguelike featuring elemental reactions where you battle through the nine circles of hell.

games.name: Perish Parade
games.summary: Long ago, the March of Ending was foretold by a prophet: a slow, creeping curse that would walk the world to its grave. Now, that march has begun, led by “The Icon”, a Godlike being who is unmaking the world one step at a time. With the world at the brink of destruction, you are its final hope.

games.name: Void Crawlers
games.summary: Void Crawlers is a Top-down Rogue-Lite Incremental Shooter, there are 3 initial games modes, Arcade - Room to room combat, Gauntlet - 30 minute invasion, and Story - A combination of Arcade and Gauntlet mode with a story on top.

games.name: Baby Carbonara
games.summary: THE BABY IS HUNGRY! Cook rats! Chop mushrooms! Handle raw uranium fuel rods??? Smoke cigarettes! FEED YOUR GLORIOUS BABY LEADER TODAY. Total VR Carbonara immersion. Absolute kino.

games.name: Cliax Codec
games.summary: It's time for a change in perspective! Explore an adventure full of tricky action and puzzles in this third-person and top-down shooter hybrid!

games.name: Wasteland Bites
games.summary: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

events.name: Ñ3 2026
events.description: Ñ3 brings together the best video game developers in the Spanish-speaking world. 43 games, one conference. How many did you already know?

games.name: 15 Minutes to the End of the World
games.summary: 15 minutes to the End of the World is a third person shooter inspired in anime and japanese culture, with a story based on the best time-loop Hollywood feature films - with a twist!

games.name: 4Mecheros
games.summary: A narrative-rhythm game I made to deal with my things 🚬, about how a predatory contract forces a fragmented band—composed of irreparable broken friendships—to get together for a final show. A coming-of-age story about reverb-punk, playing a real bass and the meaning of (not) loving forever.

games.name: A Game About Opening a Chest
games.summary: Open the chest, collect legendary swords, craft powerful synergies, and amass enough gold to pay the King. Dodge the Goblin, survive the Dragon’s fire, and earn the Angel’s blessing. Can you conquer the dungeon and reach 2,000,000,000 gold coins?

games.name: AlcheMice
games.summary: Explore 16th-century Granada, steeped in tarot and alchemy. Face Gusparda, the cursed witch, and fight for your freedom. Build your deck, choose every move across 3D boards, and use strategy and tactics to break the curse and craft the Philosopher’s Stone.

games.name: Ancient Kingdoms
games.summary: Explore a vast open world filled with unique creatures and dungeons. Choose from six powerful classes and embark on an epic fantasy journey in this RPG. Play alone or with your friends (up to 4 players)

games.name: An Eggstremely Hard Game
games.summary: Two geese. One fragile egg. Infinite chaos. Work together to carry it through unpredictable challenges without breaking it, every crack makes it harder, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of honking.

games.name: Angie Magica
games.summary: Unravel the secrets of Lamentia by harnessing the powers of the Wand of the Eternal Smile with skill and wit while you learn delicious recipes in this gourmet adventure. Fulfill the prophecy and reclaim your rightful place as the ultimate magical girl!

games.name: Blade and Madness
games.summary: Blade and Madness, a roguelite deckbuilder where turns play out simultaneously and every choice matters. As madness creeps in, your cards change, the battlefield twists, and enemies grow more unpredictable. Adaptation isn’t optional, it’s the only way to survive… or give in to the dark.

games.name: Bel's Fanfare
games.summary: Bel's Fanfare is an RPG with rich deep exploration and expressive combat. You play as Bel, the new aura cleaner of the once-luxurious vessel The Witch of the Sea.

games.name: Bestiario
games.summary: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

games.name: Boto Labo
games.summary: Solve up to 100 Sokoban-Puzzle levels with the help of your robot friends! Arrange them. Move them. Watch 'em go and... reach the flag in your own style! We got cats, dogs and many more!

games.name: Bulk
games.summary: Collect cards, mix them, watch them rise their rank, sell for gold, and invest in upgrades. Stack, mix, sell and repeat... The machines in this dark fantasy factory keep humming, and the profits are waiting for you...

games.name: Castlebound
games.summary: Lead a band of heroes in a walking castle to battle endless hordes of enemies in this unique action-packed roguelike!

games.name: Catechesis
games.summary: Embrace the darkness as a demon-possessed altar boy in this Horror RPG. Explore the city, battle demons, upgrade your weapons, and embark on an unforgettable journey with unique characters and anime-style cutscenes.

games.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
games.summary: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

games.name: Control, I'm Not Coming Back
games.summary: Control, I'm Not Coming Back is a short and emotional narrative game about a lost astronaut searching for a reason to keep going forward while facing the emptiness of space. Inspired by the Hopecore aesthetic, it’s a story about positivism, friendship and our human connection with Voyager 1.

games.name: Denshattack!
games.summary: Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

games.name: Detour
games.summary: DETOUR is a single-player driving adventure through a mysterious sci-fi landscape. Upgrade your truck, manage your resources, and chart your own path across quiet rural backroads. Scavenge materials, adapt to the unknown and uncover the secrets of a world quietly ruled by an artificial intelligence.

games.name: Drillbound
games.summary: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

games.name: Elders K.O.
games.summary:
Welcome to Elders K.O., the elderly fighting party game nobody asked for… but everyone secretly needed!

A first-person online multiplayer game where up to 8 elders (or rather, the players controlling them) exchange punches, laughs, magical items, and a worrying amount of digital osteoporosis.

Run, jump, push, dodge, steal, explode, and punch other old folks with boxing gloves.
Yes. Everything is allowed here.
Fast fun, instant chaos, guaranteed laughter.

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this thrilling action JRPG and uncover the secrets of Emery crystals as you face challenging enemies that will demand all your skill and ingenuity to defeat them.

games.name: Fugaz
games.summary: With only a flute at your disposal, play songs to solve puzzles. Explore a dark place looking for an exit before the darkness grows too dense. In this immersive psychological horror game, knowledge is the key to put the pieces together.

games.name: Hardcheologist
games.summary: You are an archeologist descending through mysterious and ever-changing ruins using only your weapon's recoil to control the fall. Shoot, try not to touch the ground, reveal secrets and survive. How deep can you go? What lies hidden in the depths of this pyramid?

games.name: GodsTV
games.summary: Smash for Fame in This Madcap 90’s Killfest. Meet a vibrant cast of characters in this frantic action game with zero chill where Gods feed off of fame... And fame is a weapon.

games.name: Hole Is Mine
games.summary: Hole Is Mine is an incremental adventure about purifying the Hole. Dive inside and launch your Mini'ohs to mine for you. Extract impurities, upgrade your power, and find hidden secrets to grow the Village, customizing your Mini'ohs with incredible powers. The Hole has spoken!

games.name: Imago Season
games.summary: A true narrative roleplaying experience. Explore an alien city inhabited by human-insect hybrids. Roll dice, join a revolution, become a mutant yourself. The choices are yours, but so are the consequences.

games.name: Inanima
games.summary: Inanima Be part of something that will change the future of humanity.

games.name: Just in Crime
games.summary: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

games.name: The Midnight Barber
games.summary: A narrative ASMR adventure about a supernatural barbershop in late 70s Barcelona. Trim and style your supernatural clientele, gain their trust, and uncover their darkest secrets.

games.name: Mythic Love: Iberian Legends
games.summary: Think you can handle a little romance with creatures from Spanish folklore? Careful: your love life isn’t the only thing at stake at Mythic Love: Iberian Legends.

games.name: The Plant Shop
games.summary: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

games.name: Prelude Dark Pain
games.summary: Prelude Dark Pain is a Tactical RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Assume the role of a local blacksmith named Soren, lead an uprising against the Order of the Ash Crusade and save a world ravaged by war.

games.name: Oddbat
games.summary: Have you ever wondered how vampires attain immortality? Join this vampire who transforms into a bat to overcome all the challenges that arise, in order to perform a ritual unlike any other!

games.name: Realms of Riddles: Wizards'Keep
games.summary: Explore a magical castle in this first-person puzzle adventure. Solve puzzles across worlds connected by portals, recover your lost memories, and uncover what happened to the kingdom.

games.name: Raiders Rise
games.summary: Raiders Rise is a multiplayer action-strategy game where two teams must cooperate and compete to collect crystals. Survive alien threats, outmaneuver rivals, and choose help or betray? In this chaotic battleground, teamwork is key… until it isn’t.

games.name: Sports Card Shop Simulator
games.summary: Rip open packs and flip cards for profit while building the sports card shop of your dreams. Hunt for holos, parallels,autos, and numbered cards to satisfy your collection obsession. Design your own card and experience the ultimate high as you pull yourself out of a pack!

games.name: Super Bomba League
games.summary: Make the ball hit the floor on their side...by any means! Throw axes, invade their field, or zap anyone in your way! 2v2 online & local matches full of chaos, explosive balls, and feisty bunnies.

games.name: Temtem: Pioneers
games.summary: Survive and explore an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers. Tame and become a roster of 200+ Temtem and master their unique abilities in fast, real-time combat. Build, craft, battle, and discover new creatures solo, or co-op with your friends in this open world survival crafting adventure.

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary:
Tenebris Somnia is a horror adventure in the same vein as survival horror classics like Silent Hill or Resident Evil, but transferred to a retro 2D environment more typical of the N.E.S. or Famicom.

You will struggle to survive by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures.

The secret ingredient of the game is its cinematics. When you reach certain key points you will see sequences with a completely different aesthetic, made in live action with real actors and created by a professional film crew.

games.name: The Last Cat in the Universe
games.summary: Gather the remains of a dying space station to build a cozy home for the last cat in the universe. A short, narrative-driven incremental game about finding peace in the face of darkness

games.name: Thornspell
games.summary: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. Thornspell is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

games.name: The Zibbo Show
games.summary: Be the star of the most exciting game show on TV! Pick your dice, place your bets, build your combos, and try not to think too hard about what happens when you lose.

games.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring
games.summary: Wilderings is an open-world action roguelite with creature collection and metroidvania-like progression that tells an emotionally impactful story about friendship, family, responsibility, and restoration.

events.name: PC Gaming Show Summer 2026
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Gone Feral
games.summary: Stalk your victims through 1980s America in this co-op roguelike assassination game. Improvise brutal kills with everyday objects, terrorize your targets, and get revenge solo or with friends. Hunt across iconic horror locations such as a summer camp, small town, farm, and a sprawling mansion.

games.name: Sated
games.summary: Gurgling messes of flesh live beneath. They seek to be sated. Your cursed fridge beckons: spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rougelike-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself.

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

games.name: Empulse
games.summary: Empulse is a fast-paced 6v6 movement shooter where movement is the weapon. Outmove and outgun your opponents across the post-utopian streets of Freehold, chain wall-runs into grapple swings into mid-air kills, and fight for Crews to control mechs for the ultimate power spike.

games.name: Mr Magpie's Harmless Card Game
games.summary: A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

games.name: Signet City
games.summary: From the creator of Citizen Sleeper, Signet City is a first-person fungalpunk RPG. You are a parasite, in a city where strange technologies and radical ideas are taking root. Grow into and through its inhabitants, uncover and change their stories, and witness the terminal season of the signet city.

games.name: To Kill a God
games.summary: An immersive action roguelite experience with a groundbreaking skill system that allows you to craft your own skill tree. unlock the true potential of your character, delivering an ever-evolving experience.

games.name: Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent
games.summary:
Terrinoth: Heroes of Descent is the first video game based on the legendary tabletop IP Descent. It is a story-driven heroic fantasy Tactical RPG refreshing the formula of dungeon crawlers for all types of fantasy fans alike and expanding on the lore of the boardgames Descent: Legends of the Dark.
Lead a fearless company of heroes into the deep and dark corridors of Terrinoth, survive against epic boss battles in turn-based combat, and settle the fate of a world facing an unending darkness

games.name: About Fishing
games.summary: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

games.name: Into the Wind
games.summary: Drive, fly, and run deliveries together with your sentient motorcycle-plane, Ermes. Make friends, battle rowdy air pirates, upgrade your bike, decorate your home, explore the islands of Santa Rosa, and solve the mystery of your uncle's disappearance.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Incremental base-building horde survival. Short runs earn you resources to construct buildings, which unlock new powers, troops, and spells. Every run pushes you forward, even if you die. Delightfully chaotic and surprisingly chill.

games.name: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Abiotic Factor: Entropic Break
games.summary: Embark on a new tropical adventure, roaming sun-drenched seas and forgotten islands. Investigate the warped GATE Leaf Test Facility and surrounding isles, confronting a new breed of fanatics, digital disorder, far-flung anomalies, the Flesh Dimension, and more in this world-crossing DLC expansion.

games.name: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered
games.summary: The shadows are your ally. Return to the city as Garrett, master thief, in this remastered classic by Nightdive Studios. Pickpocket, prowl, and outsmart in a world where trust is a luxury and every stolen secret comes at a price.

games.name: Pipes.exe
games.summary: A first-person co-op horror experience for 1-4 players based on the thing you think its based on. Climb your way through testing environments as a low level QA employee for a Perfectly Legitimate Tech Company. Survive a series of simulated assignments and brutal corporate life.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Carcass Clad
games.summary: A visceral co-op tank horror game from the creators of MOUTHWASHING. Featuring weighty physical controls, crew the Yksiö with a team of 3. Fuel is limited and ammo is scarce. The city's saint, long since laid to rest, walks again gilded and defiled.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Darktide - Skitarii
games.summary: The Adeptus Mechanicus will not see the secrets of Hive Tertium fall into the hands of heretics, the Skitarii Alpha Primus are elite operatives devoted to serving the will of the Omnissiah. They will annihilate all who stand in their way.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: 2 Fights in 2 Tight Spaces
games.summary: Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves and this time its with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

games.name: Wardogs
games.summary:
Wardogs is a first-person tactical multiplayer shooter built around large-scale combined-arms battles for up to 100 players. Three teams compete to control randomized objective zones across destructible battlefields, using infantry weapons, vehicles, logistics, fortifications, and proximity voice chat.

Players earn cash and XP through combat, support, transportation, and objective play, then spend persistent cash on custom loadouts, equipment, and vehicles across lives and matches.

games.name: ReVamp
games.summary: Rule as Dracula in this castle-defense roguelite. Shape your fortress room by room, command an army of monsters, and step into battle yourself to protect your throne from relentless mortal invaders. A war waged for eternity, for the love you couldn’t save.

games.name: Rivage
games.summary: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
games.summary: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

games.name: Valheim
games.summary: Valheim is a brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally-generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Craft powerful weapons, construct longhouses, and slay mighty foes to prove yourself to Odin!

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Eternal Whispers
games.summary: Vampire: The Masquerade - Eternal Whispers is a narrative-driven CRPG set in the World of Darkness. Awaken from decades of torpor into a dark-modern Montreal consumed by political intrigue, buried secrets and personal horror.

games.name: Company of Heroes: Definitive Edition
games.summary: Company of Heroes – Definitive Edition, features the original Company of Heroes along with the Opposing Fronts and Tales of Valor Expansions, enhanced visuals, quality-of-life gameplay improvements, and 64-bit platform support.

games.name: Hack '95
games.summary: Time travel to 1995 in this card-based computer hacking voyage. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency to become a god to the freaks and geeks of cyberspace. All while being helped by an incontinent virtual pug.

games.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
games.summary: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

games.name: AfterQuest
games.summary: AfterQuest is a fast-paced roguelite RPG with tactical, turn-based combat. Build your party by choosing three heroes from a growing roster, experiment with endless build combinations, and experience a character-driven story where defeat only makes you stronger.

games.name: Another Door
games.summary: Another Door is a multiplayer, turn-based roguelike with monsters, despair, risk and betrayal. Hide your intentions, bluff to survive and bet on your luck. Will you back out, or venture through Another Door?

games.name: Happy Bastards
games.summary: Happy Bastards is an open-world tactical RPG with turn-based combat in which you assemble a squad of unruly mercenaries to explore, fight, and loot. Let the bastards do the dirty work while you give the orders, reap the rewards, and enjoy the high life. Who needs XP when you're famous?

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Shroom and Gloom
games.summary: Gather and grow cards in Shroom & Gloom, a moody first-person, roguelike double-deckbuilder bursting with fungal foes and mountains of mega-combos!

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Clowntown
games.summary: An off-beat co-op party campaign for 2-8 clowns. Collaborate or sabotage your way through hand-crafted action puzzles and evolving minigames that will have you laughing, screaming, and honking with your friends.

games.name: Sunset Summit
games.summary: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!

games.name: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari
games.summary: A Geoguessr-inspired detective game set on an alien planet. Pinpoint the exact locations of photos to track down missing archeologist Abigail Lidari. Cross-reference journal entries, decipher cryptic symbols, and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization. Find her... before it’s too late.

games.name: P.O.N.
games.summary: P.O.N. — a realistic first-person stealth-action crime-horror game that lets you see superheroes through the eyes of crime. Players complete missions for a criminal syndicate, staying connected through a tactical tablet. The core mechanic is a super AI that creates tension with its unpredictable and brutal attacks..

games.name: Spellsided
games.summary: Play as a magical die in this ‘dice-builder’ RPG where each of your faces casts a different spell. Discover and combine new spells as you explore a world of eccentric animate board game tokens, all fighting for the affections of the Gods of the Tabletop...

games.name: Serious Sam: Shatterverse
games.summary: Serious Sam: Shatterverse is a co-op roguelite FPS for 1 - 5 players. Blast through shifting universes, stack wild boons, bend the rules with run modifiers, and hunt Mental's deadliest forces. Fall fast. Come back louder.

games.name: Arcane Eats
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

games.name: Red Kiss
games.summary: Dispatch a team of vampire spies through the tense and fractured streets of Cold War Berlin. Fulfill your darkest impulses as you tap into their powers, gain their trust, and manipulate your way through this (blood)thirsty Tactical Narrative RPG.

games.name: SlashZero
games.summary: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

games.name: Wind Runners
games.summary: For centuries, the Realm uses fear and its military superiority to keep the Zarah Igna System under control, but a group of rebellious Ishma arises to fight its tyranny. With their superior aerial combat skills, the Wind Runners will bring freedom to all who live under the shadow of oppression!

games.name: Wardens of Avalon
games.summary: Restore the former glory of a corrupt Camelot in Wardens of Avalon, an Action RPG set in a Dark Arthurian world. As a new member of the Twilight Knights, establish your fiefdom, explore, craft and gear up for thrilling adventures against the fallen Knights of the Round Table, alone or with friends.

games.name: Arkheron
games.summary: In this fast-paced, dynamic PvP game from Bonfire Studios, teams of three battle to ascend a mysterious Tower built from fragments of their life before. Here, items are the heroes - each one imbued with powerful abilities that shape how you fight, adapt, and outplay other teams. Build your strategy and identity on the fly by looting and combining items in real time, creating unique builds throughout every match. What you choose to carry defines not only what you can do, but who you can become.

games.name: Maximum Thunderness
games.summary: An extreme response to minor problems. MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike sidescrolling co-op action game where you fight a space alien criminal invasion with different skills and abilities.

games.name: Exo Rally Championship
games.summary: Exo Rally Championship is the galaxy’s most dangerous off-road racing event - remote, unexplored, extreme exoplanetary rally. Master a brutally realistic racing simulation and fight for every second gained on your quest to become a champion.

games.name: Duskers 2.0
games.summary: What will you'll sacrifice to bring humanity back? Scavenge derelict spacecraft with your drones via a command-line interface, navigating past whatever is still alive in the dark, in order to save what little of humanity is left.

games.name: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle
games.summary: Dave the Diver: In the Jungle is a DLC expansion for Dave the Diver. It introduces a new jungle-themed environment where players can explore for exotic resources and face additional challenges, all while continuing to balance underwater exploration with restaurant management.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: A kidnapping, a desperate mother, and a shadow from the past. The final chapter of the trilogy reveals every secret behind the series most unsettling icon: the Red Nun.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus is an epic new sci-fi action-adventure RPG franchise developed by the team at Archetype Entertainment. The story is fueled by the consequences of player choices due to the impact of Time Dilation and how they change the lives of those we love most.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.summary: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.summary: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

games.name: Time Strike
games.summary: TIME STRIKE is a single-player FPS that gives you maximum control: stop time to dodge projectiles, rip down walls, line up a headshot, and flip flying debris into hapless enemies. CONTROL TIME. CONTROL SPACE.

games.name: El Paso, Elsewhere 2
games.summary: More stakes. More guns. More slow-mo. James Savage returns in this sequel to the hit third-person shooter. Escape the Void. Fight creatures pulled from myth, history, and imagination. Save yourself.

games.name: Beast of Reincarnation
games.summary: In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

games.name: Total War: Warhammer 40,000
games.summary: Experience the brutal fusion of galactic strategy and grimdark warfare in Total War: WARHAMMER 40,000. Take command of iconic factions, customise your war machine, and engage in devastating battles as you carve a bloody warpath across the stars.

events.name: Deutsche Indie Showcase: Summer Game Fest 2026 Edition
events.description: Evento listado na agenda oficial do Summer Game Fest.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Lost Legions
games.summary: Lost in the Teutoburg Forest after a historical catastrophic defeat, survive as a Roman soldier in a world filled with danger. Craft, build, explore and fight in this story-rich open-world adventure. Unearth secrets of a forgotten time, alone or with up to 3 friends, in a land where history lingers.

games.name: Bot Slash Bot
games.summary: You click - You dash - You slash. Bot slash Bot is a fast-paced, top-down Hack n‘ Slash in which you control a rogue robot slashing & dashing through your former co-machines holding you captive! It's all about speed. Time is running out.

games.name: Wetter
games.summary: Explore a remote, rain-drenched archipelago. Find cozy shelters and cherish long-lost memories to see life in a new light. What will you make of your past?

games.name: Little Sheep Valley
games.summary: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

games.name: Basecamp
games.summary: Fight waves of mutated creatures in this roguelite tower defense game. Turrets can be used to defend or to harvest — you decide! How much can you secure before being overrun?

games.name: My Dear Emma
games.summary: Exploring beautiful landscapes and local wildlife. Become part of Emma’s story, a young biologist and nature photographer who has decided to start a new life far from the big city. A narrative-driven adventure to relax, feel, and slow down.

games.name: Tiny Train Adventures
games.summary: Set off on a tiny train adventure! Build your railway and drive through the mountains in this cozy exploration adventure.

games.name: Dino Party
games.summary: Fight your friends through a stadium full of chaotic minigames! Dino Party is a 2–4 player party brawler where you score goals, steal stars, dodge hazards, and settle every round with punches.

games.name: Frieda is Changing
games.summary: Frieda’s fourteen, furious, and sick of secrets. Uncover the real reason for your sister’s disappearance: Snoop through an isolated village, crack puzzles and stir up trouble. But hurry - monsters are lurking where you least expect them.

games.name: Children of Saturn
games.summary:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

games.name: Imprinted
games.summary: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

games.name: Recollage
games.summary: Craft your way through this dark fantasy puzzle adventure. Use your creativity to transform yourself and the world around you. It’s the only way to break free from the shadows of your childhood.

games.name: The Memphis Chronicles
games.summary: Welcome to Memphis, a city you can only visit once. A place where dreamers and the dead dance. Explore Memphis in the first person, uncover mysteries, and maybe even learn a bit more about yourself. You can’t bring any friends, but everyone you need is already here. This is the trip of a lifetime.

games.name: Cards & Cannons
games.summary: Build epic worlds, collect shiny loot and upgrade your defenses in this roguelite tower defense deckbuilder! Crush endless enemy hordes with mighty spells and crazy builds in unique runs. Defeat powerful bosses and conquer world after world in this colorful medieval madness!

games.name: Vena
games.summary: Roguelike deckbuilder meets hex-tile city builder! Build a resource engine to survive the center’s rising demands. Place producers, converters, and combo-rich tiles. Roll dice to shop, pick perks, and chase wildly different builds every run.

games.name: Moonlords: Tides of Battle
games.summary: Compose your army and outmaneuver the enemy troops on a lane-based map to turn the tides against them. Choose out of many factions, units, upgrades, heroes and spells to gather momentum, push lanes and storm their base in an epic tug of war.

games.name: Beards Go Underground
games.summary: The Mining Deckbuilder. Craft a deck of bombs and pickaxes to mine the mountains. Place down your card-arsenal and unleash a screen-shaking chain reaction that pays out in a juicy explosion of gold.

games.name: Chessfall
games.summary: A roguelite adventure in the chess kingdom – roam the land as a shapeshifter, collect items & loot, trade with merchants, defeat powerful bosses and find the white queen to break the curse of the black wizard!

games.name: DrillScape
games.summary: Arcade mining under pressure: pilot a fast rover, mine resources, upgrade, fight, and rescue planets before aliens take control over the whole universe.

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: Frontline Protocol
games.summary:
Frontline Protocol is an RTS with deckbuilding and auto battler elements, entirely focused on cooperative PvE. It features a tactically rich card system: you draw from three customizable decks at once, rewarding specialization, deck planning, and player experience, allowing you to control each frontline with precision.

Whether solo or in online co-op with up to three players, each battle brings new challenges. You share resources, spawners, and eco buildings. Your deck composition lets you focus on specific roles - such as economy, defense, support, or aggressive frontline control using light infantry. Communication and timing are crucial, as whatever one player builds benefits the whole team.

Throughout the game, you earn booster credits that can be spent on new card packs. These packs include new cards, temporary bonuses, and resources to further develop your decks. Some cards can also be upgraded, permanently lowering their deployment cost—offering long-term depth over short-term optimization.

With each level-up, you gain a skill point to invest in passive bonuses—such as higher starting resources, larger hand size, or better resource rates. This adds a growing meta-progression system that deepens your playstyle alongside your deck choices.

Experienced players can take on missions, randomly generated mini-campaigns with special challenges. Completing them earns mission coins used to unlock special booster packs. These contain unique deployment plans, booster items, and additional rewards that can be strategically used to optimize your loot.

With over 300 cards for units, buildings, towers, and special actions, you'll find the playstyle that suits you best.

games.name: Pinfinity: Incremental Pinball
games.summary: Hit bumpers to earn money, expand your skilltree, place more bumpers and get rich in this incremental pinball game!

games.name: Plant Everywhere
games.summary: Paint your city with plants! In this cosy guerilla gardening game, turn harmful areas into gardens that everyone can use. Use freeform planting to customise your city, and get to know the local residents and their stories.

games.name: No Man Can Deny
games.summary: Isolated on the open sea, equipped with a rusty lantern and a tape recorder. Endure the pain or drown like the rest in this short resource-management horror game.

games.name: Chromatide
games.summary: In this first-person surreal adventure set inside a vast underwater station, the experiments of the OCCTech corporation have torn reality open. Descend into the depths. Wield paranormal powers, face abnormal creatures and survive the chromatic tide.

games.name: Chop Chop Inc.
games.summary: Build your own furniture empire after getting fired from Furnox Corp . Chop down trees, process wood, automate your growing production lines and sell clever furniture sets for bonus cash. Explore a handcrafted world packed with weirdos, secrets and trees begging for violence.

games.name: Aquapark Tycoon
games.summary: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this cozy simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

games.name: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
games.summary: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

games.name: Cash is King!
games.summary: Welcome to a place where the sun is guaranteed and money is basically part of the beachwear. In this cozy first-person simulation, you start out at Miami Beach, sell, invest, optimize, and make the cash register ring – because in the end, only one thing counts: Cash is King.

games.name: Pesky Orcs!
games.summary: In "Pesky Orcs!" you take part in medieval fantasy battles between ancient foes: Orcs and humans. Dive into a unique mix of Autobattler, RTS and Roguelike in real retro pixelart fashion!

games.name: Incredibug
games.summary: Become the Incredibug: Control a cute pill bug, unite your fellow critters and rise up against a menacing smart home system in this physics-based platformer with metroidvania elements.
