It’s your job to land your clients a record deal and negotiate the terms on their behalf. Will you help them fight for their creative freedom, or sell them out to the industry bigwigs?

Coffee and Cigarettes for Breakfast: Sex, drugs, and rock ’n’ roll can only get you so far. Somebody has to make sure the band is in shape to play the next gig. This is where you come in. Make sure they eat a half-decent meal every now and again, fix their gear, get them to rehearse… Hope you like herding cats!

Don’t Stop Me Now: It’s your job to book the venue, finalize the setlist and ensure the gig goes according to the plan. Each successful performance is a step toward fame and glory. Sure, that “club” was just a grimy basement, and the audience barely outnumbered the band - but even rock legends have to start somewhere, right?

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Dive into Neo Junk City, a cyberpunk adventure where you’re an android detective unraveling your own murky past. Navigate neon streets, engage with unique characters, and race through the rain-soaked city. Uncover secrets in this twist on point-and-click gameplay.

games.name: Lazy River
games.summary: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

games.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
games.summary: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an enhanced compilation of Moss and Moss: Book II that replaces the use of virtual reality in those games with a new cinematic camera system. The game is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

games.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
games.summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

games.name: Schrödinger's Call
games.summary: I am Mary. The last person in the world you'll ever talk to. Schrodinger's Call" is an adventure game that uses a mysterious phone to connect with souls who cannot die. The main character, Mary, wakes up in a strange room with no memory. The player, along with the bewildered Mary, will save souls.

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Mutter
games.summary: In the midst of war, a far more personal horror takes root at home. Your mother is becoming a monster. Survive, uncover the truth, and navigate a heartbreaking bond in this unique stop-motion narrative horror adventure.

games.name: Voidface
games.summary: Face off in a challenging bullet-hell arena shooter to try and clear bite-sized boss rush challenges. Learn to dodge their attacks, cast spells to gain an upper hand, and kill everything that gets in your way.

games.name: The Dungeon Experience
games.summary: Put your real world responsibilities on hold with a visit to The Dungeon Experience, a fantasy theme park phenomenon. Adventure awaits, for anyone and everyone! If you've already visited, please come back, we fixed that smell.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.summary: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

games.name: General Practice
games.summary: Diagnose and (mis)treat patients to meet tight deadlines and high expectations in this wacky medical co-op adventure. Wear many hats, master numerous tools, multitask, manage the chaos: all while trying to do no harm! Play solo or enjoy the tomfoolery with up to 4 players, locally or online.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Carnival Hunt
games.summary: Carnival Hunt is an asymmetric multiplayer horror game set inside a living, ever-shifting mechanical carnival designed by the Puppetmaster. One player becomes the Carnival Monster, while others play as puppet Bunnies struggling to survive, ascend, and escape the hunt.

games.name: Hayaku! Island of Darkness
games.summary: Explore a mysterious island full of dangers and uncover the secrets behind the anomalous creatures that inhabit it in this retro-style metroidvania.

games.name: ShelfLife: Art School Detective
games.summary: ShelfLife: Art School Detective is a Mystery Adventure featuring a cast of loveable weirdos! Befriend and investigate 7 potential suspects. Use psychic powers to astral project into their artwork and learn their secrets. Unmask the mysterious ART KILLER that’s terrorising your campus!

games.name: Splash Divers
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an unforgettable diving vacation! Break free from the limits of air supply and dive into the beauty of the ocean and its incredible marine life. Build your own personalized ocean encyclopedia, make friends with a diverse cast of dive buddies, and savor these moments of leisure.

games.name: Trainwatch
games.summary: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Sol: Shogunate
games.summary: Paint the stars with the blood of your enemies in this Space-Samurai Action RPG set in an alt-future solar system ruled by the sword. A pulse-pounding soundtrack drives your gravity-defying, blood-soaked path of revenge as Yuzuki the “Shattered Heir” to a massacred clan who becomes an outlaw ronin.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Everwind
games.summary: Everwind is a novel take on RPG and Sandbox Survival genre in First-Person-Perspective. Embark on the adventure with your friends - Build a base on a flying island-ship, gather resources, craft, loot, and fight while you rise above the clouds to uncover the mysteries of this world!

games.name: Graft
games.summary: GRAFT splices together tense survival horror with a dark RPG experience in a thrilling new adventure from the developers of BATTLETECH and the Shadowrun Trilogy. Explore a dying world haunted by darkly fascinating characters and nightmarish monsters as you delve into the mysteries of the Arc. Tear pieces from your enemies to transform yourself into something new—something capable of surviving the horrors that prowl around you. Every Graft brings with it some piece of its previous owner’s identity, changing more than just your physical body.

games.name: Cathedral: Crow's Curse
games.summary: Set in the same universe as Cathedral, but with its own story and style, Cathedral: Crow's Curse is an action-adventure with tight combat and a focus on exploration. Parry, dodge and fight your way through numerous enemies in a rich detailed world as you uncover the events leading up to Cathedral.

games.name: Cosmo Tales
games.summary: Cosmo Tales is a third person, action adventure inspired by the '70s retro sci-fi aesthetic mixed with modern looks and gameplay. Use the dimension shifting ability to change between realities as you fight your way through the outer space.

games.name: Kitman
games.summary: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

games.name: Echobreaker
games.summary: A lightning-fast precision speedrunner where you pilot an armoured rig that can manipulate time itself. Every second matters, and going faster means risking everything.

games.name: Imprinted
games.summary: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

games.name: MTB Mavrix
games.summary: The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

games.name: Grobnopolis | Last Days
games.summary: You haven't been outside in quite a while. The sky was enveloped by a strange layer of clouds that's been blocking the sunlight for months. Something’s brewing in the air… and now it has found its way into your apartment.

games.name: Petunia's Purgatory
games.summary: Petunia’s Purgatory is a creepy-cute, idle-farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds that grow into horrifying crops, sacrifice animals for blood, and summon assistants to help you run your farm. Manage your sanity while you try to appease the Elder God!

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: A space station has been swallowed by a black hole, mutants roaming the corridors, and everything seems to have gone mad around you. Be sneaky or blast your way through the station and find a way home, all in a disco-punk atmosphere, as if you were the hero of a 70s B-movie that never existed...

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: Brigador Killers
games.summary: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

games.name: Lost in the Roots
games.summary: A 2D adventure with a twisted story about guilt, where a girl is kidnapped and held in an attic somewhere in the countryside. Why and who took the girl to this godforsaken place? What to do when there is nowhere to run?

games.name: Expendabots
games.summary: Expendabots is a 4-player CO-OP horror-extraction game where you and your friends explore ever-changing islands full of danger and secrets. Run, hide, loot abandoned facilities, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

games.name: John Gleep
games.summary: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: Glasshouse
games.summary: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

games.name: DayZ: Badlands
games.summary: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.name: The Mermaid Mask
games.summary: Magnus Mortuga has been killed. The captain of the world's strangest submarine, he was found in a locked room with an ancient stone cauldron - unsealed and opened for the first time. How did he die? Was it a curse? Perhaps one of his eccentric crew? Or does the bizarre truth run even deeper...

games.name: Imagine Sisyphus Happy
games.summary:
Sisyphus, king of Corinth, has tricked the Gods and Death. To punish him, the Gods condemned him to push a boulder uphill forever, only for it to roll back each time.
But Sisyphus didn't give up. He decided to livestream it.

Imagine Sisyphus Happy is a Steamer Sim, Clicker and QTE mix game about life, spectacle, and finding meaning in repetition. Roll your boulder, pull off stunts, and try to make the eternal grind worth living.

Push the boulder. Do tricks. Go live.

Progressing from Greek myth to the modern day, the story asks two simple questions:
- Aren’t you a Sisyphus too?
- Can you Imagine Sisyphus Happy?

games.name: Sated
games.summary: Gurgling messes of flesh live beneath. They seek to be sated. Your cursed fridge beckons: spin the wheel and choose revolting ingredients in this rougelike-inspired cooking course from the very depths of hell. Leave your customers satisfied or become the meal yourself.

games.name: Duskfade
games.summary: Duskfade is a colorful adventure in a world where the torments of the past haunt you. Battle against your memories in a dizzying dance to fade the shadows of the dusk.

games.name: The Subminer
games.summary: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

games.name: Nailcrown
games.summary: Nailcrown is a savage dark-fantasy boomer shooter packed with high-velocity gunplay, brutal melee action, and a dynamic gore system. Explore the dark environments and wield a deadly arsenal, while taking down a horde of accursed enemies. Fast, violent, and unapologetically old-school.

games.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction
games.summary: A terrible syndicate has infiltrated society, explore cases, listen to what the citizens have to say, and use that information to route out the good from the evil in this roguelike 'clock-like' deduction game. Can you uncover the head of the syndicate? Or will you be duped like the rest?

games.name: Code: 9
games.summary: Deduce evidence using your own words in crime investigations against the fascist regime of Aeterna. Prove yourself in real debates where every word matters. Johann Richter discovers Klara, a mysterious speaking artificial intelligence. Where does she come from? What is her mission?

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

games.name: Wildaria
games.summary: Wildaria is an Action-Adventure RPG Pet Collector set in an Infinite Fantasy World. Explore diverse open-world biomes as you collect and train unique pets to aid in your quest to conquer dungeons, slay gods, or defend the natural world from the kingdom.

games.name: Wreck Runners
games.summary: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.

games.name: Mayak
games.summary: Hard-sci-fi side-scrolling VN about first contact, love, and a prime-number countdown. You are a young astronomer researching a newly received signal from a distant star. Unravel an alien mystery — and fight to save the one you love.

games.name: Steam to Electric
games.summary: Build and optimize your railway network in this elegant voxel rail tycoon. Transport passengers and goods, unlock crazy-but-real historical train inventions, and evolve from steam to electric. Easy to start, deep to master. From the creators of Station to Station and Town to City.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Bring prestige back to Earth by building your engines and finding Glory on Pluto in this offbeat and unique deckbuilding rougelike.

games.name: Hack '95
games.summary: Time travel to 1995 in this card-based computer hacking voyage. Take down an evil tech startup and shadowy government agency to become a god to the freaks and geeks of cyberspace. All while being helped by an incontinent virtual pug.

games.name: Whisk
games.summary: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

games.name: Welcome to Elderfield
games.summary: Welcome to Elderfield is a spooky farming RPG. You can farm, fish, mine, cook, craft, befriend townsfolk, beseech the old gods, investigate mysteries, watch unsettling news programs, get lost in the dead mall, die in your sleep and more. There's lots to do in Elderfield!

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.summary: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

games.name: Being & Becoming
games.summary: Being & Becoming is a dark, atmospheric metroidvania set in a kingdom consumed by a Collective Dream. Play as a Lucid Dreamer, able to possess the corrupted, absorb their spirits, and wield them as weapons to break the world free from its endless slumber.

games.name: Bandwagon
games.summary: Assemble a band of music-playing animals and roam the land to help grumpy creatures rediscover their joy. Each run features unique, procedurally generated music based on the bandmates you choose, as you complete quests and meet quirky characters along the way.

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.summary: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

games.name: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon
games.summary: The Heavens are done waiting. In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a Survival Horror set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

events.name: The Secret Sauce Showcase 2026
events.description: Welcome to the SECRET SAUCE SHOWCASE! Expect 40+ brand new trailers for some of the coolest, cutest, weirdest, and [redacted] games ever. Plus, tune in to see exclusive behind-the-scenes dev diaries sharing some extra info on the talented devs behind some of the featured games.

games.name: Roman Sands RE:Build
games.summary: Washed up on the shores of a timeless luxury retreat, you find yourself acquainted with its unhinged inhabitants. They await the day that the Sun will swallow the world. You are obligated to serve their whims. There's more to this place than meets the eye. Can you uncover your exit?

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: A modern JRPG-inspired game with a unique battle system, rich story, fantastic visuals and music by Motoi Sakuraba.

games.name: Sprkls.exe
games.summary: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: Discover pinball like never before with Appulse! The game is a roguelite shooter, where you protect a Galactic Federation ship! Upgrade your ball, your weapons and your ship to pushback waves of unwavering robots.

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is an autoscrolling rhythm-platformer centered around slashing through enemies to the music to maintain your momentum and traverse your way towards your own heart. There are three directions to slash - up, down and right in front of you. Slash in the correct direction to aim your attacks at enemies and dash into them. Performing a series of slashes to the correct rhythmic pattern is the key to reaching the end of the stage and advancing onwards to your heart.

games.name: Boost Vector EX
games.summary: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: Sovereign Tower
games.summary: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

games.name: Kill your Darlings
games.summary: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

games.name: Shade Protocol
games.summary: Shade Protocol is a 2D cyber-fantasy Metroidvania where music, code, and combat collide. Swap between DAWN and SHADE forms to unleash devastating abilities, wield Instruments as weapons, and rewrite reality itself in a world on the brink of annihilation by the Shade Protocol.

games.name: Black Well Devil
games.summary: Ascend from the depths of hell in Black Well Devil, the stylish high-stakes platformer. Flick yourself into the air to reach higher heights, fall again and again, fight challenging bosses, and mayhaps fall in love.

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Worming from Home
games.summary: Be the Worm of Wall Street in this silly simulation game about working a remote finance job. Throw your spineless body around the keyboard to invest in the stock market and earn obscene amounts of money. Buy upgrades, train skills, and worm your way up to the promotion you've always dreamed of!

games.name: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
games.summary:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

games.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
games.summary: You play as the queen of ants, managing an anthill. Ants cannot be controlled directly, but you can create the necessary types of ants; improve them; organize raids, build a dungeon! The goal of each level is to destroy all enemy bases.

games.name: Unshine Arcade
games.summary: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

games.name: Memoirium
games.summary: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: Remote Control
games.summary: Remote-control human proxies to explore a derelict spaceship. Type your commands, manage risk and decide how disposable a life really is.

games.name: The Cave Diver
games.summary: Crawl down a suffocating cave system using only your arms in this punishing physics-horror adventure. What morbid force is calling you deeper into the heart of the caves?

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a Lovecraftian fishing adventure set in a post-nuclear apocalypse world. Sell your yield, upgrade your boat, build equipment and battle monsters lurking in water and on land. Explore forgotten lands and discover ancient secrets.

games.name: Dicewood
games.summary:
Dicewood is a fantasy horror turn-based roguelike deck-builder where adorable forest animals band together to escape the relentless hunter.

Fleeing into a dark, twisted forest filled with ancient horrors, creepy monsters, and cannibal tribes, player must strategically combine different animals, overcome nightmarish foes, and make their way to the river to start a new life.

games.name: Vale's Echo
games.summary:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

games.name: Bridgebourn
games.summary: Explore a hand-painted dynamic open world in this immersive ARPG. Create custom spells and trigger countless reactions. Plunder treasure and secrets with your party of adventurers. Upgrade your party with magic loot. Fight what lurks in the depths of dungeons. Discover mysteries of the Fadelands.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
games.summary: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

games.name: Diecast
games.summary: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

games.name: Ironclad
games.summary: A co-op horror game where you and a small crew pilot tanks to eradicate the monster infestation plaguing the world. Work together and harness ancient technology to end the scourge once and for all.

games.name: Meaningless Random Numbers
games.summary: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning cash through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching.

games.name: Palettopia
games.summary: Palettopia is a cozy city builder about creating minimalistic cities with the stroke of your paintbrush. Explore infinite islands & solve puzzles while building synergy between the serene landscapes & urban districts. Discover vibrant biomes as you paint your way to paradise and create your utopia.

games.name: Pelikeeper
games.summary: Pelikeeper is a cozy tower defense & base building strategy game where you play as the last pelican in a world swallowed by a shadowy fog. Build up and defend the settlement around your lighthouse, rescue lost animal neighbors, and return constellations to the cosmos.

games.name: Portal to the Cosmobeat
games.summary: On his mission, to become the very best dancer ever, Gorb challenges incredible dance coaches all around the galaxy. Unfortunately, he is terrible. Can you dance him to the top?

games.name: Red Snow
games.summary: Experience the ultimate fusion of snowboarding and combat in RED SNOW! Navigate perilous slopes, battle enemy forces, and execute stunning tricks to earn cash in this epic board-n-sword adventure.

games.name: Iron Nest: Heavy Turret Simulator
games.summary: Iron Nest is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.name: Ghost Vanguard
games.summary: Ghost Vanguard is a Beat'em Up game that combines stylish action with roguelike elements. Grab your sword and step into treacherous evil dungeons, using stylish and magnificent combos to defeat the sinister forces from the darkness!

games.name: Deadboot
games.summary: DEADBOOT is a fast-paced retro roguelike FPS. Blast through randomized levels, scavenge weapons and upgrades along the way, and see how far you can make it in this neon death zone.

games.name: Light Odyssey
games.summary: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

games.name: Glintseeker Island
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover exciting secrets, excavate countless treasures, and fight enemies and bosses. Save the island from a mysterious threat below!

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending puzzle game where you need to control time and space to journey through a shattered spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to move forward, whichever way that is.

games.name: A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe
games.summary: “A Week in the Life of Asocial Giraffe” is a point-and-click stealth game where the goal is to make sure nobody talks to you so that your head does not explode. You'll get to experience an average week of Giraffe's life as he does exciting things on his to-do list, such as going to the laundromat, peruses antique stores, purchasing groceries, and working out at the gym, all while making sure the incredibly sociable citizens of Friendly City never have a chance to speak with him for fear of losing your head.

games.name: Burn With Me
games.summary: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.name: Climb out of Hell
games.summary: Accompany a soul seeking its origins through an uncanny atmosphere. Uncover the lost memories of your past, meet bizarrely endearing characters, and rise from the three circles of hell, all part of a bittersweet enigmatic journey.

games.name: Dungeon Tourists
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons with up to 4 players. Take photos of the curiosities you come across. Throw stuff at them, unlock new floors, get rewards, and complete your collection!

games.name: Fugue Shot: Minigame Roguelike
games.summary:
Trapped in an ever-shifting dream, you must face a gauntlet of distorted arcade challenges, from frantic combat to puzzling trials. Conquer the Omens, break the cycle, and escape this place.

Each run in Fugue Shot presents a dreamscape filled with difficult encounters, puzzles, and challenges. Face the Omens and collect synergistic items to shift the dreamscape and your playstyle. Can you overcome the unstable terrain of this liminal world, or will you be consumed by it?

games.name: In Hope Voiden
games.summary: A forbidden warzone. Twelve soldiers. One life each. In this first person survival horror, death is permanent and the world remembers. Explore a surreal, trench-ridden hellscape where every action matters - and every death uncovers a new piece of a haunting mystery.

games.name: Killa
games.summary: Killa is a 3D adventure mystery with multiple endings. Valhalla, our protagonist, seeks the killer of her mentor, a mentor she treasures like family, venturing to an unknown island. Discover the culprit on this enigmatic island and embark on a journey of revenge.

games.name: Soundgrass
games.summary: You find yourself on a planet where plants emit sound. Sound and music are also your main gameplay mechanic. Experience the world of sound as never done before.

games.name: Grindset T.V.
games.summary: You have sinned, and Two-Day Delivery is the path to righteousness. Transport packages for the CEO of the Catholic Church, His Holiness the Cyberpope. Trick-based chaos meets corporate blasphemy in this unhinged speedrunning FPS. Your salvation isn’t free. But your suffering is priceless.

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: A Pocket Full of Slagford
games.summary: Slagford. Some call it The Backbone of the North, most call it proper sh*te. This silly misadventure will take you up monolithic megatowers, down dingy dung pits and beyond. Puzzle your way across the unravelling city by picking up pieces of the world and sticking them where they don't belong.

games.name: Venison County
games.summary: Grab your sawed-off, cast some sigils, and face the never ending nightmare head on in Venison County. Blast your old neighbors into undead venison giblets, master weapon specific active reloads, and limitlessly combine slain cultists' sigils for their sinful buffs (if you can withstand God's wrath).

games.name: Wanderburg
games.summary: Wanderburg is a minimalist open-world roguelike in an ecosystem of Castles on Wheels. Consume, grow bigger, upgrade your modules, and survive! Unlock new weapons, build your castle, and discover the procedurally generated map!

games.name: Orblins
games.summary: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

games.name: How to Fish
games.summary: You and your friends are out drinking and boating. You crash into a small island where you have to fish using everything from fishing rods to assault rifles. Sell your catch, earn money, buy better fishing gear, and defeat boss fishes to unlock new islands and finally make it back home.

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.summary: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

games.name: Stream Train
games.summary: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

games.name: K-Pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
games.summary: A love letter to the thrilling world of K-pop! In this life simulator, you're the manager responsible for scouting talent, organising schedules, creating budgets, planning social media, choosing music, and styling your idols. Your goal? To debut the next big K-pop idol group!

games.name: Shrimp Game: Overkrill
games.summary: Become a pilot of a SHRIMP - Submersible Hydrodynamic Research Integrated Marine Platform. Krill your friends, explore areas for loot and customize your SHRIMP!

games.name: Vision Quench
games.summary: An online co-op dark fantasy looter shooter set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

games.name: Altered Alma
games.summary: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cityscape, Neo-Barcelona awaits!

games.name: Dung Slinger
games.summary: An action-packed physics platformer about being chained to a giant dung ball! Master a complex movement system to move, swing and launch yourself forward. Defeat enemies, overcome obstacles and regain your freedom in a game that blends traditional platforming with a tight physics system!

games.name: Decklings
games.summary: Tame magical creatures called decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this survival deck-building card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft to build your base as you shape your path to become the deckling champion.

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

games.name: Drawchemy
games.summary: Your drawings come alive! Draw, build, and improvise your way home in this physics-based roguelike platformer. Escape a shifting realm of magic and alchemy, where creativity is your greatest tool.

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Ultrapool
games.summary: The pool bar is always open! Ultrapool is a colorful roguelike about playing pool with a bunch of wacky balls with crazy effects. Carefully craft a perfect build and get the craziest trickshots!

games.name: John Gleep
games.summary: John Gleep is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

events.name: IndieMania 3
events.description:
Last year, we digitized ourselves, breached the establishment’s firewall, and liberated the hidden gems the world needed to see. We thought that was the end of the mission—but we were wrong. 

This year, the stakes are higher, the cache is deeper, and the clock is ticking. Mike and Paul have embarked on a brand-new, high-stakes extraction mission to locate the most elusive, groundbreaking, and downright incredible indie games currently lost to the shadows of the industry. 

The question isn't just what games we’ll find—it’s can we reach them in time?

games.name: Koshmar: The Last Reverie
games.summary: When a city falls to a sleeping plague, nightmares rise up. Awaken the city as a mortician’s daughter who walks the line between the sleeping and the waking. Fight through the dreams, seal the rifts, make choices that chip away at who she is, try to become the nightmare that nightmares fear.

games.name: Sigma Star Saga DX
games.summary:
The classic shooter/RPG is back and better than ever! Featuring a unique mix of side-scrolling shoot-'em-up space battles and top-down planetary exploration, Sigma Star Saga DX is an explosive genre mashup that lets you take control of Allied Earth Federation pilot Ian Recker and infiltrate the alien Krill Empire as a double agent in a last-ditch effort to save mankind.

With loyalties divided between humans and Krill, you must investigate six planets using an ever-expanding set of tools and abilities, and jump into the cockpit to engage enemy forces in intense shmup-style combat using more than 70 different Gun Data items. Gorgeous pixel-art graphics, epic boss battles, and a twist-filled story with multiple endings await.

The new DX version adds numerous refinements over the original 2005 release, including an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, enhanced dialogue, additional save points, assorted bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, and more.

games.name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
games.summary: Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

games.name: Soul Ampz
games.summary: Summoned to another world, your choices will shape its fate. Build bonds with companions, unlock multiple endings, and turn monsters into power in this story-driven turn-based JRPG set in a handcrafted pixel fantasy world.

games.name: Underground Security Inc
games.summary: Defend your dungeon against "heroes" in this rogue-lite base defense game. Assign minions, build traps, and mine ores. All in the name of becoming the most profitable dungeon!

games.name: Hue Factory
games.summary:
Hue Factory is a minimalist automation game about color theory. It’s just you, some conveyor belts, and a stream of colorful boxes waiting to be sorted.

Find Your Flow. Start with simple inputs and route them to their destinations. As your factory grows, new colors appear, and your factory will need to evolve.

games.name: Sunset Hills
games.summary: The player takes on the role of Nico, who travels by train to each city to visit his former comrades, encountering a variety of people and events on the journey, and gradually learning about different life through solving assorted puzzles along the way. As they reunite, they recall their past experiences in the war, unravelling the war and Nico’s past, and gradually revealing the true purpose of Nico’s journey.

games.name: Foxy Dumplings
games.summary: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

games.name: Your Forever Friend
games.summary: Your Forever Friend is the solution to never feeling alone again! Play video games, listen to music together, reminisce about buried memories... And there's absolutely nothing wrong with it. NOTHING ! <3

games.name: Grandma Left Me A Building
games.summary: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

games.name: Cozy Marbles
games.summary: Cozy Marbles is a comfy game about building marble runs on a sunny afternoon. Using a huge range of bits and pieces, fit together the marble course you’ve always wanted to build and play with. Unwind to a lo-fi ASMR soundscape and roll with the nostalgia.

games.name: Scriptorium: Master of Manuscripts
games.summary: Run your manuscript workshop, receive orders to illustrate medieval books, decorate them any way you like, send them back to clients to get paid, and unlock new jobs, decorations, and items. Welcome to your very own medieval scriptorium!

games.name: Alien Morgue
games.summary: Sci-fi pathologist simulator. Identify aliens, detect damages, and perform autopsies to determine the cause of death. Choose to follow protocols or fulfill special requests when handling bodies and their stuff. Your choices may have global consequences.

games.name: Oniria
games.summary: Oniria is a first-person psychological horror game with a retro aesthetic. Explore the village by solving puzzles and evading the strange presence that haunts it. Experience Angy's present in 3D, and uncover her hidden memories in 2D.

games.name: Strategeist
games.summary: Strategeist is a grand strategy game in which you take on the mantle of a national spirit and guide a nation through time to build an empire and secure your place in history. Starting in the year 1206, at the beginning of the Mongol Invasions, you will pick one of over a thousand countries and attempt to forge a new destiny by making strategic decisions about diplomacy, technology, economy, internal politics, and war.

games.name: Tiny Terra Spaces
games.summary: Tiny Terra Spaces is a cosy, slow-paced builder where you can create your own charming medieval island. Choose whether to design an island from scratch, expand on an existing one, or take on gentle challenges in hop mode to unlock new places. With cosy 3D buildings and a theme inspired by the beauty and history of Scotland, you can build at your own pace and enjoy the process of bringing your world to life.

games.name: Kitty Haven
games.summary: A cute and cozy logic puzzle game about cats.

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: Deep Pixel Melancholy is a visual novel about being stuck in a time loop inside a gray, soulless city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Tulip Season
games.summary: Tulip Season is an incremental farming sim built from small, satisfying routines. Beauty has a number, and you make it go up. Unlock new tulips and field upgrades, breed new colours, and help out when the neighbours come by.

games.name: Mazey Village
games.summary: Mazey Village is a cozy adventure exploration game about rebuilding a village after a disaster. Explore maze-like worlds, find lost items, restore villagers’ homes, decorate your village, and bring hope back to a community torn apart by a tornado.

games.name: Lorne
games.summary: In a wartorn world you are key to restore peace and order to the lands of Lorne. Equip Evelyn with the right tools you can find, craft or upgrade in this ARPG featuring interactive combat, open world exploration and intimidating temples filled with puzzles. End the corruption and keep Lorne safe.

games.name: Sak'd
games.summary: Sak'd is an action-adventure platform game wherein players assume the role of Sak, a not-so-ordinary pillow accidentally brought to life, imbued with powerful weapon wielding, spell-casting, monster-smashing abilities and sent on a quest to destroy evil.

games.name: Ungaland!
games.summary: "Dive into a prehistoric world of adventure where the power of primal seeds changes everything. Unlock abilities, attach them to your weapons, and face challenges in a vibrant land full of action, and surprises."

games.name: Lumen the Red Panda
games.summary: Guide Lumen the Red Panda on a fun 3D platforming adventure. Jump across tricky platforms, solve puzzles, outsmart playful enemies, and collect apples and rare Golden Apples across wonderful biomes.

games.name: Erenshor
games.summary: Erenshor is a single player nod to the MMORPGs of the past. Created specifically for the nostalgic gamer who no longer wants to commit to online or scheduled play times, it offers unrestricted exploration, strategic battles, and countless weapons, armors, and spells to discover.

games.name: Stabjack
games.summary: A combination of Roguelike Deckbuilder and comic noir tragedy. Stabjack plunges you into a dark, gritty, demon-infested world, with gameplay that builds on the familiar concepts of Blackjack. Can a talking knife help you solve your wife’s murder, or is this just the beginning of your descent into madness?

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Revenge of the Firstborn
games.summary: A story-rich, party-based tactical turn-based RPG built on the classic 3.5 SRD ruleset. You lead a band of heroes to uncover the origin of the immortal “Firstborn”. Their power could either redeem the world or unleash its destruction.

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: Step into the paws of a brave, four-legged special agent! In BARKOUR, you work for a secret organization where all agents are exceptionally skilled animals brought together by one goal: to save the world from the forces of evil (and mischievous cats)!

games.name: Mojito Woody's Rescue
games.summary: MOJITO Woody's Rescue puts you on a journey to find your best dog friend Woody, who has been kidnapped by an evil Cucumber, in a cute 3d adventure with sandbox levels, platforming challenges and exploration zones. Inspired by Super Mario 64 - Odyssey / Banjo Kazooie / Celeste

games.name: Band of Crusaders
games.summary: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

games.name: Toxic Crusaders
games.summary: The Toxic Crusaders return for an all-new, all-action beat 'em up for one to four players! Grab your mop, tutu and attitude, and get ready to clean up the mean streets of Tromaville, one radioactive goon at a time!

games.name: Dagada's Story
games.summary:
Dive into the depths of a snowy world in this adventure game. Explore a mountain where a tribe of strange creatures, the Daoudaounes, lives among ancient ruins, while seeking answers to the mysteries that surround you.

Dagada's Story is a Puzzle-platformer game inspired by Super Nintendo-era games. This adventure emphasizes the balance between exploration, platforming, and puzzle-solving, with responsive controls and beautiful storytelling.

Particular attention has been given to the creation of the universe and each of its graphical, sound, and game design elements. The animation aims to be smooth and lively, reminiscent of pixel art from such game as Yoshi's island or the Super Mario bros series ...

games.name: Hungry Horrors
games.summary: Face legendary creatures from British and Irish folklore in this roguelite deck builder where cooking replaces combat. As a princess, you must prepare dishes to feed these monsters or risk becoming their next meal.

games.name: Hyperslice
games.summary: Fast paced action arena roguelike where you defeat waves of enemies using your dash. Slice through enemies or push them to survive. Upgrade and buy abilities throughout your run to turn your ship into a killing machine.

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this vast procedurally generated survival adventure for up to 4 players. What you do is up to you, but the deeper you delve, the more you uncover the hidden truth. Could you be the hero to restore stability to the land and put an end to the invading "Faults"?

games.name: Shroomwood
games.summary: Top-down bullet hell with challenging roguelike progression. Unlock and upgrade your town as you fight through procedural levels.

games.name: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
games.summary: A run-and-gun metroidvania set in Voivod’s dystopian universe. Battle biomechanical mutants, explore a twisted post-apocalyptic world, and recover fragments of your lost mind. Featuring pixel-art visuals, tight action-platforming, and Voivod soundtrack.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary:
Last Floor is a first-person psychological horror game focused on observation and anomaly detection. The player navigates a looping hospital corridor and must identify subtle changes in the environment.

Each run begins in an elevator and progresses through an identical hallway. The player must determine whether an anomaly is present during the loop and choose the correct elevator direction to continue. Incorrect decisions reset progression.

games.name: Lag Kills
games.summary: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

games.name: The Transference
games.summary: Escape from your own house, in which you have been locked up. But be careful, you will not be alone in your captivity. Immerse yourself in this first-person horror adventure, full of family secrets and betrayals. And find out who and why they locked you up.

games.name: Void Martyrs
games.summary: A grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Scavenge amongst drifting space cathedrals, balance your faith with survival, and craft the tools of your salvation.

games.name: Pink Noise
games.summary: "Pink Noise" is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, immersing you in the retro atmosphere of the '90s. It tells the tale of a group of teenagers who unknowingly set off a chain of terrifying events. What secrets lie within the mysterious VHS tape they should’ve never played?

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Dolos: Your Best Future
games.summary: A sci-fi political thriller. Live the life of an operator of DOLOS, a social regulation system predicting everyone's future. Analyze applicants' profiles and decide about their lifetime career. Apply DOLOS' logic or find how to counter it ... but don't get fired!

games.name: Nippon Marathon 2: Daijoubu
games.summary: Dash, dodge, and dive through the ultimate Japanese gameshow experience! Up to 4 contestants race through chaotic obstacle courses across Japan, filled with hilarious hazards and obscure obstacles. It’s so crazy, you’ll be shouting ‘Konnichi-what?!’ instead of ‘Konnichiwa!’

games.name: Button Man
games.summary: Button Man is a side-scrolling adventure game set in a fictional Nova Scotia during prohibition. After years of being the henchmen to the local bootlegging kingpin your job now is to find who killed him and protect the town from what’s coming to it. Explore Kingsport and learn the truth!

games.name: The Last General
games.summary: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

games.name: Kamikaze Strike: FPV Drone
games.summary: Fly a kamikaze drone through fast-paced FPV missions. Dodge bullets, sneak past jammers and radars, and crash into tanks, troops, and enemy bases. Discover diffferent drones and face tougher challenges in every level.

games.name: Flawed Tactics
games.summary: Build an unstoppable team of adorable characters ready to destroy all enemies!

games.name: Lost Legions
games.summary: Lost in the Teutoburg Forest after a historical catastrophic defeat, survive as a Roman soldier in a world filled with danger. Craft, build, explore and fight in this story-rich open-world adventure. Unearth secrets of a forgotten time, alone or with up to 3 friends, in a land where history lingers.

games.name: Hell On Earth
games.summary: Hell on Earth is a fast paced action rogue-lite game, playable solo or in co-op with a friend. Battle hordes of enemies, collect gold, gems, gear, and enhance your hero to defeat powerful bosses. Choose your class, customize your hero’s skills, select your appearance, and save the world from Hell.

games.name: Into the Grid
games.summary: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

games.name: Lion the Last Homeland
games.summary: A mother at the end of the world must rescue and command 20 powerful orphaned children to protect their last sanctuary in this Action Real-Time Tactical Metroidvania. Craft strategic attack plans for rapid commands, explore a decaying land, and defend your homeland from a relentless demonic invasion

games.name: Whirlight: No Time To Trip
games.summary: In the heart of Verice Bay, a brilliant idea takes shape in the hands of an eccentric inventor and an eclectic artist. Follow Margaret and Hector in a point-and-click graphic adventure that will take you to the edge of space and time to help them avert imminent danger.

games.name: Voxel Breakers
games.summary: Voxel Breakers - a relaxing incremental game where you break voxels, buy and upgrade breaker robots, then watch them break voxels for you faster and faster.

games.name: Nuko
games.summary: NUKO is a fast paced bluffing game set during the apocalypse! The world is ending! Are you prepared? Use your bluffing skills to earn credits, rescue rare wildlife and save priceless collectables. An abundance of Credits helps you build out, customize and manage your bunkers. Survive the end in style, and have fun doing it!

games.name: The Golden Caravan
games.summary: Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate. Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

games.name: Beatrix
games.summary: Beatrix is a dark roguelike board-builder. Shape the battlefield: deploy Canones ("Canons") to orchestrate your strategy and use tactical positioning to surround and flip your enemies. Judge the damned and restore order to Hell.

games.name: Towers Saga
games.summary: Guide humanity by building grand towers in this 3D Match-3 falling blocks puzzle game. Recall the greatest tale of them all and witness the wonders of the ancient world in Babylon, Egypt, Atlantis, and much more!

games.name: Strikers Club
games.summary: Strikers Club is a multiplayer football game where you take control of a player and compete in action-packed matches against others. Every move counts. Master dribbling, passing, and shooting while working with your team to outplay opponents.

games.name: Feather Land
games.summary: Feather Land is an idle game that blends productivity tools with a study/work companion. Enjoy calming music, hatch eggs, collect cute birds, and watch a quiet space into a landscape full of life, bringing peace and focus to your study or work sessions.

games.name: Galactic Vault
games.summary: Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

games.name: Stip
games.summary: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets. Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: Time To Wake Up is an atmospheric psychological thriller where one night you find yourself stuck in a dream. No worries, though. You are not alone. You hear a voice, in need of your eyes and willing to help you out.

games.name: Royalty Free-For-All
games.summary: Royalty Free-For-All is a hand-drawn cartoon Party Brawler featuring an original cast of characters inspired by the public domain! Join Dorothy, Sweeney Todd, Mother Goose, and more as they duke it out in hand-drawn platform fighting mayhem!

games.name: Helix: Descent N Ascent
games.summary: Helix is an adventure game taking place in a melancholic disembodied world. Combine your powers to solve puzzles and explore further and deeper.

games.name: Ruin: Beast City
games.summary: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

games.name: Swan Song
games.summary: Swan Song is a cozy and emotional puzzle game where music guides your journey. Use notes of different shapes and sizes to program a music box and solve each puzzle. Help the swan reach the exit as you uncover a touching story of family, loss and grief.

games.name: Grilluminati
games.summary: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

games.name: Project P.I.T.T.
games.summary: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

games.name: Midnight Moments
games.summary: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

games.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life
games.summary: Share your days with an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Feed, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day. Teach tricks, discover new walks locations, and keep your furry friend happy and healthy.

games.name: Dead as Disco
games.summary: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: Box Knight
games.summary: A funny, silly and irreverent action RPG roguelike. A mix of ‘the Office’ and ‘Lord of the Rings’ with a comic like aesthetic.

games.name: Edenfall: Legacy of the First Wardens
games.summary: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

games.name: Noble
games.summary:
Manage the family tree of a Noble House!
Grow your family tree with generations of diverse nobles. Decide their path and write history. Send your lords and ladies to feasts, wars, and tourneys. Become friends or foes with the other noble houses. Create your dynasty!

games.name: Exovia
games.summary: Free your mind as you mine an asteroid in zero gravity, creating floaters that drift through the oddly satisfying physics-driven supply chains you design to pave humanity's road to the stars.

games.name: DeeSicks
games.summary: Crawl out of your hole: destiny beckons. Out-spam the spammers and out-summon the swarms as you scale beyond the limits of space and time. Begin as an insect in bullet-slop misery and use the power of physics-based dice rolls to ascend as your very own bullet hell boss.

games.name: Please, Watch the Artwork
games.summary: Night surveillance at the museum but the paintings are alive. A lonely clown roams the canvases. Watch, listen and report any changes. Paranoia-inducing. Weird. Melancholic. Relaxing? No jump scares or monsters, but the game can feel oppressive at times.

games.name: RuneSmith
games.summary: Grab your beer and join Durgrim into his quest to get his money back from a summoner that is trying to end all creation. Runesmith is a humorous RPG where a grudge-holding dwarf runesmith engraves powerful runes, talks to other dwarves and kills everything else!

games.name: Dunebound Tactics
games.summary: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

events.name: For One Night Only 2026
events.description: British games. A global stage. For One Night Only is a new major showcase featuring trailers, exclusive reveals and interviews with some of the UK’s biggest and best games industry talent.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Fool King
games.summary: Fool King is a tactical autobattler where you build a powerful army on your road to challenging the immortal Fool King. Upgrade your units, bolster their stats and strategically place them on the battlefield to get the better of your opponents.

games.name: Besiege: The Broken Beyond
games.summary: Launch into the Broken Beyond expansion and conquer your way through a new space themed campaign, traveling between planets using a suite of exciting new blocks. Obliterate alien spacecraft, annihilate their armies and destroy their worlds..

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: What do you get when you combine gardening and extreme sports? A head-to-head ‘horticultural combat’ game for 1-4 players, where gardens are arenas and players battle for resources to Sow, Grow and Throw as much produce as they can at goals (and each other!!).

games.name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
games.summary: On RuneScape’s forgotten continent of Ashenfall, dragons have awoken. Gather, build, skill and craft to survive in this co-operative (1-4) survival crafting game. Only by mastering survival and uncovering ancient secrets can they hope to slay the Dragon Queen—alone or with allies.

games.name: Nine Rounds Rapid
games.summary: A fast paced, super stylized, roguelike, twin stick shooter. Nine levels of designed, hand painted and procedurally generated, punchy and punky fast mayhem in a uniquely stunning attitude filled world.

games.name: PowerWash Simulator 2: Star Wars Pack
games.summary: Step into the Star Wars galaxy as P0-W2, a humble Class Five cleaning droid, turned filth-fighting rebel! Wield the jet-force of high-pressure water to blast away imperial scum from six iconic original trilogy locations and ships in this epic dirt-busting saga.

games.name: Two Point Museum
games.summary: Curate and manage incredible museums! Explore to discover amazing artifacts. Design and refine the layout, keep staff happy, guests entertained, donations plentiful… and children off the exhibits.

games.name: Two Point Museum: Update 5.0
games.summary:
A new Digiverse expedition map is available to explore once players reach the start of Memento Mile’s second star

This new map gives Digiverse experts the ability to transcend their normal digital confines and explore the universes of other games

The Digiverse map will grow over time as new rifts are discovered, providing new exhibits, decoration and gameplay

games.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
games.summary: Tee off in Golf With Your Friends 2! Dive into 12-player chaos, wild new course mechanics, a revamped level editor, and nonstop fun—play together no matter how and where your friends play!

games.name: PlateUp!
games.summary: Hectic single-player and co-op restaurant management: cook and serve your dishes, upgrade and customise your restaurants, and expand your culinary kingdom with each procedurally-generated location. Work together to cook food, deal with customers, and serve drinks - or do it all yourself!

games.name: Hyper Sentinel Fusion
games.summary: An intense shoot-em-up + roguelite fusion. Pilot your fighter to destroy the defences of procedurally-generated space titans, then land, infiltrate and plunder the depths with your droid. Spend your bounty on epic upgrades & explore the moon base hub to interact with characters & unlock secrets.

games.name: Open Drive
games.summary: Explore freely, collect the orbs, or try to beat your high score by making and landing jumps off ramps, mounds, and mountain tops in our 3 vehicles, Roadster, Trickster and Speedste

games.name: Little Nightmares III
games.summary:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

games.name: The Lost Wild
games.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

games.name: Limerence
games.summary: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

games.name: Directive 8020
games.summary: Earth is dying and humanity is running out of time. 12 light years from home, Tau Ceti f offers a small sliver of hope. When the colony ship Cassiopeia crash lands on the planet, its crew soon realize they are far from being alone. In space, death takes many forms.

games.name: Rogue Eclipse
games.summary: A spacefighter for the new age. Master your piloting prowess in an epic sci-fi setting, take down swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in a roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

games.name: Sker Ritual
games.summary: The co-op survival FPS and spiritual successor to the award-winning occult horror, Maid of Sker. Play solo or up to 4 players to survive the supernatural onslaught of the Quiet Ones.

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary:
Silent Hill: Townfall is a full-length, self-contained psychological horror set against the cold, isolated backdrop of Scotland, 1996.

Players can explore St. Amelia, where fog-soaked streets, abandoned communities, and forgotten corners tell their story through atmosphere and history. Reality and delusion subtly intertwine to lure players into the depths of St. Amelia's grounded, tangible world.

events.name: Six One Indie Demo Days 2026
events.description:
Welcome to our first ever demo focused event called Demo Days! 

Demo Days is more than just a video showcase for indie games, but rather giving players the chance to hop into and play for themselves. This video showcase is just the tip of the iceberg of what is waiting for players in our Steam Event that is live now until August 7th, 2026! 

Head to bit.ly/DemoDays2026 for over 150 indies with playable demos. So go discover your next favorite indie and wishlist your favorites!

games.name: Curse of Resthaven
games.summary: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

games.name: Zhen: Shattered Legacy
games.summary: Zhen: Shattered Legacy is a Twin-Stick, Action-Adventure where you play as a Robot Warrior Monk sent to investigate a decrepit realm in order to restore the righteous way of Kung Fu.

games.name: Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch
games.summary: Prepare to descend into the Labyrinth. Bloodbreaker: Labyrinth of the Witch combines the best elements of the roguelite and Metroidvania genres into an unforgiving, yet rewarding experience.

games.name: Gloom Punks
games.summary: Not your average co-op roguelike. Where the price for power is death, and you’re trapped in a gloom-scape of fever dreams and fairytales gone feral, you can only rely on Punks like yourself. Cheat death, bounce back, and take on a world that so badly wants you dead!

games.name: Golf 5 Max
games.summary: Golf 5 MAX is a retro golf arcade with vibrant 80s style, fast-paced matches, and simple controls. Play Arcade, Versus, or Challenge modes, choose from six golfers ️, and aim to become world champion across stylish and colorful courses.
