games.name: Hotel Architect
games.summary:
Step into the chaotic 24/7 lifestyle of a hotel owner as you design and build grand hotels across the globe. Juggle the increasingly elaborate demands of disorderly guests, logistical nightmares and unexpected obstacles in Hotel Architect, the ultimate hotel construction and tycoon management game.

Advance in a career campaign mode, with a variety of objectives to complete, in order to unlock the sandbox mode across each location.

Create your own hotel from scratch or transform a dilapidated plot into a thriving business. Design the layout and hire construction workers to lay the foundations and build different facilities across multiple floors. Building requires careful planning, as it plays out in real-time, so be careful annoy, disturb or remove items your guests are using – or else they might leave a bad review!

games.name: BrokenLore: Don't Lie
games.summary: BrokenLore: DON'T LIE is psychological horror spin-off of DON’T WATCH, where lies, medication and fragile bonds blur the line between reality and nightmare.

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Dungeon Lurker
games.summary: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

events.name: Short Games Showcase 2026
events.description:
Short Games Showcase 2026 is an event dedicated to celebrating short video games on Steam.

This showcase highlights games that offer a complete and fulfilling experience lasting under 5 hours of gameplay, making them perfect for players who enjoy concise and impactful narratives.

games.name: Beastfolk Barber
games.summary: In Beastfolk Barber (code name: Project Salon), you're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

games.name: Frog Island
games.summary: Frog Island is a fully hand-drawn, cozy Frog Collection and Life-Sim game. Start your new life as a caretaker for an island of frogs in this cozy creature-collector! Build your dream island, discover magical wildlife, and uncover the island's many hidden secrets, to try and piece together the past life you've somehow forgotten.

games.name: Shelldiver
games.summary: Take a deep breath and dive right into this cozy incremental game about a senior turtle trying to start a business selling jellyfish. Upgrade your equipment, explore biomes, and help your turtly village!

games.name: Duck Detective: The Secret Salami
games.summary: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open, in a narrative mystery adventure where nothing is quite as it seems.

games.name: A Tiny Sticker Tale
games.summary: A Tiny Sticker Tale is a cozy miniature adventure about changing the world, using the power of stickers!

games.name: Coffee Talk
games.summary: Coffee Talk is a coffee brewing and heart-to-heart talking simulator about listening to fantasy-inspired modern peoples’ problems, and helping them by serving up a warm drink or two.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: Calico
games.summary: Calico is a low stress day-in-the-life community-sim where you move to a town of magical girls and are given a harrowing yet adorable task: make the town's cat café active and full of cuddly creatures again! You will journey to a small village of Magical Girls and other fantastical friends to fix up the cat cafe, as well as fill it with furniture, decorations, yummy pastries and most importantly cats!

games.name: Little Picnic
games.summary: Little Picnic is a relaxing open-world adventure set on a peaceful rural island in South Korea’s southern sea. Spend your summer vacation at your grandmother’s home, explore the island freely, meet its residents, and relive the quiet magic of childhood summers.

games.name: Loddlenaut
games.summary:
Loddlenaut is an ocean cleanup adventure set on a vibrant alien planet. Play as an interstellar custodian sent to clean up a polluted ocean planet. Repurpose marine debris and take care of axolotl-like alien creatures!

As you clean up the planet, you’ll run into axolotl-like aliens known as “loddles.” Protect them from the polluted waters and feed them aquatic fruits while you make their planet habitable again. Depending on their diet, loddles will grow in different ways and develop unique traits and abilities that will further enable them to survive on this polluted planet.

games.name: A Little to the Left
games.summary: A Little To The Left is a cozy puzzle game that has you sort, stack, and organize household items into pleasing arrangements while you keep an eye out for a mischievous cat with an inclination for chaos. Check out this playful and intuitive puzzler with 75+ satisfying messes to tidy.

games.name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
games.summary: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game focused on restoring dirty items to their pristine state. Use a variety of tools to return objects to their original appearance. As you clean each item belonging to the protagonist, reflect on the significance and stories behind them.

games.name: When the Past Was Around
games.summary: When the Past was Around is an adventure point-and-click puzzle game about love, moving on, letting go, and the joy and pain of everything in between.

games.name: Birth
games.summary: Birth is a pleasantly creepy point-and-click puzzle game about living alone in a large city and constructing a creature to keep you company out of spare bones and organs you find lying around. Explore libraries, post offices, museums, cafes, and apartments that don't belong to you, solving observational puzzles hidden in personal belongings and scenery.

games.name: Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp
games.summary: "Monster Prom 2: Monster Camp" brings you more of the world's best (and maybe only?) multiplayer dating sim; but in a way you've never expected!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.summary: Discover the stories of kids growing up in the midst of armed conflicts over the last three decades. Inspired by real testimonies, this narrative adventure follows the lives of children from Bosnia, Syria, and Ukraine.

games.name: Tyto
games.summary: Take flight and glide through a breathtaking world in this visually stunning platformer, where you play as a lost owlet searching for its family in a vast and perilous forest.

games.name: Dead Watch
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next killing

games.name: The Dark Queen of Mortholme
games.summary:
You are the Dark Queen—the most powerful being of your entire universe. Your lair is breached by an aspiring hero—a pitiful thing, easily crushed.

Except they keep coming back.

A 20 minute anti-game about an unconventional relationship and the capacity for change.

games.name: A House Inside Me
games.summary: A psychological horror experience told through environmental storytelling. Explore a house inhabited by trauma, denial, and fractured memories. Three endings. Multiple interpretations. This is the house that lives inside me.

games.name: Slay the Princess: The Pristine Cut
games.summary:
Slay the Princess is a choice-driven psychological horror visual novel with dramatic branching, light RPG elements, and hand-penciled art.

The Pristine Cut is the definitive version of the game. It features expanded content including 3 new chapters, never-before-seen Princesses, expansions to familiar routes, a new ending, over 1,200 new hand-penciled frames, over 2,500 new lines of dialogue, and over 35% more content overall.

games.name: Pirofauna
games.summary: Burn, little Flame, burn... Light up the misty forest, dispel the darkness... Let tiny bugs emerge from the nooks and crannies, gazing at your spark.

games.name: Lost Ember
games.summary: Explore the remains of a fallen world from fascinating perspectives! Slip into the role of different animals to uncover the fate of an ancient world. Dive into deep waters, fly at lofty heights, dig underground as a mole or even climb steep cliffs with a mountain goat, there are lots of ways of getting around.

events.name: THQ Nordic Digital Showcase 2026
events.description:
Guess who’s back! Our THQ Nordic Digital Showcase returns August 7, 2026. 🔥

Expect the showcase to shine a spotlight on titles such as Titan Quest II, Wreckfest 2, The Guild - Europa 1410, Fatekeeper, Expeditions: Samurai, The Eternal Life of Goldman and Way of the Hunter 2, with more to come as we count down to showtime.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Pinball FX Midnight
games.summary: Get ready to tilt into terror. The new horror-inspired pinball platform for fearless players. Prove your skills on the most sinister, gory, and badass tables ever brought to life.

games.name: Pinball FX VR
games.summary:
Bring pinball to life with the ultimate ‘80s arcade atmosphere - now fully immersive in virtual reality. Dive into a fully customizable and interactive setting with the integrated Mixed Reality mode and transform your living room into a personal arcade paradise with cabinets and unlockable decorations.

This includes the same tables as Pinball FX's "Secrets and Shadows" bundle: Curse of the Mummy, Pinball Noir, and Sky Pirates. Many more are available as DLC.

games.name: Pinball FX
games.summary: Discover brand new exclusive tables created for Pinball FX, or find your favorites among more than 40 unique and visually enhanced favorites from Zen's extensive digital pinball library. Relive the most iconic moments from entertainment powerhouses like Indiana Jones, Star Wars, Marvel, Universal Studios, and many more. Enjoy accurate re-creations of the most famous pinball machines of all time with Williams Pinball, or have fun with Zen’s original creations.

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Gothic II: Complete Classic
games.summary:
Continue the story of the Nameless Hero in Gothic II: Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that improved on its predecessor in every way. Experience it now for the first time on Nintendo Switch.

Gothic II: Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the add-on Night of the Raven to your fingertips for the first time on a console.

games.name: Gothic 1 Remake
games.summary: Gothic 1 Remake is an action role-playing game set in a third-person perspective within a fantasy open world. It is a remake of the 2001 game Gothic, developed by Alkimia Interactive using Unreal Engine 5. The player controls a nameless prisoner sent into the Valley of Mines, a penal colony surrounded by a magical barrier. The game features NPC routines, faction-based quest paths, and a progression system where the player starts with no skills and must learn them from trainers. Navigation is done without a minimap, and the game world is 10 to 30 percent larger than the original, with expanded chapters and additional quest content. Combat and skill systems are based on the original game's design.

games.name: Destroy All Humans!
games.summary:
A remake of Destroy All Humans!, an action-adventure video game that stands as the inaugural entry in the Destroy All Humans! franchise. It unfolds in 1959 in the United States. The game satirises the lifestyles, pop culture, and political attitudes of that era. Players take on the role of Cryptosporidium 137, a member of the fictional alien race known as "Furons." Functioning as a Furon spy hitman, Cryptosporidium 137 invades Earth with the mission of harvesting human DNA to sustain the cloning process for his species.

The remake features new missions, control schemes, upgrades, skins, abilities, and graphical enhancements.

games.name: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed
games.summary:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!

games.name: Sacred 2 Remaster
games.summary:
Step into the world of Ancaria as one of six heroes. Explore a massive open world and master combat arts and spells for epic loot. This remaster brings a fan-favorite back to life — with hi-res textures, better combat and bugfixes, for longtime fans and newcomers alike.

Includes all expansions and updates in one definitive edition.

games.name: The Eternal Life of Goldman
games.summary: The Eternal Life of Goldman is a vibrant yet dark platformer adventure that weaves together legends, fairy tales and myths. Explore a vast hand-drawn Archipelago, inspired by ancient fables and depicted in classic frame-by-frame animation, and defeat a mysterious Deity!

games.name: Titan Quest II
games.summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

games.name: Expeditions: Samurai
games.summary: The sun rises on another civil war, as you land in Japan aboard a battered Dutch ship. Thrust into command of its motley crew, you must navigate the politics of Sengoku-era Japan using stealth, diplomacy, or violence in this party-based RPG where every choice matters.

games.name: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite
games.summary: Lead a platoon of WWII tanks in this immersive TPP and FPP game. Engage in realistic, tactical combat across historic battlefields. Play through campaign or challenge yourself in skirmish mode as either German or US forces.

games.name: The Guild: Europa 1410
games.summary: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

games.name: Way of the Hunter 2
games.summary: Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the North American wilderness and the African Savanna. Hunt and display big game like Moose, and Cape Buffalo as well as, smaller animals and birds.

games.name: Wreckfest 2
games.summary: Ready for mayhem? Wreckfest is back, offering the best in full-contact racing with unrivaled destruction! Witness head-to-head battles as you tear apart rival vehicles bit by bit. Powered by the enhanced physics engine, developed by the creators of Wreckfest & FlatOut!

games.name: Gothic Classic
games.summary:
For the first time, relive this amazing RPG on a handheld console and enjoy the game that revolutionized roleplaying games on the go. Dive into dark times and adventures with great performance and a well adapted UI and controls.

War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore. You are thrown through the barrier into this prison colony. With your back against the wall, you have to survive and form volatile alliances until you can finally escape.

games.name: A Rat's Quest: The Way Back Home - Season 2
games.summary: Stranded far from home, Mat, the determined young rat, must brave the dangerous "Outside" to make his way back to his friends and Nat. Armed with only a rivet, he must face new foes and forge alliances in order to complete his epic quest and be reunited with his beloved.

games.name: Reanimal: The Prisoner
games.summary: Join The Soldier and The Prisoner on a journey through the war-ravaged streets of this once-familiar place, as they stumble blindly down a rabbit hole that will change their lives forever.

events.name: Kinetic Publishing Showcase - August 2026
events.description: Join us for the first ever Kinetic Publishing Showcase, which highlights the incredible teams building our diverse and innovative debut line-up of games.

games.name: Contact Protocol
games.summary:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Shellbound
games.summary: Shellbound is a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania where life can only exist on a gigantic snail. Explore a vibrant world, fight bizarre flora and fauna and discover civilizations fueled by the powerful snail mucus. It is the key to your natural role: Devour everything so life itself continues to exist.

games.name: Aether: Wizard Life
games.summary: Aether Wizard Life is a magical and adventurous wizard Farm Sim game packed with exciting Action Adventures.

games.name: Precognition
games.summary: PRECOGNITION follows in the footsteps of Sam Barlow’s previous game, IMMORTALITY, combining cinematic live-action sequences with non-linear storytelling and a focus on player freedom and agency. Players take on the role of Diana, a woman who discovers she can receive visions of the future after an experimental implant is embedded into her brain.

events.name: VR Games Showcase August 2026
events.description: Catch up with the latest VR Games Showcase including the announcements of System Shock VR, High on Life VR, Total Chaos VR and more!

games.name: Vertigo Rush
games.summary: Vertigo Rush is a high-speed VR racing game where your hands are your engine. Climb, swing and fly through visually stunning tracks. Race against AI, compete in global Time Trial leaderboards, or challenge up to 10 friends online with polished, precision hand-based movement.

games.name: Omega Pilot Evolution
games.summary:
Omega Pilot Evolution is a high-speed futuristic racing experience that pushes the limits of anti-gravity flight. Race in immersive VR or play on a regular screen in both first-person and third-person perspectives.

Take control of cutting-edge anti-gravity ships and master precision piloting across dynamic tracks built for extreme speed, tight control, and skill-based maneuvering.

games.name: BattleGroupVR2
games.summary: BattleGroupVR2 is a virtual reality real-time space strategy where you explore the galaxy and lead a fleet of powerful warships from the bridge of your flagship. Explore, mine, trade, hunt. Grow your fleet, upgrade your ships, train your captains, and battle the enemy from the captain's chair.

games.name: Stuffed
games.summary: Stuffed is a procedurally generated first-person shooter, that takes place in the dreams of a little girl. Play as a teddy bear and fight waves of nightmares as you defend your owner. Play solo or join your friends in up to 4 player online co-op.

games.name: Grablings: Paint 'n Seek
games.summary: Players become Grablings, interdimensional creatures who live for mischief and chaos. Their prime purpose in life is to have fun and wreak havoc across the multiverse, which they consider their ultimate playground.

games.name: Total Chaos
games.summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

games.name: Bootstrap Island
games.summary: Stranded in the 17th century after a brutal shipwreck, you awaken alone on a deadly tropical island. To survive, you’ll need to learn fast - facing wild beasts, nature’s wrath, and uncovering secrets hidden deep in the jungle. Every step is a fight for your life.

games.name: Gunman Contracts: Stand Alone
games.summary: "Gunman Contracts - Stand Alone" is an action-movie inspired shooter playable both in VR and in Non-VR (First Person). As a professional hitman, the player takes on ruthless forces in the criminal underworld, bringing justice and order in the world beyond the reach of law - one contract at a time.

games.name: Tiny Flock
games.summary: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

games.name: Out of Sight VR
games.summary: Out of Sight VR pulls you into a chilling nightmare where you see through the eyes of a child’s only comfort—her teddy bear. Guide Sophie through a sinister mansion and evade the lurking horrors that stalk her every move. The shadows are watching. And Sophie is depending on you.

games.name: Drifters: Blackout Crew
games.summary: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

games.name: Spirit Ritual
games.summary: Spirit Ritual is a supernatural horror VR/MR game. Become a psychic medium and break the demonic curse threatening the life of Shu-Mei Lin. Equip your camera, enter the spirit realm and capture ghosts to reveal the truth. Fail, and the demon will consume your soul.

games.name: All On Board!
games.summary: All On Board! is a platform to play board games in VR with friends.

games.name: R.A.I.D
games.summary: A co-op VR sci-fi shooter where you inspect interstellar cargo ships, hunt smugglers, and raid hostile spacecraft. Scan trucks, board enemy ships, upgrade outrageous weapons, and choose between protocol or profit in solo or 4-player co-op action.

games.name: Covr
games.summary: COVR is a tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, high-stakes solo and co-operative gameplay, unforgiving realism, and intense close-quarters combat.

games.name: Zero Caliber 2
games.summary: Get ready to experience the thrill of your life in Zero Caliber 2, the sequel to the critically acclaimed Zero Caliber VR! Cinematic action, explosions, tons of weapons to unlock, a full-blown single player/Co-op campaign, PvP, airstrikes and a VR experience you'll never forget! Coming in 2024.

games.name: Green Hell VR
games.summary: Green Hell VR is the most complex and authentic survival game for VR. The game faithfully recreates the dangerous conditions of the Amazon jungle. Alone and stranded, you will never feel safe. To survive, you have to face your weaknesses. Maintaining hunger, thirst, fatigue and mental health is going to be an integral part of your journey. Wild animal attacks and tropical diseases could strike you down at any time and out of nowhere if you are not prepared. Since you won’t get any help from the outside world, you need to craft your tools and weapons, learn how to build shelters, and heal nasty wounds.

games.name: The Lightkeepers
games.summary: Grab your weapons and face an unequal battle against the nightmares of the deep! The Lightkeepers is a cooperative action game where you’ll fight for your life until every dawn!

games.name: Adrian's Quest
games.summary: Adrian's Quest is a single-player VR action-adventure game filled with physics-based puzzles and bizarre gunfights, set on a dusty, run-down alien planet home to strange creatures and a declining population.

games.name: Convrgence
games.summary: Convrgence is an immersive single-player VR shooter with survival and horror elements. Explore the Chernokamensk exclusion zone: scavenge for loot, fight bandits and hunt for mystical artifacts. However be sure to return to base before duskfall, for when night arrives the hunter becomes the hunted.

games.name: The Rifted Skies
games.summary: The Rifted Skies is an active VR roguelite set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Parkour and fight to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover - can your home ever be saved?

games.name: Knights of Fiona
games.summary: Fierce dragons have emerged in the land of Gallia. Join Fiona and her sworn knights to protect the kingdom! Embark on quests solo or with friends as you fight against the darkness.

games.name: Rustmourne
games.summary: Rustmourne is a Survival Sci-fi Horror with detailed, VR-designed interactions. Traverse the corridors of an ancient, derelict structure, and face the tortured beings in it: hide, run, or cut off their limbs to survive. Will you be able to understand the purpose of your awakening and get out alive?

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Drop Dead: The Cabin
games.summary:
The Cabin is an intense and challenging game. Are you among the few that will survive? Gather supplies, arm up, and fight off waves of the walking dead that have escaped from an evil lab experiment. We expect you to die - a lot, each time you fall, you will earn XP to upgrade your character and weapons, making you stronger and bringing you one step closer to beating the game. Whether you play co-op or brave the horrors of hell solo - Fight with a blade, bat or a variety of guns, power up and become a pro monster slayer.

Can you hold off the horde before they breach the Cabin? Do you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: Trombone Champ Unflattened: Disney Movie Magic Vol. 1
High on Life VR
games.summary: High On Life VR drops you into a hilarious first-person action adventure where humanity's fate hangs on your outrageous talking guns. Battle bizarre aliens, explore vibrant worlds, and uncover hidden secrets, now rebuilt for immersive virtual reality.

games.name: System Shock VR
games.summary: A virtual reality port of Nightdive Studios’ remake of the classic 1994 immersive sim. Rebuilt for Meta Quest, PlayStation VR2, and SteamVR, the game brings the atmospheric corridors of Citadel Station into VR, allowing players to experience its exploration, combat, puzzles, and cyberpunk horror from an immersive first-person perspective while facing the rogue AI SHODAN and her mutated and cybernetic forces.

events.name: Daedalic Days - Late at Night
events.description:
On August 13 at 9PM CEST / 12PM PST, we'll be going live with Daedalic Days - Late at Night, our biggest showcase dedicated to everything coming next from us and our development partners.

Expect brand-new announcements, exclusive reveals, fresh gameplay, updates on highly anticipated projects, and a few surprises along the way.

games.name: Barotrauma: Home & Harbor
games.summary: Home & Harbor is the upcoming expansion for Barotrauma. Introducing outpost ownership, building and management and a mysterious new faction: The Descendants, which will shake up the world of Europa's merry sailors.

games.name: Hordeguard: Winds of the North
games.summary: Gather resources, fortify your village, recruit your warband, and defend against waves of monsters. With the clock ticking, every decision counts – strategize quickly and act swiftly to ensure the survival of your village. Play solo or team up with a friend in local co-op mode.

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown
games.summary: Star Trek Voyager: Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

games.name: Ghost Haunting
games.summary: GHOST HAUNTING is a humorous 2D point-and-click adventure in wonderfully low resolution. A loving tribute to the graphic adventures of the 90s - with the best of then and the comfort of today. Grinsemuskelkater guaranteed (no liability for permanent damage)!

games.name: Woodo
games.summary: Woodo is a 3D puzzle game. The player immerses in a calm and peaceful world where time stopped at the happy moment. With imaginary friend Woodo, player build bit by bit this tiny world. Woodo tells the player stories and makes the player feel not lonely while playing. The game looks like a wooden kit from childhood.

games.name: Surviving Deponia
games.summary: Explore, craft, build and fight your way through the harsh landscape of Deponia. Meet allies and make enemies while surviving the perils of the junk planet. It might be garbage - but it’s your garbage!

events.name: Ukrainian Games Festival 2026
events.description: Ukrainian Games Festival 2026 is sponsored by Ternox Games, The Future Entertainment Company, Nitro Games, NOT A CAT Studio, and KIB Games.

games.name: Sarco
games.summary: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Tukoni: Forest Keepers
games.summary: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute and cozy puzzle adventure, based on a series of award-winning books by the Ukrainian artist Oksana Bula. Play as the forest spirit Tukoni as you meet unique characters, solve captivating puzzles, brew fragrant tea and explore a magical world filled with kindness.

games.name: DDoD
games.summary: DDoD is a single-player and co-op tactical roguelite shooter set in the near future, deep inside an abandoned industrial zone. Explore, fight, and mutate your way to the source of a semi-sentient biological AI anomaly.

games.name: Saturn 94
games.summary: You are the keeper of Orbita, a Soviet station orbiting Saturn. Keep the failing station alive, assemble cargo rockets, and supply the colonies. Supplies run short, and something aboard never made it into the reports. Obey orders, or defy the Party? Lives depend on you.

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: Sealbreakers
games.summary: A top-down 3D roguelite brawler where a disgraced warrior fights immortal tyrants in a collapsing reality. Break the world back with nothing but fists.

games.name: Tulpa the Unseen Lover
games.summary: Create yourself a perfect friend in this choice-driven visual novel. Love her, hate her, don't let her turn your life into a living hell.

games.name: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
games.summary: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

games.name: Floralis
games.summary: In the cruel and dangerous world of carnivorous plants, on the ruins of human civilization, our heroine is born. A child of trees and primitive genetic engineering. She will have to fight for her life, unravel the mysteries of the past and try to become something more.

games.name: Wolf Commando
games.summary: An explosive 80s-inspired top-down military shooter where skill, guts, and firepower decide everything. Choose your route and fight for the highest score.

games.name: Last Pirates: Die Together
games.summary: Last Pirates: Die Together is a cooperative pirate-themed horror game designed for up to 4 players. Join a loyal crew of scallywags on a high-stakes mission to scavenge mysterious islands and make your old captain rich.

games.name: Dreamfear
games.summary: Escape the nightmare filled with your own fears using various weapons and upgrades in a fast-paced, surreal roguelite. Can you survive in your own mind?

games.name: Magic Shop Chaos
games.summary: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

games.name: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock
games.summary: Tic-Tac: Twelve O’Clock is a survival horror game. Monitor corridors and rooms through surveillance cameras to counter vengeful ghosts. Keep the lights on, the generator charged, and fuses replaced… and don’t get caught!

games.name: Warfactory
games.summary: Warfactory fuses planet-scale automation with real-time strategy and lite 4X elements. Build sprawling factories, design modular robot armies, and lead thousands of units into battle. Conquer a galaxy with a supply chain — one conveyor belt at a time.

games.name: I'm not a Psycho Invader
games.summary: You've seized the university! Every floor is full of obstacles. Each hostage is valuable, dangerous, or a waste of time. Kill, search, or interrogate: everything costs time, and panic raises the price. Reach the roof before time runs out.

games.name: Chumaky
games.summary: Chumaky is a game about traveling, trading, farming, and building your own homestead. Discover mysterious locations and enjoy atmospheric landscapes.

games.name: Unguided
games.summary: Escape a digital prison, upload yourself back into the real world, and get revenge on the ones who framed you in this fast-paced challenging roguelike slasher

games.name: Stunt Paradise 2
games.summary: Stunt Paradise 2 - more speed, more explosions, more madness! Jump over ramps, dodge lasers, buzzsaws, and rockets while performing insane stunts. With new traps, improved graphics, and pure arcade chaos - get ready for the ultimate stunt challenge!

games.name: Hear My Light
games.summary: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

games.name: Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare
games.summary:
Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

games.name: Polystrike
games.summary: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

games.name: Balls & Gamble
games.summary: Balls & Gamble is a casino-inspired incremental game where you shoot a LOT of balls, earn money, buy upgrades, gamble, unlock new balls, and eventually break reality itself.

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Karting Core
games.summary: A single-player kart racing game focused on skill-based driving. Race across 10+ tracks, unlock 3 kart tiers, compete in 5 tournaments, customize your garage and camera, and master races, time trials, and drift challenges.

games.name: I Hear the Forest
games.summary: A slow-burn folk horror. You play as a forest ranger who finds himself surrounded by talking trees, flying witches' heads, and cursed dryads. You'll be very lucky if you make it out of the forest alive.

games.name: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
games.summary: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

games.name: We are Eva
games.summary: Play the game in multiple dimensions at the same time, traveling between them whenever you like! Doesn't it sound fun? My name is Eva, by the way, I'm the main protagonist of the game you're looking at, and I promise we'll have fun. If you add me to your wishlist, of course. *wink wink*

games.name: Rhythmkill
games.summary: Rhythmkill is a super-fast rhythm action game where your every kill strikes on the beat. Wall-run, dash, slide, and chain lightning-fast katana kills through neon-drenched arenas. Master the rhythm, maintain your momentum, and fight your way to the boss who imprisoned you.

games.name: Sal Terrae: in search of SALT
games.summary: Post-apocalyptic Mythpunk in Ukraine. Lead a chumak caravan on a perilous journey to Crimea for salt. Guide indirect dialogues as 12-year-old Oleksa and use Neuro-Tune to read and alter people's minds. A world of Ukrainian legends, tech artifacts, and tough choices awaits!

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Hourturn: Echoes of Time
games.summary: Hourturn is an atmospheric game that begins inside a large, constantly turning hourglass. You are a tiny grain of sand within it, striving to stop it and escape, but what awaits the grain of sand outside? Is this the only way to measure time?

games.name: White Clouds
games.summary: White Clouds is a cozy first-person game. An old house is waiting for someone to come back. You tend to repair old furniture, clean lakes, plant flowers, brew tea, and write haiku about what you see. Travellers climb up to visit. Find your peace above the clouds.

games.name: Fracture Point
games.summary: After years in prison, you return to a dark megacity ruled by a ruthless corporation. The only way forward is up—through countless floors of a heavily guarded skyscraper—to reach the corporation's leader and take your revenge.

games.name: Job Burnout
games.summary: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

games.name: Gutted: Infested Crypts
games.summary: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.

games.name: Her Last Wish
games.summary: «Her Last Wish» is a physics based 2D puzzle game made in a vintage, cardboard style. After his wife's death, the main character is left alone with her final request: care for a strange creature that lives deep in a cave near their home.

games.name: Moorko
games.summary: A quiet village engulfed in a mysterious fog. The animals have turned into aggressive beasts with glowing demonic eyes, and all the people have disappeared. Only a brave cat stands against the darkness!

games.name: Remote Reaper: FPV Drone
games.summary: FPV drone simulator. Destroy enemy vehicles with high-precision strikes. Simulation of electronic warfare and realistic armor model.

games.name: Jaden Industries
games.summary: Jaden Industries is a relaxing factory-building puzzle game about managing compact crafting chains across floating islands.

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Our Freedom
games.summary: Our Freedom is a medieval colony sim with action RPG adventures. Build a village, lead your people, produce food and materials, forge powerful weapons, recruit an army to protect your village in epic battles and castle sieges. Stand up for your people and help them defend their freedom!

games.name: Ministry of Truth: False Memory
games.summary: Ministry of Truth: False Memory is a story-driven simulator in a totalitarian society. Become an official, manipulate facts, rewrite history, and provide the ‘truth’ to the public. Choose: obey or fight against the regime. The Great Father is watching you!

games.name: Nocthra
games.summary: Nocthra is a grim retro-style game where you play as a necromancer defending waves of attackers by raising hordes of minions from fallen enemies' corpses. Protect your graveyard from relentless assaults, and dive into a perk system that offers endless skill combinations for infinite replayability.

games.name: Missi
games.summary: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

games.name: Agecraft
games.summary: Agecraft is a historical strategy and city-building game where players guide a civilization from the Stone Age to the space age. The game combines settlement building, resource management, and technological progression. Players construct cities, manage the economy, provide for their people, and expand across different eras, unlocking new buildings, production chains, and methods of transportation as history advances.

games.name: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
games.summary: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

games.name: Mutate! Fight! Purr!
games.summary: A roguelike deck-builder set in a twisted biblical world, where a lone cat mutates to survive the trials of heaven and the pit.

games.name: Radar Line
games.summary: Command a radar-guided air-defense network against drones, cruise missiles, and ballistic threats. Buy intelligence, deploy radars and launchers, manage a limited stock of interceptors, then investigate every breach before the next attack begins.

games.name: PROFITS 2167: Planetary Resource Optimization & Freight Infrastructure Technician Simulator
games.summary: Arcade train driving game about collecting, managing, and delivering resources with survivors-like and TD-like elements. Manage, upgrade, and defend mining stations, drive your train through the network of underground caves, grow numbers and multiply profits in a dark neocapitalistic future.

games.name: Invasia
games.summary: Invasia is a project for those who miss Sci-Fi horror games, but featuring cutting-edge visuals. You wake up alone to the distant wail of sirens. The bright corridors of the space station are gone, replaced by claustrophobic darkness. Something has gone dreadfully wrong.

games.name: VOID PRIEST
games.summary: You are the Void Priest, bound to an Elder God against your will. Guided only by relics, symbols, and light, solve eldritch mysteries and perform forbidden rituals. Survive long enough to choose whether you stay faithful or betray.

games.name: Angelo and Deemon 2: Too Hell of a Quest
games.summary: Angelo and Deemon are back in this point-and-click adventure! Angelo’s quest for viral fame leads him to Heaven, where divine mysteries and celestial puzzles await. Join him and Deemon as they meet heavenly beings and tackle divine dilemmas.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: Lucid Falls
games.summary: Manipulate gravity, space and time, and survive terrifying nightmares in a deeply atmospheric lucid dream. Facing terrifying creatures, and solving challenges that bend reality, every moment reveals more of the dark truth behind Lucid Falls.

games.name: No Signal: Chornobyl
games.summary: No Signal is a strictly online co-op psychological horror game set in the abandoned Chornobyl Exclusion Zone. Explore decaying towns, solve tasks together, and question everything—because you and your partner may not be seeing the same reality.

games.name: Fog'n'Silence
games.summary: Lead a group of vagrants through the surreal open world of the afterlife. Observe their journey through the eyes of a drone operator. Hide from blind monsters. Avoid malicious fog. Embrace the cycle. Survive. Escape.

games.name: Walk Hero
games.summary: Go forward. Kill enemies. Collect loot. Get stronger. And again. An unusual mix of genres will allow you to focus solely on the choice of equipment and upgrades.
